items.desc: Synes du det er gøy når modellene du har utviklet, faktisk øker både salg og bunnlinje med mange millioner kroner? … da er du kanskje vår nye kollega i vårt team for Prismodellering, som er en del av vårt område Prising & Analyse. Vi vet at tariffarbeidet er en hjørnestein i forsikring, og vi vet at vi gjennom avanserte modeller og metoder kan forbedre våre allerede ganske avanserte modeller, og vi leter etter dyktige folk som kunne tenke seg å være med. Om rollen Vi ser etter en person som kan løfte prismodellene våre til å bli enda bedre til risikoseleksjon. Det kan gjøres gjennom å utforske nye datakilder, ta i bruk nye metoder og modeller, samt automatisk overvåke og oppdatere tariffene. Du får oppleve: Muligheten til å jobbe med avanserte modeller som vi bruker til å fastsette prisen på våre forsikringer. All utvikling skjer i Databricks. En kultur hvor modellbaserte argumenter veier tyngre enn sjefers magefølelser. Tett sparring med andre analytikere og dataeksperter. Vi har en sterk faglig kultur, hvor vi kontinuerlig forbedrer hverandre. Nært samarbeid med våre kolleger i produktavdelingene, som vil være med på å sikre at arbeidet ditt blir anvendt i praksis. Vi tilbyr På samme måte som vi stiller høye krav til deg som medarbeider, forventer vi også, at du stiller høye krav til oss som arbeidsgiver. Dette er noen av fordelene med å jobbe i If: Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø der alle er velkomne Karriere- og utviklingsmuligheter i Nordens største forsikringsselskap Sosiale aktiviteter, kombinert med et faglig sterkt og kompetent miljø En fleksibel arbeidsplass med fokus på helse og trivsel, med bl.a. svært gode muligheter for fysisk trening inkludert en ukentlig treningstime i arbeidstiden Mulighet for hybrid arbeidsplass Konkurransedyktige betingelser, inkludert svært gode personalforsikringer og høy pensjonssparing, og rabatt på private forsikringer. Om avdelingen Vi er mange og engasjerte analytikere. Her er det plass til forskjellige personligheter, og vi streber etter å skape en arbeidsplass som gir deg rom til å være deg selv. Vi er forskjellige i alder og erfaring, og vi tenker selv at vi er ganske dyktige, så du må også ha “nerdepotensiale” og lyst til å jobbe sammen med de beste. Du blir en del av vår svært kompetente analyse- og prissettingsavdeling, som jobber på tvers av våre forretningsområder Motor, Eiendom og Person. Vi hjelper forretningsområdene med å utvikle de beste prismodellene ved å utforske nye datakilder og ny metodikk. Ansvarsområdene inkluderer også kundeprising og produksjonssetting av priser. Vi er en del av en nordisk analyse- og prisingsorganisasjon, og samarbeider med våre søsteravdelinger i Sverige, Danmark og Finland. Hvem er du? Vi ser etter deg som kan kjenne deg igjen i begeistringen av å finne en ny forklarende variabel, og som også kjenner at du bli frustrert hvis analysene dine legges på hyllen til senere. Vi ser for oss at du har noen års erfaring med å utvikle avanserte modeller i finanssektoren, konsulenthus, på universitetet eller lignende. Du har også en solid bakgrunn i programmering og bruk av datavarehus. For å lykkes er det en fordel at du har lyst til å bruke erfaringene dine til noe konkret, og er i stand til å konkretisere og formidle resultatene dine til andre. Du har også: Mastergrad som statistiker, fysiker, matematiker eller lignende Erfaring med Python og sql Gode norsk/skandinavisk språkkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig Tilleggsinformasjon og rekrutteringsprosessen Søknadsfrist : 29.november 2026 For å søke : Last opp CVen din og vitnemål, og svar på noen kjappe spørsmål, i stedet for å skrive et søknadsbrev Rekrutteringsprosessen : For en mer rettferdig rekrutteringsprosess bruker vi tester som en del av rekrutteringsprosessen for å vurdere potensial og match med stillingen. A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem. items.desc: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role We're looking for a Cloud SDET Engineer II to join the team building CrowdStrike's AI Gateway. The gateway provides a common way for applications to access AI models across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and other providers, handling authentication, routing, usage controls, and the differences between provider APIs. You'll build the test frameworks, tools, and automation needed to validate the gateway across real cloud environments. This includes testing provider integrations, API compatibility, streaming, performance, and failure scenarios. This is a coding-heavy role. You'll work directly with backend engineers, investigate problems across services and cloud providers, and help ensure new functionality can be reliably tested and shipped without depending on manual regression testing. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks for our AI Gateway, backend services, and cloud integrations. Develop end-to-end, integration, API, and regression tests covering gateway functionality across multiple AI providers. Test integrations with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other model providers. Automate cloud authentication scenarios involving API keys, IAM roles, role assumption, service accounts, and identity federation. Validate AI API behavior, including streaming responses, tool calling, embeddings, multimodal requests, and provider-specific error handling. Test gateway functionality such as routing, retries, failover, rate limits, quotas, budgets, authentication, authorization, and usage metering. Build reusable test utilities, provider mocks, simulators, and automated cloud test environments. Develop performance, load, and resilience tests, including provider outages, throttling, timeouts, network failures, and partial responses. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, improve test reliability, and reduce feedback time for developers. Investigate defects using logs, metrics, traces, and source code, and turn production issues into automated regression tests. Work closely with software engineers on feature design, testability, and quality throughout the development lifecycle. What You'll Need 2+ years of experience in software development, SDET, test automation, or a similar engineering role. Strong programming skills in Go, Python, Java, or another modern programming language. Hands-on experience developing automated testing frameworks and tools, beyond writing individual test cases. Experience testing backend services, REST APIs, and integrations between distributed systems. Good understanding of HTTP, JSON, networking fundamentals, authentication, and common failure scenarios. Comfortable working with Linux, Git, Docker, and debugging tools. Ability to read production code, investigate failures across services, and identify root causes. Solid understanding of test design, regression testing, negative testing, and automated integration testing. Ability to work independently on assigned features and collaborate effectively with other engineers. Bonus Points: Experience with Go for backend development or test automation. Experience testing API gateways, proxies, microservices, or cloud infrastructure platforms. Familiarity with LLM APIs and providers such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI, or Anthropic. Experience testing streaming protocols such as Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets, or gRPC. Experience with performance and load-testing tools such as k6, Locust, or JMeter. Familiarity with OAuth/OIDC, IAM, RBAC, SSO, and enterprise identity systems. Experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or distributed tracing. Experience testing …

items.desc: Job Overview About the Role: This entry-level role is your chance to turn raw data into critical insights that guide decision-making across our entire organisation. You'll collaborate directly with Sales, Product Owners, and Senior Management and others, gaining exposure to a wide range of business functions. We are looking for a motivated, collaborative, kind, and humble individual to join our team. You'll get hands-on with our modern data stack—think GCP, BigQuery, DBT, and Airflow—to build robust data solutions. This is more than just running queries; you'll help teams define their data needs and build the data models and Looker dashboards that answer their most pressing questions. For a recent graduate, this is a unique opportunity to apply your knowledge, master in-demand technologies, and see your work make a tangible impact. We foster a collaborative environment where you'll be encouraged to learn, communicate effectively, and leverage our AI-assisted development workflow to enhance analysis and build solutions more efficiently. Responsibilities and impact: OSTTRA has the largest financial institutions in the world as clients. We believe that long-term value to the client is the most important goal of our team, and technology is the tool to bring that value, and your contribution in the form of delivery, improvements and innovations can have a significant impact on the financial system. Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their challenges and translate them into data requirements. Report and Dashboard Development: Design, build, and maintain interactive and user-friendly dashboards and reports in Looker. Iterate on and enhance existing reports based on user feedback and evolving business needs. Data Modelling & Transformation: Use DBT to transform, model, and test data within our data warehouse, preparing it for analysis. Contribute to the development and maintenance of our Airflow managed data pipelines to ensure data is accurate, timely, and reliable. Work with data engineers to improve data quality, consistency, and ingestion processes. Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, present findings, and provide data-driven recommendations. Clearly communicate complex insights and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Continuous Learning: Stay curious and up-to-date with the latest trends in our tech stack (GCP, BigQuery, DBT, Looker) and the broader data analytics field. Proactively seek opportunities for skill development and training, including leveraging our internal AI-assisted tools. What's in it for you: We strongly believe in individual growth and have long experience in guiding early careers engineers in our modern approach to software production, which includes: Rapid, iterative and phased delivery, backed by automated testing and deployment frameworks. Streamlined, autonomous and independent teams, optimised and supported for fast change. Clean architecture for maintainable, scalable, and flexible code, aligned with the team structures and with clear boundaries and responsibilities. A genuine eagerness to learn, grow, and take on new challenges in the data field. Exposure to version control (e.g., Git) and cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure). Innovation is at the core of NDT Global's mission. We continuously challenge the boundaries of existing technologies to deliver transformational solutions that empower the industry to achieve safer, more cost-effective pipeline management. Our commitment to research and development drives the creation of vital new methods and tools that address the evolving needs of our customers while setting new industry standards. By strategically applying inspection technologies to detect, diagnose, and model various types of threats, NDT Global provides predictive, decision-ready insights. The role contributes to both new product development and the enhancement of existing products by improving performance, reliability, safety, and cost effectiveness. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, the Mechanical Design Engineer collaborates closely with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and operations teams to deliver robust solutions that support NDT Global's pipeline inspection technologies. items.card: In this role, you will be the driving force behind how raw particle track data is transformed into precise 3D density reconstructions. Working in a fast-paced environment with access to multi-GeV beamlines and collaborative partnerships across the energy, defense, aerospace, and security industries, your work will directly empower critical pass/fail quality control assessments for high-stakes metallic and ceramic
items.desc: Join a pioneering deep-tech team developing safe, rapid, and accurate active muon imaging solutions tailored for industrial quality assessment, security and customs inspection, and advanced medical diagnostics. Operating at the intersection of advanced particle physics, cutting-edge AI, and next-generation particle detectors, our platform delivers high-resolution 3D imaging with automated decision-making. In this role, you will be the driving force behind how raw particle track data is transformed into precise 3D density reconstructions. Working in a fast-paced environment with access to multi-GeV beamlines and collaborative partnerships across the energy, defense, aerospace, and security industries, your work will directly empower critical pass/fail quality control assessments for high-stakes metallic and ceramic components—ranging from rocket engines and gas turbines to nuclear and industrial systems. Key Responsibilities & Core Tasks End-to-End Reconstruction Ownership: Take complete ownership of the pipeline that converts raw particle tracks into accurate 3D density maps, directly influencing the mission-critical decisions made by industrial clients. Algorithm Evolution: Advance reconstruction methodologies smoothly from foundational approaches like Point of Closest Approach (POCA) and Algebraic Scattering Reconstruction (ASR) to sophisticated likelihood-optimization frameworks. Grid Performance Optimization: Explore and deploy adaptive or multi-resolution reconstruction grids designed to strategically trade off resolution against memory constraints and processing speed. Advanced Uncertainty Modeling: Leverage the narrow energy bandwidth of the muon beam to compute rigorous, per-track error weights rather than relying on generalized global constants. Multi-Modal Data Fusion: Integrate external priors—such as high-resolution optical scans, computer vision data, and digital object geometry—directly into reconstructions as hard constraints to tighten the solution space. High-Flux Track Statistics: Develop robust statistical and algorithmic solutions to resolve track pile-up and hit-ambiguity issues in particle detectors operating under high-flux conditions where multiple particles register simultaneously. Production Software Delivery: Move far beyond temporary research scripts. Package and maintain standalone software tools featuring fixed, reliable input/output formats designed for long-term operational use. Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Partner closely with internal cross-functional teams and external research institutions across the globe to refine imaging capabilities and field-test solutions. Requirements & Candidate Profile Educational Background: A Doctorate (PhD / Dr.) degree in physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or a closely related technical field is strictly required. Professional Experience: Minimum post-doctoral experience required, with a strong preference for candidates bringing a few years of dedicated post-doctoral research background. Technical & Scientific Must-Haves: Deep expertise in tomographic reconstruction, specifically having implemented POCA, ASR, or equivalent scattering-tomography algorithms, with the capability to pivot to likelihood optimization when point-based limits are reached. Proven experience with numerical performance optimization, including building adaptive or multi-resolution grids. Demonstrated skill in tracking-detector physics, including resolving particle hit ambiguities and high-flux pile-up. Hands-on experience with multi-modal data fusion and uncertainty modeling at the individual track level. Production software engineering capabilities, successfully transitioning research code into maintained, robust software packages. Language Proficiency: At least full professional proficiency in English (C1 level); proficiency in German or Estonian is considered a valuable bonus. Logistics & Availability: Available to start work by January 2027 or, at the latest, February 2027. Open to occasional international travel to collaborate at various global research facilities and partner labs. Willing to work in a hybrid setup based out of our primary research hub. Personality & Working Culture Ownership & Drive: You prefer shipping complete, reliable tools over throwing together quick research scripts. You embrace accountability and treat outside parameters as definitive constraints. Curiosity & Rigor: When assumptions break, you find it fascinating rather than frustrating. You insist on validating and testing your models against real physical objects. Collaborative Spirit: You thrive in a compact, autonomous "skunkworks" team where titles matter less than clear thinking. You are comfortable debating ideas vigorously ("disagree together, commit together") and executing as a unified team. Compensation & Benefits Package Base Salary: €60,000 to €80,000 per year, commensurate with background and expertise. Equity Program: A substantial employee equity package …

items.desc: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings. We have offices in Paris and Amsterdam, and offer remote working from Germany, France, the Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London. You should apply if You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less. You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space. You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically. You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before. In this role, you will Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value. Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice. Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost. Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script. Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to. Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce. Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events. items.desc: Guy’s and St Thomas’ Echocardiography Department Highly Specialist Cardiac Physiologist (Echocardiographer) Band 7 This role is in receipt of short-term Recruitment & Retention Premia (RRP). This supplementary payment will be reviewed annually Be part of an extraordinary team. We are seeking to recruit a qualified echocardiographer to join our renowned department on a fixed term, 9 month contract to cover maternity leave. We have a strong record in research and developing new clinical services and patterns of working. We have been instrumental in developing national standards for echocardiography and for developing the new clinical scientist discipline. At an individual level we focus on role development with scientist-led valve, ACHD, cardio-oncology and ICC screening clinics and our own TOE and bubble lists. Opportunities for continuing professional development are excellent. Health Education England have commissioned five HSST (Higher Specialist Scientific Training) posts in Cardiac Science here at GSTT in recent years. We are actively encouraging our echocardiographers to seek equivalence via the Academy for Healthcare Science and become registered with the Health and Care Professions Council as Clinical Scientists. Our five echo-specialist cardiologists have wide ranging interests including stress echo, 3D, valve disease, heart failure, CRT and adult congenital heart disease. Our working days run from 8am until 6pm and weekend work is routine. Flexible working (including annualised hours) is available for our staff. Currently work is carried out across three sites (St Thomas’, Guys and Tessa Jowell Health Centre in East Dulwich). Successful candidates will be part of a rotation to give you widespread exposure across all three sites. This position would suit an echocardiographer with a good grounding in transthoracic echocardiography and an interest in maintaining their skills within a specialist area. BSE accreditation or an equivalent qualification is essential. Please do not apply unless you have full BSE, EACVI or equivalent echo accreditation. St Thomas’ is situated in the heart of London immediately opposite the Houses of Parliament and Guy’s is at London Bridge, opposite The Shard. Both hospitals have excellent transport links and an on-site nursery, along with a wide range of further innovative programmes and resources to help you enjoy a healthy lifestyle and maintain a great work/life balance. Job Summary This position is for a BSE accredited (or equivalent), independently reporting echocardiographer. The post holder will perform their own transthoracic echo lists and provide reports and expert opinions to other health professionals. Perform 3D echocardiograms with appropriate record keeping, interpretation and archiving. Perform contrast/bubble contrast echocardiography including keeping adequate stock levels of consumables, record keeping, interpretation and patient safety. Perform complex dyssynchrony studies pre and post device implant including appropriate analysis and archiving. Perform other highly specialist technical and specialist technical roles as required …

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. The aim is for you to develop the practical judgement and independence to take on – and eventually lead – increasingly substantial work. From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve. items.desc: Who We Are Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world. What We Offer Salary: €30,400.00 - €41,800.00 Location: Treviso,ITA You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. As a Process Engineer, you'll play a crucial role in designing and optimizing manufacturing processes for display and semiconductor manufacturing technologies. You will collect and analyze data, perform hardware characterization, and troubleshoot engineering issues. You'll also measure film properties, generate technical documentation, and engage with customers to resolve concerns. Process Engineers collaborate with vendors and suppliers, and become familiar with implementing new technologies and products. You will experiment, learn, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the semiconductor and display industries, partnering with our globally recognized R&D teams on state-of-the-art research and development projects. We are looking for a Process Engineer passionate about Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to join our R&D team within the Metrology Department. Key Responsabilities Develop and integrate AI-driven techniques for image analysis, defect detection, data modeling, and signal processing in high-tech applications for the Photonics Industry. Design and implement software solutions for machine vision systems and vision-based inspection. Define experimental methods for performance evaluation (e.g., detection precision, algorithm repeatability, reproducibility, sensitivity, failure analysis). Perform hands-on testing and debugging with vision systems to validate algorithms and ensure reliability. What We’re Looking For Degree in ICT, Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Automation Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, AI & Automation Engineering, Cybersecurity, Physics, Mathematics, or similar. Strong theoretical background in machine vision, image processing, or software development. Knowledge of optics is a plus. Willingness to travel. Programming skills in C++, C# (other languages are a bonus). Soft skills: autonomy, teamwork, proactivity. items.desc: Business Analyst Data & AI | Fulltime Word jij enthousiast van ontdekken welk probleem er écht achter die vraag zit? Gaat jouw hart sneller kloppen van data en houd je stiekem ook nog eens van processen slimmer maken? Dan zouden we zomaar goed bij elkaar kunnen passen. Werken bij TADA betekent werken in een klein, hecht team van nieuwsgierige en gedreven aanpakkers. We maken data en AI begrijpelijk en praktisch toepasbaar. Niet door vanaf de zijlijn dikke rapporten te schrijven, maar door samen met onze klanten de organisatie in te duiken, kansen te ontdekken en oplossingen te bouwen die echt gebruikt worden. Als Business Analyst Data & AI ben jij daarin de persoonlijke gids. Je luistert, vraagt door en brengt structuur aan in complexe vraagstukken. Je onderzoekt hoe een organisatie nu werkt, waar waarde verloren gaat en welke verbetering de meeste impact kan maken. Vervolgens vertaal je dit samen met onze data- en software-engineers naar een concrete data- of AI-oplossing. Het mooiste moment? Wanneer alles samenkomt en de klant denkt: “Wauw, dus dít is mogelijk.” Zo’n echt TADA-moment. Daar doen we het voor. Wat bieden wij jou? Bij TADA krijg je veel ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en direct invloed te hebben op onze klanten, werkwijze en groei. Je krijgt van ons: Salaris tussen €45.000 en €65.000 per jaar, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring; 28 vakantiedagen per jaar; 8% vakantiegeld; Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden; Flexibele thuiswerkmogelijkheden voor een goede werk- en privébalans; Een informele en collegiale werksfeer met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief; Fantastische werkplek op Strijp-S in het iconische Klokgebouw in Eindhoven; Een snelle laptop met de nieuwste AI toepassingen; Reiskostenvergoeding; De mogelijkheid om 4 weken per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken. Je krijgt bij ons geen volledig dichtgetimmerde functie. We kijken samen waar je goed in bent, wat je wilt leren en hoe jouw rol kan meegroeien met TADA. Wat ga je doen? Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: voorbereiden en begeleiden van klantinterviews en workshops; analyseren en modelleren van bedrijfsprocessen, bijvoorbeeld met BPMN; achterhalen van de werkelijke vraag achter een eerste klantverzoek; identificeren en prioriteren van verbeterkansen en data- en AI-use-cases; opstellen van value maps, baselines en gewenste resultaten; vertalen van klantvragen naar requirements, wireframes en datamodellen; schrijven en beheren van features, user stories en acceptatiecriteria in Azure DevOps; afstemmen met data- en software-engineers tijdens de realisatie; organiseren van korte validatiemomenten met klanten en eindgebruikers; bewaken van scope, acties en inhoudelijke voortgang; ondersteunen bij adoptie en het meten van gerealiseerde klantwaarde; onderhouden van een roadmap voor volgende implementatiewaves; herkennen welke oplossingen herbruikbaar zijn voor andere klanten. Je hoeft zelf geen engineer te zijn. Affiniteit met data en AI is wel belangrijk: je wilt begrijpen wat technisch mogelijk is en kunt hierover helder communiceren met zowel klanten als engineers. Wat verwachten we van jou? We zoeken bij voorkeur een medior die snel zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid kan nemen. Maar ben je een ambitieuze starter met sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden? Dan nodigen we je ook uit om te reageren. Je brengt in ieder geval mee: hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau; een combinatie van analytisch vermogen en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden; het vermogen om zelfstandig klantinterviews te voeren en door te vragen; ervaring met of duidelijke interesse in consultancy, data en procesverbetering; het vermogen om een complexe vraag om te zetten naar concrete requirements; initiatief: je wacht niet af, maar organiseert wat nodig is om verder te komen; een kritische blik: je legt niet alleen vast wat een klant vraagt, maar onderzoekt wat werkelijk waarde toevoegt; professioneel Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en goede beheersing van Engels. Past dit bij jou? Word jij blij van complexe vragen, slimme verbeteringen en klanten die ineens zien wat er met data en AI mogelijk is? Wil je veel verantwoordelijkheid, maar ook collega’s om mee te sparren en samen te bouwen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Je zorgt ervoor dat data beschikbaar, betrouwbaar en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie door data pipelines, dashboards en integraties te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Rail Innovators Group. AI vormt daarbij een waardevolle aanvulling op de rol, maar de basis ligt in data engineering en business intelligence. Je werkt aan uiteenlopende vraagstukken, van stuurinformatie voor de business tot innovatieve AI-toepassingen die processen slimmer en efficiënter maken. Rail Innovators Group Rail Innovators Group, opgericht in 2005 en gevestigd in Rotterdam, is een internationale specialist in goederenvervoer per spoor. Met meer dan 250 railprofessionals zijn wij actief in 23 landen en vervoeren wij jaarlijks meer dan 6 miljoen ton aan vracht. Onze moderne vloot bestaat uit hoogwaardige locomotieven, een breed scala aan wagons en intermodale units. Daarmee bieden wij flexibele, betrouwbare en duurzame transportoplossingen in heel Europa en daarbuiten. Via onze vier bedrijven Raillogix, Rail Force One, Railrelease en CWS verzorgen wij de volledige railketen: van planning en tractie tot leasing en onderhoud. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt aan uiteenlopende data- en AI-vraagstukken die bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en verdere digitalisering van de organisatie. Je werkt vanuit een backlog en roadmap, waarbij je samen met de business bepaalt welke oplossingen de meeste waarde toevoegen. Daarbij schakel je met verschillende stakeholders, van finance en operations tot directie. Concreet betekent dit dat je: Data pipelines bouwt en onderhoudt Verschillende databronnen integreert en ontsluit Dashboards en rapportages ontwikkelt waarmee de business kan sturen De data-architectuur verder professionaliseert en verbetert Businessvragen vertaalt naar concrete data-oplossingen Prioriteiten stelt op basis van impact en business value Werkt binnen een Agile omgeving met tweewekelijkse sprints Actief meebouwt aan de verdere AI-volwassenheid van de organisatie Wie ben jij? Iemand die analytisch sterk is, zelfstandig werkt en energie krijgt van complexe vraagstukken. Je vindt het leuk om techniek en business met elkaar te verbinden en durft kritisch mee te denken wanneer een antwoord niet de juiste oplossing lijkt. items.desc: Stellenbeschreibung Deine Leidenschaft sind innovative Public-Cloud-Lösungen? Begriffe wie AI, LLM, Cloud-Native und DevOps wecken Dein Interesse? Dann werde Teil vom CGI Cloud-Engineering-Team, um gemeinsam unsere Kunden auf das nächste Transformationslevel zu heben! Wir suchen Talente wie Dich, die als Teil unseres Cloud & DevOps Clusters kreative Lösungen entwerfen und im Team umsetzen. CGI ist einer der TOP 5 IT & Consulting Dienstleister weltweit. Deutschlandweit bauen wir unser Cloud-Architecture, Governance und Security-Center weiter aus und Du kannst zukünftig dabei sein. In unserem wachsenden Team triffst Du auf flache Hierarchien, eine fachnahe Führung und kannst Deine Expertise in einem dynamischen und agilen Umfeld stetig erweitern. Neben freier Hardware-Wahl (Windows oder MacBook) und einem iPhone u. a. zur Privatnutzung bieten wir eine Gewinnbeteiligung sowie ein Mentoringprogramm für Deinen idealen Start bei CGI. Flexibles Arbeiten ist selbstverständlich, genauso wie die offenen Türen Deiner Kollegen und das „Du“. Du willst Teil unseres weltweiten Netzwerkes von IT-Vordenkern werden? Dann mach Deinen nächsten Sprint bei uns! Aufgaben Als Teil eines interdisziplinären Cloud-Engineering-Teams übernimmst Du Verantwortung im Rahmen von Projekten und Services in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Architecture-Kollegen und unseren Kunden. In dieser Tätigkeit implementierst Du moderne Cloud- und AI-Technologien, lebst das Cloud-First Mindset und setzt die Dev(Sec)Ops Kultur, Prozesse und Tools um. Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen: Du nutzt cloudbasierte Plattformen wie Microsoft Azure zur Implementierung von Infrastruktur und integrierst AI-gestützte Lösungen in bestehende Cloud-Architekturen Du entwickelst und implementierst Anwendungen u. a. mit Fokus auf AI unter Einsatz von Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI und Machine Learning Du sprichst Infrastructure as Code (IaC) und lebst “automate everything” (vorrangig auf Basis von Terraform) Du kennst Dich im Portfolio der Azure Cloud aus und kennst die Vor- und Nachteile der verschiedenen Lösungen – IaaS oder Paas? SaaS oder Marketplace Offering? Du unterstützt in „Shared Service“-Bereichen, die für jede Umgebung unerlässlich sind – Netzwerk (DNS, Firewalling, Loadbalancing), Monitoring & Logging, OS-Betrieb (vorrangig Linux), CI/CD Pipelines etc. Du bringst Erfahrung mit MLOps-Ansätzen mit und hilfst, Machine-Learning-Modelle effizient zu entwickeln, zu deployen und zu skalieren Du möchtest Dich entlang des Azure-Zertifizierungspfades in einem Team mit über 70 Experten entwickeln und Dein Wissen im Bereich Cloud & AI kontinuierlich ausbauen Erste Erfahrungen in Deinen Aufgaben sind uns wichtig, allerdings sind Erfahrungen in allen Bereichen nicht zwingend notwendig. Du bist System Engineer oder Linux Admin und möchtest Deine Entwicklung in Richtung Cloud & AI starten? In all Deinen Aufgaben wirst Du stets durch Dein Team und unsere Principle Architects sowie Senior Engineers unterstützt. Lass uns Deinen Entwicklungsplan zusammen mit Deinen Mentoren planen! Qualifikation Neben der Leidenschaft für Cloud- und AI-Engineering bringst Du ein informationstechnisches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit und hast Berufserfahrung in der Implementierung von IT-Architekturen in Zusammenspiel mit cloudbasierten Services und Plattformen und AI-Technologien. Außerdem bringst Du folgende Fähigkeiten mit: Kenntnisse in den Methodiken der agilen Vorgehensweise und Dev(Sec)Ops Kultur Erfahrung mit AI-gestützten Lösungen und Azure AI Services, Machine Learning oder MLOps Wissen zu den aktuellen Cloud-Service-Portfolios der Big Player (Azure, AWS, GCP) Professionelle Kommunikationsfähigkeit in Deutsch und Englisch Hohe Eigenverantwortlichkeit und Proaktivität Zertifizierungen für Azure, AI/ML oder Terraform sind von Vorteil Was wir bieten Bei uns findest Du Kolleg*innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos - wir sehen uns als multi-nationaler Heimathafen für Cloud-Enthusiasten, nicht als fachliches Silo. Wir fördern gezielt den Austausch innerhalb des Teams – wöchentliche Brownbags und regelmäßige TechDays sowie DeepDives und PoCs sind Teil unseres Spirits. Deine fachliche Weiterbildung und Entwicklung ist uns wichtig – CGI finanziert relevante Zertifizierungen (z. B. Microsoft, AWS, Hashicorp, CNCF). Deine persönliche Entwicklung steuern Du und Dein Manager gemeinsam – jährlich legen wir zusammen individuelle Ziele für das Fiskaljahr fest. Hierbei gestaltest Du federführend Deine Entwicklung mit, welche auch über einen langjährigen Personal-Development-Plan geplant werden kann. Einen Teil Deines Bruttogehalts kannst Du in CGI-Aktien investieren – bis maximal 3 % des Monatsgehalts geben wir für jeden Euro einen weiteren hinzu. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. items.desc: In order to develop and expand the capabilities of SAFRAN Engineering Services in the UK, we are looking to recruit an AI Software Engineer to work on major programmes within the Engineering Methods & Tools Department. You will contribute directly to the design, development, testing and deployment of AI solutions supporting engineering activities. Working onsite, you will work closely with AI software engineers, data scientists, product owners and engineering stakeholders to deliver practical, reliable and efficient solutions that improve productivity and support innovation within Safran Landing Systems Engineering. The role is initially for 12m, but may extend up to 24 months, and with a start on 30/11/2026. The role is based in Gloucester. For the initial period (usually 3 months), the AI Software Engineer will be based full time onsite, then depending on priorities and dependencies, there may be an opportunity to operate in hybrid model, for up to two days working from home per week. Key activities of this job include the following: Hands-on development: Prototype, design and test AI and machine-learning solutions for engineering applications Software implementation: Build maintainable and scalable ML systems and AI solutions Data Pipeline Management: Manage data pipelines and ensuring data quality. Deployment and support: Support solution integration, cloud deployment, maintenance and transition into operation Teamwork: Work efficiently as part of the AI Software Engineering team, share progress, contribute to reviews and support collective delivery Troubleshooting: Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve problems with deployed AI systems Continuous improvement: Promote and implement AI best practices and continuous improvement Documentation: Document all steps in the development process Requirements Right to work in the UK now and in the future 1-5 years' experience Programming Languages: Python, Java Experience with LLM, machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and computer vision Strong background in software engineering principles, including deployment and maintenance of AI systems Cloud Computing: Knowledge of cloud platforms; experience with AWS is an advantage Databases: Experience with databases and data stores Data Analysis: Statistical analysis, data visualization Communication: Strong communication skills to collaborate with other team members Benefits IF THE EMPLOYED ROUTE (fixed term) IS CHOSEN: Early finish on a Friday (midday) 5 weeks holiday per year plus statutory bank holidays Personal pension scheme whereby 5% contribution from employee and 8% from employer plus salary sacrifice Death in service life insurance - covering up to 4x annual basic salary in the event of death in service Health insurance (Bupa) PEGI Share Scheme Career development within Safran Group Training & development are a focus Onsite canteen IF THE CONTRACTOR ROUTE IS CHOSEN: Early finish on a Friday (midday) Onsite canteen

items.desc: Interested in a career that matters? Are you excited about using data, advanced analytics, and AI? Join Quality Insights and Optimization and help transform Quality from traditional reactive control and follow-up toward predictive, data-driven operations. You will become part of a team of independent experts working to challenge the status quo, drive continuous improvement and use data, AI and automation to create smarter ways of working. Today, the team includes statisticians, a data scientist and strategic project managers, and we are expanding our capabilities to accelerate process optimization and AI-driven innovation across Quality. Together, we challenge the status quo, drive continuous improvement, and turn data into action and measurable business impact. The role & your impact As Quality Data Scientist, you will help build the trusted data foundation and analytical models behind AI-enabled Quality solutions. Your focus will be on execution and optimization, working globally with colleagues across Quality and other stakeholders who depend on quality-related data, insights, and solutions. Your key responsibilities will be to: Build trusted data foundations: Prepare quality-related data for AI and advanced analytics, while monitoring data quality, accuracy, accessibility, and performance. Develop advanced analytical and AI solutions: Create robust methodologies to extract and interpret quantitative and text data and develop solutions using machine learning and advanced AI approaches, including generative AI and large language models. Bring solutions into daily use: Own relevant production-ready solutions from implementation and training through continuous improvement, and support solution teams in keeping models reliable in daily use. Turn data into actionable insights: Create transparency across quality systems through trends, visualizations, and Power BI dashboards that enable informed decision-making. Demonstrate business value: Track usage and relevant KPIs to provide insight into the benefit realization of AI solutions. Strengthen responsible data practices: Define and apply governance for selected quality data in line with applicable data security, classification, and privacy requirements. What You’ll Need To Be Successful We are looking for someone who combines strong data science capabilities with the ability to apply them in a business environment. You bring: A master’s degree or equivalent in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field. Experience preparing and working with complex structured and/or unstructured data, developing analytical or AI models. Experience with developing machine learning, AI solutions and model deployment. A strong understanding of data quality, governance, and management. The ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across functions. Awareness of data security and responsible AI practices. The ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to non-technical audiences. Fluency in written and spoken English. Additional Skills & Interests We Value We value someone who is curious and proactive, thrives in a dynamic and changing environment, and brings a structured, quality-focused approach. You are comfortable taking initiative and working independently while building trust across functions and delivering through collaboration and influence. Experience with technologies such as Python, KNIME, Power BI, Databricks, Copilot Studio, and GitHub would be valuable. What We Offer You You will join a specialist team with an ambitious agenda; helping shape the next generation of data-driven Quality operations. This role gives you an opportunity to work where data science, AI, Quality, and business transformation intersect, collaborating globally and contributing to solutions designed to create measurable impact. As the team expands its capabilities across process optimization, AI enablement, strategic portfolio management, and data science, you will have the opportunity to help shape new ways of working and contribute your expertise in an environment built around continuous improvement. Ways of working The position is based in Denmark and involves collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders globally. You should expect approximately 0–5 travel days per year. We work according to an office-first principle, with the option to work from home 1–2 days per week after a successful onboarding. Application deadline: November 8th, 2026. We will screen incoming applications and invite for interviews continuously during the application period, so please apply as soon as possible. Please note that we only accept applications via our Career Site. Contact information: Senior Manager, Quality Insights and Optimization, Christina Lanz Rubæk at CHLZ@novonesis.com. items.desc: Wil jij bedrijfskundige inzichten combineren met slimme automatisering ? Als Financieel & Bedrijfskundig AI Specialist bij Gusella Bakker in Elst stap je in op een uniek moment. We hebben grote stappen gezet in interne automatisering , digitalisering en procesoptimalisatie , en nu het fundament staat, ben jij degene die de volgende stap zet . In deze brede rol (waarbij je nauw samenwerkt met onze Finance Manager, Stefan) kijk je verder dan alleen de cijfers. Je analyseert de bedrijfsprocessen, zorgt ervoor dat we organisatie breed efficiënter gaan werken en maakt ons klaar voor een datagedreven toekomst. Jouw rol ontwikkelt zich continu: door terugkerende processen te automatiseren, ontstaat er structureel meer tijd voor diepgaande analyses, procesoptimalisaties en innovatieve AI-projecten. Jouw rol en verantwoordelijkheden Je start op de financiële afdeling en leert de organisatie snel van binnenuit kennen, waarbij je continu met een bedrijfskundige bril naar onze informatiestromen kijkt. Je verdeelt je tijd globaal over vier pijlers: Traditionele Finance / Controlling: Je draait (in de beginfase) zo'n twee dagen per week operationeel mee in de boekhouding . Je werkt aan kostprijsberekeningen, periodieke rapportages en budgetten. Je kijkt kritisch mee naar marges en ondersteunt op basis hiervan beslissingen van het management. Organisatie brede procesoptimalisatie: Je gaat proactief de organisatie in. Door in gesprek te gaan met collega's van alle afdelingen, haal je op hoe de huidige werkprocessen precies lopen. Je brengt deze losse informatiestromen in kaart en verbindt ze met elkaar om efficiëntie en overzicht te creëren. Data, Power BI & ERP-optimalisatie : Onze kernsystemen, waaronder het ERP-pakket Ridder iQ, zijn onlangs flink geprofessionaliseerd. Jij benut deze systemen ten volle door ruwe bedrijfs- en financiële data te vertalen naar glasheldere stuurinformatie en (management) dashboards via bijv. Power BI. AI-testen, automatisering & innovatie : Richting onze digitaliseringsstrategie voor 2027–2030 verken je de kansen van Artificial Intelligence . Je onderzoekt praktische toepassingen van diverse tools. Daarnaast schrijf je mee aan het digitaliseringsbeleid en elimineert tijdrovende handelingen door slimme automatisering. Daarnaast onderzoek je hoe we verschillende systemen naadloos met elkaar kunnen integreren. Denk hierbij aan het creëren van een datagedreven en vloeiende workflow vanuit engineering (Inventor), via ons ERP (Ridder iQ), direct naar de productie (de shopfloor). Hiermee zorg je voor gestroomlijnde werkprocessen voor inkoop, productie en management. Wat je meebrengt Jij bent een ambitieuze starter of young professional die bedrijfskundig inzicht feilloos weet te combineren met een passie voor data en procesoptimalisatie. Verder breng je mee: Een Hbo-opleiding in Finance & Control, Bedrijfseconomie of (Technische) Bedrijfskunde. 0 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarbij je analytisch en procesmatig hebt leren kijken. Nieuwsgierigheid naar de nieuwste AI-trends en het vermogen om deze strategisch toe te passen binnen onze processen. Ervaring in de maakindustrie is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Wat je kunt verwachten Werken bij Gusella Bakker betekent bouwen aan innovatie en toekomst. Wij bieden jou: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.200 en € 4.000, afhankelijk van je achtergrond. Direct 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen volgens de cao Klein Metaal. Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden. Een ruim persoonlijk opleidingsbudget voor diverse AI- en financiële cursussen. Een solide pensioenregeling via het pensioenfonds PMT en een reiskostenvergoeding. Interesse in deze functie? Ben jij de topper die we zoeken? Wij kijken er naar uit om je te ontmoeten! Het werving- & selectietraject wordt exclusief verzorgd door Inqube. Je krijgt rechtstreeks een arbeidsovereenkomst bij Gusella Bakker. Voor meer informatie of je sollicitatie zie onderstaande contactgegevens. Marc: 06 4181 7058 / m.van.peursem@inqube.nl

items.desc: Jouw energie in de plus Zorg dat AI binnen Stedin veilig, verantwoord en toekomstbestendig wordt ingezet en draag direct bij aan de energietransitie van Nederland. Waarom werken bij Stedin jou energie oplevert Je helpt mee AI verantwoord en veilig in te zetten binnen een organisatie die werkt aan de energietransitie. Je krijgt de kans een relatief nieuw vakgebied én een nieuw team binnen Stedin verder vorm te geven. Je werkt samen met experts uit IT, Juridische Zaken, Security, Risk en Data aan vraagstukken met maatschappelijke impact. Werk om trots op te zijn AI speelt een steeds grotere rol binnen Stedin. Als Junior AI Governance Specialist help je ervoor te zorgen dat AI-systemen verantwoord, transparant en volgens wet- en regelgeving worden toegepast. Je ondersteunt bij het uitvoeren van AI-governanceprocessen, risicoanalyses en documentatie en helpt collega's bewust te maken van verantwoord AI-gebruik. Zo draag je bij aan innovatieve oplossingen die de energietransitie versnellen én betrouwbaar houden. Een dag als Junior AI Governance Specialist Je start de dag met een overleg over een nieuw AI-initiatief en denkt mee over welke risico’s en regelgeving van toepassing zijn. Vervolgens help je een collega met het documenteren van een AI-systeem zodat de vastgelegde informatie compleet en actueel blijft. Na de lunch werk je samen met Legal, Security en IT aan een risicoanalyse en bespreek je mogelijke beheersmaatregelen. Later op de middag actualiseer je rapportages en monitor je lopende AI-toepassingen binnen de organisatie. Je sluit de dag af met de voorbereiding van een awarenesssessie waarmee je collega’s helpt AI verantwoord en bewust in te zetten. Hier laad jij van op Alle financiële arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rij, weet je meteen waar je aan toe bent: Een bruto maandsalaris vanaf € 4.548,05 op basis van 40 uur per week. 24,5 vakantiedagen en pensioenopbouw bij ABP, waarbij wij 70% van de premie betalen. Bovenop je salaris ontvang je een persoonlijk budget van 24% (inclusief 8% vakantiegeld). Jij kiest wat je met het budget doet, bijvoorbeeld extra salaris of (tot maximaal 35,5) verlofdagen. In onze rekentool zie je hoe het werkt. Jaarlijks € 700 bruto om te besteden aan je eigen energie, bijvoorbeeld voor een sportabonnement of sportkleding. Daar Komt Dit Nog Bovenop Moderne thuiswerkfaciliteiten en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,40 per dag. Bij Stedin werken we 50% thuis en 50% op kantoor. Reizen naar kantoor doe je met de ov-vrijregeling. Of kies voor de flexibele reisregeling, waarbij je zelf bepaalt hoe je reist en een extra vergoeding ontvangt als je met de fiets komt. Een laptop en telefoon, of € 30 netto per maand als je je eigen telefoon gebruikt. Vol energie vooruit met team AI Governance Je komt terecht in het AI Governance-team binnen het Data Office. Een groeiend team dat volop in ontwikkeling is en waarin jouw ideeën welkom zijn. Samen werk je aan het verantwoord inzetten van AI binnen Stedin. Je schakelt dagelijks met collega’s uit onder meer IT, Juridische Zaken, Security, Risk en Inkoop. De lijnen zijn kort, collega’s zoeken elkaar makkelijk op en er is veel ruimte om van elkaar te leren. Regelmatig maken we ook tijd vrij om samen successen te vieren of bij te praten. Met deze kwaliteiten groei jij verder Je bent nieuwsgierig naar de mogelijkheden én risico’s van AI en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken voor anderen. Je werkt nauwkeurig, neemt initiatief en durft kritisch mee te denken over hoe processen beter kunnen. Daarnaast krijg je energie van samenwerken met verschillende stakeholders en weet je anderen mee te nemen in veranderingen. Verder Heb Je Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in AI, ICT, rechten, ethiek of een vergelijkbare richting. 0 tot 2 jaar relevante werkervaring op het gebied van data, AI Governance, compliance of risicomanagement. Basiskennis van AI, ethiek, wet- en regelgeving en stakeholdermanagement. Zet de stap naar jouw volgende uitdaging We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten. Solliciteer direct

items.desc: Deloitte är en globalt ledande leverantör av Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal och Consultative Services. Med mer än 470 000 medarbetare i över 150 länder hjälper vi våra klienter och vår omvärld att lösa komplexa problem och nå ambitiösa mål genom områdes- och branschexpertis, global räckvidd och allianser med de största tech-leverantörerna. Det som definierar Deloitte är vår strävan efter att göra en meningsfull skillnad. För oss innebär det långsiktig utveckling och resultat för våra klienter och deras företag, idéer och handlingar som också bidrar till en positiv samhällsutveckling. Det handlar även om att stärka våra medarbetare och främja deras utveckling. Jobbeskrivning Operations, Engineering, AI & Data stödjer våra kunder att driva strategiska förändringsprojekt där vi implementerar affärsstrategier och utvecklar deras operationella förmågor för att hjälpa dem nå sina affärsmål. Vi arbetar med verksamhetsförändring där vi använder våra industrispecifika lösningar och tekniska kunskaper för att transformera, modernisera och optimera våra klienters processer och tekniska plattformar. Inom Operations, Engineering, AI & Data finns tre olika team: AI & Data: Inom AI & Data-teamet hjälper du Deloittes kunder att förbättra beslutsfattande genom datadrivna insikter och skapa insiktsdrivna organisationer. Du kommer att arbeta med implementering av AI, GenAI, cloud data platforms, data warehouse och BI/analytics, med fokus på data science, maskininlärning, statistisk analys och modellering för att leverera avancerade insikter och affärsvärde. Vår modell är on-the-job-training där du växer in i mer ansvarsfulla roller och vidareutbildar dig i tekniska plattformar som Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure, Snowflake och Databricks. I det rådgivande spåret arbetar du med data management, data governance och datastrategi. Vi ser gärna att du har en traditionell managementkonsultutbildning kombinerad med data och teknik samt ett intresse för rådgivning. AI & Data-teamet verkar i en nordisk organisation med mycket kunskapskapital och kompetens, så du kommer att medverka i projekt, communities och utbildningar tillsammans med nordiska kollegor. Operations Transformation & Industry Solutions: Inom OTIS-teamet hjälper du Deloittes kunder att innovativt förändra sina organisationer. Du driver förändringsprojekt, förnyar operativa modeller, implementerar nya system och processer samt förbättrar effektiviteten. Hos oss fokuserar du primärt på bank och finans samt försäkring, där vi arbetar tillsammans med flertalet av Nordens största banker och försäkringsbolag. Du kommer att arbeta i projektteam med stark laganda och nära kunden. Som Analyst driver du analysarbete, stöttar i framtagandet av presentationsmaterial och hjälper kunden att lyckas med sin förändringsresa. Du får möjlighet att arbeta nära och lära dig av erfarna kollegor om olika industrier och affärsutveckling, samt adressera tekniska och affärsmässiga utmaningar. Engineering: Inom Engineering-teamet fokuserar du på att hjälpa Deloittes kunder att transformera sin affär genom planering och implementation av kritiska verksamhetssystem och molnplattformar. Du kombinerar teknik- och affärsexpertis inom systemutveckling och molnplattformar med bred projektledningsförmåga och djup branscherfarenhet inom flera sektorer. Därmed stödjer du kunder genom hela deras system- och affärstransformationsresa, oavsett fas. Vårt erbjudande inkluderar utveckling av strategier, skräddarsydda plattformar, modernisering av applikationer, alla aspekter av molnteknik samt rådgivning kring systemimplementation. Som Analyst i vårt team stödjer du kunder med roller inom kravställning, systemutveckling, testning och projektledning. Du skaffar dig erfarenhet genom kundprojekt samt deltar vid branschevent, specialiserad utbildning och certifieringsprogram. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som: Är nyexaminerad ingenjör, systemvetare eller ekonom med en masterexamen inom management, data/data science/analytics eller finans. Har relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – erfarenhet inom konsultbranschen är meriterande Har goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Meriterande: Goda akademiska meriter, internationell erfarenhet och relevant engagemang vid sidan av studierna Erfarenhet av att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans i ett team, med målmedvetenhet, engagemang och driv Intresse för hur digitalisering och ny teknik kan utveckla verksamheter och branscher Du är en prestigelös lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta projektbaserat, i nära samarbete med både ditt team och klienter, i en dynamisk miljö. Om du är osäker på om du uppfyller ovan kvalifikationer uppmuntrar vi dig att skicka in en ansökan ändå. Ytterligare information Vi erbjuder Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor som är experter inom sina områden. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppdrag, både på global och nordisk nivå, i team …

Opleidingsniveau: Master Aantal uur: 36 uur per week Locatie: Regio Amsterdam Start: Flexibel, in overleg Help organisaties waardevolle inzichten uit hun data te halen! Organisaties beschikken over grote hoeveelheden waardevolle data waar niets mee wordt gedaan. Zonde! Ben jij een Sherlock Holmes in hart en nieren? En word jij blij van speuren in grote bakken met data? Kies dan voor het traineeship data analytics en ontwikkel je in sneltreinvaart tot volwaardig professional in het vakgebied! Wat ga je doen? Als Young Professional Data Analytics help je organisaties bij het vertalen van hun data naar bruikbare inzichten. Denk aan het: Ophalen van de business vraag: wat wil de organisatie weten? Het ontsluiten van data uit verschillende databronnen met o.a. SQL, API koppelingen, Python Analyseren van data Automatiseren van (data)processen Vertalen en visualiseren van data naar waardevolle inzichten met dashboards. Wat bieden wij jou? Een contract voor onbepaalde tijd (36 uur); Een traineeship voor twee jaar; Een mooi startsalaris van €2700 bruto* o.b.v. 36 uur; Opleidingen en certificeringen volledig vergoed; Vijf weken vakantie, vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding; Persoonlijke begeleiding tijdens jouw hele ontwikkeling; Een postmaster-niveau opleiding vanuit de VU Training in Agile inclusief certificering; Verdiepende cursussen gegeven door senior data scientists in AI, Machine Learning, Python, R, SQL, textmining, data visualisatie, omgaan met weerstand en dergelijke. Persoonlijke coaching door een vaste fieldcoach; Trainingen gericht op leiderschap, communicatie en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. *Zodra je op opdracht gaat, verdien je in de meeste gevallen meer, gemiddeld €3.150 bruto per maand. Dit is exclusief vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding. Wat vragen wij? Je beschikt over een afgeronde Master opleiding Aantoonbare kennis over of ervaring met de volgende onderwerpen: data analytics, programmeren en data visualisatie Duidelijke interesse in verdiepen in Python, R, SQL en AI Communicatieve vaardigheden. Een achtergrond in data analytics vanuit je kwantitatieve master, denk aan Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, een research Master, Neuroscience, Earth Science, Economics etc. Waarom Breinstein? Bij Breinstein geloven we dat talent groeit door te doen. Daarom krijg je vanaf dag één verantwoordelijkheid, uitdagende opdrachten en alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je staat er nooit alleen voor: samen met jouw fieldcoach, opleiders en collega's werk je aan jouw carrière én aan de digitale toekomst van Nederland. Klaar om jouw carrière te starten? Solliciteer vandaag nog en ontdek hoe jij kunt uitgroeien tot de data specialist van morgen? Neem voor vragen vrijblijvend contact op met Benjamin Braas via 06- 82 24 22 25 of benjaminbraas@breinstein.nl. Woon jij niet in de omgeving? Geen probleem! Wij hebben opdrachten door heel Nederland. items.desc: La Direction Générale de la Sécurité Extérieure, DGSE, recrute un Data Engineer - Plateforme ML (H/F). Le poste est situé à Paris. La nationalité française est obligatoire. Domaine métier Sciences et Technologies Votre environnement de travail Afin de valoriser une production très hétérogène et volumineuse, le Ministère des Armées conçoit, développe et met en production des services de traitements multimédia. Ces traitements peuvent être issus du monde académique, de partenariats industriels ou de nos propres activités de R&D et couvrent un large champ d’applications de l’apprentissage automatique ou profond tels que des tâches de Traitement Automatique des Langues (transcription de la parole, traduction automatique, etc.), Vision par Ordinateur (OCR, détection d'objets, etc.). Vos missions Au sein d'une équipe en charge d'appuis opérationnels, vous aurez pour mission de concevoir, développer et maintenir un outillage permettant à des Data Scientists de construire des pipelines de traitements sous forme de batchs d’inférence, d’API ou d’applications tactiques. À ce titre, vous serez amené-e à : Définir l’architecture de la stack : identifier, évaluer et intégrer les briques techniques adaptées à partir de l’existant pour construire une stack fiable, pérenne et générique ; Développer et maintenir les composants de la plateforme : extraction, indexation, recherche de données, APIs et autres briques nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des pipelines ; Concevoir des abstractions et des templates réutilisables pour simplifier l’intégration des traitements par les Data Scientists et limiter l’effort RH sur les projets tactiques ; Rendre l’outillage accessible : documenter, accompagner et former les utilisateurs afin qu’ils puissent être autonomes dans la prise en main de la stack ; Collaborer avec l’équipe DevOps pour l’intégration et le déploiement des composants ; Veiller à ce que les traitements respectent les bonnes pratiques d'industrialisation, de traçabilité et de reproductibilité. Votre profil Diplômé-e d’une formation de niveau Bac + 5, vous justifiez d’une première expérience réussie dans la conception de pipeline de traitements Machine Learning de données et vous possédez les compétences et qualités suivantes : Bonne maîtrise de Python et des bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel ; Expérience avec ElasticSearch ou une base d’indexation équivalente ; Expérience souhaitée avec Airflow ou d'autres technologies d'orchestration ; Autonomie, curiosité et sens de l’accompagnement des utilisateurs ; Familiarité avec les problématiques Data Science / Machine Learning est un plus ; Bonne maîtrise de l’anglais technique ; Aisance avec les assistants de développement. Les plus de l’offre Technologies à la pointe Contexte d’activités unique Développement des compétences L’épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la fidélisation étant d’une importance majeure, vous bénéficierez : d’un parcours d’intégration, d’un suivi continu par votre manager de proximité afin de vous épanouir au quotidien, de développer vos compétences et de construire votre projet de carrière. Le poste est soumis à l’obtention d’une habilitation. L’accès au téléphone et à Internet pour un usage personnel est réglementé. Vos avantages à rejoindre la DGSE La satisfaction de travailler pour votre pays et la défense de ses valeurs Plus de 1000 formations linguistiques et thématiques Nombreuses activités culturelles et sportives Restaurants et points de vente à emporter fait maison 48 à 50 jours de congés annuels Pour connaître les autres avantages, consultez notre site sur https:// www.dgse.gouv.fr /fr/la-dgse/nos-actualites/rejoindre-la-dgse-de-nombreux-atouts-au-quotidien Contact Envoyez nous votre candidature à l’adresse : dgse-macandidature.cer.fct@intradef.gouv.fr Restez discret sur votre candidature : évitez d'en parler à votre entourage et n'affichez pas votre souhait de rejoindre la DGSE sur vos réseaux sociaux. Plus d’information sur www.dgse.gouv.fr > Nous rejoindre.

You will work on real operational problems involving pricing, inventory and demand modelling, optimization and decision-support tools. The role spans the full data science lifecycle — from understanding the business problem and developing models to production deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. This is a great opportunity to take meaningful ownership early and work at the intersection of data science, commercial decision-making and operational complexity. Key Responsibilities Algorithm Development & Automation Design, build, and implement machine learning and statistical models to automate pricing and business decisions for refurbished mobile devices, from prototype to production environment Develop robust, scalable modelling solutions that address real-world pricing and business challenges, including dynamic pricing, demand forecasting, competitor analysis, and other business modelling use cases Explore and evaluate new modelling approaches and data sources to improve decision quality. Business Insight & Model Translation Collaborate closely with business, operations, and product stakeholders to distil complex requirements into actionable data science solutions Translate operational and market insights into predictive and statistical models that drive measurable business value Support business modelling initiatives beyond pricing, such as demand planning, inventory optimization, or customer analytics, as our data science scope expands Model Development & Continuous Improvement Continuously monitor model performance and business outcome, address issues such as data drift or model degradation, and retrain models as necessary to maintain optimal accuracy Develop appropriate validation and experimentation approaches to evaluate models and decision strategies. Build analytical and monitoring solutions that make model behaviour and business impact transparent. Stay current with the latest research and industry best practices, supporting the implementation of new approaches to improve pricing outcomes Collaboration & Communication Work cross-functionally with engineering, data, and business teams to ensure seamless integration of pricing models into business systems Help ensure deployed solutions are reliable, maintainable and appropriately monitored. Communicate analytical findings, model behaviour, uncertainty and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, enabling data-driven decision making. Required Qualifications 2-5 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning or a closely related applied modelling role. Experience with designing and maintaining life cycle of machine learning models in production is required. Proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with common ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, LightGBM or XGBoost). Solid understanding of statistical analysis, predictive modelling, model validation and feature engineering. Experience developing and maintaining models or analytical solutions beyond the initial prototype stage. Ability to translate ambiguous business and operational problems into quantitative solutions. Strong analytical problem-solving skills and an interest in understanding how models behave in real operational environments. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex results clearly and persuasively Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Experience Experience in pricing, e-commerce, marketplaces, retail, recommerce or another data-intensive commercial environment. Experience with pricing optimization, price elasticity, demand forecasting, inventory modelling or revenue management. Experience with model monitoring, automated ML pipelines or production ML systems. Familiar with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP or Azure and containerization such as Docker. Interest or experience in modern AI/LLM applications where relevant to business problems. Help us make a difference! We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like the next step in your career, apply quickly! How does Foxway operate? Foxway is a fast-growing and dynamic organization with an international team of nearly 1,200 people, including close to 600 colleagues in Estonia. We operate across multiple countries, with key hubs across Europe. Our mission is to make sustainable technology accessible to everyone. Through Foxway Recommerce Mobiles , we give smart devices a second life, helping to reduce environmental impact and support a more circular future. By joining us, you become part of a purpose-driven, international team that is shaping the future of sustainable workplaces and circular technology.

items.desc: The algorithms we design in Guidance, Control and Navigation (GCN) lie at the heart of all of the highly complex MBDA missile and weapon systems. We’re involved in every phase of the product’s life cycle, from concept through to service. Salary : £31,900 plus a £3000 joining bonus Dynamic Working : 5 days per week on-site due to workload classification Security Clearance : British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship. Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team. This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Monday 2nd November 2026 but may close earlier depending on application volumes. What We Can Offer You 2 year Programme: Starting September 2027 Annual Salary Review Company bonus: Up to £2,500 (based on company performance and will vary year to year) Pension: Maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14% Overtime: Opportunity for paid overtime Annual Leave: 25 days plus option to purchase extra holiday Flexi Leave: Up to 15 additional days Excellent career progression and development opportunities Facilities: Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more Healthcare Cash Plan: The Healthcare Cash Plan benefit provides the option to claim cash back on everyday healthcare expenses such as optical, dental, health and wellbeing and more. The Opportunity In this role, you’ll build your skills across our four specialist areas: Guidance - figuring out a suitable trajectory, providing an effective route to target interception and improving the probability of defeating a target Control - designing and tuning autopilot algorithms, for various control surfaces, to maintain stable flight dynamics and achieve the guidance demands Navigation - estimating the current missile state (position, velocity and altitude/orientation) using measurements from a range of on-board sensors Command and Control - designing weapon-system level algorithms to track and evaluate incoming threats, plan engagements, and provide additional mission context to the operator This is a great environment and opportunity to learn, broadening your technical knowledge of the design and function of a complex weapon system through visibility of a wide range of work; from researching and developing futuristic technologies through to being on the design team for current high-profile projects. Join a supportive and experienced team who will encourage you to develop your skills in coding and modelling, mathematics, flight dynamics and control theory – as well as utilising tools such as MATLAB/SIMULINK daily. You’ll experience a variety of activities in this role, which could include: Integrated navigation, such as 'Terrain Reference Navigation', 'GPS integration', and ‘Image Based Navigation’ Autopilot and control system design and analysis, including dual-mode control, thrust vector control, etc. Algorithms for mid-course guidance, terminal guidance, target tracking and selectivity Data fusion to combine data from multiple sensors. For example, radars, seekers, IMUs, etc. Implementing AI techniques including neural networks and deep learning to improve traditional GCN algorithms and solve new challenges Designing autonomous decision-making systems for use in complex collective missions. Work collaboratively across engineering teams to develop your understanding of propulsion, aerodynamics, seekers, sensors and actuators, and how these technologies integrate within a complex missile system. Experience working within one of the many international teams in MBDA, with the GCN function in Paris and Rome - This doesn’t necessarily equate to travel but you may be offered the option where the opportunity arises. What We're Looking For From You Degree qualified in Physics, Mathematical Sciences, Engineering or Computing discipline to a minimum of 2:2 Our Company: Peace Is Not a Given, Freedom Is Not a Given, Sovereignty Is Not a Given MBDA is a leading defence organisation. We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom. We are proud of our employee-led networks, examples include: Gender Equality, Pride, Menopause Matters, Parents and Carers, Armed Forces, Ethnic Diversity, Neurodiversity, Disability and more… We recognise that everyone is unique, and we encourage you to speak to us should you require any advice, support or adjustments throughout our recruitment process.
