items.desc: Jetzt bewerben! Wir sind Mercedes-Benz Tech Innovation - doch wir bauen keine Autos: Wir definieren die Zukunft mit Technologie. Als größte Tech Company der Mercedes-Benz Group AG arbeiten rund 2.500 Mitarbeitende in Ulm, im Raum Stuttgart, in Berlin und in Karlsruhe sowie in internationalen Tech Hubs an den Techniktrends der Mobilität von morgen. Uns verbindet die Begeisterung für Innovation und neueste Technologien – kombiniert mit der Überzeugung, dass individuelle Freiheit und Eigenverantwortung für echten Fortschritt entscheidend sind. Wir sind #techinnovators. Mehr über uns erfahren Über uns Mercedes-Benz Tech Innovation GmbH Welche Aufgaben erwarten dich? Als Praktikant (d/m/w/x) tauchst du tief in die Welt des Data Engineering und der AI-Anwendungen ein und gestaltest aktiv die Zukunft mit führenden Tools wie Microsoft Azure, Databricks und Power BI mit. Zudem übernimmst du spannende und vielfältige Aufgaben im Bereich AI und Data Engineering, indem du innovative Technologien evaluierst und direkt in unsere Projekte integrierst. Du unterstützt maßgeblich bei der Konzeption, Entwicklung und Optimierung von Datenpipelines, der Pflege unserer Datenarchitektur und Data Warehouses sowie der Sicherstellung höchster Datenqualität. Während deines Praktikums wirst du Teil eines agilen Scrum-Teams und erlebst moderne Arbeitsweisen hautnah. Profitiere von der engen Begleitung erfahrener Experten (d/m/w/x) und werde Teil eines dynamischen Teams, das sich durch gegenseitige Inspiration und Unterstützung auszeichnet. Wie passt du in unser Team? Bereit, durchzustarten? Wenn du uns mit nachweislich hervorragenden Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen überzeugst und deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Notenübersicht, Immatrikulationsbescheinigung sowie ggf. Aufenthaltsgenehmigung/Arbeitserlaubnis) vorliegen, bist du nur noch einen Klick von deiner Chance entfernt. Kleiner Tipp: Bei der Flut an Top-Bewerbungen, die wir bekommen, ist eine lückenlose Bewerbung dein einziges Ticket ins Spiel. Ohne das komplette Paket geht's für dich leider nicht weiter – no exceptions! Du bist Student (d/m/w/x) der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Analytics, Data Science oder eines ähnlichen Fachbereichs und suchst eine spannende Möglichkeit, wertvolle praktische Erfahrungen in einem innovativen Unternehmen zu sammeln. Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in den Programmiersprachen Python/PySpark und SQL mit und teilst unsere Begeisterung für den Einsatz von AI. Erste Erfahrungen in Datenanalyse, DevOps, Machine Learning oder AI sind von Vorteil. Deine Stärken liegen im analytischen Denken und in der Motivation, dich schnell in neue Technologien und Methoden einzuarbeiten. Zudem bist du eigenverantwortlich, zuverlässig und erledigst deine Aufgaben stets gewissenhaft. Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab und du hast Freude daran, regelmäßig vor Ort im Team zu arbeiten. Benefits Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung Damit neben Studium und Arbeit noch genügend Freizeit bleibt, bekommst du bei uns anteilig 30 Urlaubstage sowie die Möglichkeit, deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel zu planen. In Abstimmung mit deinem Team und deinem Ansprechpartner hast du auch die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten . Zudem sind nahezu alle unsere Stellen geeignet, um in Teilzeit ausgeführt zu werden. Mittendrin statt nur dabei Du begleitest innovative Projekte am Puls der Zeit und übernimmst verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben, so bist du von Beginn an ein vollwertiges Mitglied unseres Teams! Natürlich profitierst du hierbei von einem attraktiven Gehalt . Begegnung auf Augenhöhe Bei Mercedes-Benz Tech Innovation sind wir ein Team! Unsere Zusammenarbeit basiert auf gegenseitigem Vertrauen und Respekt. Flache Hierarchien , eine wertschätzende Atmosphäre , Offenheit und Aufgeschlossenheit gehören bei uns zum Arbeitsalltag. Damit dein Start bei uns gelingt, erhältst du eine individuelle Einarbeitung und einen direkten Ansprechpartner .

items.title: Data Science Intern
items.card: About the role You'll be working with our founding team to build data infrastructure and run analyses for real clients. What you'll do: Build data pipelines that handle messy client data (CSV files with weird formats, missing values, you name it). Write validation code that catches data quality issues before they become problems. Create analyses for paying customers—market analysis, customer insights, revenue
items.desc: Data Science Intern Key information Role: Full-Time Duration : 3-6 Months Salary: £2,510 per month Location: London UK visa sponsorship: no Why we're hiring Opbox is on a mission to help small businesses to turn their scattered data into real world actions that help them to grow. Our delivery team is growing and we're looking for a data science intern to join us. You'll spend time working across the full spectrum of data science tasks, from data pipelines, to building data warehouses, to deploying the latest ML and AI models. We are a small but powerful team. You'll have the chance to learn from second time founders, experienced data scientists, AI experts and software developers. Who we're looking for We're looking for someone who's curious about how data science works in the real world and wants to build something that matters. You should have one or more of the following experiences: Have studied maths, statistics, physics, engineering, computer science, or similar. Some Python or R experience (even just from coursework). Taken a statistics or data analysis module. Built something with code before (doesn't matter what). Curious about how businesses work. About the role You'll be working with our founding team to build data infrastructure and run analyses for real clients. What you'll do: Build data pipelines that handle messy client data (CSV files with weird formats, missing values, you name it). Write validation code that catches data quality issues before they become problems. Create analyses for paying customers—market analysis, customer insights, revenue forecasting. Work directly with client data from companies across different industries. Participate in client calls and see how your work influences business decisions. What you'll learn: How to build data systems that work in production. Applied statistics with real, uncooperative data. Applied AI, using cutting-edge techniques. How data analytics can translate into business actions. Startup experience with fast iteration and direct customer feedback. Tech stack: Python, Pandas, SQL, Jupyter notebooks, data validation tools, Git workflows This isn't a typical internship where you shadow someone. You'll have real responsibility from the start, working on multiple client projects with actual deadlines. Your code gets reviewed, your analyses get questioned, and your ideas get implemented on merit. If successful, this internship is designed to lead to a full-time role in the company. FAQs Is this a paid internship? Yes, we will pay you the London Living Wage this is ~£2,510 per month. Do I need to be in an office? Yes. We have an office in Peckham. Whilst we're pretty flexible, you should plan to be in the office 3 days per week. What are the hours like? Roughly 9-5 UK time works well, but we're flexible as long as work gets done and you can join team meetings. Will this lead to a full-time offer? That's our aim. We're looking for someone who could grow with the company. What if I don't know much about startups/business? That's fine. You'll learn by working directly with clients and seeing how they use your analyses.

items.desc: Description De L'entreprise Description de l'entreprise EPSILON France est l’entité Datamarketing de Publicis Groupe avec 650 experts data, marketing et technologiques et plus de 40 métiers représentés. Avec pour claim « Every Interaction Counts », la mission d’EPSILON est de conjuguer les pouvoirs de la data, du marketing et de la technologie pour rendre les interactions entre les marques et leurs clients toujours plus justes et pertinentes. EPSILON intervient sur l’ensemble des étapes-clé d’un projet de transformation data-driven, de la définition de la stratégie à l’exécution opérationnelle. EPSILON compte plus de 300 clients actifs et pilote quotidiennement plus de 100 plateformes datamarketing. Descriptif du poste Au sein du Pôle Data & IA, constitué de 200 talents aux profils complémentaires, rejoignez le département « Intelligence Artificielle et advanced modeling », son objectif : favoriser le déploiement de l’IA pour augmenter la performance business, automatiser et industrialiser les processus opérationnels de nos clients. Nous accompagnons des clients de divers secteurs d’activités (Grande distribution, Retail, Luxe, Assurance, Automobile, etc.) et ce sur toutes les problématiques métiers pour démocratiser l’accès à l’IA et accompagner la réalisation et l’intégration de projets data science et IA du “proof of value” jusqu’au déploiement. Votre quotidien en tant que Consultant Data Scientist Confirmé(e) : Participer au cadrage des projets de Data Science & IA, Collecter, explorer & auditer de grands volumes de données, Mettre en place des pipelines de préparation de données, Concevoir et entrainer des algorithmes de Machine Learning / Deep Learning, Evaluer, analyser, synthétiser et expliquer les résultats de vos modèles, Restituer et valoriser les résultats de manière vulgarisée aux équipes métier, Industrialiser vos modèles et mettre en place des pratiques MLOps et DevOps, Intervenir sur notre laboratoire Next by Epsilon pour travailler sur des sujets R&D ou intégrer l’équipe de veille technologique et méthodologique, Participer aux REX de projets et aux hackathons. Exemple de missions confiées à un Consultant Data Scientist (confirmé(e): Grande distribution : Mise en place d’un moteur de substitution pour le Drive favorisant les produits selon leur valeur nutritionnelle et leur empreinte carbone. Assurance : mettre en œuvre une solution de NLP permettant de router automatiquement les emails des clients vers les bons services en tenant compte du niveau d’urgence. Telco: Développement d’algorithme de forecasting pour prédire le nombre d’appels au service client et anticiper le nombre de conseillers à mobiliser. Retail : Mise en place d’une solution multi-IA (NLP, Computer Vision, IA générative) permettant d’automatiser l’extraction et la génération de descriptif produit à partir d’une image du packaging. Jeu en ligne : Mise en œuvre d’un moteur de recommandation sur le site et l’application du client afin de personnaliser les jeux proposés selon le profil des joueurs. Automobile : Mise en œuvre de score d’appétences aux véhicules hybrides et électriques afin d’optimiser le ciblage des clients Et toutes ces missions sont réalisées en collaboration avec des experts data science & IA dans un cadre d’écoute et de partage. Qualifications Nous recherchons avant tout quelqu’un qui : Est orienté résultat, A la volonté de construire des solutions sur mesure pour le métier, Sait s’adapter à différents environnements, Sait se former sur de nouvelles technos et méthodes au sujet de l’IA, A un fort esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, Est bon communiquant et sait vulgariser ses résultats, Sait travailler en anglais. Diplômé d’un master à l’université ou école d’ingénieur vous : Avez au moins 3 ans d'expérience en Data Science en interne ou dans le conseil, Avez une forte expérience sur l’ensemble des étapes d’un projet data science de la préparation de données, modélisation à l’industrialisation des modèles, Savez programmer en Python, Maîtrisez les principes des bases de données et le langage SQL, Maitrisez les principales méthodes de data science (Machine Learning, séries temporelles, ...), Maitrisez les méthodes avancées de data science (Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, IA Générative, Information retrieval), Avez utilisé les services IA d’un des principaux cloud provider : GCP, Azure, AWS, Souhaitez aller jusqu’à l’industrialisation de vos modèles (Git, Docker, DAG). Vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases mais êtes motivé à apprendre et progresser : n’hésitez pas à postuler. Votre truc en + Vous aimez transmettre vos savoir-faire sur des sujets de data science (rédaction d’articles, animation de formation, conférences, …) Choisissez Un groupe qui investit massivement sur l’IA avec le lancement de la solution CoreAI et la mise à disposition de dizaines d’outils d’IA et des centaines de cas d’usage IA déployés, Un centre de compétences spécialisé en Data Science au sein d’une entreprise pionnière et …

items.desc: Contexte L'équipe travaille sur des algorithmes de détection d'objets d'intérêt militaire sur des images satellites. Le pôle est composé d'une vingtaine de personnes dont une majorité de Deep Learning Scientists. Pour faire face à une augmentation de la charge, nous avons besoin de renforcer rapidement l'équipe en particulier pour travailler sur le développement d'un Retraining Kit. L'objectif est de permettre à nos clients de réentraîner certains de nos détecteurs sur leurs propres données et cas d'usage. Ce kit s'appuiera sur plusieurs modules internes, notamment pour préparer les données, lancer et suivre les entraînements, évaluer les performances et packager le détecteur réentraîné. Nous cherchons à renforcer l'équipe avec un profil ML Engineering capable de contribuer à la mise en production de ce kit. La personne fera partie intégrante de l'équipe et s'intègrera dans une squad de 3 personnes. La mission sera d'une durée minimale de 6 mois. La personne devra venir sur le site à Paris au minimum 2 jours par semaine. Mission Les missions principales sont : Développer le Retraining Kit en s'appuyant sur les modules internes . Valider et fiabiliser le kit pour un déploiement client via des tests de bout en bout, l'amélioration des workflows, de la qualité logicielle et de la documentation. Conditions de la mission : Intégration dans une squad de 3 personnes, Mission de 6 mois minimum Présence sur site à Paris 2 jours par semaine Profil candidat: Une formation en Software Engineering, en machine learning, computer vision ou domaine similaire. 2 ans d'expérience minimum en ML Engineering très bonne connaissance de Python/Pytroch et des bonnes pratiques en développement logiciel et d'outillage Expérience en Deep Learning et / ou Computer Vision D'une expérience en SW engineering (culture archi / design, qualité / testing / CI/CD). Une connaissance de l'imagerie satellite est un plus. En terme de méthodologie de travail : d'une expérience en environnement agile, sans pour autant en défendre une application dogmatique En terme de soft skills : D'autonomie et de capacité à investiguer un problème de bout en bout. D'une posture user-centric, en pensant avant tout aux besoins des utilisateurs. D'ouverture d'esprit, communication, et travail en équipe.

items.desc: Liberty Blume Business Solutions, or BBS for short, sits right at the heart of what we do at Liberty Blume, providing technology-first, cost-effective business services that can be scaled to provide the support our businesses need to operate effectively. What To Expect Year 1 — Technology Context Rotations Three rotations of approximately 4 months each across the Technology supplementary functions. The purpose is not job-shadowing — you will own deliverables in each rotation. Product & Delivery — work embedded with our product team on our internal and external products. Learn how technical decisions translate into product outcomes. Tech PMO — contribute to resource and delivery tracking across our engineering portfolio. Understand how technology investment is governed, tracked, and reported. Tech Strategy — support architecture review, vendor assessment, and strategic initiatives. Year 2 — Engineering Team A full year embedded in our central Engineering team. You will contribute to production codebases and AI platform development on Google Cloud Platform. By the end of Year 2, you will be operating as a junior software engineer with real responsibilities. Throughout Year 2, you will work toward Google Cloud certifications, supported by structured study time and access to Google's training resources. What You Will Work On Liberty Blume builds and operates technology platforms for our business and customers. Our core platforms run on a microservices architecture on GCP. Our AI platform (Blume AI) is being built on Vertex AI and is central to our product strategy. During This Scheme, You Can Expect Direct Exposure To Google Cloud Platform - e.g. Cloud Run, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Apigee, Document AI AI and LLM integration — e.g. working with large language models in production contexts, not just experimental settings Infrastructure-as-code — e.g. Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines API-first architecture — e.g. microservices design patterns, integration engineering Data engineering — e.g. structured data pipelines, analytics, FinOps instrumentation We work closely with Google Cloud as a strategic partner. Graduates on this scheme will benefit from that relationship directly, including access to Google-led training and the pathway to formal GCP certifications. Who We Are Looking For We are primarily targeting graduates from Computer Science, Software Engineering, or adjacent STEM disciplines. However, we are open to any STEM background if you can demonstrate strong technical aptitude and the right mindset. We are more interested in how you think, than what you already know. The landscape of software development is changing rapidly, AI-assisted engineering is already here. We want people who can adapt, reason clearly under ambiguity, and learn fast. You Should Apply If You Have or are completing a degree in a STEM subject (Computer Science or Engineering preferred) Can demonstrate genuine curiosity about how technology systems work — not just surface-level interest Are comfortable working with incomplete information and iterating toward a solution Have some exposure to programming, scripting, or data analysis — however that came about Are interested in the intersection of AI, cloud infrastructure, and real business problems Want to understand the full stack from business context to production deployment You Probably Should Not Apply If You Are looking for a clearly defined 9-to-5 with low ambiguity Want to spend Year 1 watching and Year 2 doing Are not interested in engineering as an outcome Salary & Benefits Competitive salary 25 days annual leave with the option to purchase 5 more Access to wellbeing and mental health benefits such as the Calm app, personal medical, critical illness cover and dental insurance Matched pension contribution up to 10% Access to our car benefit scheme 24 hours Paid Volunteer Time Off Entitlement to a birthday day off Access to our online learning platform to continue to develop and grow your career with us The chance to join an innovative, fast-paced, and passionate team

items.desc: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a continuously growing team, which has been announced as Top Employer for the fourth consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for the third year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the second consecutive time, for our almost 3,000 professionals ! At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI . We’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams Join us as we commemorate 100 years of EY in Greece this year. Experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, Thessaloniki and Crete and contribute to building a better working world . The opportunity Modern technology produces more data than ever before and has also produced new AI algorithms and tools, resulting in new opportunities and substantiated business insights in support of new and deeper insights, more informed actions and decision making. EY delivers leading services and solutions in the area of big data, business intelligence and data engineering built on a blend of tools and custom-developed methods. As part of our AI & Data team of the Technology Consulting practice, you will work with multi-disciplinary teams to support clients in a wide range of data initiatives aiming to generate and present new, useful and actionable insights. You will have the opportunity to work and take responsibilities in challenging engagements, gaining exposure to clients in various sectors both in Greece and abroad. Your Key Responsibilities Collaborating with data scientists on model integration and deployment. Setting up infrastructure and tools for deploying and monitoring models. Managing cloud resources and optimizing performance. Implementing CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment. Building and maintaining data pipelines for pre-processing and transformation. Monitoring model performance and system health. Ensuring data security and compliance. Documenting processes and best practices. Staying updated with advancements in MLOps/ AIOps and contributing to EY innovation. Skills And Attributes For Success To qualify for the role you must have Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field. Experience in the fields of AIOps, MLOps or System Administration. Demonstrated experience in deploying ML models into production environments. Participation in Kaggle competitions or personal ML projects can also demonstrate practical skills. Experience with cloud platforms like Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Cloudera. Understanding how to leverage cloud resources for deploying and scaling ML models. Ideally, you’ll also have Proficiency in modern DevOps practices and automated software testing. Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes is valuable. Familiarity with AIOps/ MLOps tools and platforms, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Synapse Analytics or SageMaker, is advantageous. Understanding how to set up and manage machine learning pipelines, model monitoring, and deployment infrastructure is important. Knowledge of infrastructure components like servers, storage systems, and networking. Understanding how to provision and configure resources for ML workloads. What We Look For Strong analytical, problem solving and critical thinking skills. Desire to investigate and try-out new tools and technologies as they are released. Ability to work under tight timelines, in cases for multiple project deliveries. Good interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively within high-performing teams. Confidence to convey technical advice and guidance to clients. Ability to adapt in a fast paced multinational environment. items.desc: Intern in the Galileo and EGNOS Programme Department - Artificial Intelligence Job Requisition ID: 20994 Date Posted: 1 November 2026 Closing Date: 30 November 2026 23:59 CET/CEST Publication Method: External Only Type of Appointment (learn more): Directorate: Resilience, Navigation and Connectivity Workplace: Noordwijk, NL Location ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands Our team and mission Galileo is the European Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), providing highly accurate and autonomous Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) services under civilian control. It includes multiple services such as the classic Open Service, High Accuracy Service, Search and Rescue Service and new development such as the Emergency Warning Satellite System, Return Link Service, and the Timing Service Message. The programme is overseen by the European Commission, with ESA responsible for development, deployment, and system design. The Galileo ground segment is the network of facilities and systems on Earth that enable the operation, control, and maintenance of the satellite constellation and its services. It includes the mission control infrastructure responsible for managing satellite operations and ensuring precise orbit and timing determination, as well as the system that processes navigation signals and generates data for user positioning. The ground segment also comprises a global network of sensor stations that continuously monitor the signals transmitted by the satellites, uplink stations that send updated navigation data and commands to the spacecraft, and additional facilities that provide security, system integrity, and service performance monitoring. Together, these elements ensure the reliability, accuracy, and availability of Galileo services worldwide. Candidates interested are encouraged to visit the ESA website: http://www.esa.int Field(s) of activity for the internship You will join an engineering team working at the heart of one of Europe's most advanced satellite navigation ground infrastructures. As an intern, you will contribute to the adoption of artificial intelligence technologies within a real engineering environment. You will investigate how artificial intelligence can improve software validation activities, enhance engineering efficiency and support better decision-making across the team. As an intern, you will have the following tasks: developing artificial intelligence applications to support the review of software deliveries, including software quality assessment, source code analysis and security checks; evaluating emerging artificial intelligence models, tools and techniques to determine their suitability and performance; identifying opportunities to improve ways of working through intelligent assistants and autonomous software agents, and proposing innovative approaches to increase team productivity. During your internship, you will gain practical experience in: applying artificial intelligence technologies in a professional engineering environment; secure software development and deployment practices; evaluating emerging artificial intelligence models and technologies; communicating technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. This internship offers a unique opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies while contributing to the future adoption of artificial intelligence in a large-scale operational environment. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, gain exposure to real-world challenges and help shape innovative ways of working through the responsible use of artificial intelligence. Behavioural competencies Result Orientation Operational Efficiency Fostering Cooperation Relationship Management Continuous Improvement Forward Thinking For more information, please refer to ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook Education You must be a university student, preferably in your final or second-to-last year of university course at Master's level. In addition, you must be able to prove that you will be enrolled at your university for the entire duration of the internship. Additional Requirements The working languages of the Agency are English and French. A good knowledge of one of these is required. Knowledge of another ESA Member State language is an asset. items.desc: About Winton Winton is a research-based investment management company with a specialist focus on statistical and mathematical inference in financial markets. The firm researches and trades quantitative investment strategies, which are implemented systematically via thousands of securities, spanning the world's major liquid asset classes. Founded in 1997 by David Harding, Winton today manages assets for some of the world’s largest institutional investors. We employ ambitious professionals who want to work collaboratively at the leading edge of investment management. We are seeking a talented quantitative developer to join the Investment Management & Research group at Winton. The role sits within our Fundamental Commodities strategy, where you will work closely with the Senior Portfolio Manager. Within our collaborative environment, you will help design and build the systems and tools that underpin the firm's trading and research. Your focus will initially be on software development: adding functionality required for new trading strategies and maintaining the existing signal pipeline. Over time, you will become more involved in research, eventually running projects independently. items.desc: TL;DR - You own the metrics for a product area, find where users get stuck or drop off, and turn that into product bets that ship. You build the measurement and experimentation the teams rely on, and the systems that surface opportunities without waiting on you. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. What We're Looking For A product-minded data scientist who owns a product area's outcomes: you find the opportunity, form the bet, and see it shipped, rather than handing insights to a PM. You build systems, not one-offs: the instrumentation, metrics, and agents that produce insight and flag opportunities proactively. Strong SQL, Python, applied statistics, and experimentation (A/B and growth tests). Deep instinct for user behavior: activation, engagement, retention, and what moves them. Comfortable shipping directional answers fast, and knowing when a decision needs rigor. Entrepreneurial. Thrives with autonomy and ambiguity, and works shoulder to shoulder with product and engineering. What You'll Do Own the metrics and funnels for a product area, and drive measurable improvement in activation, engagement, and retention. Find opportunities in user behavior and turn them into product bets, working directly with PMs and engineers to ship them. Design and run experiments, and act on the results. Build the instrumentation, semantic models, and agents the product team runs on. Keep the data the team trusts trustworthy: quality, definitions, and lineage. items.title: (M/W) AI & Control Intern – Whole-Body Control
items.card: Job Description Within Wandercraft’s Whole Body Control team, you will develop control algorithms for exoskeletons and humanoid robots, from mathematical formulation and simulation to deployment and validation on real robots. You will work on challenging robotics problems involving locomotion, manipulation, multi-contact control and whole-body motion generation, with a strong focus on robustness, performance and
items.desc: Job Description Within Wandercraft’s Whole Body Control team, you will develop control algorithms for exoskeletons and humanoid robots, from mathematical formulation and simulation to deployment and validation on real robots. You will work on challenging robotics problems involving locomotion, manipulation, multi-contact control and whole-body motion generation, with a strong focus on robustness, performance and real-time execution. Reporting to the Head of Whole Body Control, you will work closely with other control engineers as well as the mechanical, electronics, perception and software teams. Depending on your background and interests, your work may include: Develop whole-body control algorithms for floating-base robots Design control strategies using linear and nonlinear control, MPC and NMPC Develop online and offline trajectory optimization and motion generation algorithms Design and improve whole-body trajectory tracking for locomotion and manipulation Model robot dynamics, contacts and interactions with the environment Develop or integrate state-estimation algorithms using sensor data Explore learning-based approaches, including reinforcement learning, when relevant Write efficient, maintainable software in C++ and Python Test, debug and validate algorithms directly on exoskeletons and humanoid robots Contribute to the architecture and long-term technical direction of the control stack Preferred Experience Diploma: Final year of a Master’s or engineering school program (M2 or equivalent) in Robotics, Controls, Optimization, Applied Mathematics, or a related scientific field. PhD students are also welcome to apply. Required experience: Hands-on experience with robotics, control, motion generation, trajectory optimization or related algorithmic development, through industry, research or significant academic projects. Skills: Programming (C++/Python) - Autonomous level Algorithmics - Autonomous level Robotics (kinematics, dynamics, working with sensor data) - Autonomous level Control theory - Autonomous level Machine learning - Basic knowledge Who are they? At Wandercraft we pioneer intelligent robotics to help people do what they can’t do. We apply the most advanced robotics and AI to expand what’s possible for humans in the fields of healthcare and now industry. Founded in 2012, Wandercraft is globally recognized for creating the world’s first self-balancing walking exoskeleton, Atalante X, which is used in more than 100 rehabilitation centers across four continents helping individuals with disabilities re-learn how to walk, with over a million steps taken each month. Building on over a decade of real-world experience and a proprietary neural network trained on billions of steps, we’re bringing mobility beyond clinical settings and into the home. Our personal exoskeleton, Eve, is a first-of-its-kind device designed to assist wheelchair users in standing and walking in everyday life. Now we’re expanding our platform to support industrial and assistive tasks with the Calvin family of humanoid robots. Built in just 40 days, Calvin-40 is designed to relieve factory workers from hazardous labor. Future versions of Calvin will assist persons with reduced autonomy in their daily activities. Our growth into home and industrial robotics opens new horizons while reinforcing our ability to scale innovation, improve reliability, and accelerate our impact, across our entire portfolio of products and industries. From Paris and New York, our team of over 110 engineers, clinicians, researchers, and operators is united by one mission: to design robotics that improve human life, wherever people need them most! We’re not just hiring people: we’re building a team of pioneers, curious minds and problem solvers who want to change the world, step by step. Join us to shape the next generation of medical and humanoid robotics powered by AI and purpose.

items.desc: About Us Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI. The Role As a Member of Technical Staff on the EMEA field team, you build on top of one of the largest inference platforms in the world. The work spans the stack: capabilities on top of inference and serving, tooling around fine-tuning and post-training of LLMs, and the product our region’s customers need that the core platform team will not take on. You are first and foremost an excellent software engineer; that is what we are testing for. You prefer building product to being customer-facing, and that is exactly right for this role, though you are welcome to join customer work when it interests you. Treat this as a flexible role: a bucket for exceptional builders at different levels of experience rather than a fixed job spec. There is no specific seniority requirement; anywhere from 3 to 10 years of experience can fit. What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background. Key Responsibilities Build: Design and ship product capabilities end to end, from ambiguous need to running in production. Build on Inference: Create capabilities on top of the serving stack: routing, model controls, observability, and whatever a deployment turns out to need. Build on Training: Ship tooling around fine-tuning and post-training of LLMs, from data pipelines to evaluation, working alongside our applied ML engineers. Own Regional Capability: Turn EMEA-specific requirements into product, working with core platform where the line is unclear. Engineering Quality: Set the engineering bar for the regional team; your code is the reference. Agentic Development: Use coding agents and AI tooling as a core part of how you build, with judgment about when to trust the output. Optional Customer Work: Join deployments or customer conversations when useful or interesting; never required. Minimum Qualifications First principles and critical thinking: the ability to break down novel problems and reason to a solution without a reference implementation. This is the primary interview signal and can outweigh other qualifications. Excellent software engineering: depth in backend systems and infrastructure, and a track record of shipping production systems you owned. Strong coding skills in Python and at least one systems language. Fluent in AI-assisted and agentic engineering: uses coding agents and AI tooling as a core part of how you build, and knows when to trust the output and when not to. Genuine interest in inference and AI infrastructure. Why Fireworks? Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving. Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally. Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results. Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation. Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous… Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques. Profil / Mission Au sein d’une industrie qu’elle soit Retail, Luxe, pure player, tourisme ou autre, la Data est au cœur de l’activité. En effet, il s’agit de maîtriser l’écosystème Data visant à offrir une vision complète de la connaissance clients, de la performance & de l’optimisation de chaque asset media, de la stratégie globale à l’activation locale. Davidson dispose d’un savoir-faire reconnu qui lui permet d’intervenir sur différentes phases d’un projet que ce soit en Conseil et organisation, Cadrage, Définition, Conception ou Optimisation. Nos consultants interviennent sur des projets Data ingénieur, Data Analytics et Data IA. You will be joining the Artificial Intelligence team where you will report to one of our AI Researchers. November – First-stage phone interviews with the recruitment team. December – 2nd stage interviews with Team Leads January – Final stage interviews with Business Heads and offers confirmed Please note that timelines are indicative and may be subject to change. We will keep candidates informed throughout the process. Company Description Tradeweb is a global leader in electronic trading across asset classes. As financial markets become increasingly interconnected, our technology enables efficient, multi-asset trading on a global scale. We serve more than 3,000 clients in more than 85 countries, including many of the world’s largest banks, asset managers, hedge funds, insurers, corporations, and wealth managers. Creative collaboration and sharp client focus have helped fuel our organic growth. We facilitated average daily trading volume (ADV) of more than $2.8 trillion over the past four fiscal quarters, topping $3.3 trillion in ADV for the first quarter of 2026. Since our IPO in 2019, Tradeweb has completed four acquisitions and doubled our revenues – and 2025 was our 26th consecutive year of record revenues. Tradeweb plays a central role in modernizing market structure by developing innovative trading protocols, embedding analytics into execution, and building technology infrastructure that supports the convergence of traditional and digitally native financial markets. Tradeweb is a great place to work, recognized in 2025 by Forbes as one of America’s Best Companies and by U.S. News & World Report as one of the Best Financial Services Companies to Work For . At Tradeweb, we believe some of the best ideas come from looking at challenges with a fresh perspective. During your internship, you’ll be encouraged to explore how AI and emerging technologies can be applied within your area of the business. Whether through dedicated project work or your day-to-day responsibilities, you’ll have opportunities to think differently, challenge existing processes, and contribute ideas that can help shape how we work in the future.

items.desc: Description Du Poste 🎯 Chargé(e) de Gouvernance Data & IA (H/F) 🎯 🚀 Votre rôle Au sein du Département Technologies, le Data Management Office (DMO) pilote la gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Il accompagne les métiers sur la valorisation, la qualité, la maîtrise et la conformité des données, ainsi que sur les usages de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Vous rejoignez une équipe de 9 personnes, dont trois collaborateurs dédiés à la gouvernance Data & IA. Aux côtés des deux collaborateurs déjà en poste, vous faites de la Data et de l'IA des leviers responsables, maîtrisés et créateurs de valeur. Votre rôle ne se limite pas à appliquer un cadre. Vous le faites vivre, vous le challengez et vous le faites progresser. Vous intervenez au croisement des métiers, de la technologie, de la réglementation et de la maîtrise des risques, dans un environnement bancaire où la confiance dans la donnée est un enjeu stratégique. 🧩 Vos missions Vos missions s'organisent autour de quatre axes. 1- Piloter les usages Data & IA Vous pilotez et suivez le développement des usages Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous accompagnez le déploiement de l'Offre de Service Data et diffusez les bonnes pratiques associées auprès des métiers. Vous analysez et challengez les dispositifs existants, identifiez les axes d'amélioration et contribuez à leur mise en œuvre. 2- Garantir la gouvernance, la conformité et la maîtrise des risques Vous contribuez aux travaux de gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous participez aux démarches de conformité et de maîtrise des risques, notamment BCBS 239 et le cadre normatif IA. Vous préparez et contribuez aux instances de gouvernance : Comité Data & IA, Comité de Qualité des Données, Comité d'Homologation IA. Vous assurez une veille sur les évolutions Data, IA, technologiques et réglementaires, et contribuez à leur prise en compte en interne. 3- Améliorer la connaissance et la qualité des données Vous accompagnez les métiers dans la connaissance et la documentation de leurs données. Vous les aidez à identifier les écarts de qualité et à mettre en place des actions d'amélioration concrètes. Vous transformez des problématiques complexes en recommandations claires et opérationnelles. 4- Diffuser une culture Data & IA Vous animez les communautés Data & IA et coordonnez les différents acteurs de la gouvernance des données. Vous concevez et déployez des actions de sensibilisation et d'acculturation à la Data et à l'IA. Vous animez des ateliers et vous faites le lien entre les experts et les métiers. 🧩 Environnement Une équipe DMO de 9 personnes, rattachée au Département Technologies. Un pôle gouvernance Data & IA de trois collaborateurs, dont vous. Des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques, risques, conformité et instances de gouvernance. ⚒ Environnement réglementaire et outils Réglementation : BCBS 239, cadre normatif IA Gouvernance : qualité des données, documentation, homologation des usages IA Outils appréciés : Python, SQL ou tout autre langage d'analyse de données Profil recherché 🧬 Profil recherché 🎓 Formation supérieure en data, gestion des risques, audit, finance, ingénierie ou équivalent. 💼 Expérience réussie en audit, contrôle interne, gestion des risques ou conformité, idéalement en environnement bancaire ou financier. Nous recherchons avant tout un profil hybride. Vous savez prendre de la hauteur sans perdre le fil opérationnel. Vous aimez les sujets complexes, vous savez challenger l'existant et vous formulez des recommandations qui se mettent en œuvre. La Data et l'IA vous passionnent, et vous voulez mettre cette curiosité au service d'usages utiles et maîtrisés. 🤝 Savoir-être et compétences clés Gestion de projet et coordination transverse. Capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de challenge. Connaissance ou forte appétence pour la gouvernance, la qualité et la valorisation des données. As part of Nordea's 2030 strategic direction, we are modernizing our technology and data estate while accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled capabilities across the bank. You will help deliver secure, automated, and reusable GCP infrastructure and platform capabilities in close collaboration with engineers, architects, product owners, and governance stakeholders. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will design, build, test, and improve GCP platform patterns, automation, and operational controls that enable internal teams to provision and operate modern data and AI solutions safely in a regulated banking environment. About Our Team Welcome to the Data Mesh and AI Platforms team. We are building the next generation of cloud-native data and AI platform capabilities for Nordea, with a strong focus on secure infrastructure, automated provisioning, identity integration, reusable engineering patterns, and strong operational controls. You will work closely with product owners, engineers, architects, cybersecurity, data governance, and cloud platform teams. The role requires strong practical engineering skills, a delivery mindset, and the ability to turn platform architecture and agreed standards into high-quality, reusable implementation. This is a full-time permanent position with a hybrid working arrangement—up to 40% remote work is possible, but full remote work is not allowed. We expect to hire in one of these cities: Gdańsk or Gdynia, Poland; or Helsinki, Finland. Your main responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: Build, configure and improve GCP infrastructure foundations using Terraform and automated delivery pipelines. Implement reusable infrastructure-as-code modules for projects, networking, IAM, service accounts, secrets, logging, monitoring, and policy guardrails. Support secure GCP landing-zone patterns, including organization and project structure, Shared VPC, network segmentation, private connectivity, firewall policies, and environment isolation. Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines for provisioning, validation, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of platform components. Implement identity and access patterns such as federation, workload identity, least-privilege IAM, service account governance, and secure access workflows. Support GCP data and AI platform enablement, including platform patterns for Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, and related integration services. Build observability and operational controls using Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production-readiness checks. Translate platform priorities and agreed engineering standards into well-structured backlog items, engineering tasks, implementation plans, and technical documentation. Collaborate with cybersecurity, governance and architecture teams to ensure platform capabilities meet security, compliance, and operational expectations. Contribute to code reviews, pattern reviews, testing practices and continuous improvement of the GCP platform engineering experience. Key skills required for this role: GCP infrastructure: Hands-on experience with GCP projects, networking, Shared VPC, Cloud NAT, firewall policies, private connectivity, and environment separation. Terraform and IaC: Strong Terraform skills, including module usage, reusable patterns, state handling, variables, outputs, validation, and promotion across environments. IAM and security: Practical knowledge of IAM, least privilege, service accounts, workload identity, federation, secrets management, key management, and secure access patterns. CI/CD and automation: Experience building or operating pipelines for infrastructure provisioning, validation, deployment, policy checks, and release management. Data and AI platform services: Working knowledge of GCP services such as Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, Cloud Run, or GKE. Observability and operations: Experience with Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, incident response, and production-readiness practices. Engineering collaboration: Ability to work in a team, write clear documentation, participate in reviews, and communicate technical decisions clearly. Who You Are This is the right role for you if you: You are hands-on: You enjoy building infrastructure, automation, and platform capabilities that are robust, reusable, and easy for others to consume. You care about secure engineering: You understand that identity, access, network boundaries, auditability, and operational controls are core parts of platform delivery. You are delivery focused: You can take agreed priorities and engineering standards, break them …

items.desc: We invite applications for a postdoctoral position at the University of Southampton, based at the National Oceanography Centre Southampton. The successful applicant will join the UKRI NERC funded Fast and Artificially intelligent Climate projection Tool (FACT) project. This project is developing a novel AI-enhanced Reduced Order Earth System Model to produce observationally constrained climate projections at a far lower computational cost than existing complex Earth System Models, and with greater predictive ability than existing reduced order climate models. The successful applicant will facilitate the development of a new modelling framework, in which a Reduced Order Earth System Model is combined with an AI approach for developing spatial climate projections. This position is primarily concerned with continuing development of the Reduced Order climate Model component producing latitudinal climate projections, and producing very-large ensembles of observationally constrained simulations utilising Bayesian statistical methods. The successful applicant with also work to combine the reduced order model with an AI approach to generate spatial climate projections. The position is based in the School of Ocean and Earth Sciences, in collaboration with team members in the Schools of Mathematical Sciences and Electronic and Computer Sciences, and external partners. The position is offered until 31/03/2028 in the first instance, with possible extension subject to successful grant capture. Working at the University of Southampton gives you access to a wide range of benefits in addition to our competitive rates of pay. Our core benefits include pension scheme membership; a generous annual leave allowance (supplemented by University closure days and public holidays) and excellent family leave arrangements (including maternity, paternity, adoption and parental leave). https://www.southampton.ac.uk/hr/services/benefits-explained/index.page As a university we aim to create an environment where everyone can thrive and are proactive in fostering a culture of inclusion, respect and equality of opportunity. We believe that we can only truly meet our objectives if we are reflective of society, so we are passionate about creating a working environment in which you are free to bring your whole self to work. We welcome candidates form any and all backgrounds, who are committed to helping us create an inclusive work environment. As a founding signatory of the Athena SWAN charter, and holder of a silver award, we’re committed to improving equality.

items.title: Research Fellow in Thermofluid Topology Optimisation
items.card: The role will involve extending and applying our existing topology optimisation capability to challenging three-dimensional thermofluid systems, with particular emphasis on computational efficiency, numerical robustness, and large-scale design spaces. The project is part of a broader collaborative programme involving complementary expertise in high-fidelity flow simulation and experimental fluid mechanics.
items.desc: We are seeking a highly motivated Research Fellow to join an EPSRC-funded research project developing advanced computational methods for large-scale thermofluid topology optimisation. The project will build on our in-house thermofluid topology optimisation framework to design high-performance fluid–thermal systems governed by turbulent flow and heat transfer. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of scalable optimisation algorithms, adjoint-based sensitivity analysis, high-performance CFD, and robust treatment of complex multi-physics design problems. The role will involve extending and applying our existing topology optimisation capability to challenging three-dimensional thermofluid systems, with particular emphasis on computational efficiency, numerical robustness, and large-scale design spaces. The project is part of a broader collaborative programme involving complementary expertise in high-fidelity flow simulation and experimental fluid mechanics. Applicants should have a strong background in computational fluid dynamics (preferably with OpenFOAM), numerical optimisation, high-performance computing or a closely related area. Experience in topology optimisation, adjoint methods, turbulent flow modelling, heat transfer, or high-performance computing would be particularly advantageous.

Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Expedia Group is seeking a talented and experienced Data Scientist III to join our Hotels.com Analytics team. In this role, you will own analytics for some of Hotels.com’s most important growth domains – such as customer growth, loyalty & retention, large‑scale merchandizing campaigns, and website performance. You will frame ambiguous questions, design and execute rigorous analyses and experiments, and translate insights into decisions that shape the Hotels.com strategic priorities, product roadmap, and marketing tactics. You’ll work closely with product, marketing, supply, and collaborate with central analytics teams. Using tools like SQL, experimentation platforms, and occasionally Python, you will drive impact at scale. This is a high‑impact, individual contributor role where your work will directly influence how millions of travelers discover, choose, and book hotels on Hotels.com. In This Role, You Will Deep dive into Hotels.com customers and booking data to uncover patterns, diagnose issues, and suggest clear growth and optimization paths. Design, conduct, and analyze experiments (A/B tests, Pre/Post) for product and marketing initiatives, leveraging industry best practices and internal experimentation platforms. Develop and leverage a best‑in‑class analytical toolkit (SQL, Python, statistical and causal methods, experimentation frameworks) to extract insights and make data‑driven recommendations. Collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams (Hotels.com Product, Loyalty, Marketing, Supply, as well as other Analytics teams) to identify key business challenges and provide analytical insights and recommendations to support decision‑making. Drive action to improve Hotels.com KPIs (such as revenue, engagement, retention, and marketplace health), utilizing the 80/20 rule to focus effort on the most impactful results. Demonstrate creativity and persistence in overcoming roadblocks. Develop and maintain clear and user‑friendly dashboards and reports to track and analyze KPIs (e.g., customer value, engagement, campaign outcomes). Train stakeholders on their usage. Be curious and constantly monitor key metrics and trends to proactively suggest actions, test ideas, or highlight business opportunities for Hotels.com. Experience And Qualifications Mastery of SQL and experience working with complex data ecosystems. Proven track record in translating big data into strategic and actionable business recommendations; driving end-to-end processes through data extraction, analysis, insight, implementation, and evaluation. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely. Robust experience applying statistical methods and experimentation techniques such as A/B testing and Pre/Post analyses. Demonstrated experience working with Director+ stakeholders to influence decisions and drive outcomes. Solid business acumen and problem-solving abilities. Strong technical foundation in analytics and data storytelling. Ability to appropriately visualize quantitative analyses for both presentations (e.g., PowerPoint) and reporting purposes (e.g., Tableau). Relevant degree in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, or similar is preferred. Experience in e-commerce or the travel industry is a bonus. items.desc: DTC | A Codan Company is currently recruiting for DSP Engineers at Mid, Senior and Principal level. Applying for this role is straight forward Scroll down and click on Apply to be considered for this position. About Us DTC, A Codan company, operates in fast growing markets offering innovative and robust wireless security products, leading-edge IP centric network devices, and C4I application software solutions, along with high performance wireless broadcast systems for all industries. Our passion for innovation keeps us one step ahead in the rapidly changing and increasingly challenging environments within which we perform, whether on the battlefield, in the streets of our cities, or at the world's largest sporting events. High performance IP Video, communications, and broadcast systems enable our customers to securely monitor, control, communicate, and share information with confidence in complex environments and in the most demanding situations. What You Will Be Doing Reporting to the Embedded Development Manager, you will play a pivotal role in delivering advanced embedded communications solutions within DTC’s high-performing engineering team based in Whiteley. As a Digital Signal Processing Engineer, you will be instrumental in developing mission-critical wireless systems for defence and secure communications applications. Your responsibilities will include designing and implementing advanced DSP algorithms, as well as developing bespoke waveforms tailored to specific operational requirements. Additionally, you will contribute to the continuous refinement and optimisation of our Software Defined Radio (SDR) platforms, ensuring they deliver exceptional performance, flexibility, and resilience across diverse and demanding environments. Key Areas Of Experience (Essential) Algorithm Development – Design, implement, and validate advanced DSP algorithms using Python and/or MATLAB. Some experence working on design or development of products featuring FPGA or Embedded Software Key Areas Of Experience (Desirable) FPGA Development – Develop high-performance FPGA modules for DTC’s SDR platforms. HDL Design – Proficient in VHDL/Verilog and scripting with Tcl for FPGA design workflows. FPGA Toolchains – Experience with Xilinx and Altera (Intel) development environments and toolchains. Waveform Design & Development experence Embedded Software Engineering – Skilled in C/C++ programming for embedded systems, including Linux driver development and Windows-based applications; familiarity with UML is advantageous. RF Systems Design – Strong understanding of RF design principles with practical implementation experience. Test & Measurement – Competent in using frequency-domain and time-domain test equipment, such as spectrum analysers and oscilloscopes. About You You are a highly capable and motivated engineer with a degree in Electronic Engineering, Communications Engineering, or a closely related discipline. You have a strong foundation in digital signal processing and embedded systems, with proven experience designing and implementing advanced DSP algorithms for high-performance applications. Ideally, your expertise extends to RF design principles, and you demonstrate meticulous attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and a collaborative approach. You thrive in technically complex environments and are committed to delivering innovative, high-reliability solutions for mission-critical communications. As a senior member of the team, you take pride in mentoring and supporting junior engineers, fostering knowledge sharing and capability development across the group. This is an office-based role but has flexability for some home working and requires the successful candidate to meet the eligibility criteria for UK Security Clearance. Benefits and Culture Our culture is supportive and collaborative. You will be part of a multidisciplinary team where we share our ideas and innovation is strongly encouraged. We are looking for someone with genuine passion for the job and a “can-do” attitude. Our Employees Receive 25 days annual leave plus Bank holidays A generous pension plan, company match up to 9%. Company bonus scheme Annual pay reviews (discretional) A personal approach to training and development Employee Assistance Program Income protection Life assurance Flexible core working hours. items.desc: Wir bei Norizon bauen Software für den technischen Service im Maschinenbau. Unser Ziel: Erfahrungswissen aus realen Servicefällen so erfassen, strukturieren und nutzbar machen, dass es nicht in einzelnen Köpfen verloren geht. Aktuell konzentrieren wir uns auf KI-gestützte Servicefall-Dokumentation: Techniker beschreiben einen Fall natürlich per Sprache, die Software strukturiert daraus verwertbares technisches Wissen. Für die nächste Phase suchen wir eine Person, die die technische Verantwortung für Norizon übernehmen und das Produkt gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln möchte. Was die Rolle ausmacht Du arbeitest deshalb direkt mit uns und unseren Kunden zusammen und übernimmst Verantwortung von der Problemdefinition bis zur funktionierenden technischen Lösung. Was du bei uns verantwortest Technische Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts über Frontend, Backend und Cloud-Infrastruktur Architektur einer wartbaren und skalierbaren B2B-Software auf AWS Übersetzung von Kundenproblemen in technische Konzepte, Datenmodelle und User Flows Entwicklung und produktiver Einsatz von LLM-basierten Funktionen, insbesondere rund um Sprache, strukturierte Informationsextraktion und technische Dokumentation Aufbau sinnvoller Tests, Evaluationen, Monitoring- und Release-Prozesse Technische Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und grundlegende Security unseres Produkts Direkter Austausch mit Kunden bei technischen Fragen und Produktentscheidungen Perspektivisch: Training, Fine-Tuning und Evaluation eigener bzw. Open-Weight-Modelle AI-native Software Engineering Ein wichtiger Teil der Rolle ist für uns ein moderner AI Software Development Lifecycle.Wir nutzen Tools wie Codex oder Claude Code als Engineering-Werkzeuge. Wir suchen jemanden, der: agentische Coding-Tools produktiv und bewusst einsetzen kann Architekturentscheidungen selbst trifft, statt sie einem Modell zu überlassen versteht, wann ein Modell hilfreich ist und wann klassisches Engineering die bessere Lösung ist Was du mitbringen solltest Deutschkenntnisse Muttersprachler oder mindestens C1-Level (zertifiziert), da du direkt mit unseren Kunden im deutschen Maschinenbau arbeitest Sehr gute praktische Erfahrung in Full-Stack Software Engineering Erfahrung mit moderner Softwarearchitektur und produktiven Cloud-Systemen Gute Kenntnisse von AWS Erfahrung mit LLM-basierten Anwendungen und Applied AI Starkes Produktverständnis und echtes Interesse daran, Nutzerprobleme zu verstehen Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen selbstständig zu treffen und verständlich zu erklären Hoher Qualitätsanspruch bei gleichzeitig pragmatischer Startup-Mentalität Besonders spannend, aber kein Muss Training oder Fine-Tuning von Open-Weight-Modellen wie Qwen, Nemotron oder vergleichbaren Modellen Erfahrung mit Speech-to-Text oder Voice-Produkten Erfahrung mit Industrie-, Manufacturing- oder Field-Service-Software Erfahrung mit GPU-Infrastruktur, Inference und Model Evaluation Wen wir suchen Wichtig ist uns, dass du technisch stark, neugierig und reflektiert bist, gerne Fragen stellst und Verantwortung übernimmst. Du solltest Spaß daran haben, dich in die Arbeitswelt eines Servicetechnikers hineinzuversetzen, gemeinsam mit Kunden herauszufinden, was wirklich gebraucht wird, und daraus möglichst einfache Software zu bauen.

items.desc: Ingeniero/a de Mejora Continua | Industria, Tecnología e IA Zebra | AI Transformation Company · Zaragoza (presencial) ⚠️ Antes de inscribirte: requisitos imprescindibles. Solo consideraremos candidaturas que cumplan los tres: Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería. Al menos 5 años de experiencia profesional en entornos industriales. Disponibilidad para trabajar presencialmente en Zaragoza y desplazarte a instalaciones de clientes. Si no cumples alguno de ellos, no podremos valorar tu candidatura para esta posición. En Zebra buscamos ingenieros que disfruten entrando en una fábrica, entendiendo cómo funcionan las cosas y encontrando formas de hacerlas mejor. Ayudamos a empresas industriales a transformar sus operaciones combinando ingeniería de procesos, consultoría, software e inteligencia artificial. Nos enfrentamos a problemas reales: planificaciones que cambian cada día, información dispersa, costes difíciles de controlar, tareas repetitivas o decisiones que dependen de unas pocas personas. Queremos a alguien que baje al terreno, conecte con las personas, entienda lo que ocurre y convierta los problemas en mejoras sencillas, viables y medibles. 🚀 ¿Cuál será tu reto? Trabajarás con clientes industriales desde la comprensión del problema hasta el diseño, la defensa y el seguimiento de la solución. No buscamos a alguien que entregue únicamente un diagnóstico: queremos que participe en hacer realidad las mejoras. Observar y escuchar. Recorrer plantas, almacenes y centros productivos; hablar con dirección y con quienes trabajan en los procesos cada día. Analizar el sistema. Mapear procesos, entender flujos de información, detectar cuellos de botella, desperdicios, errores y dependencias. Cuantificar. Definir indicadores, contrastar datos, medir la situación de partida y calcular el impacto potencial de las alternativas. Simplificar y diseñar. Proponer cambios operativos, estándares, sistemas de gestión, automatizaciones y, cuando aporten valor, soluciones de software e IA. Defender el proyecto. Explicar al cliente qué proponemos, por qué, cuánto puede mejorar, qué recursos requiere y cómo sabremos si ha funcionado. Impulsar la ejecución. Trabajar con el cliente y los equipos de ingeniería, producto y tecnología de Zebra para concretar soluciones y comprobar resultados. La tecnología es una herramienta, no una respuesta automática. A veces la solución será cambiar la forma de trabajar; otras, desarrollar un planificador, integrar sistemas o automatizar decisiones. Nos importa elegir bien, justificarlo y medirlo. 🏭 ¿Cómo será tu trabajo? Combinarás visitas industriales, reuniones, análisis y trabajo de diseño. Participarás en varios proyectos al mismo tiempo, con clientes, sectores y problemas muy diferentes. Entre tus tareas estarán: Preparar y realizar visitas a instalaciones, entrevistas y sesiones de trabajo con equipos operativos y directivos. Levantar procesos, estudiar tiempos, capacidades, recursos, costes e incidencias; estructurar lo observado y detectar oportunidades. Construir diagnósticos y propuestas de mejora, con prioridades, estimaciones económicas, riesgos e indicadores de seguimiento. Diseñar flujos de trabajo, procedimientos, cuadros de mando y requisitos funcionales para soluciones digitales. Colaborar con desarrollo y producto para validar la viabilidad y el alcance de herramientas tecnológicas. Presentar resultados y defender propuestas ante el cliente, adaptando la conversación a perfiles técnicos y de negocio. Experimentar con software, herramientas de IA y, cuando tenga sentido, prototipos que permitan validar hipótesis rápidamente. Organizar tu actividad, coordinar compromisos y mantener el avance de los proyectos sin perder de vista el resultado. Aquí hay trabajo de oficina y de fábrica. Necesitamos una persona a la que le guste estar con el cliente, comprender sus restricciones y ganarse la confianza desde el conocimiento y la empatía. 🎯 ¿Qué esperamos de ti?Experiencia industrial y criterio de ingeniería Los cinco años de experiencia en industria y la titulación en Ingeniería son imprescindibles. Valoraremos especialmente haber trabajado en producción, operaciones, logística, calidad, mantenimiento o mejora continua, y haber participado en proyectos sobre el terreno. Queremos que sepas diferenciar lo que dice un procedimiento de lo que sucede de verdad en planta. Que seas capaz de cuestionar supuestos sin perder el respeto por quienes conocen la operación. Mejora continua basada en datos Esperamos pensamiento analítico, capacidad para identificar causas y soltura con indicadores de productividad, tiempos, capacidad, calidad y costes. Valoraremos experiencia aplicando Lean, Kaizen, VSM, Six Sigma u otras metodologías, pero nos importan más los resultados que los certificados. Una propuesta debe responder a cinco preguntas: qué problema resuelve, qué cambia, cuánto valor puede generar, qué cuesta implantarla y cómo mediremos su impacto. La coherencia económica y operativa es tan …

items.desc: Security en IT leiders krijgen elke dag tientallen berichten van leveranciers die allemaal hetzelfde beloven. Wie hen wil bereiken, moet op het juiste moment komen met een boodschap die klopt. Daar zijn scherpe campagnes voor nodig, en slimme systemen erachter. Bij Beyond Products is AI al dagelijkse praktijk. We werken in een gedeelde AI werkomgeving met eigen skills en een contextlaag per klant, en op de gesprekken van Security Innovation Stories hebben we een Buyer Brain gebouwd. Nu zoeken we iemand die dit verder uitbouwt: een AI Marketing & GTM Engineer die B2B campagnes draait én de systemen bouwt die dat werk slimmer maken. Even eerlijk: goed kunnen prompten is niet genoeg. We zoeken iemand die systemen bouwt die blijven werken als jij er niet naast zit. Systemen die data uit verschillende bronnen koppelen, vanuit dezelfde kennis werken en waar collega's en klanten elke dag op bouwen. Wat ga je doen? Always on campagnes. Je zet LinkedIn campagnes op voor klanten en optimaliseert ze doorlopend: doelgroepen, ABM lijsten, creatives, budget en retargeting. Merkbreinen. Samen met je collega's richt je per klant een contextlaag in met doelgroep, positionering, tone of voice en bewijspunten. Elke workflow werkt vanuit die kennis. Campagne en contentworkflows. Van één briefing naar een complete eerste versie van posts en advertenties, met ingebouwde checks op onderbouwing en merkstem. Signalen en sales. Je bouwt workflows in n8n of Clay die koopsignalen opvangen, zoals bedrijfsnieuws, een vacature of een nieuwe CISO. Samen met sales, bij onze klanten en bij ons, maak je daar relevante opvolging van in plaats van een stortvloed aan leads. Outreach, met beleid. Securityspecialisten zitten niet te wachten op geautomatiseerde berichten. Je bouwt mee aan een aanpak die spaarzaam en menselijk blijft, en je durft te adviseren om iets níet te doen. Vindbaarheid in AI. Je zoekt uit wat ChatGPT, Claude en Perplexity over onze klanten zeggen, en wat je daaraan kunt doen. Meten. Van kosten per gesprek tot bijdrage aan de pipeline. Je bouwt doorlopende rapportages uit GA4, Search Console en LinkedIn. Bestaat er geen koppeling, dan bouw je die zelf. Wie zoeken wij? Je hebt AI workflows, automatiseringen of agents gebouwd die anderen echt gebruiken. Een slimme prompt of een losse chatbot telt niet. Dit is onze belangrijkste eis: wat je kunt laten zien weegt zwaarder dan het aantal jaren op je cv. Je hebt ervaring met B2B campagnebeheer, het liefst met LinkedIn Ads en Google Ads, en je gaat verantwoord om met budget. Je werkt makkelijk met GA4, Search Console, tracking en advertentiedata. Claude, n8n, Make, Clay, API's, GitHub en markdown ken je, of je pakt ze snel op. Je voelt aan wat een boodschap relevant maakt voor een kritische securityprofessional, en generieke AI tekst herken je van een kilometer afstand. Je pakt zelf de regie. Niemand vertelt je wat je morgen moet doen: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, komt met ideeën en maakt je werk af, ook als je voor meerdere klanten tegelijk werkt. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en goed Engels. Security Innovation Stories Naast het bureau bouwen we aan Security Innovation Stories (SIS), een onderzoeks en contentplatform op basis van meer dan 300 gesprekken met security en IT leiders. SIS publiceert ook eigen onderzoek, zoals De Staat van Innovatie in Cybersecurity 2026. Je zit daardoor dicht op wat er bij de koper speelt, en wat je voor een klant beweert kun je onderbouwen met wat kopers ons zelf vertelden. Voor jou is SIS ook een speeltuin: het Buyer Brain staat er al, de volgende toepassing mag jij bedenken. Wat bieden wij? Een vast dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week, hybride, met kantoor in Vught. Vaste tijd om te bouwen en te experimenteren met nieuwe AI tools, in een team dat er al dagelijks mee werkt. Je leert hier veel, en snel: over AI en over hoe securitykopers beslissen. Je werkt direct met de oprichters en senior marketeers, zonder hiërarchie. Een team in Nederland en een team in Spanje. Klanten als KPN, Northwave Cyber Security, Ubiqu, CCRC en Phantom's Lab. Een competitief salaris en goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Wie zijn wij? Beyond Products is een strategisch marketingbureau voor B2B bedrijven in IT en security. Onze klanten verkopen aan CISO's en CIO's, en die doelgroep kennen we goed. Inzicht in de koper is de motor onder alles wat we doen. We zijn nog klein, dus je bent er vanaf het begin bij en bepaalt mee hoe onze AI werkomgeving groeit. Interesse? Stuur een korte motivatie en je LinkedIn profiel, en laat zien wat je hebt gebouwd: een link, een screenshot of een korte demo. Een videoboodschap mag ook, dan sta je meteen 3-0 voor. Daarna drinken we snel een bakkie in Vught. Vragen over de functie? Mail Michelle Wols: michelle@beyondproducts.io.

Your profile you like working in dynamic, cross-functional & international teams are motivated and passionate about what you do have self-driven personality thrive in challenging work environment enjoy diverse tasks, flat hierarchies and open communication channels speak English (German is a plus) Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (such as Business, STEM, or a related area). Higher degrees are preferred. Domain Our domain spans traffic analysis, tolling systems, and applied machine learning and AI, focusing on data-driven solutions for complex mobility challenges. Impact Work on smart cities, AI-driven systems, and sustainable mobility solutions. Engage with leading industry events and communities. Be part of an AI-first culture where you can experiment with tools and actively modernize processes. DevOps/SRE professionals managing cloud infrastructure, deployments, and reliability. ML engineers developing machine learning models and data-driven solutions. Data analysts analyzing large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and anomalies Solution architects and technical consultants designing and implementing systems. Business analysts bridging technical solutions and business needs.We work with modern backend and cloud-native technologies to build scalable, data-intensive systems, with a strong focus on streaming technologies and user-facing real-time analytics. If you believe your skills or background could contribute to our company in any way, we encourage you to submit an application. We’d love to hear from you! Why us? We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, religion, belief, or age. Important note: We manage our recruitment process entirely in-house and do not collaborate with external recruiters. Please refrain from sending unsolicited profiles or outreach.
