items.desc: Veeva’s Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an accelerated pathway that transforms early-career professionals into high-impact consultants who deliver cloud and AI solutions, helping global Life Sciences companies bring life-changing therapies to patients. The Role You’ll work hands-on with innovative technology, collaborating directly with internal teams and external customers, implementing our products to solve complex business challenges. In this role, you’ll learn our industry-leading cloud platforms and work with cutting-edge AI solutions to transform how life sciences companies operate. Empowered from day one by a team-first culture, you will accelerate your career growth as a technical consultant who thrives in an environment where we work hard for our customers and each other. Now hiring for our April 2027 and September 2027 start dates. The Program As part of the Consultant Development Program, you will: Ramp up quickly. Your journey begins with an intensive, team-based onboarding program that combines hands-on learning, transparent feedback, and active collaboration to develop the consulting skills and industry knowledge to make an impact right away. Learn by doing. You won't be watching from the sidelines. You will take on real responsibility and work directly with customers to solve problems within your first three months. Thrive together. Grow alongside a supportive team of seasoned leaders and peers who actively champion your development through open communication and actionable feedback. Build your future. Advance from Associate to Consultant in less than 2 years. More importantly, you’ll develop the foundation for a successful, long-term career where you can continually expand your technical expertise, lead complex projects, and evolve with our global and diverse team. What You'll Do As part of our Professional Services team, you are a strategic partner guiding customers through implementation. We will teach you how our software works, and you will use that knowledge to design, configure, and deliver solutions that drive real business value. Your day-to-day will involve: Designing & tailoring the software: You will lead the configuration of our platform to fit each customer's unique business model—setting up workflows, structuring data, and aligning system capabilities to requirements. Conducting discovery workshops: You will lead interactive discovery workshops with customer stakeholders to gather business requirements, map out existing workflows, and translate their vision into actionable technical specifications for deployment. Managing project scope & execution: You will take ownership of core implementation deliverables by scoping requirements, building timeline estimates, and keeping project milestones on track from kick-off through go-live. Guiding the customer as an expert: You will lead the customer with best practices to ensure their business processes are optimized for maximum long-term value on our products. What We Are Looking For | We are open to graduates of a variety of backgrounds and look for a specific mindset: Drive: You thrive in a challenging, intense environment that rewards initiative and rapid learning. Curiosity: You have a genuine desire to be hands-on with software and master new technologies. Communication: You are fluent in English and German with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Analytical Mindset: You are a strong critical thinker with a proven track record of academic performance (in any degree/field of study). Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company and we expect that from all employees. Work Ethic: A commitment to excellence and passion for working hard to achieve results. Travel: Willingness to travel as needed (up to 20-30% of the time). Experience: Recent bachelor’s or master’s degree graduate How We Hire | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps: Apply: Submit your resume, a short cover letter, and take a quick personality test, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously. Fast Response: We will notify you of your next step typically within one week. Interview & Case: Interview with a Veeva leader. If successful, we will give you a real-world scenario (with 3 days to prepare) to present to our team. Offer: We make decisions quickly—usually within a week of your final presentation. What We Offer Starting Annual Salary: 48,000 EUR. Perform well, and in one year you’ll receive a compensation increase and participate in our bonus program. Hybrid Work Environment: We require Associate Consultants to live within reasonable commuting distance from Veeva's Frankfurt or Berlin office giving you easy access to in-person collaboration and support, skill development, and social opportunities as you launch your career. Long-term, our Work Anywhere policy allows you flexibility to work from the office or from your …

 Dev Ops Engineer - Machine Learning
 Job ID 2026-19775 
 Date posted Oct. 30, 2026 
 Location Galway, Ireland 
 Category Software Engineering 
 Apply 
 Job Overview 
 Join the Machine Learning DevOps team and help ML software teams adopt effective DevOps practices. You will contribute to the infrastructure, automation and services that support software development, including cloud enablement and management of shared physical-device test infrastructure. This is an opportunity to work closely with engineers on technologies that help power the next generation of computing. 
 Responsibilities 
 Partner with Machine Learning software teams to understand their development and infrastructure needs and support the adoption of DevOps practices. 
 Develop and maintain hybrid (Windows, Linux, MacOs, Android) infrastructure, automation and support services for software engineering workflows. 
 Support multi-cloud enablement activities and board farm management for ML software development and testing. 
 Improve continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows, containerised environments and operational documentation. 
 Investigate infrastructure and tooling issues, communicate findings clearly and contribute to practical solutions with the wider team. 
 Deploy, monitor and troubleshoot a pool of physical devices (Silicon boards and mobile handsets) 
 Required Skills and Experience 
 Practical experience working with Linux systems and supporting engineering infrastructure. 
 Understanding of DevOps principles and how they support reliable software delivery. 
 Ability to write and maintain automation scripts using Bash, Python or a similar scripting language. 
 Experience with CI/CD or containerisation technologies, such as Docker or Kubernetes, and the ability to collaborate clearly with technical colleagues. 
 Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience 
 Experience building or maintaining software workflows using CI/CD tools. 
 Interest in computer architecture, compilers or operating systems. 
 Experience with low-level programming or debugging. 
 Contributions to open-source projects or personal technology projects that demonstrate practical learning and problem solving. 
 In Return 
 You will work in a collaborative team where your ideas and contributions can make a tangible difference. The role offers the opportunity to develop your DevOps expertise while working with Machine Learning software teams on infrastructure and tooling that support future computing technologies. You will have scope to learn, share knowledge and help improve the ways teams build, test and deliver software. 
 Additional Information 
 Please note this role does not meet the eligibility requirements for sponsorship, and therefore the successful candidate must have the right to work in the UK without relying on sponsorship by Arm. 
 #LI-BG1 
 Our 10x Mindset 
 At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x-mindset 
 Use of AI in Your Application 
 At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you.

 Graduate Program - Engineering Pathways
 Job ID 2026-20009 
 Date posted Oct. 30, 2026 
 Location Cambridge, United Kingdom; Manchester, United Kingdom; Sheffield, United Kingdom; Bristol, United Kingdom 
 Category Hardware Engineering, Graduate, Applications Engineering, Architecture, Architecture - Engineers, Engineering Operations, Machine Learning, Product Management, Product Security, Program/Project Management, Software Engineering, Technical Writer, Verification 
 Apply 
 Job Overview
 Arm technology powers billions of devices, from the hardware inside a chip to the software and tools that bring it to life. This opportunity brings together graduate roles across hardware engineering, software, AI, systems and technical product development.
 You will contribute to real products and technical projects while learning alongside experienced teams. Opportunities are aligned to your skills, interests and the needs of the business, helping you build expertise that supports the future of computing.
 What you could be doing as a Graduate:
 Designing hardware, from digital logic and circuits to the physical implementation of chips.
 Verifying and validating hardware and software through simulation, testing and debugging.
 Modelling how processors and systems perform, exploring opportunities to improve performance and power efficiency.
 Developing software, firmware, drivers, compilers and engineering tools.
 Applying AI, machine learning, data analysis and automation to engineering challenges.
 Helping shape and deliver technical products and programmes through research, analysis, planning and collaboration.
 Supporting partners and developers as they build products and applications using Arm technology, through research, coding, data analysis, planning and clear technical communication.
 We are looking for individuals who:
 Hold (or are on track to hold) a University degree by the programme start date. This can be a Bachelors, Masters or PhD in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or other relevant subjects such as Physics and Maths. Candidates with alternative degrees will also be considered if they have relevant experience.
 Qualities that will help your application stand out
 Experience in every area isn't expected. We're interested in examples of:
 Building, testing, debugging, analysing, modelling or improving something technical through coursework, research, internships, placements or personal projects.
 Applying programming, hardware, AI/ML, data, simulation or other engineering tools to solve practical problems.
 Using analysis or evidence to investigate problems, inform decisions or improve outcomes.
 Learning unfamiliar technologies and adapting approaches to overcome challenges.
 Collaborating with others and communicating technical findings effectively.
 Application Closing Date
 2026-11-22
 We aim to review all applications no later than two weeks after the closing date. In peak periods there may be exceptions beyond this timeframe. We will do our best to keep you informed.
 In Return
 You’ll receive a starting salary of £48,000 (Bachelor level) or £49,000 (Master level), alongside a comprehensive rewards package. As you develop in role, you’ll have clear opportunities to progress within the salary range at Arm.  Job Overview
 We are looking for Graduate Systems Engineers to join our Systems Engineering teams in Bristol. You'll help develop and verify key hardware technologies that support memory management, communication and AI processing within next-generation Arm-based SoCs.
 About the Team 
Our Systems Engineering teams develop technologies that enable complex computing systems to manage data, memory and communication efficiently. Engineers work across memory and interconnect technologies, System Memory Management Units (SMMUs) and AI Subsystems, contributing to the hardware that connects and supports different components within an SoC. You'll collaborate with specialists in hardware design, verification, architecture and performance analysis.
 What you could be doing as a Graduate Systems Engineer:
 Contributing to the design and verification of system-level hardware, including memory management technologies, interconnect components and AI Subsystems.
 Developing simulations, tests and verification environments to validate hardware functionality, data movement and system behaviour!
 Investigating system-level issues and collaborating with design, verification and architecture engineers to improve functionality, performance and reliability.
 We are looking for individuals who:
 Hold, or be on track to complete by the programme start date, a degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or a related technical subject. Other degree backgrounds with relevant technical experience are also welcome.
 Qualities that will help your application stand out
 Whilst we will support and develop you throughout the graduate programme, it will help if you bring:
 An interest in digital hardware and computer architecture, including an understanding of digital logic, RTL design or hardware verification!
 Knowledge of memory systems, memory management, cache coherency, interconnect technologies or AI/ML compute concepts
 Experience with programming, scripting or hardware description languages such as Python, C, C++, SystemVerilog, Verilog or VHDL.
 Relevant experience can come from university coursework, practical projects, internships or independent learning. You do not need to meet every desirable criterion to apply.

Place of work: Hellerup Deadline: 22. november 2026 Your models might start in Python. Their impact goes far beyond it. Your career in data science might only just be getting started. At NORDEN, you will apply it to real logistics challenges involving vessels, ports, terminals, weather and cargo flows. At NORDEN, moving cargo from A to B involves vessels, ports, terminals, weather, cargo flows and countless operational constraints. Understanding how all those pieces interact can make a real difference to the decisions we make and at the end our base margin. As our new Data Scientist in Maritime Logistics, you will turn that complexity into models we can explore, test and learn from, helping us make better operational and commercial decisions. You do not need years of experience or deep shipping knowledge. What matters is a strong foundation in Python and supply chains and the curiosity to apply it to the real world. Why this role? Because you get to take problems that exist in the real world and build models that help us understand what could happen next. You might be modelling how vessels move through a logistics network, exploring the capacity of a terminal or testing what happens when weather, congestion or operational constraints change. Other times, you could be looking at historical data, improving an existing model or helping colleagues understand what different scenarios could mean commercially and operationally. A central part of your role will be translating complex logistics systems into simulations that allow us to ask better questions before decisions are made in the real world. You will work closely with commercial and operational colleagues while learning from experienced colleagues within analytics and shipping. Our broader Quantitative Analytics environment works with Python and technologies including Prefect, Docker and Azure and you will also gain practical experience developing solutions and visualisations using Power BI. What you will be doing You will work where shipping, logistics and data science meet. Helping us continuously improve how we work with simulation, optimisation, analytics and software development. To be more specific you will: Design and develop simulation models of supply chains and maritime logistics operations. Use discrete-event simulation and agent-based modelling to represent vessels, terminals, ports and other parts of complex logistics systems. Analyse logistics networks and explore opportunities to improve capacity, throughput, utilisation and operational efficiency. Use historical and operational data to calibrate, validate and continuously improve your models. Build analytical tools that allow colleagues to explore scenarios and understand their operational and commercial implications. Develop robust analytical models and simulation solutions in Python. Create visualisations that make complex outputs easier to understand and use. What you bring There is no need to understand every aspect of shipping or every modelling method from day one. What matters is that you have a good analytical foundation, an understanding of supply chains and logistics and the curiosity to keep learning. Qualification we are looking for: Have 0–3 years of relevant professional experience. Hold a degree in Supply Chain Management and Logistics, industrial engineering, operations research or another relevant quantitative field. Have a good foundation in Python and are comfortable writing structured, maintainable analytical code. Are fluent in English, our working language. Are eligible to work in Denmark. What matters just as much is how you work with people. You are curious about how complex operations actually work, you ask questions before jumping to the model and you can explain what your analysis means to colleagues who may never open a line of Python themselves. Application Please upload your motivation letter, resume and relevant diplomas via our website as soon as possible and no later than 22 November 2026. Your motivation letter helps us understand what drives you, why you are interested in the role, and how your skills and experiences could contribute to the team. We are especially interested in your motivation and transferable skills, not a recap of your CV. It is your opportunity to tell us the story behind your application. We review and interview candidates on an ongoing basis. We will do our best to get back to you at least within ten working days after the application deadline, 22 November 2026. items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Join Us as a Research Scientist– Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation Team: In-trial research team within the Patient-Centered Research group Location: North America or Europe Patient-Centered Research, In-trial qualitative research Evidera’s Patient-Centered Research (PCR) group combines a unique portfolio of scientific disciplines, including health sciences, psychometrics, epidemiology, psychology, and many other social sciences. Our PCR staff conduct a variety of studies using quantitative and qualitative approaches to develop clinical outcomes assessments, evaluate patient preferences and utilities, execute various implementation science studies, conduct Delphi panels and do secondary data analysis using advanced statistical techniques. Within the PCR group, the ITR team conduct qualitative (interviews) studies and/or surveys in the context of a clinical trial to obtain feedback from clinical trial participants (patient, caregiver, investigator or study staff) on various topics i.e., understanding patients’ experience with their condition, its impacts on their lives, exploring treatment benefit, describing trial participant experiences and identifying aspects of burden from their participation. ITR can be implemented using an embedded design (e.g., ITR is defined as clinical trial activity in the clinical trial study protocol and ICF) or associated design (ITR is covered under separate protocol, separate ICF, and IRB/EC approval, with separate site recruitment and contracting). ITR can be conducted at any trial phase and at any time in the trial (screening, mid-trial, exit). Over the past few years, there has been a growing interest in ITR studies by regulators to support relevance and interpretation of trial outcomes, meaningful change and/or meaningful treatment benefit. At NORDEN, moving cargo from A to B involves vessels, ports, terminals, weather, cargo flows and countless operational constraints. items.desc: Your models might start in Python. Their impact goes far beyond it. Your career in data science might only just be getting started. At NORDEN, you will apply it to real logistics challenges involving vessels, ports, terminals, weather and cargo flows. At NORDEN, moving cargo from A to B involves vessels, ports, terminals, weather, cargo flows and countless operational constraints. Understanding how all those pieces interact can make a real difference to the decisions we make and at the end our base margin. As our new Data Scientist in Maritime Logistics, you will turn that complexity into models we can explore, test and learn from, helping us make better operational and commercial decisions. You do not need years of experience or deep shipping knowledge. What matters is a strong foundation in Python and supply chains and the curiosity to apply it to the real world. Why this role? Because you get to take problems that exist in the real world and build models that help us understand what could happen next. You might be modelling how vessels move through a logistics network, exploring the capacity of a terminal or testing what happens when weather, congestion or operational constraints change. Other times, you could be looking at historical data, improving an existing model or helping colleagues understand what different scenarios could mean commercially and operationally. A central part of your role will be translating complex logistics systems into simulations that allow us to ask better questions before decisions are made in the real world. You will work closely with commercial and operational colleagues while learning from experienced colleagues within analytics and shipping. Our broader Quantitative Analytics environment works with Python and technologies including Prefect, Docker and Azure and you will also gain practical experience developing solutions and visualisations using Power BI. What you will be doing You will work where shipping, logistics and data science meet. Helping us continuously improve how we work with simulation, optimisation, analytics and software development. To be more specific you will: Design and develop simulation models of supply chains and maritime logistics operations. Use discrete-event simulation and agent-based modelling to represent vessels, terminals, ports and other parts of complex logistics systems. Analyse logistics networks and explore opportunities to improve capacity, throughput, utilisation and operational efficiency. Use historical and operational data to calibrate, validate and continuously improve your models. Build analytical tools that allow colleagues to explore scenarios and understand their operational and commercial implications. Develop robust analytical models and simulation solutions in Python. Create visualisations that make complex outputs easier to understand and use. What you bring There is no need to understand every aspect of shipping or every modelling method from day one. What matters is that you have a good analytical foundation, an understanding of supply chains and logistics and the curiosity to keep learning. Qualification we are looking for: Have 0–3 years of relevant professional experience. Hold a degree in Supply Chain Management and Logistics, industrial engineering, operations research or another relevant quantitative field. Have a good foundation in Python and are comfortable writing structured, maintainable analytical code. Are fluent in English, our working language. Are eligible to work in Denmark. What matters just as much is how you work with people. You are curious about how complex operations actually work, you ask questions before jumping to the model and you can explain what your analysis means to colleagues who may never open a line of Python themselves. Application Please upload your motivation letter, resume and relevant diplomas via our website as soon as possible and no later than 22 November 2026. Your motivation letter helps us understand what drives you, why you are interested in the role, and how your skills and experiences could contribute to the team. We are especially interested in your motivation and transferable skills, not a recap of your CV. It is your opportunity to tell us the story behind your application. We review and interview candidates on an ongoing basis. We will do our best to get back to you at least within ten working days after the application deadline, 22 November 2026. In NORDEN we value a range of perspectives, educational backgrounds and professional experience and encourages all qualified candidates to apply. Were you missing anything in this job ad? Please share your feedback with us here. Our company We are a global provider of ocean- based freight services for bulk and project cargo of all sizes. items.desc: Overview At Susquehanna, quantitative researchers drive innovation from the centre of our trading floor. Leveraging expertise in probability, statistics, numerical analysis, stochastic optimisation, and machine learning, they play a pivotal role in developing and refining our trading strategies. We are looking for recent or upcoming PhD and research master’s graduates to join our quantitative research graduate programme. Run by a team of dedicated senior traders and quantitative researchers, our education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. Don’t worry if you don’t come from a finance background – we will teach you everything you need to succeed. A core strength of our graduate programme is that our education is complemented by hands-on trading games and project work. Through this work, graduates gain exposure to all phases of the work of quantitative researchers including problem conceptualisation, modelling, strategy back-testing and iteration, implementation, and monitoring. What We're Looking For Research-minded: You enjoy diving deep into a question and building mathematical models to reveal patterns in vast amounts of data. Analytical & detail-oriented: You approach problems with a curious and analytical mindset – building models, interpreting data, and uncovering insights with precision. Clear communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others. Soon-to-be research master’s/PhD graduate or post-doc: You have completed research in a quantitative discipline and are available to join the graduate programme in June 2026. What’s In It For You Education: Our industry-leading education programme is designed to facilitate researchers’ transition to the world of quantitative trading. You will attend classes covering a vast range of topics (Options Pricing, Machine Learning, Data Analysis Techniques, Game Theory… the list goes on!) from some of the most experienced employees in Susquehanna. Collaboration: You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology. Culture: Our non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive. Perks: We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our graduates. Located in Ireland’s Financial Services Centre, in the heart of Dublin’s city centre, our office features free onsite catering, a games room, and a fully equipped in-house gym. About Susquehanna Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. **We hire for our quantitative research positions on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early. ** Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. items.desc: Overview Quantitative systematic traders represent a true hybrid of our core disciplines: trading, technology, and quantitative research. Drawing on their technical proficiency, research experience, and understanding of trading, quantitative systematic traders’ work involves identifying trading signals, developing strategies, and collaborating extensively with members of the trading, quantitative research, and technology teams. As a graduate on our quantitative systematic trading programme, you will benefit from our industry-leading education programme run by a team of senior traders and quantitative researchers. Don’t worry if you don’t come from a finance background – we will teach you everything you need to succeed. A core strength of our graduate programme is that our education is complemented by hands-on trading simulations and project work. Graduates are immersed in real-world algorithmic trading problems, learning about our proprietary dataspaces, novel modelling approaches, and strategy implementation. Additionally, quantitative systematic trading graduates develop a deep understanding of trading decision-making by participating in various types of trading simulations. What We're Looking For Research-minded: You enjoy diving deep into a question and building mathematical models to reveal patterns in vast amounts of data. Technically proficient: You have experience writing code to process and analyse large datasets. Clear communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others. Ambitious: You’re someone that enjoys setting personal goals and giving your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics, or another passion, you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential. Soon-to-be master’s/PhD graduate or post-doc: You conduct research in a quantitative discipline and are available to join the programme in June 2027. What’s In It For You Education: Our industry-leading education programme is designed to facilitate your transition to the world of quantitative trading. Classes on various topics (Options Pricing, Machine Learning, Data Analysis Techniques, Game Theory, Trader Talks, In-house trading games… the list goes on!) will be complemented by hands-on project work and trading simulations. Collaboration: You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology. Culture: Our non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive. Perks: We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our graduates. Located in our brand new office in London’s city centre, our office features free onsite catering, a games room and dedicated education space. About Susquehanna Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. **We hire for our quantitative systematic trading positions on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early. ** Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. items.desc: Why Harvey At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. Role Overview As a Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts. We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work. We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements. Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research. What You'll Do Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows. Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail. Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows. Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation. Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination. Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most. Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions. What You Have Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production-quality code. A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead. The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria. Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LLM work. We are hiring for this role across multiple levels. items.desc: En tant que stagiaire au CEA, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'un environnement de recherche de renommée mondiale. Nos équipes sont composées d'experts passionnés et dédiés, offrant un cadre propice à l'apprentissage et à la collaboration. Vous aurez accès à des équipements de pointe et à des ressources de recherche de premier ordre pour mener à bien vos missions. Éventuellement, les travaux menés donneront lieu à une publication scientifique Description du poste : La perception et l’analyse de l’environnement qui nous entoure est un enjeu majeur dans beaucoup de domaines industriels porteurs. Dans ce contexte, les algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle (IA) ont incontestablement montré leur efficacité pour des tâches liées à la vision, avec différents capteurs (caméra, lidar…). Aujourd’hui, il y a un intérêt croissant pour l’exploitation de données de capteurs radar (radio detection and ranging) par de l’IA. Le radar est en effet un capteur qui se démarque par la nature de ses données, son opérabilité (faible luminosité, mauvaise météo…) et son coût. Cependant, ils produisent des données éparses avec une faible résolution spatiale, ce qui les rend difficiles à exploiter par les algorithmes traditionnels. Récemment, les réseaux de neurones artificiels basés sur une représentation des données sous forme de graphe (Graph Neural Networks - GNN) ont montré une bonne précision sur des données de capteurs éparses et bruitées [1]. En conséquence, l’utilisation de GNN pour exploiter les données radar semble très prometteuse [2]. Le spectre d’application est large avec le véhicule intelligent (surveillance de l’habitacle), le dispositif médical (mesures de signes vitaux), détection de gestes [3] ou encore le dispositif de surveillance (détection de chutes). Qu'attendons-nous de vous ? Dans un contexte en pleine évolution et avec un fort intérêt industriel, le stagiaire implémentera et proposera des méthodes innovantes de traitement de données issues d’un capteur radar. Il s’appuiera sur des algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle, basés sur des GNN, actuellement développés au sein du laboratoire. L’étudiant(e) sera intégré(e) dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire dynamique. [3] Damphoffer et al. « Lightweight and Robust Embedded Radar-based # Cea-List Moyens / Méthodes / Logiciels intelligence artificielle, deep learning, réseaux de neurones artificiels, graph neural networks, vi Profil du candidat Profil recherché: Etudiant(e) en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou Master 2 Compétences souhaitées: Une forte motivation pour apprendre et contribuer à la recherche en intelligence artificielle. Une connaissance approfondie en informatique et langages de programmation (Python). Des connaissances en intelligence artificielle et une expérience dans les réseaux de neurones artificiels (librairies Pytorch ou Tensorflow) sont un plus. items.desc: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. We are looking for a Data & AI / ML Evaluation Engineer to own the data collection, mining, curation and continuous evaluation foundation for our various AI security products. High-quality models require high-quality datasets and ongoing enrichment and retraining. In this role, you will build automated data ingestion pipelines from surrogate web traffic and open sources, manage dataset curation, labeling workflows, model training and operate our benchmark and evaluation harnesses. This is a data and AI / ML software engineering role focused on building the data infrastructure that trains our proprietary Prompt Injection SLMs, Shadow-AI detection models, Malicious Macro classifiers, PII, Content Classification engines and more. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: Automated, continuous generation and curation of training, evaluation, and false-positive (FP) datasets across web, file, and macro threat surfaces. Standardized, reproducible evaluation benchmarks that guide model improvements before deployment. Automated data pipeline uptime and ingestion throughput from web/file sources. Size, diversity, and labeling accuracy of threat dataset repositories (PI, Shadow-AI, PII, Macros). Mean time to ingest live false-positive/false-negative feedback into training evaluation loops. Accuracy and benchmark coverage across historical vs. newly trained SLMs. What You'll Do Design and operate automated data collection, mining, and web-scraping pipelines to gather threat samples from surrogate traffic and web sources. Build data processing, annotation, and dataset curation workflows, training and re-training various models, e.g. Prompt Injection (PI) SLMs, Shadow-AI detection models, Malicious Macro classifiers, and PII detection. Build mechanisms to capture false-positive (FP) samples from live user/DDR flows and represent / integrate them into model retraining pipelines. Develop automated benchmarking and evaluation harnesses to continuously test model detection quality, runtime performance, and accuracy against baseline models (e.g., Vertex AI). Build automated pipelines for model training for various models. Work closely with research and software engineering teams to turn raw detection telemetry into ongoing actionable model improvements. Required: 2–4 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or automated QA/evaluation roles. Strong programming proficiency in Python. Adv: C++, SQL. Experience in model training and various ML, AI algorithms. Experience building data pipelines, web scrapers, or automated data processing systems. Familiarity with data structures, storage formats, and database configurations. Methodical approach to dataset labeling, validation, bug logging, and metric tracking. Preferred / Nice to Have: Hands-on experience with ML evaluation frameworks, dataset curation, or annotation tools. Familiarity with text extraction, NLP preprocessing, or document parsing techniques. Understanding of cybersecurity concepts (Prompt Injection, Malicious Macros, DLP/PII). Basic experience with cloud storage, object stores, and basic containerization (Docker). Experience with AWS, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Linux. Follow us on LinkedIn! Why Menlo? At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership , Straight Talk , United Impact , Elevated Talent , and Customer-Compelled . items.desc: Rejoindre Davidson, ce n’est pas seulement intégrer un groupe de 3000 consultants dans 6 pays et 2 continents, c’est intégrer LA société qui a été élue par ses salariés Great Place To Work France et Europe pendant 4 ans mais aussi une des plus grandes B Corp de France, nommée Best of the World dans la catégorie “collaborateurs” en 2022 ! (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous… Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques. Profil / Mission Dans le cadre de projets Data Science menés par Davidson pour ses clients dans des secteurs variés (Gaming, Luxe, Télécoms, Finance, etc.), tu interviendras en tant que spécialiste ML & DL. Ta mission consistera à accompagner des experts métiers sur des problématiques variées : traitement du langage naturel, reconnaissance d’images, détection de la fraude, système de recommandation, agent conversationnel, etc. À Ces Fins Tes Missions Consisteront à Animer des ateliers d’expression de besoins Identifier, intégrer et croiser les sources de données (structurées ou non structurées) Préparer et analyser des données Créer, implémenter des modèles Prototyper et valider les algorithmes Mesurer les gains obtenus Communiquer et capitaliser sur les résultats Réaliser une veille technologique ainsi que des études d’opportunités Compétences requises ou à acquérir De formation ingénieur / BAC+5, tu as déjà réussi plusieurs projets dans le domaine de la Data Science. Avec au minimum 2 ans d’expérience professionnelle (et c’est vraiment un minimum hein…) Des compétences scripting sont nécessaires. Et mieux vaut être fort en maths ! Aptitudes / Savoir-être Excellent relationnel Capacité d’analyse Curiosité Pédagogie Anglais + SQL / Python bilingue

items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Graduation assignment: Data-assisted diagnosis and predictive maintenance Level: HBO bachelor or WO bachelor/master graduation project Relevant studies: Software Engineering Location: Thermo Fisher Scientific, Eindhoven R&D, Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) Introduction Thermo Fisher Scientific develops technologies and services that help customers make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Eindhoven is its primary technology location for Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), bringing together R&D, manufacturing, and service expertise. Thermo Fisher Scientific in Eindhoven TEM instruments use electrons to reveal structures at extremely small scales, supporting research in life sciences and materials science. This assignment explores how software can help engineers diagnose problems in these complex instruments more efficiently. Background and objective Service engineers use system logs, bug reports, calibration files, and technical procedures to investigate failures. This information is often spread across multiple sources, making diagnosis time-consuming and dependent on individual experience. The objective is to develop and evaluate a software prototype that combines historical system data with service knowledge to suggest likely causes and useful diagnostic checks. Research question How can historical system data and service knowledge support faster and more reliable diagnosis of a selected TEM system problem? The student will investigate which data sources are useful, compare suitable technical approaches, and measure the prototype’s value against the current diagnostic process. Scope and approach The project focuses on one failure mode or a closely related group of problems, such as an offline module or recurring performance issue. The student will: Analyse the current diagnostic process with service engineers. Assess and prepare relevant data and technical documentation. Compare approaches such as structured search, diagnostic rules, and an LLM-based assistant. Build a prototype that provides diagnostic suggestions with supporting evidence. Evaluate diagnostic accuracy, diagnosis time, and usability using historical cases and engineer feedback. The prototype is intended for internal evaluation. Predictive maintenance may be explored as an extension if sufficient degradation or failure data is available. Deliverables A research plan and assessment of available data. A working prototype with documented code and usage instructions. An evaluation against the current diagnostic approach. A graduation thesis, final presentation, and recommendations for further development. Intern Requirements We are looking for a student who: Is enrolled in an HBO or WO Software Engineering programme and is ready to start a graduation assignment. Has programming experience, preferably in C#. Python is also acceptable. Understands software design, testing, and version control. Can analyse data and approach technical problems systematically. Can work independently and collaborate with software engineers and service specialists. Communicates clearly in English, both verbally and in writing. An interest in AI, machine learning, or information retrieval is welcome. Prior knowledge of electron microscopy is not required. Apply today!

items.desc: Murex is a global fintech leader in trading, risk management and processing solutions for capital markets. Operating from our 19 offices, 3 400 Murexians from over 65 different nationalities ensure the development, implementation and support of our platform which is used by banks, asset managers, corporations and utilities, across the world. Join Murex and work on the challenges of an industry at the forefront of innovation and thrive in a people-centric environment. You’ll be part of one global team where you can learn fast and stay true to yourself. Description Murex a fondé début 2025 l’ AI Lab , une initiative directement sponsorisée et suivie par le CEO de Murex. L’objectif est d'anticiper les transformations futures du secteur du marché des capitaux et de positionner Murex comme un acteur majeur de l’IA en France et en Europe. Ce stage s'inscrit dans le cadre d'un projet “moonshot” de recherche en IA visant à améliorer l'interprétation et l'alignement des données transactionnelles complexes par les systèmes financiers. Dans les grands environnements financiers, une seule transaction peut générer de multiples enregistrements à travers différents systèmes et processus métier. Même au sein de MX.3 (la plate-forme intégrée pour les marchés des capitaux développée et commercialisée par Murex), un même événement économique peut apparaître dans différents modules et à différentes étapes de son cycle de vie. Au fil du temps, ces représentations peuvent se fragmenter en raison d'opérations telles que la compensation, les modifications ou l'agrégation, ce qui complique le maintien d'une vision cohérente de l'événement sous-jacent. Dans Le Cadre De Ce Projet De Recherche, Le Stage Se Concentrera Sur Les Données Issues De MX.3 Et Explorera Une Approche Supervisée Pour Détecter Les Relations Entre Les Objets, Même Lorsque Les Identifiants Sont Manquants Ou Incohérents. Durant Le Stage, L'étudiant(e) Devra Construire un ensemble de données structuré de paires d'objets MX.3, Concevoir des caractéristiques pertinentes, Evaluer des modèles de classification, Analyser les facteurs qui contribuent le plus efficacement à la reconstruction des événements. Durée du stage : 5-6 mois Profil Etudiant(e) Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur idéalement - une spécialisation en finance de marché est un plus) Solides compétences analytiques Expérience de base en Python (pandas), en analyse de données et en concepts introductifs d'apprentissage automatique Intérêt pour la finance, l'analyse de données et les systèmes pilotés par l'IA Rigueur, précision, esprit d'analyse et de synthèse Autonomie, capacité à travailler de façon indépendante Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Ce stage offre une initiation aux systèmes des marchés de capitaux, à la modélisation des données financières et aux applications de l'intelligence artificielle axées sur la recherche pour améliorer la qualité des données et la reconstitution des événements.

items.desc: Description We are looking for a Data Scientist / Data Engineer to support the client’s ADAS organization. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and applied data science, working with large-scale sensor and vehicle data used to develop, validate, and improve ADAS functions (e.g., collision avoidance, lane keeping, adaptive cruise control, sensor fusion). The ideal candidate combines strong technical data skills with the interpersonal drive needed to work across multiple engineering teams and extract the right requirements and context. Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in data engineering or data science roles, ideally within automotive or another safety-relevant industry. Demonstrated experience working with ADAS-related data (sensor data, perception outputs, vehicle logs) or strong interest and transferable experience from adjacent domains (robotics, autonomous systems). Strong proficiency in Python and standard data engineering toolchains; hands-on experience with Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative development. Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Pandas, SQL-based data warehouses). Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) is a plus. Understanding of automotive data standards (CAN, DBC files, AUTOSAR data concepts) is a strong plus. Personal Attributes (Critical for This Role) High drive and initiative — comfortable proactively reaching out across departments (ADAS function teams, test/validation, software, systems engineering) to gather context and clarify ambiguous requirements. Strong communication skills; able to translate between technical data language and functional/engineering language. Curious, self-directed problem-solver who takes ownership of data quality and pipeline reliability end-to-end. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with evolving priorities. Job responsibilities Design, build, and maintain data pipelines for ingesting, processing, and structuring large volumes of ADAS sensor and test data (camera, radar, lidar, CAN bus logs). Apply data science methods to analyze vehicle and sensor datasets, supporting feature development, algorithm validation, and performance benchmarking of ADAS functions. Collaborate with ADAS function owners, test engineers, and software teams to translate development and validation needs into data requirements. Develop and maintain reusable Python-based tools and scripts for data extraction, transformation, and analysis, version-controlled via GitHub. Support root-cause analysis of ADAS performance issues using data-driven investigation. Contribute to data quality frameworks, labeling standards, and metadata management specific to ADAS datasets. Present findings and data insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. What we offer Empowering Projects: With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment. items.desc: Company Description Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human. We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together. What’s the role? Etsy is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Search Ads team. We are looking for individuals who are product and delivery-driven, and are passionate about making ML innovations in digital advertising to help improve the Etsy buyer/seller experience. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone interested in building user-centric ML systems for a two-sided marketplace with 90+ million buyers, 6+ million sellers, and hundreds of millions of unique, handmade, vintage listings. Etsy sellers use Etsy ads for advertising their products and growing their business. Etsy Ads optimizes sellers’ budgets to advertise their listings in the places on Etsy where they perform best. The work on the team involves building machine learning systems to power the sponsored search product including retrieval, ranking, ad allocation and user engagement modeling on Etsy.com and the Etsy app. This is a full time role reporting to the Engineering Manager, Search Ads. What’s this team like at Etsy? Our team develops custom machine-learning models that can drive product vision and customer impact. We ensure that the right ads are put in front of the right buyers We maintain a pipeline that scales for our 90+ million buyers and sellers We make the ad experience more personalized to a buyers journey What does the day-to-day look like? Work cross functionally with product engineering teams and communicate your ideas and model capabilities to product managers Apply the latest advances in machine learning to improve the relevance and increase buyer ad engagement Prototype, optimize, and productionize large-scale ML models to improve our ads funnel Conduct A/B experiments to validate the efficiency of ML models and pipelines Work closely with product managers, ML engineers, and analytics partners to measure and improve our ads product Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are: You have a track record of applying statistical and machine learning techniques in addressing real-world problems You are an expert in one of the following fields: natural language processing, information retrieval, search and/or recommendations, deep learning. You have experience training, deploying, monitoring, debugging and iterating on production machine learning systems in search, recommendation, and/or ads systems. You can successfully create requirements and lead your team from design through to delivery. You write understandable, testable code and you have an eye towards maintainability. You care about the implications of your work on end users. Compensation & Benefits In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience. Location We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Dublin Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. items.desc: Er du vår nye Data Engineer og AI-utvikler? Om rollen Som Data Engineer og AI-utvikler hos Forte får du jobbe med store og komplekse datamengder hos kundene våre. Det kan være alt fra store og kjente aktører som NorgesGruppen og Virke, til mindre og spennende startups med høye ambisjoner. Forte sitt Data & AI-miljø jobber med moderne dataplattformer, robuste dataflyter, analyse og AI-utvikling. Hos oss får du være med å bygge løsninger som gjør data tilgjengelig, pålitelig og verdifull, samtidig som du bidrar til å forme hvordan vi jobber faglig med data og AI. Du vil jobbe tett med kunder, utviklere, analytikere og forretningsmiljøer. Vi ser etter deg som er selvstendig, strukturert og nysgjerrig på ny teknologi, og som liker å kombinere solid data engineering med utforsking av nye muligheter innen AI, kodeagenter og AI-støttede arbeidsmetoder. Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver vil være Utvikle, drifte og videreutvikle dataplattformer og pipelines Designe og implementere datamodeller, integrasjoner og dataflyter Strukturere, transformere og optimalisere store datasett Sikre høy datakvalitet, god dokumentasjon og robuste leveranser Samarbeide med analytikere, utviklere og forretning for å gjøre data tilgjengelig og nyttig Bidra aktivt til Forte sitt Data & AI-miljø gjennom kunnskapsdeling, diskusjoner og faglige initiativer Hvem er du? Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du liker å jobbe praktisk med data, samtidig som du er opptatt av helheten rundt løsningene du bygger. Du forstår at gode dataplattformer ikke bare handler om teknologi, men også om forretningsverdi, kvalitet, samhandling og langsiktig forvaltning. Vi Ser Gjerne At Du Har Minimum 3 års relevant erfaring som Data Engineer, AI-utvikler eller i tilsvarende rolle Relevant høyere utdanning eller tilsvarende praktisk erfaring Erfaring med moderne dataplattformer som Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure Synapse eller tilsvarende skybaserte løsninger God forståelse for datakvalitet, datamodellering og ETL/ELT-prosesser Erfaring med visualisering og rapportering, for eksempel Power BI, Tableau eller tilsvarende verktøy Evne til å formidle komplekse tekniske temaer på en forståelig måte til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter Interesse for AI-løsninger, LLM-er og hvordan nye verktøy kan brukes til å skape bedre arbeidsflyt og bedre løsninger Forretningsforståelse og evne til å omsette data og innsikt til konkrete virksomhetsmål og beslutningsstøtte Fagmiljøet i Forte I Forte møter du folk som virkelig liker faget sitt. Vi er nysgjerrige, deler raust og liker å lære av hverandre. Mange av oss trives med å gå i dybden, teste nye verktøy og diskutere hvordan teknologi kan brukes bedre i praksis. Fagmiljøet vårt er i stor grad drevet av de ansatte selv. Det betyr at du får mulighet til å påvirke hva vi utforsker, hvordan vi deler kunnskap og hvilke faglige initiativer vi prioriterer. Det er lav terskel for å holde talks, dele erfaringer fra prosjekter, vise frem noe du har testet eller starte en diskusjon om et tema du er opptatt av. Hos Forte får du jobbe med varierte kunder, komplekse problemstillinger og moderne teknologi i et sterkt fagmiljø. Vi ser etter deg som vil bygge solide dataløsninger, utforske nye muligheter og bidra til at både kunder og kollegaer lykkes med data og AI. Hva kan vi tilby? 🌴 6 uker ferie Du får 6 uker ferie, fra det andre året du er ansatt i Forte 🧠 Faglig utvikling i arbeidstiden Hos oss finner du gode sparringspartnere i alt fra juniorutviklere til erfarne arkitekter. Du får bidra til å påvirke faglig retning, og du har 8 timer i måneden i arbeidstiden til å utvikle deg innenfor det du ønsker. 🩺 Gode forsikringsvilkår Dekket privat helse- og reiseforsikring og gode pensjonsordninger 🎉 Godt sosialt miljø Vi finner alltid en unnskyldning til å samles - alt fra aktivitetsgrupper, turer og månedlige arrangementer. Vi møtes ofte for sosiale samlinger på kontorene våre sentralt i Oslo (ved Slottsparken) 👶 Full lønn i foreldrepermisjon Du får selvfølgelig utbetalt full lønn i foreldrepermisjon 🤸 Dekket treningsavgift Vi vet at trening kan bidra til å fremme bedre helse. Forte dekker treningsavgift for opp til 800,- per måned Vi er Forte og vi er et europeisk konsulentselskap. Navnet vårt betyr styrke, og det er akkurat det vi gir våre kunder. Styrken til å tilpasse seg. Til å handle. Til å vokse. Vi hjelper våre kunder med å forbli relevante og realisere sitt fulle potensial - uansett hva fremtiden bringer. Vi kombinerer teknologi, strategi og brukeropplevelse for å gi deg det du trenger for å lede – ikke bare følge etter. Vi drives av det som virkelig teller: Målbare resultater, verdi og varig relevans. Vi heier på kundene våre og strekker oss litt lenger for å skape resultater sammen. Med raushet og engasjement møter vi deg der du er, tilpasser oss dine behov og gir tydelig retning. Vi tar initiativ, handler raskt og er alltid et steg foran – fordi vi gir alt for at du skal lykkes.

items.desc: Stellenbeschreibung Du hast Erfahrung im KI Umfeld und möchtest dich weiterentwickeln? Du hast bereits Beratungserfahrung, aber die Work-Life-Balance in deiner aktuellen Beratung ist dir zu schlecht? Dann werde KI Developer bei CGI! CGI ist eine global agierende und führende Management- und IT-Beratung mit weltweit rund 90.000 Mitarbeiter:innen. Unsere Projekte sind entsprechend genauso vielfältig wie unsere Kunden und ihre Herausforderungen, entsprechend sind wir ein globales Netzwerk für Fachexpert:innen als Business-, Project- oder IT-Consultants. Bei CGI ist es uns äußerst wichtig, dass Unternehmensberatung und ein erfülltes Privatleben kein Widerspruch darstellen (#Work-Life-Balance). Wir legen Wert auf langfristige Mitarbeiterbeziehungen, Mitarbeiter:innen sind bei uns keine Ressourcen, sondern Partner der CGI-Community. Mit unserem Metro-Markt-Modell stellen wir systematisch den standortnahen Einsatz unserer Berater:innen sicher, dies bedeutet das du im Normalfall keine Reisetätigkeit und stattdessen einen geregelten Feierabend zuhause mit Hobbys, Freunden und Familie hast. Dies ist Teil unserer sozialen unternehmerischen Verantwortung zur Vereinbarkeit von Privatleben und Karriere (#CSR). Zur Umsetzung spannender Projekte aus IT- und Business Consulting unserer Kunden im Rhein-Main-Gebiet (Großraum Frankfurt, Mainz, Wiesbaden) suchen wir engagierte Berater:innen. Aufgaben Als KI-Developer bist du in unserem Team Experte für die Umsetzung und arbeitest eng mit Data Scientists, Business-Analysten, Architekten und IT-Teams zusammen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung in folgenden Bereichen: Implementierung von Modellen in produktive Anwendungen. Entwicklung von APIs, Pipelines und Microservices für KI-Funktionalitäten. Optimierung von Modellen für Performance und Skalierbarkeit. Zusammenarbeit mit Architekten, um Lösungen in bestehende IT-Landschaften einzubetten. Sicherstellen und Implementierung von Monitoring, Logging und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung. Sicherstellen technische Realisierbarkeit und Produktionsreife. Qualifikation Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung und mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung Du bist Kommunikationsstark auf Deutsch und Englisch Erfahrungen in der Umsetzung produktiver KI-Anwendungen, Erfahrung mit generativen Modellen (Text, Code, Bild) und Kenntnisse in LLMs und ihrer Integration Programmiersprachen: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python, zusätzlich ggf. sogar Java, C++ oder R. Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Cloud-Plattformen: AWS, Azure oder GCP Erfahrung aus der Softwareentwicklung die ggf. unterstützen: Clean Code, Testing, Versionierung (z.B. Git), API-Design und Anbindung. Hilfreich sind darüber hinaus Kenntnisse im Bereich MLOps & Deployment: Kenntnisse in Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Model Serving (z. B. MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker). Im Bereich Datenmanagement: Umgang mit großen Datenmengen und unstrukturierten Daten, Data Lakes, Data Warehouses. Fließende Deutschkenntnisse WAS WIR BIETEN Bei uns findest du Kolleg:innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos. Du arbeitest meist direkt an deinem Heimatort – weil wir Kundennähe wörtlich nehmen und uns Work-Life-Balance am Herzen liegt. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten. Die richtigen Trainings und Zertifikate bringen deine Weiterbildung voran. Unsere E-Learning-Plattform Academia ermöglicht dir das Lernen, wo und wann du willst. Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst du in CGI Aktien investieren – bis maximal 3 % des Monatsgehalts geben wir für jeden Euro einen weiteren hinzu. Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet, sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten. Mit Jobticket und Jobbike fördern wir umweltfreundliche Mobilität. Abhängig von deiner Rolle und Projektsituation sind auch Bahncard oder Elektro-Firmenwagen möglich. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper! Wir sind an deiner Seite, auch wenn es einmal nicht so gut läuft: Du kannst Sonderurlaub nehmen, und unsere Beratungshotline steht dir immer zur Verfügung. Gemeinsamen Events und Aktivitäten stärkt deine Verbundenheit mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten! Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit …

items.desc: Cambridge, UK | Full-time | Permanent | Hybrid Salary: £40,000.00 About Us Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion. Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast. About The Role Riverlane’s Engineering Graduate Scheme is designed for graduates in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Engineering, Physics, Maths and related subjects who want to build a career in quantum computing. You will join us as a permanent, full-time employee at our head office in Cambridge, UK. During your first 12 months, you will rotate through Engineering teams, gaining hands-on experience of different technical challenges and approaches to developing QEC technology. Your work throughout the scheme will focus on engineering, in close collaboration with research teams and learn how research is translated into working technology. You will have a dedicated supervisor to support you through your rotations and help you develop your technical and professional skills. You will take on meaningful work from the outset, while learning from experienced colleagues across our multidisciplinary team. You do not need a background in quantum computing. You will have the opportunity to learn about QEC as part of the scheme. At the end of the programme year, you will move into an Engineering team or Engineering Research role to continue developing your career at Riverlane. What You Will Do Design, develop and improve software or hardware tools used in quantum computing and QEC Contribute to engineering projects from initial design through implementation, testing and improvement Learn how to build and test complex products at the cutting edge of technology Work with engineers and scientists from different disciplines to solve technical problems Develop your engineering skills through hands-on work, feedback and support from your team What We Need A completed or in-progress Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Systems Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or a related subject. Graduation in 2026 or expected graduation in 2027. Evidence of strong technical skills and creative problem-solving through academic work, research, personal projects or other relevant experience. Experience with at least one programming language, preferably C++ or Python. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Clear written and verbal communication skills. The ability to take initiative and work effectively as part of a team. An interest in applying your skills in an industrial setting and a strong desire to learn. Important notes The Engineering Graduate Scheme is the beginning of a permanent, full-time career at Riverlane. The 2027 intake will start in autumn 2027. The rotational element lasts for 12 months, after which graduates will move into an Engineering team or Engineering Research role. Application Deadline & Selection Process Please submit your application by Friday 6 November 2026 . Stage 1: Remote technical challenges These will be arranged individually, with seven days to complete them. All challenges must be completed by Monday 7 December 2026 . Stage 2: Assessment day An assessment day will be held at our headquarters in Cambridge, UK, on Thursday 14 January 2027 . Please keep this date available. How To Apply Please upload a CV and covering letter. Your covering letter should explain why you are applying for Riverlane’s Graduate Recruitment Scheme and what skills and experience you feel you can bring to the role. What Can You Expect From Us Alongside a competitive salary, we offer private medical insurance, a health cash plan and life assurance, as well as many other benefits You can also expect a diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields (including software and hardware development, quantum information theory, physics and maths) and over 25 different nationalities. If you have any queries, please contact jobs@riverlane.com. Please do not send your applications to this email address, all applications should be submitted via our careers page. Everyone is welcome at Riverlane. We are an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from eligible and suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, …

items.desc: På Prevas tror vi på att teknik gör världen bättre. Och för att lyckas göra den bättre, behöver vi personer som dig. Därför bygger vår kultur på just det, att finnas där för varandra och ha kul längs vägen. Hello Opportunity! Prevas GCM (Goods Certification Manager) är ett inmatningssystem för artikelinformation enligt GS1-standarden. Kunder matar in information om deras produkter och delar den i datapooler. Återförsäljare kan sedan hämta informationen från datapoolerna från flera leverantörer i ett och samma format (GS1-standarden) i stället för att kommunicera med varje leverantör enskilt. Exempel på kunder är företag inom dagligvaruhandel. Själva examensarbetet består i att undersöka om det från produktbilder går att att använda AI för att automatisera en idag manuell process. Din bakgrund Detta examensarbete riktar sig till dig som läser datavetenskap elr motsvarande och planeras att genomföras på kandidatnivå. Övrigt Arbetet utförs i våra lokaler i Karlstad men precis som för våra konsulter så finns det en flexibilitet och möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Arbetet utförs med fördel i par. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser Prevas värdegrund Gemensamma kärnvärden är nyckeln till vår framgång. De banar vägen för bättre kommunikation och samarbete, minskar behovet av detaljerade regler och förordningar och gör vår organisation mer agil och dynamisk. Att dela värderingar ger större frihet att agera utan detaljerade regler. Att dela gemensamma värderingar betyder inte att vi alla är lika. Vi älskar skillnader och främjar mångfald. Vi tror att unika individer är viktiga för att skapa starka och framgångsrika team. Våra värderingar styr vårt dagliga beteende gentemot både kunder och medarbetare. När vi respekterar våra värderingar och uppträder i enlighet med dem, ger vi uttryck för vår företagskultur. På Prevas sammanfattar vi våra värden i akronymen BOAT – Business driven, Open-minded, Active och Team player.

Vous accompagnerez le front office de Global Banking dans la transition de nos clients vers une économie bas-carbone, en orientant les financements vers une trajectoire net zero à l’horizon 2050. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le Low Carbon Transition Group et piloterez le projet de mesure de l’alignement du portefeuille de crédits avec les objectifs climatiques du Groupe. Au sein de l’équipe mutualisée C2A Data Analytics (Engagement Groupe & CIB), vous développerez des méthodologies innovantes et industrialiserez les processus de revue des secteurs les plus émetteurs de gaz à effet de serre (pétrole et gaz, production d’électricité, automobile, immobilier, acier, transport maritime, aviation, etc.).
