Développer et améliorer en continu les méthodologies sectorielles et leur documentation. Adapter et enrichir les programmes de simulation pour intégrer de nouvelles options méthodologiques. Modéliser les données manquantes et proposer des solutions innovantes. Participer à l’industrialisation du projet GoNetZero. Collaborer avec les spécialistes sectoriels pour simuler les impacts portefeuille, affiner les indicateurs et analyses, et apporter votre expertise data. Oui, si vous être titulaire d’un Bac+5 en école d’ingénieur, université ou équivalent universitaire et avez au moins 3 ans en tant que Data Scientist ou Data Analytics et avez des compétences avérées en programmation Python. Une expérience préalable sur les sujets climatiques serait un atout. Vous êtes reconnu pour vos capacités d’analyse et de synthèse, vous savez faire preuve d’initiatives et vous avez un goût pour la collaboration. Vous communiquez aisément à l’écrit et à l’oral. items.desc: Über uns Slalom ist ein modernes Beratungsunternehmen, das sich auf Strategie, Technologie und IT-Transformation konzentriert. In 45 Märkten auf der ganzen Welt haben unsere Berater:innen die Möglichkeit, nach dem lokalen Ansatz schnell bei unseren Kunden zu sein und vor Ort zu helfen. Slalom wurde 2001 gegründet, hat seinen Hauptsitz in Seattle und ist organisch auf über 12.000 Mitarbeitenden gewachsen. Slalom wurde acht Jahre in Folge von Fortune zu einem der 100 besten Arbeitgeber ernannt und wird regelmäßig von seinen Mitarbeitenden als bester Arbeitsplatz ausgezeichnet. Deine täglichen Aufgaben Als Google Cloud AI Engineer unterstützt du die Entwicklung von KI-Lösungskonzepten und arbeitest an der Gestaltung moderner Gemini Enterprise Architekturen mit, setzt etablierte GenAI-Muster und Best Practices für den Einsatz von KI-Agenten und multimodalen Anwendungen um und beteiligst dich an der Abstimmung technischer Lösungen im Team Durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Kollegen und unter Anwendung moderner Beratungsmethoden wirkst du iterativ an der Konzeption, dem Design und der Implementierung von GenAI-Lösungen auf Basis von Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform und anderen modernen Google Cloud Services mit Du hilfst Kunden rund um moderne Google Cloud und GenAI Lösungen und unterstützt das Team aktiv bei (Pre-)Sales Aktivitäten, insbesondere bei der Konzeption technischer Lösungen Das bringst du mit Du hast bereits einige Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Beratung mit Google Cloud und ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in der Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen Bisher warst du vor allem im Bereich Google Cloud und GenAI tätig und hast praktische Erfahrungen im Design und der Implementierung von Gemini Enterprise-basierten Lösungen gesammelt Du hast bereits eine oder mehrere Google Cloud Professional Certifications erfolgreich abgelegt Moderne Google Cloud Architekturen – idealerweise auch mit Terraform – zu entwerfen und umzusetzen ist dir vertraut, Erfahrungen mit anderen Hyperscalern wie Azure oder AWS sind von Vorteil Du verfügst über sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch (min. C1-Level) Deine Benefits Bis zu 30 Tage Arbeiten im Ausland nach Absprache jährlich möglich ﻿30 Tage Urlaub und die Möglichkeit des Erwerbs von bis zu zehn zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen pro Jahr Eine monatliche individuelle Mobilitätspauschale für private Reisen mit der Bahn, Auto, Flugzeug, Rad, Tank- oder Werkstattkosten Monatliche Smartphonepauschale von 100€ (Brutto) und freie Wahl deines Laptops (Apple oder HP) Mit deiner Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM Wellpass hast du Zugang zu über 2.800 Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnesseinrichtungen sowie zu Apps und Home Workouts Jährliches Budget von rund 300€ für dein Well-being. Ob Yoga, Fitnesskurs, Massage oder doch einer Spende für einen guten Zweck, du entscheidest Wir kümmern uns um deine Zukunft–mit einer jährlichen Zahlung in unseren Pensionsfond (4% des Grundgehalts) ﻿Zwei Impact Days für Volunteering in deiner Community pro Jahr Du bist uns wichtig – neben Coaching und weiteren Unterstützungsprogrammen bieten wir umfangreiche Versicherungspläne für dich und deine Familie an Regelmäßige Teamevents, Get together und Lunch & Learns mit den besten Kollegen:innen in unseren zentralen Offices Was uns ausmacht Unsere zehn „Slalom Core Values“ sind ein fester Bestandteil von allem, was wir bei Slalom tun, und prägen unsere mitarbeiterzentrierte Kultur. Wir fördern die Vielfalt am Arbeitsplatz und stellen sicher, dass alle unsere Mitarbeitenden ihr Potenzial voll entfalten können, unabhängig von ihrem persönlichen, kulturellen und sozialen Background. Wir bauen Teams auf, die die Vielfalt der Communities widerspiegeln, für die wir arbeiten. Come as you are! Deshalb Slalom Obwohl Slalom schon seit 2001 ein globaler Player ist, befinden wir uns in einer für unsere Branche besonderen Ausgangslage und werden nach wie vor von unseren Gründern geführt. Dies bedeutet konkret, dass unsere Ziele nicht von externen Stakeholder:innen getrieben werden, sondern stets die Mitarbeitenden und unsere Kunden im Vordergrund stehen. Unser Ziel ist es, unsere Kunden mit allen nötigen Skills auszustatten, damit diese vollumfänglich hinter ihrer Reise in die Cloud stehen und nach dem erfolgreichen Abschluss der gemeinsamen Projekte diese Veränderung eigenständig und nachhaltig leben. Man könnte fast sagen: „wir kommen, um zu gehen“. Milestones Mehr als 12.000 Slalomer:innen. Acht Länder. 45 Standorte. Und stetiges, schnelles Wachstum. In Deutschland haben wir unseren ersten Standort 2022 in München eröffnet, Düsseldorf und Frankfurt folgten in 2023 und 2024. Das Team ist auf über 150 Mitarbeiter:innen angewachsen und wird sich auch im Jahr 2026 stetig vergrößern.

Tavs uzdevums būs identificēt AI iespējas biznesa procesos, koordinēt risinājumu ieviešanu sadarbībā ar IT un palīdzēt darbiniekiem apgūt jaunas darba metodes. Risinājumu programmēšana un tehniskā izstrāde nebūs šīs lomas pienākums. Tavi galvenie uzdevumi: Koordinēt uzņēmuma AI ieviešanas
items.desc: Aicinām pievienoties mūsu komandai AI ieviešanas koordinatoru, kurš veicinās mākslīgā intelekta praktisku izmantošanu uzņēmumā. Tavs uzdevums būs identificēt AI iespējas biznesa procesos, koordinēt risinājumu ieviešanu sadarbībā ar IT un palīdzēt darbiniekiem apgūt jaunas darba metodes. Risinājumu programmēšana un tehniskā izstrāde nebūs šīs lomas pienākums. Tavi galvenie uzdevumi: Koordinēt uzņēmuma AI ieviešanas un izmantošanas veicināšanas programmu. Koordinēt un prioritizēt AI iniciatīvas, sekojot to ieviešanas progresam un rezultātiem. Sadarboties ar biznesa komandām, identificējot vajadzības un definējot prasības AI risinājumiem. Veidot vienotu AI iniciatīvu ieviešanas pieeju un koordinēt sadarbību starp biznesa komandām un IT visā iniciatīvas ciklā - no idejas izvērtēšanas līdz testēšanai, ieviešanai un rezultātu uzraudzībai. Organizēt darbinieku apmācības un veicināt AI risinājumu izmantošanu uzņēmumā. Ko mēs sagaidām: Vismaz 3 gadu pieredze biznesa analīzē, projektu vadībā, procesu uzlabošanā, pārmaiņu vadībā vai digitālu risinājumu ieviešanā. Pieredze starpfunkcionālu projektu koordinēšanā un sadarbībā ar biznesa un IT komandām. Praktiska pieredze AI rīku izmantošanā un vispārēja izpratne par AI iespējām, ierobežojumiem, datu kvalitātes nozīmi, testēšanu un atbildīgu izmantošanu. Labas analītiskās, plānošanas un komunikācijas prasmes, spēja strukturēt biznesa vajadzības un virzīt iniciatīvas līdz rezultātam. Pieredze darbnīcu, apmācību vai darba grupu vadīšanā. Ļoti labas latviešu valodas un labas angļu valodas (vismaz B2) zināšanas. Par priekšrocību uzskatīsim: Pieredzi AI, automatizācijas vai citu digitālo risinājumu ieviešanā organizācijā. Augstāko izglītību biznesa vadībā, ekonomikā, IT vai līdzīgā jomā, kā arī papildu zināšanas projektu vadībā, LEAN vai Agile. Ko mēs piedāvājam: Iespēju būt daļai no uzņēmuma AI attīstības un digitālās transformācijas. Profesionālās izaugsmes un ideju īstenošanas iespējas. Mūsdienīgus darba apstākļus un hibrīda darba modeli. Atalgojumu no 3000 līdz 3500 EUR bruto mēnesī atkarībā no pieredzes, zināšanām un kompetencēm. Bezmaksas sporta zāli, apmaksātus mobilā telefona pakalpojumus un citas darbinieku priekšrocības. Ļoti labu veselības apdrošināšanas polisi un apdrošināšanu pret nelaimes gadījumiem.

items.card: The Role We’re growing our diverse team, and you’ll contribute to the development and verification of next-generation neural network hardware! items.desc: Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence acceleration and technologies for the future of computing? We have an excellent opportunity to apply your curiosity and creativity in crafting next generation AI hardware accelerators contributing to our system testing team! We have multiple open positions available across a range of experience levels. The Role We’re growing our diverse team, and you’ll contribute to the development and verification of next-generation neural network hardware! Collaborating with experts across global design centers, you’ll help deliver Arm’s next-generation IP using sophisticated tools and methodologies. As a System Test Engineer, you will make a difference by influencing the verification strategy and methodology, taking ownership of complex work packages, and driving them to successful completion. What You'll Do The work involves designing and building test automation, developing and running test cases, and working with modern tools and infrastructure. We are a distributed team crafting and deploying advanced emulation environments for pioneering Neural Accelerators. Your work will help bridge the gap between silicon development and real-world deployment, improved system validation, and reducing time-to-market. You’ll collaborate with engineers across architecture, design, verification, and software, to optimize complex emulation workflows and use cases to support design bring-up, debug, feature validation, and system validation. Required Skills And Experience Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring high-quality verification that minimizes bug escapes. Demonstrated experience in specifying, creating, and debugging system test environments, authoring test case, tracking results, and troubleshooting simulation/emulation mismatches and test failures. Hands-on experience with emulation platforms such as ZeBu, Palladium, or Strato. Familiarity with RTL languages such as SystemVerilog/Verilog Experience in collaboration with EDA vendors to introduce new capabilities, resolve tool issues, and contribute to future tool improvements. Skilled in planning system test tasks and producing realistic effort and time estimates. Additional Qualities That Will Help Your Application Stand Out Experience with requirements definition and management. Familiarity with UVM-based verification environments. Experience with CI platforms and version control tools such as Git. Proficiency in scripting such as Python or Perl to automate workflows and diagnostics. Experience with software testing of embedded devices Practical knowledge of machine learning and neural networks. Understanding of efficiency tuning techniques and performance analysis for large-scale emulation systems. If skilled worker sponsorship is required, Arm will meet costs associated with sponsorship for the employer only. All fees associated with the individual’s application e.g. visa application fee and Immigration Health Surcharge, will be the responsibility of the successful candidate. Our 10x Mindset At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x-mindset Use of AI in Your Application At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. items.desc: Privacy & AI Governance Specialist Location: London, England Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation. Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies. Overview We are currently seeking a Privacy & AI Governance Specialist to join our Information Security, Privacy & Compliance team. As a Privacy & AI Governance Specialist, you will report to our Data Protection Officer. In this role, you will support the continued maturity of Quorum's global privacy, data protection, and AI governance programs while helping the business navigate evolving regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to embed privacy-by-design and responsible AI practices into business processes, products, and services while supporting compliance, innovation, and operational excellence. You will also contribute to vendor management, customer assurance activities, and the continuous improvement of Quorum's governance framework. Responsibilities Support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Quorum's global privacy, data protection, and AI governance programs. Maintain privacy documentation, including policies, procedures, templates, playbooks, Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), data maps, and DPIA/PIA materials. Advise internal stakeholders on privacy, data protection, vendor reviews, data subject rights, cross-border data transfers, AI use cases, and privacy-by-design principles. Conduct and support Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs), AI risk assessments, and privacy reviews for products, vendors, systems, and business initiatives. Review customer and vendor agreements, including Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), security schedules, and AI/data use provisions. Support vendor management activities, customer audits, pre-sales security questionnaires, compliance reporting, privacy incidents, and breach response activities. Maintain privacy and AI governance inventories, including data processing activities, vendors, AI tools, data flows, and associated risk assessments. Monitor global privacy, cybersecurity, and AI regulatory developments, translating legal and regulatory requirements into practical policies, standards, and operational processes. Deliver privacy, AI governance, and information security training and awareness initiatives across the organization. Collaborate closely with enterprise and business unit stakeholders to integrate privacy, data protection, and AI governance principles into products, services, and business operations. Identify, investigate, and help remediate compliance gaps and areas of risk to support ongoing regulatory compliance and continuous improvement. Proactively research and maintain a working knowledge of emerging privacy, AI governance, cybersecurity, and data protection laws, regulations, and industry best practices. And other duties as assigned. Requirements Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Law, Information Governance, Information Security, Compliance, Risk Management, Business, Technology, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, information governance, legal operations, security risk, or a related discipline. Working knowledge of GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other global privacy regulations. Experience conducting or supporting DPIAs/PIAs, maintaining Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), data mapping, vendor privacy reviews, data subject rights, privacy-by-design initiatives, and incident response activities. Familiarity with vendor management, risk management, customer audits, compliance reporting, and privacy/security contract reviews, including DPAs and SCCs. Previous experience with GRC, privacy, or compliance platforms (e.g., OneTrust or similar tools) is preferred. Strong analytical, research, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex regulatory concepts to technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global environment. Critical-thinking, …

items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we need a Senior Machine Learning Engineering to join our Engineering Team . This team is the beating heart of Prima. You’ll be joining over 350 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details What You Will Do Defining the model development methodologies and best practices, following the whole life cycle with a central role in choosing the technological stack; Supporting the productionalization and evolution of the Oracles, entities that through machine learning pilot the behavior of Prima's microservices; Developing the tools (packages, microservices, pipelines...) that you deem fundamental for your and your team job; Growing, reading, and experimenting to always be up to speed with emerging technology. What We’re Looking For A robust programming background, spotlighting your prowess in Python; A familiarity with the lifecycle of ML model development, including past experience in taking them to production; Proficiency in software development practices like TDD and BDD, ensuring our code is marked by quality, readability, and maintainability; A wealth of experience in software architecture, encompassing an understanding of common design patterns. Your focus on Machine Learning, Microservices, and DDD sets you apart;Exceptional command of the English language. Nice-to-Have Alongside the essential prerequisites, we're excited to find experience in version control of data and artefacts (like DeltaLake, DVC, or MLFlow), designing and operating cloud-based systems, preferably within AWS or Databricks, familiarity with messaging platforms and proficiency in infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi), a grasp of K8s and service mesh concepts, and previous exposure to data orchestration tools. £70,000 - £105,000 a year Why You’ll Love It Here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: DR Byg og driv de AI-platforme, som hele DR bygger på AI er en vigtig forudsætning for, at DR kan indfri sine strategiske ambitioner. Nye etiske algoritmer, der modvirker bias og polarisering, større effektivitet i DR's kernefunktioner, fleksible formater for DR's indhold og personalisering er alle strategiske prioriteter, som AI gør mulige. Skal DR nå de ambitioner i stor skala, skal AI være tilgængeligt for hele organisationen som centrale platforme og services, som DR bygger videre på, i stedet for at hvert team selv anskaffer, bygger og driver sine egne modeller, værktøjer og sin egen infrastruktur. Det kræver også, at AI-systemer kører ordentligt i produktion, også dem, som vores publikum er afhængigt af. Som Chef for AI Platform bygger, driver og ejer du de centrale AI-platforme, den infrastruktur og de services , som DR's AI-use cases bygges på og leveres fra. Du har ansvaret for deres pålidelighed, sikkerhed og omkostninger. Rollen balancerer mellem to hensyn. At gøre AI tilgængeligt og til at stole på: AI er klar til brug: teams får modeller, harnesses, værktøjer og services fra en central platform i stedet for selv at anskaffe og drive dem. AI-systemer kører stabilt i produktion, også dem, publikum bruger, med den driftsdisciplin, som produktion i DR kræver. Vejen fra idé til produktion er kort, fordi platformen allerede leverer det, teams ellers selv skulle bygge. Forbrug og omkostninger er kendte: forbrug, udbredelse og udgifter måles pr. platform, pr. team og pr. use case. At undgå ukontrolleret spredning og upålidelig AI: Ukontrolleret spredning: at hvert team vælger sine egne modeller, værktøjer og sin egen infrastruktur, uden sammenhæng og uden overblik. AI, der ikke holder i produktion: systemer, der virker i en pilot, men som fejler, bliver dårligere eller rammes af model drift, når folk begynder at være afhængige af dem. Adgang uden styring: modeller, værktøjer og agenter, der bruges uden kontrol med, hvem der bruger hvad, på hvilke data og med hvilke guardrails. Løbske omkostninger: udgifter til modeller, inferens og licenser, der vokser uden kontrol og uden opfølgning. Dine ansvarsområder Du udvikler, hoster og driver de centrale AI-platforme og -teknologier, som hele DR bruger, og du har ansvaret for at levere: Agentisk AI-platform. Den platform, som alle agentiske løsninger kører på, både til agentisk softwareudvikling og agentiske forretningsprocesser. Det omfatter runtime og deployment af agenter med isolation og sandboxing, triggering og integration med DR's systemer og data, orkestrering med koordinering mellem agenter og adgang til værktøjer, observability, tracing og replay af flows fra ende til anden samt deployment og drift af de guardrails, kvalitets- og policy-tjek, som Arkitektur stiller til rådighed. Generelle harnesses. DRChat (DR's interne chatbot), Claude og lignende, som drives som en service for hele DR, med adgang og identitet, guardrails, governance, logging og omkostninger pr. bruger og pr. team. Platform til data science og machine learning. Den platform, DR's data scientists og ML engineers arbejder på, fra eksperimenter til produktion. Det omfatter eksperimenter, feature engineering, experiment tracking og orkestrering af pipelines, model registry, modelkatalog og teknologierne bag model management samt den MLOps-værktøjskæde, der implementerer de standarder, Arkitektur definerer. Platform til træning, inferens og serving. Infrastrukturen, hvor modeller trænes, og infrastrukturen, der leverer modeller i produktion: online-, batch- og streaming-inferens for hostede, tunede og selvtrænede modeller, herunder LLM'er, SLM'er og klassiske ML-modeller. AI control plane. Governance-laget på tværs af agentiske use cases og ML-use cases: AI- eller LLM-gateways (routing, rate limiting, omkostningsopfølgning, nøglehåndtering, central logging), modelkatalog, register over værktøjer og MCP-servere, katalog over agenter og skills samt adgangsstyring på tværs af dem. AI-relaterede services. Fælles services, der understøtter eller er kernen i AI-use cases, for eksempel semantisk søgning. Færdige, genbrugelige AI-services. Tale til tekst, tekst til tale, vision og lignende, som tilbydes organisationen som færdige produkter med dokumenteret interface, omkostningsoverblik og SLA. Drift af alle platformens komponenter. Du har ansvaret for tilgængelighed, performance, sikkerhed og omkostninger på tværs af interne, udviklerrettede og publikumsrettede workloads. Det omfatter monitorering, alerting, incident management, sikkerhed, livscyklusstyring af platforme og modeller, disaster recovery og på sigt en vagtordning. Produktionssætning af modeller. Dit område omfatter ML engineers, der tager modeller fra data scientists, pakker dem, deployer dem i produktion og driver og monitorerer dem. Det omfatter CI/CD-pipelines, serving, monitorering (herunder model drift) og på sigt gentræning, afhængigt af use casen. Platform-governance og håndhævelse af guardrails. Du følger op på compliant …

items.title: AI Gateway Engineer, Data Mesh and AI Platforms team
items.card: You will help engineer the gateway capabilities, infrastructure automation, and reusable patterns that allow teams to consume AI services securely and consistently in a regulated banking environment. The team works closely with architects, cybersecurity, data governance, risk and compliance, cloud platform teams, and consuming engineering teams to ensure our solutions are pragmatic, compliant, and production-ready.
items.desc: Job ID: 6280 Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and leading Nordea's transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and Business Strategy. As part of Nordea's 2030 strategic direction, we are modernizing our technology and data estate while accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled capabilities across the bank. We are looking for an engineer to help design, build, and operate our enterprise AI Gateway. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on extending our API platforms to support LLM, MCP, and A2A patterns, with the automation needed to make these capabilities reliable, reusable, and production-ready. About Our Team The Data Mesh and AI Platforms team is part of the Integration and AI unit. We provide the integration platforms that connect Nordea, including Kong and Kafka, and we are now extending that same platform approach to an AI Gateway covering LLMs, MCP, and A2A. You will help engineer the gateway capabilities, infrastructure automation, and reusable patterns that allow teams to consume AI services securely and consistently in a regulated banking environment. The team works closely with architects, cybersecurity, data governance, risk and compliance, cloud platform teams, and consuming engineering teams to ensure our solutions are pragmatic, compliant, and production-ready. You will be expected to bring strong hands-on engineering experience with API platforms and gateways, combined with solid knowledge of Terraform, CI/CD, OpenAPI specifications, source control practices, IdP integration, observability, monitoring, and FinOps. This is a full-time permanent position with a hybrid working arrangement—up to 40% remote work is possible, but full remote work is not allowed. We expect to hire in one of these cities: Gdańsk or Gdynia, Poland; or Helsinki, Finland. Your main responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: Design, build and operate AI Gateway capabilities based on strong API platform and gateway engineering practices. Implement secure and reusable gateway patterns for LLM access, MCP servers, and A2A agent-to-agent integrations. Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and support automated provisioning of gateway components. Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, and release practices for gateway configuration and platform changes. Set up and automate gateway policies to expose AI capabilities in a consistent, governed, and developer-friendly way. Create and extend Kong plugins using languages such as Lua and Python to support custom gateway capabilities and integrations. Integrate the AI Gateway with enterprise identity providers and support authentication, authorization, and access control patterns. Set up logging, monitoring and alerting for gateway services, including observability dashboards & operational insights using tools such as Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana. Establish FinOps capabilities for AI Gateway usage, including cost visibility, consumption tracking, and support for cost control mechanisms. Support onboarding of new use cases onto the AI Gateway and contribute to platform documentation, reusable templates, and engineering standards. Who You Are This is the right role for you if you: Are a strong platform engineer: You have hands-on experience designing, configuring, and operating API platforms and gateways in enterprise environments. Are comfortable with modern engineering and operational practices: You have solid knowledge of Terraform, CI/CD, source control, IdP integration, monitoring, alerting, and automated deployment patterns. Understand AI integration patterns: You have, or are motivated to build, knowledge of LLM access patterns, MCP, A2A, and how these can be secured and governed through gateway capabilities across cloud-native AI stacks. What w're looking for: Education and Experience: A BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Professional experience as a Platform Engineer, API Gateway Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Platform Architect, or similar hands-on engineering role. Required qualifications: Strong hands-on experience with API platforms and gateway technologies in enterprise environments. Experience with gateway platforms such as Kong, IBM API Connect/DataPower, cloud-native gateways, or similar API management technologies. Solid knowledge of Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices. Experience with Kubernetes and Helm charts for deploying and managing platform or gateway components. Solid knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, and automated release practices. Solid knowledge of Python and Lua for creating, extending, and maintaining Kong plugins. Solid knowledge of IdP integration, authentication, authorization, and access control patterns …

items.desc: Job ID: 6282 Welcome to Group Technology, where we engineer solutions that support Nordea's transformation and enable the Customer Vision and Business Strategy. As part of Nordea's 2030 strategic direction, we are modernizing our technology and data estate while accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled capabilities across the bank. We are building the next generation of cloud-native data and AI platform capabilities for Nordea, with a strong focus on secure infrastructure, automated provisioning, identity integration, reusable engineering patterns, and strong operational controls. You will work closely with product owners, engineers, architects, cybersecurity, data governance, and cloud platform teams. The role requires strong practical engineering skills, a delivery mindset, and the ability to turn platform architecture and agreed standards into high-quality, reusable implementation. This is a full-time permanent position with a hybrid working arrangement—up to 40% remote work is possible, but full remote work is not allowed. We expect to hire in one of these cities: Gdańsk or Gdynia, Poland; or Helsinki, Finland. items.desc: Stillingsbeskrivelse Som vores AI arkitekt hjælper du kunder med at sætte en AI understøttet udviklingskæde op. Fra krav til drift - så AI kan bære en reel del af arbejdet, sikkert, sporbart og med en gevinst, der kan måles. Du arbejder hands-on med det, der skal til, for at forandringen kan leveres - tæt koblet til de beslutninger, ledelsen skal træffe. AI har gjort det billigt at skrive kode. Det svære er nu at definere hvornår koden er rigtig (test oracle) og tilpasse arbejdsprocesser og snitflader efter AI potentialet. Det er dit fagområde: Du afgør, hvad "korrekt" betyder i praksis og hvad det betyder for leverancemodellen, og du bygger den ramme, som både mennesker og AI arbejder inden for. Arbejdsopgaver Rådgivning og vurdering: Give kunden overblik over kodebase, arkitektur og udviklingsmetoder samt vurdere, hvor AI skaber værdi nu, hvor der skal ryddes op, og hvor det ikke giver mening. Arkitektur og fundament: Fastlægge den arkitektur, som nye løsninger bygges ind i, så sikkerhed, ydeevne og drift er tænkt ind fra start. Kvalitetssikring: Sørge for, at kunden kan se, om arbejdet er rigtigt, uden at et menneske skal læse hver linje, med tests og klare acceptkriterier, også når gamle systemer skal flyttes. Legacy-systemer: Rådgive om, hvordan ældre systemer gøres klar til AI: hvad der skal ryddes op i, hvad der skal med, og hvad der kan udfases, når systemer flyttes eller lægges sammen. AI-governance: Fastlægge sammen med kunden, hvad AI-agenter må og ikke må, og sikrer, at det bliver overholdt i praksis, også hos leverandøren. Leverandørstyring: Rådgive kunden om at stille de rigtige krav, når en leverandør bruger AI, og om at kontrollere det, der bliver leveret. Gevinstrealisering: Måle sammen med kunden, om gevinsten er reel: om opgave nr. 2 faktisk bliver billigere end nr. 1, og om koden stadig er til at vedligeholde et år senere. Metodeudvikling: Udvikler vores metoder og omsætter det, du ser hos kunderne, til nye tilbud. Problemerne med AI viser sig forskellige steder hos forskellige kunder: i kontrakten, i kodebasen, i testgrundlaget, i driften, i leverancemodellen eller i styregruppen. Du sætter dig ind i det lag, problemet ligger i, også når det ikke er dit fagområde. Vi forventer Du har sandsynligvis 8+ års erfaring som software- eller løsningsarkitekt, lead developer eller i en lignende rolle, og du har selv været med til at udvikle og drive skræddersyede systemer. har brugt AI-kodeværktøjer og agenter i rigtige leverancer - og ved, hvor de fejler. har praktisk erfaring med testautomatisering, CI/CD, statisk analyse og arkitekturtests og kan sætte målbare kvalitetskrav til ny kode. har erfaring med modernisering eller migrering af ældre systemer. kan arbejde med problemer, der endnu ikke har en metode. AI skaber udfordringer, ingen endnu har løst. nøjes ikke med, at effekten ser rigtig ud - du finder ud af, hvordan den kan verificeres. kan forklare arkitektur og risiko, så både en direktør og en udvikler forstår det, og skriver præcist på dansk og engelsk. Erfaring fra offentlige kunder er en fordel. Ansøgningsprocessen Ansøg nemt ved at klikke på "Jeg er interesseret" og send os dit CV samt et par linjer om et udviklingsforløb, hvor AI ikke gav den forventede gevinst - og hvad der skulle have været på plads. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Daisy Tsvetkova, Talent Acquisition Partner (tlf.: 7175 7022). Hvorfor blive en del af vores team? Du bliver en del af et dedikeret, fagligt stærkt og uformelt team i en mindre, agil rådgivningsvirksomhed. Her er ingen skarpe siloer eller tungt bureaukrati - vi deler viden over skrivebordet, udfordrer hinanden og fejrer vores succeser sammen. Hos os får du stor frihed og rig mulighed for at sætte et direkte og mærkbart aftryk på både kunders transformation og vores egen vækstrejse. Devoteam har samlet set ca. 350 medarbejdere i Danmark fordelt på 3 forretningsenheder. Internationalt har Devoteam 11.000+ medarbejdere inden for EMEA.

items.desc: We are seeking to appoint a talented and enthusiastic Postdoctoral Research Associate (PDRA) to play a key role in delivering an exciting investment project (IrrEO) that will develop satellite-based irrigation mapping tools for governments and development actors in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). Earth Observation (EO) technologies are enabling agricultural mapping at increasingly large scales and fine resolutions. This brings exciting opportunities to understand complex farming systems, particularly in data-sparse smallholder farming regions. However, recent research has revealed the social risks of EO-based land monitoring. Examples include imperfect representations leading to poorly informed decision-making or biased investments, and marginalised people being made visible through EO in ways which may expose them to harm. There is an urgent need for improved social risk analysis and development of good practice guidance for EO-based agricultural mapping. As part of the IrrEO project, the PDRA will lead on developing guidance for the socially responsible development and use of EO-based agricultural mapping tools in small-scale farming systems in Sub-Saharan Africa. They will catalogue existing scholarship and frameworks on the ethical and equitable use of EO in agricultural mapping. They will also carry out document-based and qualitative interview research to identify potential risks of EO-based agricultural mapping in different socio-political and agricultural contexts, focusing particularly on risks to farmers and farming communities. Based on these two workstreams and consultation with the IrrEO partners, they will devise and share strategies for socially response EO-based agricultural monitoring. The PDRA will be an integral member of the IrrEO project team, working closely with Principal Investigator Prof. Tim Foster (Department of Civil Engineering and Management) and Co-Investigators Dr. Rose Pritchard (Global Development Institute). They will also work closely with a wider team of investigators and postdoctoral researchers at the University of Manchester involved in the IrrEO project and other aligned research on socially-just use of Earth Observation including the Just Earth Observation for Conservation project (JEOC – https://www.justearthobservation.org/) which is co-led by Pritchard and Foster. The role will involve close collaboration with academic and non-academic partners in the project’s case study countries (Kenya, Nigeria, and Ethiopia) and active engagement with UK and international partners including the World Bank and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. The IrrEO project is funded by a four-year (2025-2029) investment from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Due to the nature of the funding, this post is available for a fixed term of up to 24 months with an end date of 31 August 2029. We are looking for a candidate to start in early 2027, with some flexibility over the exact start date. (Grades 6-9) Our benefits include: Generous employer contribution pension 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays, along with Christmas closure Ride to work and EV car scheme available For more information, please see University of Manchester Benefits. You can also find information on our Flexible and Hybrid working here. We are an open place of enquiry and challenge. We embrace and celebrate difference, diversity and debate, and we pride ourselves on being a place of education, learning and community where we are able, within the law, to question and test received wisdom, express new ideas and explore controversial or unpopular topics and opinions. Find out more from our Freedom of Speech Policy. Enquiries About The Role, Shortlisting And Interviews Name: Prof Tim Foster, Professor of Land and Water Informatics and Director of Manchester Environmental Research Institute (MERI) Email: timothy.foster@manchester.ac.uk General enquiries and administrative support recruitmentservices.people@manchester.ac.uk Technical and job portal support https://knowledge.jobtrain.co.uk/jobseeker [knowledge.jobtrain.co.uk] Applications close at midnight on the closing date. items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Join Us as a Research Scientist– Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation Team: In-trial research team within the Patient-Centered Research group Location: North America or Europe Patient-Centered Research, In-trial qualitative research Evidera’s Patient-Centered Research (PCR) group combines a unique portfolio of scientific disciplines, including health sciences, psychometrics, epidemiology, psychology, and many other social sciences. Our PCR staff conduct a variety of studies using quantitative and qualitative approaches to develop clinical outcomes assessments, evaluate patient preferences and utilities, execute various implementation science studies, conduct Delphi panels and do secondary data analysis using advanced statistical techniques. Within the PCR group, the ITR team conduct qualitative (interviews) studies and/or surveys in the context of a clinical trial to obtain feedback from clinical trial participants (patient, caregiver, investigator or study staff) on various topics i.e., understanding patients’ experience with their condition, its impacts on their lives, exploring treatment benefit, describing trial participant experiences and identifying aspects of burden from their participation. ITR can be implemented using an embedded design (e.g., ITR is defined as clinical trial activity in the clinical trial study protocol and ICF) or associated design (ITR is covered under separate protocol, separate ICF, and IRB/EC approval, with separate site recruitment and contracting). ITR can be conducted at any trial phase and at any time in the trial (screening, mid-trial, exit). Over the past few years, there has been a growing interest in ITR studies by regulators to support relevance and interpretation of trial outcomes, meaningful change and/or meaningful treatment benefit. Du möchtest, dass biometrische Forschung nicht im Paper endet, sondern an der Grenze funktioniert – zuverlässig, überwindungssicher und wirtschaftlich erfolgreich? Dich reizt eine Führungsrolle, in der du ein Team aus hochspezialisierten Computer-Vision- und Biometrie-Expert*innen zusammenführst, ihnen den Freiraum gibst, den kreative Köpfe brauchen, und gleichzeitig dafür sorgst, dass alle in dieselbe Richtung ziehen? Dann übernimm bei uns die Leitung des Teams Biometric Algorithms. Unser Fokus liegt klar auf der Biometrie im Umfeld hoheitlicher Identitäten – von der anwendungsorientierten Forschung bis zum Einsatz in unseren Produkten. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Leitung des Teams Biometric Algorithms und entwickelst das Team gezielt weiter. Du verantwortest die fachliche Ausrichtung und Roadmap des Teams in den Themenfeldern Biometrische Identifikation und Verifikation im Grenzkontrollprozess Überwindungssicherheit (Presentation Attack Detection) Erkennung von Morphing-Angriffen auf Lichtbilder (Morphing Attack Detection) Auswahl, Anpassung und Finetuning spezialisierter Open-Source-Modelle der Computer Vision Du setzt übergreifende Prioritäten, gibst dem Team eine gemeinsame Richtung und holst die Arbeit immer wieder aus der Detailtiefe zurück auf das, was für Produkt und Kunden den Unterschied macht. Du verantwortest die gesamte Kette von der Forschung bis zur gewinnbringenden Produktisierung und sorgst dafür, dass Forschungsergebnisse den Weg in marktfähige Lösungen finden. Du führst ohne Mikromanagement: Du schaffst Freiraum für eigenständiges, kreatives Arbeiten und einen klaren Rahmen, in dem Verantwortung übernommen werden kann. Du bringst unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten zusammen und erkennst, was die Einzelnen von dir brauchen – Rückhalt und Sicherheit, fachlichen Austausch auf Augenhöhe, ein offenes Ohr oder klare, aktive Führung. Du steuerst die Personal- und Ressourcenplanung deines Teams und sorgst für eine gute Balance zwischen Forschung, Produktentwicklung und Kundenprojekten. Du arbeitest eng mit Produktmanagement, Entwicklung, Vertrieb und Business Development zusammen und übersetzt Markt- und Kundenanforderungen in eine klare Agenda für dein Team. Du repräsentierst secunet gegenüber Kunden, Behörden, Forschungspartnern und auf Fachveranstaltungen und stärkst die Sichtbarkeit unserer Biometrie-Kompetenz. Dein Profil Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, beispielsweise in Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet. Eine Promotion ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Die tiefste Fachexpertise im Raum musst du dafür nicht haben – die bringt dein Team mit. Du kennst den Weg von der anwendungsorientierten Forschung zum Produkt aus eigener Erfahrung – inklusive Produktanforderungen, Evaluierung, Business Case und Markteinführung. Du hast Erfahrung in der fachlichen und/oder disziplinarischen Führung eines Teams, idealerweise von Forschungs- oder Expert*innenteams. Dein Führungsverständnis ist geprägt von Vertrauen, Klarheit und Orientierung: Du gibst Freiraum und hältst trotzdem alle auf ein gemeinsames Ziel ausgerichtet. Du gehst konstruktiv mit unterschiedlichen Charakteren, Interessen und Konflikten um und behältst dabei gemeinsame Ziele und praktikable Lösungen im Blick. Du denkst unternehmerisch und kundenorientiert und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich und überzeugend vermitteln – auch gegenüber Entscheider*innen. items.desc: Als adviseur bij BMC - Data en Dienstverlening speel je een cruciale rol in het ontwikkelen van geavanceerde data-oplossingen en het bevorderen van het verantwoord gebruik van machine learning, data science en AI. Zowel bij interessante opdrachtgevers als domeinoverstijgend binnen BMC. Bij BMC zijn we ervan overtuigd dat expertise gestut met data leidt tot de beste inzichten en adviezen. Wij zien waar data en goede infrastructuur kan helpen processen te stroomlijnen en nieuwe inzichten te verkrijgen. Binnen de publieke sector spelen verschillende vraagstukken, zoals de energietransitie, klimaatadaptatie of de woningbouwopgave. Dit zijn vraagstukken waarin de verdeling van de ruimte een belangrijke rol speelt. GIS technologie stelt ons in staat om op een ruimtelijke en daardoor meer integrale manier de gevolgen van deze verschillende oplossingsscenario’s te overzien en afgewogen keuzes te maken. Om ons team van data adviseurs verder te versterken zijn we daarom op zoek naar een adviseur met GIS-ervaring die niet alleen technisch bekwaam is op het gebied van GIS en data science technieken, maar ook ervaring en/of affiniteit heeft met het fysiek domein. Als GIS adviseur bij BMC ben je inzetbaar op interessante opdrachten bij verschillende opdrachtgevers. Daarnaast werk je samen met het team van gedreven data adviseurs met energie aan het (door)ontwikkelen van onze GIS-oplossingen en draag je actief bij aan de bewustwording van collega’s binnen BMC rondom het inzetten van GIS. Jij bent in staat om hen te voorzien van de informatie die zij nodig hebben, om weloverwogen beslissingen te nemen over de inzet en het gebruik van data producten. Functie-eisen Je hebt een wo-opleiding in een relevante richting, zoals Geo-informatica of Data Science. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met ArcGIS (Pro, Enterprise, Online), FME (tooling, server, flow). Je beheerst programmeervaardigheden (Python of R) of bent bereid je hierin verder te ontwikkelen. Je hebt ervaring in het werken binnen een Agile/Scrum team (pre) Je hebt de afgelopen jaren gewerkt bij een gemeente, ministerie, overheidsinstelling of vergelijkbaar. (pre) Je hebt ervaring opgedaan in het fysieke domein. Bij voorkeur binnen een van de genoemde vraagstukken (energietransitie, klimaatadaptatie en/of de woningbouwopgave). Arbeidsvoorwaarden Je wordt vast aangesteld bij BMC voor 32-40 uur per week, met flexibele werktijden. We bieden: Salaris gebaseerd op jouw kennis en ervaring (€4.700,- tot €6.500,- op basis van 40 uur). Individueel Keuzebudget (Maandelijkse opbouw van 11,04% van maandsalaris, inclusief 8% vakantiegeld). 36 vakantiedagen, waarvan een deel flexibel (IKB) op basis van 40 uur. Leaseauto met laadpas of vervoersbudget. Choose-your-own-phone regeling. Laptop. Vaste onkostenvergoeding. Pensioenregeling. Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling binnen je contracturen. Samenwerking met enthousiaste collega's met diverse expertise.

items.desc: About The Role As our People Analytics & AI Optimization Expert (m/f/d), you will be the architect of our global People Analytics capability, building it from the ground up. Your mission is to transform how we use data to make workforce decisions while pioneering the use of AI and automation to create a world-class employee experience. This is a foundational role where you will set the standards for our entire organization. You will serve as the subject matter expert for our global HRIS transformation, ensuring that data and analytics are at the core of our new technology landscape. By partnering with leaders across the business, you will move our analytics beyond reporting and toward predictive insights that solve real-world challenges, directly contributing to our operational success and strategic growth. What You’ll Build Build our global People Analytics framework from the ground up, setting the standard for data, KPIs, and dashboards. Deliver actionable insights on everything from talent acquisition and retention to organizational effectiveness and workforce planning. Serve as the analytics and data expert for our global HRIS transformation, defining the requirements that will shape our future technology. Pioneer the use of AI and automation across our People function, from identifying high-value use cases to running pilots and measuring their impact. Empower our leaders and the People team with intuitive self-service analytics capabilities, reducing manual reporting. Establish clear data governance and quality standards to create a single source of truth for all People data. Redesign and optimize People processes, using technology to eliminate manual work and improve the employee and manager experience. What You Bring A strong background in People Analytics or a related data-centric field, with a proven ability to turn complex data into strategic insights. Experience establishing analytics standards, KPIs, and governance, ideally in an international or global organization. A deep understanding of HR data models and the employee lifecycle. Experience supporting a major HRIS implementation or other large-scale HR technology transformations. Hands-on expertise with modern BI and analytics tools (such as Power BI or Tableau). Experience with SQL or Python is a strong plus. A practical understanding of how AI, particularly generative AI, and automation can be applied within an HR context. The ability to translate complex analytical topics into clear, compelling recommendations for senior stakeholders. A firm grasp of data privacy principles and a commitment to the responsible use of AI with employee data. Please note: You do not need to meet every single requirement to apply. We welcome motivated candidates who are eager to grow into the role and develop their expertise further. What We Offer Join a mission-driven European defense tech company at a pivotal stage of growth, where you can help shape meaningful technology, take ownership early, and grow with the business! Competitive compensation package including a bonus opportunity 27 vacation days to start, increasing with tenure up to 30 days Employer-supported pension contribution Learning & development support and team events budget Employee discounts and flexible benefits budget via Probonio Hybrid working setup depending on role and team needs Structured salary bands, levelling framework, and bi-annual development conversations Referral bonus program, dog-friendly office, and relocation support where applicable About Us ARX is a dual-use technology company that specializes in developing autonomous unmanned systems and sensors for the European defence sector. Our dual-use unmanned ground systems and sensors assist NATO Armies and civilian first responders in tackling their most challenging problems by providing them with training and information to make better decisions and take effective actions in life-or-death situations. As our team continues to expand rapidly, we are seeking motivated candidates who are excited to work in a highly energetic, creative, and innovative team dedicated to developing autonomous systems for challenging environments. We operate in a dynamic sector where collaboration, sharing innovative ideas, and developing novel problem-solving strategies are ingrained in our work culture. If you are passionate about overcoming challenges that have a real impact on the security of our democracies, apply here to join ARX and help shape the future of dual-use technology! ARX is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. You can find ARX Robotics Applicant Privacy Policy here.

items.desc: Chez MBDA, le sens de notre mission est ce qui nous unit : contribuer à la souveraineté des nations et préserver notre sécurité et notre liberté en Europe. Pour y parvenir, la collaboration et la confiance sont essentielles. MBDA doit relever des défis uniques pour répondre aux besoins des forces armées face à de nouvelles menaces. Motivés par les challenges technologiques, nous repoussons les limites de l’innovation, de la science et de la technologie pour développer des solutions au meilleur niveau. Nous encourageons le dépassement de soi dans un environnement unique qui offre des opportunités à chacun d’entre nous. Ensemble, nous sommes fiers du rôle que nous jouons. Au sein de la direction Engineering France , vous assurez le rôle de Coordinateur industrialisation IA produit , dans le but d’accélérer et de structurer l’introduction de l’Intelligence Artificielle (IA) dans les produits et services de MBDA. Le périmètre est transversal. Vous collaborerez avec les différents secteurs de l’ingénierie en charge du développement de ces fonctions, destinées à intégrer directement nos produits, ou des services fournis à nos clients. Les Principales Missions Confiées Sont Structuration technique et industrialisation : Outillage : définir et préconiser des standards d’outillage pour le développement des fonctions d’IA, afin d’harmoniser les pratiques au sein de la direction, et de coordonner leur déploiement dans chacun des métiers. Ce point couvre les besoins logiciels et algorithmiques, ainsi que les besoins en ressources de calcul et de gestion des données. MLOps : définir et accélérer l’adoption de pipelines MLOps pour assurer le cycle de vie complet des modèles IA (collecte de données, entraînement, déploiement, monitoring et mise à jour) dans un environnement industriel sécurisé. IA de confiance : assurer une veille active sur les meilleures pratiques et les standards du secteur de la défense en matière d'IA de confiance. Vous soutiendrez les concepteurs IA pour qu’ils disposent de l'arsenal méthodologique et des outils nécessaires (outils de test de robustesse, bibliothèques d'explicabilité, frameworks de vérification, etc.) pour qu'ils puissent développer des solutions fiables et maîtrisées. Accompagnement Opérationnel Et De L’écosystème Recensement et priorisation : identifier et hiérarchiser les cas d'usage IA avec les métiers et projets/programmes en interne MBDA. Financement : rechercher et monter des dossiers de financement internes ou externes. Partenariats externes : entretenir et développer le réseau d'experts et de partenaires (Académiques, Startups, Industriels). Relations Institutionnelles : entretenir la liaison avec les acteurs étatiques (DGA, AMIAD) pour assurer l'alignement stratégique et technique. Animation De La Communauté Et Capitalisation Animation technique : fédérer et animer la communauté IA interne en organisant des forums d’échanges, des ateliers de partage de bonnes pratiques et des présentations techniques. Gestion des connaissances : mettre en place et promouvoir des outils de partage de connaissances (Wikis, espaces de partage de code, outils, méthodologies) pour accélérer la montée en compétence collective. Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur ou doctorat avec une spécialisation en Intelligence Artificielle, informatique ou mathématiques appliquées. Vous disposez d’une première expérience dans la mise en œuvre de solutions d’IA ou d’algorithmes complexes, dans un contexte industriel et de développement de produit. Vous êtes autonome, capable d’évoluer en environnement technique, tout aussi bien que dans l’organisation de l’entreprise, ou à l’extérieur, y compris en contexte international. Vous avez un bon relationnel, une bonne capacité d’écoute et savez faire preuve de pédagogie. Vous aimez développer et faire monter en compétences les personnes et les organisations. La maîtrise de l'Anglais professionnel est impérative. Notre rémunération comporte un salaire fixe et des éléments additionnels individuels (une part variable pour nos salariés cadres et une prime d’ancienneté ainsi qu’une prime annuelle pour nos salariés non-cadres) ou collectifs dépendant de la performance et des résultats de l’entreprise (participation, intéressement). De nombreux services/avantages sont également proposés : restaurant d’entreprise, épargne salariale (PEG, PERCOL), protection sociale (mutuelle et prévoyance), comité social et économique, infirmerie et service de santé au travail interne...

items.desc:
As a Data Consultant you will work with customers and partners, guiding them through planning, preparing and delivery of complex data transformation projects based on varying customer needs. You will build and maintain strong stakeholder relationship with C-level executives to shape their cloud and data transformation roadmap.
On a daily basis, you will work together with customers to assess their organizational readiness to perform the cloud adoption. You will guide them to define goals, objectives and business outcomes. Together with the stakeholders, you will create and align a cloud vision to achieve those results. You identify solutions that help a customer, partner, or an internal team overcome technical as well as organizational challenges. You will collaborate with Subject Matter Experts to support pre-sales activities.
Do you have experience delivering IT solutions in agile environment - plan, organize, and manage all phases of a project lifecycle to ensure successful delivery?
Come build the future with us. 
Key job responsibilities
Employ customer facing skills to represent AWS well within the customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel regarding trade-offs, standard methodologies, project management and risk mitigation.
*Work closely with AWS Engineering and Architecture teams to help ensure the success of project consulting engagements with customers.
*Work directly with customers’ technical resources to devise and recommend solutions based on the understood requirements.
*Think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges in an enterprise environment. 
*Analyse on-premises database environments such as Oracle, SQL Server, or other Commercial DB Engines to Open Source Engines like Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or RedShift, DynamoDB.
*Consult for optimal design of environments, analysing complex distributed production deployments, and making recommendations to optimize performance.
*Develop innovative solutions to complex business and technology problems
Be able to obtain and maintain a UK Government Security Clearance. Further details found here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels
- Experience and technical expertise (design and implementation) in cloud computing technologies
- Experience in IT implementation
- Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
- Experience translating technical aspects of analysis and metrics into actionable insights for the advertiser and both technical and non-technical stakeholders

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? 
 Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être le stage qu’il vous faut ! 
 Vous êtes étudiant(e) et à la recherche d'un stage ou d'une année de césure vous permettant de valider votre diplôme et qui fera décoller votre carrière ? Imaginez-vous au cœur d’une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture . 
 Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante. 
 Votre mission, si vous l'acceptez : 
 Une offre de stage intitulée « Stage en Conception de Conversations et Gestion des Connaissances IA (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein de Airbus Helicopters sur son site de Marignane .
 Vous rejoindrez le département en charge du support IT pour tous nos utilisateurs.
 Ce stage, d'une durée de 6 mois , débutera idéalement en Janvier 2027 (cette période est indicative et pourra être ajustée). 
 Ce stage nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Vos principales missions consisteront à : 
 ● Transformer la documentation technique brute en contenus structurés et exploitables par les moteurs d'intelligence artificielle .
 ● Collaborer avec les référents applicatifs et équipes techniques pour modéliser des parcours conversationnels clairs, fluides et centrés sur les besoins des utilisateurs (UX Writing).
 ● Analyser les indicateurs de performance de l'assistant virtuel afin d' identifier les lacunes de réponse et enrichir continuellement la base de connaissances .
 ● Participer à la création de modèles et à l' optimisation des flux de publication pour accompagner le déploiement de nouveaux services IT . 
 Votre tuteur ou tutrice vous accompagnera tout au long de votre stage, vous aidant à développer vos compétences et à atteindre vos objectifs professionnels. 
 Ce stage vous permettra notamment de développer les compétences suivantes : 
 ● Conception conversationnelle et déploiement de modèles de traitement du langage naturel (NLU) et d'IA générative en environnement d'entreprise.
 ● Maîtrise de la plateforme ServiceNow (notamment les modules Virtual Agent Designer et Now Assist).
 ● Structuration de données et rédaction UX adaptée aux interactions homme-machine.
 Votre carte d’embarquement pour cette aventure : 
 Vous êtes actuellement en BAC+5 en Informatique, Data/IA, Sciences Cognitives, UX Design, Linguistique Computationnelle ou un domaine équivalent. 
 Vous possédez idéalement les compétences suivantes : 
 ● Compétences techniques : 
 ○ Intérêt marqué pour les modèles de langage ( LLM ) et la structuration logique de données 
 ○ Notions de rédaction technique , de design conversationnel ou d' outils de ticketing/chatbot (la connaissance de ServiceNow est un atout, mais non obligatoire).
 ● Soft Skills : 
 ○ Le traducteur : Vous savez traduire le « jargon technique » en un langage accessible aux utilisateurs finaux. 
 ○ L’enquêteur : Vous aimez analyser les données pour comprendre pourquoi un utilisateur n’a pas trouvé ce qu’il cherchait.
 ○ Le passionné de technologie : Vous vous intéressez à l’IA générative, aux grands modèles de langage (LLM) et à la manière dont les assistants numériques transforment l’environnement de travail. 
 ○ Le diplomate : Vous êtes aussi à l’aise pour échanger avec des développeurs chevronnés qu’avec des utilisateurs frustrés.
 ● Langues : 
 ○ Anglais : Courant 
 ○ Français : Courant
 Notre processus de recrutement : 
 Votre candidature sera analysée attentivement par notre équipe de recrutement. Si votre profil correspond à nos attentes, vous serez invité(e) à réaliser un entretien vidéo. Suite à cette étape, si votre candidature est retenue, elle sera alors proposée au manager pour un entretien.

 Votre quotidien 
Situé à 20mn du Pôle technologique de Paris-Saclay, le site est l’un des plus grands centres d’excellence radars de surface. Nous contribuons à développer, concevoir, intégrer et tester des radars de surveillance aériennes dédiés à la détection et l’identification de cibles. 
 Au sein de Thales Land & Air Systems France, la Business Unit Ground Master Radars (GMR) conçoit des radars de surveillance aérienne à moyenne et longue portée. Notre équipe d'IA embarquée, spécialisée dans les applications radar, exploite des volumes croissants de données et souhaite renforcer l'infrastructure qui permet de les traiter. Vous enrichirez la structure de la base de données existante et améliorerez les flux de données annexes qui permettent d'extraire, de transformer puis de charger les données en base (ETL), afin de les rendre plus facilement exploitables par l'équipe.
 Vos missions 
 Passer en revue l'infrastructure existante (base de données, ETL), recueillir les besoins de l'équipe et monter en compétences sur l'environnement de travail.
 Réaliser un état de l'art des pratiques, critères et outils qui renforcent la confiance dans les données utilisées pour l'IA : validation, cohérence, intégrité, représentativité, traçabilité des transformations et gestion des métadonnées.
 Proposer une stratégie d'évolution de l'infrastructure existante.
 Poursuivre l'amélioration de la base de données et de la chaîne ETL, et documenter les développements réalisés.
 Selon l'avancement, mettre en place des outils de validation, de suivi et de monitoring de la donnée pour fiabiliser son exploitation par l'IA.
 Construire tout au long du stage une présentation destinée au département d'ingénierie pour valoriser le travail effectué.
 Votre profil 
 Vous êtes en école d'ingénieur, avec une spécialisation en data engineering, IA/machine learning ou mathématiques appliquées, et recherchez un stage de césure (Bac+4) ou de fin d'études (Bac+5) de 6 mois. Vous avez une première expérience en ingénierie des données (stage ou projet avancé).
 Vous maîtrisez Python (niveau avancé) et ses librairies de manipulation de données (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib/Seaborn) ; des connaissances en PyTorch seraient un plus.
 Vous maîtrisez le langage SQL et les systèmes de gestion de bases de données structurées (MySQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL).
 Vous appliquez les bonnes pratiques de développement (Git, GitLab) et êtes à l'aise avec les systèmes Linux et l'interaction avec des serveurs.
 Vous êtes à l'aise en anglais, et faites preuve d'organisation, de rigueur et de motivation, avec le goût du travail en équipe.
 Le mot de l'équipe 
 Vous rejoindrez une équipe spécialisée dans la conception d'algorithmes de traitement radar, en particulier à l'aide de l'intelligence artificielle embarquée.

Operate and improve JFrog Artifactory, including repository configuration, cleanup, permissions and support for our hybrid cloud setup. Replace repetitive admin work with scripts and automation using Python, Bash and REST APIs. Build and maintain GitHub Actions workflows
items.desc:
The Developer Enablement & Security (DE&S) team within Platform Engineering owns the tooling that TomTom engineers use to write, build, store and secure code. This covers GitHub platform management, artifact management with JFrog Artifactory, security scanning, developer tooling and AI governance platforms. We treat internal developers as our customers and aim to make the secure path the easy path.

What you will do:
Administer and automate GitHub Enterprise: repository settings, rulesets, access and governance across a large repository estate.
 Operate and improve JFrog Artifactory, including repository configuration, cleanup, permissions and support for our hybrid cloud setup.
 Replace repetitive admin work with scripts and automation using Python, Bash and REST APIs.
 Build and maintain GitHub Actions workflows and support teams whose pipelines pull and publish packages.
 Manage platform configuration as code with Terraform or similar tools.
 Use AI tools to speed up automation and support work, and help developers adopt them safely in line with our AI governance approach.
 Take ownership of well-defined platform tasks from start to finish, asking for guidance when needed.
 Troubleshoot developer issues across DNS, TLS, proxies and authentication.
 Write and maintain documentation and runbooks that let developers help themselves.
 Explain platform policies clearly and work with developers to adopt them.
What you need:
2 to 5 years of experience in DevOps, platform, build or infrastructure engineering.
 Git and GitHub: comfortable with branching, pull requests, reviews and repository settings; hands-on experience with GitHub Actions.
 Scripting and automation: Python or Bash, with experience calling REST APIs.
 CI/CD basics: you have built or maintained pipelines and understand how builds pull and publish packages.
 Package ecosystems: working knowledge of at least two of Maven/Gradle, npm, PyPI, Docker and NuGet.
 Linux and networking: you can find your way around a server and troubleshoot DNS, TLS, proxy and authentication problems.
 Infrastructure as Code: some experience with Terraform or a similar tool, ideally for managing platform configuration.
 AI in day-to-day work: good understanding of AI coding assistants and agents such as GitHub Copilot or Claude, and hands-on experience using them to write scripts, automate tasks, troubleshoot and document your work.
Nice to have:
Cloud basics in Azure or AWS.
 Identity basics: exposure to SSO, SAML/OIDC or SCIM.
 Security awareness: secrets management, least privilege and dependency scanning; exposure to Black Duck, Coverity or Veracode is a plus.
 Admin experience on a developer platform such as GitHub, GitLab, Artifactory, Nexus or Jenkins.
How you work:
You write clear docs and runbooks, because platform teams depend on them.
 You treat internal developers as customers and can explain a policy without creating friction.
 You keep learning; you pick up new tools quickly rather than relying on knowing one specific product.

items.desc:
Mission 
 Understanding how urban sustainability transitions interact: How do transformations in different urban sectors—such as energy and food—interact? Under what conditions do they reinforce one another or create trade-offs, and when do they trigger tipping dynamics?
 The Laboratory for Human-Environment Relations in Urban Systems (HERUS) at the School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering (ENAC), EPFL, investigates how urban systems transform towards sustainability. We are looking for a PhD candidate to investigate coupled sustainability transitions, with an initial focus on the interactions between energy and food systems. 
 The PhD project is embedded within the ongoing research project “Tipping Transition”, which investigates the drivers and dynamics of renewable energy technology adoption in housing in Lausanne. An interdisciplinary agent-based model (ABM) has been developed to represent the energy transition at the level of Lausanne, integrating not only economic factors but also social and behavioural dimensions, such as attitudes, social norm, and their evolution over time. 
 The PhD project “Trade-off and tipping dynamics in urban transitions “ will extend this modelling framework to investigate interactions between different urban sectors, initially focusing on energy and food. A particular focus will be placed on the role of provisioning systems—the infrastructures, technologies, institutions, markets, and practices through which goods and services are provided—in enabling or constraining sustainability transitions. 
 The successful candidate will work in collaboration with a current PhD researcher developing the energy transition model. This provides an opportunity to build on an established modelling framework, contribute to its further development, and benefit from expertise and ongoing research. 
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 Develop a framework for analyzing coupled sustainability transitions in urban systems. 
 Extend and further develop an interdisciplinary agent-based model of urban transitions in Lausanne. 
 Investigate synergies, trade-offs, and tipping dynamics between sectors such as energy and food. 
 Analyse how changes in provisioning systems influence sustainability transitions 
 Develop and conduct your own research under the guidance of Prof. Claudia R. Binder. 
 Collaborate closely with the HERUS research team and the existing PhD project. 
 Publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals and present them at scientific conferences. 
 Contribute to teaching and student supervision at EPFL (20%). 
 Profile 
 An excellent MSc degree in Computer Science, Energy Science, Social Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Sustainability Science, Geography, or a closely related interdiscipline.
 A strong interest in sustainability transitions and/or urban systems tipping dynamics.
 Good knowledge of computational modelling and programming. Experience with Python and agent-based modelling is particularly valuable. Knowledge of Scala or Julia is an asset. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research. 
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, the ability to work independently, and a high level of motivation for academic research.
 Excellent written and spoken English. Knowledge of French and/or German is an asset. 
 Previous experience with agent-based modelling or sustainability transitions is welcome, but candidates with a strong quantitative or computational background and an interest in developing interdisciplinary expertise are also encouraged to apply. 
 We offer 
 A PhD position for up to four years within an interdisciplinary and international research environment at EPFL. 
 The opportunity to develop an independent research profile at the intersection of computational modelling, sustainability science, and urban studies. 
 Close collaboration with the HERUS research team.
 The opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative approaches for understanding interconnected urban sustainability transitions.
 Structured doctoral training through EPFL doctoral programs and close research mentorship. 
 Informations 
 The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. EDCE.
Please check this page for additional information on admission.
 Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL. 
 Your application should contain:
 Motivation letter: A statement (max. one page), where you outline why you want to join this group, what your specific interests are, how your skills can contribute to the mission of the HERUS laboratory and how you think you can advance in your own academic/scholarly pursuit while being a part of the team.
