 Die Digitalisierung der Hochschullehre steht vor einem tiefgreifenden Wandel. Für ein strategisches Schlüsselprojekt im Bereich digitaler Prüfungen suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Technologien, Menschen und Prozesse zusammenbringt und den Einsatz von AI Agents aktiv vorantreibt.
 Verstärken Sie als Educational IT Systemspezialist:in und (Co-)Projektleiter:in AI Agents und Automation des Service digitale Prüfungen befristet für 1 Jahr, verlängerbar auf 3 Jahre, die Gruppe Digital Education Services in der Sektion EduIT .
 Projekthintergrund
 Die Sektion Educational IT Services (EduIT) der ETH-Informatikdienste unterstützt die zeitgemässe, lernwirksame und innovative Lehre an der ETH Zürich mit einem abgestimmten Portfolio an Werkzeugen, Services und Support. Das Portfolio unterstützt Dozierende und Studierende entlang der gesamten hochschuldidaktischen Praxis, ausgehend von den Lernzielen über die Gestaltung von Lernaktivitäten, Unterricht, Prüfungen bis hin zur Evaluation. EduIT arbeitet dabei eng mit den anderen Sektionen der ETH-Informatikdienste zusammen sowie innerhalb des ETH-Rektorats mit der Abteilung für Lehre und Lernen (Unit for Teaching and Learning, UTL) und den Akademischen Diensten (AkD).
 EduIT verantwortet den Service digitale Prüfungen. Mit flexibel anpassbaren digitalen Prüfungsumgebungen für authentische, ressourcenreiche und fachnahe Prüfungen sowie einer Skalierung auf derzeit über 500 Prüfungen pro Jahr ist EduIT in diesem Bereich international führend. EduIT entwickelt Open Source Lerntechnologien wie den Safe Exam Browser (SEB) und Moodle-Plugins oder die ETH EduApp. Zudem ist die EduIT am Aufbau der ETH AI Plattform beteiligt. Viele der in EduIT entwickelten Technologien werden an Hochschulen weltweit eingesetzt.
 Stellenbeschreibung
 In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie an einem Projekt mit grosser Strahlkraft für die gesamte Organisation: Im Rahmen des Projekts AI Agents und Automation des Service digitale Prüfungen soll der Service digitale Prüfungen umfassend automatisiert werden. Sie entwickeln und realisieren moderne Automationslösungen sowie AI-Agentensysteme für den Service digitale Prüfungen. Dabei konzipieren und implementieren Sie Schnittstellen, Integrationen und APIs zwischen einer Vielzahl von Plattformen und Services und schaffen die Grundlage für nutzerfreundliche, leistungsfähige und somit skalierbare Lösungen. Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen analysieren Sie bestehende Prozesse, definieren Automations-Workflows und gestalten deren Umsetzung entlang komplexer technischer, fachlicher und organisatorischer Anforderungen.
 Von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis hin zur Pilotierung und erfolgreichen Service-Transition begleiten Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Lösungen. Sie entwickeln die Automationen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern kontinuierlich weiter und stellen deren nachhaltigen Betrieb sicher. Darüber hinaus übernehmen Sie Verantwortung in der (Co-)Projektleitung, koordinieren unterschiedliche Anspruchsgruppen und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung eines strategisch bedeutenden Vorhabens.
 Zudem bringen Sie Ihre Erfahrungen in die Weiterentwicklung der im Aufbau befindlichen hochschulweiten AI-Plattform ein. Hier arbeiten Sie eng mit einer zweiten für dieses Projekt angestellten Person zusammen, formulieren Anforderungen aus Praxis und Betrieb und wirken an der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Lösungen mit. Durch die aktive Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Services tragen Sie dazu bei, das Potenzial von AI und Automation im Hochschulumfeld nachhaltig nutzbar zu machen.

 Fachliche Anforderungen
 Hochschulabschluss in Informatik, AI, Data Science, Computerlinguistik, Human Computer Interaction, Digital Humanities oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.
 Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, beispielsweise mit Python, C# oder PHP.
 Know-how im Bereich APIs, Systemintegrationen, LLMs, AI Agents und modernen Plattformarchitekturen.
 Erfahrung im Hochschulumfeld oder Kenntnisse von Lehr- und Lerntechnologien sind willkommen

 Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von Moodle, Safe Exam Browser oder vergleichbaren digitalen Lern- und Prüfungsplattformen

Je bouwt AI-functionaliteit in applicaties, ontwikkelt API’s en backendservices en integreert modellen met bestaande systemen en cloudomgevingen. Je werkt samen met andere engineers en technische stakeholders en kunt jouw technische keuzes helder onderbouwen. Je aardt snel in wisselende projecten en weet je gemakkelijk aan te passen aan verschillende organisaties, culturen en werkwijzen. items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 03, 2026, 2:09PM Durée du contrat : 6 mois Dans un contexte d'évolutions rapides des usages et des attentes de nos clients, de ruptures technologiques, l’avènement de nouveaux acteurs et de nouveaux modèles économiques, la mission de la division Orange Innovation (INNOV) est de préparer le futur d'Orange, en construisant des atouts compétitifs différentiant. Les femmes et les hommes de la division INNOV sont chercheurs, ingénieurs, designers, développeurs, data scientists, sociologues, psychologues, ergonomes, graphistes, marketeurs, experts en cybersécurité (…) et sont porteurs d'une vision globale, réunissant la Recherche et l'Innovation du Groupe. Dans le cadre d’une thèse en Linguistique et Traitement Automatique du Langage, au sein du programme de recherche EECORE (projet INDICE), une expérimentation a été menée sur l'annotation non-directive de messages écrits de salariés, pour en dégager des éléments relevant de la charge mentale de travail. Dans un premier temps, les participants (managers, responsables RH et experts en Psychologie) ont donné leur propre définition de ce qu’est la Charge Mentale au travail. Dans un second temps, ces participants ont réalisé des annotations de messages écrits de salariés, extraits de différentes campagnes de recueil (Arsenteva, Dubois, Le Goff, Plantin & Tanguy, 2025). La thèse a mis en évidence une représentation partagée de la charge mentale telle qu'elle transparaît dans les définitions, mais cette représentation est nuancée selon les profils des annotateurs. Des différences notables entre experts et non-experts dans la manière de catégoriser et de segmenter ces écrits ont également été mises en évidence. Le stage vise à prolonger et opérationnaliser ce travail. La recherche proposée cible la question suivante: La représentation interne que ces participants ont construit de la charge mentale d’autrui permet-elle de prédire la façon dont les messages sont annotés? Comment modéliser les stratégies d’annotation si elles correspondent bien à une projection de la représentation de la charge mentale des participants sur les auteurs des messages écrits (salariés)? Il s’agira de construire une modélisation incluant, si nécessaire plusieurs profils. Un modèle des stratégies étudiées sera fourni. Une représentation en graphe sera envisagée, afin de faciliter par la suite une modélisation computationnelle simple des représentations des RH et managers et de leur interprétation individuelle. Cette modélisation future permettra, in fine, d’explorer sur ce modèle les liens (causalité/temporalité/sujets-objets...) entre les notions observées. VOTRE ROLE Intégré à une équipe de recherche pluridisciplinaire, vous serez chargé-e d’étudier des définitions individuelles de la charge mentale de travail, recueillies auprès de managers et RH. Puis, à partir des messages de salariés annotés par les participants (managers, responsables RH et experts en Psychologie), il s’agira d’analyser comment ces acteurs introspectent la notion de charge mentale, et si leur stratégie est bien orientée par leur propre définition ou (et) par d’autres paramètres. La modélisation obtenue sera comparée avec le modèle de la charge mentale en psychologie cognitive de Galy et Le Gonidec. Ces résultats seront aussi mis en regard avec des modélisations obtenues via des modèles d’IA. Enfin, si c’est possible, vous serez chargé de développer une modélisation de ces comportements humains (modèle des stratégies adoptées). Vous bénéficierez du soutien d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'Orange Research (ingénierie numérique, psychologie cognitive, linguistique, data-analyse, UX) tout au long de votre stage, en continuité directe avec les travaux de thèse d'Iuliia Arsenteva (Université de Toulouse) et un dispositif innovant de recueil de la « voix » de différents publics (salariés, citoyens…). PROFIL RECHERCHE Vous êtes en formation de Psychologie Cognitive ou d'ingénieur ou de Master en Sciences Cognitives, ou Cognitique avec des connaissances solides en Psychologie Cognitive. Une appétence pour l'analyse de corpus textuels (annotation, statistiques descriptives, manipulation de données) est souhaitée. Une capacité de travail en équipe, autonomie. Compétences rédactionnelles, curiosité, bonne maitrise de la démarche scientifique. Capacité à présenter, comprendre un document et rédiger en anglais. Aucune expertise avancée en développement n'est requise ; une aisance avec les outils de traitement de données (Python, R ou équivalent) sera en revanche appréciée. L'indemnité mensuelle brute de stage proposée est comprise entre 1 261,26 et 1 621,62 euros selon votre niveau d'études en cours. À cela s’ajoutent l’accès aux activités sociales et culturelles proposées par votre comité social et économique , l’accès au restaurant d’entreprise ou aux titres-restaurant, ainsi que la prise en charge à hauteur de 50 % de votre abonnement au transport en commun. Afin de pouvoir étudier votre candidature, nous …

items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 03, 2026, 10:48AM Durée du contrat : 6 mois L’objectif de ce stage est de concevoir et de développer un modèle à base d’IA pour la détection préventive de pannes sur les réseaux optiques. Le stage débutera par la mise en place d’un banc d’essai (test-bed) pour émuler des défaillances courantes et générer des données représentatives de chaque type de défaillance, telles que les problèmes de connecteurs ou de drift des lasers. Un système de télémétrie en streaming automatisé, basé sur les protocoles gRPC et gNMI, sera déployé pour collecter en temps réel ces données. A partir de ces flux de données, le stagiaire développera un modèle de machine learning structuré en plusieurs étapes : d'abord l'analyse des empreintes optiques pour détecter les anomalies, puis l'identification, la localisation précise et l'évaluation de la sévérité des pannes. La solution peut être intégrée dans un système multi-agents pour le diagnostic des réseaux optiques. Ce stage offre une opportunité unique d’appliquer l’intelligence artificielle aux réseaux optiques, tout en permettant de travailler avec des technologies avancées de collecte de données et de contribuer à la fiabilisation des infrastructures optiques. Une publication scientifique pourra également être envisagée à l'issue de ces travaux. Enfin, le projet auquel vous collaborerez est destiné à répondre à un besoin opérationnel, ce qui permettra de valoriser concrètement vos résultats auprès des équipes terrain. Vous intégrerez une équipe projet agile (méthode SCRUM) composée de profils variés : 1 chef de projet, 1 expert senior en systèmes optiques, 1 data scientist, 2 développeurs seniors, 1 doctorant en 3e année de thèse et 1 apprenti. We’re building the context layer for AI coding agents and a platform for AI-native software development. Overview of role Join our engineering team to build real-time AI Native workflows, tooling, and interfaces that will reshape how developers create and maintain software. items.desc: What we're building Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future. Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright. This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute. The role You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes: Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers. Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it. Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials… Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem. Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness. Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals. The problems waiting for you Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff. Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not. Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries. Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy. Couple everything, exactly. Efficient and accurate two-way constraint-based coupling between heterogeneous grey-box solvers, using state-of-the-art methods like ADMM. Owning every solver in the stack is what makes it possible. More scalable constraint solvers. Push rigid constraint solving beyond its current scalability ceiling (reference). Unify contact resolution. Hydro-elastic compliance, unilateral constraints, and sequential impulses in the same framework, ideally under one generic formulation. Closed kinematic loops without constraints. Handle loops intrinsically for numerical stability and speed, in the spirit of Kamino. Day to day: you write your physics in plain Python and Quadrants makes it fast on every backend. And you validate it the hard way: analytical closed forms, other engines, …

items.desc: A call is open for the award of one (1) Research Fellowship (“Bolsa de Investigação para Mestre”) at Instituto de Telecomunicações for MSc graduates at Instituto de Telecomunicações, within the scope of the NOS-WiSESNSE project. The main objective of the project is to develop and experimentally validate advanced passive Wi-Fi sensing solutions based on the analysis of Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI), targeting applications for human presence detection and indoor localization. Within the scope of this fellowship, the research activities will focus on the development of a low-cost platform based on Internet of Things (IoT) devices for Wi-Fi CSI acquisition and processing, as well as the investigation and implementation of signal processing algorithms and Machine Learning models for passive human presence detection and coarse-grained spatial localization in multi-room indoor environments. The work will also include the experimental validation of the developed solutions in the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi bands, the organization and documentation of experimental datasets, and the performance evaluation of the proposed methods. Scientific Area: Information and Data Sciences Group: Multimedia Signal Processing – Co Admission Requirements: Candidates for this Scholarship must: 1. Hold a Master's degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering or related fields. 2. Be enrolled in a doctoral program or in in non-degree courses that are part of the educational programme of a higher education institution, developed in association or cooperation with one or more R&D units. 3. Demonstrated knowledge and previous experience in Joint Communications and Sensing, particularly in Wi-Fi Sensing techniques, preferably based on Channel State Information (CSI). 4. Demonstrated knowledge and interest in the development of signal processing algorithms and Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques. 5. Proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Work Objectives: O principal objetivo do trabalho consiste no desenvolvimento e validação de uma plataforma experimental de passive Wi-Fi sensing, utilizando dispositivos IoT de baixo custo e técnicas de aprendizagem automática para deteção de presença e localização espacial de indivíduos em ambientes interiores, através da análise de dados Wi-Fi CSI. O/A candidato(a) selecionado(a) desenvolverá as seguintes atividades: 1. Desenvolvimento de uma plataforma experimental de aquisição de dados Wi-Fi CSI, baseada em dispositivos IoT de baixo custo, incluindo a implementação de procedimentos de aquisição, processamento e armazenamento dos dados. 2. Desenvolvimento de metodologias de processamento de sinais e modelos de aprendizagem automática, destinados à deteção passiva da presença de indivíduos e à estimativa da sua localização espacial a nível macro, em cenários interiores com múltiplas divisões. 3. Implementação e realização de campanhas de validação experimental, utilizando sinais Wi-Fi nas bandas de 2,4 GHz e 5 GHz, para caracterizar e avaliar o desempenho da plataforma e dos algoritmos desenvolvidos. 4. Organização, processamento e documentação dos dados experimentais, incluindo a criação de um conjunto de dados estruturado (dataset) para suporte ao desenvolvimento, treino e avaliação dos modelos propostos. 5. Análise e avaliação dos resultados experimentais, através da definição e aplicação de métricas de desempenho adequadas às tarefas de deteção de presença e localização interior. 6. Documentação das metodologias e dos resultados obtidos, incluindo a preparação de relatórios técnicos e a consolidação dos resultados finais do projeto Applicable legislation: A fellowship will be celebrated according to “Estatuto do Bolseiro de Investigação”, Law no. 40/2004, dated on 18th of August (Status of Scientific Research Fellow - https://dre.pt/dre/legislacao-consolidada/lei/2004-58216179), in its actual redaction, by Fellowship Regulation of Fundação para Ciência e Tecnologia (https://fiIes.dre.pt/2s/2019/12/241000000/0009100105.pdf), according to Reg. 950/2019, dated on 16th of December, and also by “Regulation of Instituto de Telecomunicações’ fellowships”. Place of work: The work will be carried out at the premises of the Instituto de Telecomunicações – Coimbra, under the scientific supervision of Professor Marco Gomes Duration: 6 months, renewable subject to satisfactory performance of the fellow, and project continuity. The maximum duration of this type of scholarship is 2 years. Start date: November 2026 or soon thereafter. Monthly salary: The scholarship amount corresponds to €1.359,64 according to the table of monthly maintenance grant values (https://www.fct.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Tabela-de-Valores-SMM-2026.pdf), plus social security contributions. Payment will be made via bank transfer. items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION The Heart Failure and Cardiac Regeneration Research Group (ICREC) is offering a 3-year predoctoral position associated with the research project SCPP2500C012173XV0 , entitled “Next-generation decellularized and re-endothelialized human vascular grafts for arterial bypass (VasCraft 2.0 Project)” . The project focuses on the development of small-calibre human vascular grafts using tissue engineering strategies , with the aim of advancing their application in coronary and peripheral arterial revascularization. The project is coordinated by the ICREC Research Group at the Germans Trias i Pujol Research Institute (IGTP), in collaboration with the Banc de Sang i Teixits (BST) and the Cardiology and Cardiac Surgery Departments of the Germans Trias i Pujol University Hospital . The successful candidate will develop a PhD thesis under the supervision of Dr Carolina Gálvez Montón , Principal Investigator of the project, and will be integrated into the research activities and scientific environment of the ICREC Research Group. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES The main responsibilities of the successful candidate will include: Performing laboratory techniques and protocols related to cell culture, tissue engineering, decellularization and re-endothelialization, flow cytometry, histology, immunohistochemistry and molecular biology. Participating in the development and optimization of re-endothelialization protocols and vascular graft conditioning using bioreactor systems. Supporting experimental procedures in large animal models (porcine and ovine), including vascular graft implantation, angiographic/echocardiographic follow-up, and sample collection and processing. Statistical analysis, processing and interpretation of experimental data, including participation in omics data analysis. Writing and reviewing scientific manuscripts, conference communications and research projects, as well as participating in other scientific dissemination activities related to the project and the research lines of the group. Collaborating with ICREC researchers in activities required for the development of the different research lines of the group. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE a) Education University degree, preferably in Veterinary Medicine or Medicine. Degrees in Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biomedicine or other related biomedical sciences will also be considered. A Master’s degree providing access to a PhD programme. b) Languages Good command of English, both written and spoken. c) Specific knowledge and experience Training required to work with laboratory animals (Category C or equivalent accreditation). Experience with large animal models, particularly porcine and/or ovine models, as well as experience in cardiovascular surgical procedures, will be highly valued. Previous experience in cell culture, tissue engineering, tissue decellularization and recellularization, histology, immunohistochemistry, molecular biology and flow cytometry will be valued. Knowledge of statistical analysis and experimental data processing will be valued, as well as experience or interest in omics data analysis, including single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics. d) Personal skills Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary research environment. Proactivity, autonomy, organizational skills, scientific rigor and willingness to learn. e) Additional requirements Strong motivation to develop a PhD thesis in cardiovascular research, tissue engineering and regenerative medicine. WHAT WE OFFER Type of contract and working hours: Fixed-term, full-time employment contract (Predoctoral contract under the Spanish Science Law / Ley de la Ciencia). Expected starting date: November 2026. The gross annual remuneration associated with this position will be established according to the applicable conditions and distributed in 12 monthly payments: €23,700 gross/year in the first year, €24,500 gross/year in the second year and €26,000 gross/year in the third year. Flexible compensation (childcare vouchers). 23 days of annual leave + 5 personal days per year. Access to training activities and programmes aimed at scientific and professional development. The opportunity to join a multidisciplinary biomedical research institute, accredited as a Health Research Institute by the ISCIII and holding the HR Excellence in Research (HRS4R) distinction, committed to the professional development of researchers. The position is based at the Can Ruti Campus, a biomedical and translational research environment that promotes interaction between basic, preclinical and clinical research, as well as collaboration across institutions and disciplines. items.desc: Department Department of Non-Communicable Disease Epidemiology Closing Date Monday 16 November 2026 Reference EPH-NCDE-2026-07 Applications are invited for the Wellcome Trust funded ENHANCE Doctoral Programme for healthcare professionals, commencing September 2027. Led by the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine in partnership with King’s College London and Queen Mary University of London, the programme combines expertise in the development and application of artificial intelligence and digital tools in healthcare. ENHANCE focuses on discovery research (as defined by the Wellcome Trust) to improve the use of digital tools and artificial intelligence in healthcare, advancing equitable care through data science approaches in diverse national and global populations. The programme supports UK-registered health professionals seeking research training. Funding includes three years of salary, research expenses, home-rate tuition fees, and training and travel costs. Applicants must be accepted onto the pre-application bootcamp before applying for a fellowship. The application process has three stages: Apply for a training bootcamp place – deadline 16 November 2026 Attend bootcamp and submit written application – January to February 2027 Interview – May 2027 Selection will be based on aptitude and potential. Pre-Application Bootcamp We will provide a bridge for those with clinical excellence to gain key AI and data science skills through a three-block dedicated data bootcamp. Bootcamps will be held on 25th – 27th January 2027, 1st – 3rd February 2027, and 22nd – 24th February 2027. They will consist of conceptual training of data science and AI, PPIE, and research methodology. Applicants will develop their PhD fellowship application with supervisors from two institutions. Each year, four applicants will receive the Fellowship after interview in May. Applicant Description Applicants must have completed their undergraduate degree, be practicing healthcare professionals and registered with a national professional regulatory body in the UK/Republic of Ireland (e.g. General Medical Council, Health and Care Professions Council). Applicants should maintain clinical skills (up to a maximum 20% of their time, or 40% for craft specialities). This is a full-time, fixed-term appointment located at the institution of their primary supervisor. Appointments will be made to match an appointee’s current salary plus London allowance if applicable. Doctors who have completed their specialist training (GPs and Consultants) should contact the Programme Director for a discussion about their salary scale. If successful, fellows will start in September 2027 Bootcamp Application Process Applicants must apply for a place on the bootcamps via the program webpage ENHANCE Home - ENHANCE Doctoral Programme by 11.59pm on Monday 16 th November. As part of the application, you will be required to: Provide a CV that includes your clinical and research experience, publications, posters and presentations. Provide evidence of a minimum of 10 hours in AI training, e.g., a certificate from an online course such as https://www.rcsi.com/online/find-a-course/cpd/a/i/ai-in-healthcare or equivalent. 1 page outline for your planned PhD (including aim, objectives, rationale and motivation) 25 shortlisted applicants will then be supported via the bootcamp to prepare their PhD application and interview. Shortlisting results will be communicated by 11th December. The London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We believe that when people feel respected and included, they can be more creative, successful, and happier at work. While we have more work to do, we are committed to building an inclusive workplace, a community that everyone feels a part of, which is safe, respectful, supportive and enables all to reach their full potential.

In collaboration with our Red Cross and Red Crescent partners around the world, we do everything we can to deliver life-saving aid, reconnect families and locate missing people – helping those who need it most, regardless of who they are and what side of the front line they are on. We engage with authorities and armed forces on all sides, often confidentially, pressing for access to detainees to improve their living conditions and urging compliance with international humanitarian law to protect non-combatants, including from digital threats. items.desc: At AAU Energy, a fixed-term position as Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design, is open for appointment from January 1, 2027, or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is 2 years. Your work tasks Your work will include developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models based on circuit data, board geometries, simulation results and design images. You will develop surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic solvers, enabling faster evaluation of design alternatives. The position may also involve computer vision for recognizing circuit structures, component placements and printed circuit board geometries from photographs or other images. In addition, you will investigate graph-based methods for representing circuit relationships, evaluating design rules and generating or testing hypotheses for circuit designs. You will contribute to the development and verification of agentic workflows, where artificial intelligence systems combine models, tools and design rules to reason through and support electronics design tasks. You will prepare datasets, document computational workflows, validate model performance and share results with colleagues working in artificial intelligence, power electronics, semiconductors and software development. The position is offered within the research field of Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design and contributes to AAU Energy’s focus areas of Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, and Energy Efficiency in Components and Systems. The Research Assistant will be affiliated with the Section of Power Electronics System Integration and Materials. Your competencies You have a relevant master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, artificial intelligence or a related field, and you are interested in working at the intersection of machine learning and power electronics design. You have a solid foundation in applied machine learning. Familiarity with electronic systems, including printed circuit boards, circuit topologies, components and the physical principles that influence electrical, thermal and electromagnetic performance, will help you engage with the engineering context of the role. You have practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models, and you can translate complex engineering challenges into data-driven methods suited to a research environment. You are comfortable working with structured and unstructured engineering data, including circuit representations, board geometries, simulation data and images. Experience with computer vision, graph-based machine learning or graph neural networks will support your work with methods that interpret circuit layouts and geometries, reason about relationships between components, and generate or assess design hypotheses. You are interested in developing surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic simulation tools while maintaining sufficient accuracy for use in electronics-design workflows. You work systematically with model validation, data quality and reproducible experiments, and you understand that artificial intelligence methods for engineering need to be technically robust as well as useful to domain specialists. You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and dialogue, and you work well in a multidisciplinary environment where colleagues with expertise in artificial intelligence, power electronics and software development collaborate closely. You take responsibility for your tasks, ask constructive questions when assumptions need clarification, and contribute with curiosity and sound technical judgement to the development of new methods for intelligent electronic-system design. Who we are AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate. We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in …

items.desc: Req ID: 531879 Chez Alstom, nous avons une connaissance pointue des réseaux de transport et comprenons ce qui conduit les individus à les emprunter. Des trains à grande vitesse, métros, monorails et tramways aux systèmes intégrés, services, infrastructures, et solutions de signalisation et de mobilité numérique, nous offrons à la diversité de nos clients le portefeuille le plus vaste du secteur. Chaque jour, plus de 80 000 collaborateurs dans le monde qui ouvrent la voie à des solutions de mobilité plus vertes et plus intelligentes pour relier les villes, réduire l’empreinte carbone et remplacer la voiture. Sujet du stage : Étude et comparaison de méthodes de Machine Learning pour données de simulation et d'essais. La création de modèles à partir de données issues de simulations numériques ou de mesures expérimentales présente un grand intérêt pour la compréhension des phénomènes physiques et la prédiction de nouveaux cas de fonctionnement. L'objectif du stage est d'évaluer différentes méthodes de Machine Learning disponibles dans les bibliothèques Python PyTorch et scikit-learn, afin d’identifier leurs domaines d’application, leurs besoins en données et leurs performances sur différentes problématiques. Le stage consistera également à développer des fonctions génériques permettant de préparer et mettre en forme les données afin de faciliter l'utilisation de ces méthodes. Nous proposons un stage de niveau Bac+5 pour un profil en mathématiques appliquées, informatique ou data science. Développement du sujet : Les activités de cette étude seront les suivantes : Analyse des méthodes disponibles dans PyTorch et scikit-learn ; Mise en place de fonctions génériques de préparation des données ; Mise en œuvre et évaluation des différentes méthodes ; Comparaison des performances et identification des cas d'utilisation adaptés ; Rédaction d'un rapport de synthèse. Export des modèles vers un format standard (ONNX) ; Développement d'un wrapper C/C++ permettant la réutilisation des modèles exportés dans des applications externes ; Évaluation sur différents cas d'application (thermique, batteries, modèles récursifs, PINN). Il n’y a pas que les passionnés de trains qui s’épanouissent chez nous. Nul doute que vous ressentirez beaucoup de fierté lorsque vous monterez dans l’un de nos trains avec votre famille ou vos amis. Nous nous sommes engagés à créer un environnement de travail inclusif pour tous. Job Type: Stage/Apprenti

items.desc: Le département SEQUOIA (Services, Economie, Questions hUmaines, Outils innovants et IA) de la R&D, intervient en appui de la direction Marketing de la Branche Commerce d’EDF. Dans ce département, le groupe E7C est spécialisé en analyse de données de consommation, et en modélisation statistique dans le but de concevoir des nouvelles offres de fourniture ou des services. Nos missions sont de : Mettre en place des panels de clients pour collecter des courbes de charge (globale ou sur des usages spécifiques) : des compétences en sondage, ou en dimensionnement de panels sont alors requises. Modéliser des profils de consommation. Développer des algorithmes pour faire de l’estimation/prévision de consommation. Estimer l’impact d’une offre ou d’un service sur la consommation des clients. Ce stage s’inscrit dans un projet, dont l’objectif est de recueillir et valoriser les données clients. Par ailleurs, un volet méthodologique du projet identifie et développe des traitements innovants et créateurs de valeur pour la relation client et les offres à partir des courbes de charge au pas de temps des compteurs communicants (Linky et Gazpar), mais aussi à pas de temps fin (seconde). Contexte du stage : Le département SEQUOIA de la R&D a pour ambition de devenir un acteur de référence en matière de foundation models. A ce jour, les méthodes en cours de développement sont spécialisées pour la prévision et l’imputation de séries temporelles (voir par exemple le modèle TS-ICL : https://github.com/EDF-Lab/ts-icl). Les méthodes d’inférence causale sont fréquemment utilisées pour répondre à des problématiques autour de l’énergie : quel est l’effet d’une rénovation énergétique sur la consommation électrique du client ? Comment réagit le client face aux changements d’offres tarifaires ? Cependant, les algorithmes traditionnels montrent parfois des limites lorsqu’il est question de travailler sur des données de courbes de charge haute fréquence (séries temporelles de consommation électrique individuelles). Le stage comportera plusieurs phases : État de l’art des méthodes envisagées et montée en compétences : Se familiariser avec les méthodes usuelles d’inférence causale. Explorer les causal foundation models ainsi que les méthodes de génération de données synthétiques causales associées, les comparer aux algorithmes traditionnels. Porter un regard critique sur ces méthodes. Capitaliser ses résultats. Prise en main des données Jeu de données public de courbes de charge avec effet causal simulé. Données de courbes de charge EDF avec effet causal réel et inconnu. Mise en œuvre Implémenter les méthodes identifiées lors de la revue de littérature en Python. Certains modèles traditionnels sont codés en R. Adapter ces méthodes à notre usage et à nos données. Réaliser un benchmark des différentes méthodes. Capitalisation des travaux effectués Rédaction d'un rapport, code python/R accompagné d'une documentation, co-rédaction d'article scientifique. La R&D propose ce stage de fin d’études, à destination d’étudiants en écoles d’ingénieurs ou Master 2, spécialisés en Statistique/Data Science/Econométrie/Deep Learning/IA. Ecoles : Ecole Polytechnique, ENSTA, Ecole Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées, IMT Atlantique, CentraleSupélec, Ecole des mines, Télécom Paris, ENSAE, ENSAI, Paris School of Economics et Toulouse School of Economics Compétences : Connaissances théoriques en statistique, Machine Learning et en Deep Learning. Capacité à comprendre et synthétiser des articles complexes. Goût pour la R&D, l’inférence causale et les foundation models.. Modélisation de séries temporelles. L’étudiant sera amené à utiliser principalement le langage de programmation Python et ponctuellement R. items.desc: About The Job A vos côtés, partout en France, depuis plus de 100 ans ! Chez Danone, grandir, on y prend goût. C’est pourquoi nous sommes présents dans le quotidien des Français grâce à ses 26 marques de produits savoureux pour se faire plaisir tout en prenant soin de soi et des siens. Avec plus de 8 000 Danoners répartis sur 13 sites de productions, 7 entrepôts, 3 sièges et un centre de R&D, Danone travaille continuellement à l’élaboration et au développement de produits iconiques dans vos cuisines, supermarchés, restaurants, cafés ou encore pour des établissements de soins et des pharmacies. Certifiée Bcorp et Happy Trainees, Danone ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais une entreprise meilleure pour le monde. Nous nous efforçons de proposer le meilleur à nos consommateurs comme à nos collaborateurs. L'équipe Normes IFRS au sein du département Consolidation & Reporting Groupe est responsable de l'analyse des évolutions réglementaires et comptables ainsi que de leur déploiement au sein du Groupe. Dans un contexte d'accélération des technologies IA, l'équipe cherche à repenser ses méthodes de travail et à développer de nouveaux outils permettant de gagner en efficacité et en pertinence. TES MISSIONS CHEZ DANONE Ce stage se déroulera à Paris, dans notre siège social à partir du 4 janvier 2027, pour une période de 6 mois. Hugo Masson, IFRS Manager , au sein de l’équipe Consolidation & Reporting Groupe , t’accompagnera pour grandir au quotidien et t’épanouir dans tes missions Participer à l’automatisation et à l’optimisation des processus de veille réglementaire et normative à l’échelle du Groupe. Développer des outils basés sur l’intelligence artificielle afin de faciliter l’analyse, la synthèse et le partage des publications des normalisateurs, régulateurs et cabinets d’audit. Tester, évaluer et déployer de nouveaux outils d'intelligence artificielle (Copilot, modèles de langage, agents IA, outils de recherche avancée) afin d'identifier les cas d'usage à forte valeur ajoutée pour améliorer l’efficacité des processus de l’équipe. Concevoir et prototyper des solutions innovantes (IA générative, assistants, agents, automatisations) destinées à transformer les méthodes de travail de l'équipe Consolidation & Reporting Groupe Contribuer à la structuration, à l’exploitation et à la valorisation des données utilisées par l’équipe Consolidation & Reporting Groupe. LES + DE CE STAGE Jusqu’à 2 jours/sem de télétravail Prise en charge intégrale de ton abonnement de transport en région parisienne/lyonnaise ou remboursement partiel/intégral de tes frais kilométriques sur nos sites de production. L’accès au programme ""Vendredi je grandis"" un programme de développement et d'accompagnement sur mesure chaque vendredi après-midi, couvrant des sujets tels que la carrière, les soft skills et les hard skills. Stage Une gratification allant de 1 300€ (Bac+4 et césure) à 1 500€ (Bac+5) brut/mois. Une opportunité unique d’appliquer les technologies IA les plus récentes à des problématiques stratégiques de Finance Groupe. Une forte autonomie pour proposer, tester et déployer de nouveaux cas d’usage. Une exposition à des sujets internationaux au contact des équipes Finance Groupe, Digital et Data. Avantages du site cantine, restaurant au dernier étage, salle de sport, parking vélos About you Pour faire de grandes choses ensembles, nous recherchons pour ce poste quelqu’un de Disponible à partir de janvier 2027 pour une durée de 6 mois De niveau Bac+4/5 en école d’ingénieur, université ou formation spécialisée en data, intelligence artificielle, informatique ou transformation digitale Curieux, autonome et force de proposition, avec une forte appétence pour l’innovation et les nouvelles technologies. À l’aise avec les outils de traitement de données et d’automatisation. Une première expérience ou des projets personnels impliquant l'utilisation de l'IA générative ou du machine learning seraient un plus. Intéressé par les applications concrètes de l’intelligence artificielle générative dans un environnement Finance d’un groupe international. Capable de vulgariser des sujets techniques et de collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés. About us Pendant ton stage, tu préfères prendre des notes ou des initiatives ? 90% de nos stagiaires et alternants estiment que Danone offre un environnement de travail propice à l’évolution professionnelle grâce aux responsabilités, à l’autonomie et aux formations accordées (source Happy Trainees). REJOINDRE DANONE C’EST… Rencontrer des Danoners aux personnalités singulières, profils divers et aux parcours professionnels variés Grandir dans des environnements différents sites de production, bases logistiques, centre de recherche et innovation ou encore sièges sociaux Se construire un parcours de carrière sur mesure, adapté à ta personnalité, tes compétences et tes envies Apprendre grâce à des missions responsabilisantes, riches et apprenantes. Nos Danoners ont la parole ! …

For more information please visit: https://www.brunel.ac.uk/about/our-history/home Description of College The College of Engineering, Design and Physical Sciences at Brunel University of London delivers world-leading research, interdisciplinary innovation, industry engagement, and excellence in engineering, computing, design, mathematics, and physical sciences education. Description Of Role And Essential Person Specification We are seeking a highly motivated Research Assistant or Research Fellow to contribute to CLIMABUILD, a Horizon Europe research project developing innovative methodologies, artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled digital technologies and decision-support solutions to enhance the resilience, sustainability and climate adaptability of buildings and the wider built environment. Brunel plays a leading role in research activities spanning resilience and sustainability assessment, computational modelling, lifecycle analysis, digital decision-support systems, knowledge graphs, participatory technologies and stakeholder engagement. Working closely with the Principal Investigator and international consortium partners, the successful candidate will: Develop, apply or support mathematical, computational and data-driven approaches for assessing the resilience, sustainability and lifecycle performance of buildings and infrastructure. Contribute to AI-enabled digital solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, digital twins and intelligent decision-support tools. Investigate climate adaptation and low-carbon renovation strategies through lifecycle assessment, scenario analysis, uncertainty evaluation and multi-criteria optimisation. Support the development, integration and validation of innovative methodologies and digital tools, working with project partners and Living Labs. Contribute to scientific publications, project deliverables, stakeholder engagement and research dissemination. Applicants should hold a relevant degree in Civil, Environmental, Building or Infrastructure Engineering, Computer Science or a closely related discipline. Appointment at Research Fellow level will require a PhD or equivalent research experience. Essential competencies include analytical and computational skills, programming experience (e.g. Python, MATLAB or R), knowledge of resilience, sustainability or lifecycle assessment, and familiarity with AI technologies, including LLMs. Good communication skills and the ability to work independently, with appropriate supervision according to grade, within an international and interdisciplinary team are essential. The appointment will be made at Research Assistant or Research Fellow level, depending on the successful candidate's qualifications and experience. We offer a generous annual leave package plus discretionary University closure days, excellent training and development opportunities as well as a great occupational pension scheme and a range of health-related support. The University is committed to a hybrid working approach. Closing date for applications: 1 December 2026 If you have any technical issues please contact us at: hrsystems@brunel.ac.uk Brunel University London has a strong commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion. Our aim is to promote and achieve a fully inclusive workforce to reflect our community.

items.desc: We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. What You'll Build Enterprise agents increasingly process personal data across documents, conversations, and business tools. In this context, personal data protection is difficult: an agent must respect the purpose, permissions, and recipient constraints governing each use. The internship will investigate how to detect privacy risks before information is released or an external action is executed, testing whether signals from a language model's internal representations provide measurable benefits beyond input/output filters and explicit policy enforcement. The internship will be part of a project investigating on the following research questions. Under which conditions do model-internal signals improve the detection and prevention of: unauthorized personal-data disclosure beyond external monitoring and policy enforcement, while preserving task performance and acceptable latency? misalignment against constraints set to personal data processing? This Central Question Can Be Broken Down Into Detection: Can internal representations predict an impending violation beyond what is already observable from the input, policy context, and proposed action? Intervention: Does targeted steering improve the privacy–utility trade-off? What You'll Bring You are a university student in the last year of your Master's degree/ MSc in Computer Science or similar major You possess a passion for research activities (reading/identifying relevant scientific papers, scientific writing, etc.) You have strong Python development skills You know about Natural Language Processing (NLP) practices You have some AI agentic development skills You demonstrate a fluent level in English (working language) You possess good oral and written communication skills and an ability to synthesize Meet your team Customers rely on SAP delivering trustworthy secure products. The “Secure Development Center of Excellence” is responsible for the SAP Secure Software Development and Operations Lifecycle and the respective Product Standard Security and Data Protection. The team is driving an automation assisted approach in significantly reducing security risks emerging during software development Duration : 6 months Start date: From January-February 2027 In accordance with the French legislation, for any duration over 2 months, this internship is paid in line with the SAP gratification grid. Bring out your best SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Dann werde Teil unseres REWE Atelier Teams. Als Creative AI Developer / Creative Technologist (m/w/d) entwickelst du technische Lösungen für KI-gestützte kreative Prozesse. Dabei bist du weder ausschließlich klassische:r Software Developer:in noch reine:r Kreative:r: Du verstehst, wie Design, Content und Produktion funktionieren, und kannst diese Anforderungen in funktionierende technische Lösungen übersetzen. Du entwickelst Prototypen, Tools, Schnittstellen und Automatisierungen und erprobst, wie sich aktuelle Generative-AI-Technologien sinnvoll in kreative Workflows integrieren lassen. Gemeinsam mit Designer:innen, Entwickler:innen, internen Stakeholdern und Technologiepartnern gestaltest du so die technische Grundlage für eine skalierbare, KI-gestützte Kreation. Die Position ist zunächst auf 12 Monate befristet und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, in einem zukunftsweisenden Innovationsprojekt früh Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sichtbare Wirkung zu erzielen. Was du bei uns bewegst: Du entwickelst technische Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Kreation, Generative AI und Softwareentwicklung und bringst kreative Anforderungen schnell in die technische Umsetzung. Du konzipierst und entwickelst Proofs of Concept, Prototypen, Tools, Skripte und Automatisierungen, mit denen du neue Ansätze für kreative Anwendungen praktisch erprobbar machst. Du entwickelst und integrierst APIs, Interfaces und Workflows, über die KI-Services in bestehende oder neue kreative Prozesse eingebunden werden. Du beschäftigst dich mit aktuellen GenAI-Modellen für Bild- und Videoanwendungen und prüfst, wie sie sich sinnvoll in Creative-Production-Workflows einsetzen lassen. Du wirkst am Aufbau einer modularen und skalierbaren technischen Infrastruktur für KI-gestützte Kreation mit. Du arbeitest eng mit Designer:innen, Entwickler:innen, internen Stakeholdern und Technologiepartnern zusammen und übersetzt zwischen kreativen Anforderungen und technischer Umsetzung. Du nutzt moderne KI-gestützte Entwicklungsansätze wie Agentic Coding / Vibe Coding und entwickelst bestehende Lösungen pragmatisch und iterativ weiter. Was uns überzeugt: Zuallererst deine Persönlichkeit: Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und hast Freude daran, Dinge selbst auszuprobieren und zum Laufen zu bringen. Du arbeitest pragmatisch, übernimmst Verantwortung und entwickelst Lösungen gerne iterativ weiter. Du bringst praktische Entwicklungserfahrung und Verständnis für kreative Produktionsprozesse zusammen. Das kann zum Beispiel aus Creative Technology, Creative Development, Design Automation, Motion/Graphic Design, CGI, Postproduktion oder Content Production kommen. Du hast bereits selbst technische Lösungen für kreative Anwendungen entwickelt, zum Beispiel Tools oder Skripte zur Automatisierung von Produktionsschritten, Interfaces oder Plugins für Kreativsoftware oder automatisierte Bild- und Video-Workflows. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Explorer, observer, sécuriser l’espace de demain. Avec 50 ans d’expertise, notre Business Unit Espace est un partenaire de confiance des agences spatiales, maîtres d’œuvre et opérateurs de satellites à travers l’Europe.Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l’innovation de l’écosystème spatial. Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l’Espace. Portées par l’IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens. Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c’est façonner le futur de l’espace aux côtés d’experts passionnés. Description Du Poste Nous recrutons un(e) Stagiaire Ingénieur(e) R&D afin de mener des travaux sur l’estimation de la largeur des rivières par approche d’intelligence artificielle (IA) . Vous rejoignez notre Business Unit Espace , au sein de notre agence Space Processing & Intelligence , spécialisée dans le traitement et l’hybridation des données spatiales . Vos missions Au sein de l’équipe Hydrologie Spatiale et encadré(e) par vos référent(e)s techniques, vous développez un modèle d’apprentissage supervisé permettant d’estimer les largeurs de rivières à partir d’images satellite, élément crucial pour la mesure de débits. CS GROUP dispose d’une méthode déterministe de calcul de largeurs de rivières à partir de masques d’eau mais la complexité de certains cours d’eau, notamment en zone tropicale, limite la précision du modèle. L’objectif de ce stage R&D est de surpasser les performances actuelles via une approche IA et pour cela =, vous devez : Effectuer l’état de l’art des méthodes et datasets existants. Créer un jeu de données pour l’entraînement et l’évaluation. Évaluer et prendre en main la méthode déterministe actuelle, MIRROWRS. Développer et entraîner la méthode supervisée. Évaluer les performances du nouveau modèle. L'environnement technique Python, GeoPandas, Rasterio PyTorch, OpenCV, MLFlow, etc pour la partie IA Les plus de ce stage Intégrer une communauté scientifique dynamique autour de l’hydrologie continentale, des données spatiales et des enjeux environnementaux liés à l’eau Monter en compétences en développement métier avec Python Découvrir les aspects R&D en entreprise Possibilité de poursuivre en CDI à l’issue du stage Qualifications Vous êtes en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou diplôme universitaire équivalent, vous recherchez un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois. Vous avez une très bonne connaissance du langage Python et de ses principales librairies scientifiques (GeoPandas, PyTorch, etc.) ainsi que des notions de Git. Vous êtes autonome , curieux(se) et rigoureux(se) ? Alors vous êtes la pépite que nous recherchons ! Informations supplémentaires Rejoignez une entreprise où l’humain, l’innovation et l’impact se rencontrent. You understand what our developers are building, you can build alongside them, and you have the strategic instinct to know where automation creates the most leverage. Why Conduct We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't. Every process change, every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain. We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service. We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out. What you'll own The mandate is simple: make every team at Conduct dramatically more productive through AI . You'll identify the highest-leverage opportunities across the company, build and deploy the automations, and own adoption end-to-end. You'll work as closely with our engineering team as you will with sales and ops - understanding what we're building technically, contributing to developer productivity workflows, and building internal tooling that makes our engineers faster. In practice: Partner directly with functional leads across GTM, product, finance, and ops to identify and prioritise the highest-impact automation opportunities Build and deploy AI agents, automations, and internal tooling, using both code-first approaches and modern low-code platforms depending on what's right for the job Work closely with the engineering team to understand what we're building technically, contribute to developer productivity workflows, and build automations that make engineers faster Build and maintain internal knowledge systems that compound in value over time Who we hire We're looking for someone who sits at the intersection of technical depth and operational instinct. You've built real things, not just mapped processes or written strategy docs. You understand how software gets built, you're comfortable working alongside engineers, and you bring enough commercial awareness to know which problems are actually worth solving. In practice that tends to look like: 2+ years in a technical operations, solutions engineering, internal tools, or technical product role. You've been close to engineering teams and you know how to work with them, not just around them. Genuinely technical. You're comfortable with code-first approaches and can prototype real workflows, not just wire together low-code tools. You understand what our developers are building and can contribute meaningfully to engineering productivity. Hands-on with modern AI tooling. You've built real workflows using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, n8n, Clay, Gumloop, or similar and you have strong opinions about when to use what. A sharp process thinker. You spot inefficiency fast, know how to prioritise ruthlessly, and design solutions that actually get adopted. High ownership, low ego. You're as comfortable doing the hands-on build as you are presenting a business case to leadership. No task is beneath you if it moves things forward.

items.desc: IMAGO is one of the leading agencies for visual content in Europe, with over 800 million photos and videos used daily by international clients across News Media, Broadcast, Sports, Brands, and Corporate sectors. For almost 30 years, we’ve built a strong market position in Germany and continue evolving our platform to meet global digital demands. Our international team works closely together from our headquarters in the heart of Berlin. Our sales team should spend its time selling, not on manual work. As our first GTM Engineer, you’ll build and run the AI agents and automations that find, qualify, route and keep IMAGO’s customers. You’ll report to our Head of RevOps, work closely with our RevOps Specialist, own the whole automation setup, and be measured on the pipeline it creates. What you’ll do Build our automated inbound and prospecting engine: enrichment, ICP scoring, routing and outreach written by AI Analyse conversion and leakage across the funnel, segment our customers, and turn each finding into an automation or a process change Turn buying signals and product usage data into prioritised tasks in HubSpot, and test no-touch motions for long-tail customers Automate renewals, churn alerts, upsells and contract-to-invoice Build and manage AI agents for sales (account research, CRM updates, meeting prep) on Claude and n8n: set their guardrails and human approval steps, and track precision, cost per output and pipeline impact for every agent Run scrapers for prospect data and copyright compliance Monitor and document everything you ship, and train the team to use it Ship first versions in days, test them, and stop what doesn’t work What you bring 2+ years in GTM engineering, RevOps or growth engineering at a B2B company Strong analytical skills and a solid grasp of SaaS metrics (pipeline, conversion, NRR, churn) You link every build to revenue and know when not to automate You have built automations or AI agents that a sales team used every day, and you can show us examples Hands-on experience building HubSpot workflows, HubSpot API integrations and n8n, Make or Zapier automations in production, including tracking their precision, cost per output and pipeline impact Scheduled scrapers built with code or tools (Apify, Firecrawl, Clay) API workflows with Tableau or a similar BI tool Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents; you can read Python or JavaScript and use SQL High ownership and a bias for action: you are comfortable as our first and only GTM Engineer Clear written communication: you scope a project on one page and document workflows so others can use them Fluent English, and you live in Berlin or are willing to relocate Nice to have: German language skills, Clay, and experience in media or content licensing What we offer A modern workplace in the heart of Berlin Public transportation ticket Monthly budget to spend in an area of your liking, incl. items.desc: Vacancy Notice 2033 INTERPOL is the world’s largest international police organization, with 196 Member Countries. Created in 1923, it facilitates cross-border police co-operation, and supports and assists all organizations, authorities, and services whose mission is to prevent or combat international crime. INTERPOL strives to achieve a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcomes applications from individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. To achieve our Diversity goals, we encourage applications from women and nationals of under/unrepresented member countries who are passionate about our mission. INTERPOL’s recruitment process is merit-based hence all hiring decisions are made considering the applicant’s qualifications and the needs of the Organization. Job Title: Data Scientist Reporting To: Assistant Director Location: Lyon Type of contract: Project Fixed-term Contract Duration (End date): 31 December 2027* Grade: 4 Number of post(s): 1 Level of Security screening: Enhanced Deadline for application: 18 November 2026 11.00 PM (Singapore Time) Conditions applying for all candidates Only professional experience for which candidates can provide official proof of employment will be considered. This position also carries, in principle, no expectation of renewal. Any potential subsequent extension will be subject to the terms of the Organization’s Staff Manual, to satisfactory performance and to availability of funds. Tests/interviews in connection to this selection procedure will take place approximately 3-4 weeks after the deadline for applications. Applicants are kindly requested to plan their availability during this period accordingly, in case they are short-listed. Selected candidates will be expected to report for duty approximately two to three months after receiving an offer of employment at the latest. INTRODUCTION OF POST Context and Mission The Executive Directorate for Police Capabilities (EDPC) designs and oversees all INTERPOL’s police capabilities, including criminal databases. Within this framework, the Operational Support and Analysis Directorate (OSA) empowers law enforcement officers to respond to international crime in real time. Specifically, the Criminal Analysis Sub-Directorate (CAS) leverages Project INSIGHT, a modern analytical platform designed to harness the power, security, and scalability of INTERPOL’s infrastructure. This initiative aims to make criminal intelligence analysis more efficient and effective for the benefit of all member countries. The Data Opportunity INTERPOL databases serve as an invaluable global repository, containing millions of records contributed daily by member countries via a secure communications system. These datasets include information on suspects and wanted people, fingerprints, DNA profiles, stolen motor vehicles, firearms, lost or stolen travel documents, etc. While these resources are vast, maximizing their potential requires the application of up-to-date analytical tools and methodologies to transform raw data into actionable intelligence. The Role The Data Scientist will provide advanced analytical support to help users generate actionable insights from these large-scale datasets, both within the core INTERPOL databases and through the Project INSIGHT platform. The successful candidate will translate complex data into compelling graphical, numerical, and narrative formats. We seek an interdisciplinary professional who integrates techniques from diverse scientific and computer science disciplines to solve complex data problems. Collaboration and Impact The post holder will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to continuously refine data science models and outputs. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential for interpreting data and uncovering hidden solutions within massive datasets. This role requires a passion for optimizing data processing workflows and extracting high-value outputs that directly support INTERPOL’s General Secretariat crime and operational support units, as well as member countries worldwide. items.desc: Overview: We help UK consumers recover money lost through mis-sold financial products. Our work includes managing claims, processing financial documentation and supporting customers throughout the claims process. We operate at scale, with legal and operations teams working across multiple locations. Technology plays a central role in how we work, with AI already being used to process incoming correspondence, interpret documents and streamline operational workflows. We are looking for someone to take ownership of this capability and help develop it further. The role: You will own the business's AI and automation capabilities, overseeing the models, prompts and workflows that process incoming documents, interpret information and determine the appropriate next steps. These systems are central to day-to-day operations. Their accuracy, reliability and performance directly affect how efficiently cases progress and how quickly customers receive updates. You will be responsible for maintaining and improving these systems, ensuring they are robust, well documented and continually evolving. You will also identify new opportunities to introduce AI and automation across the business. You will work closely with the CTO and development team, who are responsible for the wider technology platform and its ongoing development. Your focus will be on the AI and automation layer, ensuring its outputs integrate effectively with the wider platform and deliver tangible operational improvements. Key responsibilities Lender response categorisation Own the end-to-end pipeline that reads, classifies and routes every lender response: acknowledgements, holding letters, final responses, offers, rejections and DSAR data packs. Maintain the categories, rules and confidence thresholds that decide what goes straight through and what goes to a person. Investigate misclassifications quickly and fix the root cause, not just the case in front of you. Postal scan categorisation Run the OCR and document classification pipeline for scanned post: document type, client, lender and claim matching. Improve extraction on poor scans, handwriting and multi-page bundles. Keep unmatched and low-confidence items in a clear exception queue, cleared within an agreed turnaround. Prompts, models and evaluation Own the prompt library: version control, documentation, change history and review for every production prompt. Build and maintain test sets of anonymised real documents, so every prompt or model change is measured before it ships. Monitor accuracy, drift, latency and cost, and choose and tune models against those measures. Manage provider dependencies, rate limits and fallbacks, so the pipeline keeps running when a provider has an outage. ﻿ Automation and integration Build and maintain the automations that move documents and data between the AI layer, the case management system and the client portal. Work with the development team so AI outputs (claim status, document type, next step) show correctly in the client portal. Spot the next manual processes worth automating and build the case for them with operations. Governance and compliance Make sure AI processing of client data meets UK GDPR, our data protection policies and the standards expected of a regulated legal and claims business. Keep a clear audit trail of what each model decided, on what input and with which prompt version. Write and maintain runbooks, so no system depends on one person's knowledge. Working with the business Turn needs from the legal and claims teams into system changes, and explain AI behaviour in plain English. Report to the CTO on performance, incidents and the roadmap. Skills and experience Essential 3+ years building production software, including at least 2 year shipping LLM or machine learning systems that real users rely on. Strong prompt engineering backed by evaluation: you can show how you measured a prompt and improved it, not just that you wrote it. Hands-on document AI: OCR, document classification and data extraction (for example Azure Document Intelligence, AWS Textract, Google Document AI or open-source tools). Python or TypeScript, REST APIs and SQL. Workflow automation and integration (for example Power Automate, Make, n8n, or custom queues and webhooks). Experience with major LLM providers' APIs (for example OpenAI, Anthropic or Azure OpenAI), including cost and rate-limit management. A track record of picking up an existing, partly documented system and becoming its owner fast. Working knowledge of UK GDPR and of handling sensitive personal and financial data. Clear communication with non-technical colleagues.
