items.desc: Bei 8com, ansässig in Neustadt an der Weinstraße in der wunderschönen Pfalz, pulsiert das Herz der Cyber-Sicherheit. Seit 2004 sind wir stolz darauf, ein etablierter und vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Unternehmen und Behörden in über 40 Ländern weltweit zu sein. Unsere Expertise? Schutz im digitalen Zeitalter durch hochkarätige Managed Security Services. Von unserem modernen Security Operations Center aus bieten wir ein breites Spektrum an Dienstleistungen: Vulnerability Management, Security Monitoring, Threat Hunting und Digital Forensics & Incident Response – um nur einige zu nennen. Unsere Penetration Tests und Security Awareness Programme sind dabei nicht nur Dienstleistungen, sondern echte Hingucker im Bereich der Cyber-Sicherheit. Was uns als Arbeitgeber besonders macht? Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter schätzen die offene, familiäre Atmosphäre, die kurzen Entscheidungswege und das Gefühl, mit ihrer Arbeit wirklich Impact zu haben. Wir arbeiten modern, digital und hochprofessionell – aber immer menschlich, nahbar und mit echter Freude an Zusammenarbeit. In diesem Umfeld erhältst du die Chance, nah an Entscheidungen zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unser dynamisches Wachstum aktiv mitzugestalten. Was du bei uns bewegst AI & LLM Engineering: Du entwickelst und implementierst AI- und LLM-basierte Lösungen für unsere internen Prozesse im Security Operations Center. Dabei fokussierst du dich auf die Integration und den Betrieb von Large Language Models, das Design autonomer AI-Agents und den Einsatz moderner Agentic Frameworks/Harnesses (z. B. pi-agent). Lokale AI-Infrastruktur: Gemeinsam mit dem Team betreust und betreibst du unsere lokale AI-Infrastruktur und Hardware – aktuell auf Apple Mac Servern mit Tools wie Open WebUI, llama.cpp und vLLM sowie künftig auf einem zusätzlichen High-End Nvidia-Server. AI-Integration & Automatisierung: Du entwickelst Schnittstellen und Automatisierungen, um AI-Agents und LLM-Lösungen in bestehende Systeme, Prozesse und Security-Workflows zu integrieren. Dabei entwickelst du unter anderem eigene Anwendungen und Skripte in Python und bindest Security-Tools über APIs und Protokolle wie dem Model Context Protocol (MCP) an. Lokale Modelle & Optimierung: Du beschäftigst dich mit lokalen AI-Modellen (z. B. Qwen, GLM, Gemma), deren Auswahl, Bereitstellung, Benchmarking sowie zielgerichtetem Fine-Tuning und Optimierung für unsere Anwendungsfälle. Security Automation & SOAR: Ein ebenso zentraler Bestandteil deiner Rolle ist die Security Automation. Du entwickelst und optimierst Automatisierungen für Cyber-Security-Prozesse und erstellst Playbooks sowie Integrationen mit Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR. Weiterentwicklung: Du beobachtest neue Entwicklungen im Bereich AI, LLMs und Security Automation und bringst neue Technologien, Tools und Ideen aktiv in unsere technische Weiterentwicklung ein. Was dich auszeichnet Dein Hintergrund: Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Informatik, Künstliche Intelligenz, IT-Sicherheit oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen – oder überzeugst uns durch entsprechende praktische Erfahrung. Deine AI-Expertise: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Large Language Models (LLMs) und hast bereits praktische Erfahrung mit deren Einsatz, Integration und Bereitstellung gesammelt. Themen wie Modellarchitekturen, Agentic AI Frameworks, Context Management oder MCP sind dir nicht fremd. Deine Tool-Erfahrung: Idealerweise hast du bereits mit Technologien und Tools wie Open WebUI, llama.cpp, vLLM, pi-agent oder vergleichbaren AI-/LLM-Frameworks gearbeitet und weißt, wie lokale Modelle auf Mac- und Nvidia-Systemen bereitgestellt, konfiguriert und betrieben werden. Deine Programmierkenntnisse: Du programmierst sicher in Python und hast Erfahrung mit moderner Softwareentwicklung. Kenntnisse in Git, CI/CD, SecOps-Prinzipien, n8n und Docker helfen dir dabei, deine Lösungen professionell zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen. Dein Security-Know-how: Idealerweise bringst du einen Hintergrund im Bereich Cyber Security mit und kennst Security-Technologien und -Prozesse. Erfahrung mit SOAR-Plattformen, insbesondere Cortex XSOAR, sowie mit der Entwicklung von Playbooks und Security-Automatisierungen ist ein großes Plus. Deine Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest analytisch, eigenständig und lösungsorientiert. Du hast Freude daran, neue Technologien auszuprobieren, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und daraus praxistaugliche Lösungen zu entwickeln. Deine Persönlichkeit: Du bist ein kommunikativer Teamplayer und kannst komplexe technische Themen verständlich vermitteln. Auf Deutsch und Englisch bewegst du dich sicher. Was wir Dir bieten Strukturiertes Onboarding: Dank unseres bewährten Paten Modells findest du schnell deinen Platz im Team und startest erfolgreich durch. Benefits: Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, familienfreundliche Angebote und Unterstützung (z. B. Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Fitness, Kindergartenzuschuss) …

items.desc:
Lieu : Elancourt, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
Au coeur de Saint Quentin en Yvelines, le site d'Elancourt est un des centres d’excellence technologique Thales les plus importants. La diversité et la technicité des systèmes et équipements mobilisent des savoir-faire dans plus de 80 métiers dans les solutions de défense, de sécurité de haute technologie et de services numériques. 
 En nous rejoignant, vous serez intégré au Centre de compétences Electronique de Missiles, qui conçoit, développe et valide des équipements pour les générations de missiles en cours de développement et futures au sein de la BL Optronique et Missiles Electroniques (OME).
 Dans ce cadre, vous serez rattaché au responsable de l'activité Data & IA qui est en charge du développement des solutions d'IA et de leur validation au sein du Secteur Electronique de Missiles et en charge du déploiement des algorithmes de Deep Learning sur des cartes matérielles embarquées à bord de nos systèmes.
 Au sein de l'équipe Data & IA, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'industrialisation, le déploiement, la maintenance et la supervision de modèles d'IA de détection et de reconnaissance au sein de systèmes embarqués soumis à de fortes contraintes en ressources (calcul, énergie, mémoire) et en accès aux données. Vous prendrez en compte dès la conception les approches de frugalité des données et d'optimisation du cycle de vie des modèles.
 Dans le cadre de la mise à jour des algorithmes de reconnaissance embarqués, l’équipe souhaite traiter le besoin de mettre à jour un modèle sans procéder à un réentraînement complet du réseau, coûteux en temps et en ressources. L’objectif du stage est d’étudier des approches d’incremental learning permettant d’améliorer progressivement la performance au fil du temps, en limitant la dérive et l’oubli des classes déjà apprises.
 En nous rejoignant, vous vous verrez confier les missions suivantes : 
 1) le fine-tuning des dernières couches d’un modèle pré-entraîné pour intégrer des données récentes
 2)l’ajout d’une nouvelle classe au classifieur
 3)le remplacement d’une classe par une autre, en simulant une mise à jour de l'ontologie.
 L’objectif est de concevoir une pipeline d’entraînement incrémental reproductible, de définir des protocoles d’évaluation adaptés (performances globales et par classe, stabilité, robustesse), et de comparer plusieurs stratégies de mise à jour.
 L’objectif est de concevoir une pipeline d’entraînement incrémental reproductible, de définir des protocoles d’évaluation adaptés (performances globales et par classe, stabilité, robustesse), et de comparer plusieurs stratégies de mise à jour.
 Vous analyserez les compromis entre plasticité (apprentissage du nouveau) et stabilité (maintien des performances initiales) afin de proposer des recommandations concrètes pour un usage embarqué.
 Votre profil 
 Vous préparez un BAC+5 en IA et vous recherchez un stage pour une durée de 6 mois ? 
 Vous avez idéalement une première expérience en Deep Learning ou traitement de données ?
 Vous avez des solides bases en computer vision, apprentissage automatique et programmation Python ?
 Vous avez une expérience des frameworks IA (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.) ?
 Vous avez un intérêt pour les problématiques sur le transfert learning ?
 Vous avez des capacités d’analyse et de synthèse, autonomie et curiosité scientifique. 
 Vous avez des connaissances en traitement du signal - notion du traitement radar/imagerie SAR ?
 Vous faites preuve de curiosité et de motivation ?
 Vous avez de bonnes capacités à intégrer une équipe ?
 Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! 
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.
 Your Impact 
 Are you looking for a change of role and are wondering if a move into FPGA (Field-Programmable Gate Array) design might be for you? Leonardo provides a route to develop your existing skills in our on-site FPGA Academy, to allow you to become a full-time Senior FPGA / Firmware Engineer. You’ll then apply your talents to a range of cutting edge designs in our world class Radar and Advanced Targeting Systems (RATS) team.
 About the FPGA Academy 
 The FPGA Academy is a 16‑week structured training and development programme designed for engineers with transferable technical skill sets (such as electronic engineering, embedded software, or systems engineering) who wish to transition into FPGA / Firmware Engineering.
 The Academy provides focused technical training, mentored practical exercises, and hands‑on project work. On successful completion, engineers are deployed across a range of complex design projects, contributing to real systems alongside experienced FPGA and Electronics engineers.
 This programme is not intended for absolute beginners; it is aimed at capable engineers with strong fundamentals and proven problem‑solving ability who can quickly adapt and progress.
 About the Role 
 As an FPGA Academy Engineer, you will re-skill into a FPGA / Firmware engineering role and apply your existing engineering and coding experience to the design, implementation, and verification of complex electronic systems. You will learn how to translate requirements into robust FPGA-based solutions and work within established engineering processes suitable for high‑reliability and mission‑critical applications.
 What You’ll Do 
 During the Academy, and following deployment, you will:
 Undertake a structured 16‑week FPGA training programme combining:
 Practical labs 
 Mentored design exercises
 Online training material and self-led research
 Apply systems thinking to hardware design challenges
 Post training deployment into established engineering teams
 Once you have completed the Academy, as a FPGA / Firmware Engineer, you will be responsible for (with support appropriate to your development stage): 
 Hardware requirements, capture and management
 Concept development for complex functions and systems
 FPGA design, implementation, and analysis
 Applying verification techniques using VHDL or SystemVerilog, with exposure to UVM where applicable
 Production of material for design reviews
 Development of test planning, integration, and design verification activities
 Ensuring all firmware designs comply with the company firmware development process
 Working with FPGA technologies and tools from AMD, Altera, or Microchip
 What you’ll bring 
 A degree (BSc, BEng, MEng, MSc, PhD, EngD) in Electrical & Electronic Engineering (preferred) or a related science (e.g. Physics)
 Coding experience, such as: Embedded C / C++, Python / scripting languages, Low‑level or real‑time software, algorithmic or systems‑level programming
 Proven engineering problem‑solving experience, demonstrated through academic projects, industrial experience or personal / independent engineering work
 Strong digital engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly

An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

items.desc:
Teaching and Research Assistant (3 positions) 
 chevron_left 
 Übersicht 
 Teaching and Research Assistant (3 positions)
 40%, Zurich, fixed-term 
 print 
 Drucken 
 The Department of Architecture (D-ARCH) at ETH Zurich is among the world’s leading schools of architecture, known for its teaching as much as for its research. The Chair of Architectural Behaviorology, led by Prof. Momoyo Kaijima, is looking for new members to join its team. The following positions are open:
 Teaching Assistant, 40%, starting January 2027
 Research Assistant, 40%, starting January 2027
 Teaching Assistant, 40%, starting August 2027
 Project background
 Since 2017, the Chair of Architectural Behaviorology has been investigating architectural form through the lens of behaviors: the behavior of climate and materials, of humans and non-humans, and of architectural typologies. This approach aims to understand architecture within ecological networks, creating better accessibility to resources and finding shared commons. We see practice, research, and education as one integrated, cyclical activity in which theory and practice inform and shape one another.
 Because architecture is grounded in specific places, we explore its relationship to regional lifestyles, including urban, mountainous, and agricultural contexts. In doing so, we address gaps in architectural discourse, particularly the divide between areas of consumption and production.
 Our research projects include, for example, Swiss Window Journey , a study of window typologies across Switzerland, or Valley Section , a study of Swiss industrial heritage through territorial cross-sections. We also work on Housing, Shelter, and Care Behaviorology, which address domestic, post-disaster, and healthcare environments. Together with other ETH chairs, we have developed structural and spatial experiments rooted in Behaviorology.
 In teaching, the Chair leads a second-year Design Studio, where around 70 students are introduced to the methodologies of Architectural Behaviorology and Actor Network Theory, as tools both for designing architecture and for understanding our built, lived, and social environment. Students gain hands-on experience in designing and drawing architectural projects, doing research, working in teams, building 1:1 structures, and presenting and defending their ideas.
 You can find more information about the chair and the students’ work on our website .
 Job description
 As a teaching assistant (40%), you teach a combination of architectural design and research within the framework of Architectural Behaviorology. You understand students' ideas and help them develop their projects further. Your knowledge of structure, construction, and detailing lets you support them in these matters too, and your research-based thinking helps them find good, workable solutions to design problems. Studio days are Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Your tasks include:
 Preparation of materials and documents for the design studio
 Supporting the students in developing their projects
 Evaluating and grading student projects
 Holding short input lectures and workshops for the studio
 As a research assistant (40%), you conduct research within the framework of Architectural Behaviorology. You work across a broad range of ongoing research projects on Window Behaviorology, Urban-Rural Commons, Housing in Switzerland, Architecture for Care, and others. Among other tasks, you organize workshops and seminar weeks, help edit and publish books, and arrange exhibitions.
 Teaching and research assistant contracts are limited to one year, and can be renewed annually for up to 6 years.
 Profile
 You have
 A master’s degree in architecture
 Good knowledge of English and (Swiss) German: the design studios and research are mostly taught and led in English, while German is needed to work with local collaborators
 Solid knowledge of the Swiss architectural landscape, including construction, detailing, and the most common regulations
 A good understanding of architectural design practice, and of Swiss socio-economic, cultural, historical, and political context
 Residence in Switzerland, ideally in the Zurich area
 Ideally, you also have
 2-3 years of professional experience, including work on execution plans
 Knowledge of French or Italian

You will work in multi-disciplinary environments harnessing data to provide real-world impact for organizations globally.
 You will influence many of the recommendations our clients need to positively change their businesses and enhance performance.
 You will be responsible for working on complex and extremely varied data sets from some of the world’s largest organizations to solve real-world problems. You will develop high-quality data science products and solutions for clients as well as assets for our internal data teams, focusing on modeling. Additionally, you will present findings, recommendations, and provide consultation to stakeholders, both internal and clients.
 Throughout your tenure, you will learn to work across various industries and sectors, gaining insights into diverse business challenges, applications of data science and AI engineering. You will build large-scale data and analytics solutions, handling complex problems and advanced client situations. You will also learn best practices in data and analytics development, including framework, responsibility model, high-quality code, data security, sustainability, and scalability. Working in collaborative teams with diverse skill sets, you will foster effective teamwork and learn from colleagues in a multicultural and creative environment. Staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in generative and agentic AI, data science tools, techniques, and technologies, as well as participating in first-class learning programs, will be a key part of your development. You will also develop strong client-facing skills, including effective communication, problem-solving, and presentation abilities.
 You will work with other data scientists, data and software engineers, designers, project managers, and business subject matter experts on interdisciplinary projects across various industry sectors to enable business ambitions with data and analytics.
 While we advocate for using the right tools for the right task, we also take into account the client’s current landscape and preferences. Often, we use Python, PySpark, Databricks, SQL, Docker, and Kubernetes. We work on a regular basis with cloud service providers such as AWS, GCP, and Azure.
 Master's degree in math, statistics, economics/econometrics, machine learning, data science, physics, computer science or engineering required
 Up to 2 years of professional hands-on experience in applying advanced data science methods and implementing technical data solutions (e.g. developing machine learning models), to solve business problems
 A strong grasp of various analytics landscape, including business intelligence, machine learning, AI, and generative AI, and how to apply them effectively in different scenarios
 Proficiency in Python, SQL (focus on data & analytics applications)
 Professional experience in cloud-based analytical tools from market-leading providers such as AWS, MS Azure, Google Cloud
 Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities

„Heritage Creates Future“ – diesem Leitgedanken verpflichtet, verantwortet die Mercedes-Benz Heritage GmbH
als 100%iges Tochterunternehmen der Mercedes-Benz Group AG mit verschiedenen Divisionen die gesamte
Bandbreite historischer Themen der Marke mit dem Stern.
Das Mercedes-Benz Museum in Stuttgart stellt als eines der bekanntesten und beliebtesten Automobilmuseen der
Welt die faszinierende Geschichte des Automobils seit dessen Erfindung im Jahr 1886 umfassend dar und macht
die Historie der Marke auf einzigartige Weise für ein breites Publikum erlebbar. Weitere für die Marke relevante
historische Stätten sind unter anderem die Gottlieb-Daimler-Gedächtnisstätte in Stuttgart-Bad Cannstatt, das
Geburtshaus von Gottlieb Daimler in Schorndorf und das Carl-Benz-Haus in Ladenburg.
Das Mercedes-Benz Classic Center in Fellbach dient als Kompetenzzentrum für Klassiker mit dem Stern. Neben
einem exklusiven Fahrzeughandel bieten die Expertinnen und Experten Serviceleistungen und Restaurierungen für
klassische Mercedes-Benz Fahrzeuge an und sind erste Ansprechpartner für Original-Teile.
Mit dem Zugang zu originalen Fahrzeugunterlagen in den Archiven, welche umfangreiche Zeugnisse der Geschichte
des Unternehmens und der Marke dokumentieren, bewahren und pflegen, verfügt die Mercedes-Benz Heritage
GmbH über eine weltweit einmalige und einzigartige Wissensbasis.
Diese Wissensbasis nutzt die Mercedes-Benz Heritage GmbH im Rahmen ihrer Verantwortung für das weltweite
Mercedes-Benz Classic Ersatzteilgeschäft, um Klassiker der Marke mit Original-Teilen nach ursprünglichen
Herstellerspezifikationen zu versorgen und diese so nachhaltig in authentischem Zustand zu erhalten.
Um die besondere Geschichte von Mercedes-Benz erlebbar zu machen, nimmt die Mercedes-Benz Heritage GmbH
an einer Vielzahl renommierter historischer Automobilveranstaltungen und Fachmessen in der ganzen Welt teil.
Dafür stehen Klassiker aus der über 1.000 Fahrzeuge umfassenden Sammlung zur Verfügung. Neben der
Kommunikation der Markenhistorie steht dort auch der Austausch mit den anerkannten Mercedes-Benz
Markenclubs und der Classic-Community im Mittelpunkt.
Werden auch Sie als Museumsguide/Gästebetreuer (w/m/d) im Team Besucherservice Teil von Mercedes-Benz
Heritage.

items.desc:
Juro | AI Engineer (Agentic team) | London, UK | REMOTE (UK) | Full-time | £115k + equity
Juro is an AI contract automation platform used by in-house legal and business teams. Our Agentic team builds Operator, the agent that works across contracts inside Juro: it answers questions and takes action on legal data. You'd build the tools that let it act across the product, own parts of the agent harness (planning, tool use, context) and put evals around what you ship, together with our QA team.
Stack: TypeScript/Node.js, MongoDB, pgvector, AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM, Mastra, some React. Engineers pick their own AI tooling (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor...) and we pay for the usage.
We're looking for programmers first who now build with LLMs, and who have shipped something people use. Years of ML matter less to us than what you've built. We apply models, we don't train them.
Process: 30-min intro call, interview with the hiring manager, a build review where you walk us through something you've built, and a short chat with our CTO. We reply to every applicant.
You'll work from the UK. For exceptional candidates we can sponsor a UK Skilled Worker visa, whether you're relocating or already in the UK. If you need sponsorship, say so in your application.
Apply: https://juro.notion.site/aie

items.desc: At RoboRana, we help organisations put AI to work in their everyday processes. As an AI Business Analyst & Coach, you turn business needs into practical solutions and help people build their own. You enjoy analysing a process, making an idea tangible and teaching others how to use the tools themselves. Your biggest contribution is helping teams become more capable and independent. What you'll do Process & Business Analysis Explore processes with domain experts, uncover bottlenecks and identify where AI or automation can make a useful difference. Translate business needs into clear requirements and priorities, with a shared view of what success looks like. Use AI to support your analysis and solution design, checking its output against the process and the facts. Prototyping & Building Build prototypes, straightforward agents, workflows or applications with tools such as Copilot Studio and Power Apps. Test ideas with users, gather feedback and improve the solution before committing to a larger implementation. Recognise when complexity, integration or security calls for a developer, and work with technical colleagues on the next steps. ‍ Coaching & Enablement Run practical workshops and coaching sessions that help domain experts and business users apply AI to their own work. Guide people through their first applications, from choosing a useful problem to building, testing and improving their solution. Help teams work independently within agreed governance and security boundaries, using examples and guidance they can reuse. ‍ Who you are Experience in business analysis, process improvement or automation projects, with strong analytical skills and a structured way of working. Able to connect business needs to workable solutions and explain your reasoning to both users and technical colleagues. Experience with, or a strong interest in, using AI agents to support analysis and building. You are willing to experiment and critically assess the results. A practical mindset: you enjoy making ideas tangible and learning through user feedback. You get energy from helping others become more confident and independent, and can turn a complex topic into an accessible explanation. Comfortable facilitating discussions and coaching users in Dutch and English. Nice to have Experience building with Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate or similar tools. Experience delivering training, coaching business users or supporting AI adoption. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude or other AI assistants, and with governance for solutions built by business users. What we’ll offer Challenging projects across industries, always with impact. A strong & open team culture where learning, trying, and helping each other are essential. Continuous learning through certifications, training, and knowledge sharing. Early responsibility, paired with trust and support so you can truly make a difference. 32 holidays per year (20 + 12 ADV). A hybrid working environment with flexibility built in. A competitive package including salary, company car, the right tools and attractive benefits on top of that. Zero fluff and sharp focus, where your skills directly shape our solutions.

items.desc: 02-11-2026 Brussels AI Engineer Functie Voor een organisatie binnen de publieke sector zoeken we een ervaren AI Engineer die AI-oplossingen bouwt, test en beheert. Je ontwikkelt de technische componenten die artificiële intelligentie bruikbaar maken in concrete toepassingen: van agents en retrievaloplossingen tot modelintegraties, pipelines, observability en herbruikbare platformcomponenten. Je ondersteunt teams bij het ontwikkelen en implementeren van betrouwbare, veilige en onderhoudbare AI-oplossingen. Verantwoordelijkheden Implementeren van AI-services, agents, retrievaloplossingen en API-integraties. Bouwen van herbruikbare componenten voor modeltoegang, prompting, contextbeheer, evaluatie, logging, kostenopvolging en foutafhandeling. Opzetten van geautomatiseerde test- en evaluatiesets voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, performantie en kosten. Toepassen van CI/CD- en MLOps/LLMOps-praktijken voor versiebeheer, deployment, configuratie, monitoring en rollback. Technisch ondersteunen van sandboxomgevingen en proofs of concept. Productieklaar maken van AI-oplossingen volgens de geldende architectuur-, security- en governancevoorwaarden. Ondersteunen van data- en platformteams bij privacyveilige testdata, datastromen en integraties met bestaande systemen. Onderhouden van technische documentatie, runbooks en voorbeelden, zodat andere teams oplossingen kunnen hergebruiken. Analyseren van operationele problemen en doorvoeren van verbeteringen op basis van logs, evaluaties, feedback en gebruiksgegevens. Technische competenties 5 tot 8 jaar ervaring als software engineer, platform engineer, ML engineer of in een vergelijkbare hands-on functie. Sterke programmeervaardigheden, bij voorkeur in Python en Java . Ervaring met API’s, authenticatie, containers en geautomatiseerd testen. Praktische kennis van LLM’s, embeddings, retrieval, agents, model-API’s en evaluatiemethoden . Ervaring met CI/CD, Git, infrastructure as code, observability en cloud- of containerplatformen . Aandacht voor security, privacy, documentatie en operationele betrouwbaarheid. Kennis van de publieke sector, G-Cloud of openbare instellingen van sociale zekerheid is een troef. Persoonlijke competenties Innovatie: je volgt ontwikkelingen in AI en experimenteert met nieuwe technologieën. Probleemoplossend vermogen: je analyseert complexe vraagstukken en vertaalt ze naar pragmatische oplossingen. Samenwerken: je werkt vlot samen met collega’s uit IT, business, security en architectuur. Communicatie: je legt technische concepten helder uit aan technische en niet-technische stakeholders. Adviseren: je structureert en visualiseert informatie, formuleert onderbouwde adviezen en begeleidt multidisciplinaire besluitvorming. Resultaatgerichtheid: je bewaakt deadlines en zorgt voor kwalitatieve opleveringen. Kandidatuur en selectie Voeg bij je kandidatuur een document van maximaal twee pagina’s waarin je jouw visie toelicht op hoe een publieke dienstverlenende organisatie AI kan inzetten om concrete meerwaarde te creëren voor haar dienstverlening en interne werking. Leg daarbij de nadruk op: De technologische uitwerking van de voorgestelde toepassingen. Jouw bijdrage als AI Engineer aan het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van bruikbare AI-oplossingen. Na analyse van de cv’s wordt een shortlist van drie tot vijf kandidaten opgesteld op basis van de vastgelegde selectiecriteria. De geselecteerde kandidaten worden uitgenodigd voor een interview waarin hun technische competenties, persoonlijke competenties en talenkennis worden beoordeeld. Op basis daarvan wordt een eindrangschikking opgesteld.

items.desc: Stage BAC+5 - Data Science - F/H/D Localisation: Marcy l'Etoile, France Type de Contrat: Stage Fonction: Bioscience R&D Acteur mondial dans le domaine du diagnostic in vitro depuis plus de 60 ans, bioMérieux offre des solutions de diagnostic qui déterminent l’origine d’une maladie ou d’une contamination pour améliorer la santé des patients et assurer la sécurité des consommateurs. Rejoindre bioMérieux, c’est choisir une société familiale et humaniste, portée par une vision long terme, au service de la santé publique dans le monde. Chaque stagiaire ou alternant est accompagné par un tuteur expérimenté et formé. Il ou elle bénéficie d’un suivi et d’une évaluation l’aidant à progresser et à se préparer à la vie professionnelle. Acteur mondial dans le domaine du diagnostic in vitro depuis plus de 60 ans, bioMérieux offre des solutions de diagnostic qui déterminent l’origine d’une maladie ou d’une contamination pour améliorer la santé des patients et assurer la sécurité des consommateurs. Rejoindre bioMérieux, c’est choisir une société familiale et humaniste, portée par une vision long terme, au service de la santé publique dans le monde. Chaque stagiaire ou alternant est accompagné par un tuteur expérimenté et formé. Il ou elle bénéficie d’un suivi et d’une évaluation l’aidant à progresser et à se préparer à la vie professionnelle. Quelle est votre mission chez bioMérieux ? Au sein du département Data Science, dans le domaine de l’Intelligence Artificielle (AI) appliquée à la maintenance préventive du système, vous contribuerez au développement d’une solution innovante de surveillance en temps réelle de la fonction des systèmes VIDAS. L’objectif sera de détecter automatiquement les comportements anormaux et de reconnaître les patterns récurrents dans les signaux afin de mieux caractériser le fonctionnement des équipements. Plus précisément, vos missions seront de : Analyser et prétraiter les données temporelles issues des pompes VIDAS®, puis identifier les signaux, événements et patterns pertinents pour la surveillance de leur fonctionnement. Configurer et développer des approches de détection d’anomalies et de reconnaissance de patterns adaptées aux séries temporelles, en s’appuyant sur des méthodes de machine learning/deep learning dans des contextes d’apprentissage supervisé ou non supervisé. Mettre en place un pipeline d’analyse en temps réel sur Databricks, évaluer sa robustesse sur différents scénarios de fonctionnement et proposer des outils de visualisation des résultats. Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe polyvalente et pluridisciplinaire composée de data scientistes et d’ingénieurs. Mots-clés : Time series, Machine Learning, Anomaly Detection, Pattern Recognition Qui êtes-vous ? Vous suivez une formation de niveau BAC+5 avec une spécialisation en mathématiques appliquées ou en informatique. Vous avez des connaissances solides en machine learning, deep learning, et traitement du signal. Vous avez une bonne maîtrise de la programmation en Python, ainsi que des outils de développement tels que VS Code, Git. Vous êtes curieux(se), aimez découvrir de nouveaux outils méthodologiques et êtes capable de comprendre les articles scientifiques. Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, êtes force de proposition et avez un sens de la communication. Votre niveau d'anglais vous permet de communiquer à l'écrit et à l'oral, au quotidien. Une expérience en détection d’anomalies, en analyse de séries temporelles et en utilisation de Databricks serait appréciée. Ce stage sera effectué sur le site de BioMérieux à Marcy L’Etoile Date de démarrage : possibilité à partir de février 2027 Durée du stage : 6 mois La gratification mensuelle pour un stagiaire est attribuée dès un mois de présence. Le montant de la gratification dépend du niveau de formation de l’étudiant et est supérieure au minimum légal. Les + : Restaurant d’entreprise avec participation de l’employeur. Remboursement de 100 % de l’abonnement de transports en commun ou indemnité de transport. Conciergerie sur les sites de Craponne, Marcy et La Balme. bioMérieux s'engage à éviter toute discrimination et à traiter tous les candidats de manière équitable sans distinction d'origine, de sexe, d'âge, de caractéristiques physiques, d'origine sociale, de handicap, d'appartenance syndicale, de religion, de situation familiale, de grossesse, d'orientation sexuelle, d'identité de genre, d'expression de genre ou de tout autre critère illégal selon la loi applicable. items.desc: Vos en Setz Kerstpakketten en Relatiegeschenken B.V. Je komt te werken bij de specialist op het gebied van relatiegeschenken, kerstpakketten en keuzegeschenken. Vanuit Drachten bedienen we zakelijke klanten via een groep eigen webshops, waaronder Budgetgift.nl, RelatiegeschenkenXL.nl, PennenshopXL.nl, GulleGever.nl, KerstpakkettenXL.nl en Tezet.nl. We benaderen zaken met noordelijke nuchterheid en zijn daar best trots op. Hard werken voor hetzelfde doel, en op gezette momenten samen ontspannen. De functie Al onze webshops draaien op ons eigen platform, gebouwd in PHP. Als developer werk je samen met onze Lead Developer en het development-team aan het doorontwikkelen van dat platform: nieuwe functionaliteit, optimalisatie van de shops en koppelingen met leveranciers en andere systemen. Daarnaast speel je een hoofdrol in hoe wij AI inzetten. We automatiseren stap voor stap het werk van offerte tot order: van digitale drukproef en offerte tot bestelling bij de leverancier. Daarvoor bouw je onder meer: AI-toepassingen en agents die met onze eigen systemen praten (via API's en MCP), bijvoorbeeld een sales-agent die accountmanagers ondersteunt; koppelingen tussen ons platform en LLM's zoals Claude of OpenAI; slimme automatisering van terugkerende handelingen in orderverwerking, studio en administratie. Het uitgangspunt: de mens beslist, AI ondersteunt. Prijzen en berekeningen blijven altijd in betrouwbare, controleerbare code. Zo krijgen onze accountmanagers meer tijd voor hun klanten. Wat vragen wij Minimaal mbo werk- en denkniveau, of aantoonbaar vergelijkbare ervaring; Een aantal jaar werkervaring met PHP en MySQL (ervaring met Laravel is een pre); Goede kennis van HTML, CSS en JavaScript; Aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van AI-toepassingen: werken met LLM-API's, prompt engineering, tool use/agents of MCP; Ervaring met REST-API's en het koppelen van systemen; Je denkt mee over processen en ziet zelf kansen om werk slimmer te maken; Pragmatisch, zelfstandig, resultaatgericht en met humor; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift. Wat bieden wij Een vaste baan voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een salaris van €4.000 tot €5.500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring; Veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng: je bouwt mee aan de AI-aanpak van een hele groep webshops; Werkplek in Drachten, met de mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken; Budget en tijd voor cursussen en trainingen om bij te blijven in een snel veranderend vakgebied; Een informeel, nuchter team waar je snel resultaat ziet van je werk. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Solliciteer dan direct. Meer informatie over ons vind je op www.vosensetz.nl. items.desc: Description Le Bureau des Talents est spécialisé dans la chasse, l'accompagnement et le coaching des talents pour les startups, les scale-ups et les entreprises à impact. À PROPOS DE L'ENTREPRISE Notre client est une entreprise technologique B2B qui développe des solutions logicielles destinées aux professionnels. Dans un contexte de développement en France et à l'international, l'entreprise souhaite accélérer son acquisition, renforcer sa visibilité et structurer ses actions marketing. Vous rejoindrez une structure à taille humaine, où les idées peuvent rapidement se transformer en actions concrètes. L'environnement favorise l'autonomie, l'expérimentation et l'utilisation des nouvelles technologies pour gagner en efficacité. LE POSTE Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable Marketing B2B capable de prendre en main des sujets variés, de proposer des initiatives et de les concrétiser rapidement. Votre objectif : développer la visibilité de l'entreprise, générer des leads qualifiés et contribuer directement à sa croissance grâce à des actions marketing mesurables. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle marketing, de la définition des priorités à l'exécution des campagnes, en passant par la création de contenus et l'analyse des résultats. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales, produit et techniques, ainsi qu'avec la direction opérationnelle. L'IA fera partie de votre quotidien pour accélérer la production, automatiser certaines tâches et améliorer l'efficacité de vos actions. Poste VOS MISSIONS 1. DÉVELOPPER L'ACQUISITION B2B Concevoir et déployer des campagnes marketing multicanales : emailing, LinkedIn, webinars, contenus et publicité digitale. Identifier les leviers les plus pertinents pour toucher les bonnes audiences et générer de nouvelles opportunités. Tester différentes approches, analyser les résultats et optimiser les campagnes en continu. Construire un plan marketing pragmatique, adapté aux objectifs et aux ressources disponibles. 2. GÉNÉRER DES LEADS QUALIFIÉS Mettre en place des actions pour attirer et convertir des prospects B2B. Travailler avec les équipes commerciales pour comprendre leurs besoins et améliorer la qualité des leads transmis. Concevoir des supports et contenus facilitant la compréhension de l'offre et le travail des commerciaux. Suivre les performances des actions menées et identifier les leviers d'amélioration. 3. RENFORCER LA VISIBILITÉ ET LA PRÉSENCE DE MARQUE Animer les canaux de communication de l'entreprise, notamment le site web et LinkedIn. Créer des contenus pertinents : newsletters, publications, articles et cas clients. Valoriser les nouveautés de l'offre en collaboration avec les équipes produit et techniques. Développer une communication cohérente avec le positionnement et les objectifs de l'entreprise. 4. DÉVELOPPER LE MARKETING PARTENAIRES Concevoir des actions de co-marketing avec les partenaires de l'entreprise. Créer des contenus et campagnes permettant de toucher de nouvelles audiences. Organiser des webinars et participer à la préparation d'événements professionnels en France et à l'international. Contribuer à renforcer la visibilité de l'entreprise auprès de son écosystème professionnel. 5. INTÉGRER L'IA DANS LES PRATIQUES MARKETING Utiliser des outils d'IA générative pour accélérer la création de contenus, la veille et l'analyse. Identifier les tâches pouvant être automatisées pour gagner en efficacité. Expérimenter de nouveaux usages et évaluer leur intérêt concret pour l'activité marketing. Maintenir un regard critique sur les contenus produits et garantir leur pertinence. 6. PILOTER LES ACTIONS ET LES PRIORITÉS Proposer un plan d'action marketing et des budgets adaptés aux objectifs. Prioriser les initiatives en fonction de leur impact potentiel et des ressources disponibles. Coordonner leur mise en oeuvre après validation, en lien avec les équipes internes. Mesurer les résultats et ajuster les actions en fonction des enseignements tirés. Profil LE PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Nous recherchons avant tout une personne capable de passer rapidement de l'idée à l'action, avec une approche pragmatique du marketing B2B. LES INDISPENSABLES Une expérience en marketing B2B : vous avez déjà conçu et déployé des actions marketing destinées à une clientèle professionnelle. Les réalisations concrètes comptent davantage que l'intitulé de vos précédents postes. Une maîtrise des leviers d'acquisition : vous connaissez les principaux canaux du marketing digital et savez construire des campagnes adaptées à vos objectifs. Un anglais bilingue : vous êtes capable de communiquer avec aisance à l'oral comme à l'écrit dans un contexte professionnel international. items.desc: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. items.desc: Published: 02/11/2026 Deadline: 20/11/2026 Envisaged Job Starting Date: December 2026 A Laboratory Technician position is available in the Radiochemistry and Nuclear Imaging Group at CIC biomaGUNE, located in the Gipuzkoa Technology Park in San Sebastián. The appointed person will provide technical and scientific support to research activities involving radiolabelled compounds and nanomaterials, bioanalytical sample processing, and quantitative multimodal imaging. The candidate will join a multidisciplinary research environment working at the interface of chemistry, radiochemistry and biomedical imaging. The position will involve participation in the preparation and evaluation of PET-labelled materials for preclinical imaging studies, together with the analysis of biological samples and imaging datasets. The activities to be carried out at CIC biomaGUNE will include: Participation in radiolabelling and radiosynthesis procedures, with particular emphasis on particles and other materials labelled with positron-emitting radionuclides for PET imaging studies. Support in the preparation, purification and quality control of radiolabelled compounds and materials using chromatographic and analytical techniques. Processing and analysis of tissue and biological fluid samples, including extraction procedures and chromatographic/mass-spectrometric analysis (HPLC-MS). Processing, analysis and quantitative evaluation of PET/CT images generated in preclinical studies. Participation, when required, in the analysis and co-registration of complementary imaging modalities, including MRI and optical imaging. Support in data organisation, documentation of experimental procedures and preparation of results for research projects and scientific reports. The candidate will receive specific training in radiochemistry, handling of radioactive materials, bioanalytical methods and image analysis until reaching the level of knowledge and autonomy required for the comprehensive development of the position. Required Education Level: MSc in Chemistry or a closely related discipline. Required Skills/Qualifications: Required Skills/Qualifications: Background in synthetic and/or analytical chemistry. Good laboratory skills and ability to follow experimental protocols accurately. Good communication skills in English and Spanish. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team. Interest in radiochemistry, molecular imaging and biomedical research. Less than 3 years since obtaining the qualification giving access to the training contract, in accordance with the applicable regulations. Desirable Skills/Experience: MSc or postgraduate training in synthetic, medicinal, industrial or related chemistry. Practical experience in organic synthesis and compound characterisation, gained through academic training, a Master’s thesis, internships or research projects Previous exposure to radiochemistry, radiotracer preparation or PET imaging. Familiarity Experience with chromatographic techniques (HPLC) and/or mass spectrometry. • Previous experience in a research environment through academic projects, internships or similar training activities, and familiarity with scientific data analysis. Duration: Full time. Training contract for obtaining professional practice (1 year). Project Funding: Bladdebots II-Radiobots - CPP2024-011448 - (Spanish Research Agency - AEI) Equal opportunities Policy: CIC biomaGUNE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to: age, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other classification protected by European, national, or local law. Open Transparent and Merit Based Recruitment Policy: You can check CIC biomaGUNE OTM-R Policy. How To Apply: Submit your application with a motivation letter stating why you are interested in this position, your CV, the contact details of two academics who can provide a reference using the "Apply to this Job Offer" button. CIC biomaGUNE, located in the Science and Technology Park of Gipuzkoa (Donostia-San Sebastián), is a leading research center in the area of bionanomaterials, synthetic bioengineering and molecular imaging and counts with more than 180 people from 33 countries. The activity of CIC biomaGUNE is conducted by a team of 12 international and dynamic research groups, supported by flexible and efficient management teams and a unique research infrastructure including the Molecular Imaging Facility, one of the biggest preclinical imaging research infrastructures in Europe. CIC biomaGUNE maintains a vibrant weekly scientific seminar program by visiting leading scientists. Additional training in soft skills and technologies covered by the CIC biomaGUNE technical platforms is offered to researchers within the in-house training program. items.desc: Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset. Description of the workplace Mathematical Physics is a common division between the Natural Science and Engineering (LTH) faculties and is part of the Department of Physics. Research is conducted primarily in the field of quantum mechanical many particle physics, which includes theoretical nuclear structure physics, nanometer physics, quantum information, atomic theory and material modelling, with numerous partnerships both internationally and within Lund University. Work duties You will conduct theoretical research on ultrafast quantum entanglement of light and matter. You will be responsible for developing both analytical models and numerical implementations, as well as analyzing the generated data. You will be expected to publish the scientific results obtained and present them at international conferences. You will also be expected to assist with the day-to-day supervision within the research group. Description of the work duties: To support the research group and participate in research within the relevant subject area. To supervise students working on degree projects/theses. To assist with applications for external research funding. Qualifications Appointment to a position as a researcher requires that the applicant has a PhD. Required qualifications : PhD within the subject of the position. Very good oral and written proficiency in English. Experience with theoretical models and computational codes in atomic physics. Ability to work independently. Strong collaboration skills. Additional requirements: Knowledge of quantum entanglement between light and matter is considered an advantage. Knowledge of time-dependent quantum mechanics is considered an advantage. Advanced programming skills and experience with computational codes in atomic physics. We offer Lund University is a public authority which means that employees get particular benefits, generous annual leave and an advantageous occupational pension scheme. Read more on the University website about being a Lund University employee. Further information The position is a fixed term position for 2027-01-01-2027-12-31 at 100% of full time. Researchers are covered by a local collective agreement on annual working hours for researchers and assistant researchers. The planning of annual working hours is done in dialogue between the manager and the employee. How to apply Applications are to be submitted via the University’s recruitment system. The application should include a CV and a personal letter justifying your interest in the position and how it matches your qualifications. The application should also include a degree certificate or equivalent and any other document to which you would like to draw attention (copies of grade transcripts, details of referees, letters of recommendation, etc.)” We welcome your application! We create space for brilliant research and inspire creative advancements in technology, architecture and design. We have nearly 12,000 students. Every year, our researchers – many of whom work in world-leading profile areas – publish around 100 theses and 2 000 scientific findings. In addition, a number of research results and degree projects are transformed into innovations. Together we explore and create – to benefit the world. items.desc: We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced Consultant Gastroenterologist with a specialist interest in Clinical Nutrition to establish our Nutrition Support Team (NST) within a leading tertiary cancer centre. This substantive part-time post (5 PAs) offers a unique opportunity to focus exclusively on nutrition support, with no general gastroenterology, endoscopy, or on-call commitments. Based within the Nutrition and Dietetics Department, the successful applicant will work in close partnership with the Head of Nutrition and Dietetics and the Complex Artificial Nutrition Support Dietitian to provide clinical leadership for patients with complex nutritional needs, including cancer-related intestinal failure, malnutrition, enteral feeding, and parenteral nutrition. Working within a highly skilled multidisciplinary team, you will collaborate closely with dietitians, specialist nurses, pharmacists, oncologists, palliative care teams, and surgeons to deliver high-quality, patient-centred care. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and develop a specialist nutrition support service within a world-renowned cancer centre while contributing to education, research, service development, and quality improvement. The role offers a predictable job plan and excellent work-life balance, making it ideal for consultants seeking a specialist leadership role in clinical nutrition The postholder will provide specialist gastroenterology expertise to the Nutrition Support Team, supporting patients with complex nutritional needs requiring parenteral nutrition, and complex enteral feeding and including those with cancer-related intestinal failure and advanced gastrointestinal complications. Working alongside the Head of Nutrition and Dietetics and the Complex Artificial Nutrition Support Dietitian, the successful candidate will lead Nutrition Support Team ward rounds, outpatient clinics, and multidisciplinary discussions, ensuring safe, effective, and evidence-based nutritional care. They will provide expert advice to clinical teams across the Trust, support decision-making regarding home parenteral nutrition, and contribute to complex discussions around artificial nutrition, including palliative and end-of-life care. The role includes developing and enhancing the Nutrition Support Service, promoting best practice in line with national guidance, leading audit and quality improvement initiatives, supporting research activity, and delivering education and training to medical, nursing, pharmacy, and dietetic colleagues. We are looking for a collaborative consultant with expertise in clinical nutrition, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to multidisciplinary working and patient-centred care The postholder will contribute to the delivery of high‑quality consultant‑led care across 7 days. This includes participation in planned weekend and weekday clinical activity to support safe, timely decision‑making and continuity of care for patients. The Christie is one of Europe’s leading cancer centres, treating over 60,000 patients a year. We are based in Manchester and serve a population of 3.2 million across Greater Manchester & Cheshire, but as a national specialist around 15% patients are referred to us from other parts of the country. We provide radiotherapy through one of the largest radiotherapy departments in the world; chemotherapy on site and through 14 other hospitals; highly specialist surgery for complex and rare cancer; and a wide range of support and diagnostic services. We are also an international leader in research, with world first breakthroughs for over 100 years. We run one of the largest early clinical trial units in Europe with over 300 trials every year. Cancer research in Manchester, most of which is undertaken on the Christie site, has been officially ranked the best in the UK. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES The appointee will be based at The Christie and will provide senior input to wards and an outpatient clinic. Clinical Provide specialist gastroenterology and nutrition input for inpatients and outpatients requiring complex nutrition support, including cancer-related intestinal failure, complex enteral feeding, and parenteral nutrition. Provide specialist input into the assessment and management of patients requiring artificial nutrition support, including parenteral nutrition (PN) and complex enteral feeding. Undertaking outpatient clinics (OPC) for patients on home parenteral nutrition, ensuring continuity of care and prevention of avoidable admissions. As an AI & Algorithms Engineerring Intern, you'll have the opportunity to get involved with a range of diverse projects working and supported by a talented team of experts and mentors. There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. What you'll be doing Working alongside our engineers building intelligent systems, developing your skills through hands-on coding and training/testing models. Supporting projects for our clients to solve real-world problems Learning software development skills in mixed-discipline teams, attending stand-ups and contributing to planning sessions. Communicating the results of your work to your colleagues and clients. We combine our research output with engineering rigour to create innovative and robust solutions to solve complex problems presented to us by our clients. We help clients across a diverse range of markets, including defence/security, healthcare, biotech, industrial and energy, so there is no shortage of variety. At the heart of what we do are talented and motivated multi-disciplinary teams empowered to create cutting edge technologies and systems to solve difficult problems for our clients. We offer a diverse, fun, and challenging work environment where you'll have the chance to work on a wide variety of projects that deliver real value using technology. We recognise and celebrate individual talent and we understand the importance of letting individuals be just that. Our people are here to do the best work of their lives and our job is to provide the platform for them to do it. L’activité Parfums Beauté affirme sa singularité à travers une promesse : révéler la beauté de chaque personne dans ce qui la rend unique. La Recherche et l’Innovation CHANEL Parfums Beauté sont au service de la Création. Dans un environnement scientifique pluridisciplinaire, les équipes développent des approches innovantes pour mieux comprendre les caractéristiques humaines et leur perception. Au sein de l’équipe de Recherche en Biostatistiques et Épidémiologie, vous contribuerez à explorer de nouvelles approches de data science, d’intelligence artificielle et de modélisation prédictive pour répondre à des problématiques de recherche. L’objectif sera de développer des méthodes robustes et interprétables permettant de mieux exploiter et comprendre des données complexes. MISSIONS Dans ce cadre, vos missions principales seront de : Contribuer au développement et à l’évaluation de méthodes de data science et de modélisation prédictive appliquées à des données issues de la recherche. Explorer et analyser différents types de données, notamment des données quantitatives et des images, afin d’identifier les informations pertinentes et les facteurs associés aux phénomènes étudiés. Développer, tester et comparer différentes approches statistiques et de machine learning/deep learning/IA Contribuer à l’interprétation des modèles, à l’évaluation de leur robustesse et à la compréhension des principaux facteurs influençant les prédictions. Participer à l’analyse, la visualisation et l’interprétation scientifique des résultats, en interaction avec les équipes de recherche. Une expérience en deep learning appliqué aux images, PyTorch ou TensorFlow, ainsi qu’en OpenCV sera fortement appréciée. Autonomie en programmation et capacité à construire, valider et interpréter un pipeline complet de modélisation d’images. R serait un plus pour les analyses statistiques complémentaires et la visualisation des résultats. Le projet porte sur des données et problématiques non publiques ; le respect strict de la confidentialité est indispensable. VIVEZ L’EXPÉRIENCE CHANEL ! Tout au long de votre expérience, vous serez immergé(e) dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et apprenant ; où la création et l’humain sont au cœur des préoccupations. Vous rejoignez une activité singulière, aux méthodes et procédés uniques - qu’ils soient créatifs, de développement ou d’industrialisation - et évoluez aux côtés d’une diversité d’experts aux savoir-faire reconnus.

items.desc: About the Company At WhiteSpace, we bring care back to critical decisions. Our AI-powered solutions don't replace human judgment - they elevate it. By combining advanced algorithms with deeply human interfaces, we turn complexity into clarity and confident action - always with fast time to value. Behind that is a team of 25+ consultants and engineers with the delivery discipline to take a client's problem all the way to something they use to make better, faster decisions. Our use cases span energy, manufacturing, logistics, and health. About the Role You are the person who turns a client's problem into a product they use. You build it end-to-end: user experience, frontend, backend, and algorithms. You do so using our shared platform, working as a pair with a consultant who owns the scope. You own the build: its design, its technical quality, and whether it actually works in the client's hands. Responsibilities Build the whole thing . Take an agreed scope to a working application across the stack: interface, frontend, backend services, data, and the algorithms underneath. Decide what to build, what to reuse, and what to leave out. Work agentically . Build, test, and document with agentic tooling as the default, and own everything it produces. Think in terms of our Platform . Build on our shared platform components rather than from scratch. When something you need is general, help put it into the platform so nobody builds it twice. Be the technical voice in the room . Hear requirements first-hand, explain your design choices, run technical sessions, and demo progress as you go. Give honest estimates . Size the work with your consultant and commit only to what has been sized. When the build won't meet the plan, say so early - and when something isn't ready to ship, say that too. Ship quality . Automated tests, reference cases, and evidence that the solution does what was agreed. It is done when it runs in the client's environment, and someone else can maintain it. Key interfaces Clients : You own the technical conversation: requirements, design choices, demos. Consultant : Your partner on every new build. Together you agree scope, estimate, and acceptance before anything is committed. The consultant leads the client conversation and the commercial commitments; you lead the technology. Innovation & Account Lead : You report here. Tech Lead and Platform developers : Platform standards, and specialist depth (optimisation, performance, security) when a build needs it. Competences & Experience Experience : Evidence that you have built complex end-to-end products and made them work - at a job, in your thesis, or on your own. Recent MSc graduates welcome. Breadth over specialism : Comfortable across frontend, backend, data, and deployment, with enough optimisation and algorithms to implement them and judge whether the results make sense. Our Tech team brings specialist depth; your job is to bring breadth. Product and UX judgement : You build interfaces people love to use and make decisions with. Engineering discipline : Testing, versioning, CI, so what you build survives beyond its builder. Care about the problem : Enough curiosity about the client's world to notice when a correct answer is useless to them, and to talk it through with them directly. How you work : You would rather talk to the client than read a ticket about them. You chase quality and notice when something is off before the client does. Why this is worth doing Most engineering jobs are a slice: a service, a layer, a ticket from someone who spoke to someone who spoke to the client. This role is built the other way round. You hear the problem first-hand, you build the whole thing, and you see it used. The measure is simple: the client uses what you built, and asks for the next thing. If you would rather ship the whole thing than a part of it, this is a seat designed around that. Terms & Conditions This is a staff position, based in The Netherlands. We offer a hybrid work environment and trust you can balance remote & office work. Fluent English required; willingness to travel as client engagements require. Starting salary €58,800 + 8% holiday allowance + 4% pension contribution. The first year is a step-up year: we expect you to grow into the full role, which brings the base salary to €79,800 + 8% holiday allowance + 4% pension contribution. We have an annual profit-sharing scheme dependent on company performance, individual delivery, and alignment with company values. We also intend to offer equity participation as part of our commitment to sharing in the company's future success.

items.desc: Mews Labs est une filiale de Mews Partners\ **spécialisée dans la résolution de problèmes complexes issus de l’industrie* dans les domaines de l’optimisation, de la modélisation, de la simulation physique et de la science des données. L’allocation de stock est une décision stratégique et quotidienne qui consiste à répartir des stocks limités entre différents sites, à partir de prévisions de demande incertaines, tout en arbitrant entre risques de rupture et de surstock. Face à une demande non stationnaire et à des réseaux multi-échelons complexes, les approches classiques montrent leurs limites. Les progrès de l’intelligence artificielle et de la recherche opérationnelle ouvrent ainsi de nouvelles perspectives pour concevoir des politiques d’allocation plus performantes et robustes. \\*Mews Partners est un cabinet de conseil en management indépendant de plus de 250 Consultant.e.s. Spécialisé dans la conduite de projets de stratégie opérationnelle auprès de clients phares de l’industrie, le cabinet est en croissance régulière depuis sa création en 1992.** L’objectif du stage est de concevoir et d’évaluer des méthodes d’allocation de stock sous incertitude de la demande, en explorant l’apport de l’intelligence artificielle par rapport aux approches classiques de recherche opérationnelle. Programme de travail : Revue bibliographique ciblée à l’intersection recherche opérationnelle / apprentissage automatique Modélisation d’un ou plusieurs cas d’étude et choix des jeux de données (benchmarks ouverts type OR-Gym, et/ou données industrielles) Implémentation et expérimentation de plusieurs approches dans un framework adapté Évaluation comparative : qualité des décisions (coût, taux de service), robustesse à l’incertitude, passage à l’échelle et temps de calcul Compétences mises en jeu : Recherche opérationnelle et optimisation sous incertitude Apprentissage par renforcement et deep learning Programmation scientifique (Python, bibliothèques IA/optimisation : PyTorch, OR-Tools,…) Analyse et évaluation comparative d’algorithmes Notre futur talent : Prépare une dernière année de Master ou d’École d’ingénieurs (Bac +5) en mathématiques appliquées, intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle ou domaine connexe Connaît les principaux outils de programmation (Python, bibliothèques IA/optimisation : PyTorch, OR-Tools...) A des connaissances en optimisation, probabilités et intelligence artificielle A un intérêt pour les applications concrètes à la supply chain Sait travailler de manière autonome et proposer des solutions innovantes Modalités du stage Le stage se déroulera sur une durée de 6 mois dans les locaux de Mews Labs à Cachan (94230). Possibilité de valorisation des résultats (rapport technique, démonstrateur logiciel, communication scientifique). Ce stage pourra être suivi d’une proposition d’embauche au sein de Mews Labs. Si vous êtes prêt.e à relever des défis stimulants et à développer vos compétences au sein d’une équipe de passionnés, nous vous attendons avec impatience ! Rejoindre Mews Labs c’est : Contribuer à des projets de R&D et d’innovation à forte valeur ajoutée, au croisement des enjeux scientifiques, technologiques et industriels. Travailler sur des sujets techniques de pointe, au sein d’équipes expertes et pluridisciplinaires, Evoluer dans un environnement reconnu pour sa bienveillance (certifié Platinum par ChooseMyCompany, le plus haut niveau de reconnaissance attribué par le label) S’investir activement dans la vie interne et le développement du cabinet - notamment atour de nos engagements RSE (Diversité & Inclusion, Handicap, Mécénat de compétences, Solidarité, Achats responsables, etc), Partager ensemble des moments forts, grâce à des sorties et activités fréquentes. Mews Partners s’engage pour la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes nos offres d’emploi sont ainsi également ouvertes aux travailleurs en situation de handicap. items.desc: Electricity flows with us. On behalf of Switzerland and in cooperation with international partners, we do our utmost every day to develop the best solutions for the Swiss electricity grid. For our headquarters in Aarau, we are looking for a motivated team member to join us as soon as possible, preferably in December or January Intern Software & AI Engineering (80-100%) - 1667 Participate in the power supply in Switzerland Since May 2025, Swissgrid’s Balancing Energy Autopilot has been live, autonomously securing the stability of the Swiss power grid through high-performance, cost-efficient energy procurement. As the first European transmission system operator to run such a system, we’ve moved past the proof-of-concept phase – we are now in the business of continuous high-performance optimization. Your time is split equally between hands-on product engineering and building the AI harness to elevate both our delivery speed and code quality. Optimization of the Autopilot Performance (50%) You work on the heart of Swissgrid: Machine Learning models and optimization problems that power our autopilot. Your task isn’t just maintaining but pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in live operation. Your work has massive impact: we move fast, iterate quickly within short cycles, and deploy features that have a million-euro impact on the Swiss energy system. You blend Data Science, ML, and Software Engineering to ensure the autopilot remains efficient and reliable. Agentic AI & Next-Gen Engineering (50%) Evolving the Software Lifecycle: Build and improve our closed-loop agentic architectures that take engineering challenges from high-level specifications to verified solutions. Bridging Upstream & Downstream: Drive implementations that sharpen requirements upfront, paired with early prototypes of self-healing loops that detect and resolve operational friction across delivery pipelines. This Is How You Make The Difference We are seeking a "Builder" who is creative enough to experiment and disciplined enough to deliver production-grade results. Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI, or a related field. Tech Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and Software Engineering is a must. A solid foundation in Machine Learning is an advantage. Mindset: You love the speed of "vibe coding" and rapid prototyping, but you understand that in critical infrastructure, the final details must be rock solid. AI Passion: You are an AI enthusiast who keeps up with the latest trends and is eager to share that knowledge to enable others. Impact-Driven: You want to see your work directly affecting the stability of a whole country’s power supply. Above all, we value curiosity and a growth mindset. If you’re ready to tackle complex challenges in an interdisciplinary and fun environment, we want to hear from you! What We Offer A comprehensive look behind the scenes of the electricity industry and an understanding of its challenges, as well as in-depth insights into the development of the grid of the future Varied and exciting tasks within a company unique to Switzerland. Flexible working hours as part of a motivated team 25–30 days of holiday, as well as company holiday between Christmas and New Year A state-of-the-art work environment in the immediate vicinity of Aarau railway station

items.desc: Professor Olli Kallioniemi’s lab at the University of Helsinki is currently seeking a Data Scientist or Biomolecular Scientist for Data and AI-Driven Molecular Medicine research program Location: Helsinki, Finland Unit: Helsinki Institute of Life Science Sub-unit: Institute for Molecular Medicine Finland (FIMM) Research group: Precision Systems Medicine, Professor Olli Kallioniemi Are you interested about exploring the possibilities of generative AI and AI agents in biomedical research? Do you enjoy exploring complex biological data, developing new computational approaches, or building software and data systems that enable scientific discovery? We are looking for a Data Scientist or Biomolecular Scientist to join the interdisciplinary research environment led by Professor Olli Kallioniemi at FIMM, University of Helsinki. The position is funded through a Data- and AI-Driven Molecular Medicine (DAIMM) project grant. Our research focuses on developing new ways of using generative AI, AI agents and data-driven approaches to explore biology. Cancer and precision medicine, including prostate cancer, are important application areas, while the methods and technologies developed are intended to be broadly applicable across biomedical research. We welcome applicants with an MSc, MSc (Eng) or PhD in biology, molecular medicine, bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, data science, software engineering or a related field. For candidates with a life science background , we are looking for a strong understanding of biology, molecular medicine or a related biomedical discipline, combined with significant experience in computational analysis of biological or biomedical data. Programming skills, for example in Python or R, are an advantage but are not required. Previous experience with single-cell or spatial omics data analysis, multi-omics data integration, genomics, cancer biology, precision medicine, machine learning or generative AI is an advantage. For candidates with a data science or computer science background , we are looking for strong programming skills, particularly in Python or related languages. Experience with data engineering, databases, data pipelines and integrating heterogeneous datasets is expected. Experience with biological or health-related data is an advantage. All applicants should have an interest in generative AI, AI agents and emerging AI technologies, as well as excellent communication skills in English. We do not expect candidates to have expertise in all areas. Scientific curiosity, computational ability and enthusiasm for developing new AI-driven approaches to biomedical research are particularly important. Key Responsibilities Depending on the candidate's background, responsibilities may include: Develop and apply AI-driven and computational approaches for analyzing large-scale biological, molecular and clinical datasets. Explore the use of generative AI, large language models, and AI agents. Develop data infrastructure, databases, software tools, APIs, and computational pipelines. Collaborate with biological, computational, and clinical researchers to connect computational approaches and findings with experimental and medical research. What We Offer An opportunity to work at the interface of artificial intelligence, biological discovery and precision medicine. A collaborative and supportive interdisciplinary research environment bringing together expertise in biology, medicine, computational research and data science. The opportunity to explore and develop emerging AI technologies, including generative AI and AI agents, for scientific discovery. A chance to contribute to the development of new computational tools, workflows and AI-enabled research environments in life science. An international research environment at FIMM and the University of Helsinki, with opportunities for scientific collaboration and professional development. The salary will be based on the salary system of the the Finnish universities. The position will initially be filled until the end of 2028. A six-month trial period will be applied. To apply, please submit your application, including your CV and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience, through the University of Helsinki electronic recruitment system by clicking on Apply for job. Internal applicants (i.e., current employees of the University of Helsinki) please submit your applications through the SAP HR portal. Applications are welcome as soon as possible - the call will be open until 30 November 2026 , and may be extended until the hiring decision is made. For further information please contact coordinator Erika Romppanen (erika.romppanen@helsinki.fi). A diverse and equitable study and work culture is important to us. That is why we do our best to promote an inclusive university community. We encourage all qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply for our positions.
