items.desc: Mews Labs est une filiale de Mews Partners\ **spécialisée dans la résolution de problèmes complexes issus de l’industrie* dans les domaines de l’optimisation, de la modélisation, de la simulation physique et de la science des données. La prévision de séries temporelles est omniprésente dans l’industrie : prévision des ventes et de la demande , de la consommation d’énergie, ou encore suivi d’actifs industriels. La qualité de ces prévisions conditionne directement des décisions à fort enjeu , en particulier la gestion et l’allocation des stocks . Le domaine connaît une transformation profonde. Après les architectures profondes spécialisées ( Transformers, modèles linéaires/MLP ), une nouvelle génération de modèles de fondation , pré-entraînés sur de vastes corpus, permet de prévoir des séries inédites en zero-shot ou few-shot . Au-delà de la précision du point de prévision, l’enjeu se déplace vers la quantification calibrée de l’incertitude , indispensable pour piloter des décisions sous risque. Mews Labs développe le package Python PASTS , dédié à l’analyse et à la prévision de séries temporelles. Le stage visera à enrichir cet outil et à évaluer, sur des cas industriels, l’apport des approches les plus récentes ; il s’articule naturellement avec les problématiques d’ allocation de stock traitées dans le cadre de nos projets, la prévision alimentant la décision. \\*Mews Partners est un cabinet de conseil en management indépendant de plus de 250 Consultant.e.s. Spécialisé dans la conduite de projets de stratégie opérationnelle auprès de clients phares de l’industrie, le cabinet est en croissance régulière depuis sa création en 1992.** L’objectif du stage est de dresser un panorama et une évaluation rigoureuse des approches modernes de prévision de séries temporelles, en visant une contribution au package PASTS et une application à la prévision de la demande en supply chain. Le sujet est volontairement ouvert : le/la stagiaire explorera et comparera plusieurs familles d’approches. Programme de travail : Revue bibliographique de l’état de l’art Sélection de cas d’étude et de jeux de données (benchmarks ouverts type GIFT-Eval, Monash, et/ou données industrielles Mews Labs) Implémentation, comparaison honnête avec des baselines classiques (ARIMA/ETS), et intégration des méthodes retenues dans PASTS Évaluation : précision, calibration des intervalles, robustesse à la non-stationnarité, coût de calcul Compétences mises en jeu : Séries temporelles, probabilités et statistiques Deep learning et modèles de fondation Programmation scientifique (Python, PyTorch, bibliothèques de prévision : Nixtla, GluonTS, Darts...) Analyse de données et évaluation comparative Notre futur talent : Prépare une dernière année de Master ou d’Ecole d’ingénieurs (Bac +5) en mathématiques appliquées, probabilités & statistiques ou domaine connexe Dispose de compétences en programmation (Python, Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow) Possède une connaissance des séries temporelles et du machine learning Sait travailler de manière autonome et à proposer des solutions innovantes Modalités du stage Le stage se déroulera sur une durée de 6 mois dans les locaux de Mews Labs à Cachan (94230). Possibilité de valorisation des résultats (rapport technique, démonstrateur logiciel, communication scientifique). Ce stage pourra être suivi d’une proposition d’embauche au sein de Mews Labs. Si vous êtes prêt.e à relever des défis stimulants et à développer vos compétences au sein d’une équipe de passionnés, nous vous attendons avec impatience ! Rejoindre Mews Labs c’est : Contribuer à des projets de R&D et d’innovation à forte valeur ajoutée, au croisement des enjeux scientifiques, technologiques et industriels. Travailler sur des sujets techniques de pointe, au sein d’équipes expertes et pluridisciplinaires, Evoluer dans un environnement reconnu pour sa bienveillance (certifié Platinum par ChooseMyCompany, le plus haut niveau de reconnaissance attribué par le label) S’investir activement dans la vie interne et le développement du cabinet - notamment atour de nos engagements RSE (Diversité & Inclusion, Handicap, Mécénat de compétences, Solidarité, Achats responsables, etc), Partager ensemble des moments forts, grâce à des sorties et activités fréquentes. items.desc: Join the Crew Alle reden von KI. Wir liefern. Copilot, AI Agents, Automatisierung, Transformation. Klingt spannend? Finden wir auch. Die Nordic AI Solutions GmbH (NAIS) unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, Künstliche Intelligenz erfolgreich in ihre Prozesse, Teams und Geschäftsmodelle zu integrieren. Gemeinsam schaffen wir die Grundlage für moderne, KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen – von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Lösung. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Technologie nicht nur spannend finden, sondern aktiv mitgestalten möchten. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden konkrete Use Cases und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Lösungen. Du bewertest die technische Umsetzbarkeit von KI-Lösungen. Du begleitest Kundenprojekte von der ersten Idee über Proof of Concepts bis hin zum produktiven Rollout moderner KI-Anwendungen. Du erkennst, welche Kundenlösungen das Potenzial zu einem skalierbaren Produkt oder Service haben. Du planst Sprints und Releases gemeinsam mit dem Entwicklungsteam und hältst den Überblick über laufende Projekte. Du beobachtest den KI-Markt und bringst neue Möglichkeiten in die Produktentwicklung ein. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Du begeisterst dich für Künstliche Intelligenz und möchtest gemeinsam mit uns Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg zu einer zukunftsfähigen, KI-gestützten Organisation begleiten. Idealerweise hast du bereits mindestens 2–3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine Programmiersprache sicher (z. B. Python, C#, Java, JavaScript oder TypeScript). Welche Sprache du mitbringst, ist für uns zweitrangig – entscheidend ist dein Verständnis für gute Softwareentwicklung. Du legst Wert auf sauberen, wartbaren und skalierbaren Code und bist mit grundlegenden Prinzipien und Konzepten wie Clean Code, SOLID, DRY, KISS und Separation of Concerns vertraut. Du hast Erfahrung mit modernen Entwicklungspraktiken wie Git, Code Reviews, automatisierten Tests sowie der strukturierten Entwicklung und Integration von APIs. Du bist kommunikativ und teamorientiert. Wenn du bereits erste Erfahrung in der Rolle als Product Owner gemacht hast oder eine Zertifizierung wie PSPO oder CSPO hast, ist das ein Plus. Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und bringst idealerweise auch gute Englischkenntnisse mit. Wir bieten Dir Uns: Wir verbinden technologische Neugier mit pragmatischer Umsetzung. Dabei setzen wir auf Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und eine offene Kultur, in der neue Ideen nicht nur willkommen sondern erwünscht sind. Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Kundenprojekte rund um KI, Automatisierung und moderne Arbeitsweisen. Dabei bewegst du dich in einem innovativen Umfeld und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie Unternehmen die Möglichkeiten von KI für sich nutzen können. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Die KI-Welt entwickelt sich rasant und du dich mit ihr. Mit Weiterbildungen, Zertifizierungen und einem jährlichen Weiterbildungsbudget unterstützen wir deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung. Dich erwarten Benefits wie das Deutschlandticket, eine monatlich aufgeladene Bonuskarte, Fahrradleasing, Corporate Benefits, regelmäßige Team-Events und weitere Extras für deinen Arbeitsalltag. items.desc: Chez Kiiro , nous accompagnons nos clients, de la scale-up aux grands comptes, dans la conception et l'industrialisation de leurs produits IA & data. En tant qu' AI Engineer, vous construisez les systèmes qui orchestrent leurs modèles et résolvent leurs problèmes métiers. En pratique, comptez environ 90 % de temps projet client (conception, build, industrialisation) et 10 % de contribution interne (partenariats, montée en compétence des équipes). Vous ne serez pas seul·e : rejoignez une équipe Data habituée au travail à distance, et vous vous appuyez sur nos partenariats Databricks et AWS. Ce poste est ouvert aux profils ayant un background mixte en développement logiciel, Data Engineering ou Machine Learning, justifiant d'environ 1 an d'expérience concrète sur des architectures IA. Vos missions : Cadrer avec le client : vous êtes en première ligne pour comprendre le besoin et poser les bonnes questions. Concevoir & déployer sur le cloud : vous designez, développez et déployez des architectures cloud modernes (principalement AWS) et des services backend scalables au service des produits d'IA. Construire des systèmes agentiques : vous développez des agents, des systèmes RAG et des pipelines sur des données non structurées (documents, Speech-to-Text), principalement sur AWS et Databricks. Mettre en prod : CI/CD, conteneurs, infra as code, observabilité. Vous travaillez la latence, le coût des tokens et la tenue en charge. Évaluer & fiabiliser : vous mettez en place les évaluations et les garde-fous qui permettent de savoir si le système répond juste. Rester en veille & évangéliser : l'écosystème bouge très rapidement. Vous partagez ce qui mérite vraiment d'être adopté, en interne comme chez le client 🦸‍♂️ Côté interne : Partenariats : vous soutenez nos partenariats Databricks & AWS sur le volet technique. Diffusion de la culture Data & IA : webinars, événements en présentiel co-animés avec nos partenaires, publication d'articles. L'environnement technique : Langages : Python, SQL Cloud & Serverless : AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, Bedrock, Secrets Manager, KMS), Databricks. Bases de données & stockage : PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra. IA, Data & outillage : Python, SQL, architectures RAG, frameworks d'orchestration d'agents, Speech-to-Text, dbt, Fivetran, Airbyte. Pratiques : MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, conteneurisation. Nous ne cherchons pas un profil parfait ! L'IA évolue trop vite pour ça. Ce qui nous intéresse, c'est quelqu'un qui a déjà mis un système d'IA en production, qui l'a vu casser, et qui sait pourquoi. Ce qui compte pour nous : Vous avez au moins 3 ans en développement logiciel , Data Engineering ou ML, en produit ou en ESN. Vous êtes hands-on : solide expérience en Python et SQL. Vous avez construit et mis en production au moins un système d’IA générative : RAG, orchestration d'agents (Agentcore, Agent Bricks etc), usage d'APIs LLM, traitement de données non structurées. Vous avez une connaissance pratique des services Cloud AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager, KMS, Bedrock). Vous venez de GCP ou d’Azure, les réflexes se transfèrent. Vous avez de bonnes pratiques software & DevOps : de bonnes bases en industrialisation applicative (CI/CD, conteneurisation Docker, versioning, tests automatisés). Français professionnel obligatoire et anglais technique . Vous avez une posture conseil : Communication et force de proposition : vous êtes en capacité d'interagir efficacement avec les équipes de développement et les différentes parties prenantes. Autonomie et gestion des priorités , en équipe comme en solo. Les petits + qui font plaisir : Une expérience sur Databricks . Des certifications AWS ou Databricks Ce poste n'est probablement PAS pour vous si… Vous n’avez jamais écrit de code qui tourne en production : votre parcours en ESN s’est fait côté pilotage ou coordination. Vous êtes plus à l’aise avec le POC qu’avec la production et tout ce qu’elle implique (monitoring, évals, incidents). Vous préférez recevoir des specs toutes faites plutôt qu’aller cadrer le besoin chez le client. Ce que nous vous proposons : 🤑 Rémunération : 40 à 60K€. 💪 Développement des compétences : formations certifiantes AWS et Databricks prises en charge, accompagnement individualisé, budget conférences. 🏡 Rythme : hybride, télétravail fréquent et horaires flexibles. 🚀 Une aventure à construire : vous n'arrivez pas dans une case figée. Votre expérience, votre savoir-être et votre ambition participeront activement au développement de votre rôle. Une trajectoire qui se construit avec celle de l'entreprise. Si vous avez envie de laisser votre empreinte plutôt que d'appliquer un cadre existant, vous allez vous plaire ici 🫶 Premier échange RH, en visio (45 min) avec Chloé : faire connaissance, comprendre votre parcours et ce que vous avez déjà réalisé, et vous partager la vision de Kiiro. Entretien technique / manager (1h) : échange plus approfondi autour du rôle, de votre expérience et de votre manière d’aborder à la fois …

Advanced Python skills, incl. pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, scipy, statsmodels for modelling and analytics. items.desc: Chez MPdata, nous sommes une équipe passionnée d’experts en données, spécialisée dans l’acquisition, le traitement et la valorisation des données pour nos clients industriels. Depuis 2015, nous mettons notre savoir-faire technique et notre engagement au service de missions et de projets pour les grands groupes. Notre approche repose sur les valeurs d’Excellence, de Partage et d’Engagement. Suite à la forte croissance de MPdata et une forte demande de nos clients dans les Hauts-de-France, nous avons lancé une nouvelle agence à Lille. Nous recherchons un(e) Data Scientist pour rejoindre notre équipe lilloise. En tant que Data Scientist , vous serez responsable de concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions d’analyse de données avancées permettant de soutenir les décisions stratégiques de l’entreprise. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’industrialisation des modèles et l’accompagnement des équipes métiers. Vos missions : Analyser, structurer et valoriser des jeux de données internes et externes. Développer des modèles de machine learning (prédiction, scoring, segmentation, NLP, LLM, RAG, Computer vision, etc.). Concevoir des pipelines de traitement de données robustes et automatisés. Travailler sur la mise en production des modèles dans un environnement scalable et industrialisé. Créer des APIs pour exposer les modèles (FastAPI, Flask). Assurer le suivi post-déploiement : monitoring, versioning, réentraînement, performance. Collaborer avec les Data Engineers, DevOps et Product Owners pour garantir la cohérence de bout en bout. Ingénieur d’une grande école (Centrale, Mines, Supaero, Supelec, …), vous avez des connaissances en modélisation et machine learning (deep learning, random forest, svm…) acquises lors de vos expériences passées. Vous avez de bonnes connaissances en Python (ou R) pour coder ces algorithmes. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre autonomie, votre excellent relationnel et votre capacité à être force de proposition. Solide maîtrise de Python et des librairies ML (Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow ou PyTorch). Expérience en mise en production de modèles ML (APIs, CI/CD, containerisation). Bonne connaissance des bases de données (SQL, NoSQL) et des outils de data pipeline (Airflow, Spark, etc.). Compétences en MLOps : versioning de modèles, monitoring, déploiement cloud (AWS, GCP, ou Azure). Aisance dans l’analyse métier et la vulgarisation des résultats. Goût pour l’optimisation, la performance et la qualité logicielle 1 - Prise de Contact (15min par téléphone) 2 - Entretien avec un Ingénieur d’affaires (45 min) 3 - Test technique 4 - Entretien Technique (1h) 5 - Visite des locaux à Marcq-en-Baroeul et/ou du DataLab à Boulogne-Billancourt

items.desc: Company Description foyard.ai is an AI-native platform for corporate travel management, built in Zagreb. We connect airline distribution (GDS, direct NDC links with major carriers, low-cost aggregators), rail and bus, hotels and car rental behind one decision layer: a deterministic multi-criteria ranking model and a network of autonomous agents that handle disruptions, rebooking, EU261 claims and duty of care. The platform is live and processing real bookings, and we are now taking it into a large European retail group as our first enterprise customer. We are a small, senior team: what you build ships to a real customer in weeks, and the work sits at the intersection of airline distribution, AI agents and EU regulation (AI Act, CSRD, accessibility). Role Description This is a full-time, fully remote role (EU) with monthly team days in Zagreb. You will own the AI layer of the platform: the ranking model that decides which travel option is best for a given employee under a given policy, and the seven post-sales agents that act on a booking after it is made – disruption monitoring, rebooking, cross-modal coordination, ancillary lifecycle, EU261 claims, duty of care and BSP reconciliation. The architecture separates a probabilistic AI layer from a deterministic execution layer, and every decision must be explainable and reproducible. Day to day you will: Recalibrate the ranking model (value of time by employee grade, CO₂ price, channel risk, policy penalties) on the enterprise customer’s real profiles and travel data Configure, test and harden agent workflows against the customer’s disruption scenarios and policy thresholds Extend and maintain the tool layer through which LLM agents use the platform (currently 23 tools in five categories, exposed via a standard agent-tool protocol) Build evaluation pipelines, guardrails and the audit trail required for an auditable AI system under the EU AI Act Manage LLM cost, latency and model choice across providers; decide where a model belongs and where a rule belongs Work with the backend and corporate-modules engineers so that agent actions execute through the same transactional layer as human bookings Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering or a related field (required) 4+ years in ML/AI engineering, including at least 18 months building production LLM applications: tool use / function calling, retrieval, multi-agent orchestration Strong Python; experience with evaluation frameworks, prompt and version management, observability for LLM systems Clear understanding of where probabilistic models end and deterministic systems begin, and the discipline to keep them apart Experience shipping AI features that real users depend on, not only prototypes or notebooks Attention to security, data privacy (GDPR) and auditability Proactive communication and ownership in a remote team; professional working proficiency in English Nice to have Agent-tool protocols (MCP or similar), BDI or planning architectures Optimisation or operations-research background; multi-criteria decision models Experience with regulated, safety-critical or audited AI systems Any exposure to travel, logistics or payments How to apply Send your CV and a short note on a production LLM or agent system you have built, what it did, how you evaluated it, and what went wrong, to contact@bnbwelcome.com, with “AI/ML Engineer” in the subject line. First interview with the CEO, technical interview with the CTO and Head of AI. items.desc: About This Role Cilium Tetragon is a flexible, Kubernetes-aware security tool, with real-time observability and enforcement. Leveraging the power of eBPF, Tetragon offers a low-overhead, in kernel solution that enhances security posture by monitoring system behaviors such as process executions, system call activities, and both network and file access events. Tetragon Threat Detection Engineers primarily focus on creating and maintaining Tetragon runtime security policies, based on the latest threat intelligence, vulnerability disclosures, and their own research. Policies can act either as a mitigation to known vulnerabilities or as monitoring and protection against unknown security issues. What You’ll Do Develop and maintain Tetragon runtime security policies to ensure customers have good visibility of suspicious activity on their infrastructure and are protected against the latest emerging threats Help design frameworks and architectures that allow customers to easily consume policies and understand their overall security posture Monitor vulnerability disclosures (CVEs) and the latest threat intelligence to develop Tetragon runtime security policies Work with software engineers at Isovalent and Cisco to improve and enhance the capabilities of Tetragon security policies Interact with solution architects and customers as necessary to support and deploy Tetragon security policies in production Publish content and give talks based on your work Minimum Qualifications 3+ years of experience in threat and/or vulnerability research 3+ years of experience in developing security detections at scale, for use in a wide range of environments 3+ years of experience working on Linux system security (e.g., capabilities, LSMs, etc.) Good communication skills, both written and verbal Preferred Qualifications Experience with eBPF (extended Berkeley Packet Filter) and its applications in security. Experience with the cloud-native ecosystem (containers, Kubernetes, etc.) and their Linux implementation (e.g., Linux cgroups, namespaces) Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

items.desc: Wil je uitgroeien tot een AI engineer die slimme oplossingen bouwt met Large Language Models (LLMs), computer vision of de optimalisatie van bedrijfsprocessen? En wil je dat doen in een enthousiast team dat jou daarbij de ruimte en begeleiding geeft? Dan zoeken wij jou voor ons kantoor in Arnhem. Je bent nieuwsgierig, pakt graag zelf iets op en vindt het fijn om samen met collega's te leren. Over Datacation Datacation is de data- en AI-partner waar inhoud, kwaliteit en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Met ongeveer 60 collega's helpen we organisaties om data structureel in te zetten voor betere besluitvorming, van strategie en architectuur tot implementatie en adoptie. We werken vanuit Amsterdam en Eindhoven en bouwen nu ons nieuwe kantoor in Arnhem op. Ons werk begint vaak klein en concreet, met een quick scan, een AI Readiness Scan of een workshop. Daarna bouwen we door aan oplossingen binnen onze drie AI-domeinen: taal (LLMs, chatbots en tekstanalyse), beeld (computer vision, bijvoorbeeld voor inspecties en kwaliteitscontroles) en optimalisatie en forecasting. Onze klanten komen uit uiteenlopende sectoren, van zorg en landbouw tot financiële dienstverlening, sport en luchtvaart. Veel van onze mensen zijn engineer en consultant tegelijk. We zitten dicht op de klant, steken zelf de handen uit de mouwen en blijven betrokken van idee tot implementatie. Daarbij kiezen we pragmatisch voor wat werkt, en schakelen we snel. Jouw rol Als junior AI engineer help je onze klanten het potentieel van hun data te benutten door AI-toepassingen te bouwen die echt gebruikt worden. Je werkt samen met ervaren collega's, die je op weg helpen en met je meedenken. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Meedenken over hoe je een businessvraag vertaalt naar een concrete AI-oplossing. AI-applicaties ontwikkelen, van prototype tot werkende oplossing. Schrijven van goed geteste, leesbare code, waarbij we samen leren en best practices toepassen. Bijdragen aan betrouwbare softwarearchitecturen en datapijplijnen, zodat modellen stabiel draaien. Samenwerken met onze experts en met de klant, en je keuzes en resultaten delen met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's. Leren hoe je AI-oplossingen in productie brengt, monitort en verbetert. Wat vragen we van jou? Je hoeft niet alle onderstaande punten af te vinken. Herken je jezelf in een groot deel van dit profiel? Dan willen we je graag leren kennen. Een afgeronde opleiding of aantoonbare ervaring in een richting zoals Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science of een verwant vakgebied. Goede kennis van Python, bijvoorbeeld opgedaan tijdens je studie, stage, afstudeerproject of eigen projecten, en een eerste basis in SQL. Kennis van AI-technieken in minstens één van onze drie AI-domeinen. Je kunt een technisch verhaal uitleggen aan collega's en klanten, en je denkt mee met de klant door vragen te stellen. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift. Handig om te hebben, maar zeker niet verplicht: ervaring met cloudplatformen zoals Azure, AWS of Databricks, en met frameworks en tools zoals LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV of optimalisatiesolvers. Wat mag je van ons verwachten? Begeleiding om te groeien tot een AI engineer die ook als consultant met klanten meedenkt, met ervaren collega's als mentor en sparringpartner. Afwisselende projecten waarin je klanten direct helpt en kennismaakt met veel verschillende sectoren in de samenleving. Een warme werkomgeving in een gedreven, groeiend team op ons kantoor in Arnhem. Ruimte voor opleidingen, certificeringen en experimenteren met nieuwe technologieën. Je werkt ook samen met collega’s uit Amsterdam en Eindhoven en leert zo van de expertise van heel Datacation. Verschillende teamuitjes per jaar, met als hoogtepunt de jaarlijkse gezamenlijke wintersport. Solliciteren Solliciteer zeker als je zin hebt om langs te komen, ook als je niet aan alle eisen voldoet. Wil je eerst meer horen? Mail naar m.vanvreeswijk@datacation.nl voor een koffie of een belletje met een toekomstige collega.

items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? coEnergy est une startup deeptech parisienne bénéficiant du statut Jeune Entreprise Innovante et soutenue par l'ADEME. Nous mesurons in situ la performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments (isolation, inertie) en combinant simulation thermique dynamique et intelligence artificielle. Notre technologie a notamment servi lors de la rénovation du bâtiment historique de Mines Paris (projet Grand Quartz). 🎯 La mission À partir de mesures de température et de puissance de chauffe réalisées dans un bâtiment réel, nous cherchons à retrouver ses caractéristiques thermiques. Le stage combine : de la simulation numérique de bâtiments des modèles de machine learning sur séries temporelles des méthodes d'optimisation pour concevoir les meilleurs protocoles de mesure de l'industrialisation de modèles (Git, DVC, pratiques MLOps) et du développement backend ✅ Pour qui ? Étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs ou de master (Bac+5), en stage de fin d'études ou en césure. Indispensable Python scientifique (NumPy, Pandas, PyTorch) et rigueur pour écrire un code propre et maintenable Mathématiques : algèbre linéaire, statistiques, calcul différentiel, méthodes numériques Machine Learning : bases solides, idéalement sur les séries temporelles, réseaux récurrents (RNN, GRU, LSTM) Optimisation bayésienne, méthodes inverses, différences finies ou éléments finis Curiosité, rigueur et envie d'aller sur le terrain lors de campagnes de mesure Un plus Thermodynamique et transferts thermiques Une première expérience avec un framework backend (FastAPI, Django) Un vrai goût pour la visualisation de données 📌 En pratique Durée de 6 mois, à partir de début 2027 Lieu : Paris 9e (rue de Clichy) , avec des déplacements ponctuels sur des sites de mesure Gratification : de 1400€ brut à 1900€, selon profile et expérience CV et quelques lignes sur votre motivation à michael.cohen@coenergy.fr, avec en objet « Stage ML thermique » 😊

Then, watch for a unique link in your email to apply. Reporting into the AI Transformation Office, the Associate, AI Enablement & Adoption is a highly approachable, people-centric guide dedicated to accelerating AI fluency across our corporate office. Operating as a hybrid between a hands-on coach and an adoption advocate, you will empower employees to confidently integrate enterprise AI tools — specifically Microsoft Copilot, Gemini and Claude — into their daily work. This role is important because you are the visible, go-to resource on the floor: providing on-demand support, lightweight training, and immediate troubleshooting so our teams can maximize their productivity securely, effectively, and without frustration. If you love helping people, are genuinely curious about generative AI, and can translate technical concepts into plain language for any audience, this is an excellent opportunity to shape how our organization works in the age of AI. You Will Be Responsible For On-Demand Coaching & Support Act as the visible, go-to AI resource in the office, approachable to employees at every level of comfort and skill. Provide 1:1 and small-group troubleshooting, prompt refinement, and immediate assistance for employees who are stuck or unsure how to get started with AI tools. Training & Enablement Develop and deliver lightweight micro-training and practical “how-to” resources that demonstrate effective, real-world ways to use AI for everyday tasks. Adoption Advocacy Monitor tool usage and recommend targeted actions to drive uptake across teams. Collect employee feedback, success stories, and use-case examples to inform and refine adoption tactics. Task-Level Integration Help individuals apply AI directly to the work in front of them — e.g., drafting emails, summarizing meetings, and generating ideas — without the need for large-scale, formal business process mapping. Responsible AI Guidance Educate employees on OMERS AI governance policies, ensuring data privacy, risk mitigation, and safe guardrails are followed during daily AI use. Required Skills & Experience Strong practical familiarity with generative AI tools — specifically Microsoft Copilot, Gemini and Claude — including prompt engineering basics and a clear understanding of their corporate capabilities and limitations. Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate technical AI concepts into accessible, actionable advice for non-technical employees. High degree of emotional intelligence and patience to guide employees with varying levels of comfort and skill with AI tools. Strong organization, problem-solving, and prioritization skills, with a demonstrated curiosity for understanding user needs and finding solutions. Preferred Skills & Experience University degree in Business, Computer Science, IT, or equivalent. 1–2 years of experience in a technology-driven role (e.g., corporate support, training, IT helpdesk, technology adoption, or related experience). Strong familiarity with the Microsoft Office Suite. Exposure to change management, employee enablement, or technology adoption programs in a corporate environment. As one of Canada’s largest defined benefit pension plans, our people-first culture is at its best when our workforce reflects the communities where we live and work — and the members we proudly serve. From hire to retire, we are an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process that extends all the way through your employee experience. This sense of belonging and connection is cultivated up, down and across our global organization thanks to our vast network of Employee Resource Groups with executive leader sponsorship, our Purpose@Work committee and employee recognition programs.

items.desc: FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential! The Opportunity FICO builds the analytics and decisioning technology behind some of the highest-stakes decisions in the world economy including the FICO Score, the standard measure of consumer credit risk in the US, and FICO Platform, an API-first applied intelligence platform delivering real-time decisions across fraud detection, credit risk, regulatory compliance, marketing, and customer engagement. This is mission-critical, low-latency, heavily regulated software where auditability and controlled change are non-negotiable. This role sits at the point where that technology is being built and operated in an agentic-first way. As coding agents take on an increasing share of the software lifecycle, the engineer's role shifts from hand-writing code to directing, specifying, and verifying the output of a fleet of specialised agents, working through a structured harness of guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that transforms raw model capability into production grade engineering. The successful candidate will bring the engineering judgement that agents cannot replicate: the ability to define what good looks like, encode it with sufficient precision for agents to achieve it, and recognise when they have not, applying that judgement to architecture, correctness, trade-off analysis, and the design of the work itself. What You’ll Contribute Collaborate with Product teams to translate early stage ideation into structured Proof of Concepts, establishing clear technical feasibility and scope. Produce detailed specifications and acceptance criteria that enable coding agents to generate correct, maintainable, and well-architected output, taking full ownership of the resulting code through to deployment. Apply rigorous quality standards to all agent generated output, ensuring it meets the same level of scrutiny as hand written code within a regulated decisioning context. Operate effectively within the agentic harness, utilising established guides, including AGENTS.md files, architectural rules, and reference documentation alongside automated sensors such as linters, fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers. Identify the root cause of recurring agent errors and work with the harness team to implement systemic controls, ensuring the same class of failure cannot recur across the codebase. Maintain the accuracy and currency of repository documentation, specifications, and contextual knowledge, treating these as a shared system of record for both human engineers and agents. Apply focused technical judgement to architecture decisions, edge case analysis, latency and integration risk, auditability requirements, and any determination that falls outside the appropriate scope of agent autonomy. What We’re Seeking Demonstrable experience in software engineering within large, complex codebases, with a strong foundation in software architecture, testing practices, and long-term maintainability. Practical experience working with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor with a clear understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use within a production engineering workflow. The technical judgement to critically evaluate agent generated output, identify subtle errors or architectural weaknesses, and make informed decisions about when to intervene in the agent workflow. The ability to communicate technical requirements with precision, producing specifications and definitions of done that are unambiguous, testable, and actionable by both agents and engineering colleagues. A disciplined approach to verification, instinctively questioning correctness, building appropriate checks and test coverage, and applying particular rigour in regulated and mission-critical delivery contexts. A results-oriented approach to delivery, with accountability for the quality and correctness of shipped work rather than volume of code produced. Familiarity with relevant technologies including Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, AWS or Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, ML model deployment, or real-time decisioning systems. Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, or agent orchestration in a team environment is a significant advantage, as is knowledge of regulated or audited software delivery processes and controlled change management. A background in decisioning, credit risk, fraud detection, analytics, optimisation, or data engineering would be advantageous; candidates who can also articulate a considered approach to human-AI collaboration including delegation boundaries, human oversight, and earning autonomy through demonstrated quality will be of particular interest. Our Offer to You An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, …

items.desc: Company Description Melanion Srl, a subsidiary of Melanion Capital, is building an AI-native concierge business in Rome. Our ambition is to create a fully agentic service that understands individual preferences, anticipates needs, and executes complex tasks across travel, dining, experiences, and everyday life. The principal will be the first user, providing direct feedback and real-world use cases before the service expands to selected clients. We combine the freedom of an early-stage venture with access to an established investment management firm and its professional network. Role Description We are looking for a hands-on technical builder to turn this ambition into a working product. This is a full-time founding role based in Rome, with flexibility for remote working. You will design and build agents that can move from understanding a request to researching options, coordinating providers, and completing tasks—with appropriate user approvals. The challenge extends beyond generating recommendations: the system must take action, handle exceptions, retain useful context, and earn users’ trust. Working directly with the principal, you will own the initial product and technical development. You will choose the stack, ship prototypes, test them against real requests, and develop a service that can support paying clients. Early work will include manually investigating workflows and resolving failures so that you can identify what to automate and how. As the business develops, you will help shape its commercial model, recruit a technical team, and grow into a broader technology and product leadership role. Responsibilities Build an end-to-end agentic concierge, from conversational interface to task execution. Connect agents to email, calendars, messaging, booking platforms, payments, and service providers through APIs and browser automation. Develop persistent preference profiles and contextual memory to personalise the service. Implement permissions, spending limits, approval flows, and audit trails for consequential actions. Build evaluations, monitoring, and recovery mechanisms so that workflows perform reliably in real-world conditions. Work directly with early users, translate feedback into product decisions, and ship improvements quickly. Own technical choices while managing latency, infrastructure costs, security, and maintainability. Help turn a working product into a scalable business with a clear customer proposition. Qualifications Strong software engineering skills and evidence of products, tools, or ambitious side projects you have built and shipped. Hands-on experience with LLMs, tool calling, agent workflows, APIs, and automation. Proficiency in Python or TypeScript, with the ability to build across backend systems, integrations, and a functional user interface. A practical understanding of where agents succeed, where they fail, and how to test their behaviour. Strong product judgment: you care about whether a task gets completed successfully and whether the experience is useful. Comfort with ambiguity, rapid experimentation, and taking responsibility from idea through deployment. Curiosity about new technology, paired with the judgment to choose simple solutions when they work. Professional English; Italian is an advantage. Experience with travel technology, payments, browser automation, or consumer products is welcome. Luxury hospitality experience is not required. What We Offer Ownership of a product from its earliest stage. Direct access to the founder and first users. The opportunity to build and lead a team as the venture grows. A Rome base with flexibility for remote working. To Apply Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, links to projects you have built, and a short explanation of how you would approach the first version of an agentic concierge. We are particularly interested in seeing something you made work outside a demo.

From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. items.desc: The Role A modelling residency puts you in the center of a frontier lab. You'll be embedded in real work: placed on key production and research projects and mentored directly by our modelling team. We're building our frontier innovation around efficiency, gradient-free exploration, real-time learning, and interface design. Responsibilities Innovation: Build the future of adaptive algorithms that continuously learn. Co-design algorithms that react in real-time to product signal and feedback, and explore new ways of capturing feedback that make those algorithms better Cross-Stack Optimization: Collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to drive system-wide efficiency gains Measure What Matters: We believe the ultimate signal of value is real-world impact. The smartest algorithm is one capable of interacting with the world — that's why product signal matters so much to how we work. Qualifications We value impact over credentials. Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to check every box - but you do need to be adaptable. A degree or equivalent research/engineering experience in a computer science field. Genuine interest in, and at least one project touching: model efficiency, synthetic data, interfaces, real-time alignment, or algorithmic optimization Systems thinking — the ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stack Strong Python skills and experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow) Familiarity with model optimization techniques such as RLHF and fine-tuning Strong communication and self-awareness — you know how to collaborate in a remote environment and you're open to feedback You care about technical excellence and last mile impact. We value impact more than effort, and about owning outcomes end to end. About Us Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn't adapt to the world. We think that's backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, personalized, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible - it's how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few. We believe in talent density: bringing together the best and most driven individuals to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We're looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

items.desc: Functieomschrijving Bouw mee aan de toekomst van EnergyZero Jij zorgt ervoor dat we continu exact weten hoe onzeker de toekomst is, van het volgende kwartier tot morgen einde dag: je levert de distributies van elektriciteitsprijzen, productie en consumptie waar onze trading algoritmes en de aansturing van thuisbatterijen, EV's en zonne-installaties op draaien. Slaat de monitoring aan op een haperende datafeed of op concept drift, dan kom je met de oorzaak en een oplossing, niet met een melding. Waarom dit anders is Dit is greenfield, en we zijn al hard onderweg. De infrastructuur is er, we hebben toegang tot alle relevante markten en onze forecasting draait in productie. Het doel is een optimale interactie met de elektriciteitsmarkt te realiseren voor onze klanten, inclusief de inzet van hun flexibiliteit, zodat er maximale waarde wordt gecreëerd voor de eindklant. Dat bouwen we vanaf de basis goed op, niet op wat er toevallig al stond. De scope is afgebakend. De logica van de virtual power plant bouwen we zelf. Jij levert de inputs waar die op draait. Ons platformteam levert de infrastructuur. De forecasting engine is van jou, van ruwe data tot model in productie. Wat ga je doen? Probabilistisch voorspellen. Prijzen, productie en consumptie, beoordeeld op kalibratie en scherpte. Een 90%-interval dat de uitkomst in 90% van de gevallen bevat, is jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Afhankelijkheden modelleren. Prijs en zon, verbruik en temperatuur, over kwartieren heen. De gezamenlijke structuur bepaalt of de optimalisatie erna iets waard is. Bronnen combineren. Weermodellen, satellietdata, assettelemetrie, P4- en P1-meterdata. Jij bepaalt welke input echt iets toevoegt en hoe je systematische afwijkingen corrigeert. Modellen in productie brengen en houden. Geautomatiseerde data- en modeltests, point-in-time evaluatie, monitoring die drift signaleert voordat de onbalansmarkt dat doet, en hertraining die meebeweegt met een portfolio dat snel verandert, zeker nu de saldering verdwijnt en het gedrag van ons portfolio snel verandert. Evalueren in de markt. Dagelijks met de Portfolio Manager (ingenieur en certified power trader) en de Quantitative Portfolio Analyst (econometrist en certified power trader) nagaan waar de onbalanskosten vandaan kwamen en wat de forecast miste. Wie ben jij? Je voelt het als een forecast ernaast zit, omdat je weet wat het kost. Je hebt gevoel voor trading: je denkt in risico en rendement, niet alleen in error metrics. Je steekt je kop boven het maaiveld uit en komt uit jezelf met verbeteringen, zonder te wachten tot iemand erom vraagt. Je staat stevig in je schoenen, geeft tegengas als iets beter kan, en komt met opties in plaats van alleen het probleem. Onder druk blijf je helder: als er iets stilvalt handel je direct, maar een modelwijziging gaat pas live als hij klopt. Vereisten Een kwantitatieve master of PhD en drie tot vijf jaar ervaring met forecasting modellen die je zelf in productie hebt gebracht en onderhouden. Diepgang in time series en probabilistisch voorspellen: quantile regression, conformal prediction, kalibratie, CRPS en andere proper scoring rules. Sterke Python skills (Pandas/Polars, scikit-learn, gradient boosting) en ervaring met MLOps: Docker, CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen en model monitoring. Nederlands op professioneel niveau. Sterke pre: ervaring met het modelleren van elektriciteitsprijzen, verbruik of opwek in een trading context, en ervaring met stochastische optimalisatie, copula's en scenariogeneratie. Je hoeft de solver niet te bouwen, maar weten hoe je forecasts erin landen maakt ze beter. Wat we je bieden Een dienstverband van 32–40 uur per week. Een salaris van €4,500–€6,500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring. Een prachtig kantoor op de Kop van Zuid in Rotterdam. Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken. Een gezamenlijke uitgebreide lunch (collega's koken graag voor elkaar!). Gezellige borrels en een goed gevulde koelkast met (speciaal)bier, frisdrank en andere alcoholvrije opties. Budget om je thuiswerkplek in te richten. Telefoon-, internet- en thuiswerkvergoeding. Jaarlijks opleidingsbudget én een vrij besteedbaar budget voor trainingen, boeken of well-being. 26 vakantiedagen per jaar. 8% vakantiegeld (maandelijks uit te betalen indien gewenst). NS Business Card & NS Go. Korting op sportabonnementen via Urban Sports Club & Bedrijfsfitness NL. Een gepersonaliseerde Stanley Cup of sapcentrifuge cadeau na je eerste maand. Laptop in bruikleen. Een pensioentoeslag van 5,3%, volledig door ons betaald. Bij EnergyZero geloven we dat verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en perspectieven ons sterker maken. We bouwen aan een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich welkom voelt en de ruimte krijgt om impact te maken. Voldoe je niet aan ieder punt in de vacature, maar krijg je energie van deze rol? Solliciteer vooral. We zijn nieuwsgierig naar wie je bent, wat je meebrengt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

items.desc: The Role A modelling residency puts you in the center of a frontier lab. You'll be embedded in real work: placed on key production and research projects and mentored directly by our modelling team. We're building our frontier innovation around efficiency, gradient-free exploration, real-time learning, and interface design. By the end of this 8-month residency, our hope is that you leave with a track record you're proud to put on your resume and experiences that meaningfully upskill you. Responsibilities Innovation: Build the future of adaptive algorithms that continuously learn. Co-design algorithms that react in real-time to product signal and feedback, and explore new ways of capturing feedback that make those algorithms better Cross-Stack Optimization: Collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to drive system-wide efficiency gains Measure What Matters: We believe the ultimate signal of value is real-world impact. The smartest algorithm is one capable of interacting with the world — that's why product signal matters so much to how we work. Qualifications We value impact over credentials. Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to check every box - but you do need to be adaptable. A degree or equivalent research/engineering experience in a computer science field. Genuine interest in, and at least one project touching: model efficiency, synthetic data, interfaces, real-time alignment, or algorithmic optimization Systems thinking — the ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stack Strong Python skills and experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow) Familiarity with model optimization techniques such as RLHF and fine-tuning Strong communication and self-awareness — you know how to collaborate in a remote environment and you're open to feedback You care about technical excellence and last mile impact. We value impact more than effort, and about owning outcomes end to end. About Us Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn't adapt to the world. We think that's backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, personalized, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible - it's how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few. We believe in talent density: bringing together the best and most driven individuals to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We're looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

items.card: job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.
items.desc: About Charles River Associates Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. Since 1965, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges. CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters. We have played a key role in many cases that have shaped European competition policy in recent years: from aerospace to software, and manufacturing to transportation. More recently, we have been at the forefront of economic thinking in antitrust investigations and regulation in the tech sector. We seek candidates for our London, UK location. Position Overview The Consulting Associate position is the entry-level position for applicants with a postgraduate qualification in economics. Consulting Associates work closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high-profile, and most significant competition cases in Europe, providing conceptual and practice input to projects. A typical Consulting Associate would: Identify potential issues and conduct analyses that can be used to illustrate economic arguments; Assemble compelling evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations; Program, build models and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing; Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using financial, market, industry or client-proprietary data; Interact with clients and communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to non-experts in an understandable, accessible manner; Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions; Participate in practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.). Desired Qualifications First degree in economics with a postgraduate qualification (MSc/MPhil) in economics from well-regarded institutions, graduating between December 2026 and August 2027; Strong foundation in microeconomics, with a specialism in industrial economics preferred; High degree of numeracy and comfort with data manipulation are essential, familiarity with econometric techniques desirable; Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems; Effective oral and written communication skills; Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages; Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership; Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities; Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills; and Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events. As much of our work occurs in our offices, minimal travel is required. To Apply To be considered for this position, please submit the following: CV/Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number; Covering letter – please describe your interest in the European Competition practice and how this role matches your goals; Academic Results - from all relevant degrees. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Career Growth And Benefits Charles River Associate’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering 100 hours of training annually through formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with research and analysis skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities. We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers. Work Location Flexibility Charles River Associates creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our …

items.desc: Bedrijf Begin 2023 bundelden VSE, Yvan Paque en de afdeling Infrastructuur van Collignon hun krachten oner een gemeenschappelijke noemer: Eiffage Énergie Systèmes - Infra . Ook Luxtechnologie en Luxys hebben zicht bij de divisie aangesloten. De Infra-activiteiten zijn zeer uitgebreid: van elektrische voedingen tot de plaatsing van LS- en MS-schakelborden, van openbare verlichting langs snelwegen tot renovatie en onderhoud van tunnels. En niet te vergeten: metrostations, verkeerslichten, glasvezel, spoorwegsignalisatie, elektriciteitsnetten op luchthavens, evenals onze expertise in milieu-instrumentatie met de installatie en het onderhoud van analysesystemen voor lucht- en waterkwaliteit. Wat je doet Begrijp jij bedrijfsprocessen én kun je zelf AI-oplossingen bouwen die het dagelijkse werk verbeteren? Bij Eiffage Énergie Systèmes combineer je analyse met concrete ontwikkeling en implementatie. Jouw functie Je combineert twee rollen. Als Business Analyst breng je samen met projectleiders, calculatoren, werfleiding, aankoop, administratie en HR in kaart hoe processen vandaag verlopen en waar tijd verloren gaat. Als AI Specialist ontwerp en bouw je vervolgens oplossingen die dat werk automatiseren of ondersteunen. Je zorgt ervoor dat ze veilig en betrouwbaar werken en daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Businessanalyse Je organiseert workshops en interviews met de verschillende afdelingen om hun processen en behoeften te begrijpen. Je brengt bestaande en gewenste processen in kaart, identificeert knelpunten en stelt per verbetering een businesscase op, met aandacht voor tijdswinst, kosten en risico’s. Je stelt in overleg met het management een roadmap voor automatiseringsprojecten op en bewaakt de prioriteiten. Je vertaalt functionele vereisten naar heldere specificaties voor interne IT-teams, de groep of externe partners. AI en automatisering Je bouwt oplossingen met automatiseringstools zoals Power Automate, Power Apps en n8n, en met taalmodellen zoals Claude en Azure OpenAI, binnen de Microsoft 365-omgeving. Je realiseert koppelingen met bestaande systemen, zoals ERP- en planningssoftware, en met SharePoint. Je test oplossingen, rolt ze uit en zorgt voor documentatie en onderhoud. Wie je bent Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma in (toegepaste) informatica, bedrijfskunde, handelsingenieurswetenschappen of industriële wetenschappen, of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Je hebt aantoonbare praktijkervaring met generatieve AI: prompt engineering, werken met API’s van taalmodellen en het opzetten van AI-workflows. Je hebt ervaring met Microsoft Power Platform, waaronder Power Automate en Power Apps, of met een vergelijkbaar automatiseringsplatform. Je hebt ervaring met procesmodellering, bijvoorbeeld BPMN, en het opstellen van functionele analyses. Je hebt basiskennis van programmeren in Python of JavaScript en van dataverwerking met Excel, SQL en Power BI. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Frans uitstekend en hebt een goede kennis van het Engels. Jouw aanpak Analytisch: je doorgrondt complexe processen en ziet waar verbeteringen de meeste waarde opleveren. Verbindend en communicatief: je spreekt de taal van zowel de werf als de directie en legt technologie begrijpelijk uit. Pragmatisch en resultaatgericht: je levert snel werkende oplossingen die het dagelijkse werk daadwerkelijk verlichten. Zelfstandig en ondernemend: je neemt initiatief en trekt projecten van idee tot uitrol. Veranderingsgericht: je begeleidt collega’s bij nieuwe manieren van werken, met geduld en overtuigingskracht. Verantwoordelijk: je hebt oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid, privacy en de impact van je oplossingen op collega’s. Wil jij bedrijfsprocessen verbeteren met AI en automatisering? Solliciteer bij Eiffage Énergie Systèmes. Wat we bieden Een voltijds contract van onbepaalde duur. Een competitief salaris in verhouding met uw kennis en ervaring. Een volledig salarispakket (bedrijfswagen + Tankkaart/laadpas, maaltijdcheques, groepsverzekering, hospitalisatieverzekering, ecocheques, geschenkcheques, laptop, smartphone + abonnement, 12 ADV-dagen, deelname aan het werknemersaandeelhouderschap, Cafetaria Plan). Opleidingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden. Een aangename en motiverende werkomgeving in een stabiel en sterk bedrijf dat deel uitmaakt van de internationale groep Eiffage. Contact

items.desc: Verisk is a global data, analytics, and technology company helping organizations make better decisions about risk. Across the insurance industry, our data, predictive models, and technology support decisions throughout the insurance lifecycle, from underwriting and pricing to claims management and fraud detection. We work with complex, high-value datasets including weather, property, business, financial, claims, policy, medical, imagery, and geodemographic data. Within Verisk Claims UK, we focus on helping insurers improve how claims are assessed, managed, and resolved. Our analytics and automation solutions help streamline claims processes, identify fraud, and support better outcomes for insurers and their customers. About the role We’re looking for an early-career Data Scientist to join our International Analytics Team and help build the next generation of analytics products across claims and underwriting. This is a role where you can do more than develop models in isolation. You’ll work with real-world insurance data, explore complex problems, test different approaches, and help take models from initial idea through to production. The work is varied. Depending on the project, you could be developing supervised machine learning models, exploring clustering techniques, working with language models or network analysis, or contributing to AI solutions involving automated document processing, agentic decision-making workflows, and claims analysis and auditing. You’ll have room to experiment, learn, and build your technical depth while working alongside experienced colleagues who value peer review, knowledge sharing, and high-quality analytical work. For someone at the beginning of their data science career, this is an opportunity to develop broad, practical experience within a global organization while seeing the real-world impact of your work. This position can be based in our offices in London or Norwich. Why join Verisk Claims? This role offers the combination of technical variety, meaningful data, and long-term career development that can be difficult to find in an early-career data science position. You’ll be working on products that support real decisions across the insurance industry, with access to diverse datasets and opportunities to apply both established modeling techniques and newer areas of AI. You’ll also have the scale and stability of Verisk behind you, alongside the opportunity to take genuine ownership of your work, develop your technical expertise, and understand how high-quality data science moves from experimentation into products used by the industry. If you’re looking for a Data Scientist role where you can keep learning while building things that have a practical, measurable purpose, we’d like to hear from you. #LI-SD2 #LI-Hybrid Support the development of new analytics products for insurance claims and underwriting. Explore complex datasets and turn them into meaningful insights, including data processing, cleaning, joining multiple data sources, feature engineering, analysis, and interpretation. Build and compare predictive models using techniques such as GLMs, gradient boosting, Random Forests, and neural networks. Identify the features and factors that provide meaningful predictive value and understand how they influence model performance. Help create, test, and monitor agentic AI workflows that are traceable, repeatable, and suitable for real-world use. Work with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business problems into practical analytical solutions. Write clear, reusable, and well-documented code, using version control and creating functions and templates that can be applied efficiently to future projects. Communicate analytical approaches, progress, findings, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Take part in peer reviews, sharing ideas and learning from colleagues while contributing to consistently high-quality work. You don’t need to arrive knowing everything about insurance. We’re looking for someone with strong analytical foundations, curiosity, and the motivation to develop. Ideally, you’ll bring: A bachelor's, master's, or PhD in mathematics, statistics, data science, computer science, another scientific discipline, or a related analytical field. Solid programming skills, ideally using Python and SQL. Experience working with data, including manipulation, cleaning, validation, and analysis. Exposure to statistical modeling, machine learning, or other predictive techniques. Strong logical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach complex questions in a structured way. Good attention to detail and an interest in producing reliable, reproducible analytical work. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical work to different audiences. A collaborative approach and willingness to learn from, and contribute to, the wider team. Our People, Our Culture For more …

items.desc: About VIB VIB is a leading life sciences research institute with a unique collaborative model spanning nine research centers and four partner universities. Our mission is to advance life sciences for the benefit of society through scientific excellence, innovation, and collaboration. At the VIB Data Core, we empower scientists by delivering advanced infrastructure and services that tackle complex challenges in data storage, management, and computing. About the role Life-science data reaches its full value only when it is well described, connected and reusable. At VIB Data Core, you will help make that possible. As our Research Metadata Specialist, you shape how life-science data is described, connected and exchanged across VIB's data platforms, institutional systems and external repositories. You link datasets to the information that gives them meaning: samples, experiments, projects and publications. You make that information structured, machine-readable and consistent, so it supports scientific reuse, institutional reporting, automation and responsible AI. You work closely with researchers, data stewards, developers and repository teams, and you turn their needs into practical metadata models, mappings and validation rules. What you will do Design and maintain metadata models that connect diverse life-science data (omics, imaging, spatial, etc.) with their scientific and administrative context. Select and apply the right standards, controlled vocabularies, ontologies and persistent identifiers, together with domain experts. Build and maintain mappings between local systems, the central data platform, external repositories, literature databases and institutional reporting. Develop and maintain lightweight, API-based workflows to retrieve and transform metadata and apply mappings, working with developers to integrate the resulting metadata into target systems. Define quality requirements and validation rules, and help automate them. Coordinate the review, testing, versioning and documentation of metadata models and templates. Support and train developers, data stewards and users and use their feedback to keep improving templates and workflows. Your profile We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and career paths. If you meet most of the essential requirements, we encourage you to apply. You bring: A Master's degree in bioinformatics, data science, information science, life sciences or a related field, or equivalent experience. Several years of experience with metadata in life-science research, across a range of data types. Experience designing or maintaining metadata schemas, data models or mappings. A practical understanding of metadata standards, vocabularies, persistent identifiers and provenance, and how they support FAIR data. The ability to read API documentation, work with JSON or XML, and use or adapt scripts. Familiarity with Git and with testing and documenting changes. A structured, collaborative way of working, with clear communication and documentation. Strong assets: Experience with research repositories, bibliographic databases, data deposition or federated data platforms. Experience with ontologies or semantic technologies such as RDF or JSON-LD. Experience building reusable metadata transformation or validation tools. Our offer A permanent, full-time position in an international, research-driven organization. The chance to shape how research metadata is managed and reused across VIB. A varied role, split between strategic projects (such as Open Science and European data initiatives) and the day-to-day running of our metadata, data deposition and archiving services. Room to grow in FAIR data, semantic interoperability and knowledge graphs, through training and through national and European initiatives. Flexible working, with up to two days per week from home. The position is based in Ghent and includes travel about two to three times a year. How to apply Please apply via the VIB online application form (https://jobs.vib.be/apply/138262). A complete application file (English) should contain the following documents: your cover/motivation letter your CV 2 references (optional) In case of questions, please email recruiting@vib.be . Get to know VIB https://vib.be https://datacore.sites.vib.be/en Listen to our podcast 'Called to Science' Follow us on LinkedIn.

items.desc: Job Description Verisk is a global data, analytics, and technology company helping organizations make better decisions about risk. Across the insurance industry, our data, predictive models, and technology support decisions throughout the insurance lifecycle, from underwriting and pricing to claims management and fraud detection. We work with complex, high-value datasets including weather, property, business, financial, claims, policy, medical, imagery, and geodemographic data. Within Verisk Claims UK, we focus on helping insurers improve how claims are assessed, managed, and resolved. Our analytics and automation solutions help streamline claims processes, identify fraud, and support better outcomes for insurers and their customers. About The Role We’re looking for an early-career Data Scientist to join our International Analytics Team and help build the next generation of analytics products across claims and underwriting. This is a role where you can do more than develop models in isolation. You’ll work with real-world insurance data, explore complex problems, test different approaches, and help take models from initial idea through to production. The work is varied. Depending on the project, you could be developing supervised machine learning models, exploring clustering techniques, working with language models or network analysis, or contributing to AI solutions involving automated document processing, agentic decision-making workflows, and claims analysis and auditing. You’ll have room to experiment, learn, and build your technical depth while working alongside experienced colleagues who value peer review, knowledge sharing, and high-quality analytical work. For someone at the beginning of their data science career, this is an opportunity to develop broad, practical experience within a global organization while seeing the real-world impact of your work. This position can be based in our offices in London or Norwich. Why join Verisk Claims? This role offers the combination of technical variety, meaningful data, and long-term career development that can be difficult to find in an early-career data science position. You’ll be working on products that support real decisions across the insurance industry, with access to diverse datasets and opportunities to apply both established modeling techniques and newer areas of AI. You’ll also have the scale and stability of Verisk behind you, alongside the opportunity to take genuine ownership of your work, develop your technical expertise, and understand how high-quality data science moves from experimentation into products used by the industry. If you’re looking for a Data Scientist role where you can keep learning while building things that have a practical, measurable purpose, we’d like to hear from you. Responsibilities Support the development of new analytics products for insurance claims and underwriting. Explore complex datasets and turn them into meaningful insights, including data processing, cleaning, joining multiple data sources, feature engineering, analysis, and interpretation. Build and compare predictive models using techniques such as GLMs, gradient boosting, Random Forests, and neural networks. Identify the features and factors that provide meaningful predictive value and understand how they influence model performance. Help create, test, and monitor agentic AI workflows that are traceable, repeatable, and suitable for real-world use. Work with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business problems into practical analytical solutions. Write clear, reusable, and well-documented code, using version control and creating functions and templates that can be applied efficiently to future projects. Communicate analytical approaches, progress, findings, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Take part in peer reviews, sharing ideas and learning from colleagues while contributing to consistently high-quality work. Qualifications You don’t need to arrive knowing everything about insurance. We’re looking for someone with strong analytical foundations, curiosity, and the motivation to develop. Ideally, You’ll Bring A bachelor's, master's, or PhD in mathematics, statistics, data science, computer science, another scientific discipline, or a related analytical field. Solid programming skills, ideally using Python and SQL. Experience working with data, including manipulation, cleaning, validation, and analysis. Exposure to statistical modeling, machine learning, or other predictive techniques. Strong logical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach complex questions in a structured way. Good attention to detail and an interest in producing reliable, reproducible analytical work. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical work to different audiences. A collaborative approach and willingness to learn from, and contribute to, the wider team. About …
