items.desc: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME We are looking for curious and rigorous minds to push the boundaries of Generative AI at Betclic. Our GenAI Center of Excellence builds and runs generative-AI applications for the whole group. Among them is a semantic-analysis platform that turns millions of raw texts (customer conversations, support tickets, news) into clear, actionable themes for several business teams. The method behind it is the one the AI labs use on their own data. Anthropic’s Clio makes sense of millions of conversations with Claude without anyone reading them; GitHub and Google Research have published the same recipe: embed the texts, cluster them, let an LLM name what emerges. Each runs it on its own data; almost nobody applies it to everyday business text. We do. You will join the GenAI Center of Excellence in Bordeaux, working with GenAI solution architects and will be exposed to business teams expressing analysis needs. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC As a GenAI Research Intern at Betclic, you will work on a question this field has not answered yet. Today, these systems group texts by what they are about. Grouping them by an angle you choose (tone of voice, urgency, intent) means paying an LLM to rewrite every document first. Can the representation itself be oriented, so that steering costs almost nothing? And before that: how do you prove that one clustering is better than another? Your missions will include: Mapping the state of the art in LLM-assisted clustering, steerable embeddings and clustering evaluation. Designing an evaluation protocol (reference corpora, metrics, LLM-as-a-judge) and measuring how far it can be trusted. Running controlled experiments that compare clustering pipelines, embedding models and orientation techniques, on real corpora as well as public benchmarks. Writing up your protocols and conclusions as research notes, and presenting them to the team and to business stakeholders. This internship will give you hands-on experience of the methods the AI labs use on their own data, and a research question you own end to end, from hypothesis to conclusion. Who We Are Looking For We are looking for curious, passionate and collaborative people who enjoy solving problems and working in a dynamic environment. This internship is for you if you: Are currently enrolled in a Master’s degree (or equivalent, final year) in Machine Learning, Data Science, NLP, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. Have strong analytical skills and scientific rigour, are autonomous, and care more about why something works than about making it work once. Are proficient in Python and at ease building with LLMs and agents: LLM APIs, prompting, tool calling, and AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow. Want to grow your skills in communicating experimental results clearly, including what they do not prove. Work comfortably in English or French. Nice to have : Previous exposure to embeddings, clustering or topic modelling (e.g. sentence-transformers, UMAP, HDBSCAN, BERTopic), or to LLM APIs. A first research experience: a lab internship, a paper, or a habit of reproducible experiments. An interest in sports or gaming industries is appreciated, but not required. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? If your application is shortlisted, Maxime will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). Next, you will meet your future manager. Finally, Maxime will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. Nous ? 22 000 passionnés de plus de 50 nationalités, portés par un esprit d’entreprenariat. items.card: What You'll Do Define and own the metrics for agent quality: success, completion, error rates, and the behaviors that drive them. Build the eval systems and experiment framework that decide whether an agent change ships, like an A/B-tested rollout that catches a change increasing errors before it reaches everyone. Turn agent traces and telemetry into concrete fixes, working directly with the agent engineering team.
items.desc: TL;DR — You own how we measure and improve Lovable's AI agent. You build the eval systems and experiments that tell us whether a change makes the agent better or worse, and you turn agent telemetry into the fixes that raise success rates and cut errors. At Lovable, data scientists are not isolated model-builders; they sit close to the product, experimenting continuously with how intelligence changes user behavior and product dynamics. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. What We're Looking For A data scientist who wants to make an AI agent measurably better, not just report on it. You own agent quality metrics and drive them up. Experience or strong interest in LLM evaluation and observability: building evals, scoring outputs, tracing agent behavior, and catching regressions. Strong SQL and Python, applied statistics, and experimentation. Comfortable designing A/B tests for agent changes where outcomes are noisy. You build systems and agents that produce this insight continuously, rather than one-off analyses. Instinct for what "good" looks like in agent behavior (success, error rates, task completion) and how to measure it when there is no clean answer key. Entrepreneurial. Thrives in ambiguity, and works closely with the engineers building the agent. What You'll Do Define and own the metrics for agent quality: success, completion, error rates, and the behaviors that drive them. Build the eval systems and experiment framework that decide whether an agent change ships, like an A/B-tested rollout that catches a change increasing errors before it reaches everyone. Turn agent traces and telemetry into concrete fixes, working directly with the agent engineering team. Build the tooling and agents that produce these evaluations continuously as the agent evolves. Set the bar for how we judge agent behavior where there is no answer key to check against. Our tech stack We're building with tools that both humans and AI love: Languages: SQL and Python LLM evaluation & observability: Braintrust, OTEL tracing, many LLM providers Warehouse & events: BigQuery, PubSub Analytics & product: Hex, Lovable Apps Experimentation: A/B and growth testing Cloud: GCP And always on the lookout for what's next. You'll be joining the most lean, talent-dense, and fast-moving engineering team in London. You'll be responsible for: Developing production-ready AI agents. We've built proprietary agents and tools for drafting, analysing, and evaluating patents. You'll improve these agents and ship new ones that directly move product quality and customer adoption. Context management, tools and prompt engineering. You'll ensure our AI manages its context effectively at scale, reliably handling thousands of documents while producing the highest-quality output. You'll build the specialist tools and integrations that make this possible, and engineer prompts alongside our IP experts to maximise performance. Building a state-of-the-art evaluation pipeline. Robust evals keep AI output high-quality and objectively steer our R&D. You'll build this pipeline and benchmark performance across large datasets. 👤 About You As an AI engineer, you will have extensive experience building AI agents and products to solve impressively difficult problems through past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. ✏️ Essential Requirements Expert in Python. Industry experience of shipping agents and/or evaluation pipelines into production. Experience with context engineering and prompt engineering Familiarity with back-end development and Postgres databases. Experience with front-end development (Typescript/React). Extremely clear writer and communicator. Nice To Have Publications at top machine learning conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML) or in adjacent fields. 💰 What We Offer Competitive base salary depending on skill and experience. Significant equity — we want you to take ownership in Solve Intelligence and share in the success that lies ahead. Full visa sponsorship. Opportunity to work with a super smart and ambitious group of people building something people want. Private medical insurance. Free meals. 🚀 About Solve Intelligence Solve Intelligence is the fastest-growing startup transforming the IP landscape. Solve's AI platform manages everything from invention harvesting and patent generation through to litigation and licensing. Growth: 20–30% MoM revenue growth; selling to 600+ global IP teams across 6 continents (DLA Piper, tech giants, boutiques, etc); 8 figures of ARR — all just ~2 years since we started. Impact: 50–90% efficiency and quality improvements. See our latest Series B announcement. We're on a high-growth trajectory, and we're looking for people who want to join us on the journey to building a generational AI company. 👥 Meet the founders Sanj (Chief Research Officer and co-founder): Sanj did his MSci in Physics at the University of Cambridge and his PhD in AI at the Gatsby Unit, UCL. He won awards at top AI conferences, worked on the R&D team at Huawei, and received widespread attention for his contributions to open-source LLM projects on GitHub. He joined Magic Carpet AI as employee #4, where he developed AI strategies for trading, before the company was acquired. Chris (Chief Executive Officer and co-founder): Chris did his undergrad at Imperial College London, his masters at the University of Cambridge, and his PhD in machine learning at UCL, during which he published 10+ papers and won awards at top AI conferences and journals. Prior to founding Solve, Chris worked at The Alan Turing Institute, InstaDeep, and Dyson. Angus (Chief Technology Officer and co-founder): Angus did an MEng in Computer Science at the University of Bristol where he won a cyber security scholarship at GCHQ before working at Qualcomm. He then joined a London-based hedge fund, Coremont (Brevan Howard). There, he led a small team to build a greenfield trade processing platform which scaled to millions of trades per day. Ready to build the future of AI? Apply now. 🚀 Compensation Range: $100K - $250K

The Network Infrastructure team is responsible for designing, building, and operating one of the largest networks in the world. Networking is at the core of all Meta products and experiences, and we are looking for Network Production Engineers who are interested in solving complex technical challenges in the Backbone, Datacenter, and AI Network domains.

Production Network Engineers at Meta are hybrid software and network engineers who design, build, and operate our worldwide network. This team owns the complete lifecycle of the network, which includes areas of planning, design, product definition, QA, deployment, and monitoring. Simple, elegant, and scalable network design, automation, and data analytics are the keys to meeting our demands. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Du bist Teil des Project Delivery innerhalb von Business Solutions. 
 Als Project Cost Engineer (PCE) unterstützt du unsere Projektleitungen bei der finanziellen Steuerung von Investitionsprojekte. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Kostenkontrolle, Prognosen und Berichtswesen, bringst dein technisches Know-how in unsere bestehende Systemlandschaft ein und treibst aktiv den Einsatz innovativer, KI-gestützter Tools zur Prozessoptimierung voran. 
 Die Möglichkeit 
 Mit dieser verantwortungsvollen Aufgabe unterstützt du unser Team mit folgenden Hauptaufgaben:
 Budgetüberwachung & Kostenkontrolle: Kontinuierliche Überwachung des freigegebenen Projektbudgets, Abgleich von Soll-/Ist-Werten zur Früherkennung von Abweichungen sowie Verwaltung von Contingencies.
 Cost Forecasting & Cashflow: Erstellung und Aktualisierung von rollierenden Kosten- und Mittelabfluss- (Expenditure) Prognosen inklusive Vorbereitung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Steuerungsgremien (z. B. Steering Committees).
 Kostenschätzung & Cost Breakdown: Unterstützung bei der CAPEX-Kostenschätzung, Strukturierung von Kostenpaketen (Cost Breakdown Structure) und Organisation regelmässiger Cost Reviews im Projektteam.
 Change Management: Operative Führung des kommerziellen Projekt-Änderungsprozesses (Change Orders, Nachtragsprüfung, Pflege des Change Registers und Anpassung von Budget-Baselines).
 Projekt-Reporting & KPI-Ermittlung: Termingerechte Erstellung standardisierter Status- und Fortschrittsberichte (z. B. monatliche Project Management Reports) sowie Ermittlung relevanter Projekt-KPIs.
 Rechnungsprüfung & Beschaffungssupport: Überprüfung und korrekte Kontierung von Rechnungen und Nachträgen in enger Abstimmung mit den Beschaffungs- und Finanzfunktionen.
 Betreuung der Portfoliosysteme: Sicherer operativer Umgang mit bestehenden Projekt- und Portfoliomanagement-Tools (z. B. CORA, CPPO, SAP, TMT, myBuy) als Ansprechperson im Projekt.
 Impulse durch KI-Tools & Digitalisierung: Evaluierung und praxisnahe Implementierung moderner, KI-gestützter Lösungen zur Automatisierung von Routineanalysen, Datenaufbereitung und Effizienzsteigerung im Controlling.
 Schnittstellenkoordination & Continuous Improvement: Aktive Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitung, Einkauf und Finanzen sowie Mitwirkung an Lessons-Learned-Workshops zur stetigen Weiterentwicklung von Controlling-Standards.
 Wer du bist
 Um in dieser spannenden Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du idealerweise folgende Qualifikationen mit:
 Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Bau-/Verfahrenstechnik, Naturwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Berufserfahrung: >3 Jahren Erfahrung in Project Controls in Kleinen und Mittelgrossen Projekten oder Multi Project Controls / Portfolio Controlling von mehreren Kleinprojekten, idealerweise im Life-Sciences- oder Pharma Anlagenbau Umfeld.
 System- & Tool-Kompetenz: Fundierte Kenntnisse in MS Excel/Google Workspace; Erfahrung mit ERP- und Portfoliosystemen (wie SAP, CORA, CPPO o. ä.) sind von Vorteil.
 KI-Affinität: Begeisterung für digitale Trends und konkretes Interesse daran, KI-gestützte Tools (z. B. zur Datenanalyse, Berichterstellung oder Prozessautomatisierung) in den Controlling-Alltag einzubinden.
 Arbeitsweise: Hohe Zahlenaffinität, sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten und eine lösungsorientierte Hands-on-Mentalität sowie Eigeninitiative und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit
 Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und fliessende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die Arbeit in interdisziplinären Schnittstellen.
 Bewirb dich jetzt und werdeTeil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) Specialist 
 Almere & Woerden, Netherlands 
 At Roche, we believe that delivering life-saving healthcare shouldn't come at the cost of the planet or the well-being of our people. As our Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) Specialist, you will directly safeguard the colleagues who bring innovative diagnostic and pharmaceutical solutions to patients every day. 
 By translating global sustainability and safety strategies into local action across both Roche Diagnostics Netherlands B.V. and Roche Nederland B.V., you will foster a safe, resilient, and compliant environment where our teams can focus on what matters most: doing now what patients need next.
 Reporting to the SHE Officer, you will operationalize Roche’s well-established global SHE frameworks across our two Dutch affiliates in Almere and Woerden. Because Roche provides mature corporate directives and digital systems, you don’t have to reinvent the wheel. Instead, your mission is pragmatic deployment: translating clear global guidelines into engaging local safety culture, health initiatives, and community wellbeing programs, backed by a flexible hybrid working model.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Localize Corporate Directives & Dutch Legislation: Leverage Roche’s comprehensive global SHE directives and adapt them seamlessly for our commercial and office teams. Facilitate local legislation (Arbowet, RI&E updates, GreenDeal 3.0, and applicable European environmental standards) with the support of established local advisory partners and turnkey templates.
 Digital Systems, Incident Investigations & Corporate Reporting: Utilize enterprise platforms (Enablon) to coordinate incident investigations and CAPA workflows, as well as annual affiliate SHE and resilience metrics.
 Workplace Safety & Ergonomics: Oversee practical ergonomics (office and home working) and commercial field safety, ensuring our facilities remain safe, supportive, and hazard-free.
 Occupational Health & Vitality: Partner with independent occupational health providers (Arbodienst) and drive wellbeing campaigns (e.g., Roche LiveWell) that prioritize mental health, work-life harmony, and vitality.
 Resilience & Business Continuity Exercises: Partner with the SHE Officer to facilitate the annual review of our affiliate Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and help organize tabletop exercises to test business resilience across our hybrid operating model. (Day-to-day emergency response and floor wardens are managed by our dedicated internal emergency response (BHV) team).
 Safety Culture & Community Engagement: Act as the visible, approachable SHE champion for both sites. Turn corporate safety principles into fun, human-centered campaigns that build genuine community engagement across diverse, international teams. 
 What We Hope You Will Bring 
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Environmental Science, Safety Engineering, Occupational Health, or a related field. Professional credentials (MVK/HVK qualification or Certified Preventiemedewerker) are strongly preferred.
 Regulatory Literacy: Sound working knowledge of European environmental standards and core occupational safety principles. Familiarity with (or readiness to quickly master), Dutch Arbowet and RI&E frameworks with the support of our local partners. 
 Experience: 3 to 5 years of practical SHE/HSE experience within a commercial affiliate, corporate office, or service-oriented environment. Experience within the Roche Group or life sciences network is a distinct advantage. 
 Mindset: A pragmatic implementer who loves people over paperwork. You excel at taking structured global corporate standards and turning them into engaging local initiatives. 
 Systems & Languages: Hands-on experience with digital SHE platforms (e.g. Enablon). Professional fluency in English is required (our primary business language). Working knowledge of Dutch is a strong asset for local stakeholder engagement, but we welcome internal transfers and international candidates. 
 Why Roche? 
 For over 125 years, Roche has been working towards a healthier future with one clear goal: "Doing now what patients need next". We believe that the greatest medical challenges can only be solved through intensive collaboration with healthcare professionals and patients.

Job Description: 
 Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? 
 Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être le stage qu’il vous faut ! 
 Vous êtes étudiant(e) et à la recherche d'un stage de fin d’étude vous permettant de valider votre diplôme et qui fera décoller votre carrière ? Imaginez-vous au cœur d’une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture . 
 Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante. 
 Votre mission, si vous l'acceptez : 
 Une offre de stage intitulée « Stage implémentation d’un réseau de neurone sur cible FPGA (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein de AIRBUS Defence and Space sur son site de Toulouse-Palays. 
 Vous rejoindrez le département Applicative FPGA en charge du développement des FPGA pour des applications spatiales.
 Votre stage consistera à l’implémentation puis la vérification d’un modèle de réseau de neurone sur cible FPGA.
 Ce stage, d'une durée de 6 mois, débutera idéalement en mars 2027 (cette période est indicative et pourra être ajustée). 
 Ce stage peut nécessiter une habilitation de sécurité ou d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.
 Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l’IGI 1300 du 9 Août 2021 (paragraphe 1.2.2.1).
 Tâches et responsabilités : 
 Vos principales missions consisteront à : 
 Prendre en main les outils de développement FPGA et monter en compétence sur l’architecture du composant 
 Étudier et réaliser (de manière partielle ou complète) l’architecture du modèle de réseau de neurones ciblé (notamment le découpage hard/soft, les interconnexions et l’utilisation de couches physiques du FPGA).
 Coder en VHDL & C/C++ puis vérifier le design architecturé.
 Implémenter le réseau de neurones sur la cible et faire les mesures de performances (conso, optimisation des ressources, etc…)
 Votre tuteur ou tutrice vous accompagnera tout au long de votre stage, vous aidant à développer vos compétences et à atteindre vos objectifs professionnels. 
 Ce stage vous permettra notamment de développer les compétences suivantes : 
 prise en main du plan de développement d’un FPGA spatialisable (norme ECSS)
 implémentation hard/soft d’un design complexe et innovant
 monter en compétence sur un environnement de développement industriel déjà éprouvé
 coder proprement en VHDL & C/C++
 développer ses connaissances sur l’architecture d’un réseau de neurones
 Votre carte d’embarquement pour cette aventure : 
 Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) en électronique numérique embarquée / circuits intégrés ou un domaine équivalent ? Vous possédez les compétences suivantes : 
 Compétences techniques : coder en VHDL & C/C++ 
 connaissance en technologie FPGA
 avoir des connaissances/notions sur l’architecture et le fonctionnement d’un réseau de neurones sont fortement recommandées. De la proactivité dans ce domaine est attendue
 Soft Skills : être proactif et organisé dans son travail
 communiquer, rédiger et présenter des résultats
 avoir un esprit critique
 Compétences linguistiques attendues : Anglais : niveau avancé 
 Français : niveau négociation 
 Notre processus de recrutement : 
 Votre candidature sera analysée attentivement par notre équipe de recrutement. Si votre profil correspond à nos attentes, vous serez invité(e) à réaliser un entretien vidéo. Suite à cette étape, si votre candidature est retenue, elle sera alors proposée au manager pour un entretien. 
 Envie de faire partie de l'aventure Airbus ? Postulez dès maintenant et rejoignez-nous !

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 In order to support Manoeuvre Loads Team in Hamburg, Airbus is looking for a 
 Loads & Aeroelastic Engineer (d/f/m) 
 As Loads & Aeroelastic Engineer (d/f/m) we are at the heart of aircraft design and deal as part of the engineering organisation with the key flight sciences. 
 In the Manoeuvre Loads Team in Hamburg we perform load calculations covering our fleet from a very early design stage until certification and finally during airline operations. We are responsible for build model activities such as aerodynamics modelling for the manoeuvre loads models and integrating model bricks. We subsequently perform manoeuvre loads calculation and provide the loads data to our component loads colleagues. In addition to this, the team is strongly involved in performing loads in-service support, research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, new services, model based system engineering, automation, and machine learning. 
 Having the transverse view of the whole aircraft, our main mission is to deliver suitable aircraft design and configuration for optimum performance. As such we are fully part of the current and future challenges in designing a safe aircraft meeting the highest sustainability and operational standards. 
 We are present throughout the full aircraft life-cycle: supporting sales campaigns from early definition phase through the core design phase and onwards into supporting manufacture, flight testing and the aircraft in service. By this we ensure the best-operational and safe use of the aircraft and create value for our customers. 
 We are aeronautical engineers, developers and innovators. We make use of cutting edge technologies in our tools as digital enablers are key to ensure our success. 
 Your location 
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 You will perform manoeuvre loads calculations covering our fleet from a very early design stage until certification taking into consideration the certification requirements and the A/C specificities such as aerodynamic loads & flight control design. 
 You will support research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, new services, model based system engineering, automation, and machine learning. 
 You would also support airlines through Airbus Customer Services by carrying out L&A analyses of in-service events: Contribute to Loads In-Service Support with trouble shooting activities in the L&A design office context for development and production flight test and in-service aircraft, perform related L&A assessments. 
 Engage for timely response to engineering queries as on-call engineer for Loads In-Service Support. 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 You have a Master degree in the STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics), preferably having focussed on aircraft design 
 You are curious and interested in developing new methodologies, driving improvements and shaping the future of aeronautical engineering 
 Your positivity and motivation enthuses your team. You are willing to master your responsibilities in an empowered environment. 
 Your English is at a negotiating level whereas German language skills would be a plus. 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Job Description: 
 The Finance NextGen Programme is an Airbus Defence & Space wide development programme. This programme is designed to identify and develop talented Leaders for the Airbus Finance Community who will contribute significantly towards achieving our business goals. The FinanceNextGen Programme - sponsored by Airbus Defence & Space CFO - enables its participants to enhance financial know-how and expertise, combined with further learning in management and leadership competencies.
 The mission of the programme 
 - Fostering and deepening participants’ financial knowledge and expertise on the Airbus world of Finance, enlarging the scope to the international financial context.
 - Linking formal learning with rotating, real-business project assignments.
 - Increasing participants’ project management and leadership competencies.
 - Encouraging networking, job shadowing, mobility and cross-cultural experiences.
 - Mentorship from a member of the Finance Top Management.
 This Program consists of two assignments in two different countries. Each assignment lasts for a period of two years. They are combined with off-the-job modules, designed to strengthen participant’s management and financial competencies.
 The successful applicant will join the Air Power Performance Engineering F&C Team in Getafe. You will join the team as Financial Analyst / Cost Engineer. The scope of responsibility includes finance controlling, consolidation and costing activities related with New Programmes mainly. Costing activities include, among others, to plan future target costs for products, development activities, and services of Airbus as well as to challenge supplier quotations for their fair value.
 As a Financial Analyst you will be a vital part in the Finance community to gather and consolidate the data to enable educated decision making on management level and give visibility about performance versus targets in an international environment.
 MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Consolidating, supporting and preparing finance exercise as Operational Planning, EAC, Forecast, End of Year Estimation, Budget within the Operations & Engineering F&C team in Getafe.
 Implement the standardization strategy for monthly closing reporting at TFAO Perimeter level, automatization of activities, co-pilot the finance strategy with the operational improving communication and better finance understanding.
 Focal point for Internal Finance Customer demand, as general queries, deep analysis on specific matter, new way of working implementation, task request by the business.
 Compiling relevant information and providing advice to clarify needs (e.g. assumptions, specifications, premises) for specific cost calculations in cooperation with the internal customer (e.g. Engineering, Programmes, VSM, Production, Procurement) and based on prior experience.
 Technical responsibility for a defined range of tasks.
 Decision on the costing methodology and the references to be assumed.
 Assessment of risks and opportunities in costing; identification of cost drivers (e.g. processes, design premises); providing recommendations regarding the optimisation of the analysed cost basis; including full documentation of the costing result and presentation of the results to the customer.
 Knowledge management: maintaining and sharing expertise and current knowledge of the processes, methods, and industrial set-up of the internal customers (e.g. Programmes, Procurement, Production), the suppliers.
 Supporting and actively contributing to improvement measures (e.g. processes, tools), also with regard to sustainability.
 Internal and cross-divisional harmonisation of cost models, methods, and tools. Continuous development of cost models and data analyses that can be used by other costing actors.
 Accomplishment of all business activities in compliance with all relevant internal and external regulations/legislation; escalation of occurring Ethics & Compliance issues.
 Supporting supplier negotiations, contributing to the supplier strategy and internal strategic go/no-go decisions.
 Cost by destination oriented, providing management with transparent information vital to the decision-making process, advancing recovery measures in case of potential deviations in a changing and volatile environment (development programs with a multi-companies and multi-countries set-up).
 SKILLS 
 We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience:
 Master’s degree in mechanical or electrical Engineering or equivalent.
 3-5 years of relevant professional experience.
 Finance experience in the areas of Finance / Accounting / Cost-Accounting / Project-Controlling / Reporting would be an advantage.
 Knowledge of SAP SP1 and ability to learn and adapt on new systems.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Industrial Cyber Sec. Specialist (f/m) to join our Industrial Cybersecurity Operations department based in Toulouse, France. 
 You will be part of a team protecting aircraft manufacturing processes against cyber threats. As part of the local ICS operations, you will be involved in bridging plant operations with security technologies aiming at systematically controlling and mitigating risks for the Toulouse St. Martin manufacturing facilities). 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you:
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 
 Your challenges: 
 Carry out industrial cyber solutions (such as ISP) and service implementation projects in cooperation with plant stakeholders. 
 Conduct Industrial Cyber Security Maturity Assessments (ICMA) and deliver resulting local initiatives. 
 Coordinate local response actions to cybersecurity incidents and supervise change control for OT and IACS. 
 Manage local resources, budgets, work packages, and support the vulnerability management process. 
 Maintain plant security metrics and develop communication plans to periodically report the cybersecurity posture to local management. 
 Your boarding pass: 
 Degree in Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, Industrial Automation, IT, or equivalent practical experience. 
 Proven expertise in Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity. 
 Solid background in cyber incident detection, response, and information systems security architectures. 
 Strong grasp of NIST CSF (Manufacturing Profile, 800-53, 800-82) and ISA/IEC 62443 standards. 
 Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (EASA PART-IS, NIS2, EBIOS) and Security-by-Design principles.

 Testia, filiale du groupe Airbus, est une entreprise internationale spécialisée dans l’intégrité et les inspections d’aérostructures et le contrôle non destructif aéronautique.

Nous offrons une large gamme d’ équipements et de produits pour des analyses rapides et efficaces des structures, composants et assemblages. Job Description: 
 Take off with Airbus Helicopters! 
 Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Drive System Design Responsible to join our Engineering departement based in Marignane, France. 
 You will join Transmission Design & Dynamic Systems Architecture department, which is in charge of the whole Airbus Helicopters fleet. Your missions will be operational.
 Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters.
 The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment.
 You will live a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters.
 To learn more about our site and our activities: Airbus Helicopters - Marignane 
 Your future missions: 
 As System Design Responsible (SDR), you will be in charge of :
 - defining technical objectives of transmission systems (specification writing) ;
 - following detailed design & compliance to requirements of performance, manufacturing, assembly & reliability for any design change and/or new certification ;
 - managing activities in compliance with Airbus Helicopters AH applicable processes
 - writing (flight and bench) tests requests & conclusions, preparing, following-up these tests ;
 - certifying transmission systems (documents writing, discussions with EASA)
 You will belong to a Squad organization & will be interfaced with a lot of different AH entities (stress analysis, work preparation, quality, production, lab tests, flight tests, project, configuration, airworthiness, other design offices, program, customer support...) and transmission equipments suppliers.
 In order to succeed in this challenging transmission systems environment , you will use your experience within Airbus Helicopters engineering. You will also be closely supported by the whole Métiers organization (overall, design, gears & splines, bearings & freewheels, wear & phydical laws, spalling & chip detectability, sealing & TBO extension, Dynamic Systems architecture, stress analysis, lubrication & thermics), experts, CVE and TVE.
 You will also have deep interactions with physical parts, whatever it is linked to production (workshops, manufacturing, assembly, MRO), bench tests or helicopters.
 Your profile 
 - At least 3 years of Experience in aeronautical domain
 - Synthesis spirit, rigorous

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Ingénieur d'Essais Radiofréquences (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Département Assemblage, Intégration et Tests (AIT) basé à Toulouse , France.
 Vos missions : 
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des satellites de télécommunications de haute technologie . Au sein du département d'Assemblage, Intégration et Tests (AIT), vous serez impliqué(e) dans la conception et le pilotage des campagnes d'essais hyperfréquences visant à garantir la performance et la fiabilité des équipements spatiaux avant leur lancement.
 Vos responsabilités : 
 Ingénierie et conception des tests 
 Définir les stratégies de tests et concevoir les configurations techniques (setups) sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie du satellite.
 Concevoir les méthodologies d'essais et définir les architectures de tests automatisées pour répondre aux exigences de conception complexes
 Optimiser les processus et les outils de mesure en analysant les retours d'expérience.
 Pilotage opérationnel et expertise technique 
 Orchestrer le déroulement des campagnes d'essais en coordination avec les services de planification et de production.
 Assurer l'expertise technique lors des phases de tests en environnements critiques, notamment en Vide Thermique (simulation de l'espace) et en CATR (Compact Antenna Test Range - chambre de mesure d'antennes).
 Diriger les investigations techniques et les analyses de causes profondes en cas d'anomalie sur les sous-systèmes de la Charge Utile (équipements de mission du satellite).
 Coordination et gestion de projet 
 Coordonner les opérations en lien étroit avec les responsables d'essais et les planificateurs.
 Piloter le reporting technique, analyser les écarts de performance et garantir la validation des résultats auprès de la direction et des clients.
 OBLIGATOIRE 
Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Votre profil : 
 Compétences et expérience : 
 Minimum 2 ans d'expérience professionnelle en ingénierie ou essais hyperfréquences dans un environnement industriel complexe.
 Maîtrise des techniques de mesure Radiofréquence (utilisation d'analyseurs de réseau, analyseurs de spectre, etc.).
 Capacité à piloter des projets techniques en autonomie, avec une aptitude à l'arbitrage décisionnel en environnement critique.
 Anglais niveau avancé (usage quotidien en contexte international) et Français niveau professionnel.

 Maîtrise de la programmation (ex: Java, LabVIEW) ou expertise du cycle d'intégration de satellites.

Des déplacements professionnels sont à prévoir ( 1 à 2 fois par an en Europe ou sur site de lancement, durée 2 à 3 semaines )
Vous serez amené(e) à travailler le samedi et en astreinte le dimanche ( 12 week-ends par an , planning discuté en équipe et communiqué 2 semaines en avance minimum) 
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air !

 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites.

items.title: Forward Strategist
items.card: The role Forward Strategists at Helsing sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Operations. Where engineering builds the system, the Forward Strategist works alongside it: landing in ambiguity, understanding the technical shape of the problem, and building a path through it that engineering, product, and operations teams can execute against. We deploy Forward Strategists against the highest-leverage
items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role 
 Forward Strategists at Helsing sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Operations. Where engineering builds the system, the Forward Strategist works alongside it: landing in ambiguity, understanding the technical shape of the problem, and building a path through it that engineering, product, and operations teams can execute against. We deploy Forward Strategists against the highest-leverage problems in the company, where you will embed deeply in the technical and product work, take full ownership of outcomes, and leave behind systems, tooling, and clarity that keep delivering long after you have moved on.
 The day-to-day 
 Take a poorly-defined technical or product problem, establish what it actually is, and build a structured path to resolution, setting direction through the ambiguity

items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As a Systems Engineer, Interceptors, you will shape the system architecture and requirements for AD-2 Ambush, Helsing’s solid-rocket-powered interceptor within the Contra air defence system. Designed to engage high-speed one-way attack drones and subsonic cruise missiles beyond AD-1’s reach, AD-2 can reach Mach 2.5 and engage targets at a range of 20 km. You will translate stakeholder needs and the threat environment into a coherent system concept, then develop the requirements, architecture and evidence needed to support testing, certification and production. You will also make sure that safety, security and through-life considerations are built into the system from the outset.

 Define AD-2’s system architecture and maintain traceability from customer requirements through to hardware and software design
 Coordinate system integration and verification, validation and qualification so that AD-2 meets its performance, safety and delivery requirements
 Work with software, hardware and programme teams to integrate and validate the system’s capabilities, including its radar seeker and container launch configuration
 Apply reliability, availability, maintainability and safety practices, and establish quality processes that support compliance with relevant defence standards and regulations
 Identify technical risks, assess their impact on delivery and agree mitigations with customers and industry partners as AD-2 progresses from testing towards production
 You should apply if you 
 Have delivered systems engineering for complex or safety-critical systems, including system architecture and requirements management
 Have translated system-level requirements into integrated hardware and software designs with engineering teams
 Have planned or delivered integration, verification, validation or qualification activities
 Apply reliability, availability, maintainability and safety practices to manage system risks and meet relevant standards

 Have worked on guided, rocket-powered or container-launched systems
 Have supported a defence system through testing and into production
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're scaling from 1,000 → 4,000 employees across 50+ countries, and the complexity of how we support our people through performance, conflict, and change is growing quickly. Our Employee Relations (ER) Partners protect fairness, consistency, and trust as we grow. You'll own our most sensitive and complex People cases, so that leads can act early.

As an ER Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll lead formal performance processes, investigations, grievances, and disciplinary matters from start to finish, working closely with Legal and outside counsel across many jurisdictions. You'll also coach leads through difficult conversations before they become formal cases, and turn what you see into playbooks, frameworks, and training that reduce risk and case volume over time.

This is our first ER hire. We're building a dedicated ER function, and we want someone who can help shape and build it out: how cases are triaged and escalated, how we work with counsel, and how we measure what's working.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can handle sensitive situations with discretion, make sound judgment calls, and bring clarity and calm to fast-moving environments.




YOU WILL

 - Lead formal performance processes, including back on track plans, end to end, in partnership with Leads and People Partners.

 - Run fair, well-documented investigations into misconduct allegations, grievances, and complaints, from fact-finding through to outcome.

 - Manage disciplinary, dismissal, and exit matters, drafting outcomes and communications with Legal.

 - Partner with in-house employment counsel and, when necessary, outside counsel to assess risk.

 - Triage incoming cases with People Partners using clear escalation criteria, so the right cases reach ER at the right time.

 - Keep the case log and report on patterns, risks, and trends by team, region, and case type.

 - Build playbooks, templates, and training that raise lead capability and cut avoidable cases.

 - Build out a self-serve ER flow for leads, so that common ER cases become scalable.

 - Partner with People Ops & Compliance teams to ensure smooth execution of terminations, local requirements, and compliance-heavy workflows.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Hands-on experience leading employee relations cases, including performance management, …

You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation
items.desc:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 - Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance

 - Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback

 - Own requirements, release readiness, and in-field performance and issue triage

 - Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles

 - Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements

 - Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features (Ownership through the full lifecycle)

 - Define and track quality metrics (e.g., comfort, tracking error, and safety margin KPIs, and regressions against them)

 - Contribute to safety artefacts: provide evidence for safety cases, work with the safety team to ensure compliance with required standards

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV). You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology.



🙌 You should apply if you have:


REQUIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

 - Strong fundamentals in control theory, with applied experience in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems

 - Practical experience developing, tuning and validating motion control on complex real world physical systems (e.g., direct experience with mobile robotics and/or autonomous vehicles)

 - Experience with test and validation discipline: unit and integration tests, simulation regression suites, closed-loop metrics.

 - Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++

 - Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software

 - Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware


DESIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

 - Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components

 - Vehicle dynamics and actuation. Steering, braking and powertrain interfaces, actuator delay models, and CAN or similar vehicle bus experience

 - Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls

 - Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262)

 - Experience with monitoring and diagnostics: Logging, fault detection, and on-platform debugging tools, ideally with experience investigating field issues

 - Experience across multiple platforms or vehicles. The team supports vehicle-to-vehicle variation, such as accounting for parameter identification, calibration, and keeping one software stack across hardware variants

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban …

items.desc:
Lieu : Bordeaux, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
En nous rejoignant à Mérignac, à proximité de Bordeaux, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée. 
 Dans le cadre du développement de nos solutions analytiques, nous recherchons un stagiaire en Data Science pour rejoindre notre équipe et rechercher des méthodes différentes de clustering actuellement utilisées pour une recherche de pattern, ou des méthodes de prédictions différentes de celles du projet. Vous aurez l’opportunité de travailler sur des algorithmes de machine Learning, en comparant leur pertinence et performance par rapport aux approches existantes, notamment les solutions basées sur le clustering traditionnel.
 Vos missions
 Étudier et analyser les algorithmes de clustering actuellement en place sur nos données
 Mettre en œuvre différents modèles de machine learning (clustering, analyses topologiques, etc.) afin d’identifier des méthodologies plus pertinentes et performantes
 Évaluer et comparer la qualité des clusters obtenus selon différents critères (cohérence, densité, séparation, topologie, etc.)
 Proposer des recommandations pour optimiser les méthodes de segmentation et de partition des données
 Documenter les résultats et présenter les conclusions à l’équipe
 Votre profil
 Vous préparez une formation de n iveau Bac+5 en Data Science, Statistiques, Informatique , vous recherchez un stage de 6 mois et avez des connaissances en :
 Algorithmes de machine learning , notamment le clustering (k-means, DBSCAN, clustering hiérarchique, etc.)

 Python (scikit-learn, pandas, numpy)
 Anglais

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

En rejoignant le site de Toulouse, vous intégrez un site regroupant nos solutions de cyberdéfense souveraines pour faire face aux menaces informatiques croissantes et nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée. 
 Au sein d’une équipe travaillant sur l’exploitation d’images satellitaires issues de capteurs innovants, vous contribuerez au développement de méthodes de recalage entre images visible et infra-rouge . 
 e stage vous permettra d’intervenir sur des problématiques avancées de traitement d’image, de vision par ordinateur et d’intelligence artificielle appliquées au domaine spatial.
 La qualité de la mise en correspondance entre les différentes bandes spectrales est un enjeu majeur pour de nombreuses applications, notamment la génération de modèles 3D, l’observation de la Terre et les traitements scientifiques réalisés à partir de données satellitaires.
 Vous serez amené à :
 Analyser les difficultés spécifiques liées au recalage d’images multi-bandes, notamment les différences géométriques, radiométriques, de contraste et de résolution.
 Étudier les méthodes existantes de mise en correspondance entre images visible et infra-rouge .
 Concevoir et développer en Python une chaîne de traitement permettant le recalage robuste d’images satellitaires.
 Mettre en œuvre et évaluer des approches basées sur l’ intelligence artificielle et le Deep Learning .
 Comparer les performances des approches IA avec des méthodes plus classiques de traitement d’image.
 Valider les résultats obtenus sur des données satellitaires issues de capteurs innovants et analyser les performances des différentes solutions.
 Documenter les travaux réalisés et présenter les résultats obtenus aux équipes techniques.
 Votre profil
 Votre priorité est de réaliser un stage de fin d’études à la frontière entre l’ imagerie satellitaire , le traitement d’image et l’ intelligence artificielle ?
 Vous avez l’ambition de développer vos compétences sur des problématiques scientifiques et techniques appliquées à l’exploitation de données spatiales ?
 Vous avez envie de travailler sur des données réelles issues de capteurs satellitaires innovants ?
 Vous préparez votre dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou un Master 2 Bac+5 avec une spécialisation en traitement d’image , vision par ordinateur ou intelligence artificielle, et vous avez des connaissances sur :
 Le traitement d’image .
 Le développement en Python .
 Les méthodes de vision par ordinateur et d’analyse d’images.
 L’ intelligence artificielle et le Deep Learning .
 Un intérêt pour le domaine spatial, l’imagerie optique ou les données satellitaires serait particulièrement apprécié.
 Votre autonomie, votre curiosité, votre rigueur et votre capacité d’analyse sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnait ?
 Alors ce stage est fait pour vous !
 Le mot de l’équipe
 Vous aurez l’opportunité de travailler sur un sujet concret et exigeant, à la frontière entre l’imagerie satellitaire et l’intelligence artificielle.
 Rejoignez-nous pour relever ce défi technique et contribuer au développement des futures générations de traitements d’images spatiales.
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études.

items.card: ABOUT THE ROLE As a Talent Partner at Faculty, you will own the end-to-end recruitment process, attracting and engaging exceptional talent to power our high-growth business goals. Operating within our People team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers across all levels while driving an inclusive, world-class candidate experience within the commercial space and across our Central Functions. This is
items.desc:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.




ABOUT THE ROLE 



As a Talent Partner at Faculty, you will own the end-to-end recruitment process, attracting and engaging exceptional talent to power our high-growth business goals. Operating within our People team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers across all levels while driving an inclusive, world-class candidate experience within the commercial space and across our Central Functions. 



This is an opportunity to shape our hiring strategy, solve complex talent challenges, and directly contribute to building a world-leading AI organisation.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 - Owning the recruitment lifecycle from initial scoping through to interviewing, offer management, and candidate onboarding.

 - Sourcing passive talent creatively across platforms like LinkedIn, networking channels, and referrals to build diverse candidate pipelines.

 - Partnering closely with business leaders as a trusted advisor, offering data-backed insights and guiding recruitment strategy.

 - Designing structured interview packs and assessment criteria to ensure objective, high-quality hiring decisions.

 - Driving diversity and inclusion initiatives throughout every step of the hiring funnel.

 - Analysing recruitment data and pipeline metrics to identify bottlenecks and optimize process performance.

 - Amplifying Faculty’s employer brand by representing the company at industry events, conferences, and meetups.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - You bring experience managing end-to-end talent acquisition processes, ideally within a fast-moving, in-house environment within the commercial and/or GTM space.

 - You possess strong direct-sourcing skills and know how to leverage modern applicant tracking systems to engage top-tier passive candidates.

 - You excel at stakeholder management, building authentic relationships across all levels while balancing support with constructive challenge.

 - You take an agile, problem-solving approach to recruitment, adapting quickly to change while upholding high standards of confidentiality and compliance.

 - You prioritise quality over volume, demonstrating resilience and a dedication to delivering an outstanding, inclusive candidate experience.

 - You are a confident, articulate communicator who thrives as a brand ambassador, passionately sharing our culture and ambition with prospective talent.




OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Initial Talent Screen (30 mins)

 2. Introductory interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins) 

 3. Competency & Scenario based interview (60 mins)






OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 



A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

items.card: What You'll Do: Design, build, and deliver backend capabilities that support Spotify's commerce platform, from solution design through to production. Develop and improve scalable services powering merchandising, order management, payment orchestration, and purchase experiences. Work with complex, high-traffic systems to improve reliability, performance, and scalability. Collaborate with engineers and teams across
items.desc:
What You'll Do:
Design, build, and deliver backend capabilities that support Spotify's commerce platform, from solution design through to production.
 Develop and improve scalable services powering merchandising, order management, payment orchestration, and purchase experiences.
 Work with complex, high-traffic systems to improve reliability, performance, and scalability.
 Collaborate with engineers and teams across Spotify to deliver solutions that support our listeners and subscription business.
 Work with cloud infrastructure, databases, and data pipelines to build and maintain reliable backend systems.
 Contribute to technical discussions, engineering workshops, and solution reviews, sharing ideas and learning from your peers.
 Help improve engineering practices and contribute to a collaborative environment where knowledge-sharing and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.
Who You Are:
You have experience developing and scaling backend services using Java, Python, or similar technologies in a cloud environment such as Google Cloud Platform.
 You're familiar with scalable database technologies such as PostgreSQL and understand the fundamentals of building reliable backend systems.
 You have exposure to data systems and pipelines, or you're interested in developing your expertise in this area.
 You enjoy tackling technical challenges, breaking down complex problems, and finding practical solutions.
 You communicate clearly and are comfortable sharing ideas, participating in technical discussions, and presenting your work to others.
 You're proactive, take ownership of your work, and enjoy learning new technologies and approaches.
 You value collaboration, feedback, and working with people from different technical backgrounds to achieve shared goals.
 Experience in e-commerce, payments, or financial engineering is valuable, but not essential.
Where You'll Be:
This role is based in London or Stockholm
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

items.desc:
Be part of the future of mobility at CERN and lead projects contributing to the delivery and evolution of CERN's mobility strategy. You will coordinate the implementation of the mobility plan, prepare the next mobility plan, and lead cross-functional projects and events that improve mobility across CERN sites .
 Your responsibilities: 
 Coordinate and monitor the actions of CERN's mobility plan through to the 2028 horizon, including milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions and follow-up actions.
 Maintain a consolidated project portfolio and ensure regular, reliable reporting on status, priorities, issues and forthcoming decisions.
 Work with action owners and stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into practical workplans, deliverables and implementation steps.
 Contribute to the preparation of the future CERN mobility plan by gathering needs, analysing lessons learned, structuring consultations and drafting supporting material.
 Pilot mobility-related projects and events, from initial scoping and stakeholder alignment through implementation, operational coordination and post-event review.
 Participate actively in the CERN mobility working group, prepare inputs and meetings, document conclusions, and coordinate agreed follow-up.
 Support communication and stakeholder engagement on mobility initiatives, ensuring that information is clear, timely and adapted to the target audience.
 Identify opportunities for service improvement, sustainability and better user experience, and formulate evidence-based recommendations for decision-making.
 Ensure that project documentation, decisions, indicators and lessons learned are recorded and accessible for continuity and governance purposes.
 Your profile: 
 Graduated in Project Management, Transport and Mobility, Urban Planning, Sustainability, Engineering, Business Administration, Public Policy or a related field.
 Initial experience in project coordination, multi-stakeholder initiatives, mobility, events, sustainability or service development would be an asset.
 Experience in an international or multidisciplinary environment would be an advantage.
 Skills: 
 Ability to structure and monitor projects, action plans, milestones, risks and deliverables.
 Strong analytical and drafting skills, with the ability to turn varied inputs into concise reports and recommendations.
 Good command of common office, collaboration, presentation and project-tracking tools.
 Ability to organise meetings, workshops and events and to ensure systematic follow-up.
 Interest in sustainable mobility, transport services and user-centred service improvement.
 Clear communication and stakeholder management.
 Ability to work autonomously while escalating risks and decisions appropriately.
 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 You have a professional background in Transportation Management, Civil Engineering (or a related field) and have either: a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
 or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
