items.title: Mechanical Design Engineer (EN-MME-MD-2026-250-GRAE)
items.card: You will join the Design Office that is in charge of mechanical design of components required for CERN's accelerator and detectors, comprising many high-tech equipment such as superconducting magnets and cavities, vacuum systems and instrumentation. And under the supervision of a senior design engineer, you will design and develop mechanical components and systems from concept to production. What we offer: A
items.desc:
As a motivated young mechanical design engineer, with a specific interest in seeking practical solutions around mechanical systems, CERN's graduate program may very well give you that challenging opportunity.
The mandate of the MME group, within the Engineering Department (EN), is to provide to the CERN community specific engineering solutions combining mechanical design, fabrication and material sciences. Historically the group maintains and develops the know-how on the mechanical construction of beam accelerator components and physics detectors. You will join the Design Office that is in charge of mechanical design of components required for CERN's accelerator and detectors, comprising many high-tech equipment such as superconducting magnets and cavities, vacuum systems and instrumentation. And under the supervision of a senior design engineer, you will design and develop mechanical components and systems from concept to production.
 What we offer:
 A collaborative and innovative work environment.
 Opportunities for professional growth and development.
 Access to the latest tools and technologies.
 Supportive team culture focused on achieving excellence.
 Your responsibilities 
 Design and develop mechanical components and systems from concept to production.
 Create detailed 3D models and 2D drawings using CATIA V5, adhering to ISO GPS norms.
 Carry out simple structural analysis and numerical calculations.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams within the group, material science, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure design feasibility and manufacturability.
 Continuously improve designs based on feedback and testing results.
 Participate in problem-solving and troubleshooting activities related to design and production issues.
 Maintain accurate documentation of designs, modifications, and project progress.
 Your profile 
 Initial experience in mechanical design and development of mechanical components or assemblies.
 Knowledge of 3D CAD modelling and 2D technical drafting, preferably using CATIA V5
 Understanding of mechanical engineering principles, including materials, manufacturing processes and mechanical behaviour of structures.
 Skills 
 Proficiency in CAD software such as CATIA V5 for creating 3D & 2D drawings.
 Strong understanding of ISO GPS norms and their application in mechanical design.
 Practical knowledge of mechanics and mechanical systems.
 Ability to learn new languages (French / English).
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
 Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
 Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job Description: 
 Leonardo è un gruppo industriale internazionale, tra le principali realtà mondiali nell’Aerospazio, Difesa e Sicurezza che realizza capacità tecnologiche multidominio in ambito Elicotteri, Velivoli, Aerostrutture, Elettronica, Cyber Security e Spazio. Con oltre 60.000 dipendenti nel mondo, l’azienda ha una solida presenza industriale in Italia, Regno Unito, Polonia, Stati Uniti, e opera in 150 paesi anche attraverso aziende controllate, joint venture e partecipazioni. Protagonista dei principali programmi strategici a livello globale, è partner tecnologico e industriale di Governi, Amministrazioni della Difesa, Istituzioni e imprese.
 All'interno dell'Area Engineering Configuration Management siamo alla ricerca di un/una Simulators & Ground Support Configuration Management Specialist per il nostro sito di Torino.
 La risorsa di occuperà del configuration management dei training devices e ground support su vari programmi aziendali.
 Le principali attività sono:
 Governance e applicazione operativa del processo di Configuration Management (configuration identification, change control e status accounting)
 Definizione, aggiornamento ed emissione dei Configuration Management Plan (CMP) dei sistemi di addestramento e ground support
 Identificazione e gestione dei configuration items (HW e SW), definizione e mantenimento delle configuration baseline e controllo delle modifiche tramite il processo di Change Request
 Gestione e coordinamento dei Configuration Change Board (CCB)
 Partecipazione e supporto alle review di Progetto/Programma
 Titolo di studio:
 Laurea (triennale o magistrale) in Ingegneria o discipline scientifiche (STEM).
 Livello di esperienza richiesto (junior, expert, senior, master)
 Junior

 Conoscenza fasi delle fasi di sviluppo (SRR, PDR, CDR …).

 Richiesta precisione, attenzione ai dettagli e approccio metodico.
 Capacità di lavorare con processi strutturati.
 Buona capacità di comunicazione e organizzative.
 Conoscenze linguistiche:
 Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. In particolare, è richiesta la capacità di leggere, comprendere e preparare testi tecnici in inglese.
 Conoscenze Informatiche:
 Conoscenza del pacchetto Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, ecc.).

 Disponibilità a brevi trasferte.

items.desc:
Tu Negocio con Zurich | Programa de Desarrollo de Nuevos Agentes
 ¿Buscas algo más que un empleo? ¿Y si tu próximo paso profesional fuera construir tu propio negocio con el respaldo de Zurich? 
 Si buscas algo más que un trabajo tradicional, quieres tener más autonomía y te atrae la idea de desarrollar tu propio proyecto profesional, estás en el lugar correcto.
 En Zurich lanzamos nuestro Programa de Desarrollo para Agentes Exclusivos en Andalucía 
 Se trata de una oportunidad para desarrollar tu propio negocio como autónomo siendo agente exclusivo para Zurich, creando así tu propia agencia, con el respaldo, la formación, las herramientas y el acompañamiento de una compañía sólida, reconocida y con una apuesta clara por el crecimiento de su red de agentes.
 Esta oportunidad no va solo de vender seguros.
 Va de crear tu propia actividad profesional, desarrollar una cartera de clientes y crecer acompañado desde el primer día.
 ¿Cómo será tu día a día? 
 Asesoramiento de alto valor: Asesorarás a personas, familias y empresas para ayudarles a proteger lo que más les importa, ofreciendo soluciones aseguradoras adaptadas a sus necesidades.
 Desarrollo de tu propio negocio 
Construirás tu propia cartera de clientes y desarrollarás una actividad profesional con recorrido, apoyándote en una marca reconocida y en un modelo pensado para crecer.
 Una propuesta de valor pensada para ayudarte a crecer 
Tendrás una propuesta de valor sólida y servicios de apoyo pensados para que puedas centrarte en lo importante: generar confianza, asesorar bien a tus clientes y hacer crecer tu negocio.
 Gestión comercial con herramientas digitales 
Contarás con herramientas, datos y recursos comerciales que te ayudarán a gestionar oportunidades, hacer seguimiento de clientes y dedicar más tiempo a generar negocio.
 Autonomía con acompañamiento 
Organizarás tu actividad con autonomía, pero no estarás solo. Tendrás el apoyo de profesionales expertos que te acompañarán en tu arranque, planificación comercial y evolución como agente.
 ¿Encajas en esta propuesta? 
 No buscamos la perfección, ¡buscamos actitud, iniciativa y ganas reales de construir algo propio!
 Este plan es ideal si tienes estudios mínimos (Bachillerato, FP o Grado), aptitudes comunicativas y en servicio al cliente y tienes vocación comercial.
 Valoramos la experiencia previa en el sector asegurador o en posiciones comerciales, pero no es imprescindible.
Lo importante es que tengas ambición, compromiso y ganas de aprender.
 ¿Qué te ofrecemos en Zurich? 
 Un programa para ayudarte a construir tu propio negocio
 No se trata solo de empezar como agente. Se trata de hacerlo acompañado, con un programa diseñado para ayudarte a arrancar, aprender, ganar confianza comercial y crecer paso a paso.
 Formación y certificación oficial
 Financiamos tu curso homologado de mediación (Nivel 2 DGSFP) y te acompañaremos para que puedas iniciar tu actividad profesional con una base sólida.
 Acompañamiento desde el primer día
 Contarás con apoyo experto para orientarte en tus primeros pasos, ayudarte a planificar tu actividad comercial y acompañarte en el desarrollo de tu negocio
 Tranquilidad Financiera Inicial y elevado potencial de crecimiento: modelo de comisiones e incentivos altamente competitivo, complementado con un esquema de apoyo económico durante el arranque
 Una carrera con futuro 
Queremos acompañarte para que puedas construir una cartera, consolidar tu actividad profesional y desarrollar una agencia con recorrido.
 ¿Por qué Zurich? 
 Porque no queremos que seas un agente más. 
 Queremos acompañarte en la construcción de tu propio negocio, con formación, herramientas, apoyo comercial y una marca que apuesta por el desarrollo de nuevos agentes como una palanca clave de crecimiento. 
 Estamos construyendo la nueva generación de agentes Zurich. 
 Y queremos contar con personas que quieran formar parte de este proyecto desde el inicio. 
 ¿Sientes que esto es para ti? 
 Si te ves construyendo tu propio negocio, no lo pienses más, haz clic en inscribirte. Estaré encantada de conocerte, tomar un café (virtual o real) y contarte cómo puedes empezar a construir tu carrera como agente profesional independiente con el respaldo de Zurich.
 Empieza a construir tu propio negocio con Zurich.
 Por qué elegir Zurich 
 En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?
 Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor! 
 Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

Möchtest du deine juristische Expertise in einem erfahrenen Spezialisten-Team einbringen und dich langfristig im Vorsorge- und Versicherungsrecht
items.desc:
137388 | 80 - 100% | Oerlikon, Zürich | Hybrid
 Motiviert dich der Gedanke, anspruchsvolle rechtliche Fragestellungen rund um die berufliche und private Vorsorge zu bearbeiten und dabei insbesondere unsere französischsprachigen Kundinnen und Kunden zu unterstützen? Möchtest du deine juristische Expertise in einem erfahrenen Spezialisten-Team einbringen und dich langfristig im Vorsorge- und Versicherungsrecht weiterentwickeln?
 In dieser Rolle verstärkst du bei Zurich Schweiz den Geschäftsbereich Claims im Bereich Leistungen Leben, Rechtsdienst Leben, und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg. Als Teil eines eingespielten Teams von Juristinnen und Juristen bearbeitest du selbstständig rechtliche Fragestellungen und Fälle aus der beruflichen Vorsorge, Säule 3a und Lebensversicherung, mit einem besonderen Fokus auf die französischsprachige Schweiz, und führst Gerichtsverfahren. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du unsere Claims Teams sowie weitere Fachbereiche mit deiner rechtlichen Expertise und bringst dich in Projekte und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Vorsorgethemen ein. Referatstätigkeiten bei Schulungen und Kundenanlässen runden die herausfordernde und vielseitige Tätigkeit ab. 
 Das erwartet dich 
 Du bearbeitest selbstständig anspruchsvolle Rechtsfälle in der beruflichen und privaten Vorsorge, insbesondere in französischer Sprache 
 Du führst Gerichtsverfahren und vertrittst die Interessen von Zurich in rechtlichen Auseinandersetzungen 
 Du berätst Claims Teams und weitere Fachbereiche bei rechtlichen Fragestellungen rund um Kollektivleben, Einzelleben und Vorsorge 
 Du arbeitest in fachübergreifenden Projekten mit und bringst die juristische Perspektive in die Entwicklung von Lösungen und Prozessen ein 
 Du arbeitest mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen wie Kundinnen und Kunden, Vertrieb, Rechtsvertretungen, Vertragspartnern und Behörden zusammen 
 Das zeichnet dich aus 
 Juristischer Hochschulabschluss (Master of Law oder lic. iur.) einer Schweizer Universität, vorzugsweise mit Anwaltspatent 
 Sehr gute Französischkenntnisse sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 
 Ausgeprägtes Interesse an der beruflichen und privaten Vorsorge sowie an versicherungs- und steuerrechtlichen Fragestellungen 
 Fähigkeit, komplexe rechtliche Sachverhalte selbstständig zu analysieren und verständliche, praxisorientierte Lösungen zu entwickeln 
 Überzeugende Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise 
 Gut zu wissen 
 Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100% 
 Arbeitsort: Oerlikon, Zürich 
 Stellenantritt : ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung 
 Reisetätigkeit: Keine 
 Hybrides Arbeiten: bis zu 40% 
 Alles rund um deine Bewerbung 
 Du kannst dich in einem ersten Schritt direkt online bei uns bewerben – dafür benötigst du nur deinen Lebenslauf. Weitere Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier . 
 Wir legen Wert auf einen effizienten und wertschätzenden Bewerbungsprozess. Das Talent Acquisition Team prüft deine Bewerbung persönlich, ohne Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz. Ab deinem ersten persönlichen Kennenlernen mit der zuständigen Führungskraft erhältst du von uns immer eine individuelle Rückmeldung. Denn wir sind überzeugt: Aussagekräftiges Feedback basiert auf dem persönlichen Austausch. 
 Für diese Position arbeiten wir nicht mit Personalvermittlungen zusammen. Unaufgefordert eingereichte Bewerbungen werden weder berücksichtigt noch vergütet. 
 Hast du noch Fragen? Bernd, Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant steht dir unter +41 44 628 42 14 gerne zur Verfügung.

items.title: Traineeship Insurance Administrator - Belgium
items.card: you will be fully immersed in the Underwriting Services department. You get to do 3 rotations in 3 different sub-teams (Domestic, International and European team), each with their own specialization. You’ll get the opportunity to discover your strengths, and we will provide an environment where you can develop your professional skills. Your responsibilities: Collecting data and drawing up policies & endorsements
items.desc:
About us: 
Zurich Insurance is a leading insurance company based in the Benelux, where we specialize in non-life insurance for businesses. Our ambition is to become one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. To get there, we hire and develop some of the world’s best talent. With Zurich, you can expect meaningful and impactful work that will help you grow, and to collaborate with a diverse and inclusive global team. We are now looking for a trainee to join our Underwriting Services (UWS) department in Belgium, Zaventem.
 Traineeship overview 
 The UWS department is crucial to our company. After an insurance deal is closed, the department takes care of all the administration from A to Z. Within about 1 year, you will be fully immersed in the Underwriting Services department. You get to do 3 rotations in 3 different sub-teams (Domestic, International and European team), each with their own specialization. You’ll get the opportunity to discover your strengths, and we will provide an environment where you can develop your professional skills.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Collecting data and drawing up policies & endorsements
 Processing financial data and issuing invoices
 Working closely with different departments and providing the right service to customers and insurance brokers
 Coordinating international insurance programs for large Belgian multinationals
 Continuously looking at how processes can be improved, which you present to your team
 What you can expect from us: 
 Opportunities for professional growth and development. After the traineeship of 1 year, you’ll stay on board at Underwriting Services where you can further develop your career.
 Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
 A collaborative, international and inclusive corporate culture: be yourself in a diverse workplace
 Be the CEO of your career: Take on new challenges and responsibilities as you grow with us
 About you: 
 In addition to Dutch and/or French, you also speak excellent English (reading & writing)
 You have recently obtained a Bachelor or Master degree or equivalent (“graduaat”)
 You have a maximum of 2 years of work experience and want to take on a new challenge. Knowledge of the insurance sector is a plus, but certainly not a requirement.
 You are analytically strong, detail oriented and work well with numbers.
 You are service-oriented and proactive, you go the extra mile and have a can-do mentality.
 Ready to grow with us? 
 Apply today and help us shape a brighter tomorrow—for you, for Zurich, and for our communities. We look forward to welcoming you to our team and supporting you in being the CEO of your own career!

items.desc:
Short Description
 Are you a robotics engineer who enjoys explaining technology, engaging with industry and helping researchers develop meaningful collaborations? The EPFL Robotics Center seeks a professional with a solid robotics background, hands-on engineering experience and strong presentation skills to act as the technical bridge between its laboratories and industrial partners.
 Your technical expertise will underpin the role: understanding laboratory capabilities, assessing industrial challenges, preparing and presenting robotics demonstrations, and supporting the development of relevant research opportunities. You will combine practical engineering with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with researchers, industrial partners and visitors.
 Mission 
 Your mission is to apply your robotics expertise to make the Center's laboratory capabilities visible, accessible and ready for collaboration — and to help translate industrial needs into relevant research opportunities. Working closely with laboratory teams, you will develop and maintain a thorough technical map of their expertise. You will prepare and run live demonstrations during visits, workshops and events, prepare audience-adapted technical materials with the lab teams, and help scope technical follow-up.
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 Develop, adapt, and improve prototypes and demonstrators to showcase robotics technologies and maintain technical documentation, software configurations, setup procedures, and operating instructions to ensure systems can be operated reliably.
 Integrate lab demonstrators into event and visit setups, including on-site installation, interfacing, calibration and troubleshooting.
 Build and maintain detailed hands-on knowledge of the participating laboratories’ robotic platforms, software stacks, prototypes and experimental setups.
 Keep an up-to-date technical map of lab capabilities, including technology readiness levels, available demonstrators, equipment and key contacts among PhD students and postdocs.
 Work with lab engineers and researchers to keep demonstrators operational, transportable and ready to show.
 Act as the technical contact for industry requests: clarify the need, check feasibility and identify the matching labs.
 Write short technical pre-assessments and involve professors only when there is a clear research fit.
 Set up and run live demonstrations during visits, workshops and events, and explain what the systems can and cannot do.
 Prepare technical materials with the lab teams, adapted to each audience.
 Help scope technical follow-up, such as feasibility studies, tests and proposal content, and coordinate practical next steps with labs, companies and EPFL services.
 Profile 
 Master’s or PhD degree in robotics or a closely related engineering field, with a demonstrated specialisation in robotics.
 Demonstrated hands-on engineering experience in robotics, including the integration, programming, testing, and troubleshooting of robotic systems.
 Strong practical skills in robotics software and hardware, with experience in areas such as ROS/ROS 2, C++ or Python, sensors, actuators, control systems, robotic perception.
 Ability to understand research contributions, discuss industrial requirements and assess the fit between technical challenges and laboratory expertise.
 Strong speaking and presentation skills, with the ability to demonstrate technologies and explain complex concepts accurately to different audiences.
 Good organisational skills and the ability to work autonomously within agreed priorities.
 Familiarity with Swiss and European research and innovation ecosystems is an asset.
 Excellent command of English, German and French.
 Please note that only applications meeting the criteria of the advertisement will be considered.
 We offer 
 At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation. 
 We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference.
 Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year.

Telefónica Defensa y Seguridad es la compañía del Grupo Telefónica especializada en el diseño, desarrollo, implantación y gestión de soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas en los ámbitos de la defensa y la seguridad. Contribuimos al propósito del Grupo de ser la mejor vía de acceso de ciudadanos, empresas e instituciones a las tecnologías digitales, acercando la innovación a la protección de personas, infraestructuras críticas y activos esenciales.
 Acompañamos a las Fuerzas Armadas, las Fuerzas y Cuerpos de Seguridad, las administraciones públicas y las organizaciones de sectores estratégicos con soluciones adaptadas a sus necesidades. Integramos tecnología, inteligencia y capacidad operativa para anticipar y responder a amenazas, reforzar la continuidad operativa y la resiliencia, y generar confianza en entornos de alta exigencia www.telefonica.es 
 Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a Preventa para proporcionar soporte técnico y consultivo a las distintas áreas de negocio de la compañía, participando en el análisis de necesidades, el diseño de soluciones y la elaboración de propuestas de valor para nuestros clientes. La persona seleccionada será responsable de definir la solución técnico-funcional más adecuada en cada oportunidad, colaborando con equipos multidisciplinares para garantizar propuestas competitivas, innovadoras y alineadas con los requisitos de calidad, alcance y plazo establecidos.
 Funciones 
 Análisis de necesidades y requisitos: estudiar las necesidades de los clientes y analizar pliegos técnicos, especificaciones y documentación de licitaciones, identificando requisitos funcionales, técnicos y operativos.
 Diseño de soluciones tecnológicas: definir y dimensionar arquitecturas y soluciones de seguridad física y electrónica e integración de sistemas, seleccionando las tecnologías más adecuadas para cada proyecto.
 Elaboración de propuestas técnico-económicas: preparar memorias técnicas, presupuestos, estimaciones de costes, matrices de cumplimiento y el resto de documentación necesaria para la presentación de ofertas.
 Gestión integral de oportunidades: asumir la responsabilidad técnica de las propuestas, coordinando su desarrollo desde el análisis inicial hasta la presentación final y garantizando el cumplimiento de requisitos, calidad y plazos.
 Coordinación con fabricantes y partners: identificar y evaluar alternativas, solicitar y analizar propuestas técnicas y económicas y colaborar con proveedores y socios tecnológicos para construir soluciones competitivas.
 Colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares: trabajar conjuntamente con las áreas comerciales, ingeniería, operaciones y especialistas de otras disciplinas para garantizar la viabilidad técnica, económica y operativa de las soluciones.
 Análisis de viabilidad y riesgos: identificar riesgos técnicos, económicos y de ejecución, proponiendo alternativas y medidas de mitigación.
 Interlocución y defensa técnica: participar en reuniones con clientes, presentaciones técnicas y sesiones de aclaración, defendiendo las soluciones propuestas y dando respuesta a las necesidades planteadas.
 Versatilidad tecnológica y desarrollo de nuevas capacidades: participar en proyectos de diferentes ámbitos tecnológicos, adquiriendo los conocimientos necesarios para analizar requisitos, plantear soluciones y coordinar su desarrollo con los equipos especialistas correspondientes.
 Innovación y mejora continua: mantenerse actualizado sobre la evolución tecnológica e identificar nuevas soluciones y oportunidades que contribuyan a mejorar la competitividad de las propuestas.
 Formación y experiencia 
 Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones, Informática, Industrial o disciplinas técnicas afines.
 Experiencia profesional mínima de 5 años en preventa tecnológica, ingeniería de soluciones o elaboración de propuestas técnicas .
 Experiencia demostrable en el diseño y dimensionamiento de soluciones de seguridad física y electrónica , especialmente sistemas de videovigilancia, control de accesos, detección de intrusión y plataformas de gestión e integración de sistemas.
 Capacidad para definir arquitecturas y soluciones integradas, combinando diferentes tecnologías, fabricantes y plataformas.
 Experiencia en preparación de ofertas técnicas y económicas , incluyendo dimensionamiento, elaboración de presupuestos, estimaciones de costes y análisis de viabilidad.
 Experiencia en el análisis e interpretación de pliegos técnicos y participación en procesos de licitación.
 Capacidad para gestionar propuestas de forma autónoma, coordinando diferentes interlocutores y garantizando el cumplimiento de requisitos y plazos.

 Buenas habilidades de comunicación y redacción técnica.

Colaboración en la adaptación de controles internos de reporte que se adapten a los nuevos avances que están teniendo lugar en materia regulatoria. 
 ¿Qué otros aspectos valoramos? 📚 
 Formación académica o conocimientos en sostenibilidad corporativa, ESG, reporting no financiero y financiero, contabilidad, auditoría, finanzas o áreas afines. items.desc:
Overview 
 Team purpose
 With a vision to "Build and sell Microsoft AI, Cloud applications, services, and devices with partners, empowering people and organizations to achieve more," SME&C Channel Partner Sales (CPS) is responsible for driving revenue outcomes with partners through innovative solutions—at scale. The Global Channel partner Sales team delivers SME&C growth and market share across AI Business Solutions, Cloud & AI platforms, and Security within GCPS by capturing total addressable market (TAM) and accelerating cloud growth at scale through our top Channel Sales partner. Our approach is grounded in Cloud Solution Provider acceleration, cc-sell precision, and performance accountability—executed consistently across all solution areas and every stage of the MCEM Win Formula. We are committed to delivering on our segment and revenue accountabilities by aligning execution with measurable impact, fostering partner transformation, and enabling scalable, outcome-driven growth. 
 Job Purpose 
 As a Cloud Solution Architect, you will guide the development of business solutions, provide deep technical insights, and accelerate the growth of Microsoft Tech priorities. You will work closely with partners to understand their technical requirements and business objectives, and guide them through architectural design sessions, developing proof of concepts, and help them transition from legacy systems to modern cloud environments, ensuring that their solutions are optimized for performance and cost-efficiency. Join our team as a Cloud Solution Architect and play a pivotal role in guiding our most significant partners to designing and implementing innovative scalable, secure, and efficient cloud architectures that meet market needs. By leveraging your skills in technical leadership, cloud computing, software development, problem solving and systems architecture, you will drive business impact by enabling digital transformation, optimizing performance, and driving innovation through the effective use of cloud technologies.
 Company Culture 
 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on Our values Of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture Of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 As a Partner Solution Architect (PSA), you will serve as the deep technical SME to partners' technical force & own the partner's technical strategy plan for their Cloud Solution Area (CSA). Withing your responsibilities are: 
 Guide Solution Development & Activation - You'll lead the development and activation of new or enhanced partner offerings that align with Microsoft Cloud priorities. Your focus will be on ensuring these solutions are robust, scalable, secure, and tailored to meet evolving customer needs.
 Empower Innovation - You'll run technical innovation workshops, tech briefings, and envisioning sessions to build technical intensity across partner teams. By collaborating with engineering and product teams, you'll help accelerate the adoption of emerging technologies and shape partner Offerings that align with both business goals and technical requirements.
 Strategic Sales Enablement - You'll play a key role in activating transformational deals by providing architectural guidance, resolving technical blockers, and enhancing solution design. Your work will directly contribute to workload consumption and revenue impact.
 Champion Technical Excellence - You'll guide partners through architecture design sessions, proof-of-concepts, and MVP builds. You'll ensure that solutions follow Microsoft's Cloud and AI best practices and are optimized for performance, scalability, and security.
 Thought Leadership & Stakeholder Management - You'll build long-term engagements with strategic partners, influencing their adoption of Microsoft technologies. You'll develop deep technical relationships with CXOs and foster executive alignment to support joint success. Job Requirements Internal Job Additional Details External & Internal Footer partner Enablement & Business Acumen - You'll coach broader partner technical teams to ensure pre-sales, deployrnent, and consumption are embedded in solution development. You'll help partners build resilience to technical challenges, navigate competitive landscapes, and translate technical concepts into business value. 
 Qualifications 
 This job requires Dutch / Flamish language proficiency (verbal and written). 
 Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND relevant experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, …

Overview 
 As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process. 
 This role is based in North Paris 
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. 
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. 
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals.  Contributes to issue tracking through escalations, asking questions, and seeking guidance on timely resolution of issues from more experienced technicians.

 Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with guidance from other technicians. 
 Complies with security and data management procedures and policies with guidance from other technicians and completes the required security training. 
 Maintains a strong client focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned tasks. 
 Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work. 
 Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and ownership of the data center facilities. 
 Embodies our culture and values .

 1+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.

Overview 
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) team powers the infrastructure behind our cloud services. We’re looking for an IT Technical Trainer to help datacenter technicians build the knowledge and practical skills they need to succeed.
 In this role, you’ll deliver engaging technical training, identify learning needs, and work with colleagues to keep training aligned with evolving technologies and operational processes. You’ll support learners at different stages of their careers and help create an inclusive environment where everyone feels comfortable asking questions and developing their skills.
 This is an on-site datacenter role, with limited opportunities to work from home.
 At Microsoft, we bring a growth mindset to our work, collaborate to achieve shared goals, and act with respect, integrity, and accountability. We’re committed to a workplace where everyone can thrive
 Responsibilities 
 Deliver technical training in person and virtually, using presentations, discussions, hands-on labs, simulations, and other methods suited to the learning objectives.
 Prepare and adapt learning experiences to meet workforce needs and support datacenter operational goals.
 Stay informed about relevant technologies, features, and processes, and incorporate updates into training delivery.
 Use feedback and relevant measures to evaluate learning effectiveness and identify improvements.
 Create a supportive learning environment, encourage questions, and adapt your approach to help learners understand and apply key concepts.
 Guide hands-on activities and provide constructive coaching that supports learners’ development.
 Share feedback on course content with the wider Learning team to help keep training consistent, relevant, and effective.
 Contribute to procedural change-management activities and embody Microsoft’s culture and values.
 Qualifications 
 Required qualifications
 A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and practical experience in training, education, information technology, cloud systems, datacenter or server environments, or computer technologies; or equivalent practical experience.
 Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and support learning through a range of delivery methods.
 Ability to meet applicable Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements.
 Background check requirement: This role requires a Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.
 Preferred qualifications
 Demonstrated experience in datacenter or IT operations across relevant functions.
 Strong written and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders and organizational leaders.
 A technical training certification, such as CompTIA CTT+, an equivalent qualification, or the ability to complete a relevant certification within six months of hire.
 A relevant industry framework or technical certification, such as ITIL, PRINCE2, Lean Six Sigma, CCNA, MCSE, or Network+.

items.desc:
Overview 
 As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
 Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
 Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
 Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.
 Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
 Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training.
 Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
 Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
 Embodies our culture and values 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications : 
 Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.
 Experienced in diagnostics, troubleshooting , route cause analysis of hardware deployments. 
 Experience of Decommissioning and Upgrading hardware. 
 You may be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
 Background Check Requirements: 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 
 Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
 While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
 Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

 Help shape AI-assisted verification for advanced radiation therapy solutions. 
 As a Product Verification Engineer with a focus on AI-assisted testing, you will play an important role in bringing high-quality products and solutions to our customers and ultimately to patients. You will verify that our treatment delivery systems meet their functional and technical requirements, combining hands-on testing with analytical problem solving and close collaboration with engineering teams. 
 You will work in an international, cross-functional R&D environment where verification goes beyond executing tests. Alongside your core verification work, you will help introduce practical AI-assisted approaches across the verification process, including requirement and test case reviews, and share effective practices with the team. Human oversight, product quality, and patient safety will remain central to this work. 
 Join our Varian's Business in Oncology Systems team and contribute to our mission of creating a world without fear of cancer. 
 Your Responsibilities 
 Plan and perform verification activities for our treatment delivery systems 
 Develop, maintain, and execute manual and automated tests based on requirements 
 Use AI tools for requirement review and test design, critically reviewing outputs 
 Evaluate, pilot, and share AI-assisted verification practices with human oversight 
 Analyze test results, report defects, and support troubleshooting with engineering teams 
 Contribute to requirement and design reviews and risk analysis 
 What You Bring 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field 
 Three or more years in software or system verification, preferably in medical devices 
 Practical experience using AI tools and the ability to recognize inaccurate AI output 
 A pragmatic approach to evaluating new technologies and their benefits 
 Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to support team learning 
 A strong commitment to quality and patient safety 
 Fluency in spoken and written English; German is an advantage 
 Proficiency in at least one programming language, preferably Python 
 Willingness to travel up to 10% 
 Nice to Have 
 Understanding of modern software verification practices 
 ISTQB, SAQ Certified Tester, or a comparable testing certification

Apply now for the position of Product Verification Engineer, where you will apply your clinical experience in radiotherapy to system-level verification, helping ensure that our medical device systems support safe and effective clinical workflows. Your role
 You apply your radiotherapy experience to develop realistic test scenarios that reflect clinical workflows and intended use.
 You contribute to planning system-level verification for product releases and projects, considering requirements, design changes, risks and regression impact.
 You design and review test cases with a focus on clinically relevant workflows and perform hands-on formal and informal verification testing on complex medical device systems.
 You analyze test results, document complete and traceable objective evidence, report defects and support troubleshooting and problem analysis together with engineering teams.
 You contribute to requirement, design and risk reviews and collaborate with local and international stakeholders from Engineering, Product Management, Risk Management and other relevant areas.
 You contribute to the continuous improvement of verification methods, tools and processes and support knowledge sharing across the organization.
 You are willing to travel up to 10% as required.
 Your expertise
 A degree or equivalent professional qualification in a relevant clinical discipline, medical technology or a comparable field.
 Several years of hands-on clinical experience in radiotherapy, with a strong understanding of clinical workflows and the practical use of radiotherapy systems.
 Ability to translate clinical workflows and practical experience into structured test scenarios and clearly documented results.
 An analytical, structured and proactive approach, with the willingness to build technical expertise and work independently on complex systems.
 Strong commitment to product safety and quality.
 Fluent spoken and written English; German is an advantage.
 Experience creating radiotherapy treatment plans is an advantage.
 Experience in medical device verification or structured system testing is an advantage.

items.desc:
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
 DNV is seeking a Mathematical Modeller to join our Plant Product Engineering team. 
 You will help develop mathematical and computational models used to understand the consequences and risks associated with hazardous events, supporting customers in making safer and better-informed decisions.
 You will work with experienced modellers, scientists and software developers on our industry-leading quantitative risk assessment products, including Phast and Safeti. Your work will contribute to technically challenging areas such as fire, explosion and dispersion modelling, as well as emerging applications involving hydrogen, ammonia, carbon dioxide and LNG.
 The role offers an opportunity to develop expertise in consequence and risk modelling while gaining practical experience of creating and maintaining commercial scientific software. You will be supported by experienced colleagues and given opportunities to build your technical, software and industry knowledge.
 The preferred location is Manchester, UK, although other UK locations may be considered for the right candidate.
 Tasks may include: 
 Model development, implementation, testing and validation across a range of consequence and risk models. In addition, the on-going improvement or refinement of those models in response to customer needs. 
 Modelling and development of features for energy transition challenges related to hydrogen, ammonia, CO 2 and LNG 
 Work with software developers to integrate models into commercial quantitative risk assessment software, including Phast and Safeti.
 Work closely with industry partners and internal stakeholders on future development and alignment of models. 
 Contribute to advanced risk advisory services by providing modelling domain expertise and advice 
 Support for customer-facing activities, such as support and training of users and conference presentations 
 Support the marketing team in delivering user conferences, webinars, marketing material, white papers etc. 
 Writing and presenting papers for conferences and journals

Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu.  Platové podmienky

 zabezpečovať servisné činnosti pre klientov - malých podnikateľov,
 identifikovať potreby právnických osôb a analyzovať ich potreby,

 aktívne vyhľadávať nové obchodné príležitosti,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.

 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!

items.card: Dobre finančne odločitve se začnejo z dobrim pogovorom in zaupanjem. Za vsakim bančnim računom, kreditom ali varčevanjem stoji zgodba. Nekdo načrtuje nakup prvega doma. Nekdo gradi finančno varnost za svojo družino. Nekdo potrebuje posvet za pomembno življenjsko odločitev. V Intesi Sanpaolo Bank verjamemo, da so najboljše bančne storitve tiste, ki temeljijo na razumevanju, zaupanju in pristnem odnosu s stranko. Zato
items.desc:
Dobre finančne odločitve se začnejo z dobrim pogovorom in zaupanjem. 
 Za vsakim bančnim računom, kreditom ali varčevanjem stoji zgodba. Nekdo načrtuje nakup prvega doma. Nekdo gradi finančno varnost za svojo družino. Nekdo potrebuje posvet za pomembno življenjsko odločitev. 
 V Intesi Sanpaolo Bank verjamemo, da so najboljše bančne storitve tiste, ki temeljijo na razumevanju, zaupanju in pristnem odnosu s stranko. Zato iščemo bančnega svetovalca, ki zna prisluhniti, razumeti potrebe ljudi in jim pomagati najti rešitve, ki bodo podpirale njihove cilje. 
 Če vas veseli delo z ljudmi, radi gradite dolgoročne odnose in želite svojo kariero razvijati v stabilnem ter spodbudnem okolju, vas vabimo, da se pridružite naši ekipi. 
 Kaj vam ponujamo? 
 zaposlitev za nedoločen čas s 3-mesečnim poskusnim obdobjem, 
 fleksibilen delovni čas, 
 strukturirano uvajanje in mentorstvo ob začetku dela, 
 strokovna izobraževanja ter možnosti osebnega in kariernega razvoja, 
 dodatne ugodnosti s področja zdravstvenega varstva, nezgodnega in pokojninskega zavarovanja, 
 sodelovanje v povezani in strokovni ekipi, 
 številne športne, družabne in timske dogodke na ravni banke in bančne skupine, 
 stabilno delovno okolje z jasno usmeritvijo v razvoj zaposlenih. 
 Kaj bo obsegalo vaše delo? 
 Grajenje in razvijanje odnosov z obstoječimi in novimi strankami, 
 svetovanje strankam pri izbiri bančnih produktov in storitev glede na njihove potrebe in življenjske cilje, 
 izvajanje poslov osnovnega bančništva, plačilnega prometa ter blagajniških in trezorskih poslov, 
 nudenje strokovnega finančnega svetovanja v okviru osnovne obravnave strank, 
 zagotavljanje podpore strankam prek osebnih, telefonskih in digitalnih kanalov, 
 prepoznavanje poslovnih priložnosti ter prispevanje k odlični uporabniški izkušnji in uspešnosti poslovalnice. 
 Koga iščemo? 
 Iščemo osebo, ki uživa v delu s strankami, zna graditi zaupanje in verjame, da je prijazen, strokoven in odgovoren pristop ključ do dolgoročnih odnosov. 
 Pri vas cenimo: 
 odlične komunikacijske in medosebne veščine, 
 pozitiven, proaktiven in odgovoren pristop k delu, 
 usmerjenost k strankam in iskanju kakovostnih rešitev, 
 željo po učenju in osebnem razvoju, 
 sposobnost sodelovanja ter timsko naravnanost, 
 natančnost, zanesljivost in profesionalnost. 
 Kaj pričakujemo? 
 Najmanj srednješolsko izobrazbo ekonomske ali druge ustrezne smeri, 
 razvite komunikacijske in svetovalne veščine, 
 odgovoren odnos do dela s strankami in ravnanja s podatki, 
 pripravljenost za stalno pridobivanje novih znanj in strokovni razvoj. 
 Prednost predstavljajo izkušnje v bančništvu ali finančnih storitvah ter licenca za posredovanje zavarovalniških produktov in licenca za trženje investicijskih storitev. 
 Vas zanima? 
 Če vas navdihuje delo z ljudmi in želite biti del okolja, kjer sta strokovnost in zaupanje v ospredju, vas vabimo, da nam pošljete svojo prijavo z življenjepisom. 
 Dobrodošli so tudi kandidati, ki še nimajo vseh zahtevanih izkušenj, vendar izkazujejo motivacijo za učenje, strokovni razvoj in delo s strankami. 
 Prijave sprejemamo do 20. novembra 2026. Veselimo se, da vas spoznamo.

items.desc:
Sodelavec za podporo strankam v Poslovalnici Sežana (m/ž) 
 Dobre finančne odločitve se začnejo z dobrim pogovorom in zaupanjem. 
 Za vsakim bančnim računom, kreditom ali varčevanjem stoji zgodba. Bančništvo se spreminja in z njim tudi način, kako stranke opravljajo svoje vsakodnevne finančne storitve. 
 Iščemo osebo, ki rada dela z ljudmi, zna prisluhniti njihovim potrebam ter jim pomaga izbrati najbolj enostaven in učinkovit način opravljanja bančnih storitev. 
 Če vas veseli delo s strankami in želite prispevati k prijetni, sodobni in uporabniku prijazni bančni izkušnji, vas vabimo, da se pridružite naši ekipi. 
 Kaj vam ponujamo? 
 Spoznavanje sodobnega bančništva : pridobili boste izkušnje z različnimi bančnimi storitvami, storitvenimi kanali in digitalnimi rešitvami. 
 Pridobivanje strokovnega znanja: razvijali boste poznavanje poslovanja poslovalnice ter gotovinskega in transakcijskega poslovanja. 
 Strokovno uvajanje in mentorstvo: ob začetku dela boste deležni podpore pri usvajanju znanj in vključevanju v ekipo. 
 Razvoj znanja in kariere: strokovno uvajanje, izobraževanja ter podpora pri razvoju kompetenc in karierni poti, možnost napredovanja tudi izven poslovalnice 
 Skrb za dobro počutje: vključitev v programe zdravstvenega varstva, nezgodnega in pokojninskega zavarovanja. 
 Povezana ekipa: sodelovanje z izkušenimi sodelavci v strokovnem in spodbudnem okolju. 
 Več kot le delo: številni športni, družabni in timski dogodki na ravni banke in bančne skupine. 
 Kaj bo obsegalo vaše delo? 
 zagotavljanje učinkovite obravnave strank v poslovalnici ter usmerjanje 
 pomoč strankam pri uporabi bankomatov, večnamenskih transakcijskih naprav, spletne banke in drugih digitalnih storitev, 
 izvajanje blagajniških in transakcijskih storitev 
 izvajanje operativnih in administrativnih aktivnosti poslovalnice, 
 upravljanje asistiranih blagajn ter bankomatov in večnamenskih transakcijskih naprav, 
 sodelovanje pri nemotenem delovanju poslovalnice in učinkoviti organizaciji dela, 
 skrb za pravilno izvajanje aktivnosti v skladu z internimi postopki in pravili banke. 
 Koga iščemo? 
 Iščemo osebo, ki uživa v delu z ljudmi, zna ustvariti prijetno uporabniško izkušnjo in razume pomen prijazne ter strokovne podpore strankam. 
 Pri vas cenimo: 
 veselje do dela s strankami, 
 prijazen, spoštljiv in profesionalen odnos, 
 razvite komunikacijske veščine, 
 natančnost, odgovornost in zanesljivost, 
 pripravljenost za učenje in pridobivanje novih znanj, 
 samostojnost pri delu ter pozitiven pristop, 
 sposobnost sodelovanja in timsko naravnanost, 
 zanimanje za sodobne bančne storitve in digitalne rešitve. 
 Kaj pričakujemo? 
 najmanj srednješolsko izobrazbo ekonomske ali druge ustrezne smeri, 
 veselje do dela s strankami in storitveno naravnanost, 
 odgovoren odnos do ravnanja s podatki, 
 pripravljenost na učenje in strokovni razvoj 
 zaželeno poznavanje bančnega poslovanja ali izkušnje pri delu s strankami. 
 Vas zanima? 
 Če vas veseli delo z ljudmi in želite biti del okolja, kjer prijazen osebni stik dopolnjuje sodobne načine bančnega poslovanja, vas vabimo, da nam pošljete svojo prijavo z življenjepisom. 
 Prijave sprejemamo do 20.11.2026. Veselimo se, da vas spoznamo.

 If you’re a security engineer who wants impact, on real life security solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

 You bring proven experience validating high-speed hardware systems where signal integrity and standards compliance are critical. Your work with SERDES interfaces and laboratory instrumentation has taught you that successful validation requires technical rigor and systematic methodology. When issues arise, you isolate root causes through disciplined analysis. 
 You don't just execute test plans, you improve them. You automate measurements, develop analysis tools, and document your work for team benefit. You collaborate effectively with analog designers, digital engineers, and customers. At Synopsys, you will validate IP that enables next-generation systems with direct impact on product quality and customer success. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Validate high-speed SERDES IP designs including PCI Express and Ethernet through electrical and system-level testing on prototype hardware
 Execute validation test plans using oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, BER testers, and TDR equipment to verify signal integrity and standards compliance
 Debug complex analog and digital circuit behavior on prototype boards using schematics and layouts
 Develop test automation frameworks and analysis tools using Python, MATLAB, or C
 Support product certification and conduct interoperability validation with silicon from key manufacturers
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve validation findings and optimize IP performance
 Document results, improve test methodologies, and provide technical guidance to junior engineers
 The Impact You Will Have 
 Ensure Synopsys SERDES IP meets industry certification standards before customer delivery
 Improve validation efficiency and measurement consistency across the global prototyping organization through automation tools
 Identify design issues early, reducing costly respins and accelerating time to market
 Provide customers confidence in IP reliability across diverse system configurations
 Strengthen correlation between simulation models and silicon behavior for future IP development
 Enable high-speed connectivity powering AI infrastructure, data centers, telecommunications, and automotive systems
 What You'll Need 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related discipline
 Experience conducting hardware validation using laboratory instrumentation including oscilloscopes and spectrum analyzers
 Proficiency reading electrical schematics and PCB layouts
 Strong programming skills in MATLAB, Python, or C for test automation and analysis
 Proven debugging capabilities and systematic problem-solving methodology
 Experience with high-speed circuits, SERDES standards (PCI Express, Ethernet), or RF theory (transmission lines, S-parameters) is highly valued
 Familiarity with FPGA development (Verilog/VHDL) or serial protocols (JTAG, I2C, SPI) is beneficial
 Who You Are 
 You apply structured debugging methodology to isolate root causes systematically
 You develop maintainable, well-documented automation tools that provide measurable value
 You communicate technical content effectively across audiences from engineering to management
 You stay current with industry developments in SERDES standards and validation methodologies
 You share technical knowledge and guide less experienced engineers
 You work effectively onsite with flexibility for remote work when appropriate
 The Team You'll Be Part Of 
 You will join the Synopsys Hardware Prototyping team in Lisbon, Portugal, part of a worldwide organization responsible for validating industry-leading high-speed IP designs. The team collaborates closely with analog and digital designers, hardware and software engineers, and customers. …

 Mi hiszünk abban, hogy egy ideális munkahely alapja a barátságos légkör, stabilitás és a megfelelő értékrend. 
 Egy lelkes, nemzetközi csapatot építünk, ahol mindenki azért dolgozik, hogy a banki tevékenységekben rejlő lehetőségekből a legtöbbet hozza ki – és valódi értéket teremtsen ügyfeleink számára. 
 Ha Te is hiszel abban, hogy a fenntartható fejlődés a mindennapi döntéseinkben kezdődik, és szeretnél hatással lenni a jövőre – akkor nálunk a helyed ! 
 A munkavégzés helyszíne Budapest. 
 Mire számíthatsz nálunk
 A Bank lakossági és mikró hitel termék és szolgáltatás kínálatának ellenőrzése és kezelése (ideértve az árazást, a termékleírásokat és szerződés-sablonokat). 
 Javaslatot tesz a területe által menedzselt termékek árazása és egyéb feltételei kapcsán (teljes körű termékkezelés). Elkészült üzleti javaslatok, valamint akció- és tevékenységi tervek véleményezése, ellenőrzése, a terület által menedzselt termék bevezetésével/fejlesztésével/megszüntetésével kapcsolatban ezek értékelése, valamint összehangolása a jogi/szabályozói környezettel. A termék bevezetéssel/fejlesztéssel/megszüntetéssel kapcsolatos tevékenységek koordinálása/ támogatása, valamint a termékfejlesztések vezetése az aktuális termékfejlesztési módszertannal összhangban. 
 A termékek vonatkozásában részt vesz a szolgáltatási modell megtervezésében és megvalósításában. Összeállítja az új és meglévő ügyfelek által igénybe vehető, a terület által menedzselt termék/szolgáltatások árazását és egyéb nyilvános feltételeit, elkészíti és aktualizálja a vonatkozó nyilvános közleményeket és kondíciós listákat, részt vesz a vonatkozó általános üzleti szabályok és szerződések elkészítésében és aktualizálásában. 
 Együttműködik az érintett társosztályok bevonásával, a terület által menedzselt termékhez kapcsolódó külső partnerekkel. Koordinálja a társterületektől érkező javaslatok beépülését a területe által menedzselt termékkörök termékeibe/folyamataiba. A termékekre vonatkozóan kapcsolatot tart a hatóságokkal, partnerekkel és szolgáltatókkal. Proaktív termékfejlesztési együttműködések keresése külső stratégiai üzleti partnerekkel, valamint közreműködés a partnerekkel termékfejlesztési téren. Meghatározza és menedzseli a globális termékgyárakkal közösen a versenyképes termékajánlatokat a célügyfelek piaci igényeinek megfelelően; ily módon támogatva a fiókhálózati célokkal összefüggésben a termék-és szolgáltatásértékesítést. 
 Részt vesz a lakossági ügyfél szegmensekkel, illetve a Retail ügyfelek által igénybe vehető termékekkel kapcsolatos stratégia és terv meghatározásában, részt vesz az éves/féléves tervezési és előrejelzési tevékenységekben, részt vesz/támogatja a stratégiai és üzleti célkitűzések elérését.

 Ние, в УниКредит, сме отворени за смели и иновативни идеи и предлагаме продукти и решения, които дават възможност на хората да бъдат по-успешни и по-удовлетворени. Нашата цел е да бъдем банката за бъдещето на Европа и търсим хора, които имат желание да поемат с нас в тази посока. Ключово за отношенията и процесите, които градим, е те да са най-добър пример в прилагането на принципите за многообразие и равнопоставеност и в утвърждаването на приобщаваща среда за всички.
 Ние ще ти дадем възможност да
 • Организираш и осъществяваш дейностите по вторична реализация на лизингови автомобили, съобразно утвърдените стандарти и поставените бизнес цели;
 • Координираш и управляваш процеса по приемане на върнати лизингови автомобили, като осигурява ефективно изпълнение на всички свързани оперативни дейности;
 • Поддържаш активна комуникация с клиенти и предоставя своевременна информация относно необходимите действия и следващи стъпки при връщане на лизингов автомобил;
 • Организираш и координираш подготовката на върнатите автомобили за продажба, като взаимодейства с външни партньори по ремаркетинг и договаря необходимите условия;
 • Отговаряш за процеса по изготвяне и подписване на споразумения за предсрочно прекратяване на лизингови договори, като осигуряваш тяхното коректно администриране;
 • Следиш за точното и своевременно въвеждане на данни в информационните системи, свързани с договорите и предоставените услуги за превозни средства, върнати от оперативен лизинг.
 В теб търсим
 • Висше образование, за предпочитане в областта на икономиката, бизнеса, финансите или транспорта.
 • Поне 2 години професионален опит в сферата на лизинга, автомобилния бизнес, продажбите или обслужването на клиенти.
 • Познания в областта на оперативния лизинг, управлението на автомобилни паркове или вторичната реализация на автомобили се считат за предимство.
 • Добри умения за водене на преговори и работа с външни партньори и клиенти.
 • Отлични организационни умения и способност за управление на множество задачи едновременно.
 • Добро владеене на английски език (писмено и говоримо) ще се счита за предимство.
 При нас ще откриеш
 • Бонусна система, съобразена със заеманата длъжност
 • Коледен паричен подарък
 • Кредитни продукти при специални условия
 • Освобождаване от такси и комисиони при ползване на голяма част от услугите на банката
 • Допълнително здравно осигуряване
 • Допълнителни плащания във важни моменти от живота
 • Ваучери за храна
 • 25 дни платен годишен отпуск
 • Платен почивен ден за рожден ден и за доброволчество
 • Възможност за допълнителни дни платен годишен отпуск с натрупване на стаж в организацията
 • Гъвкаво работно време и възможност за работа от вкъщи
 • Безплатен достъп до онлайн обучителни курсове и обучения на разнообразни теми
 • Достъп до платформа за изучаване на чужди езици
 • MultiSport карта на преференциални цени
 • Програма „Препоръчай приятел"
 • Отлично оборудвани фитнес зали
 • Кафетерия и стол с преференциални цени
 • Корпоративна детска градина
 • Зъболекарски кабинет

 Interna revizija pruža neovisnu i objektivnu procjenu upravljanja rizicima, sustava internih kontrola i upravljačkih procesa u cijeloj Banci. Kao IT revizor, surađivat ćete s IT i poslovnim funkcijama te stjecati uvid u ključne tehnologije, procese i digitalne inicijative Banke. Imat ćete priliku primijeniti svoje tehničko znanje u procjeni IT rizika, informacijskih sustava, sigurnosnih kontrola i regulatornih zahtjeva te aktivno doprinositi unaprjeđenju kontrolnog okruženja. 
 Što biste radili na ovoj poziciji: 
 Planiranje i provođenje IT revizija informacijskih sustava, aplikacija, infrastrukture i procesa 
 Procjena IT rizika te učinkovitosti sustava internih kontrola 
 Analiza usklađenosti s internim politikama, regulatornim zahtjevima i industrijskim standardima 
 Procjena kontrola iz područja informacijske sigurnosti i zaštite podataka 
 Identificiranje prilika za unapređenje IT procesa i kontrolnog okruženja 
 Izrada revizorskih nalaza, preporuka i izvještaja za menadžment 
 Praćenje provedbe dogovorenih akcijskih planova i revizorskih preporuka 
 Koje uvjete za prijavu trebate ispunjavati: 
 VSS iz područja informacijskih tehnologija, računarstva, elektrotehnike ili srodnog tehničkog usmjerenja 
 Iskustvo rada u IT okruženju uz dobro razumijevanje IT infrastrukture, aplikacija, baza podataka, mreža i informacijskih sustava 
 Poznavanje područja informacijske sigurnosti, upravljanja IT rizicima i internih kontrola 
 Razvijene analitičke vještine i sposobnost kritičkog sagledavanja procesa, rizika i kontrolnog okruženja 
 Sposobnost jasnog i strukturiranog prezentiranja nalaza, zaključaka i preporuka različitim dionicima 
 Aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu 
 Napredno poznavanje MS Office alata, posebno Excela i PowerPointa 
 Prednost predstavljaju: 
 Iskustvo rada u internoj ili eksternoj reviziji 
 Poznavanje regulatornih zahtjeva i okvira primjenjivih u financijskom sektoru 
 Poznavanje standarda i metodologija kao što su COBIT, ITIL, ISO 27001 i DORA 
 Posjedovanje ili stjecanje stručnih certifikata kao što su CISA, CISSP ili srodni certifikati iz područja IT-a, sigurnosti i upravljanja rizicima 
 Zašto bi Vam pozicija mogla biti zanimljiva za prijavu: 
 Rad u okruženju koje potiče kontinuirano učenje, razmjenu znanja i profesionalni razvoj 
 Pristup edukacijama, stručnim programima razvoja i međunarodnim praksama unutar UniCredit Grupe 
 Mogućnost stjecanja i daljnjeg razvoja stručnih znanja iz područja IT revizije, upravljanja rizicima, informacijskih tehnologija i regulatornih okvira 
 Fleksibilne modele rada i podršku ravnoteži privatnog i poslovnog života

 The IG Financing Solutions Italy team, part of UniCredit's Advisory & Financing Solutions division within Client Solutions, provides best-in-class expertise in structuring, underwriting and executing complex financing transactions for leading Italian corporates and financial institutions.
 The team combines the capabilities of Corporate Structured Finance and Debt Capital Markets, offering a comprehensive suite of lending and debt advisory solutions to Investment Grade corporate clients, as well as banks and insurance companies, accessing both loan and bond markets. Leveraging deep sector expertise and strong execution capabilities, the team supports clients across a broad range of financing needs, including general corporate purposes, acquisitions, refinancings, liability management transactions, and strategic funding initiatives.
 Recognized as one of the leading franchises in Italy and across EMEA, the team consistently achieves top-tier market positions and plays a key role in delivering innovative financing solutions to a broad client base.
 As an Associate, you will work closely with senior bankers, coverage teams, and product specialists across the UniCredit platform, including M&A, ECM, DCM, Syndicate and Rating Advisory. You will play a key role in the analysis, structuring and execution of financing transactions, supporting clients throughout the transaction lifecycle.
 What you'll be doing
 - Active involvement in the structuring and execution of financing transactions with Italian large corporate clients 
 - Analysis and assessment of companies' business profiles, financial performance, capital structures and credit fundamentals
 - Preparation of financial analyses, credit assessments and transaction materials
 - Support in structuring tailored financing solutions across loan and capital markets products 
 - Preparation of client presentations, marketing materials and financing proposals
 - Review of term sheets, financing documentation and key transaction terms
 - Coordination with internal counterparties, incl. DCM, Syndicate, Rating Advisory, Coverage, and M&A teams
 - Active involvement in internal approval processes, including drafting memos / credit papers 
 - Ensuring compliance with internal policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.
 What you'll need to succeed
 - A least 3 years’ experience in investment banking, corporate structure finance or leveraged finance 
 - Strong financial modelling, financial analysis and credit assessment skills
 - Solid understanding of corporate financing products and debt markets
 - Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a dynamic environment
 - Proactive, analytical and solution-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 - Strong team-player attitude and ability to work effectively in an international environment
 - Flexibility, resilience and willingness to take ownership of tasks and transactions
 - Fluency in written and spoken English.

 -

 Co budete dělat
 Chceš se podílet na tom, jak si klienti zakládají účet online nebo jak probíhá jejich digitální identifikace? Zajímá tě svět digitálního bankovnictví, moderních technologií a klientské zkušenosti? 
 Do týmu Digitální platformy hledáme nového kolegu nebo kolegyni, který/á má za sebou první zkušenosti s digitálními produkty, business analýzou nebo bankovními procesy a chce se dále rozvíjet v oblasti produktového řízení. 
 Budeš spolupracovat se zkušenými specialisty z businessu, IT, compliance i risku a podílet se na návrhu a realizaci změn v jedné z nejdůležitějších klientských cest v bance. Hledáme člověka s analytickým myšlením, zájmem o digitální produkty a chutí učit se nové věci. 
 Co budete potřebovat k úspěchu
 💡 Co budeš dělat? 
 Podílet se na rozvoji digitálních procesů v oblasti onboardingu klientů a zakládání účtů. 
 Spolupracovat na návrhu nových funkcionalit a vylepšování klientské zkušenosti. 
 Sbírat, analyzovat a specifikovat business požadavky. 
 Připravovat zadání pro vývojové týmy formou user stories a akceptačních kritérií. 
 Spolupracovat s IT, produkťáky, compliance, riskem a dalšími útvary banky. 
 Podílet se na implementaci regulatorních a obchodních požadavků. 
 Testovat nově dodané funkcionality a ověřovat jejich správné fungování. 
 Vyhodnocovat data a hledat příležitosti ke zlepšení digitálních procesů. 
 Sledovat nové trendy v oblasti digitální identity, onboardingu a digitálního bankovnictví. 
 Poskytovat podporu interním stakeholderům a podílet se na řešení provozních situací. 
 👔 Co požadujeme? 
 SŠ/VŠ vzdělání, ideálně ekonomického, technického nebo IT směru. 
 Min. 1-3 roky zkušeností v oblasti digitálních produktů, business analýzy, projektového řízení nebo bankovních procesů. 
 Češtinu/slovenštinu na úrovni rodilého mluvčího + angličtinu alespoň na úrovni B2. 
 Orientaci v digitálních službách a zájem o nové technologie. 
 Zkušenosti s testováním, analýzou nebo implementací změn. 
 Výhodou jsou zkušenosti z bankovnictví, fintechu nebo finančních služeb a znalost Agile metodik (Scrum, Kanban). 
 ✅ Jaký/á bys měl/a být? 
 Máš analytické myšlení a smysl pro detail. 
 Umíš komunikovat s různými typy stakeholderů. 
 Jsi proaktivní a nebojíš se přicházet s vlastními nápady. 
 Chceš se učit nové věci a rozvíjet se v oblasti digitálních produktů. 
 Dokážeš analyzovat požadavky a převést je do srozumitelného zadání. 
 Dokážeš převzít odpovědnost za svěřené úkoly a dotahovat je do konce. 
 Být týmový hráč. 
 Co za to dostanete
 Co Vám nabídneme:
 Příležitost podílet se na digitálních službách, které využívají tisíce klientů každý den. 
 Možnost učit se od zkušených odborníků z businessu i IT. 
 Práci na zajímavých projektech v oblasti digitální identity a onboardingu klientů. 
 Prostor pro kariérní růst. 
 Moderní pracovní prostředí a flexibilní způsob práce. 
 Možnost přicházet s vlastními nápady a ovlivňovat výsledné řešení.

 Benefity přesahující 75 000 Kč ročně a další výhody: 
 ✔️ 5 týdnů dovolené, narozeninové volno, sick days a 8 dnů na regeneraci ✔️ 20 000 Benefit Plus bodů ročně na sport, kulturu, vzdělávání i další aktivity podle vašeho výběru ✔️ Stravenky v hodnotě 180 Kč za každý odpracovaný den ✔️ Možnost pořízení karty MultiSport ✔️ Zvýhodněné bankovní produkty a služby včetně výhodnějších podmínek hypotéky ✔️ Záleží nám na Vaší psychické pohodě – nabízíme neomezený přístup k online terapii Hedepy ✔️ Bohatý program zaměstnaneckých akcí, od sportovních her až po vánoční večírek ✔️ Možnost rekreace v podnikové chatě v Horní Malé Úpě ✔️ 2 dny placeného volna na dobrovolnické aktivity ✔️ Podporujeme rodiny: nabízíme placené volno navíc pro rodiče samoživitele i nastávající maminky ✔️ Za věrnost odměňujeme: po 10 letech získáte dalších 5 dní dovolené, více Benefit Plus bodů a možnost sabbaticalu
