items.desc: CDI - F/H Software Test Automation Engineer SEBIA - Leader mondial du diagnostic biomédical Basé à 91 Evry-Lisses Depuis 1967, SEBIA est un acteur mondial spécialisé dans le diagnostic in vitro qui fournit des équipements et des réactifs pour le dépistage et le suivi de diverses maladies, principalement dans les domaines de l’oncologie (myélome multiple), du diabète, de l’hémoglobinopathie, des maladies auto-immunes et infectieuses et d’autres pathologies rares. La mission de Sebia est de fournir des outils puissants qui traduisent ce qui se passe dans le corps d’un patient dans un langage lisible et interprétable. Nous l’appelons notre nouveau langage de vie. Au sein de la R&D Instruments et Logiciels, le Software Test & Automation Engineer est responsable de la stratégie d’automatisation logicielle des produits de diagnostic médical. Il transforme progressivement les activités de test en une chaîne de vérification automatisée couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de développement, depuis la compilation du logiciel jusqu’à l’exécution automatique des campagnes de tests. Plus qu’un expert du test, il agit comme un véritable leader technique de l’automatisation. Il définit les architectures de test, met en place les outils permettant l’exécution automatique des vérifications à chaque build, pilote l’amélioration de la couverture de tests et fournit aux équipes de développement des indicateurs fiables sur la qualité des produits. Il intègre une équipe de 3 à 4 ingénieurs validation et contribue activement à l’amélioration des pratiques de développement, de qualité logicielle et de livraison continue. Dans un contexte d’adoption croissante de l’intelligence artificielle, il exploite les assistants et agents IA afin d’accélérer la génération, la maintenance et l’analyse des tests automatisés, tout en conservant la responsabilité des choix techniques, de la validation et de la qualité des résultats obtenus. Nous recherchons un leader technique capable d’industrialiser la validation logicielle, de réduire drastiquement les efforts manuels et de construire une plateforme de tests automatisés capable d’accompagner durablement le développement de nos futurs produits. Vos missions : Définir et déployer la stratégie d’automatisation des tests logiciels à l’échelle des produits. Concevoir les architectures de test et développer des frameworks d’automatisation robustes, maintenables et réutilisables. Le programme, les supports et le module e-learning sont fournis. Vous adaptez chaque séance au projet réel de l'apprenant. Conditions - 25 € de l'heure d'animation, facturés mensuellement. - 100 % à distance, volume selon les inscriptions (14 heures par apprenant). - Votre CV sera soumis au certificateur pour validation avant la première séance, et une séance d'observation précède la première affectation. Our mission is to accelerate the development of internet capital markets by making it easier, faster, and more intuitive to build on-chain. Thousands of teams - from early-stage startups to industry leaders like Coinbase, Phantom, and Jupiter - rely on Helius APIs, webhooks, and indexing tools to power their products. Backed by Haun Ventures, Founders Fund, and Foundation Capital, we’re a small, senior team obsessed with performance, simplicity, and scalability in decentralized systems. Read our Helius Manifesto to see how we work and what we value. About the Role We're hiring a Solutions Engineer who thrives on being the go-to technical resource for developers building on Solana. You'll own the customer support experience — answering hard questions in real time, unblocking integrations, and turning recurring pain points into better products, docs, and tooling. This is a hybrid role: part technical support, part solutions engineering, and part internal engineering partner. You'll be embedded in our developer community day-to-day, spotting patterns in what customers need and shipping code, demos, and automation that raise the bar for the entire Helius developer experience. We move quickly and bias toward ownership. If you're energized by helping developers succeed — and by the distributed systems and crypto infrastructure powering that work — you'll thrive here. What You'll Do Serve as the technical front door for developers using Helius APIs and streaming products Troubleshoot issues, reproduce bugs, and work with engineering to get fixes shipped Build code samples, demos, and SDKs that help customers integrate faster Rewrite and expand documentation, tutorials, and guides based on real-world questions Automate support workflows using internal tooling, scripts and AI-assisted systems Collaborate with engineering on feature requests, bug reports, and customer-driven improvements Live in Discord and Telegram to support developers, gather feedback, and spot new patterns Partner with enterprise and ecosystem teams to design integrations and optimize performance Prototype new experimental features alongside engineers and product owners based on customer feedback What You'll Bring 1-2 years of experience in a technical role (support, engineering, solutions or devrel) Excitement for the Solana ecosystem, distributed systems, and internet capital markets Comfort reading and writing code (TypeScript & Rust preferred) Deep curiosity, bias for action, and ownership Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when breaking down complex technical ideas Passion for helping developers and improving developer experience Nice to Have Prior experience in a developer-facing support or solutions role with high volume or real-time community support (Discord, Telegram, forums) Experience with APIs, SDK design, or open-source contributions Prior startup experience or work in a small, fast-moving team Why Helius? High-impact work: Your code will power applications used by millions across the Solana ecosystem, including Coinbase, Jupiter, and Phantom Ownership & growth: Lead critical initiatives, influence architecture and product direction, and take on more responsibility as the company scales Remote-first flexibility: Work where you’re most effective with a flexible, fully distributed team Competitive comp & perks: Market-leading salary, meaningful equity, generous vacation, wellness budgets, and support for learning and travel Mission-driven team: Join ambitious builders who move fast, take ownership, and are shaping the future of decentralized apps

items.desc: RSM est devenu 6ème réseau mondial en Audit, Expertise Comptable et Conseil grâce à l’engagement de nos équipes. Dans nos cabinets en Méditerranée, 220 experts et expertes évoluent au quotidien dans un environnement bienveillant et en constante évolution, où autonomie et prise d’initiatives sont valorisées. Ils témoignent : « RSM m’a offert un environnement de travail exceptionnel, où le soutien et la bonne ambiance sont des valeurs quotidiennes. Je suis reconnaissante d’évoluer dans un cadre où l’on se sent valorisée et soutenue, et j’ai à cœur de contribuer au succès de notre équipe. » — Oriane, Collaboratrice Comptable. « RSM me permet de vivre mes ambitions puisque je vois tous les jours des dossiers divers et variés. » — Nicolas, Juriste. Chez RSM, chaque jour est une opportunité de grandir. Nous avons à cœur de faire évoluer nos équipes tout en accompagnant nos clients avec excellence. Ainsi, 95% des collaborateurs nous recommandent. Votre rôle : Intégrateur(trice) Pennylane & Data Analyst H/F au sein de notre pôle Expertise. Dans le cadre du développement de son activité de conseil en digitalisation, RSM renforce son équipe avec un poste à la croisée de la comptabilité et de la data. Un logiciel, c’est de la donnée : où elle se trouve, comment on la range, ce qui est important ou non. Vous aidez nos clients à choisir, déployer et tirer parti de leurs outils, puis à faire parler leurs données . En ce sens, votre contribution portera sur deux missions complémentaires : Intégration de logiciels (environ 50 % de votre temps) : Vous collectez le besoin du client, migrez ses données, paramétrez Pennylane, puis assurez le suivi et l’accompagnement à l’utilisation, y compris par des formations sur site auprès de nos clients. Vous intervenez à la fois pour les clients du cabinet et pour des entreprises qui nous sont adressées par Pennylane, notre partenaire. Vous savez expliquer au client ce qui est possible ou non dans l’outil, et lui répondre avec pédagogie. Vous échangez avec le réseau d’intégrateurs RSM et avec le support technique de Pennylane. À terme, le périmètre s’élargira à d’autres outils (CRM, suivi de trésorerie, facturation) : si vous n’y êtes pas formé(e), nous vous formerons. Data analyst (analyse de données) : Vous identifiez où se trouve la donnée, la structurez et la croisez entre plusieurs outils pour la faire parler sous forme de tableaux de bord. Nous utilisons Power BI, sans exclusivité : aucune connaissance préalable de cet outil n’est exigée. Vous répondez aux demandes de nos équipes et de nos clients, en les questionnant : « Qu’est-ce que la marge pour vous ? Où la trouve-t-on ? » Vous personnalisez au maximum, même quand la définition du client diffère de la vôtre. Une approche IA sans code : Nous ne cherchons pas un(e) développeur(se). Vous utilisez les outils d’IA et d’automatisation sans code pour gagner du temps et simplifier la vie de vos interlocuteurs. À terme , selon votre évolution, vous pourrez contribuer au développement commercial de l’activité (prospection, développement du portefeuille), sans que ce soit une urgence. Formation initiale : Issu(e) d’une formation orientée vers la data, l’informatique, la gestion ou la comptabilité, vous disposez de solides connaissances en matière de structuration et d’organisation des données. Une appétence particulière pour les outils numériques et les nouvelles technologies est essentielle. Expérience : Vous bénéficiez idéalement d’une première expérience d’1 à 2 ans dans les domaines de l’intégration logicielle (cabinet, éditeur, ESN), de la data / BI ou de la comptabilité. Une connaissance de Pennylane, Power BI ou d’autres outils de BI constitue un atout, sans être indispensable. Une formation à Pennylane et à nos méthodes de travail vous sera dispensée. Qualités personnelles : Curieux(se), adaptable et doté(e) d’un bon relationnel, vous appréciez les échanges humains et le travail en équipe. Vous savez écouter et questionner les clients afin de comprendre leurs besoins, vulgariser les aspects techniques et proposer des solutions concrètes et adaptées. Votre esprit d’analyse et votre capacité à structurer l’information seront de véritables atouts. Mobilité : Le poste implique des déplacements fréquents chez les clients de la région, notamment pour assurer les formations sur site. Le permis B est donc indispensable. Ce que nous vous offrons : Un accompagnement sur-mesure : Formation aux outils et méthodologie RSM, accompagnement pour se former et évoluer, diversités des dossiers. Un environnement de travail dynamique : Un séminaire annuel, participation à des évènements initiés par la direction, les collaborateurs ou le CSE, des conférences, une charte de télétravail. Une rémunération fixe (sur 12 mois) et une part variable selon votre performance individuelle. Des avantages : 12 jours de congés supplémentaires, carte Ticket Restaurant®, mutuelle et prévoyance, flexibilité des horaires. RSM est engagé, au travers de sa politique …

items.desc: Company Description An enterprise client is seeking experienced Geospatial Research & Analysis Experts to support an AI-training project focused on developing expert-level analytical workflows. The selected freelancers will help train an AI assistant by reviewing complex geospatial questions, identifying missing information, making reasonable assumptions, and creating detailed workflows for solving real-world spatial problems. Job Description This opportunity is ideal for professionals and researchers with strong geospatial knowledge and experience in GIS, spatial analysis, and geospatial data tools. Candidates should be comfortable reviewing open-ended questions, developing analytical approaches, and explaining their methods clearly. Depending on their assessment results and the client's requirements, selected candidates may be assigned to either an Operator or Quality Assurance (QA) role. What You'll Do: Review geospatial queries and identify unclear terms, missing information, and other gaps that may affect the analysis. Suggest clarifications and reasonable assumptions to turn complex questions into well-defined geospatial problems. Develop detailed, step-by-step workflows for geospatial analysis. Identify appropriate data sources, tools, analytical methods, and validation steps. Define expected deliverables, such as maps, reports, and other outputs. Apply geospatial knowledge to real-world scenarios, such as crisis response, damage assessment, agriculture, site selection, market expansion, supply chain analysis, and forecasting. For QA assignments, review completed work, check its quality, and provide feedback based on project guidelines. Qualifications Requirements: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in a relevant field, such as: Geographic Information Science (GIS) or Geospatial Science. Geography with a focus on GIS or spatial analysis. Geomatics. Remote Sensing or Earth Observation. Geospatial Engineering or a closely related discipline. Strong geospatial expertise gained through professional experience, academic research, or both. Experience working with geospatial data and tools such as QGIS, ArcGIS, GeoPandas, Google Earth Engine, or Google Earth. Experience applying geospatial analysis to real-world problems or research projects. Ability to evaluate complex questions, identify missing information, and explain analytical assumptions and methods. Strong written communication skills in English. Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow project guidelines. Nice to Haves: Experience working as a GIS Analyst, Geospatial Engineer, GIS Data Analyst, or Geospatial Researcher. Experience with crisis response, damage assessment, agriculture, site selection, market expansion, supply chain analysis, or forecasting. Additional coursework or training in geospatial frameworks, tools, and libraries. Previous experience with AI training, data annotation, or quality assurance projects. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. Your Role We are looking for a dedicated Public Funding Project Coordinator (f/m/d) to coordinate the full lifecycle of publicly funded projects in Germany and the EU, from opportunity assessment and application through financial administration, reporting, and close-out. Working closely with Technology & Engineering, Global Corporate Affairs, Finance, and project partners, you will translate funding requirements into clear plans and keep budgets, documentation, and deadlines on track. Financial Administration & Compliance Drive timely payment requests and financial reporting by bringing together accurate inputs from Accounting, technical project owners, and project partners. Build and maintain complete, audit-ready project records, including funding conditions, supporting evidence, reporting obligations and correspondence. Improve workflows, templates and data quality, establishing well-organized project information and using data- and AI-enabled tools where appropriate. What You Bring Practical experience in public funding administration , including assessing new funding opportunities, preparing funding applications, payment requests, reporting, financial documentation, or related grant-management activities. Around five years of relevant experience would be helpful, but we value hands-on capability over a fixed number of years or a particular qualification. Experience with German federal or state funding programmes, particularly those supporting research, innovation or industrial development. An understanding of funding conditions, eligible-cost requirements and audit-ready documentation, with the ability to translate these into practical project plans. A structured, hands-on working style: you manage multiple deadlines, maintain accurate records and follow through on missing information without needing to be chased. Confidence working with spreadsheets and financial or project data, including consolidating inputs and checking information for accuracy and completeness. Fluent German and English, with the ability to explain funding requirements clearly to colleagues, project partners and funding bodies. Ownership and sound judgment: you resolve routine issues independently, communicate risks early, and collaborate effectively across teams without formal authority. Nice to have Experience in a public-funding consultancy, research organization, public administration, or a startup or scale-up environment. Familiarity with financial or ERP systems such as NetSuite and an interest in improving workflows through data and AI-enabled tools. items.desc: Snapshot of Your Day Join the Omnivise Ecosystem Solutions team and be at the forefront of Siemens Energy’s digital transformation! As a Solution Architect (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing scalable, secure end-to-end digital solutions that seamlessly connect energy assets, control systems, applications, and data. You will translate business and operational needs into integrated technical solutions, focusing on cloud-based innovations powered by IIoT technology. Collaborating with diverse teams, including Solution Management, engineering, and customers, you will align multiple products and development streams into a cohesive solution, ensuring transparency in technical decisions and acceptance criteria. Your expertise will guide solutions from concept to operational handover, paving the way for repeatable deployments across various customer operating models. How You’ll Make an Impact End-to-end ownership of solution architecture and technical solution lifecycle management, from concept definition to deployment and operational handover Design and development of integrated IT/OT architectures connecting industrial assets, control systems, edge technologies, cloud platforms, applications, and analytics solutions Translation of business and operational requirements into scalable solution architectures, technical roadmaps, and prioritized implementation requirements Leadership of capability and feature definition, including alignment of cross-functional development activities and technical implementation across products and domains Collaboration with customers, stakeholders, product management, and engineering teams to establish sustainable solution patterns and resolve architectural trade-offs Definition of end-to-end validation strategies, technical governance, architecture documentation, cybersecurity considerations, and quality assurance for enterprise-scale solutions What You Bring Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Energy Technology, or a related discipline Proven experience in solution architecture, systems engineering, or technical leadership for complex digital and enterprise-scale solutions Strong capability to translate business requirements into solution architectures, technical capabilities, and implementation specifications Deep knowledge of cloud and edge architectures, industrial connectivity, cybersecurity principles, and IT/OT integration Experience in cross-functional coordination across multiple technical domains while maintaining an end-to-end solution perspective Fluency in English combined with strong stakeholder management, communication, and analytical skills in a global and cross-functional environment About the Team Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. The STACKIT Cloud Accelerator Program is more than a traditional trainee program: In nine months, our company's engineers teach you the cloud – embedded in our culture, our teams, and our real daily work routine. After the program, you will start full speed as a Junior Cloud Engineer there. Get Ready (6 weeks): In numerous technical training courses, you will get everything you need for everyday cloud life – Git, HTTP Basics, Linux Basics, Docker, Golang, Kubernetes, HTTP From Scratch in Go, Microservices in Go – and much more. Taught by the best engineers of the company. Innovation Lab (8 weeks): You implement Long Standing Ideas of the domains in practice – using the agile methods, teamwork, and pair programming you learned in Get Ready. Grow Together (2 days, offsite): You present the lab results, experience team building and a hackathon, and learn your future team assignment. Develop & Grow (6 months): Everyday life in the expert team. You implement real projects and are systematically developed through monthly check-ins and soft-skill training courses. Finals: The joint, successful completion of your program – with a certificate. Time for further education and training so you can grow both professionally and personally. A network of cloud experts who accompany and support you on your way. From day 1 an indefinite employment contract – you are a permanent part of Schwarz Digits right from the start. That's You Must-Haves: You have completed a degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering (Bachelor / Master) or are a graduate of the 42 Coding School. You have already demonstrably implemented initial projects in software engineering – whether privately or professionally. You have a solid theoretical understanding of software architecture, microservices, and scaling from your studies. You have initial experience in developing REST APIs and know the underlying principles – such as HTTP methods and resource-based design. You have basic knowledge in Git, web development, and databases. You communicate confidently in English and can exchange ideas in technical discussions. You can participate on site (Bad Friedrichshall) for the first 12 weeks in the training courses / workshops. Nice to have: You have initial experience in Go and TypeScript. You have initial experience in Docker, Kubernetes & Observability. You have initial experience in Infrastructure as Code, deployment, and operation of applications. You are at home in the terminal. You communicate confidently in German. Further Information Your Documents: CV / Resume Project list University academic transcript GitHub Our Application Process in Three Selection Steps: 1. items.desc: As an Analytics Engineer (f/m/d) , you will play a key role in connecting data engineering and analytics at KoRo. You will develop reliable data models, establish consistent metrics and create the foundation for accurate reporting and AI-driven insights. Working closely with Data, Tech and business teams, you will ensure a shared understanding of business data and enable teams to access and use data independently. What you will do: Data Modeling & Transformation: You design and maintain scalable dbt models and pipelines in BigQuery, ensuring high data quality through automated testing, performance optimization, and GDPR-compliant data processing. Semantic Layer & Metrics: You build and maintain KoRo's semantic layer with consistent business metrics and AI-ready metadata, modeling key business entities and their relationships through ontologies and knowledge graphs. AI Quality & Optimization: You evaluate and improve AI-generated answers using real business questions, identifying data inconsistencies, resolving modeling gaps, and preventing recurring errors. Data Dictionary & Governance: You maintain a centralized, versioned data dictionary, working with Data and business teams to ensure consistent definitions of metrics, entities, and business rules across reporting and analytics. Self-Service Analytics & Collaboration: You work closely with business stakeholders to make reliable data accessible through BI and AI tools, support user adoption, and enable teams to independently answer business questions. What you bring: 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, ideally within e-commerce, consumer apps, or a fast-paced digital business. Strong technical skills in SQL, dbt, and Python, with experience in data modeling, automated testing, and BI tools such as Tableau. Experience with GCP and BigQuery is a plus. Hands-on experience with semantic layers and AI-ready data structures, including preparing data and context for LLM-based applications, ideally paired with experience evaluating AI-generated outputs. Understanding of business ontologies and knowledge graphs, with experience modeling business entities and their relationships or a strong interest in developing expertise in this area. Strong analytical and communication skills in English, with a business-oriented mindset, a focus on data quality and documentation, and the ability to align stakeholders on shared definitions and drive the adoption of data tools. What's in it for you: Smart Working & Flexibility: Flexible working hours, hybrid work, and 20 days of workation. We trust you to take ownership: you deliver on our shared goals and structure your day in the way that works best for you. You’ll also start with 28 days of vacation, increasing by one additional day per year of tenure (capped at 30 days), so you always have time to recharge. Growth & Setup: A structured onboarding plan to get you started, plus a dedicated development budget for your personal and professional growth. You’ll also receive your own MacBook and a fully equipped office setup with monitors and height-adjustable desks. KoRo Life & Extras: Free snacks and barista coffee in the office, 20% discount in the KoRo Online-Shop, and exclusive perks with partner companies. On top of that, a fully funded BVG ticket (Jobticket), a subsidy for your fitness membership (Urban Sports Club, Hansefit, or FitX), and a company pension scheme (bAV) via Ginkgo. Shared Moments: Regular team events and company parties to celebrate milestones and successes together. We're looking for People who share our Mindset For us, it's not just about the what , but above all about the how . You'll be a perfect fit for us if you have the following mindset: You take initiative and ownership. You don't wait for a perfect brief or a mandate to get started. When you see an opportunity, a risk, or something that can be improved - you act. When things don't go as planned, you look at your own contribution first and step up, without waiting to be asked. You thrive in change. Shifting priorities and evolving processes don't slow you down. You adapt fast and keep moving. You build, you don't wait. When something is missing - a tool, a process, a solution - you create it. You prefer a working MVP over a perfect plan and iterate from there. You think in leverage. You question how things are done, prioritize ruthlessly, and find smarter paths to better outcomes. You don't mistake effort for impact. You're a team player, humble and genuinely kind. You collaborate in and across teams, care about the people around you, and bring sparkles to the room. You speak up when you disagree, commit fully once a decision is made, and actively make the people around you better. Own it – Move fast – Build it – Create impact – Lift others Sounds good? Then we’d love to hear from you! Send us your CV and tell us a little about yourself in a few introductory sentences – who you are, what drives you, …

items.desc: Position Type Full Time Career area Marketing Merchandising Location Warschauer Straße 70A, Berlin, Berlin 10829, Germany Job ID R-92028 Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game. Location: Frankfurt This role will primarily support Nike’s retail marketplace across Frankfurt and the surrounding region . It would therefore be ideally suited to someone based in or around Frankfurt, working remotely and travelling regularly across the assigned region. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Visual Merchandising & Styling Specialist (m/f/d) to elevate Nike’s retail experiences across Austria, Germany and Switzerland. The role translates Nike’s seasonal strategies and VMS directives into locally relevant store experiences across Inline, Value and Partner doors within the assigned portfolio. You combine strong styling and visual merchandising skills with consumer insight and commercial awareness to create inspiring, consistent consumer journeys. WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON Plan and execute: Support seasonal launches, campaigns and everyday VMS execution, applying Nike’s standards across the assigned doors. Elevate the consumer journey: Review zoning, assortment and styling to build cohesive stories, identifying gaps and opportunities across physical and digital touchpoints. Develop store capabilities: Coach store and partner VMS teams through practical training, clear guidance and hands-on support. Drive consistency: Conduct store visits, assess execution and follow up on actions to improve presentation and maintain standards. Support business performance: Use consumer insights, retail KPIs and store feedback to inform priorities and measure impact. Coordinate delivery: Align with cross-functional teams on launch readiness, execution needs and the VMS service model. WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH You will report to the VMS Manager, AGS and collaborate with AGS Retail Marketing, Nike Direct, marketplace partners and store teams. You will work closely with EMEA VMS to apply directives, share feedback and exchange best practices. WHAT YOU BRING Relevant visual merchandising experience, with a strong foundation in retail, styling and retail marketing. Understanding of consumers across the AGS marketplace and the relationship between product, presentation and commercial performance. Ability to translate brand direction into clear store actions and coach teams effectively. Awareness of how physical and digital experiences connect across the consumer journey. Strong planning, communication and collaboration skills, with ownership of delivery and follow-through. Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities, willingness to travel across AGS and a valid driving licence is required. Candidates must be fluent in both written and spoken English and German. Local candidates preferred. Application closing date: 17th November 2026 NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete* in the world. NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. What You Can Expect OUR HIRING GAME PLAN 01 Apply Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you. 02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique. 03 Interview Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

items.desc: ZEISS Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology Enabler for smaller, more powerful, and more energy-efficient microchips Working for tomorrow today. Around 80 percent of all microchips worldwide are produced using ZEISS technologies. As the centerpiece of every electronically controlled system, they have become an integral part of our everyday lives – whether in smartphones, smart homes or smart factories. ZEISS is a technology leader in the field of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With high-precision lithography optics, photomask systems and process control solutions, ZEISS enables the production of ever smaller, increasingly powerful, and more energy-efficient microchips, and thus plays a pivotal role in the age of micro- and nanoelectronics. The Maintenance Management area (SMT-OM) is responsible for maintenance processes of SMT secondary equipment and consolidates all manufacturing-related topics. The setup and integration of equipment into the SMT core competencies—such as optical metrology systems and interferometry—create an optimal interface to R&D. In addition, these assets must be kept in good working order through preventive maintenance and repairs. Your Role Perform mechanical maintenance, inspection, and repair work on complex production, metrology, and assembly systems; analyze mechanical disturbances, systematically isolate root causes, and implement countermeasures. Support the setup, integration, and commissioning of new machines and equipment. accompany the ramp-up of Anlagen (systems) and identify technical weaknesses and improvement potential early. Carry out repairs, modifications, adjustments, and replacement of mechanical components; participate in preventive maintenance, retrofit, and optimization measures. Document completed work, fault patterns, and technical solutions in the designated systems in a traceable manner; create and update work instructions, checklists, and maintenance documentation as needed. Coordinate actions with system operators, internal departments, and external service partners. Adhere consistently to applicable safety, quality, and cleanliness standards. Your Profile Successfully completed vocational training leading to the status of state-certified master craftsman or technician (m/f/x) in Mechanical Engineering / Mechatronics / Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification and field. Professional experience in mechanical maintenance, mechanical engineering, special purpose machinery, or technical service is advantageous. Good knowledge in at least several of the following areas: mechanics and precision mechanics, pneumatics and possibly hydraulics, assembly and adjustment of mechanical subsystems, technical drawings and bill of materials, systematic fault analysis. Ideally, experience with complex or automated production equipment. Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style, with a strong emphasis on quality and safety. Strong teamwork and communication skills, and willingness to pursue ongoing professional development. Willingness to work in required shift models or on-call duties if applicable to the role. Our Added Value We provide stability and security! The long-standing success, strong market position of ZEISS, and the continuously growing demand for IT components offer security for every ZEISS employee and a reliable long-term perspective you can count on. Your work-life balance matters to us! Benefit from flexible working time models (including flexible shift systems), the option to work remotely, and a range of childcare support services. Your skills are highly valued! At ZEISS, we offer a wide range of opportunities for professional development, including qualification programs, our internal online learning platform CurioZ, external training opportunities, and attractive career paths. With individually defined annual development goals, we support our employees in achieving their career ambitions. Your work is valuable! As part of our team, you will benefit from a variety of attractive employee benefits, such as corporate benefits programs, subsidies for the Germany ticket and company bicycles, as well as an award-winning pension scheme. In addition, you will of course receive collectively agreed special payments, including holiday pay, Christmas bonuses, transformation payments, and additional collective bonuses (T-Zug), as well as an annual performance-based bonus tied to the fiscal year. We invest in your health & well-being! Our health management program includes online fitness classes, webinars, partnerships with gyms, ZEISS sports groups and running clubs, occupational health physicians, and a unique health partnership with Barmer, offering health courses and a personal contact. In our company restaurants, you will enjoy healthy and diverse meals, including daily vegetarian and vegan options as well as regional organic products. People are at the center of everything we do! ZEISS is a foundation-owned company. …

items.desc: Über CHAPTERS Group CHAPTERS Group ist eine börsennotierte deutsche Holding, die vertikale Softwareunternehmen erwirbt und hält. In den letzten fünf Jahren sind wir um das Zehnfache gewachsen und besitzen heute mehr als 60 Unternehmen. Jedes führt sein eigenes Geschäft, nah an seinen Kunden. Wir machen sie stärker, ohne ihnen das Steuer aus der Hand zu nehmen. KI ist eine der größten Chancen, die wir für sie sehen. Sie wirkt aber nur, wenn die Menschen in diesen Unternehmen sie auch nutzen. Die Rolle Du bist Teil des AI Core Teams im Office des CTO und arbeitest als Forward Deployed Engineer nah an den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe. Du betreibst unseren AI Hub, eine Open WebUI-basierte KI-Plattform, für mehr als 10 Unternehmen. Du bringst mit, was du im Feld siehst, testest neue Fähigkeiten und gestaltest die Plattform für alle 60+ Unternehmen mit. Deutsch (C1+) und Englisch sind Pflicht. Was du machst Den AI Hub für 10+ Unternehmen betreiben: Deployments, Updates, Konfiguration, SSO mit Entra ID, Monitoring, Backups und Incident Handling Unternehmen und Teams onboarden: Skills, Knowledge Bases und Tools einrichten, damit jedes Unternehmen produktiv mit dem Hub arbeitet Technische Ansprechperson sein: Wenn etwas ausfällt oder ein Champion nicht weiterkommt, analysierst und behebst du das. Wiederkehrende Probleme dokumentierst du, damit sie nur einmal gelöst werden müssen. Den Hub anbinden, wo ein Use Case es braucht: Microsoft 365 / Graph, CRM, Ticketing und ERP-Systeme über Tools, MCP-Server und REST-APIs Wiederkehrende Fragen in wiederverwendbare Bausteine verwandeln: Dokumentation, Vorlagen und kurze Hands-on-Sessions Im AI Core Team arbeiten: Muster über Unternehmen hinweg teilen, neue Features testen und Erkenntnisse in die Plattform-Roadmap einspeisen Gelegentlich das M&A-Team unterstützen (etwa 10 bis 20 % deiner Zeit) bei technischen Fragen, zum Beispiel bei der Bewertung des Tech- und AI-Stacks von Übernahmekandidaten Das bringst du mit Pflicht Deutsch (C1 oder höher) und fließend Englisch. Du arbeitest täglich auf Deutsch mit Geschäftsführern und nicht-technischen Teams. Hier machen wir keine Ausnahmen. Erfahrung im Produktivbetrieb. Du hast containerisierte Anwendungen produktiv deployt und betrieben (Docker, CI/CD, Linux, eine große Cloud, Azure bevorzugt) und warst verantwortlich, wenn sie ausgefallen sind. Das heißt meist mindestens 2 Jahre in einer DevOps-, Platform-, SRE- oder Backend-Rolle. Python , das du sicher lesen, debuggen und erweitern kannst Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs. Du nutzt sie im eigenen Arbeitsalltag ernsthaft, hast beruflich oder privat etwas damit gebaut und weißt, wo sie scheitern. Du erklärst Technik so, dass Nicht-Techniker sie verstehen und danach handeln können. Du bist gern die technische Ansprechperson für Teams ohne technischen Hintergrund. Starke Signale Enterprise Identity: Entra ID, OAuth, SSO Selbst gehostete LLM-Plattformen wie Open WebUI oder LibreChat MCP, Tool Calling, Agent-Frameworks Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform) Erfahrung in einer Support-, Solutions- oder kundennahen technischen Rolle Erfahrung in der Arbeit über mehrere Unternehmen, Tenants oder eine Gruppenstruktur hinweg Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du den Großteil deiner Zeit damit verbringen willst, neue AI-Produkte von Grund auf zu bauen ML-Forschung oder Modelltraining suchst nur mit Engineers arbeiten und direkten Kontakt mit Fachbereichen vermeiden willst Das bekommst du Echte Verantwortung: 10+ Unternehmen, eine Plattform, und du sorgst dafür, dass KI dort funktioniert Ein kleines AI Core Team mit direktem Draht zum C-Level. Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Wirkung über deine Plattform hinaus: Was in deinen Unternehmen funktioniert, wird Standard für 55+ Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle , Remote-first mit gelegentlichen Präsenzterminen Entwicklung: Talent Reviews, Events und Konferenzen. Wir stellen Leute ein, die mit uns wachsen wollen. So bewirbst du dich Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte diese eine Frage auf Deutsch , maximal 200 Wörter. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Erzähl uns von einem System, das du produktiv betrieben hast und das ausgefallen ist. Was ist passiert, was hast du getan, und was hat sich danach geändert? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

items.desc: Cloudevo is a technology company working at the intersection of data, artificial intelligence and digital growth. Since 2018, we’ve helped leading organizations in Greece and internationally build data foundations they can trust, and use them to power smarter marketing, better products and AI-driven decisions. Our work spans data engineering, analytics, machine learning, conversational AI, cloud architecture and performance marketing. We take on complex, high-stakes problems for companies and public-sector organizations where data quality really matters. We are a team that values growth, empathy and ownership. We learn fast, challenge assumptions and build things that last. The role Measurement is changing fast. Browsers restrict cookies, privacy regulation tightens, and platforms rely more and more on modeled data. The companies that win are the ones that own their first-party data and know exactly how it flows. As a Measurement Engineer , you’ll design and build the measurement infrastructure behind that shift. You’ll own the full data lifecycle, from event design and collection to warehousing, modeling and activation, across a range of technologies and client environments. You’ll work alongside our data, AI and growth teams, and act as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders. What you’ll do Architect end-to-end measurement strategies for web, apps and e-commerce, from tracking plans to reporting. Design and implement server-side and first-party data collection architectures that are resilient to browser restrictions and ad blockers. Lead migrations between tag management and analytics platforms with zero data loss. Build conversion API integrations with major ad platforms, including event deduplication and match-quality optimization. Design event schemas and data contracts that keep data consistent across teams and tools. Build pipelines into cloud data warehouses and model raw event data into analysis-ready datasets. Implement privacy-by-design measurement: consent management, data minimization and regulatory compliance (GDPR, ePrivacy). Audit complex setups, find the root cause of data discrepancies and fix them for good. Explore how modeled conversions, AI and advanced attribution can close the gaps that deterministic tracking can’t. Turn technical work into clear insight and guidance for decision-makers. Requirements [3+] years of experience in digital analytics engineering, tracking or measurement. Deep hands-on experience with at least one major tag management system (e.g. Google Tag Manager, Tealium, Adobe Launch). Proven experience building server-side tracking in production environments. Strong experience with at least one major analytics platform (e.g. GA4, Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Piwik PRO). Advanced SQL and experience with a cloud data warehouse (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks). Solid JavaScript ; Python is a plus. Experience with at least one cloud platform (GCP, AWS or Azure). A solid grasp of browser privacy changes, consent frameworks and their impact on data. A rigorous, analytical mindset and the habit of questioning every number. Clear communication with both engineers and business stakeholders. Fluency in English; Greek is a plus. Nice to have Experience with CDPs and event pipelines (e.g. Segment, RudderStack, Snowplow). Experience with data modeling and transformation tools (e.g. dbt, Dataform). Knowledge of attribution modeling, incrementality testing or marketing mix modeling (MMM) . Experience with BI tools (e.g. Looker, Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio). Experience with reverse ETL and activating warehouse data into marketing platforms. Interest in applying AI and machine learning to measurement problems. Relevant certifications in analytics or cloud platforms.

items.desc: About Fairlo The story of Fairlo began when our founders, Jimmy and Shamon, saw first-hand how unfair and predatory lending practices can trap people in cycles of debt. Their mother had been misled by a large bank, and instead of being offered a lifeline, she was pushed further into financial difficulties. That injustice sparked something: to build a company that reimagines credit – rooted in transparency, flexibility, and respect. That company became Fairlo. Where we are now Since launching in 2018, Fairlo has helped tens of thousands of customers access responsible credit when life happens. With approximately 50,000 active customers, a 4.7 Trustpilot rating from 4,700+ reviews, and an incredibly low churn rate, we're proving that transparency and flexibility aren't just the right things to offer – they're a winning model. We're a tight-knit team of around 50 people across Stockholm, Crete, and the UK. Backed by some of Sweden's most experienced investors and driven by a culture that values kindness, courage, collaboration, and common sense, we're incredibly proud of what we've built so far. Where we're going We're now entering the most exciting chapter in our journey so far: Fairlo is becoming a bank. With this, technology is becoming even more central to our mission – scaling our platform, launching new products, and ensuring reliability and security at every step. At the same time, Fairlo's AI transformation is already under way. We have a plan in place and people across the company are actively working on it, with the goal of becoming a truly AI-native organisation. We believe AI is fundamentally changing how great technology is built, and we want to be at the forefront of that change. For us, being AI-native isn't just about using the latest tools. It's about rethinking how we work, solve problems, collaborate, and create value. We want AI to become a natural part of our everyday work, helping us move faster, think bigger, experiment more, and spend more time on what really matters. That's why we're looking for curious, ambitious Fullstack Engineers who want to join that work, and who are excited not only about building great technology, but also about exploring new ways of building it. You'll join our Fairlo Tech Hub in Heraklion, working alongside talented engineers in a cross-functional team closely integrated with our product organisation in Sweden. You'll have the opportunity to make a real impact on our technology, our ways of working, and the future of Fairlo. We're investing deeply in people, technology, and community, with the ambition of building one of Europe's most exciting and respected tech hubs. items.desc: About NOW Group NOW Group is an award-winning social enterprise operating across Belfast and Dublin. We are committed to working with individuals and businesses to unlock potential and create meaningful, lasting change across the island of Ireland. Our work focuses on supporting people who are neurodiverse, autistic, or have a learning disability, helping them to build skills and progress into sustainable, future-focused employment. Through tailored training programmes, inclusive job opportunities, and community-based support, we empower individuals to achieve their goals and thrive in the workplace. The Role As Administration & Compliance Officer, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation of administrative processes and maintaining funder compliance across our services. You’ll be the backbone of our operational integrity, supporting the delivery team, completing awarding body paperwork, monitoring data, and ensuring we meet the highest standards of governance. Key Responsibilities 1. Provide administrative support across services, ensuring efficient and effective day to day operations. 2. Maintain accurate participant records using SPARK (internal MS Dynamics system) in line with organisational and funder requirements. 3. Support services with participant enrolment, onboarding, attendance monitoring, progression tracking and exit processes. 4. Monitor and maintain compliance documentation to ensure programmes meet contractual, funding, audit and quality assurance requirements. 5. Prepare and collate evidence, reports and documentation required for funders, inspections, audits and monitoring visits. 6. Complete regular compliance checks and data quality audits, ensuring any issues are addressed promptly. 7. Produce routine management information reports and programme statistics for managers and stakeholders. 8. Support the financial administration activities including purchase orders, invoicing, expenditure tracking and reconciliation of programme records. 9. Organise meetings, maintain accurate minutes and ensure actions are recorded and followed up within agreed timescales. 10. Ensure compliance with GDPR, confidentiality requirements, safeguarding procedures and organisational policies. 11. Assist with the development and continuous improvement of administrative systems, processes and reporting mechanisms. 12. Build positive working relationships with participants, colleagues, funders, referral partners and external stakeholders, acting as a professional representative of NOW Group at all times This job description is not definitive and may be subject to review as the duties and responsibilities determine. What We Offer At NOW Group, we value and invest in our team. As part of our organisation, you’ll benefit from: Generous Leave: 25 days annual leave plus 11 statutory days (pro-rata). Health Cash Plan: Available after successful probation. Wellbeing Support: Confidential staff counselling and financial advisory services. Pension Scheme: 5% employer contribution. Flexible Work Initiatives: Including the Bike-to-Work scheme, holiday purchase options, and more. About The Role Additional Information Employment is subject to a Garda Vetting check. NOW Group is committed to fair recruitment practices. Policies on safeguarding, recruitment of ex-offenders, and data protection are available upon request. Required Criteria 1. A Leaving Certificate (or equivalent qualification), including passes in English and Mathematics. 2. Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office applications, with demonstrable experience using Microsoft Word and Excel. 3. A minimum of two years' recent administrative or secretarial experience in a busy office environment. 4. Experience of establishing and maintaining effective filing, data management and reporting systems. 5. Experience of carrying out quality checks, audits, or compliance monitoring activities. 6. Knowledge of GDPR requirements and an understanding of compliance and data protection principles. 7. Excellent organisational, planning and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands and meet deadlines. 8. Strong attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when handling records, reports, and compliance documentation. Desired Criteria 1. Experience of working with funded programmes. 2. Experience of working in an accredited training / further education / awarding body environment. About The Company At the heart of the NOW Group’s mission is its commitment to empowering individuals to gain skills and access meaningful employment. It achieves this through tailored employment academies, which provide participants with industry-specific training and work placements, and through their social enterprise businesses Loaf Catering and Cafes and Loaf Pottery. items.desc: FP&A Specialist/Group FP&A Lead: Build Our Forecasting Function from Scratch Remote (Ireland or UK) | Reporting to the Group CFO | Yomali Why This Role Exists Yomali has never had a formal forecasting capability, and that's about to change. We're a privately-held group of e-commerce businesses (HelpGrid, BuyGoods, MaxWeb and more). Today our leaders don't have a consistent way to forecast revenue and costs, understand variance, or be held accountable to their numbers. We're building that capability from the ground up. The forecasting model will be built in Excel and loaded into Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for reporting against actuals. We need someone who has built models like this before to lead the build. This isn't a role where you inherit a working model and keep the lights on. You're building the model. What You'll Own Design, build and maintain our driver-based Excel forecasting and budgeting model, starting with HelpGrid, BuyGoods and MaxWeb Load the outputs into Business Central and report forecast versus actual Own the accountability loop, making sure business leaders understand, use and stand behind their forecasts Build visibility of the cost base down to supplier level, working with our Financial Controllers Run what-if and scenario analysis for leadership Evolve the model as we grow, so it scales and can move into a dedicated planning platform when the time is right You'll work directly with our Group CFO, Financial Controllers and business unit leaders, with real autonomy and real visibility into how the business runs. What Success Looks Like First 3–6 months: The foundations of the Excel forecasting model are in place. The revenue and cost drivers for HelpGrid, BuyGoods and MaxWeb are built and tested, and the outputs are loading into Business Central. 12 months: A full 12-month budget is built and loaded. There's a regular rhythm of forecast-versus-actual conversations between Finance and business leaders, who use Finance's numbers in their own performance reviews. Supplier-level spend reporting is live. What We're Looking For Substantial hands-on FP&A experience , including having personally built a driver-based forecasting or budgeting model in Excel from scratch, not just maintained or administered one that already existed Advanced Excel financial modelling: scenario analysis, clear model structure and integrity checks. You should also be comfortable reviewing and improving a model someone else built Comfortable owning forecast-vs-actual conversations directly with business stakeholders, including pushing back when the numbers don't add up Able to explain the numbers clearly to non-finance leaders Genuinely energised by complex "what-if" modelling, not just running the base forecast but exploring what a new market or acquisition could look like Able to work autonomously, without a team beneath you or an established playbook to follow Experience loading budget or forecast data into an ERP and reporting against actuals is helpful. Business Central or NAV is a plus, but any ERP (Oracle, SAP, Sage, Workday, NetSuite or similar) is fine Experience with a dedicated planning platform (Anaplan, Vena, Planful, Adaptive, Datarails, Pigment or similar) is a bonus, not a requirement Professional finance qualification (CIMA/CGMA, ACCA, ACA or equivalent) preferred, not required Who Thrives Here You'll do well here if you're the kind of person who gets excited by ambiguity rather than overwhelmed by it. There's no existing FP&A team to lean on. You'll be it, with our CFO backing you up. You'll need to be strategic about sequencing (one business at a time, not all three at once) and comfortable holding your ground with senior stakeholders who are new to forecasting. This role won't suit someone who needs an established process, a team of analysts to delegate to, or quick, fully-validated wins in the first few months. It will suit someone who wants to point at a forecasting capability in a year's time and say "I built that." Why People Stay / Love Working Here Our finance team spans Malta, Switzerland, the Philippines and the UK & Ireland, around 11 people in Finance and roughly 600 across the wider Group. The culture is genuinely open: people want to evolve how things are done, there's no bureaucracy slowing you down, and our CFO leads by trusting people to own their remit rather than micromanaging it. What's In It For You Genuine ownership: you're not maintaining someone else's model, you're building the Group's forecasting capability from day one Direct access and visibility: you'll work closely with the Group CFO and business unit leaders, not buried in a large finance function Fully remote, 9am–5pm UK/Ireland time Competitive salary: Ireland: €68,000–€92,000 base | UK: £62,000–£82,000 base A rare chance to shape how an entire Group forecasts and makes decisions. This isn't a role you'll find advertised often Interview Process Initial conversation with Talent Interview with Group CFO, …

items.desc: TXT Group is an international, IT end-to-end provider of consultancy, software solutions and services, supporting the digital transformation of customers’ products and core processes. With a proprietary software portfolio and deep expertise in vertical domains, TXT Group operates across different markets, with a growing footprint in Aerospace, Aviation, Defense, Industrial, Government and Fintech. The holding company, TXT e-Solutions, has been listed on the Italian Stock Exchange - STAR segment (TXT.MI) - since July 2000. TXT Group is headquartered in Milan and has subsidiaries in Italy, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland and the United States of America. Embedded Software Engineer: TXT e-Tech, part of the TXT Group, is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to work at one of our clients’ sites within the Aerospace & Aviation division. As part of the European MALE RPAS programme, the successful candidate will join the development team for the Airborne Armament Computer (AAC), a component of the AAS system, and will be involved in all phases of the software development cycle: from the elicitation of system requirements through to the writing, integration and configuration management of the application code, working within a real-time embedded environment certified to the DO-178C aeronautical standard. Key responsibilities: Involvement in the elicitation of AAS system requirements to feed into the software development process. Involvement in the development of software requirements (High-Level Requirements) based on the system requirements. Involvement in the development of the Detailed Design, including the production of low-level requirements (where necessary) for the AAS system. Writing and maintaining requirements in the DOORS database. Involvement in the development, integration and configuration management of the AAS system’s application code. Technical requirements: Knowledge of the C programming language; Experience in programming real-time embedded applications in the avionics sector. Optional technical requirements: Knowledge of the RTCA DO-178C standard; Experience in preparing software requirements (HLR) for real-time embedded applications in the avionics sector; knowledge of the IBM Rational Rhapsody tool (SysML/UML); Knowledge of the IBM Rational DOORS tool; Knowledge of the Serena Dimensions tool; Knowledge of the Integrity 178B ARINC 653 real-time embedded operating system; Knowledge of the MathWorks Polyspace tool (Bug Finder and Code Prover). Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics or Electronics. The ideal candidate will also demonstrate attention to detail, an aptitude for teamwork and a keen interest in learning and developing within complex, multidisciplinary technological environments. Why choose TXT GROUP: Career opportunities in a fast-growing and profoundly changing company with international staff; Training on business-related topics; Corporate Benefits (health insurance, welfare, Ticket Restaurant, discounts as a group employee). The contract offered for this position is a permanent one, and the salary range for this position is between EUR 28.000 € and EUR 30.000 € gross per year. The grading/level will be defined during the selection process based on the candidate's profile and in accordance with the National Collective Labor Agreement (Metalworking Industry). This position is open to all applicants regardless of gender in accordance with Legislative Decree 198/2006. The company promotes equal opportunities and values diversity in all its forms.

items.desc: Job Description Contribuisci alla qualità dei prodotti che aiutano milioni di persone nel mondo. Stevanato Group è uno dei principali fornitori a livello mondiale di soluzioni integrate per il contenimento e la somministrazione di farmaci destinate all’industria biofarmaceutica. Per il nostro stabilimento di Piombino Dese (PD) cerchiamo una persona che desideri entrare a far parte di un contesto produttivo tecnologicamente avanzato e orientato alla qualità, assumendo il ruolo di punto di riferimento per il controllo dei prodotti durante il processo produttivo. Perché questo ruolo è importante In qualità di Referente della Qualità in Linea , contribuirai direttamente a garantire che i prodotti realizzati rispettino gli standard richiesti dall’industria farmaceutica. Attraverso i controlli effettuati durante il processo, l’analisi delle eventuali anomalie e la collaborazione con le altre funzioni di reparto, aiuterai a tutelare la qualità e l’affidabilità dei prodotti che realizziamo ogni giorno. Cosa farai Eseguirai in autonomia controlli statistici, visivi, dimensionali, funzionali e di imballaggio durante il processo produttivo, nel rispetto dei piani di controllo e delle tempistiche previste. Sarai il punto di riferimento per la qualità del prodotto durante il turno, sia all’interno sia all’esterno della Clean Room. Raccoglierai e condividerai le informazioni relative allo stato delle linee, collaborando con le altre funzioni coinvolte nella gestione della produzione. Registrerai i risultati dei controlli e le informazioni richieste attraverso software e modulistica dedicata. Riconoscerai e segnalerai eventuali non conformità e situazioni fuori specifica, collaborando alla valutazione dei difetti e alla verifica dell’efficacia delle azioni correttive. Fornirai supporto nelle attività di selezione e rilavorazione collegate alle non conformità. Contribuirai alla formazione e all’affiancamento del personale sulle attività e sulle procedure di qualità. Ti impegnerai a mantenere elevati standard di ordine, pulizia e sicurezza nelle aree di lavoro. Lavorerai su turni a ciclo continuo, secondo calendario 3-2. Qualifications Chi cerchiamo Hai conseguito almeno un diploma di scuola secondaria. Hai maturato esperienza in contesti produttivi strutturati, preferibilmente in attività di controllo qualità o controllo di processo. Possiedi una buona dimestichezza nell’utilizzo del computer e degli strumenti digitali. Sei una persona responsabile, precisa e attenta ai dettagli. Sai comunicare in modo chiaro e collaborare efficacemente con persone e funzioni differenti. Affronti le anomalie con spirito pratico e orientamento alla risoluzione dei problemi. Sei disponibile al lavoro su turni a ciclo continuo. Un’esperienza nei settori farmaceutico, biomedicale, cosmetico o alimentare rappresenta un plus. Cosa troverai Un ambiente strutturato e in continua evoluzione Formazione e affiancamento per sviluppare le tue competenze Un team collaborativo e orientato al miglioramento continuo L'opportunità di contribuire a prodotti destinati al mondo farmaceutico e della salute Cosa offriamo In Stevanato Group, crediamo che risultati sostenibili nel tempo nascano dalla giusta combinazione di strumenti, supporto, benessere e sviluppo continuo. Come parte della nostra offerta in Italia, potrai beneficiare di: Buoni pasto da 8€ , a supporto della tua esperienza quotidiana in azienda. Accesso alla nostra piattaforma welfare, con 800 € all’anno da utilizzare per benefit flessibili a supporto del benessere, delle esigenze familiari e dello stile di vita, oltre a sconti esclusivi per i dipendenti. Per questo ruolo, la retribuzione prevista parte da €23.000 con maggiorazioni medie di €5.000. La retribuzione effettiva dipenderà da diversi fattori legati al ruolo, tra cui la sede geografica, l’esperienza professionale, il percorso di studi e il livello di competenze. Il nostro impegno Se questa opportunità ti sembra interessante, ti invitiamo ad approfondirla e a candidarti, anche se la tua esperienza non corrisponde perfettamente a tutti i requisiti. In Stevanato Group , ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e diversificato, e crediamo che potenziale, approccio e motivazione siano importanti tanto quanto l’esperienza. About Us At the heart of the Stevanato Group’s vision is the desire to develop innovative solutions to solve complex problems for our customers across the pharmaceutical industry providing them products, processes and services that guarantee the integrity of parenteral drugs in a way that is far superior to anything that has been achieved before. With a worldwide presence, Stevanato Group employs more than 3,200 people who share this commitment towards customer satisfaction and patient well-being. Joining Stevanato Group you become part of a group of highly dedicated people who pursues its business goals driven by an e thical and transparent mindset, fostering innovation.

items.desc: Jurist contractenrecht & Intellectueel Eigendomsrecht (IE) Met juridisch advies en sterke contracten maak jij baanbrekend onderzoek en innovatie mogelijk. Als jurist contractenrecht met expertise in intellectueel eigendomsrecht draag je bij aan juridisch sterke samenwerkingen en de bescherming van kennis en innovatie. Functieomschrijving Bij TU Delft werken wetenschappers, studenten, bedrijven en maatschappelijke organisaties samen aan oplossingen voor de grote uitdagingen van onze tijd. Van de energietransitie tot gezondheid en digitalisering: ons onderzoek heeft impact op de samenleving. Om deze ambities waar te maken, werken we samen met uiteenlopende nationale en internationale partners. Als jurist contractenrecht en intellectueel eigendomsrecht zorg jij dat deze samenwerkingen juridisch goed zijn geregeld. De belangen van TU Delft en haar samenwerkingspartners lopen niet altijd gelijk. Bovendien hebben internationale partners, verschillende financieringsvoorwaarden en de aard van het onderzoek invloed op de afspraken die nodig zijn. Hoe bescherm je de belangen van TU Delft en zorg je tegelijkertijd voor werkbare afspraken die ruimte bieden aan samenwerking en innovatie? En hoe ga je om met intellectueel eigendom dat tijdens gezamenlijk onderzoek ontstaat of wordt ingebracht? Je overziet de juridische en organisatorische belangen en kijkt daarbij verder dan de formulering van een contract. Je hebt oog voor de bredere context en het doel van de samenwerking, brengt de verwachtingen van partijen samen en vertaalt deze naar juridisch houdbare afspraken die ruimte bieden aan onderzoek en innovatie. Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden: Je adviseert faculteiten, ondersteunende diensten en het College van Bestuur over uiteenlopende privaatrechtelijke vraagstukken. Je adviseert over samenwerkingsconstructies en de juridische voorwaarden waaronder onderzoek kan plaatsvinden. Daarbij heb je oog voor juridische risico’s en vertaal je deze naar praktische oplossingen en heldere afspraken. Je voert contractonderhandelingen met nationale en internationale samenwerkingspartners, stelt overeenkomsten op voor gesubsidieerd en commercieel gefinancierd onderzoek en beoordeelt bestaande contracten. Je adviseert over intellectueel eigendom in onderzoeks- en samenwerkingsovereenkomsten en bent binnen het cluster Civiel het aanspreekpunt voor complexere IE-vraagstukken. Je deelt je kennis met collega's en draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het contractbeleid en de modelovereenkomsten van TU Delft. Je werkomgeving Je wordt onderdeel van het cluster Civiel binnen Legal Affairs, samen met drie andere juristen. Binnen het cluster verdelen jullie de specialisaties en interessegebieden op basis van kennis en ervaring. Zo vullen jullie elkaar aan en kunnen jullie ook bij complexe juridische vraagstukken op elkaars expertise terugvallen. Je behandelt zelfstandig je eigen dossiers, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking op wanneer dat nodig is. Legal Affairs bestaat uit achttien juristen en adviseert de hele universiteit. Je werkt daardoor samen met uiteenlopende collega's en stakeholders, zoals onderzoekers, beleidsmedewerkers, bestuurders en andere juridische specialisten. Ook heb je regelmatig contact met externe advocaten en internationale samenwerkingspartners. Een omgeving waarin je veel verschillende belangen bij elkaar brengt, inhoudelijk wordt uitgedaagd en volop ruimte krijgt om je juridische expertise verder te ontwikkelen. Functie-eisen Je bent een ervaren jurist die complexe juridische vraagstukken snel doorgrondt, vanuit verschillende invalshoeken analyseert en vertaalt naar heldere, praktische adviezen. Je werkt zelfstandig, stelt de juiste prioriteiten en weet verwachtingen goed te managen. Je combineert juridische scherpte met een oplossingsgerichte aanpak en zoekt actief de samenwerking op wanneer een dossier daarom vraagt. Daarnaast beschik je over: Een wo-diploma Nederlands recht. Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring met het (internationaal) contractenrecht. Gedegen kennis van het intellectueel eigendomsrecht en ervaring met allerlei IE-gerelateerde transacties. Je bent bereid je in het staatssteunrecht te verdiepen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, advieskracht en gevoel voor bestuurlijke verhoudingen. Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke vaardigheden in zowel het Engels als het Nederlands. TU Delft Werken bij TU Delft betekent bijdragen aan oplossingen die er echt toe doen. Al meer dan 180 jaar leiden we ingenieurs op die wereldwijd impact maken bij bedrijven, overheden of als ondernemer. Onze alumni zetten kennis om in concrete oplossingen voor de uitdagingen van vandaag en morgen. Die uitdagingen veranderen snel. Daarom werken we elke dag aan thema’s zoals energie, klimaat, digitalisering, AI en slimme mobiliteit. Ons onderwijs en onderzoek sluiten direct aan op wat de samenleving nodig heeft, nu en straks. Bij TU Delft maken mensen het verschil. Met hun kennis en nieuwsgierigheid zorgen zij voor sterk …
