items.desc: Jouw baan Wij zoeken een veelzijdige Back-up & restore Engineer voor het beheren van onze datacenters en het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van een stabiele en veilige back-up & restore infrastructuur waarmee we al onze bedrijfsdata kunnen veiligstellen en herstellen. Samen met je collega’s maak je een goed plan voor de selectie van nieuw te gebruiken hardware die voldoet aan onze requirements waardoor afgeschreven hardware tijdig vervangen kan worden. Je bent als back-up & restore specialist primair verantwoordelijk voor het veiligstellen, herstellen en optimaliseren van alle bedrijfsdata binnen onze entreprise omgeving. Je beheert een volledig redundant back-up platform gebaseerd op VEEAM, verspreid over twee eigen datacenters. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze data altijd beschikbaar, beschermd en compliant is - ook in de meest kritische situaties. Je hebt een sterk gevoel voor security, omdat onze data maximaal beschermd moet worden en zelfs in de meest extreme situaties (hacking attacks, natuurrampen, datacenter down) veilig en herstelbaar moet zijn. Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden als Back-up & restore Engineer zijn: het beheren en onderhouden van onze backup & restore omgeving; het zorgen voor een correcte backup van onze data binnen de WUR; het bewaken van de performance en de capaciteit van de backup omgeving; het bedenken en onderhouden van onze disaster recovery scenario’s; het opstellen van een roadmap voor tijdige vervanging en uitbreiding om de toenemende vraag voor te blijven. Je bent in staat om ver vooruit te kijken om ontwikkelingen in de technologie goed mee te kunnen nemen in ons datacenter ontwerp; regulier beheer zoals incident afhandeling, troubleshooting, monitoring en onderhoud; lifecycle management en het patchen, upgraden en migreren van hard- en software, zowel op Linux als Windows; het automatiseren van taken en werkzaamheden; het verlenen van consultancy en advies; documenteren van technische architectuur, beheerprocedures en runbooks. Jouw team Wij zijn het Multidisciplinair Team Datacenter management & Storage Services, onderdeel van DIAS (Digitalisation, Information & Archiving Services). We zijn met 10 medewerkers verantwoordelijk voor het inrichten en beheren van onze datacenters, het installeren en beheren van rackmount servers, storage omgevingen en het beheren van de back-up infrastructuur. Je werkt nauw samen met gebruikers, Security en IT-teams om de continuïteit van onze bedrijfsprocessen te garanderen. Met jouw ervaring weet je risico’s vroegtijdig te signaleren en verbeteringen door te voeren in processen, tooling en architectuur. Je maakt IT-infrastructuur ontwerpen waarmee het team Infrastructure-as-a-Service kan bieden aan haar gebruikers. Je denkt mee over manieren om de dienstverlening en het beheer waar mogelijk te automatiseren en je analyseert aanwezige kwetsbaarheden om ze waar nodig zo snel mogelijk op te kunnen lossen. Je bekijkt samen met onze leveranciers welke hardware we gebruiken en welke firmware versies nodig zijn om onderlinge compatibiliteit, stabiliteit en veiligheid te borgen. Ook ben je bedreven in het aanmaken van cases bij onze leveranciers, kun je snel de benodigde informatie vinden en opleveren en weet je druk te zetten waar nodig. Je geeft richting aan onze leveranciers met je visie op het gebruik van onze infra. Het werk is zeer divers: zowel beheer als ontwikkeling en zowel tactisch als operationeel. Hier ga je werken Je komt te werken in een professionele IT-organisatie met meer dan 200 IT specialisten waar je veel kunt leren en jezelf goed kunt ontwikkelen. We hebben twee eigen datacenters op onze mooie, groene en ruime campus en we zetten ons in voor digitale soevereiniteit, het gebruik van open source oplossingen en een duurzaam gebruik van onze omgeving. Je werkt met state-of-the-art technologie en krijgt veel ruimte om te innoveren. De werkzaamheden vinden hoofdzakelijk plaats tijdens kantooruren, maar je zult waar nodig ook gevraagd worden mee te werken aan onderhoud buiten kantoortijden (’s avonds of in het weekend). Daarnaast loop je samen met je collega’s volgens een afgesproken rooster 7x24 stand-by voor security incidenten (maximaal een week per maand). In overleg kan er een deel van de tijd vanuit huis worden gewerkt. Jouw kwaliteiten Jij bent een zelfstandige en leergierige IT-professional. Je werkt graag samen met andere professionals en verschillende stakeholders in een agile omgeving. Je bent een verbinder en durft je uit te spreken en door te vragen. Je bent een echte doorpakker, communicatief sterk en draagt onderwijs- en onderzoek een warm hart toe. Daarnaast ben je analytisch ingesteld maar ook oplossings- en klantgericht. Je bent initiatiefrijk en beschikt over de drive en het organisatietalent om dingen als kartrekker voor elkaar te krijgen. Je bent creatief en zoekt steeds naar nieuwe oplossingen om bestaande omgevingen effectiever en nieuwe functionaliteiten mogelijk te maken. Verder heb je een goed oog voor de …

items.title: Junior Vegetable Oils Trader
items.card: About the role As Junior Vegetable Oils Trader, you will be part of AAK’s European Sourcing & Trading team, supporting the sourcing and trading of vegetable oils across our European business. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with up to three years of experience in commodity trading, sourcing, procurement or a related commercial role who is looking to build a long-term career in international trading.
items.desc: Junior Vegetable Oils Trader Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe. We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food - we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet. Everything we do is about Making Better Happen™ . AAK Location This role is based in either Rotterdam or Zaandijk, The Netherlands. About the role As Junior Vegetable Oils Trader, you will be part of AAK’s European Sourcing & Trading team, supporting the sourcing and trading of vegetable oils across our European business. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with up to three years of experience in commodity trading, sourcing, procurement or a related commercial role who is looking to build a long-term career in international trading. Working alongside experienced traders, you will develop market knowledge, commercial judgement and disciplined trading skills while gaining exposure to the fast-moving world of agricultural commodities. You will monitor market developments, support trade execution and help ensure reliable supply across AAK’s European operations. As your experience grows, you will take increasing ownership of selected trades, supplier relationships and purchasing decisions, all within agreed trading mandates and risk frameworks. Responsibilities Monitor vegetable oils markets, including prices, supply and demand trends, freight, currencies and relevant geopolitical or regulatory developments. Support the execution of physical vegetable oils trades, including quotations, contract confirmations, delivery coordination and trade follow-up. Maintain accurate trading positions, pricing records and exposure reporting, escalating risks or discrepancies where required. Contribute to pricing analysis, hedging preparation and trading recommendations under the guidance of senior traders. Build strong relationships with suppliers, brokers, customers and internal stakeholders to support reliable supply and identify commercial opportunities. Collaborate with Supply Chain, Finance, Quality, Sustainability, Sales and Operations to resolve commercial and operational issues. Develop your understanding of commodity markets, trading disciplines and risk management while progressively taking ownership of selected categories and trades. Ensure compliance with trading governance, contractual obligations and sustainability requirements across all activities. About you Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Supply Chain, Agribusiness or a related field. Up to three years of relevant experience in commodity trading, sourcing, procurement, logistics, market analysis or a similar commercial environment; internships and graduate experience are also valued. Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret market data and draw clear commercial conclusions. A genuine interest in vegetable oils, agricultural commodities and international physical trading. Commercial mindset combined with strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to learning. Ability to work within structured risk and governance frameworks while developing sound trading judgement. Strong communication skills and the confidence to build relationships with colleagues, suppliers and market partners. Fluent in English; additional European languages are an advantage. In return AAK offers Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability. In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team. AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths. You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach. Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents. Contact and information For further information about the position, please contact Paul Engwell, Talent Acquisition Specialist: paul.engwell@aak.com About AAK Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™ . We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable. At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care. items.desc: Business Consultant / Analyst Collateral Management Lifecycle (hay 10) At a glance Are you ready to be a part of the exciting changes happening in ABN Amro's Corporate Credit Landscape? We are seeking individuals who are passionate about learning and developing their skills while designing future-proof end-to-end lending processes within Financing Solutions. ABN AMRO is committed to enriching and renewing the lending landscape by simplifying and accelerating processes to better identify customer risks and serve them transparently. As part of the Credits Capability Grid department, we are digitizing customer data and building a new central credit platform. Your role will be crucial in identifying business needs and translating them to our IT department. If you are ready to contribute to the credit landscape of the future and be a part of our mission to serve our customers better, then we want you on our team. Join us as a Business Consultant / Analyst in building a brighter future for lending! Your job We are looking for a Business Consultant / Analyst to design and continuously improve our new digital end-to-end lending processes. In this position, you will have the opportunity to make a positive impact on the future of lending. You will be working for the Collateral Management Lifecycle team within Corporate Banking, responsible for a new digital end-to-end customer journey. Your role will involve driving requirement gathering from end-users and specialist teams , such as Lenders, Credit Risk, Contracting, Operations and Regulatory. Turning these into technical designs for our Salesforce credit origination platform. Balancing regulatory requirements with practical, day-to-day operational feasibility to ensure compliant yet workable solutions for end-users. As the bridge between end-users and our developers, you will learn the end-to-end journey of corporate credits and the daily tasks of our end-users. In order to excel at this job, you need to be creative, good at stakeholder management, organized, empathetic towards users, like a challenge, and eager to learn about our software and processes. Examples of day-to-day tasks include: Analysing services, business processes, information flows, user and system requirements to identify opportunities. Translating product roadmap features into concrete user stories by identifying and prioritizing technical and functional requirements. Creating system and/or data model designs which you translate in clear documentation to develop a shared understanding of the topic and improve organizational learning. Supporting implementation, helping the development team to deliver quality by collaborating on test design and user acceptance tests. Working environment We are excited to welcome you to our devops team within the Collateral Management Lifecycle shop. You will work closely with colleagues from other streams, such as Integrations, Business Implementation, Regulatory, and subject matter experts from departments such as Lending, Risk and FR&R. Collaboration is key to our success, and we are committed to create a supportive and inclusive workplace culture. A healthy work-life balance is essential for you to thrive and succeed in your role where we strive to be between 2 a 3 days a week at the office. Your profile You are passionate about devops, driven to learn and grow and eager to contribute to our mission of shaping the future of lending. If you are a team player who enjoys working collaboratively, then we would love to hear from you. Join us in making a positive impact on the world of Collateral Management! As a problem-solver, you enjoy tackling complex challenges and providing structure to problems. You take ownership of challenges and can translate requirements into Salesforce functionalities in collaboration with our IT teams. You are a connector, building bridges and bringing others together. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and experiences, including those without professional working experience in banking. We are looking for someone who is eager to learn and can bring a positive attitude to the team. We will provide you with the necessary training and support to excel in the role. Job Overview Wegens uitbreiding van onze werkzaamheden zijn wij op zoek naar diverse; CYTOLOGISCHE ANALISTEN De afdeling Discovery & Environmental Sciences bestaat uit circa 40 medewerkers. Binnen deze afdeling wordt onderzoek uitgevoerd naar de veiligheid van bestaande en nieuwe stoffen. Kenmerkend voor het werk is de grote diversiteit aan testen, teststoffen en klanten. Je taken De taken voor de cytologische/cytogenetische analisten bestaan uit het microscopisch beoordelen van preparaten behorende bij mutageniciteitsonderzoeken (bijvoorbeeld in vitro en in vivo micronucleus studies). De werkzaamheden kunnen grotendeels vanuit huis worden uitgevoerd. Hiervoor ontvang je een microscoop van Charles River. Voor specifieke studies wordt gebruik gemaakt van een fluorescentiemicroscoop. In overleg is het dan mogelijk om gedurende een vooraf afgesproken periode gemiddeld één dag per week op onze locatie. Uiteraard wordt dit tijdig afgestemd. Je profiel Afgeronde MLO- of HLO/HBO-opleiding; Ervaring met GLP is gewenst; Goede communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden; Accuraat, zelfstandig en flexibel; Vaardigheden op cytologisch gebied gewenst; Bereidheid om voor specifieke onderzoeksprojecten gedurende een afgesproken periode één dag per week op locatie te werken. Wat bieden we jou: De mogelijkheid je verder te ontwikkelen in je vakgebied; Passend uurloon, inclusief vakantieuren en vakantiegeld; Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer met een maximum van 100 kilometer per dag. Physical Requirements About Safety Assessment Charles River is committed to helping our partners expedite their preclinical drug development with exceptional safety assessment services, state-of-the-art facilities and expert regulatory guidance. From individual specialty toxicology and IND enabling studies to tailored packages and total laboratory support, our deeply experienced team can design and execute programs that anticipate challenges and avoid roadblocks for a smooth, efficient journey to market. Each year approximately 300 investigational new drug (IND) programs are conducted in our Safety Assessment facilities. About Charles River Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market. With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world. At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well-being of many across the globe. We have proudly worked on 80% of the drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the past five years. At Charles River Laboratories, we recognize and recruit all talent. Ønsker du i tillegg å bidra til å gjøre Norge tryggere? Da er du kanskje den vi ser etter! Avdelingen for taktisk og teknisk innhenting er PSTs øyne og ører utad og henter inn informasjon, slik at PST er i stand til å oppdage trusler og gjøre de riktige vurderingene når det gjelder landets sikkerhet. Avdelingen har et nasjonalt ansvar for innhenting og analyse av informasjon fra åpne kilder samt for utvikling av fagområdet OSINT og av metoder for informasjonsinnhenting fra internett. PST bygger opp et nytt miljø innenfor innhenting og analyse fra åpne kilder, og vi søker derfor nye kollegaer med varierte bakgrunner og ferdigheter til stillinger som utvikler. Vi ser etter deg som liker å samle store datamengder og hente ut merverdi av disse. Arbeidsoppgaver Som OSINT-utvikler vil du løse komplekse oppgaver som krever kreativitet, og du vil få en stor grad av innflytelse over utviklingen av metoder og verktøy innen fagdisiplinen - også direkte rettet mot de aktuelle sakene vi jobber med. Du vil jobbe sammen med researchere og analytikere, samt øvrige innhentings- og teknologimiljøer i organisasjonen, for å utvikle verktøy og metoder i takt med utviklingen av ny teknologi og digitale muligheter. Arbeidsoppgavene omfatter blant annet å: innhente, bearbeide og tilgjengeliggjøre data i en rekke ulike formater sette opp og prosessere datastrømmer samt utvikle eller utnytte AI-modeller, plattformer, metoder og verktøy På grunn av kompleksiteten i arbeidsoppgavene og som ansatt i en sikkerhets- og etterretningstjeneste, forstår du kanskje at vi ikke har mulighet til å jobbe hjemmefra, men vi har desto bedre muligheter for å støtte oss på, sparre med og utvikle oss faglig i samarbeid med gode kolleger. Endringer i stillingsinnhold, arbeidstid og organisatorisk tilhørighet kan forekomme. Kvalifikasjoner Vi ser fortrinnsvis etter utviklere med fullført og relevant høyere utdanning innen et teknisk fagområde. For oss er likevel dine tekniske ferdigheter, kreativitet og interesse det aller viktigste, og relevant erfaring med tilsvarende arbeidsoppgaver kan derfor kompensere for utdanningskravet. For å kvalifisere til stilling som overingeniør/rådgiver må du ha: relevant høyere utdanning på bachelornivå eller flerårig erfaring med utviklingsprosjekter relevant erfaring med prosessering og analyse av store datamengder relevant erfaring med programmering og utvikling av systemer på ulike plattformer For å kvalifisere til stilling som senioringeniør/seniorrådgiver må du i tillegg ha: relevant høyere utdanning på masternivå eller flere års erfaring med kompliserte utviklingsprosjekter relevant erfaring på høyt nivå og relevant spesialkompetanse og har hatt ansvar for teknologivalg og håndtering av uforutsette utfordringer gjerne fungert som faglig mentor for mindre erfarne utviklere, eventuelt også organisert og strukturert utviklingsprosjekter Til begge stillingene er det er en fordel om du har relevant erfaring med og/eller kjennskap til et eller flere av disse fagområdene: programmering i ulike språk skraping og automatisert innhenting stordata og datasjøer arkitektur nettverk databaser og datastruktur API-integrasjon dataanalyse cybersikkerhet styring, struktur og kontroll av utviklingsprosjekter UI/UX- og interaksjonsdesign maskinlæring og natural language processing identifisering og søk i åpne informasjonskilder (sosiale medier, offisielle registre, karttjenester o.l.) rammeverk og beste praksis innen OSINT Personlige egenskaper Vi ser etter deg som er kreativ, initiativrik og nysgjerrig. Du har gode analytiske evner og en metodisk tilnærming til å vurdere og strukturere komplekse mengder informasjon. Du søker innsikt og kunnskap proaktivt for å holde deg oppdatert på relevante trender og utvikling. Du har gode samarbeidsevner og arbeider effektivt både selvstendig og i team, og du håndterer tidsfrister godt. Du har god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne og formidler kjernen i problemstillinger og løsninger på en forståelig måte til ulike målgrupper. PSTs mandat stiller store krav til din faglige integritet og etiske vurderingsevne, samt til din evne til å følge etablerte rammebetingelser. PST er underlagt sikkerhetsloven, og det stilles strenge krav til at våre ansatte har en sikkerhetsbevisst atferd. For en stilling i PST vil personlig egnethet vektlegges i stor grad, og du må som ansatt ha egenskaper som pålitelighet, dømmekraft og lojalitet. Videre må du tilfredsstille kravene til sikkerhetsklarering for STRENGT HEMMELIG og NATO SECRET og for autorisasjon. items.desc: We are looking for a Cybersecurity Architect to define and govern security architecture across connectivity, critical facilities and digital infrastructure. You will translate business, technology, risk and regulatory requirements into secure and operationally supportable architectures. items.desc: Reklamy, które oglądasz w telewizji i internecie, często powstają właśnie u nas. TELEVISOR to studio postprodukcji, animacji i AI. Pracujemy dla dużych marek i agencji reklamowych w dwóch budynkach na zielonej Sadybie, z ogrodem i basenem. Nasi klienci często spędzają u nas cały dzień. Chcemy, żeby czuli się jak u dobrych znajomych i chętnie do nas wracali. Kogo szukamy Szukamy osoby, która zadba o studio jak o swój dom. To Ty będziesz pierwszą osobą, którą zobaczą nasi goście. Lubisz ludzi, masz oko do szczegółów i dobry gust. Zauważasz, co można zrobić lepiej, i po prostu to robisz. Prowadzisz kilkuosobowy zespół recepcji. Jeśli cieszy Cię, kiedy goście wychodzą zadowoleni, a w biurze wszystko działa, to miejsce jest dla Ciebie. Czym się zajmiesz — Przyjmowaniem klientów i gości oraz opieką nad nimi w trakcie wizyty. — Prowadzeniem zespołu recepcji, przygotowywaniem grafiku pracy, rozliczaniem godzin, wdrażaniem nowych osób. — Przygotowaniem spotkań razem z produkcją, tak żeby wszystko było gotowe na czas. — Dbaniem o atmosferę w studiu, w tym o kwiaty, rośliny i wystrój. — Dbaniem o porządek i wygląd budynków, kuchni i ogrodu. — Zamawianiem cateringu, kawy i zaopatrzenia. — Współpracą z dostawcami (sprzątanie, woda, kawa, ogród, basen) i zlecaniem drobnych napraw. — Bieżącymi sprawami biura: zakupy, kurierzy. — Comiesięcznym zbieraniem i opisywaniem faktur oraz rozliczeń kart firmowych dla księgowości. Czego oczekujemy — Min. 2 lata doświadczenia jako koordynator recepcji, office manager, na recepcji, w hotelu, gastronomii lub przy eventach. — Doświadczenia w koordynowaniu pracy innych osób, formalnego lub nie. — Samodzielności i dbałości o szczegóły. — Spokoju i dobrej organizacji, nawet gdy dużo dzieje się naraz. — Swobody w pracy z arkuszami i dokumentami. — Angielskiego na poziomie swobodnej rozmowy z klientem. — Gotowości do zadań praktycznych, nie tylko przy biurku. — Sympatii do psów. Co oferujemy — Umowę o pracę na pełny etat. — Pracę 8 godzin dziennie, ze startem między 7:00 a 9:00, ustalanym z wyprzedzeniem pod wizyty klientów. — Realny wpływ na to, jak wygląda i działa studio, oraz własny budżet na bieżące decyzje. — Kartę Multisport. — Prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover. — Studio z ogrodem i basenem, z którego możesz korzystać na zielonej Sadybie. — Pyszną kawę i zawsze pełną miskę owoców. — Psie towarzystwo na co dzień. — Życzliwy zespół, który doceni Twoją pracę. Jak aplikować Wyślij nam CV i kilka zdań o tym, co udało Ci się zmienić na lepsze w poprzedniej pracy. Proces: krótka rozmowa telefoniczna, spotkanie w studiu, potem płatny dzień próbny. Do zobaczenia na Okrężnej!

items.desc: At Media Miami, we believe every brand has a story worth telling—and we’re here to turn that story into something powerful, memorable, and impactful. We operate as a specialised team of A-players who move fast, think strategically, and take ownership. We’re not about bureaucracy—we're about execution, growth, and doing meaningful work that drives real outcomes. Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on Automation & Infrastructure Engineer to build, maintain, and continuously improve the technical infrastructure behind our growing digital publishing and newsletter operation. This is not a traditional DevOps role and not a purely operational support position. We need someone who can understand a manual workflow, work through it when necessary, and then turn it into a reliable, scalable system using code, APIs, automation tools, and AI. As the number of newsletters, domains, accounts, and operational workflows grows, your responsibility will be to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and build technical systems that allow the operation to scale without increasing headcount at the same rate. We are looking for someone who can turn unclear operational problems into reliable technical solutions, troubleshooting unfamiliar systems independently in a fast-changing environment where not every process is documented. You will bring a strong focus on edge cases, logging, error handling, and data integrity to everything you build. Key Responsibilities Automation & Integrations Build and maintain automations for recurring operational workflows Integrate internal and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and custom scripts Build workflows in n8n and similar automation platforms Develop lightweight internal tools and utilities using Python and/or Node.js/TypeScript Integrate LLMs and AI agents into internal workflows where they provide measurable value Infrastructure & Platforms Configure and maintain domains and DNS records, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, TXT, and A records Work with Cloudflare and other domain/infrastructure management tools Work with newsletter platforms, ESPs, CRM systems, and publishing tools Automate account creation, configuration, status tracking, and operational checks where possible Work with databases and structured operational data Reliability, Improvement & Collaboration Build monitoring, alerts, validation checks, retries, and error-handling mechanisms Troubleshoot technical issues across APIs, domains, integrations, accounts, and automation workflows Identify repetitive manual work and propose technical solutions to eliminate or reduce it Maintain clear technical documentation for systems and automations Collaborate closely with Operations, Marketing, QA, and other internal specialists Requirements Must Have 1+ year of strong hands-on experience with Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or a similar backend/scripting language Experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, and third-party integrations Experience with proxies, isolated browser environments, or large-scale account operations Understanding of databases and ability to work with SQL Practical experience with LLM APIs, AI agents, structured outputs, tool/function calling, or AI-powered automation Basic infrastructure knowledge: domains, DNS, HTTP, authentication, servers, networking concepts Nice to Have Experience with Cloudflare, cPanel, AWS Route53, or similar tools Experience with newsletter platforms or ESPs such as Ghost, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, etc. Practical experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar — including automations that go beyond simple no-code workflows CRM integration experience Social media account creation and boosting Experience managing large numbers of accounts, domains, or digital properties Experience building internal admin panels, dashboards, or operational tools Previous experience in digital publishing, affiliate marketing, e-commerce, or marketing technology What Success Looks Like You will not be measured by how many repetitive tasks you can perform manually. You will be successful if, over time: Fewer workflows require manual intervention Recurring operational tasks become automated and standardized Technical incidents are detected earlier New newsletters and accounts can be launched faster Systems are documented and maintainable The operation can scale significantly without a proportional increase in manual work Who We're Looking For You will probably enjoy this role if your natural reaction to a repetitive process is: “I can do this manually first, understand how it works, and then build something so we don’t have to keep doing it manually.” We're looking for someone who: Is a curious, pragmatic builder who takes ownership Is comfortable moving between code, APIs, automation platforms, infrastructure, and business operations Understands unfamiliar systems quickly, experiments, and builds reliable solutions Solves problems independently …

items.desc: Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible. You will support end-to-end logistics (physical flows from plants to customers), including all warehouse, transport and co-packing operations, in terms of service, cost, health and safety, quality, food defense, sustainability, legal requirements and policies compliance. You will provide team leadership and direction for the logistics organization. In this role, you will implement logistics strategy and effectively execute operations to ensure optimum logistics solutions while supporting various routes-to-market, and balancing service and cost. You will work collaboratively with internal and external (third-party logistics vendors) business partners to ensure effective management, timely solutions and execution. How you will contribute You will: Be accountable for warehouse, transportation, international logistics (import/export) and co-packing operations Ensure the implementation of the business plan by delivering a consistent service level, adapting the supply chain to the demanding and changing customer environment and ensuring sufficient operational capacity to deliver business needs Be accountable for delivering logistics operational cost budget, ensuring that best-in-class controls and governance are in place Foster, initiate and lead continuous improvement programs that reduce cost and our carbon footprint and improve the service performance of the operation Ensure successful project implementation Select, manage and develop long-term relationships with third-party service providers Ensure adherence to health and safety, quality, food defense and legal requirements and policies Establish a business continuity plan for logistics operations. Support best-practices sharing and adoption What you will bring A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge: Solid background in logistics with experience leading operations in an FMCG/CPG environment Team leadership experience, with proven ability to build effective teams and develop people Drive for results with proactive, dynamic and action orientated approach, identifying areas where business change is required and excellence in project management Strong collaboration skills with strong business and financial acumen and the ability to forge senior level strategic partnerships with both internal and external stakeholders Strategic thinking plus excellent presentation, communication, influencing and motivational skills Strong negotiating skills with ability to negotiate in tough situations with both internal and external groups More about this role As our Poland logistics operations grow in complexity and scope, we are creating a Logistics Operations Supervisor role to provide dedicated senior operational leadership across the LogOps Polish team. This person will own day-to-day operational coordination across domestic distribution — from inbound through storage to outbound. The role drives process discipline, resolves escalations, and leads the LogOps side of our SAP 4 HANA transformation and continuous improvement agenda, ensuring these deliver real operational gains. Main Responsibilities: Manage priorities and workload allocation across the LogOps PL team — ensure balanced capacity, clear ownership, and timely execution across inbound, storage, and outbound. Own escalation resolution — act as the first decision point for operational issues; assess, decide, and drive resolution or escalate with a clear recommendation. Coordinate with 3PL operational counterparts — ensure smooth daily execution, flag issues early, and drive joint resolution with the Logistics Operations Manager. Lead LogOps preparation, testing, and go-live execution as the team's S4H Super User Additionally, drive adoption of S4H processes within the team — train, troubleshoot, and maintain process integrity post-go-live. Own and maintain LogOps process workflows — document, challenge, and improve standard operating procedures with input from process owners. Lead continuous improvement initiatives end-to-end (e.g. process mapping, waste elimination) — from problem identification through implementation to measured results. Own cost monitoring, invoice verification and accruals — ensure accuracy and timeliness in coordination with finance and external partners. Deliver operational input for budget preparation and forecasting Provide data, analysis, and operational insight to support Logistics Operations Manager. Requirements: Great Communications Skills - clearness, structure, and assertiveness. Challenging constructively, escalating effectively, and keeping people aligned. Confidence in working with data, building analyses, and translating findings into decisions and actions. Strong Excel skills; Power BI or similar is a plus. items.desc: We are looking for a QA Engineer who combines manual testing, end-to-end test automation, and basic DevOps knowledge with AI-assisted workflows. The role focuses on maintaining software quality while using AI tools to improve testing efficiency, accelerate routine tasks, and support problem-solving. OUR PERFECT CANDIDATE Experience in manual software testing; Understanding of software testing principles, testing levels, and software development methodologies; Experience creating and maintaining test documentation, including test cases, checklists, and bug reports; Practical experience testing web and mobile applications; Experience identifying, documenting, and tracking defects; Experience with end-to-end (E2E) test automation; Ability to review requirements and specifications and identify potential issues before implementation; Basic understanding of DevOps practices and the software development lifecycle; Experience using AI tools to support test design, test automation, troubleshooting, and other QA activities; Ability to analyze problems, identify quality risks, and take ownership of testing activities; Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with developers and other team members. KEY QUALIFICATIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES Estimate tasks provided by a Project Manager (PM) or Technology Lead (TL); Complete tasks from PM or TL within the estimated time; Participate in the SCRUM process; Participate in project development; Perform technical research; Keep technical documentation of the project; Prepare reports; Communicate with customers; Work on improvements of the current project. EMPLOYMENT CONDITIONS FOR THIS ROLE A friendly team of professionals: Strong technical specialists who are ready to help solve problems. Professional development: Financial and 1-to-1 meetings to discuss development plans; Individual Development Plan; Paid conferences and certifications; Lectures and other events where senior specialists share their knowledge with junior and middle specialists; Knowledge Bases with useful information for development. Vertical development: Opportunity to grow and become a coordinator and a Technology Lead further. Improving the English level: English courses. items.desc: Warsaw Full-time Permanent employee Tech stack you’ll work with About the role We are hiring an IT Administrator to own our internal IT and security operations: endpoints, identity, aaccess, networking and core SaaS tools. You will keep every laptop, account and system secure, compliant and running smoothly, so our teams can build and operate financial products with confidence. You will be the go-to person for Google Workspace, Jamf, Jira, GitHub and our Wazuh SIEM, and you will work closely with engineering, security and compliance. In a regulated fintech environment, that means getting the details right: least-privilege access, auditable changes and fast response when something looks wrong. Key responsibilities Endpoint management (Jamf) Administer Jamf Pro for the full macOS (and iOS, where applicable) fleet: enrollment, zero-touch provisioning via Apple Business Manager, and offboarding. Build and maintain configuration profiles, policies and smart groups for FileVault encryption, firewall, screen lock, Gatekeeper and OS update enforcement. Deploy and patch applications, and keep the fleet aligned with CIS benchmarks. Manage hardware inventory, device lifecycle and remote lock or wipe for lost or compromised devices. Identity and access management (Google Workspace) Administer Google Workspace as the primary identity provider: users, groups, organizational units and SSO (SAML/OIDC) to connected apps. Enforce MFA (security keys or passkeys preferred), password policies, context-aware access and session controls. Own joiner, mover and leaver processes, with access granted on least-privilege and role-based principles. Run periodic access reviews and keep auditable records of approvals and changes. Configure Gmail security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), DLP rules and Drive sharing restrictions. Jira and GitHub administration Administer Jira: projects, workflows, permission schemes, user provisioning and integrations. Administer the GitHub organization: teams, repository permissions, SSO enforcement, branch protection rules and required reviews. Manage GitHub security features such as secret scanning, Dependabot and audit log monitoring, in partnership with engineering. Security monitoring (Wazuh SIEM) Operate and maintain Wazuh: agent deployment across endpoints and servers, rule tuning and log source onboarding (Google Workspace, GitHub, cloud and network logs). Triage alerts, investigate suspicious activity and escalate or handle incidents following our response runbooks. Use Wazuh for file integrity monitoring, vulnerability detection and compliance reporting. Network and VPN Manage the corporate VPN or zero-trust network access solution, including client deployment, access policies and certificate management. Maintain office network infrastructure: Wi-Fi (WPA3-Enterprise), firewall rules, network segmentation and guest isolation. Security and compliance Implement and document security controls that support our compliance obligations (for example SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and GDPR). Collect evidence for audits and help answer security questionnaires from partners and regulators. Write and maintain IT policies, runbooks and system documentation. Run security awareness basics, such as phishing simulations and onboarding training. IT support Provide day-to-day IT support to employees, and onboard new joiners with a ready-to-use, secure setup on day one. Evaluate, purchase and manage SaaS tools and licenses, keeping costs and shadow IT under control. Required qualifications 3+ years in IT administration or systems administration, ideally in a fast-growing or regulated company. Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace, including SSO, MFA, groups and security settings. Hands-on experience with Jamf Pro (or a comparable MDM) managing a macOS fleet. Working knowledge of Jira and GitHub administration: permissions, SSO and user lifecycle. Experience with a SIEM (Wazuh strongly preferred) and basic incident triage. Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewalls and VPN technologies. Comfort with scripting for automation (Bash, Python or similar) and with APIs. A security-first mindset: least privilege, change control, documentation and audit trails. Clear written communication and a helpful, service-oriented attitude. Fluent English. Nice to have Experience in fintech, banking or payments, and familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS or DORA audits. Experience with zero-trust access tools (for example Tailscale, Cloudflare Zero Trust or similar). Cloud fundamentals on AWS, GCP or Azure, especially IAM and logging. Infrastructure-as-code or configuration-as-code experience (Terraform, GAM, Jamf API). Certifications such as Jamf Certified Admin, Google Workspace Administrator, CompTIA Security+ or similar. Some Windows or Linux endpoint management experience. What we offer Ownership of IT and security operations, with real influence over tools and processes. Close collaboration with …

items.desc: SD Worx is a leading European provider of Payroll & HR services with global reach. We have offices in Europe and an office in Mauritius. Our goal? We bring people solutions to life, so companies of any size can turn Human Resources into a source of value for the business and the people in it. Our people solutions span the entire employee journey, from getting people paid to attracting, rewarding, and developing talent. Are you ready to join us? Scrum Master Responsibilities: As a Scrum Master, you are a key enabler of effective, sustainable delivery. You strengthen team dynamics, foster psychological safety, and help squads continuously improve how they work. By combining coaching, facilitation, and systems thinking, you ensure that teams operate in line with Product OS expectations while continuously improving flow, collaboration, and outcomes. Your key responsibilities include: Establishing and reinforcing Product OS–aligned ways of working, including rhythms, ceremonies, artefacts, and decision making patterns. Partnering closely with the ProdOps Center of Excellence to implement agreed practices, while providing continuous feedback from teams to evolve and improve them. Improving overall squad effectiveness by identifying delivery bottlenecks, enabling systemic problem solving, and improving end to end flow of value. Driving continuous practice improvement by helping teams regularly inspect and adapt their processes, behaviors, and delivery patterns. Strengthening team dynamics by fostering open communication, constructive conflict, and healthy collaboration. Building and maintaining psychological safety, enabling team members to speak up, experiment, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Coaching individuals and teams on self management, collaboration skills, delivery habits, and continuous improvement mindsets. Supporting clearer goals, priorities, and shared understanding within and across teams. Result Areas: Your impact is visible through the following outcomes: Effective and Sustainable Delivery Flow – smoother value delivery with improved predictability. Strong Team Dynamics & Psychological Safety – teams that collaborate openly, learn, and improve together. Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date. The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC. items.desc: KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor. The mission of this role Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer. Who are we? KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business. What is our culture like & who is a good fit? Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values: Better Everyday – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round. Speed Is King – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day. Work Smart – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts. Overdeliver – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told. If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place. Outcomes (what success looks like) 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify) Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam) Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell) No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day Key Objectives Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first. Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners. Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor. Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix. Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house. Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting. Requirements Fully remote, full-time Fluent in English CRO Experience: 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must. Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up. Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages. Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help. Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency. Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule. Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin. No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work. What sets us apart isn’t just the tech. It’s the people. Our leadership team combines deep industry know how with world class tech expertise, giving you the chance to learn and grow faster than anywhere else. The mission is massive. The ambition is real. And we need talent like you to bring our vision to every food factory on earth. The Challenge We’re looking for a UX/UI Designer to shape intuitive, effective experiences across BRAINR’s AI-powered factory operating system. You’ll turn complex industrial workflows and user needs into clear, accessible interfaces that help people across food factories make confident, informed decisions. This is a hands-on product design role at the intersection of user research, interaction design, visual design, and technology. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success, learning from factory teams and translating real-world challenges into thoughtful digital experiences. You’ll take ownership of well-defined features, with guidance from our Design Leader on more complex design challenges. As you deepen your understanding of our product and users, you’ll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on broader responsibilities. This role is based at our headquarters in Leiria, Portugal. What you’ll own: Design well-defined features from understanding requirements through to delivery, exploring solutions and refining them with Product, Engineering, and the Design Lead. Create user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs in Figma for responsive web and mobile experiences. Help translate industrial workflows into clear, intuitive interfaces, working with the team to understand factory operations and user needs. Participate in user research, usability testing, and feedback sessions, applying findings to improve your designs. Work closely with developers to understand technical constraints, communicate design intent, and review implementation quality. Use and contribute to BRAINR’s design system and reusable components, helping keep product experiences consistent. Participate in design reviews, explain your design decisions, and give and incorporate constructive feedback. Keep developing your craft through feedback, team learning sessions, and exploration of relevant design practices and tools. What success looks like: The features you work on help factory teams complete their tasks more clearly and efficiently. Your designs are thoughtful, consistent with the design system, and ready for implementation. You use user feedback and design reviews to improve your work and explain the reasoning behind your decisions. You collaborate effectively with Product and Engineering, following your designs through implementation. You build confidence and autonomy as you learn more about our product, users, and industrial workflows.

items.desc: Position Being part of LOEWE gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company. As a Stoc k K eeper you will be responsible for the activities of the Back of House , ensuring the creation of an environment wh ich allows efficiency, effectiveness, and excellence in routines and execution . You will work closely with the store team ensuring the right products are available on and close to the shop floor enabling an excellent client experience. Job responsibilities Your role will be: Maintain the organization of the stockroom to the highest standards with merchandise stored in a clear and organised way which allows the efficient flow between front and back of house. Manage the delivery of stock into the store, checking that it matches against the invoice and informing HQ / Inventory of any discrepancies. Unpack all deliveries placing stock safely and correctly in its designated location Control and manage the transfer of stock to and from the store and the return of stock to the Warehouse. Support the flow of stock and packaging between the back and front of house, ensuring the right products are available on the shop floor to improve efficiency and client experience. Support and coordinate the aftersales process (repairs, alteration, etc) to ensure an excellent client experience. Fully integrate and participate in the store activities such as morning briefings, relevant training, etc. Profile What is important for the role: Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results Experience within a similar role , preferably in fashion/luxury Organised, with close attention to detail and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment Clear communication with the ability to connect with and influence various people Confident to work a utonomously and as part of a team A deep interest in Fashion, Art and Culture Fluent in Spanish, English will be a plus Additional information About LOEWE Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise. At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best. LOEWE MAISON Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques. Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work. Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision. Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House. Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force. At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. items.desc: About Aleph Aleph is a global leader accelerating digital advertising, and fintech solutions across more than 130 high-growth markets. With more than 20 years of experience and strategic partnerships with over 50 of the world's leading digital platforms, Aleph connects media, payments, and local market expertise to enable platforms and businesses to grow and operate globally with speed and compliance. With teams in more than 90 offices worldwide, Aleph combines global scale with deep local execution. Beyond business impact, Aleph drives digital inclusion through its education initiative, Digital Ad Expert, member of UNESCO’s Global Skills Academy. Are you a proactive, curious, organized and multilingual person looking to kickstart a career in Talent Acquisition (reclutamiento y selección de personal)? Do you thrive in an international environment and enjoy connecting people with great opportunities? Are you curious about how TikTok, Google or Amazon Ads actually work behind the scenes? Do you want real global business experience before you graduate? Then our Global Talent Sourcing internship in Madrid is for you. Join Aleph’s Global Sourcing Internship Program, a six-month, immersive learning experience where you will partner with our dynamic Global Talent Acquisition team and with hiring managers from four continents. This is not a classroom or a university program. It is your first step into the real world of Talent Acquisition, in a company that is truly global. About the Role As a Talent Sourcing Specialist intern, you will be at the forefront of identifying and attracting top talent for our vacancies worldwide. This is more than an internship: it is a foundational learning experience where you will gain hands-on expertise in direct search and sourcing in a truly global context. You will learn best practices, build a solid understanding of the Talent Acquisition lifecycle, and become skilled at finding the right people for the right roles, wherever they are. This role offers a unique opportunity to: Master direct sourcing: Learn the art and science of proactive talent identification, including advanced search techniques (such as Boolean search) and sourcing tools. Embrace global collaboration: Work with teams and candidates from various cultures and regions, expanding your global perspective and communication skills. Develop Talent Acquisition expertise: Build a strong foundation in recruitment processes, candidate engagement and employer branding. Make a real impact: People are our core business. Contribute directly to building our future talent pipeline by bringing in the best talent on the market. What You Will Do Conduct direct sourcing activities to identify potential candidates for Aleph in 100+ countries. Use a variety of sourcing techniques to build a robust candidate pipeline. Engage potential candidates globally through appealing outreach methods. Collaborate with hiring managers and recruiters to understand specific candidate needs and profiles. Maintain and update candidate databases. Partner with our Talent Advisors to support global searches and strengthen the business. What We Are Looking For English fluency is a must. Proficiency in additional languages is a significant advantage, as it allows you to connect with a wider pool of global talent. A genuine desire to understand new cultures and learn innovative sourcing strategies. A proactive mindset: you create opportunities rather than wait for them. The ability to communicate ideas clearly and engagingly, both verbally and in writing. A keen eye for detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources (Relaciones Laborales y Recursos Humanos), Business Administration (ADE), International Relations (Relaciones Internacionales) or a related field. Why Join Aleph Impact: Your sourcing work feeds real hiring pipelines for Aleph teams in 100+ countries, so you contribute to meaningful projects from the start. Growth: Mentorship from experienced Talent Acquisition professionals and hands-on training in direct sourcing, outreach and the full recruiting lifecycle. Team culture: A stimulating, international team working across four continents, where curiosity is welcome and you will have fun along the way. Market context: Aleph represents leading platforms such as TikTok, Google and Amazon across 130+ markets, giving you a close look at how a global digital advertising business hires. Flexibility: A hybrid setup in Madrid, with 2 to 3 office days per week alongside the team. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we are committed to fair and open compensation practices. items.desc: Industry Travel & Tourism Category Services & Hospitality Experience Mid level Applications are considered on a rolling basis Location: Las Palmas Visit website Follow Apollo Destination Contact Person Mari Yilmaz Mari.Yilmaz@apollo.se Job Description We offer an opportunity for those who thrive in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment where your work truly makes an impact. If you’re organized, responsible, solution-oriented, and passionate about delivering outstanding service, this role is for you. As a Contact Center Representative, you will be a vital part of the operations at our Contact Center abroad, delivering exceptional customer service both online and over the phone according to established guidelines and processes. You will become an expert in all the destinations covered by the Contact Center, knowledgeable about local traditions, customs, religions, and events. Your primary goal will be to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction, quality, and productivity by addressing customer needs and resolving their problems. Additionally, you will work toward meeting sales targets by promoting ancillary products and services. This role also involves regular collaboration with stakeholders at the destinations you serve, including hotels, suppliers, and other employees. Skills & Requirements What we’re looking for: Education: Completed 3-year upper secondary education Work Experience: Experience working in a Call/Contact Center or Customer Service role Technical Skills: Proficiency in computer systems, including the Microsoft Office suite Language Skills: Fluency in a Nordic language, along with fluent spoken and written English A natural sense of service is crucial for this role. As the first point of contact for customers, you will respond to their questions, fulfil their wishes, and enhance their overall experience. To succeed in this position, you should have strong communication skills in both your native language and English, with the ability to express yourself clearly in both writing and speaking. You must be organized, detail-oriented, and possess good problem-solving skills. The ability to work independently is essential, along with being customer-oriented and business-minded. Academic qualifications, a background in tourism, and fluency in an additional Scandinavian language are also considered advantageous. About the company Apollo is one of the Nordic region’s leading travel operators, with around one million travelers each year. We have approximately 200 employees across our Nordic offices, and during our summer and winter seasons, the team expands with an additional 100–250 seasonal staff. We offer customers the opportunity to explore the world—whether they dream of a relaxing beach holiday, an energizing training week in sunny destinations, or an exciting city adventure over a weekend. We arrange package holidays, training trips, cruises, and city breaks to meet all travel needs. In addition, we offer flexible flight and hotel bookings for those who prefer to tailor their own trip. Since 2015, Apollo has been part of DERTOUR Nordic AB together with Golf Plaisir and Lime Travel. We are also part of the German REWE Group, which employs over 300,000 people. Our mission is to make our customers’ holiday dreams come true by delivering outstanding service and experiences. To achieve our vision of becoming Northern Europe’s most engaging and obvious choice for holidays, we are always looking for driven and innovative employees—whether as a tour representative at one of our destinations or working in the production and sales of our trips. Apollo also strives for sustainable travel and social responsibility through partnerships with organizations such as SOS Children’s Villages, Ecpat, and the Swedish Olympic Committee (SOK). Since 2016, we have proudly held our Travelife certification. For more information, visit apollo.se.

items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for a Master Production Scheduler has arisen within Airbus Operations, Illescas (Toledo) . The selected candidate will join the Planning & Scheduling Team , responsible for the mid- and long-term planning (18 months) for MDCD A350F. The role operates across two core axes: leading the monthly finite capacity planning routines alongside manufacturing and program stakeholders, and steering the planning IT ecosystem (APC Jaguar and SAP). In this position, you will drive scenarios, simulate program updates for MCA & Elementary Parts, and provide the decision-making backbone for resources, buffer levels, and delivery priorities across the plant. RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Evaluate program and production requirements , analyzing recovery scenarios and plant calendar constraints to propose optimized production plans. Lead Master Production Schedule (MPS) routines and stakeholder reviews , challenging delays to secure firm operational commitments. Design and simulate capacity scenarios within assembly lines to absorb program cascades and minimize lead-time disruptions. Build, track, and analyze execution KPIs measuring deliveries and schedule compliance, defining and driving targeted recovery action plans. Maintain and calibrate planning models and parameters across core systems (APC Jaguar, SAP, and APC-ARP interface). Coordinate logistics alignment and resource availability , actively mitigating supply disruptions to guarantee smooth assembly execution. SKILLS Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you: Education: Degree in Engineering (Aeronautical, Industrial, Mechanical) or a related technical discipline. Experience: Hands-on background in production planning, scheduling, or manufacturing operations within industrial or aerospace environments. Technical Knowledge: Mandatory advanced proficiency in APC Jaguar (and APC-ARP interface) as well as Google Sheets / advanced spreadsheets; working familiarity with SAP . Soft Skills: Strong negotiation, conflict resolution, active listening, proactive prioritization, and ability to coordinate multi-functional stakeholders under time constraints. Languages: Negotiation level / fluent in both English and Spanish (written and spoken). Valuable / Nice to have: Direct experience managing assembly lines planning or aerostructures manufacturing environments. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year (approx. 35 days per year in total). Attractive salary. Hybrid model of working (up to 40% per quarter when possible), promoting work-life balance. Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location. Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. Option to access special rates in products & benefits. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. Company: Airbus Operations SL Employment Type: Permanent - Experience Level: Professional Job Family: Production Planning & Scheduling <JF-MA-PP> By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus. Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief. Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com . At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

items.desc: Location: Barcelona, Spain Type: Full-time | On-site https://www.loop-machines.com/careers/founding-engineer/ About Loop Machines Loop Machines is building the engineering intelligence layer for mission-critical hardware. We're creating a platform that connects engineering data, decisions, and workflows across the entire hardware lifecycle — from design and verification to testing, production, and operations. Our goal is to help teams building drones, satellites, robotics, and other complex systems move faster, make better engineering decisions, and continuously improve the products they build. We're an early-stage startup based in Barcelona, building from the ground up. The Opportunity We're looking for a Founding Full-Stack Engineer to join our founding team and help shape the technical foundations of Loop Machines. This isn't a role where you'll simply execute predefined tickets. You'll work directly with the founders, contribute to product and architecture decisions, and take ownership of features from concept to production. You'll have the opportunity to build a complex, AI-native engineering platform at an early stage, with meaningful influence over its direction. What You'll Work On Design, build, and ship end-to-end features across frontend and backend. Develop intuitive interfaces that turn complex engineering information into actionable insights. Build scalable APIs, backend services, and data integrations. Work on connected engineering data models, workflows, and real-time information systems. Integrate AI-powered capabilities and agents into practical engineering workflows. Make architectural decisions and help establish engineering best practices. items.desc: About Fairlo The story of Fairlo began when our founders, Jimmy and Shamon, saw first-hand how unfair and predatory lending practices can trap people in cycles of debt. Their mother had been misled by a large bank, and instead of being offered a lifeline, she was pushed further into financial difficulties. That injustice sparked an idea: to build a company that reimagines credit, rooted in transparency, flexibility, and respect. That company became Fairlo. Since launching in 2018, we've helped tens of thousands of people access fairer, more flexible credit. Today, we have around 50,000 active customers, an outstanding Trustpilot rating, and a team of passionate people across Stockholm, Crete, and the UK. We've built something we're incredibly proud of. But what comes next is even more exciting. The next chapter. And why you should be part of it. Fairlo is becoming a bank. And we're rethinking how we build technology along the way. We're entering a new phase where technology will play an even bigger role in everything we do. New products, new possibilities, more complex challenges, and an opportunity to build financial services that genuinely make people's lives better. At the same time, our AI transformation is already under way. There's a plan, and people across Fairlo are working on it every day as we become an AI-native organisation. We want to challenge old assumptions about how software gets built. Experiment with new tools and ways of working. Move from idea to impact faster. And create an engineering culture where curiosity, creativity, and great judgment matter more than ever. We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer who wants to join that work and help shape where it goes next. You'll join our Stockholm team, working closely with CTO, Product, Design, and our engineering colleagues in Crete. We're a small organisation with big ambitions, which means you'll be close to the decisions, the challenges, and the impact of what you build. This isn't a role where you'll simply pick up tickets and write code. We want you to understand the problems we're solving, challenge how we approach them, and help turn ambitious ideas into great products. You'll have the freedom to experiment, the responsibility to own your work, and the opportunity to influence both our technology and how we work with it. What you'll do As a Fullstack Engineer at Fairlo, you'll work across the entire product experience, from the interfaces our customers interact with to the services and systems powering them. You'll be part of a cross-functional crew with real ownership, working together to solve meaningful problems and deliver value to our customers. Here's what that looks like: Build products that matter. Design and develop intuitive customer experiences, scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations that make financial services simpler, smarter, and fairer. Own problems, not just code. Be involved from the first idea to the finished product. Understand the customer's needs, contribute to the solution, build it, ship it, and learn from the results. Build on the AI work already under way. Explore how AI can fundamentally improve the way we build software, from prototyping and development to testing, debugging, and delivery. Experiment, challenge existing practices, and help turn new possibilities into everyday ways of working. Make great technical decisions. Balance speed, simplicity, scalability, and security as we build technology that needs to perform today and grow with us tomorrow. Work close to the business. Collaborate directly with Product, Design, and colleagues across Fairlo. Your ideas and perspectives will matter, and you'll have the opportunity to influence what we build and why. Raise the bar together. Share knowledge, challenge assumptions, bring fresh ideas, and help create an engineering culture where talented people continuously learn and get better. Who you are We're looking for someone who loves building things, gets excited about solving real problems, and is genuinely curious about what's next in technology. You're comfortable moving between frontend and backend, enjoy taking ownership, and care just as much about the customer experience as you do about the code behind it. And while you're a strong engineer today, you're even more interested in what you could become tomorrow. We believe you'll thrive at Fairlo if you: Have solid professional experience in fullstack development, with strong skills across both frontend and backend. Are comfortable with modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript, as well as backend frameworks such as Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, .NET, or similar. Have experience building APIs, working with relational databases, and developing scalable, cloud-based applications, preferably using AWS. Are already exploring how AI can make you a better engineer, and are excited to push beyond traditional development practices. Care about building great products, not just great code. …
