items.desc: I rollen får du arbeta med att utveckla och vidareutveckla automationer som stödjer verksamhetens processer. Du blir samtidigt en viktig del i att bygga upp våra interna förmågor och tjänster kring automationsplattformen, exempelvis självbetjäning och gemensamma tekniska komponenter som gör det enklare för verksamheten att använda automation som tjänst. Om jobbet Du blir en del av sektionen Automatisering och Digitalisering i en sektion med 16 engagerade medarbetare som arbetar tillsammans på olika orter mellan Göteborg och Gävle. Vi ansvarar för utveckling och förvaltning av digitala lösningar som stödjer Trafikverkets verksamhet och arbetar nära produktägare, verksamhetsspecialister och andra utvecklingsteam. Vi tillhör tåget Data- och Analyståget och uppdragen ingår i tåget. Vi arbetar enligt agila principer och tillämpar bland annat samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig förbättring är en naturlig del av vårt arbetssätt. Rollen kombinerar systemutveckling, automation och teknisk utveckling av vår automationsplattform. Det innebär att du både får bygga konkreta automationer och vara med och utveckla de gemensamma tjänster och förmågor som gör att organisationen kan använda automation på ett effektivt och hållbart sätt. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med tekniker inom RPA, integration, AI, intelligent dokumenthantering och agentbaserad automation i en miljö där säkerhet, kvalitet och långsiktig förvaltning är centrala delar. Som systemutvecklare kommer du bland annat att: utveckla, testa och vidareutveckla automationer, främst med UiPath Automation Suite omsätta verksamhetens behov och processer till robusta och förvaltningsbara automationslösningar arbeta med integrationer mot olika system, API:er och datakällor bidra till utveckling av gemensamma komponenter, ramverk och tekniska lösningar för automation vara med och utveckla interna tjänster och självbetjäningslösningar kopplade till automationsplattformen bidra till plattformens tekniska utveckling och etablering av nya förmågor arbeta tillsammans med produktägare, processägare, arkitekter och andra tekniska kompetenser bidra till test, dokumentation, livscykelhantering och förvaltning av utvecklade lösningar Incidenthantering av utvecklade automationer Jag som tf. chef tror på att ge människor förtroende, ansvar och utrymme att använda sin kompetens, ta egna initiativ och hitta egna lösningar. För mig handlar ledarskap om att skapa rätt förutsättningar för att du ska lyckas, utan att detaljstyra. Jag vill finnas där som stöd och bollplank när du behöver mig, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att utveckla din självständighet. Jag vill uppmuntra dig att våga prova nya idéer, anta utmaningar och fortsätta utvecklas. Vi ska kunna lära av både framgångar och misstag. Vad kan vi erbjuda dig Hos Trafikverket får du möjlighet att arbeta i en samhällsviktig verksamhet där digitalisering och automation bidrar till att utveckla framtidens infrastruktur. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team med hög kompetens och får arbeta med modern systemutveckling, komplexa integrationer och kontinuerlig förbättring i en agil miljö. Kvalifikationer Vem är du? Vi söker dig som är analytisk och lösningsorienterad, med ett intresse för att förstå både tekniken och verksamhetens behov. Du är nyfiken på hur automation och digitalisering kan bidra till smarta och effektiva lösningar. Med ett strukturerat arbetssätt och fokus på kvalitet tar du ansvar för ditt arbete och driver det självständigt framåt. Du trivs i ett tvärfunktionellt team där samarbete och kunskapsutbyte är en naturlig del av arbetet. Genom din goda kommunikativa förmåga kan du omsätta verksamhetens behov till fungerande tekniska lösningar. Samtidigt vill du utvecklas inom nya teknikområden och bidra till teamets gemensamma mål. Vi söker dig som har relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning om minst 180hp (120 p) med inriktning systemvetenskap alternativt annan utbildning i kombination med relevant erfarenhet i närtid som bedöms likvärdig mångårig och aktuell erfarenhet av systemutveckling i Uipath erfarenhet av automatisering av verksamhetsprocesser erfarenhet av API:er och databaser goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av UiPath Automation Suite AI-stödd systemutveckling och programmering av AI-agenter Machine Learning och MLOps Intelligent Document Processing och Document Understanding Övrig information Valbara placeringsorter för denna tjänst är Göteborg, Örebro, Borlänge eller Gävle. I denna rekrytering kan webbaserade tester och/eller arbetsprov förekomma som en del i urvalet. Inledande intervjuer sker digitalt via Skype och är planerade att genomföras under vecka 50. items.desc: TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Role Summary Join us at TRATON Group R&D and become part of a team that is shaping the future of secure and sustainable transportation. As an PSIRT Operational Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting connected vehicles, digital platforms, and services from evolving cyber threats. Working within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT), you will move between incident response, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and cybersecurity risk mitigation across our products and ecosystems. This role combines both operational and tactical responsibilities. You will collaborate with experts across Vehicle Security Operations, Cybersecurity Testing, Product Development, Safety, Compliance, and Engineering to ensure the highest level of cybersecurity resilience throughout the product lifecycle. If you are passionate about cybersecurity, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to contribute to products that impact millions of people worldwide, this is your opportunity to make a real difference. Job Responsibilities As an PSIRT Operational Specialist, you will: Analyze cybersecurity incidents, vulnerabilities, and risks, including assessment of CVEs, CPEs, and CVSS scores, as well as disclosure management. Contribute to, and when ready coordinate or lead, cross-functional incident triage, forensic investigations, and response activities. Contribute to the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of PSIRT playbooks, security procedures, and incident readiness plans. Configure, validate, and support our security tools and technologies. Support in compliance activities related to cybersecurity regulations and standards such as ISO 21434 and UNECE R155. Stay informed about emerging cyber threats, technology trends, and industry developments to proactively develop our security capabilities. Who You Are You are a driven and proactive cybersecurity professional who thrives in a technical environment and enjoys collaborating across teams, functions, and cultures. You can balance tactical thinking with hands-on execution and remain calm in critical situations. We believe you have: Experience from cybersecurity operations, incident response, vulnerability analysis, PSIRT, SOC, or automotive cybersecurity environments. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Experience from evaluating security risks, threats, or vulnerabilities. A structured and detail-oriented approach combined with strong integrity and professionalism. Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken. And, a strong interest in emerging technologies and cybersecurity threats It is a plus if you have: Experience from working with automotive EE systems, connected vehicles, or embedded systems software. Knowledge of ISO 21434, UNECE R155, CRA, digital forensics, or threat intelligence. Security certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, OSCP, or CompTIA Security+. Experience contributing to security communities such as FIRST, ENISA, CSIRT networks, or similar. This Is Us We are a collaborative and skilled cybersecurity team responsible for protecting TRATON's products and services from evolving cyber threats. Expanding across brands, technologies, and international teams, we combine deep technical expertise with a strong culture of trust, continuous learning, and teamwork. Our mission is not only to respond to cybersecurity incidents, but also to proactively strengthen security capabilities, improve resilience, and support the secure development of future transportation solutions. With us, your actions will have a direct impact on the company’s cybersecurity status. Who Is Your Manager I am here to support you and the whole team in being successful and taking the necessary steps toward fulfilling our goals and stakeholders' expectations. I believe in creating a safe, transparent, and collaborative environment where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, challenge assumptions, and contribute to better solutions. Our work is challenging yet meaningful, which is why I prioritize trust, teamwork, and personal development and growth. Just as important, I value work-life balance and the well-being of every individual in the team. TRATON Offers We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace …

items.desc: Combine quantitative expertise, technology and valuation in one of the Nordics’ largest asset managers! SEB Asset Management is one of the largest asset managers in the Nordics, offering a broad range of funds and mandates across most asset classes to private and institutional investors. We combine deep expertise with a strong customer focus, a commitment to quality and trust, and an entrepreneurial mindset. Here, you will join an international environment where collaboration, continuous development, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact are part of everyday work. Since SEB was founded in 1856, our focus on customers and long-term relationships has been at the heart of our success. We aim to drive positive change by providing capital to help everyone reach their goals and accelerate progress towards a sustainable tomorrow. As a leading financial services group in northern Europe, we'll help you grow and empower you to take on more responsibility to create a real difference. Welcome to SEB. About the role As a Quantitative Valuation Analyst, you will join the Risk & Performance Analytics team within Risk & Performance. The team works across risk, performance and valuation, in close collaboration with portfolio managers and other specialists across SEB Asset Management. In this role, you will have a particular focus on valuation and valuation processes, both within SimCorp Dimension and for instruments and processes handled outside the system. You will combine financial and mathematical understanding with strong technical skills to analyse, develop and improve how valuation is performed and controlled. The role sits at the intersection of financial instruments, systems, data and quantitative analysis. You will work with large datasets and databases, use Python to develop analytical and valuation solutions, and contribute to the continued development and automation of our valuation processes. methodologies, models and processes Working with databases and data flows supporting valuation and quantitative analysis Developing tools and solutions in Python to support analysis, controls and automation Investigating valuation differences and supporting the understanding of underlying data, models and methodologies Collaborating closely with portfolio managers and other stakeholders across with SimCorp Dimension, preferably within valuation, pricing, financial instruments or closely related areas A strong understanding of financial instruments and valuation Experience working with databases and large datasets Good programming skills in Python A strong mathematical and quantitative foundation A relevant academic degree within engineering, mathematics, finance, economics or another quantitative field and/or equivalent experience An analytical and structured approach, with the ability to investigate complex problems across systems, data and financial instruments Strong communication and collaboration skills and an interest in working closely with both technical specialists and investment professionals Fluency in spoken and written Swedish and English What we offer A key role in developing valuation processes within one of the Nordics’ largest asset managers The opportunity to combine finance, mathematics, data and technology in your daily work Work with a broad range of financial instruments, systems and valuation challenges An international learning environment in central Stockholm Close collaboration with experienced specialists and portfolio managers The opportunity to influence how we develop and automate our valuation processes An inclusive, value-driven culture focused on trust, quality and continuous development Do you want to be part of SEB? It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov. Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad. Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder. Arbetsbeskrivning Vi söker en erfaren Business Analyst som tillsammans med verksamheten ska definiera framtida rapporterings- och analysbehov kopplade till införandet av ett nytt ERP-system (SAP S/4HANA) inom energibranschen. Uppdraget omfattar att identifiera, analysera och dokumentera verksamhetens behov av rapporter, dashboards, KPI och beslutsunderlag inom följande områden: Inköp Project Portfolio Management Asset Management Underhåll Finans Fokus ligger på att definiera vilka rapporter och analyser som ska utvecklas i organisationens analysplattform samt rekommendera vilka rapporter som lämpar sig för direkt användning i ERP-systemet. Uppdraget omfattar även att kartlägga, verifiera och vid behov komplettera målgrupper och användningsområden för befintlig och framtida rapportering. Arbetet inleds med en inventering av befintlig rapportering och identifierade målgrupper. Ansvarsområden Genomföra en nulägesinventering av befintlig rapportering inom ERP-system, analysplattformar och relevanta självservicelösningar. Dokumentera informationsbehov och rapporteringskrav. Etablera en övergripande förståelse för befintliga KPI, nyckeltal och affärsregler. För prioriterade rapporteringsområden definiera, förankra och dokumentera mätetal och verksamhetsregler som krävs för framtida rapportering. Genomföra gap-analyser mellan befintlig och framtida rapportering. Samverka med verksamheten, ERP-programmet, analysteam och andra relevanta utvecklings- och dataorganisationer. Leverabler Rapportkatalog med identifierade rapportbehov, målgrupper och prioriteringar. Dokumenterade verksamhets-, informations- och rapporteringskrav. Rekommendation om vilka rapporter som ska hanteras direkt i ERP-systemet respektive i analysplattformen. Definition och dokumentation av KPI, nyckeltal, affärsregler och rapporteringskrav som underlag för utveckling. Kravspecifikationer för nya rapporter. Required Skills and Education Kompetenskrav Minst 5 års erfarenhet som Business Analyst, Requirements Analyst eller motsvarande inom Business Intelligence. Erfarenhet av ERP-system och rapporteringslösningar. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av kravinsamling inom rapportering, BI och analys. Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Flytande svenska är ett obligatoriskt krav. Meriterande kompetenser Erfarenhet av SAP ERP eller SAP S/4HANA, gärna inom inköp, finans, Asset Management, underhåll eller projektstyrning. Erfarenhet av Power BI. Erfarenhet från energibranschen. Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom större energibolag. Ansökan När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder. Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.

items.desc: Företagsbeskrivning Vattenfall är en av Europas största producenter och återförsäljare av el och värme. Våra huvudmarknader är Sverige, Tyskland, Nederländerna, Danmark och Storbritannien. Inom Vattenfallkoncernen finns cirka 20 000 anställda. Vi har elektrifierat industrier, levererat energi till bostäder och förvandlat tillvaron genom innovation i över hundra års tid. Vi driver på övergången till ett hållbart energisystem. Jobbeskrivning Är du en systemförvaltare som gillar utmaningar? Då kan du vara vår nya kollega! Som systemförvaltare/systemutvecklare ansvarar du för att både underhålla och vidareutveckla IT-system i vår komplexa IT-miljö. Vi arbetar i en miljö präglad av mycket högt ställda krav på IT-säkerhet. Du kommer arbeta inom området Dokumenthantering där uppgiften är att vidareutveckla samt förvalta våra egenutvecklade applikationer likväl som förvaltning av inköpta standardapplikationer. Vi strävar efter att hitta strategiskt hållbara lösningar och där ser vi dig som en viktig spelare. Du blir en del av ett team av systemutvecklare som samarbetar över geografiska gränser och stöttar varandra i det dagliga arbetet. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med förvaltningsledare och projektledare, samtidigt som du arbetar självständigt inom ditt teknikområde. Du kommer framför allt att: Ansvara för systemförvaltning inklusive kontakt med användare, felsökning, proaktivitet samt åtgärder på kort och lång sikt Delta som utvecklare i projekt och uppdrag av varierande omfattning Installera, konfigurera och anpassa programvaror Arbeta löpande med underhåll av förvaltningsdokumentation Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har: Akademisk utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kunskaper Erfarenhet av och goda kunskaper inom Java, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQL, Windows och Linux Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Det är meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av kvalitetsprocesser, exempelvis ITL, samt testning Erfarenhet av plattformen Documentum och dess produkter Som person är du nyfiken, analytisk och trivs med att lösa tekniska utmaningar. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt med förmåga att se både helheten och detaljer. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, driver ditt arbete framåt och planerar din tid på ett effektivt sätt. Du samarbetar gärna med andra och är lyhörd för kundernas behov. Vi är ett företag i förändring och med stora utmaningar framför oss, vilket ställer krav på en flexibel organisation och medarbetare som har förmågan att hantera förändringar genom en positiv inställning. Ytterligare information Förutom att du får vara med och forma framtidens smarta energisamhälle erbjuder vi dig ett utvecklande och omväxlande arbete med många kontaktytor. För oss på Vattenfall är det viktigt att arbete och privatliv har en god balans, därför erbjuder vi flexibilitet i arbetet samt möjlighet till att arbeta hemifrån vid behov. Vi har även en hel del andra personalförmåner som exempelvis arbetstidsförkortning, förmånliga tjänstepensionsavtal, föräldraledighetstillägg med mera. Läs mer om våra förmåner här. Placeringsort : Ringhals, Forsmark eller Solna För mer information om tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Linda Ahlbom, linda.ahlbom@vattenfall.com. För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontakta rekryterare Lea Skånberg, lea.skanberg@vattenfall.com. Fackliga representanter är Sofi Wadström (Akademikerna), Christer Gustafsson (Ledarna), Juha Siipilehto (SEKO) och Patricia Ek (Unionen). Du når samtliga via Vattenfalls växel, 08 739 50 00. Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 22 november 2026. Vi tar inte emot personligt brev i ansökan. Du söker snabbt och enkelt genom att svara på urvalsfrågor och bifoga ditt CV. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår webbplats. I den här rekryteringsprocessen kommer tester att förekomma. På Vattenfall värdesätter vi att vara aktiva, positiva, öppna och säkerhetsmedvetna. Vi söker medarbetare som delar vår vision och kan bidra till att stärka vår företagskultur. Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. Vattenfall arbetar aktivt för att alla medarbetare ska ha samma möjligheter och rättigheter oavsett ålder, etnisk eller kulturell bakgrund, könstillhörighet, religion/tro, sexuell läggning eller funktionsvariation. Läs mer om hur vi arbetar med mångfald och inkludering här. Att arbeta inom Vattenfall innebär att arbeta med samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Därmed är många av våra tjänster säkerhetsklassade och du kan komma att bli krigsplacerad. Är denna tjänst säkerhetsklassad kommer säkerhetsprövning genomföras innan anställning, i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen. En eventuell krigsplacering sker med stöd i anställningsavtalet och lagen om totalförsvarsplikt.

Coordinate matters across different technical disciplines and stakeholders. Support planning and permitting processes. Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future. To succeed in this role, you enjoy working with people from different backgrounds and building relationships based on trust and mutual respect. You can adapt your communication to different audiences, navigate competing interests and perspectives, and approach stakeholder dialogue in a professional and attentive manner. It is considered an advantage if you also have experience in: Land acquisition and land negotiations. Property law matters in urban development and infrastructure projects. Valuation and compensation matters. Railway plans, road plans or other statutory planning processes. Coordination or project management responsibilities. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers' transition towards increased sustainability and strive to lead by example through our business practices and the solutions we provide. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are more than 7,300 people bringing our expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environmental solutions into play. What we also offer Being part of the COWI community means more than competitive employment conditions. We take care of our people and offer opportunities to grow both professionally and personally. As a foundation-owned and employee-owned company, COWI gives you the opportunity to become a co-owner. You will also have access to extensive development opportunities through COWI Academy, networking opportunities across the organisation, an attractive benefits package and an individual development plan through our career framework. items.desc: When Anyfin goes down, someone’s loan payment doesn’t go through. Make sure it doesn’t. You open your laptop on Monday and find out the primary database failed at 3am on Sunday. Services reconnected in seconds and no customer noticed a thing. We’d practised exactly that failover the week before. If that’s your idea of a good weekend, we should talk. The foundation is built. Now it needs to scale. Anyfin helps people refinance expensive consumer credit on better terms. Since 2017 we’ve helped people across Sweden, Finland and Germany take back control of their finances. We’re profitable, we have a banking licence that lets us operate across the EU, and we’re getting ready to launch new products and enter new markets. Our ambition is to be a pan-European company by 2030. Every one of those steps puts more weight on our platform: more traffic, more integrations, more markets and more regulators who expect us to prove that we’re resilient, not just say it. The team is small and intentionally so. We’d rather grow what each engineer can do than how many engineers we have. The actual job You’ll own reliability across the platform. That covers how our services run on Kubernetes and GCP, how we deploy, how we scale and how we recover when something breaks. You’ll decide what “reliable enough” means for each part of the system and make it measurable. You’ll make problems visible before customers feel them. That means monitoring, alerting and logging that tell us what’s wrong and why, not dashboards nobody opens. When an alert fires, it should matter. You’ll make incidents boring. You’ll shape how we respond, who gets paged, how we communicate and how we learn. That means blameless reviews that lead to real changes, not just documents. You’ll build the paved road. Engineers should be able to ship safely and quickly without thinking about infrastructure every time. You’ll work on CI/CD, infrastructure as code and the tooling that makes the right way the easy way. You’ll help us meet the bar a bank is held to. As a regulated lender, operational resilience isn’t optional. You’ll help us turn requirements like DORA into systems and practices that actually work, not just policies we can point to. You’ll keep an eye on cost. Scaling into new markets shouldn’t mean scaling our cloud bill at the same rate. Reliability in an AI-native company AI isn’t a side tool here. It’s built into how we work across engineering, analytics, operations and product, and our tech team has built an AI-connected data and code environment on frontier models. That shows up in reliability work too. AI can help read logs, trace incidents and draft runbooks faster than any of us. It also means more systems in production act on data without questioning it, and more automation can change things on its own. Part of this role is working out what reliability means in that world: where AI makes us faster, where it needs guardrails, and how we make sure we’re never the last to know when something goes wrong. The people You’ll work closely with backend engineers, data engineers, product teams and our engineering managers, who care a lot about getting things right. Sometimes a little too much. Propose a new alert and someone will ask how many times it would have fired last month. We prefer it that way. They’re also generous with what they know, quick to laugh and happy to change their minds when you make a better case. As long as you can back it up. This sounds like you if… You have solid experience in SRE, platform or infrastructure engineering, ideally in a product company where reliability directly affects customers. You’ve run production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment and are comfortable with infrastructure as code. You write real code, not just YAML. Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, Python and Go, running on Kubernetes and GCP. Experience with GCP and Terraform is a plus, but you don’t need to know every technology in our stack. You’re comfortable reading, debugging and improving services, and the judgment you bring matters more than ticking every box. You’ve built observability that people actually use, and you’ve been on call for systems that mattered. You know the difference between an alert and noise. You’re pragmatic. You care about reliability, but you know 100% uptime isn’t the goal and that over-engineering has a cost too. You can explain that trade-off to engineers and non-engineers alike. Experience from fintech, banking or another regulated environment is a plus, but not a requirement. More than anything, you can tell us about a system you made more reliable. Not just what you changed, but what it made possible for the team and the business. A few practical notes This role is based at our office on Drottninggatan 92 in Stockholm, and we work from the office. We think great teams and culture are built when people meet in person, especially at this stage. EU work authorisation is required. If you’d rather prevent the next …

items.desc: Har du flera år som digital strateg på byrå bakom dig och vill jobba där strategi, varumärke, design, teknik och innehåll finns under samma tak? Vi söker en senior digital strateg till vår fullservicebyrå, som använder AI i sitt eget arbete och hjälper kunderna att göra detsamma i sin affär. Om KAN KAN är en kreativ byrå som hjälper företag inom främst B2B, men också B2C, med webb, varumärke, innehåll, marknadsföring, Hubspot och AI. Våra kunder är allt från snabbrörliga scaleups till stora organisationer som medlemsorganisationer, fastighetsbolag och energibolag, och vi har även kunder inom offentlig sektor. Vi har kontor i Skrapan i Stockholm och vid Stortorget i Malmö, och vi jobbar utifrån vår devis Working With Friends. Om rollen Som digital strateg hjälper du kunder att hitta var affären kan växa och arbetet bli mer effektivt, och hur de kommer dit. Det kan vara en ny webbstrategi, ett bättre samspel mellan sälj och marknad i HubSpot eller ett första steg med AI där det faktiskt sparar tid eller ger bättre resultat. Du har en central roll i uppdragen och binder ihop våra kompetensteam inom varumärke, design, utveckling, innehåll och marknadsföring, så att kunden möter en helhet där allt hänger ihop. AI är en naturlig del av ditt eget arbete, från research och analys till koncept och prototyper. Rollen är bred och spänner över UX, webbstrategi, digital marknadsföring, martech och affärsutveckling. Vi räknar med att du har din spetskompetens inom ett eller två av dem och tillräcklig överblick över resten för att se helheten och veta när du ska ta in en kollega. Det här kommer du att göra Ta fram digitala strategier åt kunder, med AI där det gör nytta Leda workshops och analyser kring webb, UX och martech Hjälpa kunder att prioritera vad som ska göras först och vad det ska leda till Vara med i försäljningen och ta fram förslag tillsammans med kollegor Följa utvecklingen inom AI och dela med dig internt Vi tror att du Har runt tio års erfarenhet som digital strateg, UX-strateg, affärsutvecklare eller liknande, på byrå eller i en större organisation, och är van att på egen hand leda strategiarbete och vara kundens närmaste rådgivare Har god förståelse för UX, webbstrategi, digital marknadsföring och affärsutveckling och är särskilt stark inom minst ett av dem Använder AI dagligen och kan förklara för en kund hur det kan användas i deras verksamhet Utgår från affären och kopplar digitala insatser till mål som går att följa upp Trivs med kundkontakt och är bekväm med att leda möten eller workshops Har erfarenhet av HubSpot och vet hur plattformen kan användas för att effektivisera en organisation Vi erbjuder En roll där du får stort utrymme att påverka, både i kunduppdragen och i hur KAN utvecklar sitt arbete med digital strategi. Du får varierade uppdrag, cirka 100 kollegor som gärna delar med sig, friskvårdsbidrag och hälsoförsäkring, och eftersom vi har kollektivavtal får du även alla förmåner som följer med det. Ett par gånger om året samlas hela gänget för fest, resa eller någon annan aktivitet tillsammans. Du utgår från vårt kontor i Skrapan i Stockholm. Ansökan Låter det som du? Skicka ditt CV och några rader om varför rollen lockar dig. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential. Job Description Join our Cloud & Infrastructure Delivery Architecture team and play a key role in shaping the future of our modular, cloud-native banking platform. You will be contribute to the design, development, and deployment of our Avaloq Banking Solution SaaS offering on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), ensuring scalability, reliability, and automation. The team acts as the primary architectural interface between clients, delivery execution, and central architecture functions, ensuring alignment between customer needs, execution feasibility, and architecture standards. Your key tasks: Develop end-to-end infrastructure and cloud solution designs for Avaloq SaaS on OCI Support Cloud Engineers and Developers ensuring solutions are deployable, scalable, and operationally sustainable Collaborate with internal teams and clients to deliver tailored cloud solutions aligned with strategic goals Provide expert-level support and guidance on cloud architecture and DevOps practices Contribute to cost optimization and implementation approaches Troubleshoot complex issues and drive continuous improvement in system performance and reliability Qualifications Proven experience as a Cloud Architect or in a similar role Strong expertise in DevOps methodologies and Git-based project workflows Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures, including Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE), Oracle Exadata, Oracle RAC, container orchestration, and enterprise deployment strategies Proficiency with automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible is strongly preferred Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and abstraction skills Strong communication and collaboration abilities A proactive, team-oriented mindset with a passion for innovation It would be a real bonus if you have Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is essential; experience with other cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus OCI Certified Solution Architect preferred Knowledge of cloud governance, landing zones, multi-region architectures, business continuity, and cloud security best practices Additional certifications in AWS, Azure, or GCP are advantageous Experience with enterprise observability and monitoring solutions such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK/OpenSearch, or Splunk Additional Information We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

items.desc: Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions. Apply now for the position of Product Verification Engineer, where you will apply your clinical experience in radiotherapy to system-level verification, helping ensure that our medical device systems support safe and effective clinical workflows. Your role You apply your radiotherapy experience to develop realistic test scenarios that reflect clinical workflows and intended use. You contribute to planning system-level verification for product releases and projects, considering requirements, design changes, risks and regression impact. You design and review test cases with a focus on clinically relevant workflows and perform hands-on formal and informal verification testing on complex medical device systems. You analyze test results, document complete and traceable objective evidence, report defects and support troubleshooting and problem analysis together with engineering teams. You contribute to requirement, design and risk reviews and collaborate with local and international stakeholders from Engineering, Product Management, Risk Management and other relevant areas. You contribute to the continuous improvement of verification methods, tools and processes and support knowledge sharing across the organization. You are willing to travel up to 10% as required. Your expertise A degree or equivalent professional qualification in a relevant clinical discipline, medical technology or a comparable field. Several years of hands-on clinical experience in radiotherapy, with a strong understanding of clinical workflows and the practical use of radiotherapy systems. items.desc: We are seeking a Research Assistant to the Translational Neuropathology Group (TNG) led by Professor Laura Parkkinen, in the Nuffield Department of Clinical Neurosciences (NDCN), University of Oxford. The post is part of “Deciphering the Aggregatome: Unravelling Alpha-Synuclein Seeding Drivers in Parkinson’s Disease”, an international research programme supported by Aligning Science Across Parkinson’s (ASAP). The project brings together Oxford, the Max Planck Institute of Biochemistry and LMU Munich to investigate why Parkinson’s disease progresses differently between individuals and to identify molecular determinants of α-synuclein seeding. Misfolded α-synuclein aggregates are a defining pathological feature of Parkinson’s disease and related synucleinopathies. Seed amplification assays (SAAs), including RT-QuIC, can detect disease-associated α-synuclein seeding activity in human samples. The TNG group in Oxford has contributed to the development and application of these approaches in cerebrospinal fluid [1, 2] and to the biochemical characterisation of human brain-derived α-synuclein aggregates [3]. However, it remains unclear which molecular features explain differences in seeding activity and clinical progression. The collaborative project will investigate the “aggregatome”, the molecular environment associated with α-synuclein aggregates, including interacting proteins, post-translational modifications, lipids and glycosaminoglycans. Complementary SAAs will be combined with biochemical and structural analyses, spatially resolved measurements and multi-omics data across brain tissue, cerebrospinal fluid, blood and skin. By comparing matched and longitudinal samples, the consortium aims to distinguish factors associated with seeding from those that functionally modify it, and to identify potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets. At Oxford, the postholder will contribute primarily to the experimental characterisation and quantification of α-synuclein seeding and to the preparation and analysis of human biosamples. Working with Professor Parkkinen and under the day-to-day supervision of Dr Livia Civitelli, they will collaborate with scientists in Oxford and across the ASAP Collaborative Research Network. This is an opportunity to develop specialist skills in translational neuropathology, quantitative assays, reproducible data analysis and open science within a multidisciplinary international programme. The postholder will optimise, perform and quality-control α-synuclein SAAs on cerebrospinal fluid and brain-derived material, and, as required by the study plan, other human biomaterials. They will support complementary assay formats, including quantitative, recursive and in situ approaches [4-6], where appropriate to their training and project priorities; compare assay kinetics and seeding profiles; and assist with biochemical and morphological characterisation of native and amplified aggregates. They will maintain rigorous sample traceability, experimental records and reproducible analysis workflows, and contribute data and protocols to consortium-wide analyses and outputs. You will work closely with developers and product teams to integrate security early in the development process, identify and oversee the remediation of vulnerabilities, and ensure adherence to secure coding practices and application security standards. This role focuses on practical, hands-on security support while also growing your expertise in application security. Key Responsibilities SSDLC & Secure Coding Assist in integrating security controls into the SSDLC. Support the creation and maintenance of secure coding guidelines (e.g., OWASP Top 10, CERT Secure Coding Standards). Application Security Testing Run a Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) scans. Conduct API security testing. Support CI/CD pipelines to keep secure and effective integration. Threat Modeling & Application Security Analysis Participate in threat modeling sessions. Document identified threats, assess risks and provide mitigation recommendations. Assist in code and system reviews to analyse security in company’s products. Vulnerability Management Triage and prioritise vulnerabilities from automated scans. Track, verify and ensure security flaws remediation. Assist to automate an AppSec pipelines Collaboration & Awareness Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate security into product design and improve existing systems. Help deliver training and awareness on SSDLC best practices and secure coding. Contribute to security documentations. Required Skills & Experience 1–3 years in application security, secure software development, or related IT/security role. Understand basic network technologies and protocols (HTTP, TCP/IP, DNS and the OSI model). Understanding of common software vulnerabilities and their mitigations. Basic programming experience in a popular language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Golang). Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps principles. Basic understanding of cloud technologies (AWS, GCP or Azure) and GitHub security features. Strong attention to detail in documentation and assessments. Preferred Familiarity with SAST/DAST/SCA tools and API security testing platforms. Exposure to cloud-native application security (AWS, Azure, GCP). Understanding of container security (Docker, Kubernetes). Experience of participating in Capture The Flag (CTF) competitions. Key Competencies Eager to learn and expand technical skills in application security. Effective communicator with both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborative and proactive problem solver. Ability to prioritise work. items.desc: Are you caring, compassionate and committed to delivering patient-centred care? An exciting opportunity has arisen for a nurse working as a band 6 or 7, who are looking for a new challenge or to progress to a Guided Care Matron. In Hillingdon we are transforming our model of case management as part of the North West London - Integrated Care model. You will work as part of a Care Connection Team (CCT) in Hillingdon, providing anticipatory care to patients to prevent escalation of their health and or social care needs, thereby reducing the risk of emergency hospital admissions. The service works with patients over the age of 18 years with one more or of the following conditions; COPD, Stroke, Cardio Vascular Disease, Dementia, Social Isolation and Diabetes Mellitus. You will work to develop care plans for the patients on the CCT caseload, and proactively seek to identify at risk patients. You will be part of a once weekly huddle meeting with each of your CCT's, to discuss patients on your caseload and formulate their care plans. Where appropriate, you will make referrals to key stakeholders such as other community services e.g. district nurses, geriatrician, social services and third sector. The distance nurses travel each day is considerable and you will need to use a motor vehicle to carry out domiciliary visits. You will work autonomously to provide a full range of services predominantly to house bound patients including care homes and supported living, and will be skilled in carrying out Holistic assessments. The role also involves managerial aspects such as attending key meetings and supervision of junior staff such as Healthcare Support Workers, Senior Administrative Co-ordinators and Student nurses. The GCM will work closely with GPs to proactively identify patients (aged 18+) with high risk complex needs. They will provide a proactive, holistic approach to managing patients with long-term conditions that is centered on primary care and the prevention of avoidable hospital admissions. The focus will be on providing comprehensive assessments, individualized care plans and coordination for complex patients in their usual place of residence including care homes. The GCM will enable the patient, carers/care home staff and families to understand their disease or condition, how to recognize early symptoms and proactively manage their care decisions. The GCM will work as part of a multi- disciplinary team and will develop care plans for the patients on the Care Connection Team (CCT) caseload, supported by the CCT. GCMs will attend once or twice weekly huddles with the CCT to discuss patients on their caseload and formulate care plans. Where appropriate, referrals will be made to key stakeholders such as other community services e.g. district nurses, geriatrician, social services and third sector. The distance nurses travel each day is considerable and the GCM nurses use of their own car to carry out their domiciliary visits. The GCM works autonomously to provide a full range of services predominantly to house bound patients including residential and nursing homes and will be skilled in carrying out Holistic assessments.

items.desc: Bespoke Design Development & Technical Designer Freelance initially, with potential for a permanent position Location: Lewes, East Sussex – primarily studio-based, with some flexibility for remote working Rate: Dependent on experience Studio Hardie is looking for a competent, practical and technically minded designer to join our small design and manufacturing studio, on an initial freelance basis. We work on an unusually varied mix of projects, including architecture, landscape architecture, bespoke playgrounds, structures, furniture, sculpture and complex one-off pieces. The role is primarily focused on 3D modelling, design development, technical detailing, fabrication drawings and project documentation. Working predominantly in SketchUp and SketchUp Layout, you will help develop projects from initial concept through RIBA Stages 2–5 and into manufacture and construction. We have a substantial amount of work available over the first three months and are keen to develop a longer-term working relationship, with the potential for ongoing work and a permanent position for the right person. About Us Studio Hardie is an innovative design and manufacture studio known for invention, high-quality craftsmanship and playfulness. We are a small, collaborative team of designers and craftspeople working on unusual and often technically challenging projects. The work is extremely varied, from tiny mechanical details to large masterplans and everything in between. You will work closely with our lead designers and manufacturing team, helping to turn ambitious ideas into well-resolved, buildable designs. The Role You will be involved in projects from early design and costing through technical design, manufacture and construction. Responsibilities include: Developing accurate 3D models, technical drawings and fabrication/manufacturing packages. Producing planning, Building Regulations, tender and construction information. Preparing specifications, drawing registers, cutting lists and other project documentation. Researching materials, manufacturing methods and costs. Coordinating information from surveys, consultants, suppliers and contractors. Working with our manufacturing team to resolve technical details and practical construction issues. Taking ownership of your work, identifying missing information and checking drawings and specifications before issue. Skills & Experience Ideally, you will have at least three years' relevant industry experience, including RIBA Stages 2–5. We are looking for: Proficiency in SketchUp and SketchUp Layout , with experience in AutoCAD or equivalent and Adobe Creative Suite. Strong 3D modelling, technical drawing and detailing skills. A good practical understanding of construction, fabrication, building materials and assembly. Experience preparing detailed working drawings and manufacturing information. A working awareness of UK Building Regulations, planning requirements and relevant standards. The ability to interpret and coordinate site surveys and consultant information. Good communication skills and the ability to organise your own workload and meet deadlines. Experience with building contracts and listed sites would be useful but is not essential. Working Qualities We are looking for someone who: Takes ownership — thinks beyond the immediate drawing, anticipates what is needed and identifies gaps or unresolved issues. Thinks practically — considers how things are made, assembled, installed and used, and works towards well-resolved solutions. Is thorough and accurate — produces complete, considered information and takes responsibility for checking their own work. Works independently — is self-motivated, organised and able to make progress without constant direction. Communicates and collaborates well — works effectively with designers, craftspeople, consultants and contractors, and knows when to ask questions. We don't expect someone to be an expert in every area. Our projects cover a broad range of disciplines, materials and scales, and some knowledge can be developed along the way. What's important is a good practical foundation, curiosity, initiative, a willingness to learn and a genuine interest in realising high-quality design. Position We are initially looking for someone to work with us on a freelance basis, with a substantial amount of work available over the first three months. The role is primarily studio-based in Lewes, East Sussex, working closely with our design and manufacturing team, with some flexibility for remote working. We are keen to develop a longer-term working relationship, with the potential for ongoing work and a permanent position for the right person. Freelance rate: Dependent on experience. items.desc: Ref Number B02-11519 Professional Expertise Research and Research Support Department School of Life & Medical Sciences (B02) Location London Working Pattern Full time Salary £37,162-£43,749 Contract Type Fixed-term Working Type On site Available for Secondment No Closing Date 17-Nov-2026 About us The Department of Clinical and Movement Neurosciences at UCL Queen Square Institute of Neurology is a world-leading centre for research into neurological disorders. Bringing together clinical and basic neuroscience expertise, the Department uses advanced technologies and cellular, animal and human models to investigate disease mechanisms and develop new therapeutic approaches. The Queen Square Brain Bank provides access to well-characterised post-mortem tissue supporting internationally collaborative research. About the role We are seeking a motivated and organised Research Technician to support an international, multicentre digital pathology project investigating neurodegenerative diseases. Fox Foundation (MJFF), the project brings together brain bank collections, in partnership with the 10k Brains project, to advance research through the integration of digital pathology, clinical data and emerging AI-based approaches. You will work collaboratively with laboratory staff, researchers and clinical colleagues, with training provided where needed. Please do not upload any additional attachments as these will not be considered by the selection panel. You will have practical experience of histological techniques, excellent organisational skills and a meticulous approach to maintaining accurate records and handling research data. You will be confident using IT systems, able to interpret data accurately, and have excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You will be adaptable, able to manage competing priorities, and comfortable working collaboratively across laboratory, data and clinical settings. Sensitivity, professionalism and respect for confidentiality are essential, particularly when communicating with patients and families about brain donation. Rooted in values of compassion, dignity, inclusion, and justice, we unite churches, faith groups, community members, professionals and those with lived and living experience in a shared mission - to support those facing complex life challenges. We are currently delivering a pioneering One Stop Shop model in the heart of Kilmarnock — a holistic, trauma-informed service hub that integrates recovery, crisis response, harm reduction, peer support, digital inclusion, and access to practical essentials, all under one welcoming roof. items.desc: Hi We're Legl. Legl is building the operating system for modern legal services. We help law firms and regulated businesses replace manual, fragmented workflows with intelligent software, from client onboarding and compliance to payments, risk, and reporting. Legal work is high-stakes: it's regulated, complex, and deeply impactful. Our mission is to help regulated firms grow faster, run their businesses more profitably, manage risk intelligently, and deliver great client experiences. We're backed by leading European VCs, scaling quickly, partnered with over 600 law firms including 50 of the UK's top 200, launched in the UK and Australia, and entering our next phase of growth. We Work Best When AI is the central operating model: not a tool or a future plan, but the way we run. Decisions live with people: you're trusted to make calls and own them. Think deeply, execute quickly: speed and rigour, not speed or rigour. What You'll Do As a Technical Solutions Engineer at Legl, you’ll play a crucial hands-on role at the intersection of product, engineering and customer delivery. Embed with customers to map how they work. At kick-off, sit with the customer's teams, IT and third parties to understand their workflows, systems and data, then design how Legl connects into them. Stand up the deployment. Scope the integration, coordinate the customer's IT and partners, configure and deploy, and verify it actually works before and after go-live. You own the technical workstream inside every launch. Build and tune what each customer needs. Craft configurations, data mappings and lightweight integrations, writing simple scripts or API calls where it helps. Nothing requiring a CS degree, but you're not afraid of a terminal. Drive adoption across the installed base. Find the workflows that prove value fast, help existing customers switch integrations on, and monitor usage so their teams are getting everything they can out of them. Support commercial teams. Join prospect and customer calls as the technical voice, run discovery with customer developers and help Sales and CS scope integration requirements. This Role Is a Great Fit If You… Are as happy sitting with a customer's developer team working through a data sync as you are presenting to their partners about what it will do for them. Obsess over understanding customer goals, timelines and problems, and measure yourself on whether the thing you set up actually gets used. Are comfortable owning the customer-facing side of our technical deployments, and collaborating heavily across Sales, Customer Success, Support, EPD and our partners. Have some Python, or experience with no-code / low-code tooling, and have worked directly with founders or senior leadership in a scale-up. Love the complexity of technical delivery and commercial customer problems at the edge of legaltech operations. This Role Is Not a Great Fit If You… Would rather develop in isolation instead of getting stuck in with customer teams. Are lost when it comes to APIs and integration patterns. Dislike ambiguity. Every day is a school day! Can't adapt to new tooling, platforms and ways of working. We work across a broad tech stack with our customers, and ship every day.

 Werde als Metallograph (w/m/d) an unserem Standort Chemnitz Teil unseres Expertenteams und bring deine Leidenschaft für Werkstoffe und Präzision in spannende Analysen und vielfältige Projekte ein! Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Qualität und unterstütze unsere Entwicklung, Qualitätssicherung und Produktion mit deinem Know-how.
 Einstellort ist unser Standort in Chemnitz. Die Einarbeitung erfolgt an unserem Standort in Berlin.
 Was wir dir bieten: 
 Ansprechendes Vergütungspaket
 Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowohl für deine berufliche als auch persönliche Entwicklung
 30 Tage Urlaub sowie vielfältige, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, die eine Auszeit für dich und deine Familie ermöglichen
 Zugang zu Aktienplänen für Mitarbeitende
 Da jeder von uns 300.000 Mitarbeitenden andere Benefits als besonders wichtig empfindet und wir an dieser Stelle nicht unser ganzes Benefit-Portfolio auflisten können, findest du hier weitere Informationen.
 Die einzelnen Benefits unterliegen gesetzlichen, tarif-/vertraglichen oder betrieblichen Bedingungen.
 Verändere die Welt von morgen: 
 Du führst selbstständig metallographische Untersuchungen an metallischen Werkstoffen durch, indem du beispielsweise Schliffpräparationen und Ätzungen vornimmst sowie lichtmikroskopische Verfahren einsetzt
 Im Anschluss bewertest du Gefügestrukturen und identifizierst mögliche Schadensbilder, um fundierte Aussagen über den Zustand und die Eigenschaften der Werkstoffe zu treffen
 Darauf aufbauend dokumentierst und analysierst du die Untersuchungsergebnisse gemäß relevanter Normen wie DIN EN ISO und stellst deren Nachvollziehbarkeit sicher
 Zusätzlich unterstützt du bei werkstofftechnischen Prüfungen und trägst aktiv zur Schadensanalyse bei, um die Qualität und Sicherheit unserer Produkte zu gewährleisten
 Abschließend arbeitest du eng mit den Abteilungen Entwicklung, Qualitätssicherung und Produktion zusammen, um Untersuchungsergebnisse zielgerichtet weiterzugeben und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern
 So überzeugst du uns: 
 Ausbildung : Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Metallograph/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit langjähriger einschlägiger Berufserfahrung. Alternativ verfügst du über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Meister/in und mehrjähriger einschlägiger Berufserfahrung
 Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse : Du hast umfassende Erfahrung in der Präparation und Analyse metallischer und keramischer Werkstoffe
 Du bist sicher im Umgang mit lichtmikroskopischen Verfahren
 Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Werkstoffkunde und relevanten Normen wie DIN EN ISO
 Arbeitsweise : Du überzeugst durch sorgfältige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Teamfähigkeit und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität
 Sprachkenntnisse : Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind wünschenswert
 Du bist viel mehr als deine Qualifikationen und wir glauben an das Potential jeder einzelnen Person. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!
 Bei Siemens sind wir überzeugt: Wer sich wertgeschätzt und zugehörig fühlt, kann das eigene Potenzial voll entwickeln. Deshalb schaffen wir ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Person ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit erfährt und in dem individuelle Perspektiven und Erfahrungen geschätzt werden. Unser Engagement für Fairness und Respekt gilt für alle Bewerbenden.
 Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, ausdrücklich auch von Menschen mit Behinderung. Bei gleicher Qualifikation werden schwerbehinderte und gleichgestellte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber bevorzugt berücksichtigt.
 Über Uns Bist du bereit, die Energiewende voranzutreiben?
 Unsere Mission ist es, innovative und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln, die sowohl Energieeinsparungen ermöglichen als auch den CO₂-Fußabdruck von Gebäuden und Infrastrukturen reduzieren. Deshalb setzen wir bei Siemens im Bereich Smart Infrastructure Electrification & Automation alles daran, eine grünere Zukunft zu gestalten und unsere Lebens- und Arbeitsweise zu revolutionieren.
 Mehr Informationen zum Bereich und den Produkten findest du hier: https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/themenfelder/smart-infrastructure.html

 We are Siemens: 
 At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.

 Hello World, We are hiring! 
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future.
 Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant team.
 Siemens Software, a business unit of the Siemens Digital Industries, is a leading global provider of software solutions to drive the digital transformation of industry, creating new opportunities for manufacturers to realize innovation.
 About the role: 
 Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking motivated Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) software engineers to join our CFD solver development team.
 The primary focus of the CFD solver team, a unit within our Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) division, is the conception, design and development of core thermo-fluid flow solver capabilities within Siemens Digital Industries’ flagship multi-physics simulation product, Simcenter STAR-CCM+.
 The CFD solver development team is responsible for developing accurate, robust and efficient flow solvers for modeling complex industrial flows, such as turbomachinery, external aerodynamics, and internal combustion engines. As a team member, you will be expected to contribute to both the innovation and development of new features, as well as the improvement and maintenance of existing functionality. Your responsibility will be to ensure a well-designed, high-quality, robust implementation; efficient operation; and good scalability in our highly parallel, client-server platform.
 What you’ll be doing: 
 As a member of the CFD solver development team your specific responsibilities will include:
 Design and development of core CFD solver components in Simcenter STAR-CCM+
 Ensuring high-quality and robust implementation of core CFD solver components in Simcenter STAR-CCM+
 Supporting maintenance and improvement of our existing capability (bug fixing, code refactoring, etc.)
 Conception, design and development of new features based on requests from both product management and internal strategic initiatives
 Participation in regularly scheduled team meetings and contribution of ideas to drive innovation in our technology
 Supporting other developers through design discussion and code review
 What you'll bring: 
 A PhD or Master's degree in engineering, physics, applied mathematics, or a related physical science discipline
 Solid understanding of the Navier-Stokes equations and the numerical methods used to solve them
 Working knowledge of object-oriented C++ and an interest in building maintainable, well-structured software
 Familiarity with computational modelling of fluid flow, ideally in aerodynamic or hydrodynamic applications
 Good understanding of software design principles, and a willingness to learn modern design patterns
 Familiarity with high-performance computing concepts, including parallel programming and GPU computing
 Nice to have: 
 Coursework or project experience in thermodynamics, heat transfer, multiphase flow, or combustion
 Exposure to CFD applications such as vehicle aerodynamics, internal combustion engines, or turbomachinery
 Experience with CFD software, either commercial or open-source, through academic projects, internships, or personal work
 Experience with source control (such as Git) and participating in code reviews or team-based development
 Working at Siemens Software 
 A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
 Siemens is not the same manufacturing company as in the past. We are helping our customers get to tomorrow faster through innovation and digitalization and are transforming alongside them. We are a modern, forward-looking software company, with the opportunities of a large corporation, where your opportunities are endless. The role you apply for today is only the first step in your Siemens journey.

 A Siemens Mobility Kft. K+F központjában, a XI. kerületi Infoparkban olyan projekteken dolgozunk, melyek biztosítják a zavartalan, fenntartható, megbízható és biztonságos közlekedést. 
 Tudj meg többet a cégünkről: www.siemens.hu/mobility 
 A projektről: a projekt célja a vasúti járművek vonatvezérlési és vonatbefolyásolási rendszereihez tartozó Unified Display System (UDS) fejlesztése, tesztelése és validálása. Az UDS egy olyan integrált kijelzőplatform, amely a különböző fedélzeti rendszerek információit egy egységes felületen jeleníti meg a járművezető számára, ezzel támogatva a biztonságos és hatékony üzemeltetést.
 A csapat tagjaként az alábbi feladatok várnak rád: 
 A rendszer és a kapcsolódó technológiák mélyreható megismerése a terület szakértőinek támogatásával.
 Ügyfél- és rendszerkövetelmények elemzése, értelmezése és pontosítása.
 Az EN 50716 szabvány szerinti biztonságkritikus fejlesztési elvek alkalmazásának támogatása.
 Tesztkoncepciók és validációs megközelítések kidolgozása.
 Technikai előírások és ügyféligények leképezése a vasúti járművek funkcionális architektúrájára.
 A vasúti jármű különböző alrendszerei közötti rendszer- és interfészkapcsolatok koordinálása.
 Fejlesztési folyamatok szakmai támogatása és összehangolása.
 Rendszerdokumentáció készítése és karbantartása angol nyelven, modellező eszközök használatával.
 Kapcsolattartás különböző szakterületek képviselőivel, technikai egyeztetések koordinálása.
 Te vagy az ideális jelölt, ha: 
 Felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel villamosmérnöki, közlekedésmérnöki vagy gépészmérnöki területen.
 Legalább 3 éves tapasztalatot szereztél rendszermérnöki vagy hasonló pozícióban.
 Magabiztos, aktív angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel szóban és írásban (minimum C1).
 Képes vagy összetett rendszerek átlátására és több érintett szakterület összehangolására.
 Jellemző rád a precíz, alapos munkavégzés és az erős felelősségvállalás.
 Prioritásváltozások esetén is nyugodtan és megoldásorientáltan dolgozol.
 Kiváló kommunikációs és együttműködési készséggel rendelkezel.
 Proaktívan formálod és fejleszted a folyamatokat, valamint szívesen vállalsz tulajdonosi szerepet egy-egy területen.
 Fontos számodra a tudásmegosztás és a csapat sikere.
 A pályázásod során előnyt jelenthet, ha: 
 Német nyelvtudással rendelkezel.
 Szereztél már tapasztalatot vasúti vagy más biztonságkritikus iparágban, illetve szoftverkiadási és jóváhagyási (approval) folyamatokkal kapcsolatos projektekben.
 Részt vettél járműirányítási vagy járművezérlési rendszerek fejlesztésében.
 Van projektvezetői vagy műszaki koordinációs tapasztalatod.
 Magabiztosan mozogsz komplex rendszerek és szerteágazó műszaki témák összefogásában.
 Ismered a DOORS vagy a Polarion követelménykezelő rendszereket.
 Mi az, amit mi biztosítunk? 
 Lehetőséget a projekttel kapcsolatos nemzetközi utazáson való részvételre.
 Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással.
 Stresszmentes környezetet, ahol nagy hangsúlyt kap a work-life balance.
 Fejlődési lehetőségeket, egyéni tréning kerettel, kidolgozott karrierúttal.
 Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk.
 Ergonomikus munkakörnyezetet biztosítunk számodra, ezzel is kényelmessé téve az irodai munkavégzést.
 A felsoroltak mellett egy több mint 20 elemből álló béren kívüli juttatási csomaggal várunk.

 Actualmente buscamos un/a Técnico/a de Mantenimiento con entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia, especializado/a en diagnóstico, detección de fallos, reparación y mantenimiento de equipos industriales, para cubrir temporalmente una baja dentro del equipo . 
 Funciones principales: 
 Realizar las tareas de mantenimiento correctivo y preventivo siguiendo los procedimientos establecidos. 
 Diagnóstico de averías y detección de fallos para su posterior reparación. 
 Realizar trabajos mecánicos y eléctricos, incluyendo tareas de taller. 
 Detectar y comunicar cualquier anomalía que observe en las máquinas, tanto en la ejecución de sus tareas como en la documentación de los equipos. 
 Participar en las modificaciones de las máquinas en base a las instrucciones dadas por los mandos directos. 
 Búsqueda e identificación de oportunidades de mejora. 
 Reporte de las órdenes de trabajo (descripción, tiempo, origen, repuestos, etc.) 
 Asegurar que en las operaciones a realizar se cumplen los requisitos de calidad, medio ambiente y prevención de riesgos laborales legales y normativos. 
 Requisitos básicos del puesto: 
 Titulación oficial en Electromecánica o Electrónica (FP2 o Grado Superior). 
 Conocimientos técnicos en hidráulica y neumática. 
 Capacidad para leer y comprender esquemas mecánicos y eléctricos. 
 Manejo de herramientas ofimáticas y experiencia en uso de sistemas ERP (preferiblemente SAP). 
 Experiencia mínima de 3-5 años trabajando conforme a la normativa de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales (PRL). 
 Se valorará conocimiento en programación Step 7/TIA Portal (Siemens), sistemas de visualización, CMMS y robótica. 
 Inglés técnico (nivel medio), valorable pero no imprescindible. 
 Perfil personal: Proactivo/a, con habilidades para el trabajo en equipo, responsable y comprometido/a con el cumplimiento estricto de las normas de seguridad y calidad. 
 Este puesto es de carácter temporal para cubrir una baja, y el trabajo se desarrollará en turnos rotativos (mañana, tarde y noche), de lunes a domingo . 
 En Siemens, valoramos la diversidad de nuestros equipos, promovemos la igualdad de oportunidades y fomentamos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo. Buscamos talento sin distinciones, apoyando y respetando todas las formas de diversidad. Nuestro Plan de Igualdad , alineado con la normativa vigente, garantiza un trato justo y transparente, reafirmando nuestro compromiso de seguir construyendo un lugar cada vez más equitativo y diverso. #LI-AMC

items.desc: [Stage de 6 mois] Qui sommes-nous ? Rejoignez une entreprise qui donne des ailes à votre avenir. Depuis 170 ans, Abeille Assurances protège et accompagne près de 3 millions de clients (particuliers et entreprises) à chaque étape de leur vie. Abeille Assurances, en quelques chiffres, c’est près de 9 milliards de CA en 2025, en progression de plus de 23% ; et désormais 3 900 collaborateurs en France. Nous sommes intégrés à AEMA Groupe. Nous rejoindre, c’est intégrer un collectif moderne, engagé pour le climat, les territoires et les actions fortes de RSE. C’est aussi adhérer à une entreprise qui promeut l’inclusion, l’égalité et la diversité. Votre environnement de travail Au sein de la Direction Dommage et Santé, l’équipe R&D Data Science réalise des travaux de détection et de lutte contre la fraude. A partir de données structurées provenant de sources internes et externes, l'équipe R&D Data Science réalise des modèles en utilisant des techniques Statistiques ou de Machine Learning. Vos Missions Le/La stagiaire aura pour mission, en collaboration avec les équipes et directions métier concernées, de : Analyser et préparer les données fraude afin de construire un socle de données fiable pour la modélisation. Améliorer et enrichir les modèles supervisés de détection de fraude existants, en étudiant notamment l'apport de techniques de rééquilibrage des classes (SMOTE, données synthétiques, etc.) et en comparant leurs performances. Mettre en œuvre des algorithmes de détection d’anomalies pour identifier des comportements atypiques ou des schémas de fraude émergents. Construire des indicateurs d’incertitude des prédictions afin de repérer les dossiers nécessitant une expertise complémentaire. Combiner les différents scores (modèle supervisé, anomalie, incertitude) pour élaborer une stratégie de classification des dossiers en trois catégories : non fraude, fraude et suspicion de fraude. Développer un prototype d’aide à la décision et évaluer sa performance en vue de son intégration dans le processus de génération d’alertes à destination des équipes de lutte contre la fraude. Votre profil Vous êtes actuellement en formation supérieure en Master 2 Data Sciences, IA ou Ecole d’Ingénieur. Vous maitrisez Python. Vous souhaitez intégrer une équipe jeune et dynamique et travailler sur des sujets en lien avec des problématiques concrètes. Votre rigueur, votre esprit de synthèse, votre motivation et votre aisance relationnelle seront indispensables pour réussir ce stage. Vous devrez également faire preuve d’autonomie et de proactivité pour mener à bien les missions qui vous seront confiées. Les modalités du poste Lieu : Bois-Colombes (92) Durée : 6 mois Date de démarrage : Avril 2027 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Rejoindre Abeille Assurances, c’est intégrer une entreprise qui prend soin de ses talents autant que de ses clients. Nous offrons un cadre de travail équilibré et pensé pour favoriser votre développement professionnel et personnel. Nous offrons, notamment : Une gratification fixe, Un remboursement de transport flexible, encadré par un forfait mobilité durable, pour favoriser les mobilités douces. Un environnement de travail chaleureux et convivial 100 % en flex-office, facilement accessible en transport.

items.desc: Répondre aux défis de la transition énergétique et renforcer notre souveraineté sont des priorités du XXIᵉ siècle. Au cœur de ces enjeux, Assystem accompagne ses clients dans la réalisation de leurs projets les plus stratégiques. Et pour y parvenir, nos 8 000 Switchers mobilisent leur expertise en ingénierie, management de projet et digital. Présents dans 13 pays (Europe, Moyen-Orient, Asie centrale, Amérique du Nord), nous contribuons au développement de nouvelles capacités de production d’électricité nucléaire, au maintien en conditions opérationnelles des installations existantes, ainsi qu'à la conception et à la réalisation d'infrastructures critiques, notamment dans le secteur de la défense. Description Du Poste Votre future équipe Sous la responsabilité de Karl, Responsable d’équipe, vous êtes moteur dans une équipe spécialisée en système informatisé dans le domaine de l’ amélioration de la performance , travaillant en étroite collaboration avec d'importants acteurs industriels. Vous participez à la conception et à la réalisation de projets visant à utiliser des modèles IA pour la détection d’anomalies sur des installations industrielles. Vos missions 🔹 Contribuer à la mise à jour d’un état de l’art sur les modèles d’IA qui ont déjà été utilisés pour la détection et/ou la prédiction d’anomalies dans des installations industrielles, 🔹 Participer à la création de jeux de données : collecte, nettoyage, annotation, contrôle qualité, 🔹 Mettre en place des scripts pour automatiser les traitements : préparation de données, évaluation, visualisation des résultats et génération de rapports, 🔹 Expérimenter des modèles d’IA pour la détection et/ou la prédiction d’anomalies, 🔹 Réaliser des benchmarks sur des cas d’usage industriels réels ou représentatifs, en documentant les limites observées, les conditions de réussite et les axes d’amélioration, 🔹 Expérimenter des modèles d’IA générative pour compléter et équilibrer des jeux de données, 🔹 Participer à la valorisation des travaux : synthèses techniques, supports de restitution, démonstrateurs et recommandations pour la suite du projet. Ce stage de fin d’études est bien plus qu'une simple opportunité professionnelle ; il offre des perspectives d'évolution de carrière stimulantes à l’issue du diplôme. Pourquoi réaliser votre stage chez Assystem ? On a 3 bonnes raisons pour vous convaincre ! 🏆 Développez rapidement vos compétences grâce à des missions à forte valeur ajoutée, un accompagnement de proximité et un parcours d'intégration structuré comprenant des points de suivi tout au long de votre stage. 🥐 Évoluez dans un environnement bienveillant où l'esprit d'équipe est une réalité : 87% de nos stagiaires et alternants soulignent la qualité du climat social chez Assystem. 📈Construisez votre avenir professionnel au sein d'un groupe qui recrute plus de 100 stagiaires chaque année et où 75 % des stagiaires poursuivent l'aventure en CDI ou en alternance ! Qualifications Vos atouts et les prérequis pour réussir 🔹 En formation BAC+5 (école ingénieur ou Master) axée sur IA, Data Science, Ingénierie des données, mathématiques appliques ou équivalent. 🔹 Vous recherchez votre stage de 6 mois pour valider votre diplôme. 🔹 Autonomie, rigueur, organisation, esprit d'équipe, sens de l'analyse et fortes capacités techniques sont vos traits distinctifs. 🔹 Expérience en développement Python, capacité à concevoir des expérimentations et à mesurer la justesse, la couverture et l’utilité. 🔹 La maîtrise de l'anglais est obligatoire. Rejoignez-nous pour donner une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière au sein d'une équipe passionnée chez Assystem, où l'excellence et l'innovation sont nos moteurs quotidiens. Envoyez-nous votre candidature dès maintenant pour prendre part à cette aventure professionnelle enrichissante ! Informations supplémentaires Nous nous engageons au respect de l’égalité de traitement entre les candidats, et cultivons toutes les formes de diversité. Chez Assystem, seules les compétences comptent ! Si vous souhaitez porter à la connaissance d’Assystem une quelconque situation ou des besoins spécifiques, n’hésitez pas : vous serez accompagné(e) !
