Job Description: 
 In order to support our Component Loads team, Airbus is looking for a 
 Component Loads Engineer (d/f/m) 
 Are you passionate about aircraft physics? 
 Are you keen to work at the interface between flight physics and airframe design? 
 Do you enjoy connecting people and building trustful connections with your co-workers and your customers? 
 As Component Loads Engineer in Hamburg, you will master the technical challenges around the fuselage and the VTP (vertical tail plane) in a transnational organisation located in Europe and India. 
 In this role, you will also act as the Fatigue & Damage Tolerance Loads Integrator (FLI), serving as a key technical focal point and liaison between the Loads & Aeroelasticity (L&A) domain and the Stress Office (SO) F&DT group.
We would like you to join our mixed team of 15 engaged engineers and scientists and get introduced to the different activities we perform from an early design stage until certification for all Airbus aircraft. We are responsible for the interface to our customers in airframe, systems, and cabin & cargo, identifying requirements and delivering aero and inertia loads for static and fatigue design. We perform special assessments around dynamic component problems and cabin analyses, and we contribute to the overall aircraft model within the loads process. Our in-house tool world ranges from high-performance software to simple scripts and is in the middle of a transformation to more automation and machine learning. 
 Your location 
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 As a team member, you will work in an empowered manner to ensure customer satisfaction. You will have the chance to develop throughout our activities and contribute to: 
 Requirements capture and modelling for our components fuselage and VTP 
 Mass modelling for overall aircraft loads 
 Preparation and delivery of static and fatigue loads 
 Loads computation for fairings, secondary structure, rudder, and/or specific cabin layouts 
 Component dynamics 
 Support airlines through Airbus Customer Services by carrying out L&A analyses of in-service events 
 Contribute to Loads In-Service Support with troubleshooting activities in the L&A design office context for development and production flight test and in-service aircraft, performing related L&A assessments 
 Engage for timely response to engineering queries as on-call engineer for Loads In-Service Support 
 Desired skills and qualifications
 You are a highly motivated, proactive, and open-minded person with a great sense of initiative who likes connecting people. 
 You have a Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent, preferably with working experience in the loads-stress perimeter, dynamic modelling, or fatigue & damage tolerance (F&DT). 
 You bring a solid background in flight physics, dynamic behavior, and aircraft fatigue loads evaluation. 
 You are interested in understanding physical aspects, using engineering judgment, and applying analytical methods to solve complex load challenges. 
 You are keen to deepen your technical knowledge while enjoying working in a multicultural and interdisciplinary team across sites. 
 You are committed to investing your time in your development in the area of loads and aeroelastics along with the required methods, processes, and tools. 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Job Description: 
 With the development of future Airbus programs accelerating, Airbus UpNext is launching a new Demonstrator. 
 This high-stakes R&T flight platform has a dual mission: deliver flight-proven breakthroughs directly to future Airbus programs, and inject game-changing ideas to reshape how Airbus Commercial builds aircraft for the next 30 years. 
 Operating as a "startup within the giant," this program flies a heavily instrumented subsonic demonstrator platform to pioneer advanced flight physics technologies, aiming for a significant block fuel reduction. 
 Based in Toulouse (Saint Martin) within a flat, fast-paced project organization, this role requires close collaboration with the engineering leadership team, Overall Aircraft Design (OAD), Flight Control Systems, and data science specialists. 
 This position comes with limited contract (CDI-C) linked to the deliverable of the demo ( estimated end date - end of July 2029), starting ASAP. 
 The Mission 
 As the Xwing Active Control Functions & Artificial intelligence leader , you will be the end-to-end owner for the deployment of advanced active control technologies and AI capabilities on the demonstrator platform. Working directly within the Flight Physics & System Engineering team, you will bridge Overall Aircraft Design (OAD), Flight Control Systems & Sensors and Data Science to pioneer breakthrough technologies to active load alleviation, performance optimization, and physical modelling. 
 Your mission is vital: drive multi-disciplinary technical convergence, lead the strategic deployment with our partners, and deliver flight-proven gains to shape future Airbus commercial aircraft programs. 
 What You’ll Own (Accountabilities): 
 1. Active Control System Architecture & End-to-End Roadmap 
 End-to-End ACF Leadership: Own the complete roadmap for Active Control Functions 
 Aircraft-Level Trade-Offs: Support Trade off for active control application on Airbus programs 
 Top-Level System Requirements & Architecture definition: Define and arbitrate functional requirements across disciplines and lead architecture analysis based on XWing configuration 
 2. AI & Strategic Partnership Leadership 
 AI Technology Deployment: Lead the deployment of disruptive AI capabilities on the demonstrator and ensure seamless synchronization with Airbus initiatives 
 Executive Communication: Report progress, demonstrate flight test results, and communicate the overall AI strategy to executive stakeholders and Airbus-level AI leaders. 
 Your Boarding Pass: 
 Flight Physics & Systems Track Record : Master's Degree or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Automatic Control, Flight Physics, or Computational Sciences, with a strong background in Overall Aircraft Design (OAD), Flight Dynamics, Aeroelasticity, or Flight Control Systems. 
 Applied AI & Data Science : Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of machine learning applied to physical systems (surrogate modeling, CFD/loads neural networks, real-time data fusion). 
 Systems Architecture & Testing : Proven ability to derive multi-disciplinary system requirements, alongside experience with flight test operations, telemetry exploitation, or hardware-in-the-loop validation. 
 Mindset & Leadership : Recognized for your high autonomy, strategic vision, and cross-functional leadership skills. Ability to influence without direct authority and drive alignment across multi-disciplinary technical teams. 
 Linguistic Versatility & Communication : Fluent English is mandatory due to our international ecosystem and strong worldwide partnerships. Strong presentation skills to communicate complex technical concepts to executive audiences. 
 About Us & Values 
 Airbus UpNext empowers you to think and act like a startup, backed by the robust expertise of Airbus. In this role, you will embody our core DNA: 
 #Speed of Execution: Moving fast, prioritizing fast experimentation and agility over paperwork. 
 #Be Audacious: Welcoming challenges; constantly striving to push boundaries. 
 #Be Simple: Finding the most efficient, pragmatic path to success. 
 #Caring for Each Other & Open to the World: Building a trustful team and expanding global partnerships.

Job Description: 
 B1 & B2 Licensed Engineers 
 At Airbus Helicopters UK, we are the backbone of Britain’s civil helicopter hub. AHUK delivers expert maintenance and bespoke completions on a broad range of Airbus Helicopter types. We partner with Corporate, Air Ambulance, Police, Military and Utility customers, AHUK is also proud to be the chosen maintenance provider for the No.1 Flying Training School, the rotary element of the UK Military Flight Training System (MFTS). AHUK specialises in delivering critical maintenance support for missions that save lives and protect communities. 
 We are looking for professional B1 and B2 Licensed Engineers to maintain our high standards of safety and operational excellence. 
 Location: Your Career, Your Base 
 London Oxford Airport (Kidlington): Our headquarters and Civil MRO hub . 
 The best of City & Country: Moments from Oxford’s world-class dining, culture, and historic energy, with the scenic Cotswolds countryside just around the corner. 
 Great Connectivity: Fast, regular train links straight into central London and across the Thames Valley. 
 An Unbeatable Lifestyle: Vibrant market towns, welcoming communities, and plenty of green open space to recharge. 
 RAF Shawbury (Shropshire) : Supporting the MFTS fleet. 
 The Best of Heritage & Country: Minutes from Shrewsbury’s historic medieval streets, independent dining, and river loops, with the rugged Shropshire Hills Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty right on your doorstep. 
 Great Connectivity: Direct rail routes into Birmingham, Chester, and Manchester, with seamless links across the Midlands and the Welsh Marches. 
 An Unbeatable Lifestyle: Vibrant historic market towns, outstanding local schools, safe communities, and miles of rolling countryside to recharge. 
 RAF Valley (Anglesey) : Supporting the MFTS fleet. 
 The Best of Coast & Peak: Surrounded by Anglesey’s pristine Blue Flag beaches, dramatic cliffs, and coastal paths, with the sweeping peaks of Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park just across the Menai Strait. 
 Great Connectivity: Direct rail and road corridors via the A55 express route, linking seamlessly along the North Wales coast to Chester, Liverpool, and Manchester, plus daily ferry connections to Dublin. 
 An Unbeatable Lifestyle: A haven for water sports, mountain hiking, and wildlife, supported by friendly coastal villages, great local seafood, and an exceptional outdoor work-life balance. 
 Compensation: Brand New Competitive Salary & Career Scale 
 At Airbus Helicopters UK, we have launched a brand new, highly competitive, and transparent pay structure. Built to recognise your expertise, commitment, and location. This industry-leading framework is designed to reward you from day one while providing a clear, continuous path for salary and career progression with AHUK 
 Progressive Base Pay : A tiered salary structure that increases based on your qualifications, with dedicated pay increments for every useful type rating held (up to 4 types) and additional premium reward for dual-licensed B1/B2 Engineers. 
 Clear Progression Pathways (5 Tiered Career Levels) : We map your advancement through five structured tiers of technical expertise, with salary progression directly linked to your growing competencies and authorisations: 
 - Licence Without Type 
 - Certifying Engineer 
 - Multi-Type Engineer 
 - Specialist Engineer 
 - Technical Expert 
 Role-Specific Allowances: Opportunity to boost your earnings through dedicated responsibilities, such as a C Rating or Crew Chief allowance. 
 Site-Specific Aviation Skills Premium: A targeted annual premium applied across our Oxford, Shawbury, and Valley sites, recognising and rewarding the specialised skills required in these key operational regions. 
 Additional Uplifts : A 7.5% shift allowance (where applicable) on your base salary. 
 The Reward: Why Join Airbus? 
 We offer a competitive base salary and a robust suite of benefits designed to support your health, wealth, and lifestyle: 
 Joining Bonus: To recognise the value of your CAA Part 66 licence and AHUK type rating, we are offering a phased signing bonus for eligible new joiners. This incentive is split between your commencement date and your one-year anniversary with the company. 
 (Conditions apply: A standard 2-year bonding agreement applies to the total bonus value; candidates previously employed by Airbus in the last 18 months are not eligible). 
 Future Wealth: up to 8% Company Pension contribution, when you contribute 6%. Plus Yearly Share Incentive Plans, and Discretionary Group Bonuses in including 6 times basic salary for death in service life Insurance 
 Holiday Allowance : We value loyalty and work-life balance; your annual leave entitlement grows with you, rewarding your commitment with an extra day of leave for each year of service (up to an additional 4 days) 
 Health : Private Medical Insurance (Bupa). You also have the flexibility to add family members to your policy at an …

Job Description: 
 Zur Unterstützung des IT Operation- und Kubernetes Teams sucht Airbus Defence and Space einen 
 IT Operations & Cloud Platform Specialist (d/m/w) 
 Als IT Operations & Cloud Platform Specialist (d/m/w) übernehmen Sie die Schlüsselrolle an der Nahtstelle zweier Technologie-Generationen: In einem 50/50-Hybridmodell steuern Sie sowohl moderne Cloud-Native-Plattformen als auch hochverfügbare Enterprise-Datacenter-Lösungen. Sie arbeiten in einem spezialisierten Team, tragen echte End-to-End-Verantwortung und schaffen die Plattformbasis für hunderte geschäftskritische Anwendungen. 
 Dein Standort 
 Unser Standort ist nur einen Katzensprung von München, der schönen Landeshauptstadt von Bayern, entfernt. Du magst Sport und andere Outdoor-Aktivitäten? Die Alpen und der Starnberger See sind in einer Stunde zu erreichen und bieten eine Vielzahl von Freizeitaktivitäten. 
 Unsere Benefits für dich 
 Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien. 
 Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical) 
 Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven 
 Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten 
 Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird 
 Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 1. Cloud Platforms & Container Operations (50%) 
 Plattformbetrieb & GitOps: Sie betreiben, warten und skalieren unsere Managed-Container-Services auf Basis von Red Hat OpenShift und Kubernetes – sowohl in Standardumgebungen als auch in isolierten, hochsicheren Zonen ( air-gapped / restricted ). 
 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE): Sie überwachen Kernmetriken (Latenzen, Uptime, Fehlerraten via Prometheus & Grafana), halten SLOs verlässlich ein und reduzieren operativen Routineaufwand ( Toil ) durch konsequente Automatisierung. 
 DevSecOps & Entwicklungsschnittstelle: Sie etablieren Best Practices für Container-Sicherheit, steuern das Schwachstellenmanagement ( Vulnerability Management ) und unterstützen Entwicklerteams bei der nahtlosen Integration moderner CI/CD-Pipelines. 
 Entry into Service: Als technischer Sparringspartner begleiten Sie die Inbetriebnahme neuer Container-Applikationen von der Konzeption bis zur Produktion. 
 2. Infrastructure & Compute Operations (50%) 
 Enterprise Hardware Lifecycle: Sie übernehmen die ganzheitliche Betreuung, Wartung und Entstörung unserer physischen Serverlandschaft (HPE ProLiant, Synergy Frames, OneView), inklusive Firmware-Updates und Hardware-Komponententausch. 
 Virtualisierung & Datacenter: Sie verantworten Administration, Patching, Skalierung und tiefes Troubleshooting für hochverfügbare Umgebungen auf Basis von VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter) sowie Nutanix. 
 ITIL-Prozesse in der Praxis: Sie steuern die täglichen operativen IT-Prozesse souverän – von der schnellen Störungsbeseitigung (Incident Management) über fundierte Ursachenanalysen (Problem Management) bis hin zu Changes mit minimaler Ausfallzeit. 
 Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery: Sie überwachen Backup- und Replikationsprozesse und leiten Disaster-Recovery-Tests, um im Ernstfall schnellste Wiederherstellungszeiten zu garantieren. 
 Gewünschte Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen 
 Fundierte Basis: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Systemtechnik oder eine vergleichbare IT-Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker/in für Systemintegration) mit mehrjähriger Praxis im Enterprise-IT-Betrieb. 
 Die perfekte Kombination: 
 Mehrjährige operative Erfahrung im Betrieb von produktiven Kubernetes- / OpenShift-Clustern. 
 Zeitgleich tiefgehendes Praxiswissen in der Administration von VMware vSphere und Nutanix. 
 Hardware-Kompetenz: Praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit physischer Rechenzentrums-Hardware (idealerweise HPE Compute / Synergy / ProLiant) inklusive Wartung und Firmware-Management. 
 Prozess-Sicherheit: Sicheres Verständnis und gelebte Praxis von ITIL-Serviceprozessen bei Ausfällen und Eskalationen in kritischen Umgebungen. 
 Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Schnittstellen Teams.

Job Description: 
 In order to support our structure development team, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for an 
 Airframe Design Approver (d/f/m) 
 Are you motivated to work in an international environment where collaboration is key? Here, you will be part of our dedicated team of development engineers in the fuselage area for the primary/secondary structure of all our commercial Airbus aircraft programs and their derivatives. You will therefore be involved with your expertise from the concept study through detailed design to certification.
 This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.
 Your location 
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Guarantee product quality and airworthiness by taking full responsibility for design approval according to established processes
 Develop and optimize metal, composite, and hybrid components and assemblies with regard to weight, cost, performance, manufacturing, and assembly requirements.
 Collaborate in multifunctional teams alongside structural analysis, production, program, project, configuration, and systems functions to achieve optimal technical solutions.
 Evaluate design changes, estimate implementation efforts, and ensure full compliance with regulations, design principles, and guidelines.
 Manage engineering partner and supplier activities, serving as their key technical contact.
 Drive digitalization and automation innovations actively, taking all relevant regulations and stakeholders into account.
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Technical university degree or similar professional qualification.
 First experience in structural design. 
 Solid understanding of metal, composite, and hybrid design principles, including manufacturing/assembly requirements and tolerance definition.
 Practical knowledge in project management and motivation to work with agile methodologies.
 Hands-on proficiency with CATIA V5, VPM and a PLM tool such as e.g. PASS SSCI.
 Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills to align diverse stakeholders, foster continuous improvement, and achieve team goals. Interest in both detailed work and the big picture.
 Ideally experience in AI within the work context
 Business-fluent communication skills in German and English

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 A new opportunity in Learning has opened in Airbus GBS.
 This role contributes to the "Federated Academies in Airbus Defence and Space" [FA] Mission to enable the Business to appropriately qualify employees by understanding (and helping the Business understand) the Short, Medium and Long-term Competency Needs, and defining, maintaining and managing the optimal Learning Offer to meet those Needs. Consequently, this role focuses on driving professional growth and a robust learning culture within the Technical domains that are the focus, like Engineering, Industrial and Procurement, in a transnational environment, ensuring the workforce is compliant, technically proficient and continuously evolving.
 Responsibilities - your mission: 
 The jobholder will have strategic and operational responsibilities within the Engineering, Industrial or Procurement domain in the Federated Academies of Airbus Defence and Space: 
 Competence Strategy: design and implement the Competence Strategy in Engineering, Industrial, Procurement or Quality domain, fostering a modern learning culture
 Prepare the future: anticipating industry trends to identify emerging and critical roles within Engineering, Industrial, Procurement or Quality, as well as maintaining the Jobs catalogue and job mapping according to the business
 Gap analysis: proactively identify skill needs to ensure the organization remains competitive
 Lifecycle management: maintain and evolve the Jobs and Competences catalogues, ensuring the learning solutions align with current and future business needs
 Solution design: define requirements for new training solutions and manage the development process partnering with internal Subject Matter Experts and external providers
 Learning Deployment: define learning paths, collaborate with internal trainers and implement corrective actions whenever there are deviation from the Learning Plan. 
 Network and Communication: actively participate in the communication strategy, promoting knowledge sharing and strengthening the Engineering, Industrial, Procurement or Quality network across the organization
 Projects: contribute to transversal projects within the Engineering, Industrial, Procurement or Quality domain or across the Federated Academies to ensure consistency in learning standards and drive organizational synergy
 In detail, the following describes the common Faculty responsibilities to which the jobholder shall contribute and deliver to: 
 Creation and Maintenance of a diverse and comprehensive Learning Portfolio / Offer (with optimized learning strategies) in order to provide a tailored response to the Mid-to-Long-term representation of When, Who and What the Business requires in terms of Competencies, driven by various factors (e.g. Business Strategy), specifically for the Engineering, Industrial, Procurement or Quality Domain --> maximizing the Return on Investment of such a Portfolio / Offer;
 Definition and Maintenance of the Competence Strategy of the Airbus DS Business that has Jobs mapped within the Engineering, Industrial, Procurement or Quality Domain; the 'Competence Strategy' represents the Mid-to-Long-term Business Strategy expressed in When, Who and What the business requires in terms of Competences AND the high-level responses to these [competence requirements] in terms of Learning, thereby fostering a modern learning culture. (this includes the identification of Critical, Emerging and Future Jobs & Competences);

In this role, you will play an active part in steering workload and workforce processes across the Engineering perimeter of Air Power, ensuring transparent workload planning, management, reporting, and scheduling.
 This position offers you the exciting opportunity to work closely with work package management, bid coordination, and workload planning processes across key Engineering programmes—such as the Eurofighter—supporting our Engineering teams and leadership. Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants. 
 Rejoignez la Discipline Data, IA, Algo du Centre de Compétences Digital Solution (CCDS) France en charge du développement des logiciels, produits et services en algorithme, en intelligence artificielle et en data dans les domaines Télécom, Observation, Navigation et Science.

 En tant qu'Ingénieur Data Scientist Recherche Operationnelle, 
 Vous aurez en charge les missions suivantes : 
 Développement d’algorithmes pour la planification de resources dans le cadre de constellations télécom.
 Proposition de nouveaux algorithmes ou modification d’algorithmes existants.
 Implémentation des algorithmes dans un outil proof-of-concept en Python.
 Implémentation de méthodes et outils pour le calcul de données physiques métiers télécom (géométrie orbital, bilans de liaisons, interférences, puissances, etc.).
 Implémentation dans les outils existants TAS de méthodes de visualisation permettant d’analyser les résultats des algorithmes ou de présenter les résultats à une audience externe.
 VOTRE PROFIL 
 Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou titulaire d’un Bac +5, avec une spécialisation en Science des données, Recherche opérationnelle et Optimisation combinatoire. 
 Vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d’expérience en Data Science, Recherche opérationnelle et Optimisation, idéalement en collaboration avec des équipes techniques et opérationnelles. 
 Vous maîtrisez les statistiques, le Machine Learning (ML), le Deep Learning (DL) ainsi que le développement et le déploiement de modèles et d’applications de Data Science en environnement de production. 
 Vous possédez de solides compétences en Python, programmation orientée objet, analyse et visualisation de données (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Plotly), ainsi qu’en pratiques DevOps (Git, CI/CD, SecOps, Docker). 
 Vous êtes capable d'analyser les besoins utilisateurs et de concevoir des solutions adaptées. Une expérience dans le secteur spatial ou industriel et une connaissance des méthodes d’IA de confiance (explicabilité, robustesse) constituent des atouts. 
 Vous êtes proactif(ve), autonome et adaptable, doté(e) d'un bon esprit d'analyse et d'un excellent relationnel. Vous maîtrisez couramment le français et l'anglais, y compris le vocabulaire technique lié à la Data Science.

items.desc:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands 
 Job Title: AI Platform Engineer 
 Location: Hengelo – Hybrid
 Languages: Dutch & English 
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Role Overview 
 Are you a DevOps or Platform Engineer looking to transition into the world of Generative AI , within one of the most secure software environments in the Netherlands? At Thales Nederland in Hengelo, we are building cutting-edge AI ecosystems that operate in fully air-gapped infrastructures . As an AI Platform Engineer , you will be the linchpin ensuring that our software engineers and systems can securely leverage local language models , advanced multi-agent networks , and context-based information retrieval systems . Since we cannot rely on public cloud APIs, we design, host, and manage everything on-premise on our own high-performance GPU clusters .
 Key Responsibilities 
 AI Container Application Management: You will be responsible for deploying, updating, and maintaining critical AI tools and developer tools within on-premise container orchestration platforms. Your focus will be on ensuring optimal performance, resource allocation, and high availability for development teams.
 Air-Gapped RAG & Codebase Infrastructure: You will build and maintain the on-premise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) infrastructure. This ensures that applications can securely and rapidly retrieve context from internal codebases via local data pipelines, text segmentation (chunking), and vector indexing.
 On-Premise Model Routing & Lifecycle: You will set up tooling for local model serving and help develop a flexible routing layer. This enables applications within the closed network to dynamically switch between different local models based on the complexity of the task.
 Agent Orchestration & Tooling: You will support the setup of local frameworks for multi-agent systems (e.g., specialized code, architecture, and debugging agents). You will also assist in integrating local memory systems and interfaces that allow agents to call external tools.
 Air-Gapped Observability: You will implement monitoring and tracing dashboards that operate entirely within the local network. These will track token usage, processing time (latency), and infrastructure costs per team or user— without any data leakage .
 Strict AI Safety & Security Rails: In collaboration with our security experts, you will implement robust guardrails and security infrastructures to prevent malicious inputs (e.g., prompt injections) and ensure agents adhere strictly to data compartmentalization and authorization levels.
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 On-Premise & DevOps Experience: Strong experience with Linux environments, containerization, and container orchestration in an on-premise data center setting.
 Software Engineering: Strong programming skills in Python (experience with other system languages or scripting is a plus) and experience building and integrating local APIs.
 GenAI Interest & Conceptual Knowledge: You understand the theory behind vector indexing, embeddings, and the functioning of large language models (LLMs) . Ideally, you have experimented with open-source tools on a hobby or project basis.
 Languages: Excellent proficiency in English , both written and spoken. Dutch is preferred. 
 Security Clearance: Since you will be working on defense-related projects, passing a national security screening (Verklaring van Geen Bezwaar) is mandatory.
 What Thales Offers 
 A unique opportunity to pioneer state-of-the-art Generative AI technology in a high-security enterprise environment .
 A flexible hybrid work model with a healthy balance between remote work and collaboration at the High Tech Systems Park in Hengelo .
 Excellent employment conditions under the CAO Metalelektro , including a highly competitive salary and 40 vacation days per year (27 standard vacation days + 13 ADV days).
 Space and budget to further develop yourself into an expert in AI infrastructure .
 #LI-NB1

About the Role

Help customers put AI to work. Our technical customer-facing teams connect business goals with practical solutions, helping organizations evaluate, build, deploy, and adopt OpenAI technology.

We welcome technical pre-sales and post-sales professionals, whatever your current title or team. If your work combines technical expertise with helping customers evaluate, implement, or adopt technology, we would like to hear from you. You do not need to decide which role is the right fit before applying.



In this role, you will:

Depending on the opportunity and your strengths, your work may include:

 - Work with customers to understand their goals, identify useful AI applications, and define measurable outcomes.

 - Design technical approaches across architecture, integrations, data, security, governance, and evaluation.

 - Build demonstrations, prototypes, or production solutions, and helping customers navigate technical trade-offs.

 - Support deployment and adoption through technical guidance, workshops, enablement, and delivery coordination.

 - Partner with Sales, Product, Research, Engineering, and other customer-facing teams to resolve challenges and turn customer feedback into better products and practices.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have helped customers evaluate, implement, or adopt complex technology and can connect technical work to business outcomes.

 - Bring a strong technical foundation in areas such as software, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, or AI systems.

 - Can explain technical concepts clearly, build trust with different audiences, and work through ambiguous problems.

 - Learn quickly, collaborate across disciplines, and care about the safe and effective use of AI.



We value different kinds of technical depth. Engineering-focused opportunities may call for substantial hands-on coding, integration, debugging, and production delivery. Other opportunities emphasize architecture, technical strategy, customer enablement, or delivery leadership. You do not need to cover every area listed here.



How the Talent Pool Works

Tell us about your technical strengths, customer-facing work, and the kinds of problems you enjoy solving. Our recruiting team reviews this pool to identify potential matches across relevant teams and may contact you to explore a suitable opportunity. This is a general expression of interest rather than a specific vacancy, and we may not be able to respond to every application.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for industrial placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates. 
 Our Industrial Placement Programme 
 Our Industrial Placement Programme offers you the chance to spend a year with us, working on meaningful projects alongside industry leaders, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. You’ll receive a salary of £26,228, with coaching and support from a dedicated team to help you achieve both your placement objectives and personal development goals. 
 Successful completion of an Industrial Placement with Leonardo may also lead to an offer on our Graduate Development Programme. 
 During your placement, we encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience. 
 As an Industrial Placement Supportability Engineer, you will: 
 Be involved in all aspects of design and development; from initial product design through to in-service support.
 Assist with the analysis, preparation and delivery of Supportability Engineering activities, with a particular focus on analysis, across a variety of projects within Leonardo. You will help ensure that reliability and maintainability considerations influence product concepts and designs so that required performance and availability targets are met, while contributing to a culture of best-practice sharing and turning requirements into supportable solutions.
 As a Industrial Placement Supportability Engineer, you will work on real engineering problems. You will have the opportunity to be involved in supporting a wide range of tasks across multiple projects/products, which covers Sea, Land, Air and space domains.
 You will join a dynamic and innovative team who will provide day-to-day guidance and on-the-job training, introducing you to Supportability engineering processes, methods, technology and tools. You will also receive targeted training, developing the engineering skills and necessary domain knowledge required to achieve technical excellence and be a successful Supportability Engineer.
 What you will bring: 
 All of our Industrial Placement roles require a minimum of a predicted 2:2 grade in a relevant degree discipline. For technical roles please note that our preferred degree disciplines include Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or other STEM subject degrees.
 In addition to this, we would be interested in hearing from you if you have experience in:
 Coding/programming.
 Relevant project work and/or placements in industry.
 Solving problems as part of a team.
 Applying your science and technology knowledge to solve a real world problem.
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 
 Why join us 
 At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.
 Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year. 
 Secure your future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with …

items.desc:
As a Mechanical Engineer for Vacuum you will join the team working on the vacuum systems for a future accelerator at CERN (FCC-ee) and contribute to the selection, characterisation and validation of materials and processes for ultra-high vacuum components. In this role, you will be involved in defining samples and prototypes, their production and procurement, as well as their testing and validation.
 Your responsibilities 
 Actively participate in the development of the FCC-ee vacuum systems, particularly in materials and process selection, characterisation and validation, as well as prototyping.
 Contribute to the internalisation and in-house development of key manufacturing technologies for large component production.
 Collaborate with a dynamic team dedicated to the FCC-ee study.
 Communicate regularly with CERN-wide services and external companies or institutes.
 Your profile 
 Experience with metallic, in particular copper alloys, and ceramic materials for UHV applications.
 Experience with metallic and ceramic additive manufacturing processes, including plasma spray, cold gas dynamic spray and 3D SLM printing.
 Experience with metals hot and cold work processing and welding technologies. Experience with Laser and/or Friction Stir Welding is an advantage.
 Skills 
 Fabrication of mechanical parts with CNC machine, in particular with CAM software.
 Production of samples for materials characterisation including microscopic observations.
 Prior knowledge or use of WorkNC is an advantage.
 Design of mechanical parts with CAD program. Use of CATIA is an advantage.
 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 You have a professional background in Mechanical/Materials & Process Engineering (or a related field) and have either: a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
 or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

items.desc:
Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 A propos de vos missions 
 Au sein de l’équipe Chip Package Interaction de Grenoble, dans un environnement très compétitif où la reduction des coûts est un enjeu majeur, vous serez amené à participer au projet de réduction des chemins de découpes pour le package WLCSP. Votre rôle consistera à trouver des solution de découpe chez nos sous-traitants pour répondre aux demande de nos clients internes.
 Basé en Asie, vous piloterez le développement des méthodes de découpe, assurant un lien fort entre ST et les partenaires industriels pour une durée de 24 mois
 A propos de vos missions 
 Vous intégrez l’équipe technique locale de package R&D
 Vous suivez et coordonnez les activités de développement de découpe des boitiers WLCSP
 Vous supportez les essais de développement chez nos sous-traitants
 Vous êtes l’interlocuteur clé entre ST et les sous-traitants pour garantir la qualité et la performance des processus
 A propos de vous 
 Diplômé(e) Bac +5 en Physique des matériaux ou domaine équivalent. Des connaissances en semi-conducteurs serait un plus.
 Adaptabilité, autonomie, flexibilité et goût pour les challenges dans un environnement multiculturel
 Maîtrise courante de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral
 Bon relationnel et capacité à s’intégrer rapidement dans une équipe internationale
 ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche d’amélioration continue, se démarquant notamment par son engagement en matière d’éthique et d’intégrité, de sens et de valeurs, d’organisation et de gestion du changement, ainsi que par sa stratégie commerciale et ses performances. En France, ST a également obtenu la labélisation Happy Trainee 2025. 
 Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous évoluons.
 Nous nous engageons à l’équité dans le développement des carrières, les opportunités professionnelles et la rémunération.
 Chez ST, nous encourageons les candidats qui ne remplissent pas forcément tous les critères à postuler, car nous croyons en la richesse des parcours variés et offrons de réelles opportunités d’apprentissage et d’évolution. La diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sont des valeurs fondamentales qui façonnent notre culture d’entreprise.
 Pour découvrir toutes nos opportunités, rendez-vous sur st.com/careers.

Overview 
 As a Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our Datacenters up and running. This could be anything from coordinating with supplier/vendors, recognizing safe versus unsafe work environment, having a hands-on understanding of how critical environment equipment works, performing various types of maintenance, responding to onsite incidents while coordinating with other critical facilities professionals, and using telemetry and other platforms to monitor equipment performance and operations.
 This role works on a 13 week shift patterns, including both 8 and 12 hours shifts. You will receive appropriate allowances for this.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
 Responsibilities 
 Serve as an operations specialist in one major area of CE operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators) and works on advanced tasks independently.
 Inspect and supervise critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions and escalate per applicable policies and standards. 
 Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work.
 Safely and quickly respond to and lead onsite incident response teams for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs, without supervision.
 Enhance, develop new or follow preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to CE operations and incidents.
 Under minimal oversight, perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for one or more types of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems), correct procedures.
 Have a hands-on understanding of how equipment works and how to troubleshoot equipment, systems, subsystems, and components independently within their trained discipline.
 Provides consultation to lower-level colleagues in troubleshooting systems and problems. 
 Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], environmental health and safety (EH&S), toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable within Microsoft requirements.
 Embody our culture and values

 High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND 1+ year(s) mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)
 OR equivalent experience.
 Ability to work shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends, and/or holidays

items.desc:
Entdecke, was du bei der KUKA Group bewegen kannst. 
 Die KUKA Group bietet ein enormes Spektrum an Möglichkeiten, um deine Karriere voranzutreiben, deiner Leidenschaft zu folgen und dein Potenzial zu entfalten. Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Automatisierungsspezialisten und bieten globale Möglichkeiten in Bereichen wie Robotik, Automatisierung, Logistik, Softwarelösungen und Elektronik. Wenn du ein Macher bist, ein Visionär mit kühnen Ambitionen und dir Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Respekt wichtig sind, dann bist du hier bei KUKA Group auf Erfolgskurs.
 Hier bewirkst du etwas 
 Als Applikationsingenieur programmieren Sie Roboteranwendungen vor Ort beim Kunden in den verschiedensten Branchen und Einsatzbereichen.
 Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören auch Inbetriebnahmen, Konfigurationen, Störungsbehebung und Anlaufbegleitung von Robotersystemen. Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt ist die Optimierung von Robotersystemen die sich bereits im Produktionsbetrieb befinden.
 Ihre Einsätze finden vorzugsweise in den Bundesländern NRW, Hessen, Rheinland-Pfalz und Saarland statt. In einigen Projekten unterstützen wir aber auch unsere Auslandsniederlassungen oder begleiten die Wiederinbetriebnahme eines Kundenprojektes, das ins Ausland geliefert wird.
 Im Rahmen eines Projektes sind Sie in Projektgesprächen und in Entscheidungen mit eingebunden. Für besondere Einsatzfälle passen Sie Kuka Standardsoftwarepakete auf Kundenbedürfnisse an. Nach erfolgter Umsetzung führen Sie Einweisungen des Kundenpersonals durch und begleiten die Abnahme. Nach dem Projektabschluss ist eine Dokumentation der Roboterapplikation nach Bedarf für den Kunden zu erstellen.
 Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt ist den Kunden im Rahmen unseres neuen Dienstleistungsportfolio „SafetyServices“ bei der Beratung und bei der Ausführung im Umgang mit der Robotersicherheit zu unterstützen.
 Nach Ihrer Einarbeitung unterstützen Sie in der Planungsphase bei der Klärung der technischen Anforderungen und arbeiten bei der Erstellung technischer Angebotsvorlagen mit. Des Weiteren beinhaltet ihr Aufgabengebiet Kundengespräche im Hause oder vor Ort. Bei komplexeren Anfragen validieren Sie die technische Machbarkeit im Laborumfeld und präsentieren gegenüber Vertrieb/Kunde Ihre Lösungsansätze. Innerhalb des Unternehmens arbeiten Sie eng mit Vertrieb, der Simulationsabteilung und anderen Abteilungen/Niederlassungen des Customer Service zusammen.
 Die Einsatzstandorte fährst Du mit Deinem Dienstwagen an, der Dir auch zur privaten Nutzung zur Verfügung steht 
 Das bringst du mit 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium zum Bachelor/Master/Ingenieur oder Techniker der Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatronik, Maschinenbau oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse. Berufseinsteiger werden ebenso berücksichtigt.
 Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung für Programmierung von Industrierobotern und SPS Programmiererfahrung in Hochsprachen z.B. C# oder Java
 Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office, Windows, Computernetzwerke
 Erfahrung im Bereich Robotik und Anlagenbau von Vorteil
 Teamfähigkeit und Interesse an anderen Kulturen
 Selbstständiger, projektorientierter und strukturierter Arbeitsstil
 Mobilität, Flexibilität und Einsatzbereitschaft für unsere Kunden. Die Einsätze finden in der Regel bei unseren Kunden vor Ort statt.
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
 Ein Führerschein der Klasse B (alt Kl.3)
 Unser Versprechen an dich 
 Unsere Kultur ist tief in unserer Leidenschaft, Robotik und Automatisierungslösungen für jeden zugänglich und einfach nutzbar zu machen, verwurzelt. Das Ergebnis? Wir machen das Leben der Menschen einfacher und sicherer, überall auf der Welt. Vielfalt ist das Herzstück unseres Unternehmens – und wir schätzen jeden einzelnen unserer klugen und kreativen Köpfe. Wir ermutigen jeden, sich bei der Arbeit voll und ganz einzubringen, und fördern so ein Umfeld, in dem Inspiration, Fachwissen und persönliches Wachstum gedeihen können. Unser gemeinsames Ziel? Wir wollen Großes erreichen und innovative, positive Veränderungen anstoßen - nicht nur innerhalb der Automatisierungsbranche, sondern auch über deren Grenzen hinaus. Im Gegenzug legen wir großen Wert darauf, eine unterstützende, fördernden und fürsorgliche Umgebung für alle zu schaffen.
 Vorteile und Leistungen 
 Als Teil unseres Engagements für das Wohlergehen unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten wir eine Reihe umfassender Vorteile und Leistungen. Von wettbewerbsfähigen Gehaltspaketen über flexible Arbeitszeiten bis hin zu beruflichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten - wir wollen einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz für die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten. Es ist uns wichtig, die harte Arbeit und das Engagement unserer Mitarbeitenden anzuerkennen und zu würdigen, und unsere Zusatzleistungen spiegeln dies wider. Unser Ziel ist es, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem sich unsere Mitarbeitenden wertgeschätzt, motiviert und inspiriert fühlen, ihr Bestes zu geben. items.desc:
¿Quiénes somos? 
 Telefónica Servicios Audiovisuales (TSA) es la compañía del Grupo Telefónica creadora de soluciones audiovisuales broadcast desde 1993. 
 Con sede central en España y oficina en Latinoamérica, TSA destaca por su carácter internacional ofreciendo servicios y soluciones broadcast y multimedia en cualquier parte del mundo. Ofrecemos soluciones de consultoría, diseño e integración de proyectos audiovisuales broadcast end-to-end, soluciones integrales para la producción de televisión, proyectos de innovación como los basados en IA y servicios de plataformas de video DTH, IPTV, OTT, emisión de canales, etc. Nuestros proyectos y servicios se complementan además con formación, coaching y soporte con diferentes niveles de servicio. 
 También gestionamos el mayor telepuerto totalmente privado de España, mediante el cual se distribuyen más de 700 canales de televisión y radio, además de ofrecer accesos a Internet, Starlink, LAN, Voz IP y datos. 
 Nuestra experiencia se ha forjado a lo largo de los años a través del diseño, ejecución y soporte de numerosos proyectos y servicios, tanto propios como de nuestros clientes. 
 Creemos en la orientación al cliente, la innovación y la flexibilidad, y nuestro compromiso es promover soluciones tecnológicas para nuestros clientes, que se ajusten a las necesidades cambiantes de un mundo audiovisual en constante evolución. 
 ¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones? 
 Entre tus principales funciones destacan: 
 Coordinación con otras empresas para instalación de los distintos sistemas broadcast audiovisuales, así como prescripción de requerimientos relativos a canalización y reparto de corriente en instalaciones de este tipo. 
 Organización de grupos de trabajo multidisciplinares y gestión de múltiples tareas simultáneas para la consecución de proyectos tanto dedicados como multicliente. 
 Orientación al cliente en cuanto a la recogida de sus especificaciones, priorización de sus necesidades, y presentación de los avances y resultados asociados a la implementación de proyectos. 
 Realización de esquemas de infraestructuras de red y esquemas funcionales de soluciones informáticas, manuales de usuario, y guías de utilización de aplicaciones informáticas. 
 ¿Qué necesitamos de ti? 
 Formación: 
 Se valorará titulación o formación en Ingeniería Técnico, o Grado en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación, o experiencia equivalente demostrable en los conocimientos técnicos descritos en esta convocatoria, superior a 3 años, en Sistemas Digitales y Redes o en el sector Broadcast. 
 Idiomas: 
 Valorable inglés nivel alto hablado y escrito. 
 Experiencia: 
 Se valorará experiencia en: 
 Diseño, configuración, administración y puesta en marcha de Sistemas de Producción basados en plataformas IT. 
 Configuración y puesta en servicio de las distintas áreas de un entorno de producción y/o transmisión en entornos Broadcast. 
 Realización de proyectos y consecución de hitos, con gran capacidad de autogestión y control de tiempos. 
 Capacidad de análisis para la anticipación de problemas y autonomía y decisión para la valoración de alternativas y soluciones. 
 Manejo de herramientas técnicas aplicadas a la gestión de proyectos (Microsoft Project) y a la digitalización de planos y esquemas técnicos (AutoCAD/Visio otros). Manejo de herramientas ofimáticas habituales de Office e internet. 
 Conocimientos Técnicos: 
 Valorables conocimientos: 
 Conocimiento y experiencia en Sistemas Operativos Windows y Linux a nivel de administración, y del entorno de todo tipo de aplicaciones cliente/servidor TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, FTP, SNMP, DHCP, TELNET, SSH, NTP. 
 Conocimiento o experiencia en software de entornos virtualizados, Vmware, Hyper-V, entre otros. 
 Dominio de las tecnologías específicas de los sistemas de almacenamiento, NAS, SAN, librerías de cintas, así como conocer Sistemas de Archivo, y las diversas aplicaciones MAM y HSM específicas para su gestión. 
 Conocimiento en las tecnologías de AV sobre infraestructura IP//SMPTE 2110, SMPTE 2022, AES67. 
 Experiencia en la configuración y puesta en servicio de las distintas áreas de un entorno de producción y/o transmisión en entornos Broadcast, tales como: 
 Platós de televisión (virtuales o no) y controles de realización. 
 Entornos de producción no lineal, redacciones digitales, Salas de edición no lineal, Sistemas de postproducción de Audio, valorándose especialmente haber implementado sistemas de producción Digitales tipo AVID, DALET, HIVE, STRATUS. 
 Servidores de vídeo, sistemas de almacenamiento y automatizaciones de Continuidad. 
 Sistemas de transmisión a través de fibra óptica y de radioenlaces punto a punto. 
 Conocimiento sistemas de orquestación de estudios, como VSM-Lawo, entre otros. 
 Conocimiento y experiencia de equipamiento audiovisual: matrices, electrónica de conmutación y distribución, videoconferencias, videowalls, pantallas de LED, cabecera IPTV, videomarcadores, proyectores, sistemas de megafonía y amplificación. 
 Otros:

 Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung sowie Kfz-technische Kenntnisse. 
 Mehrjährige Verkaufserfahrung in der Automobilbranche und Zertifizierung als Automobilverkäufer:in. 
 Verhandlungsgeschick, -sicherheit und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit. 
 Kundenorientiertes Denken und Handeln. 
 Durchsetzungsvermögen und Überzeugungskraft. 
 Führerschein-Klasse B bzw. III. 
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

 Herausfordernde Projekte, mit denen wir gemeinsam die Mobilität von morgen gestalten. 
 Vielfältige persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungschancen. 
 Attraktive, faire und leistungsgerechte Vergütung. 
 Hohe Arbeitsplatzsicherheit. 
 Jährliche Sonderzahlungen wie Urlaubsgeld, Weihnachtsgeld und Erfolgsbeteiligung. 
 Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung inkl. sechs Wochen Jahresurlaub und Überstundenausgleich. 
 Vergünstigte BMW & MINI Konditionen.

 • Aider à la préparation de présentations et à la coordination / au support des réunions de mise à jour technique. 
 • Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes des projets et développer un réseau solide au sein des équipes.

 Vous faites preuve d’un esprit analytique et d’une bonne capacité de résolution de problèmes

 High School graduate or equivalent

Scientific Software Engineer (Weather Warning Verification) 
 chevron_left 
 Übersicht 
 Scientific Software Engineer (Weather Warning Verification)
 80%-100%, Locarno, fixed-term 
 print 
 Drucken 
 The Center for Climate Systems Modeling (C2SM) at ETH Zurich and the Federal Office of Meteorology and Climatology (MeteoSwiss) are collaborating to extend and strengthen MeteoSwiss’s operational warning verification activities. Weather warnings are among the most important services a national meteorological service provides. They help authorities, emergency services and the public prepare for heavy rain, strong winds, thunderstorms, snow, heat and other hazardous weather. To keep improving these warnings and to transparently show how well they perform, we need systematic, objective and reliable verification.
 Project background
 The project builds on a Python-based verification system that evaluates issued weather warnings and automated warning proposals against observations, such as gridded products and station measurements. A first set of rain warning verification products is currently being made operational with further weather hazard products to follow.
 Job description
 We are looking for a Scientific Software Engineer to join the Warning & Impact solution team within the Development of Forecasting division of MeteoSwiss for a three-year project on warning verification. Working closely with scientists, developers, forecasters and other users, you will further develop existing verification methods and turn them into robust, maintainable operational code.
 Initially, your tasks will be to:
 Improve and extend the operational rain warning verification products
 Further develop and operationalize the wind warning verification pipeline, extending the existing station-based approach to a grid-based one
 Later, depending on the team's priorities and progress, your work will include tasks such as:
 Integrating an existing nowcasting warning verification tool into our operational system, harmonizing approaches and consolidating code where reasonable
 Developing snow and heat warning verification pipelines and, if their quality is sufficient, implementing them operationally
 The position is limited to three years.
 Profile
 We welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds who meet most (not necessarily all) of the following criteria:
 MSc or PhD in computer science, data science, natural sciences (e.g. physics, atmospheric or environmental sciences), or a related field
 Experience in scientific and operational software development (e.g. automated testing, version control, CI/CD) and a keen interest in writing maintainable, well-documented code
 Strong Python skills, ideally with experience in handling station and gridded meteorological data, and familiarity with domain-specific formats and frameworks (e.g. Polars, Xarray, earthkit, GRIB, netCDF)
 Solid understanding of meteorology, preferably with a focus on high-impact weather and weather warnings
 Familiarity with forecast verification methods and statistical evaluation
 Willingness to contribute across the full workflow, from turning scientific methods into operational products to maintaining them
 A collaborative mindset, with the ability to take ownership of tasks and communicate effectively within a team
 Enjoyment of working closely with forecasters and other users and translating their needs into useful products
 Workplace
 Workplace
 We offer
 The opportunity to shape how MeteoSwiss evaluates and improves its weather warnings, a core public service that helps protect people and infrastructure
 The chance to turn approaches for verifying weather warnings into robust operational products used across MeteoSwiss
 Access to a modern scientific software stack, powerful on-prem and cloud computing platforms and AI-powered tools
 Close collaboration with forecasters and other users, whose feedback directly shapes the products you build
 A supportive and interdisciplinary team at Switzerland's national weather service
 Flexible working arrangements with the possibility of partial home office, and the choice between two main workplace locations: Locarno-Monti or Zurich Airport

 In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 650 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 450 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 200 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 700 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak Ťa zaujíma svet bankovníctva, si komunikatívny/komunikatívna a máš prax v práci s hotovosťou, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku vo VÚB!
 Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
 Okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Vítame u nás skúsených bankárov, ale ak ešte bankovú prax nemáš, nevadí. U nás vo VÚB Ťa na to pripravíme celkom od začiatku.
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
 postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
 naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO PORADCU KLIENTA BUDE:
 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,
 hľadať príležitosti pre predaj všetkých bankových produktov a služieb,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom,
 vykonávať pokladničné a zmenárenské operácie,
 vykonávať servisné klientske operácie, zodpovedne pracovať s hotovosťou,
 podieľať sa na administratívnych činnostiach,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.

 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.

 Overview 
 Entrerai in Prestitalia, società del Gruppo Intesa Sanpaolo, in una rete agenziale strutturata dove opererai in ambito commerciale a diretto contatto con i clienti. Ti occuperai di proporre soluzioni di credito personalizzate, supportato inizialmente da un Coach e, successivamente, da un Team Leader. Lavorerai in autonomia ma all’interno di un’organizzazione solida, con strumenti, formazione continua e un chiaro percorso di crescita professionale. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Gestire il collocamento fuori sede di prodotti di credito (prestiti personali, cessione del quinto per dipendenti pubblici/privati e pensionati, delegazione di pagamento (prestito delega) e soluzioni di acquiring (POS), con un approccio innovativo e digitale 
 Partecipare alla definizione e realizzazione di iniziative di comunicazione e promozione dei prodotti 
 Acquisire nuovi clienti, sia privati sia business, attraverso proposte commerciali integrate con l’offerta del Gruppo Intesa Sanpaolo 
 Sviluppare attività di cross selling sui clienti della Banca, valorizzando le opportunità commerciali esistenti 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Sei all’inizio del tuo percorso professionale o desideri consolidare la tua esperienza in ambito commerciale? Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 approccio imprenditoriale, che svilupperemo insieme 
 pianificazione e organizzazione delle attività 
 orientamento al raggiungimento degli obiettivi e dei risultati 
 Costituiscono un plus: 
 titolo di studio in ambito economico (laurea o diploma quinquennale) o un’esperienza equivalente 
 breve esperienza in ambito commerciale 
 iscrizione agli elenchi OAM (Organismo Agenti e Mediatori) da meno di un anno 
 Chi siamo 
 Prestitalia è la società finanziaria del Gruppo Intesa Sanpaolo, attiva da oltre 25 anni nel mercato del credito al consumo e specializzata nei prestiti contro cessione del quinto dello stipendio e della pensione e nell'anticipo del Trattamento di Fine Servizio.

VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2 000 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 700 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 300 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1000 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Si ambiciózny/a? Máš v sebe ducha obchodníka? Rád/rada kominukuješ? Máš bankovú prax? Ak si odpovedal/a na všetky otázky áno, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku pre VÚB!
Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
Ako si šikovný/á, toľko si aj zarobíš.
A okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Na pozícii Osobný poradca/poradkyňa klienta bude Tvojou úlohou:
 starať sa o nadštandardných klientov,
 predávať všetky bankové produkty a služby z portfólia VÚB banky,
 aktívne (telefonicky i osobne) oslovovať súčasných a zároveň aj potenciálnych klientov banky zo segmentu nadštandardných klientov,
 vyhľadávať rôzne obchodné príležitosti.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás: 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.

 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.

 ste dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 si ochotný/á na sebe pracovať a rozvíjať sa.

 Overview 
 Entrerai nella struttura di Intesa Sanpaolo che si occupa delle soluzioni tecnologiche a supporto della sicurezza degli accessi del Gruppo. Ti potrai occupare di progettare e realizzare le soluzioni, supportare le attività operative del team, contribuire al monitoraggio dei servizi, all'analisi degli eventi, alla gestione degli incidenti. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con specialisti di sicurezza e team tecnologici, acquisendo competenze sulle principali tecnologie di mercato, in un ambiente altamente innovativo e sfidante. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Partecipare attivamente a progetti innovativi nel rispetto di requisiti, tempi e costi definiti, guidando parte delle attività con il supporto dei colleghi e la collaborazione di esperti di settore esterni 
 Assumere il ruolo di riferimento specialistico per le soluzioni di autenticazione, federazione delle identità e controllo degli accessi, indirizzando le scelte tecnologiche 
 Governare la gestione dei problemi e degli incidenti ad alta criticità, supportando le attività delle funzioni operative, di cybersecurity e dei fornitori tecnologici al fine di garantire la continuità dei servizi 
 Definire e supervisionare framework di monitoraggio, controllo e reporting, assicurando il presidio di disponibilità, performance, resilienza, compliance e sicurezza delle piattaforme di competenza 
 Fornire indirizzo e mentoring tecnico ai colleghi meno esperti, favorendo la crescita delle competenze specialistiche e la diffusione delle best practice all'interno della struttura 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Esperienza di 3-5 anni in ambito Cybersecurity 
 Esperienza su soluzioni Single Sign-On (SSO), Federation e Multi Factor Authentication (MFA), standard di settore (SAML, OAuth2, OpenID Connect) 
 Capacità di analizzare requisiti tecnico-funzionali e tradurli in soluzioni scalabili, resilienti e conformi agli standard di sicurezza 
 Esperienza nella gestione operativa di servizi critici, nel monitoraggio delle piattaforme e nel governo di incidenti 
 Rappresentano titolo preferenziale: 
 Laurea STEM 
 Interesse ed esperienza nell'applicazione di AI ai processi di Cybersecurity 
 Possesso di certificazioni professionali di ambito (CISSP,CISM,CCSP,Microsoft SC-100,AZ-500 o equivalenti) 
 Significative esperienze professionali o di studio in contesti internazionali.

 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 40.000 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo

 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo

 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati.
