items.desc:
Privredna banka Zagreb d.d. je društvo čija je vizija biti uzor i centar izvrsnosti u području financijskog poslovanja u Hrvatskoj. Temelj našeg uspješnog poslovanja su naši zaposlenici, koji aktivno sudjeluju u modernom razvoju banke i kreiranju stalnih promjena. PBZ, kao inovativna i suvremena banka i koja je usmjerena na interni razvoj, pruža okolinu u kojoj se možete razviti u smjeru u kojem želite. Univerzalni način kako ostvariti karijeru kod nas nije nepoznanica: učinkovitim radom, ostvarivanjem ciljeva, kontinuiranim razvojem kompetencija, odgovornim organizacijskim ponašanjem, prihvaćanjem različitosti, timskim doprinosom i osobnom proaktivnošću. Svi preduvjeti su tu, na Vama je samo da iskoristite. 
 IT Analitičar (m/ž) 
 (Zagreb) 
 Tražimo stručnjaka koji će preuzeti ulogu IT analitičara u financijskoj industriji. Radno mjesto obuhvaća analizu poslovnih zahtjeva, izradu tehničkih specifikacija i testiranje programskih rješenja. 
 Ključne odgovornosti: 
 Analiza poslovnih zahtjeva i izrada tehničkih specifikacija 
 Testiranje programskih rješenja na funkcionalnom nivou 
 Aktivna suradnja s razvojnim inženjerima i poslovnim korisnicima 
 Pružanje podrške voditeljima projekata i IT projektantima 
 Koordinacija IT aktivnosti koje uključuju zahvate u više IT sustava ili aplikacija 
 Upravljanje manjim projektnim cjelinama 
 Formalni uvjeti koje svi prijavljeni kandidati moraju zadovoljavati su: 
 Završen studij tehničkog usmjerenja (FER, FOI, FERIT, TVZ, PMF ili srodni fakulteti/ veleučilišta) 
 5 ili više godina radnog iskustva na poslovima sistem analize poslovnih zahtjeva i/ili IT sustava u financijskoj industriji 
 Uz iskustvo u području bankarskog poslovanja, navedeno radno mjesto zahtijeva: 
 Iskustvo u programiranju SQL i PL/SQL 
 Poznavanje arhitekture DWH (Data Warehouse) i BI (Business Intelligence) sustava 
 Razumijevanje procesa razvoja SW 
 Iskustvo u izradi funkcionalnih specifikacija, kontroli kvalitete i testiranju funkcionalnosti aplikativnih rješenja 
 Znanje i iskustvo u području regulatornog izvještavanja banaka 
 Što nudimo? 
 Mogućnost napretka u karijeri i profesionalno usavršavanje 
 dinamično i motivirajuće okruženje 
 izazovni projekti 
 stručni tečajevi, seminari, interni razvojni moduli 
 Ravnotežu poslovnog i privatnog života te brigu za zaposlenike 
 rad izvan poslovnog prostora 
 sistematski pregled u okviru police dodatnog zdravstvenog osiguranja 
 korporativni vrtić uz subvenciju 
 slobodan dan za rođendan 
 sportska udruga PBZ standard i MultiSport kartica 
 PBZ book club 
 Prigodne nagrade, dar djetetu, novčane nagrade 
 O karijeri u PBZ grupi više možete pročitati i na našim korporativnim stranicama . 
 Zainteresirane kandidate pozivamo da se prijave za otvorenu poziciju. 
 U Privrednoj banci Zagreb prepoznajemo vaš talent, pružamo vam vrhunske uvjete za profesionalni razvoj i želimo zajedno s vama stvarati nove vrijednosti. Ako ste ambiciozni i motivirani te želite napraviti izazovan iskorak u karijeri – javite nam se. Ljudi čine PBZ.

Bratislava, SK
 About the role 
 Data is one of Swiss Re’s most valuable assets - powering our business decisions, driving innovation, and enabling us to lead in the global re/insurance industry. Within our Group Data Services organisation, we are committed to building and sustaining strong data governance practices that ensure our data is trusted, compliant, and strategically leveraged. 
 We’re looking for a motivated junior professional who combines an interest in Data Governance with strong organisational and project coordination skills. In this role, you will help strengthen our Group Data Governance Framework while supporting and coordinating initiatives that drive its implementation across Swiss Re. Working with stakeholders across the organisation, you will contribute to improving governance practices, tracking progress, and turning plans into tangible outcomes. Your work will directly support Swiss Re’s ambition of becoming a truly data-driven organisation. 
 Your key responsibilities: 
 Data Governance Framework & Capabilities 
 Support the maintenance and improvement of Data Governance standards, guidance, processes and related materials 
 Contribute to initiatives covering data ownership, data quality, metadata and data issue management 
 Gather and analyse input from stakeholders, document requirements and help translate them into practical improvements. 
 Project Management & Delivery 
 Support the planning and coordination of Data Governance initiatives, including workplans, milestones, deliverables and follow-up actions 
 Coordinate activities across business units, group functions, and other stakeholders to achieve agreed outcomes 
 Monitor progress, manage dependencies and risks, and provide clear updates to stakeholders and governance bodies 
 Proactively address challenges and ensure effective follow-through on agreed actions 
 Stakeholder Engagement & Communication 
 Work closely with Data Governance representatives, and other stakeholders to support consistent implementation 
 Coordinate and facilitate working groups, workshops, and governance meetings, ensuring clear decisions and follow-up actions 
 Prepare concise presentations, management updates, and decision materials for senior stakeholders and governance bodies 
 Support communication, training, and change activities to strengthen governance practices 
 About the Team 
 You will join the Group Data Governance team within Swiss Re’s Group Data Services organisation. We shape and advance the enterprise-wide Data Governance Framework, working closely with business units and group functions to strengthen accountability, transparency, and trust in data. 
 Our work spans governance standards, operating models, data ownership, data quality, governance effectiveness, and strategic initiatives. We are a collaborative team combining strategic thinking with practical implementation. 
 About you 
 We are looking for someone who combines Data Governance knowledge with a structured, delivery-oriented mindset and enjoys turning ideas into results. 
 Practical experience in Data Governance, Data Management, or a closely related discipline, with an understanding of governance frameworks, processes, and responsibilities 
 Proven experience in projects or initiatives, including planning, coordination, stakeholder management, and delivery tracking 
 Organised, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities with a focus on outcomes 
 Clear, confident communicator who translates complex topics into structured, concise messages and presentations 
 Enjoys working with diverse stakeholders, facilitating discussions, and building effective relationships 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel 
 Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to advance Data Governance across Swiss Re 
 About Swiss Re 
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.
 ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future. 
 About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .
 The Opportunity 
 Are you an engineer who enjoys understanding how complex systems work and turning new technologies into real customer solutions? 
 As part of Analog Devices’ Early Career Program, you will join our Field Applications organization and develop toward a System Platform / technical specialist role. 
 You will work alongside experienced Field Applications Engineers (FAE), Account Managers, customers, and ADI business units to understand system-level challenges and identify how ADI technologies can solve them. The role combines deep technical development with significant customer exposure, helping you build expertise while learning how customers design their next-generation platforms. 
 The Early Career Program includes technical training, hands-on projects, job shadowing, mentoring and direct customer engagement. 
 What you will develop 
 Build deep technical expertise in selected system platforms and technologies 
 Understand customer architectures, requirements and technical challenges at system level 
 Translate customer needs into system-level solutions 
 Work closely with customers during evaluation, design and development 
 Collaborate with ADI product and business teams to connect customer requirements with technology roadmaps 
 Develop hands-on laboratory, measurement, debugging and prototyping skills 
 Present technical concepts and solutions to customer engineering teams 
 Share technical knowledge and best practices across the Field organization 
 Build strong customer relationships through regular on-site customer engagement and shadowing 
 Who we are looking for: 
 Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, Computer Engineering or a related discipline 
 0-2years of professional experience 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
 Good understanding of electronic systems and willingness to develop broad system-level knowledge 
 Hands-on mindset and interest in laboratory work, prototyping and debugging 
 Curiosity for emerging technologies, including areas such as industrial automation, connectivity, sensing, signal processing, embedded software and AI at the edge 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills 
 Customer-oriented mindset and enthusiasm for working directly with engineers 
 Ability to travel 25-40% of time 
 Driving license 
 Previous exposure to industrial applications is a plus 
 Where this can take you: 
 The goal of this track is to develop you into a customer-facing technical expert who can connect customer system challenges with ADI technologies and platforms. 
 For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process. 
 Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.

We make robots that autonomously construct buildings, starting with bricklaying.
There's a lot of vapourware in robotics, but we're deploying robots across multiple concurrent sites today - and generating revenue. Help us to build things that matter in the long run.
We're looking for experienced software engineers for many roles. You can help us solve problems like:
- Data sync and analytics queries across a fleet of robots (that can be offline for hours at a time)
- Modelling buildings in code and finding the right UI for operators to edit them
- Designing systems for robots to drive safely and fully autonomously around a building site
Check out the progress we've already made on Atrium, our operating system for robotics: https://www.monumental.co/atrium 
We're rapidly scaling up operations - we're already hiring operators in the UK too - and we need experienced engineers who can build the systems that manage all of that complexity. If you think that 'full-stack' could reasonably mean debugging firmware, mixing buckets of mortar _and_ writing React components, we are looking for you. Robotics experience not required!

items.desc:
Subimage (YC W25) | Founding Engineer | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE (5 days/week) | Full-time | $170K–$230K + 0.5%–1.0% equity | https://subimage.io 
Hihi, I'm Alex, co-founder and CEO. Subimage maps infrastructure the way an attacker does so security teams at scale-ups and enterprises can find and fix problems. We're built on Cartography ( https://cartography.dev ), the open source infra mapping tool we helped create at Lyft and donated to the CNCF. It runs at over 70 companies, including 7 in the Fortune 100.
We're a tiny seed-stage team and our customers are companies your parents have heard of. We have more demand than we can build for, which is why this post exists. This is a chance to get in on the ground floor of something big (or to find out quickly that it won't work; just being upfront about it).
Some of the problems you'd be working on:
- Vulnerability triage with real context: is the asset internet-facing, through which services, is the vulnerable function actually reachable in code, are there compensating controls, and what sensitive data does it reach once exploited, across how many hops.
- Proving that the security fixes our agent proposes won't break anything.
- A near-real-time, self-updating map of an environment so you can see an attack as it happens, plus "time travel" in the graph so you can replay it afterward.
- Teaching an agent to answer questions about a large graph quickly, with only the context it needs and without making mistakes.
- Determining who owns a given resource from messy signals like tags, actions, logs, and files.
Stack: Cartography for ingestion, Neo4j for the graph, Python/FastAPI backend, Svelte frontend with a homegrown WebGL graph renderer, an MCP server that exposes all of it to agents, Terraform for IaC.
Who we're looking for: 3+ years at high-growth companies, strong distributed systems and cloud experience, a real sense of ownership, first-principles thinking, and a willingness to implement gnarly business logic (elegantly, ideally) if it makes a jaded security engineer's life easier. Kubernetes and security knowledge are nice to have, not required. You're in the Bay Area and want to be in the office five days a week.
Process: technical screen, call with the founders, a paid day working with the team, then offer. Health/vision/dental, 401k match, gym, team lunches, unlimited PTO.
Apply here and mention HN: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/subimage/jobs/NCTFgKK-...

items.desc:
Sobre nosotros: 
 Today Mobility facilita la propiedad de vehículos proporcionando soluciones de movilidad para toda la industria automotriz. En esencia, transportamos los vehículos de nuestros clientes hacia y desde la inspección técnica, el cambio de neumáticos, el mantenimiento, la reparación, etc.
 Actualmente, Today Mobility ofrece servicios a través de algunos de los fabricantes de automóviles más grandes del mundo y a empresas con sus propias flotas de vehículos. Como resultado, los propietarios de automóviles disfrutan de una gran comodidad, las empresas mantienen su flota en excelente estado mientras ahorran tiempo y dinero, y los fabricantes de automóviles logran una distribución equilibrada en sus talleres, ofreciendo un servicio aún mejor a sus clientes.
 El ADN de Today Mobility: 
 Exigimos altos estándares de personalidad, espíritu de servicio y un fuerte sentido de responsabilidad en la gestión de proyectos.
 Today Mobility es una empresa amigable. Nos movemos con rapidez y hacemos lo necesario para ayudar a nuestros clientes, colegas y socios a tener un mejor día a día. Formamos equipos que actúan con un enfoque de "nosotros" en lugar de "yo", priorizando personas sin ego que valoran los resultados colectivos por encima de los individuales.
 Nuestro ADN impregna todo lo que hacemos, y nuestra identidad se demuestra con acciones más que con palabras. Por eso, nuestros socios nos eligen.
 ------------ 
 Conductor: 
Como conductor, es importante que te sientas cómodo interactuando con clientes.
En Today Mobility, nuestros clientes son grandes empresas y, en ocasiones, sus clientes finales.
El rol de conductor es dinámico y cada jornada laboral es diferente, por lo que es fundamental que disfrutes estar en movimiento y viajar.
Fecha de inicio: por confirmar, noviembre de ser posible.
Aplicaciones: Todas las tareas de conducción y turnos de trabajo se presentan en nuestra aplicación, que cuenta con integración con Google Maps, cámara y función de firma
 Criterios clave: 
✅Buen conocimiento local
✅Interés genuino por el servicio al cliente de primera calidad
✅Comprensión técnica de aplicaciones móviles
✅Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y actitud orientada a la solución
✅Nivel avanzado de español y inglés
✅Licencia de conducción categoría B (transmisión manual) y un historial de conducción sin incidentes durante al menos 1 año
 Estás cordialmente invitado a ponerte en contacto para obtener más información sobre el puesto. 
La solicitud debe enviarse en forma de CV y carta de presentación en la aplicación a continuación.

 Čvrsto verujemo da se najbolji rezultati ostvaruju zajedničkim radom i da potencijal svakog pojedinca dolazi do izražaja u okruženju koje podstiče razvoj, inicijativu, saradnju, ali i brigu o zaposlenima. Naš fokus je na stvaranju kvalitetnih i prilagođenih rešenja, kroz blizak i odgovoran odnos sa klijentima uz razumevanje njihovih svakodnevnih potreba i životnih ciljeva.
 Ako želiš da radiš u timu koji ceni profesionalnost, otvorenu komunikaciju, lični doprinos i vodi računa o tvojim potrebama – pozivamo te da nam se pridružiš.
 Šta ćete raditi
 Upravljanje i operativno organizovanje rada u ekspozituri
 Planiranje, nadzor i kontrola poslovnih procesa i rada zaposlenih
 Učestvovanje u planiranju rada i podrška u vođenju portfolija svih zaposlenih u ekspozituri
 Maksimiziranje produktivnosti rada ekspoziture
 Osiguravanje dugoročnog zadovoljstva klijenata Banke kroz visok kvalitet usluge
 Uspostavljanje odnosa sa novim klijentima
 Neposredno koordiniranje i angažovanje na kreditnim zahtevima, proveravanje i odobravanje zahteva koje pripremaju Specijalisti za rad sa fizičkim licima pre upućivanja Sektoru za upravljanje rizikom
 Nadzor nad sprovođenjem bezbednosne procedure i ispravne zaštite novca i druge imovine Banke
 Praćenje i vrednovanje poslovnog rezultata i performansi zaposlenih
 Ispunjenje godišnjeg budžeta ekspoziture
 Odgovornost za rad blagajne u ekspozituri
 Odgovornost za rezultate i izveštaje Interne revizije
 Šta će vam trebati da biste uspeli
 Formalno obrazovanje ekonomskog, finansijskog ili sličnog smera
 Najmanje tri godine iskustva rada na istim ili sličnim poslovima
 Interesovanje za rad sa preduzetnicima i malim privrednim društvima
 Dobro poznavanje rada na računaru, MS office paket
 Znanje engleskog jezika
 Prodajni pristup i veštine
 Izražene analitičke veštine
 Timski igrač
 Šta ćete dobiti zauzvrat
 Stabilno i podsticajno radno okruženje u kojem se neguju međusobno poverenje, saradnja i otvorena komunikacija
 Privatno zdravstveno osiguranje
 Balans između profesionalnih obaveza i privatnog života, uz dodatne slobodni dane za rođendan (1), najmilije (1), sebe (2) i za polazak deteta u prvi razred (1)
 Priliku za kontinuirano učenje i profesionalni razvoj kroz interne programe unapređenja, obuke, mentorstvo i razmenu znanja
 Jasno definisane procese rada i podršku tima na koji se možeš osloniti
 Mogućnost ličnog i karijernog napredovanja u skladu sa rezultatima, zalaganjem i interesovanjima
 Dinamičan posao koji omogućava svakodnevni kontakt sa klijentima i stvaranje dugoročnih odnosa
 Priliku da budeš deo Banke koja gradi dugoročne odnose sa klijentima i zaposlenima, zasnovane na kvalitetu, poštovanju i zajedničkom uspehu

 Ние, в УниКредит, сме отворени за смели и иновативни идеи и предлагаме продукти и решения, които дават възможност на хората да бъдат по-успешни и по-удовлетворени. Нашата цел е да бъдем банката за бъдещето на Европа и търсим хора, които имат желание да поемат с нас в тази посока. Ключово за отношенията и процесите, които градим, е те да са най-добър пример в прилагането на принципите за многообразие и равнопоставеност и в утвърждаването на приобщаваща среда за всички.
 Бизнесът ни създава инвестиции, ресурси и нови възможности, които стимулират развитието на нашите служители, като им предоставят уникално и динамично професионално преживяване. Ще се радваме да допълните екипа ни с вашите таланти и силни страни и да изградите кариера, в която ще бъдете възнаградени подобаващо за постиженията ви.
 Ние ще ти дадем възможност да
 ● Работиш с бизнес клиенти от собствен портфейл;
 ● Осъществяваш контакти с оглед тяхното задържане, консултиране и търсене на решения при казуси;
 ● Използваш пълната гама от банкови продукти за бизнес клиенти, предлагани от Банката, включително и в областта на кредитирането;
 ● Правиш предложения за повишаване на качеството на обслужване и ще съдействаш при възникнали запитвания, постъпващи от клиенти;
 ● Търсиш и привличаш нови клиенти в сегмента.
 В теб търсим
 ● Завършено висше икономическо или друго подходящо образование, магистърска степен или в ход на обучение;
 ● Познания по счетоводство и финанси, както и опит в сходна област ще се считат за предимство;
 ● Търговски умения, ориентираност към клиента;
 ● Предприемчивост, аналитичност, умения за работа в екип, инициативност.
 ● Компютърни умения - Microsoft Officе пакет;
 ● Ползване на английски език (счита се за предимство).
 При нас ще откриеш
 ● Коледен бонус;
 ● Стартово възнаграждение от минимум 1580 евро БРЗ;
 ● Бонуси за постигнати резултати;
 ● Ваучери за храна в размер на 102.26 евро;
 ● 25 дни отпуск;
 ● Платен почивен ден и подарък за рожден ден;
 ● Платен почивен ден за доброволчество;
 ● Програма „Препоръчай приятел“;
 ● Кредити при преференциални условия;
 ● Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
 ● MultiSport карти и обновени фитнес зали в централата ни;

 A s a Graduate within Group Payment Solutions , you will support the team in activities related to the development, governance and strategic evolution of the Group’s payment, cash management and clearing services. In this role, you will:

 Support the coordination of Group‑wide activities, collaborating with different countries and Group Functions to foster alignment and knowledge sharing. 
 Participate in the assessment of service levels provided by external suppliers, working closely with Operations and other stakeholders. 
 Contribute to business development activities, including identifying new opportunities and supporting cross‑selling initiatives.

 Relevant work/internship experience

 Fluency in English is a prerequisite

 A unique opportunity to gain hands‑on experience in a strategic area at the core of the Group’s transformation. 
 Exposure to cutting‑edge topics in payments, digital innovation and product development at Group level. 
 The chance to collaborate with senior professionals, international teams and multiple Group Functions. 
 A structured learning journey designed to accelerate your professional growth and build solid technical and soft skills.

Identify and develop use cases for AI workflows and genAI technology within the automotive industry. Collaborate with different stakeholders, engineers and domain experts to understand requirements and create effective AI solutions based. Analyze, interpret and audit results from genAI models & workflows to improve performance and user experience. Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in genAI, AI engineering and agentic techniques. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI technology in the automotive sector and have a knack for crafting effective prompts, this is the right job for you! Strong knowledge of genAI foundations, techniques, and best practices. Expertise in genAI frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex and agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI + OpenAI/Claude sdk. Proven experience in designing and implementing AI automation workflows and integrations in a business context. Proficiency in n8n or equivalent visual orchestration tools, such as Make (Integromat), Activepieces, or Pipedream. Familiarity with AI-specific orchestration platforms like Flowise or Langflow, or agentic frameworks (e.g., CrewAI) is a plus. Familiarity with text analysis, data chunking, embedding and information retrieval systems. Expertise in Multimodal unstructured data storage and explotation methods (vector, graph, document,...) is a plus. Knowledge of or experience with AWS framework. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think creatively about AI-based efficient and accurate solutions. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to understand requirements, propose solutions and explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computational Linguistics, or a related field. Master's degree in AI, Machine Learning, or Data Science is a plus. Languages: Fluent in Spanish and English. Additional Information Applus IDIADA is committed to equality, diversity and inclusion . We don’t put limits on you, so don’t put limits on yourself either. There is a place for everyone.

items.desc: Prêt(e) à façonner le paysage urbain de demain ? Rejoignez JCDecaux, N°1 mondial de la communication extérieure ! Imaginez avoir un impact quotidien sur la vie de plus de 850 millions de personnes à travers le monde. Chez JCDecaux, c'est notre réalité ! Depuis plus de 60 ans, nous réinventons les villes en concevant des solutions de communication innovantes et esthétiques, du mobilier urbain intelligent jusqu’aux écrans digitaux spectaculaires dans les aéroports. Présents dans plus de 80 pays avec une équipe de 13.000 talents (dont 300 passionnés en Belgique et au Luxembourg), nous sommes à l'aube d'une nouvelle ère urbaine : plus intelligente, connectée et durable. Portés par nos valeurs "Stronger Together" et une stratégie climat ambitieuse, nous recherchons des esprits brillants et engagés pour innover avec nous. Choisir JCDecaux, c'est intégrer une entreprise solide, leader sur son marché, où la bienveillance, la formation continue et la fidélisation (10 ans d'ancienneté moyenne !) sont des réalités. Description de fonction Analyser les mesures et traduire les résultats en actions concrètes et en axes d’amélioration. Modéliser les données lorsque cela est nécessaire et les préparer pour leur intégration dans nos outils, tels que notre système de planification et d’allocation. Construire, calibrer et documenter nos modèles d’audience OOH (fréquentation par panneau et par heure, couverture et répétition, scoring de segmentation des audiences) sur la base de données de mobilité, de capteurs et de panneaux. Relier ces données à d’autres sources disponibles dans nos outils, telles que la météo, le trafic, les points d’intérêt, etc. Analyser les jeux de données afin de définir et de contrôler les règles de qualité. Veiller à ce que les données restent fiables, faciles à maintenir et exploitables dans la durée. Documenter nos méthodologies afin de pouvoir les expliquer et les défendre auprès des agences, des annonceurs et des organismes de mesure. Croiser les données d’audience et mesurer l’impact des campagnes : comparaison entre les groupes exposés et les groupes témoins, études de progression (lift studies), mesure des visites en magasin, etc. Adopter une approche fondée sur la protection des données dès la conception (privacy by design), conformément au RGPD et aux seuils d’agrégation. À partir de données brutes, structurer et visualiser les informations sous forme de jeux de données et de graphiques facilement exploitables par l’ensemble des parties prenantes dans leur travail quotidien. Être responsable du positionnement optimal, de l’analyse des données, de la gestion de l’inventaire et de la compréhension technique des capteurs Wi-Fi, afin d’assurer la collecte de données la plus efficace possible. Collaborer avec les différents interlocuteurs internes et externes impliqués dans la collecte, l’analyse, la modélisation et l’utilisation des données. Description du profil Vous êtes titulaire d’un bachelier ou d’un master en data science, informatique, statistiques, géomatique, physique, économie ou dans un domaine équivalent, ou vous disposez d’une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Vous avez au moins deux ans d’expérience professionnelle en tant que data scientist. Une expérience dans le secteur de l’OOH ou des médias constitue un atout, mais n’est pas indispensable. Vous maîtrisez Python et SQL avancé, êtes à l’aise avec les entrepôts de données cloud tels que Snowflake ou BigQuery, les API et les pipelines de données, et utilisez Git. Vous maîtrisez les applications Microsoft Office ainsi que les outils de visualisation de données tels que Power BI. Vous êtes capable de prendre rapidement en main de nouveaux logiciels. Vous avez un réel intérêt pour les solutions d’intelligence artificielle appliquées aux données et êtes capable d’identifier les solutions permettant d’optimiser les processus et l’exploitation des données. Vous combinez de solides compétences analytiques avec précision et efficacité, ainsi qu’une réelle curiosité pour les nouvelles avancées dans les domaines de la data et de l’intelligence artificielle. Vous êtes organisé(e) et capable de naviguer efficacement entre différents outils et applications. Vous êtes avant tout motivé(e) par une forte envie d’apprendre et par l’ambition d’évoluer au sein de l’organisation JCDecaux BeLux. Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et le néerlandais, indispensables pour participer aux réunions, et vous avez une bonne connaissance de l’anglais, notamment pour préparer des présentations et communiquer avec les équipes internationales. Vous rapporterez directement au/à la Head of Data & Insights.

items.desc: Description : Contexte Saify est une startup, à la fois intégrateur IA et société de conseil en IA agentique appliquée à la finance, spécialisée dans l'intégration de solutions d'IA agentique au sein d'environnements financiers exigeants. Elle a été fondée par Jorian Rousselle et Philippe Lemaire. Le poste consiste à écrire le code qui fait tourner des agents IA en conditions réelles : dans un middle office, une trésorerie, chez un gérant de patrimoine. Il s'agit d'outils que des équipes ouvrent tous les matins, et non de POC qui dorment dans un dépôt. Saify recrute sur profil, et non sur un besoin de staffing du moment : les missions s'ajustent aux compétences du collaborateur et à la croissance de Saify. Elles évoluent avec les besoins des clients, les priorités internes et la croissance de l'activité. Au fil du parcours, le collaborateur passe par plusieurs projets et plusieurs clients (banque, finance, gestion de patrimoine, conseil financier) ainsi que par des projets internes. Il peut enchaîner plusieurs projets, ou en mener deux en parallèle, parfois au sein des équipes Saify, parfois intégré chez un client. Saify est une startup : équipe réduite, décisions rapides, impact immédiatement visible. Le collaborateur participe à construire l'organisation, avec la polyvalence, l'autonomie et la prise de responsabilité que cela suppose. Le fond des missions est presque toujours le même : déployer des agents IA métiers dans des directions opérationnelles, automatiser des traitements existants, faire parler des données financières. Les périmètres changent beaucoup : opérations de marché, middle et back office, trésorerie, flux bancaires et clientèle, déclaratifs réglementaires, appels de marge, analyse d'encours et de contreparties, automatisation de formulaires KYC. Ce que cela change côté client : l'information accessible en quelques secondes ; des données rationalisées et centralisées ; des nouveaux arrivants opérationnels plus vite ; un pilotage opérationnel plus net ; les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée qui disparaissent du quotidien. Objectif du poste Concevoir, développer et industrialiser des solutions d'IA agentique adaptées aux métiers financiers, sur des projets clients comme internes. Le collaborateur est garant de la qualité et de la robustesse de ce qui part en production. Le fil rouge : prototyper vite, fiabiliser, puis passer à l'échelle. Missions Concevoir et développer des agents IA métiers, des services backend et des API, dans les langages et les stacks adaptés à chaque contexte. Mettre en place des workflows agentiques, des pipelines RAG, des outils d'automatisation et des connecteurs de données. Brancher les solutions sur ce qui existe déjà : API, bases de données, fichiers, référentiels documentaires et systèmes métiers. Manipuler, nettoyer et structurer des données hétérogènes : fichiers Excel, XML, TXT, CSV et bases de données. Refondre des traitements qui vivent aujourd'hui dans Excel, VBA, Power Query, Power BI ou des scripts ponctuels. Pratiquer le développement assisté par IA au quotidien : générer, relire, tester et refactorer avec les assistants de code, et faire progresser les pratiques de l'équipe sur ce point. Mettre en place l'observabilité, les tests, l'évaluation et la documentation, puis industrialiser avec les exigences de sécurité, de traçabilité et de confidentialité propres à la finance. Contribuer au cadrage technique : estimer, découper, alerter tôt, et rendre compte au chef de projet et au client. Profil recherché Saify attend un développeur junior: une maîtrise solide de plusieurs langages et au moins une réalisation aboutie en IA générative. Le reste s'apprend en chemin : l'intérêt marqué compte autant que l'expérience. Les profils qui réussissent combinent quatre familles de compétences. Les trois premières sont attendues dès l'arrivée ; la quatrième (la finance) se construit avec Saify. Ingénierie logicielle : concevoir, coder, tester et livrer des solutions robustes, en maîtrisant plusieurs langages et plusieurs stacks, du backend aux données. IA générative : LLM, agents, RAG, orchestration, évaluation ; au moins une réalisation aboutie et une lecture lucide des limites et des risques des modèles. Développement assisté par IA : utiliser les assistants de code au quotidien pour aller plus vite sans baisser l'exigence ; relire, tester et rester responsable de ce qui est livré. Finance : comprendre des processus financiers, bancaires ou de marché, et parler d'égal à égal avec les équipes métier. Compétences techniques : Ingénierie logicielle : maîtrise de plusieurs langages et de leurs écosystèmes (Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, Go ou équivalents), API REST, architecture de services, tests, CI/CD, Git, conteneurs. Écosystème IA et données : LLM, agents IA, RAG, embeddings, orchestration d'agents, MCP, évaluation, Agno, Langfuse, LiteLLM, AWS Bedrock, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, bases vectorielles, SQL et NoSQL. items.desc: Smadex is a performance advertising engine for mobile apps, enabling the world's leading marketers to grow across Mobile and Connected TV (CTV). Powered by AI models trained on real campaign outcomes, Smadex delivers profitable growth at scale. Headquartered in Barcelona, with teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, Smadex is a business unit of Entravision (NYSE: EVC). About the role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Platform Experience team. This role will focus on building internal tools, integrations, workflows, and business solutions for teams across the company, such as HR, Marketing, Finance, Sales, and Operations. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic, end-to-end engineer who is comfortable working with greenfield ideas, understands how to translate business problems into simple technical solutions, and can decide when to build, integrate, automate, or leverage existing tools. This is not a traditional product engineering role focused on external customers. It is a high-impact internal role focused on improving company efficiency through well-scoped, maintainable solutions. What you will do Build internal tools, workflows, and lightweight applications for engineering and non-engineering teams. Design and implement integrations between internal systems and third-party platforms. Work directly with stakeholders to understand processes, pain points, and business needs. Translate ideas and suggestions into clear technical plans and pragmatic solutions. Evaluate build-vs-buy tradeoffs and recommend the simplest viable approach. Improve or automate manual processes involving spreadsheets, approvals, documents, CMSs, email flows, and internal operations. Deliver end-to-end solutions across frontend, backend, integrations, and data flows when needed. Help define lightweight intake, scoping, and ownership practices for internal requests. Ensure solutions are maintainable, secure, and appropriately documented. Partner with the broader engineering group to align on technical standards and shared capabilities. What we are looking for 1+ years of experience as a Software engineer. Strong full-stack skills and the ability to build end-to-end solutions with limited supervision. Experience working with APIs, integrations, and business workflows. Good judgment when deciding between custom development, SaaS, automation tooling, or simple manual solutions. Comfort working in ambiguous environments where requirements are not fully defined upfront. Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A pragmatic mindset: able to deliver useful solutions without overengineering. Ability to understand business processes and identify where technology can genuinely improve efficiency. Ownership mentality: able to move initiatives forward, identify blockers, and make progress without constant direction. Nice to have Experience building internal tools or operational platforms. Experience with CMS platforms, document workflows, or systems such as Adobe Sign, Google Workspace, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar tools. Familiarity with automation platforms or workflow tools. Experience with frontend frameworks such as Angular. Experience with Node.js, Python, SQL, and REST APIs. Experience evaluating low-code / no-code options when appropriate. Exposure to cloud environments and deploying internal services. What We Offer Join a highly motivated and talented team in a fun and friendly work environment. Opportunity to work in a complex environment and gain experience from it. Directly add value to the business with the projects that you are assigned. Great compensation package. Top location at the heart of Barcelona with a rooftop terrace, Barbeque, and a fully stocked fridge. Great work-life balance: work from home (2 days per week) and flexible hours. Professional development with a LinkedIn Learning subscription and other training opportunities. Meal vouchers - Ticket Restaurant monthly allowance. Monthly gym allowance: Choose between DiR and Wellhub Monthly TGIF (Thank God It’s Friday) events and regular team-building activities. Ping-pong table and arcade machine. And more! If you want to know more about us visit our website Smadex.com, and for a sneak peek of the cool stuff we build check this video out! And, if you are ready to take your career to the next level and tackle engineering challenges at a global scale, we encourage you to apply! Please note that we do NOT provide VISA sponsorship. Candidates without a legal permit to work in Spain won't be considered. NrbepSQ5ur

items.desc: Job Overview ENPULSION is looking for an Industrial Engineer (f/m/x) to join our Production Technology department. In this role you will be responsible for designing, optimizing, and scaling production processes to ensure efficient, safe, and cost-effective manufacturing operations. The role drives industrialization activities, capacity planning, facility and layout design, and continuous improvement initiatives while supporting the introduction of new products and process changes. Working closely with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and external partners, the Industrial Engineer develops data-driven solutions that enhance productivity, improve process stability, and support operational excellence. Your profile Key Responsibilities: Design and Manage Production Processes, designing safe and efficient production processes and managing capacity demand. Evaluate, specify, and select manufacturing equipment, machinery, tooling, and automation systems. Managing external and internal partners for production improvements. Facility and Layout Management, defining facility requirements and being responsible for the production layout. Project and Change Management, overseeing industrialization projects (new products, new versions) and handling change management. Implement Kaizen, 5S and continuous improvement initiatives. Managing master data in the ERP system, setting up a system for traceability, and data collection. Type of contract: Full time position with 38.5 hours/week Salary: The minimum base salary for this position starts at EUR 3,654.05 gross per month on a full-time basis (38.5 h/week), with a planned overpayment depending on your professional experience and qualifications. Your profile Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline. 3+ years of experience in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, or Operations Excellence roles. Knowledge of operational excellence tools (Lean Thinking, 5S, SMED, Value Stream Analysis). Strong hands-on experience with Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives. Experience managing industrialization, change management, or operational improvement projects. Experience in production process design, layout planning, and capacity management. Familiarity with manufacturing KPI analysis and operational performance monitoring. Experience in aerospace, electronics, high-tech manufacturing, or industrial production environments is an advantage Excellent English communication skills; German language skills are considered a strong advantage. Why us? Why us? At ENPULSION, you’ll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. We foster a friendly, open-minded work environment that encourages new ideas and rewards initiative. Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark. Our benefits include: 25 days of paid vacation Choice between a KlimaTicket (Metropol region), a parking space or cantina vouchers for on-site dining Role-dependent FlexTime Monthly team lunches and regular team-building events Learning & development budget to support your continued growth Firmenradl - Bike Leasing Program Office located at VIE Airport City with access to: FitFabrik Fitness Center Airport Health Center Shops, restaurants, and Crew Shop discounts VIE Community App for news and deals About us Meet ENPULSION - a Space Tech company based in Wien-Flughafen Austria. Founded in 2016, it has quickly become a dominant player in the Space Industry selling some of the most advanced propulsion solutions for SmallSats to a large number of worldwide satellite platform integrators. The unique, modular solution we offer brings high performance at low cost to satellite manufacturers, fostering the democratization of space and enabling the exploration and exploitation of the solar system, positioning ENPULSION at the very heart of the NewSpace Area. The teams behind this are full of talented hardworking people, plenty of whom may just be your new lunch buddy! ENPULSION strongly believes in equal opportunities for everyone. We're encouraging applicants with diverse backgrounds to apply. All applications are processed without regard to gender, nationality, race, colour, religion, age, disability status, sexual orientation or marital status.

items.desc: At RoboRana, we help organisations improve how work gets done through automation and AI. We’re looking for an Automation Engineer who can turn a process into a reliable solution and take it all the way into production. You bring experience across automation platforms and enjoy building solutions that colleagues can understand, maintain and extend. What you'll do Develop and test automations with Blue Prism, UiPath and Power Automate, drawing on your experience in at least two of these platforms. Work with analysts and business users to understand the process, clarify exceptions and translate requirements into a practical technical design. Build reusable components with clear error handling, logging and configuration, so solutions remain manageable as processes change. Prepare releases, deploy to production and make sure each automation has the documentation and operational handover it needs. Monitor running automations, investigate incidents and fix the underlying causes to improve reliability. Extend existing solutions and connect them to other systems through APIs or user interfaces, depending on the application and process. Review work with colleagues, share useful patterns and help improve our development practices. Explore how orchestration and AI capabilities can add value to the automations we build for clients. ‍ Who you are Hands-on project experience with at least two of these three platforms: Blue Prism, UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate, including Power Automate Desktop. Deep expertise in Blue Prism or UiPath, with the ability to develop, test, deploy and maintain automations independently. A sound understanding of queues, exception handling, credentials, scheduling and the day-to-day operation of automations. A structured approach to troubleshooting, testing and documentation, with attention to maintainability. Comfortable discussing requirements and technical choices with clients and colleagues. You communicate clearly in Dutch and English. Nice to have Experience with the third automation platform in our stack. Broader platform knowledge, such as UiPath Maestro, UiPath AIXP or Blue Prism WorkHQ. Experience with API integrations, source control or automated deployment, and relevant platform certifications. What we’ll offer Challenging projects across industries, always with impact. A strong & open team culture where learning, trying, and helping each other are essential. Continuous learning through certifications, training, and knowledge sharing. Early responsibility, paired with trust and support so you can truly make a difference. 32 holidays per year (20 + 12 ADV). A hybrid working environment with flexibility built in. A competitive package including salary, company car, the right tools and attractive benefits on top of that. Zero fluff and sharp focus, where your skills directly shape our solutions.

items.desc: What the role is about Do you enjoy figuring out how software works, testing how it performs and getting to the bottom of technical issues? Join our Broadcast team in Ghent and help prepare Philips TV software for operator certification. You’ll work with test and development teams to check software before it is sent to external certification labs. When an issue appears, you’ll help reproduce it, document what happened and work with developers to verify the fix. You’ll also use Python and our in-house Jarvis system to automate testing. This is an early-career opportunity. You don’t need to arrive with broadcast expertise: experienced colleagues will help you learn the TV and certification landscape as you grow into greater ownership. What you will do Review operator requirements and test specifications, and turn them into clear test cases. Prepare test environments and run certification and validation tests. Test software before it is submitted for certification. Use Python and our Jarvis system to automate test cases and repetitive tasks. Reproduce and analyse issues reported by operators or certification labs. Document bugs clearly, including relevant test conditions and supporting information, and share them with development teams. Follow up with developers as they investigate issues, then verify fixes and carry out regression tests. Work with certification colleagues, testers and developers across locations, and occasionally help clarify findings with external labs. Gradually take ownership of selected certification activities and contribute ideas to improve our tools and processes. What do you need to succeed? ✅Must have A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Applied Computer Science, Software Engineering, ICT, Computer Engineering, Industrial Engineering with a computer science focus, Electronics Engineering with a strong software interest, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent training or relevant experience is also welcome. Basic Python knowledge and an interest in using it to build or improve software solutions. Fluent English, written and spoken, for collaboration and technical documentation. An analytical, structured approach to solving problems, with the patience to investigate and reproduce technical issues. Curiosity about software, technology and testing, and the motivation to learn a new technical domain. Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach. You’re comfortable working independently while keeping colleagues informed. Openness to using AI tools to work efficiently. Recent graduates and candidates at the beginning of their careers are encouraged to apply. This will give you an additional advantage Experience or familiarity with Linux. Exposure to software testing, validation or test automation. Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools. An interest in broadcast technology, DVB or satellite technology. Some knowledge of operator certification or the TV industry. What we offer A hybrid working model, with regular time in our Ghent office. Our physical TVs and part of the testing infrastructure are based there, and working alongside the team will help you learn the role. 20 holidays and 16 ADV days. 10 public holidays plus one additional company holiday. €10 meal vouchers for each day worked. An annual, tax-friendly CAO 90 bonus plan. A quarterly bonus. Medical insurance. A pension plan. A supportive, international team where you can learn from experienced colleagues and gradually take ownership of your work. The chance to contribute to certification, testing and automation in an innovative technology environment. Occasional travel depending on project needs. Recruitment process 1. Apply by submitting your CV in English. 2. Hear from us: Our Recruitment Team will contact every applicant with an update within two weeks. 3. Online interview: If selected to continue, you’ll be invited to an interview in English by video. 4. Meet the Hiring Manager: Successful candidates will be invited to an in-person interview at our office in Ghent. Prior to this interview you will get a technical subject to prepare for at home and to present during the interview. 5. Final interview: The last stage is an interview with HR. Ready to apply? If this sounds like a role where you could learn, contribute and grow, we’d be happy to hear from you. Submit your CV in English to apply.

The interns work in a highly motivating and challenging environment on exciting, cutting-edge development and expansion projects involving (i) all aspects of EU privacy and data protection law, including: GDPR compliance, international data transfers strategy, data breaches and cybersecurity incidents, corporate transactional privacy, contract negotiation, regulatory investigations, and litigation before national courts, national Data Protection Authorities and the European Court of Justice, (ii) other data regulatory legislations, including the EU Digital Markets Act (DMA), the EU Digital Services Act (DSA), the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Act and other legislative initiatives in the EU. items.desc: OUR STORY: \uD83C\uDDEA\uD83C\uDDFA Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow ! Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies. Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector. With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants. Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen. \uD83D\uDCCD Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon. WHY WE NEED YOU ? Our growth is driving us to strengthen our UX Research team within the Product & Design department to scale our research capabilities and better support product decisions across our core cloud infrastructure. Your mission will be to lead impactful user research on highly technical products, while developing scalable ResearchOps practices and empowering product teams to conduct research independently, in order to embed user insights into product strategy and continuously improve the experience of our cloud infrastructure users. YOUR FUTURE TEAM We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together. You will join a growing team of 2 UX Researchers , within the Design department, working closely with Product Managers and Product Designers across different tribes. The team focuses on making user research more continuous, accessible and impactful across Scaleway's product organization. Key initiatives include scaling ResearchOps, developing our Insight Hub, enabling People Who Do Research (PwDR), and responsibly integrating AI into research workflows. You will also collaborate with Solution Architects, Customer Success and Marketing teams when relevant, gaining exposure to a wide range of technical products and customer needs. YOUR DAILY ROUTINE Lead end-to-end UX research initiatives, from discovery to usability testing and continuous research, focusing on cloud infrastructure products and technical users such as developers, DevOps engineers and system administrators. Partner closely with Product Managers and Product Designers to identify research opportunities, frame relevant research questions and translate findings into actionable product recommendations. Collaborate with Product Designers to make highly technical concepts (e.g. provisioning, networking, storage configuration) understandable and usable, helping Scaleway stand out for usability in a historically technical industry. Develop and scale ResearchOps practices, including research workflows, methodologies, templates and insight management processes. Contribute to the development and adoption of the Insight Hub, ensuring research findings are accessible, reusable and actionable across multiple product tribes. Empower Product Managers, Product Designers and other PwDRs to conduct high-quality research independently through coaching, training and practical research guidelines. Explore and integrate AI-powered tools and automated workflows to improve research efficiency while maintaining methodological rigor and responsible practices. Identify cross-product user needs and behavioral patterns to generate insights that extend beyond individual features or product teams. Advocate for user-centered decision-making, communicate research findings effectively and follow up on their impact on product roadmaps and strategic priorities. ABOUT YOU HARDSKILLS : UX Research expertise: 4+ years of experience in UX Research, or UX Design with a strong research focus, including discovery research, usability testing, quantitative and qualitative research methodologies. Technical product experience: Proven experience researching complex B2B products, ideally in cloud infrastructure, developer tools, SaaS or enterprise technology, with the ability to understand technical users and unfamiliar technical concepts. This will include urban heat island effect assessments and approaches to adapt cities to rising temperatures, including providing medium- and long-term adaptation and mitigation strategies such as increasing nature-based solutions, cool surfaces, shaded and pervious surfaces and other passive cooling approaches into the city heat governance and local action plans. Work Location India, remote Expected duration 12 months Duties and Responsibilities The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is the leading global environmental authority that sets the global environmental agenda, promotes the coherent implementation of the environmental dimension of sustainable development within the United Nations system, and serves as an authoritative advocate for the global environment. UNEP's Climate Change Division has as objective to deliver effective strategic guidance and high-impact action in support of the transition towards climate stability. Its work is guided by ambition, innovation, credible science, and alignment to global climate goals and needs of individual countries. The Climate Change Division works with Member States and partners to accelerate and support a just transition by addressing climate change mitigation and adaptation through enhancing implementation capacity, provision of data, information and knowledge, access to finance and technology, and building resilience. It promotes sustainable development and effective policies for climate stability; supports action so that countries progress on decarbonization, dematerialization and resilience pathways in line with their climate commitments, aspirations and needs; and fosters transparency in reporting. The Cool Coalition is a UNEP-led global multi-stakeholder platform that supports governments, cities, businesses and international partners to deliver sustainable cooling solutions that advance climate mitigation, climate resilience, air quality, energy access and sustainable development goals. The Cool Coalition is part of the Climate Change Division under the Cooling and Buildings Unit, Sectoral Transformation Section. The consultant’s assignment is to provide technical expertise to national and subnational implementation activities on sustainable urban cooling in India (urban design, passive cooling, district cooling) including direct technical support to subnational governments and real estate developers; development of knowledge products, tools, training material and communication pieces. Consultant will be part of the Buildings and Cooling Unit of the Mitigation Branch, Climate Change Division, United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP). Specifically, they are needed to support the delivery of UNEP’s India Cooling Programme which is being implemented by UNEP under the framework of the Cool Coalition. Qualifications/special skills The consultant should have PhD or Post Doctoral with post graduate qualification in environment planning, urban planning, Climate Science, Urban meteorology, energy engineering or related field. A minimum of 2 years’ experience in a relevant field of work, preferably with a focus on extreme heat, cooling, urban & environment planning, and climate science. Practical experience in India is essential in scientific assessments, climate analysis, urban heat island analysis and city engagement. Experience in working with diverse research, academic and international organizations is essential. Qualifying years of experience are calculated following the receipt of the first level university degree recognized by the United Nations. Languages English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat. For this post, fluency in written and oral English is required. Knowledge of Hindi is required. Knowledge of another UN language would be an advantage. Additional Information Not available. No Fee THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CHARGE A FEE AT ANY STAGE OF THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS (APPLICATION, INTERVIEW MEETING, PROCESSING, OR TRAINING). THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CONCERN ITSELF WITH INFORMATION ON APPLICANTS’ BANK ACCOUNTS.

items.desc: Vos missions Vous travaillerez sur des systèmes radar à synthèse d’ouverture (SAR) aéroportés et satellitaires, dans les domaines de l’imagerie radar et de l’analyse des performances système. Vos missions consisteront à : Réaliser des analyses de performances et des dimensionnements de systèmes SAR (géométrie d’acquisition, résolution, bilan radiométrique, ambiguïtés) ; Évaluer l’impact des choix système (porteur, trajectoire, navigation, antenne) sur la qualité des images ; Développer et valider des méthodes d’imagerie SAR et de post-traitement (focalisation, compensation de mouvement, interférométrie, polarimétrie, détection, intelligence artificielle) à partir de données réelles ; Contribuer aux études, aux réponses aux appels d’offres et, progressivement, au pilotage de projets ; Participer à l’encadrement de stagiaires et de doctorants. Vous collaborerez avec l’unité SERA de Salon-de-Provence ainsi qu’avec des partenaires institutionnels et industriels. Des déplacements ponctuels en France et à l’étranger seront à prévoir. Votre profil Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou diplômé d’une école d’ingénieur en radar, traitement du signal, télédétection ou domaine connexe. Le poste est ouvert aux jeunes docteurs et ingénieurs, qui bénéficieront d’un accompagnement dans leur montée en compétences, ainsi qu’aux profils expérimentés, qui pourront rapidement prendre des responsabilités de projet. Vous avez envie de comprendre un système radar dans son ensemble, du porteur jusqu’à l’image, et de mettre vos compétences au service de problématiques concrètes, à la frontière entre recherche et application. Vous disposez également des compétences suivantes : Posséder de solides connaissances en radar et en traitement du signal, ainsi que maîtriser les principes de l’imagerie SAR ; Maîtriser la programmation scientifique, notamment Python (NumPy, SciPy ou équivalent) ; Posséder de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et maîtriser l’anglais scientifique ; Faire preuve d’autonomie et de rigueur, apprécier le travail en équipe et souhaiter contribuer à des projets de recherche appliquée. Des compétences en analyse de performances SAR, traitement de données radar réelles, compensation de mouvement, navigation inertielle, GNSS ou conduite d’études constituent des atouts. Votre environnement Le Département ÉlectroMagnétisme et Radar (DEMR) regroupe l’ensemble des compétences allant de la physique à l’étude et réalisation de systèmes dans le domaine de l’électromagnétisme et ses applications. Rejoignez l'ONERA, façonnez l'avenir ! L'ONERA, expert étatique de la recherche aéronautique et spatiale, façonne l’innovation et la défense de demain. Ses 2200 collaborateurs relèvent les défis du futur et renforcent la compétitivité de l'industrie aérospatiale à travers les grands programmes français et européens, porteurs de l’ADN ONERA. Intégrer l’ONERA, c’est s’engager dans une aventure où chaque jour est une occasion d’innover, de repousser les limites de la connaissance et de construire le futur. Rejoignez l’ONERA, et prenez votre envol vers l’avenir ! Job Reference: ONERA02008

L'Activité Développer deux types de détecteurs électromagnétiques pour améliorer la maitrise des faisceaux d’ions extraits des sources ECR : un détecteur de paramètres plasma par mesure tomographique et un détecteur non interceptif de caractérisation du faisceau d'ions (taille, position, intensité) Analyser les contraintes du projet (diponibilité, type de sources, caractéristiques du banc de tests) pour concevoir et faire évoluer les systèmes expérimentaux permettant la qualificiation des détecteurs. Développer une interface homme-machine permettant de piloter les paramètres de réglage de la source (gaz, HF, …) ainsi que les signaux provenant des systèmes de détection Concevoir un système d'asservissement visant à stabiliser le fonctionnement de la source d'ions ECR et du faisceau produit, à partir des informations issues des détecteurs Piloter la réalisation des mesures (planning, programme de qualification, adaptations techniques) Réaliser les mesures expérimentales, les interpréter et valider les performances des détecteurs. Assurer l'interface technique entre le GANIL et son partenaire Coordonner techniquement les activités concernées dans le cadre du projet SAGA (Space Applications at Ganil Accelerators) Votre Profil Compétences Connaissances : Bac +5 dans l’un des domaines suivants : mathématiques, programmation, IA, modélisation Techniques et sciences de l’ingénieur Instrumentation et mesure Langue anglaise : B2 (cadre européen commun de référence pour les langues) Savoir-faire : Programmer, modéliser et intégrer des outils de machine learning Maîtriser les systèmes d'acquisition et de traitement du signal Gérer un projet (planning, budget, reporting) Savoir présenter des résultats scientifiques Savoir-être : Esprit déquipe Sens de l'organisation Rigueur et méthode Autonomie Votre Environnement de Travail Le « Grand Accélérateur National d'Ions Lourds » est une infrastructure nationale de recherche basée sur l’utilisation des faisceaux d'ions. Les champs de recherche portent sur la recherche fondamentale en physique nucléaire et l’astrophysique nucléaire, les matériaux sous irradiation et la nanostructuration, les collisions moléculaires et le milieu interstellaire, la radiobiologie et les techniques innovantes pour la dosimétrie et la thérapie de certains cancers. Le GANIL (environ 350 personnes) se situe sur le futur site EPOPEA, parc de sciences et d’innovation de la communauté urbaine de Caen la Mer, à Caen en Normandie. Il est géré conjointement, au sein d’un Groupe d'Intérêt Économique (GIE), par le Commissariat à l'énergie atomique (CEA/DRF) et par le Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS/IN2P3). En tant qu’infrastructure de recherche, le GANIL est au service d’une communauté scientifique nationale, européenne et internationale d’un millier d’utilisateurs. Au sein de la Division Opérations et Développements, la personne recrutée sera affectée et placée sous la responsabilité hiérarchique du Chef de groupe Cibles et Sources. Elle intégrera une équipe de 15 personnes en charge de la production d'ions stables et radioactifs pour les installations du GANIL. La personne recrutée sera affectée exclusivement au projet SAGA et l’activité se fera en lien avec la société Scienteama. En effet, la société Scienteama développe, en partenariat avec le GANIL, une instrumentation permettant d’analyser les faisceaux d’ions et d’améliorer leurs stabilités. Le projet SAGA (Space Applications at Ganil Accelerators) Face à l’augmentation des demandes d’utilisation des temps de faisceaux d’ions lourds pour l’industrie spatiale, le GANIL, avec le soutien du CNES, a lancé le projet SAGA (Space Applications @ GANIL Accelerators). Son objectif : rendre ces faisceaux plus accessibles à la communauté industrielle spatiale afin de renforcer la réactivité et la compétitivité des entreprises françaises et européennes. Co-portée par le G.I.E GANIL et des partenaires académiques et industriels, la plateforme NORMANDIE ACCÉLÉRATEURS, cofinancée par la Région Normandie, assure le déploiement opérationnel du projet. ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde
items.desc: Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite. ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables. Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis). DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne. Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis. Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales. L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie. Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables. Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables : Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle Solides compétences en caractérisation des matériaux, en recherche expérimentale et dans les technologies de stockage de l’énergie Bonnes compétences en programmation Capacités et aptitudes : Rigueur scientifique, capacité d’analyse et de synthèse Autonomie et esprit d’initiative Capacité à travailler dans un environnement de recherche international et interdisciplinaire Bonne communication écrite et orale en anglais PROFIL RECHERCHE : Diplôme de doctorat (PhD) en génie des procédés, science des matériaux, génie énergétique, physique, sciences computationnelles ou dans un domaine connexe. items.desc: Êtes-vous prêt à façonner l’avenir du Manufacturing Engineering ? Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que responsable de rôle (interne) de produits (extérieur) DELMIA, où vous piloterez une des meilleures offres mondiales de Process Engineering, couvrant aussi bien la fabrication discrète que la fabrication par lots (batch manufacturing). Votre mission En tant que membre clé de notre équipe, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de recherche et développement, de l’expérience utilisateur et de contrôle qualité pour définir et livrer un portefeuille de solutions DELMIA de classe mondiale. Votre objectif est d’offrir une valeur inégalée à nos utilisateurs dans le domaine de l’ingénierie des processus, en discret comme en batch, en stimulant la croissance de revenus, le leadership sur le marché et l’innovation. Deux dimensions sont au cœur de votre rôle : Ancrer les solutions dans les besoins réels des clients . Chaque évolution que vous définissez repose sur les enjeux métier et opérationnels concrets de nos clients, afin que la valeur délivrée soit tangible et différenciante. Contribuer à l’investigation et à la définition de solutions avancées , notamment celles reposant sur les nouvelles technologies à base d’IA. L’objectif est de maintenir DELMIA en avance sur le marché et d’ouvrir de nouvelles sources de valeur pour nos utilisateurs, dans le cadre de Gen7, la nouvelle génération de logiciels Dassault Systèmes. Définir et créer Maîtriser l’ensemble du processus d’industrialisation d’un produit en milieu industriel, qu’il s’agisse de gammes d’assemblage en discret ou de formules et recettes en batch, notamment dans le cadre du transfert de technologie. C ela couvre : la veille du marché et de la technologie dans le domaine ; l’analyse de la concurrence et les orientations stratégiques ; les cas d’utilisation clients end-to-end et l’identification des manques, y compris sur les systèmes externes et les échanges de données ; les retours internes et clients ; les nouveaux packages et la tarification des produits ; la définition détaillée des nouveautés importantes ; l’usage des produits, en se plaçant du côté de l’utilisateur. Être un acteur majeur de la transformation IA de l’offre (Gen7) Investiguer et définir des solutions de nouvelle génération intégrant les technologies d’IA, et proposer les opportunités à inscrire à la feuille de route. Identifier, à partir des cas d’usage clients, où l’IA crée une valeur réelle pour l’ingénierie des processus. Les exemples incluent l’assistance à la définition des gammes et des instructions de travail, la conversion de formules en recettes, ou l’analyse d’impact des changements. Définir et documenter ces évolutions avec les Application Managers et la R&D, afin de traduire la vision en livrables concrets à forte valeur. Collaborer avec les autres Brands Dassault Systèmes pour assurer la continuité des scénarios end-to-end. Travailler avec l’équipe QA pour maintenir les scénarios « red wire » end-to-end destinés aux tests. Livrer & Promouvoir Créer des démonstrateurs qui mettent en valeur les produits DELMIA, notamment les documents démontrant les « Nouveautés » par version. Contribuer aux activités de lancement sur le marché : événements internes et externes, démonstrations industry et brand, définition des meilleures pratiques et création de contenu de formation. Assister les équipes d’avant-vente et de déploiement de projets en apportant une expertise affirmée sur les cas clients clés. S’engager et Soutenir Soutenir l’engagement auprès des clients stratégiques, afin de fournir la bonne valeur aux utilisateurs et d’améliorer en continu les solutions en fonction de leurs cas d’utilisation métier. Travailler avec les organisations en contact direct avec les clients (brand, industry, partenaires, services) pour capter et évaluer leurs besoins. Cultiver des relations durables avec les clients et les utilisateurs à travers les communautés, en partageant connaissances et avis éclairés. Assurer la promotion interne et externe dans le domaine de l’ingénierie des processus de fabrication via les divers canaux de communication. Ce que vous apporterez : Une passion pour la technologie, l’innovation et les solutions centrées sur le client. Des connaissances approfondies sur les enjeux industriels majeurs autour de l’ingénierie des processus de fabrication. De la curiosité et une bonne connaissance des technologies émergentes, en particulier l’IA, avec l’envie d’explorer comment elles créent une valeur réelle pour les utilisateurs. De solides compétences en communication et en collaboration. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Au sein des équipes DELMIA, vous serez à l’avant-garde de la transformation de la façon dont les usines fonctionnent. Faites partie d’une équipe dynamique dédiée à l’innovation, avec la possibilité d’influencer l’avenir de l’industrie. Faites le prochain pas dans votre carrière : postulez maintenant et laissez un impact durable ! Qualifications …
