items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques. Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif. Vous êtes un team player, animé·e par des valeurs fortes, curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre et de progresser chaque jour ? Vous aimez relever des défis et vous investir dans des environnements exigeants et stimulants ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain. Descriptif du poste Dans un contexte de transformation profonde du secteur financier, marqué par l’accélération des usages digitaux, l’essor des plateformes data et l’émergence rapide de l’intelligence artificielle, les acteurs bancaires et assurantiels doivent repenser leurs modèles opérationnels, leur relation client et leurs processus de décision. En tant que Consultant.e au sein de la Business Unit Financial Services, vous intervenez auprès de grands acteurs du secteur bancaire et assurantiel pour les accompagner dans leurs programmes de transformation, en particulier sur des problématiques mêlant enjeux métiers, data et technologies. Les acteurs bancaires et assurantiels doivent aujourd’hui : Mieux exploiter leurs données pour piloter leur performance, renforcer la gestion des risques et répondre aux exigences réglementaires croissantes ; Intégrer l’intelligence artificielle dans leurs processus métiers afin d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle, automatiser certaines activités et renforcer la qualité de service ; Réinventer la relation client via des parcours omnicanaux, personnalisés et fluides ; Moderniser leurs architectures technologiques et leurs plateformes data ; Encadrer les nouveaux usages de l’IA, en intégrant des enjeux de gouvernance, de conformité et de maîtrise des risques. Vous intervenez au cœur des stratégies métier, data et technologiques, avec un niveau d’autonomie croissant, et contribuez activement à la réussite des missions confiées, notamment à travers : La contribution à la définition et à la déclinaison opérationnelle de stratégies de transformation digitale, data et IA ; La réalisation d’analyses, la production de livrables de qualité et la formulation de recommandations à valeur ajoutée ; Le cadrage et le pilotage de chantiers ou de lots de projets, en lien étroit avec les équipes client et Wavestone ; L’optimisation des processus métiers et des parcours clients ; La participation à la mise en œuvre de solutions data (reporting, pilotage, valorisation de la donnée) et à l’identification de cas d’usage IA (automatisation, aide à la décision, IA générative) ; La préparation et l’animation d’ateliers et de réunions avec les clients ; La contribution à l’accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes métiers. Rejoindre la Business Unit Financial Services, c’est intégrer une équipe de plus de 400 consultant·es qui accompagnent les grands acteurs du secteur bancaire et assurantiel dans leurs transformations, dans un environnement exigeant, stimulant et en constante évolution. Au-delà des missions clients, vous pourrez vous investir dans la vie du cabinet à travers : Le développement et le partage de l’expertise Data & IA au sein de la Business Unit ; La réalisation d’activités de veille, la rédaction d’articles ; Contribution active au développement commercial : participation à l’identification d’opportunités business, appui à la préparation de propositions commerciales et collaboration avec les équipes de vente pour renforcer la qualification des besoins clients. La participation aux actions de recrutement, de relations écoles, d’avant-vente et de formation interne L’engagement dans les initiatives RSE de Wavestone. Profil recherché Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieurs, de management ou d’une grande université, vous disposez de premières expériences réussies en conseil ou au sein d’un environnement en transformation dans le secteur Financial Services dans le cadre de vos stages. Vous avez développé : De solides capacités d’analyse et de structuration de problématiques complexes ; Une aptitude à produire des livrables de grande qualité et à respecter vos engagements ; Une posture professionnelle et orientée satisfaction client ; Une capacité à travailler en autonomie tout en collaborant efficacement au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires. items.desc: About Scality Scality solves organisations' biggest data storage challenges: growth, security, performance, and cost. Designed for end-to-end cyber resilience, only Scality S3 object storage with CORE5 safeguards data at every level of the system, from API to architecture. Its patented MultiScale Architecture enables limitless, independent scalability in all critical dimensions to meet the unpredictable demands of modern workloads. The world's most discerning companies depend on Scality to accelerate high-performance AI initiatives, optimize cloud deployments, and defend their data with confidence. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality software is reliable, secure, and sustainable. The job context The team Our IT & Security team builds, runs and secures Scality's IT infrastructure. It also supports the whole Scality community: employees, contractors, consultants and freelancers. We make sure everyone works in a secure, compliant and up-to-date environment. We also bring security expertise to our products (RING, ARTESCA, ADI) and to our customers. You will join a team of 4 to 5 people with varied backgrounds (development, security, IT operations, helpdesk) and 2 to 30+ years of experience. The mission You will own Scality's information security compliance program and coordinate the team's security operations. You will lead our ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 (AI management system) certifications and manage vulnerability (CVE) follow-up with Engineering. You will answer customer security requests and audits. You will also help our products meet new regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA). The role is about 70% governance, risk and compliance (GRC) and product security, and 30% hands-on security operations. The job description You will own (Responsible) Security operations coordination : be the point of contact for incoming IT & Security requests, prioritize them and dispatch them within the team. Vulnerability management : Assess product exposure to CVEs by leveraging internal tools powered by our Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).. Handle customer security requests (RD tickets) with Engineering and Support until a fix version or a customer answer is delivered. Track scan and pentest reports through remediation. ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 programs : maintain the framework, policies and procedures in our GRC tool. Run risk analysis and treatment plans, objectives and indicators, and the Statement of Applicability. Prepare internal and external audits and follow up on nonconformities and improvement opportunities. Control management : run the monthly, quarterly and annual controls (account and access reviews across HR system and SSO, application access, offboarding checks), automate them in Jira and keep audit evidence. ISMS processes : run security incident management and change management in Jira (workflows, fields, records), and the business continuity part of customer requests (ISO 22301-type questionnaires). Third-party and application security reviews : assess new SaaS tools, suppliers and internal applications or automations (no-code tools, Slack or AI integrations). Keep the supplier inventory and the service account inventory up to date. AI governance : maintain the AI systems inventory, review the AI features of tools before use, and follow regulatory changes (EU AI Act). Personal data : maintain the personal data inventory and processing records (GDPR, CNIL guidance) together with the data protection contact. Customer trust : answer security questionnaires and RFPs, and prepare evidence packages for customer audits (banking, telecom and public-sector customers). Security awareness : plan and run awareness and phishing campaigns, and track participation and click rates for managers. You will contribute to (Contributor) Product security and certifications : prepare the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) technical files per product (compliance matrix, risk assessment, SBOM, vulnerability handling, RACI). Also contribute to CISA Secure by Design commitments and UK Cyber Essentials. Bring security input to the product roadmap, the development teams and the product documentation. Data leak prevention : define and tune DLP indicators and alerts (Google Workspace, Salesforce event monitoring) and investigate alerts. Infrastructure security : IaaS/PaaS security, monitoring and SIEM alerting, reporting of security incidents, business continuity and disaster recovery. Automation and tooling : scripts (Python, Bash) and Jira automations that reduce manual work. IT operations : account, application and permission management, level 1 and 2 network and security incidents. Mentoring : onboard and supervise interns or work-study students on security topics. You will be informed of Laptop fleet and IT room hardware, SSO integration and SaaS administration, level 3 network management, CI security, and relations with external IT providers. Other team members handle these topics. Desired profile In general Degree …

Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain. Descriptif du poste Rejoindre le département Digital Consumer dans l’équipe Digital Maker Dev , c’est intégrer une communauté de consultant·e·s capable d’ intervenir de bout en bout , depuis la clarification d’un besoin métier jusqu’à la réalisation concrète d’applications , de sites web ou de produits digitaux, accéléré par les technologies d’ IA générative . Nous recherchons un·e Consultant·e Développeur·se, ou Product Builder, à l’aise aussi bien face au client que dans le code, combinant : une capacité de conseil et de cadrage (écoute, reformulation, priorisation), une sensibilité UX et produit (conception, expérience) et une capacité à développer des solutions utilisables, maintenables et à valeur. L’IA générative est vue comme un outil d’accélération, au service de la qualité, du time-to-market et de la créativité – pas comme une fin en soi. Elle permet de rendre autonomes des individus dans des projets qui auraient nécessités plusieurs spécialistes. Vos missions principales 1. Cadrer et traduire les besoins clients Comprendre les enjeux métier, utilisateurs et techniques du client. Animer ou contribuer à des ateliers de cadrage (besoins, parcours, priorités, MVP). Participer à la définition de produits digitaux : user stories, wireframes, prototypes, choix d’architecture. 2. Apporter une attention forte à l’expérience utilisateur Collaborer étroitement avec des UX/UI designers, voire – selon les projets – être le représentant des besoins de l’utilisateurs Être attentif·ve à la clarté des parcours, à l’utilisabilité et à l’adoption des solutions livrées. Challenger les choix fonctionnels ou techniques au regard de l’expérience utilisateur. 3. Concevoir et développer des solutions digitales Développer concrètement des applications web, sites, back-offices, outils internes ou MVP, seul·e ou en équipe restreinte. Utiliser les bons outils selon le contexte : développement custom, frameworks web modernes, plateformes low-code/no-code, intégration d’API et de services IA. Exploiter l’IA pour accélérer le développement, améliorer l’UX ou enrichir les fonctionnalités (copilotes, assistants, automatisations…). 4. Accompagner le client jusqu’à la mise en œuvre Présenter et expliquer les solutions auprès de profils variés (métier, IT, direction). Contribuer à la conduite du changement et à l’appropriation des outils livrés. S’inscrire dans une logique d’amélioration continue. Quelques exemples de missions récentes Conception et développement en VueJS d’un outil de personnalisation de produit maroquiniers de luxe en langage naturel, avec affichage sur écran déporté, et présenté sur le stand Vivatech du client Conception et développement en React d’un outil d’audit pour analyser automatiquement les nombreux sites web du client pour s’assurer du bon usage du Design System officiel. Conception et développement avec Streamlit de l’interface de suivi et de projection des performances des junior au sein d’un centre d’entrainement d’un grand club de foot, en collaboration avec les collègues du département Data & IA Conception et développement en React du « ChatGPT » interne du client, en intégrant des fonctionnalités spécifiques à l’entreprise en plus des standards du marchés. En tant que consultant·e junior (Analyst), vous serez : Acteur·rice à part entière des missions clients, en intervenant sur des problématiques concrètes et créatives : cadrage de cas d’usage, définition d’expériences utilisateurs, développement de solutions, accompagnement au changement… Responsable de vos livrables, avec un niveau d’exigence élevé sur la qualité, la clarté et l’impact de vos analyses, présentations ou recommandations. Formé·e en continu aux méthodes de conseil, aux outils technologiques et aux enjeux sectoriels, pour monter rapidement en compétences et gagner en autonomie. Impliqué·e dans la vie de la Business Unit, à travers des projets internes (veille, développement d’offres, formations, animation de communautés, etc.) et des initiatives transverses du cabinet. Accompagné·e par un management de proximité, avec un suivi régulier, des feedbacks constructifs et des perspectives d’évolution …

Avec le temps, notre savoir-faire s’est élargi aux infrastructures, à la data et à l’intelligence collective , toujours avec un objectif clair : amplifier le potentiel humain grâce à la technologie . Nous intervenons en régie, en infogérance et sur des projets , avec une conviction forte : l’innovation ne doit pas se voir, mais se vivre. Notre mission est d’ humaniser la technologie , de la rendre fluide, éthique et au service de ceux qui l’utilisent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Une expertise historique sur le Modern Workplace et au-delà Régie, infogérance, projets : des missions variées et enrichissantes Un engagement fort pour la formation et la certification de nos collaborateurs afin qu’ils restent à la pointe des technologies Télétravail possible selon mission Afterworks, événements et engagement dans des causes solidaires Avantages CSE, accès à Skilleos et réductions Microsoft Gymlib co-financé et une mutuelle généreuse Description du poste Vous intégrerez Experteam pour contribuer au développement de notre expertise en intelligence artificielle, au cœur de notre vision de l'Intelligent Workplace. Votre rôle sera d'explorer et de développer des solutions s'appuyant notamment sur l'IA générative et les agents autonomes, avec pour ambition de réinventer les environnements de travail et d'en améliorer la productivité et la fluidité. Qualifications Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 en informatique, Data, Intelligence Artificielle ou domaine équivalent. Vous disposez d'une spécialisation ou d'une expérience significative dans le domaine de l'IA. Vous avez idéalement une connaissance de l'environnement Microsoft et de ses solutions IA : Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric… Vous maîtrisez couramment le français et l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Vous êtes curieux(se), force de proposition et aimez explorer de nouvelles technologies. Vous avez envie de contribuer à la construction et au développement d'une expertise. Informations supplémentaires Et si vous participiez au développement de l'expertise IA d'Experteam ? L'intelligence artificielle transforme les usages et les environnements informatiques. Chez Experteam, nous souhaitons aller plus loin sur ces sujets en développant notre expertise interne et en intégrant un profil spécialisé en intelligence artificielle. Dans cette démarche, nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) de l'IA, idéalement familiarisé(e) avec l'écosystème Microsoft, qui pourra apporter ses connaissances, partager son expertise et contribuer à construire nos compétences sur ces technologies. Il s'agit d'un recrutement sur profil : nous souhaitons avant tout rencontrer la bonne personne, découvrir son parcours, ses compétences et son potentiel. Nous sommes prêts à prendre le temps nécessaire pour identifier le profil qui correspondra à cette ambition. Votre rôle En rejoignant Experteam, vous contribuerez notamment à : Développer et structurer notre expertise interne autour de l'intelligence artificielle. Explorer les technologies et solutions IA, avec un intérêt particulier pour l'écosystème Microsoft. Identifier de nouveaux cas d'usage et étudier les possibilités offertes par ces technologies. Participer à la conception et au développement de solutions intégrant l'IA. Accompagner la montée en compétences des équipes et partager vos connaissances. Contribuer à la réflexion autour de notre positionnement et de nos futures offres IA. Ce qu’il faut savoir Type de contrat : CDI uniquement Localisation : IDF Rémunération : jusqu’à 58K Tous nos postes se conjuguent au féminin et au masculin et sont bien évidemment ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap .

items.desc: Le/la Responsable des relations financières (des délégations du service public) est l'interlocuteur financier de référence des villes sur les principales DSP. Il/elle pilote le suivi de la performance financière des contrats tout au long de l'année, anticipe les écarts, construit les argumentaires et porte la parole financière de l'entreprise auprès des collectivités. Il/elle contribue également à outiller et à industrialiser ces pratiques, notamment grâce à l'intelligence artificielle. 1. Suivi de la performance des principales DSP Suivre tout au long de l'année la performance financière de chaque DSP du périmètre par rapport au compte d'exploitation prévisionnel et aux hypothèses de l'appel d'offre. Comparaison avec les résultats N-1 Produire des analyses régulières et fiables : suivi mensuel, projection d'atterrissage de fin d'année, identification précoce des dérives et des risques. Alerter sans délai les opérationnels et responsable PFO de la région sur les écarts significatifs et proposer des plans d'action. 2. Relation financière avec les villes Programmer et animer des points financiers avec chaque ville délégante, au minimum tous les 6 mois et plus souvent selon les enjeux, afin de présenter les résultats intermédiaires puis l'atterrissage de fin d'année. Être présent(e) et réactif(ve) auprès des villes pour répondre à leurs questions financières, en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles concernées. Préparer pour chaque échéance des argumentaires construits, pédagogiques et chiffrés, adaptés au niveau d'interlocuteur (élus, directions, services financiers). Expliquer de façon claire et documentée les différences entre le réalisé et les hypothèses de l'appel d'offre (évolution de l'activité, des coûts, du cadre réglementaire, des paramètres contractuels). Contribuer à la préparation des échanges sensibles (avenants, révision de prix, équilibre économique, contentieux éventuels). 3. Relecture et sécurisation des rapports Relire et valider la partie financière des rapports remis aux villes sur les rapports non réalisés Garantir la cohérence des chiffres, la conformité aux exigences contractuelles et la qualité des explications fournies. Harmoniser la structure et la qualité des rapports entre les différentes DSP. 4. Accompagnement et formation des opérationnels Accompagner les RS et DR sur la partie financière des DSP : lecture des indicateurs, compréhension des enjeux économiques, impact des décisions de gestion sur les résultats. Concevoir et animer des formations et des temps de partage collectifs. Produire des supports pédagogiques simples (guides, fiches pratiques, tableaux de bord commentés). items.desc: Über uns Bei encentive entwickeln wir flexOn – ein intelligentes Energiemanagementsystem, das mithilfe von KI industrielle Anlagen steuert. Wir erfassen Echtzeitdaten von Anlagen, prognostizieren das Betriebsverhalten, kombinieren diese mit externen Faktoren (wie Wetter und Energiepreise) und optimieren den Energieverbrauch, um sowohl Kosten als auch CO₂-Emissionen zu senken. Wir gestalten die Zukunft der Energie: Es kommt nicht nur darauf an, weniger Energie zu verbrauchen, sondern sie zum richtigen Zeitpunkt zu nutzen! Dies ermöglicht die bestmögliche Integration von schwankendem Strom aus erneuerbaren Energien wie Wind und Sonne. Mit unserer KI-gestützten flexOn-Plattform helfen wir industriellen Stromverbrauchern dabei, ihre Flexibilität aktiv zu steigern und Strom genau dann zu nutzen, wenn er am umweltfreundlichsten und kostengünstigsten ist. Unser Ziel ist es, die Dekarbonisierung des Energiesystems zu beschleunigen und gleichzeitig die Energiekosten für unsere Kunden deutlich zu senken. Als Product Designer (f/m/d) arbeitest du an flexOn und unseren ergänzenden Tools. Deine Designs helfen KundInnen, PartnerInnen und internen Teams dabei, Anlagen einzurichten, Optimierungsergebnisse zu verstehen und den Betrieb von Anlagen anzupassen. Deine Aufgaben Sei Teil unserer realen Arbeitsabläufe. Sprich mit KundInnen und internen NutzerInnen, beobachte ihre Arbeitsweise und finde heraus, wo Design Hürden abbauen kann. Überprüfe Ideen mit Interviews, Prototypen und Usability-Tests. Du verantwortest den Designprozess von der Recherche bis zur Umsetzung und entwickelst aus offenen Fragen klare Konzepte, testbare Prototypen und ausgereifte Interfaces. Du machst komplexe Systeme verständlich. Du gestaltest Möglichkeiten, Energiedaten zu analysieren, Anlagen zu konfigurieren und Optimierungsergebnisse zu interpretieren. Du unterstützt NutzerInnen dabei, Prognosen und automatisierte Entscheidungen zu verstehen, Unsicherheiten zu erkennen, Betriebsgrenzen festzulegen und bei Bedarf einzugreifen. Du entwickelst KI-gestützte Arbeitsabläufe für Research, die Ausarbeitung von Konzepten und interaktives Prototyping. Du entwickelst unsere gemeinsame Designgrundlage weiter . Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering entwickelst du unser Designsystem weiter und machst unser System wiederverwendbar, barrierearm und konsistent. Du prüfst, was sich für NutzerInnen verändert. Du legst gemeinsam mit dem Product und Engineering fest, woran Erfolg erkennbar ist. Auf Basis von Research, Nutzerdaten und Kundenfeedback entwickelst du unsere Lösungen weiter. Der Erfolg im Product Design kann bedeuten, dass NutzerInnen eine Einrichtung mit weniger Unterstützung abschließen, Optimierungsergebnisse richtig verstehen oder einen Datenfehler selbst beheben können, ohne den Support zu kontaktieren. Dein Profil Erfahrung damit, digitale Produkte vom Problem bis zum Launch zu gestalten , typischerweise erworben in mindestens drei Jahren im Product Design. Dein Portfolio zeigt deine Überlegungen, deinen konkreten Beitrag und was du nach dem Launch gelernt hast. Starke Fähigkeiten in Interaction und Visual Design. Du kannst komplexe Abläufe und Informationen strukturieren, ausgereifte Interfaces gestalten und Barrierefreiheit bei Diagrammen, Formularen und Systemmeldungen berücksichtigen. Praxis in Research und Testing. Du wählst passende Methoden für die jeweilige Fragestellung und nutzt Erkenntnisse, um Annahmen zu hinterfragen und Designs zu verbessern. Our mission is to improve soil fertility, support sustainable agriculture, and contribute to long-term carbon storage. We are a small, international team of scientists and engineers working to bring this technology from the laboratory to industrial production. You will work directly with our engineers and scientists to prepare experiments, operate the extruder, modify equipment, and ensure that our experimental processes run safely and reliably. items.card: In this role, you will take total ownership of how the muon beam travels from the converter to the scanned object, steering the complete lifecycle of capture, transport, and shielding design. Key Responsibilities & Core Tasks End-to-End Beam Transport Ownership: Own the complete pathway of the muon beam from converter to target, managing capture efficiency, transport dynamics, and comprehensive radiation shielding.
items.desc: Join an innovative deep-tech pioneer dedicated to developing safe, rapid, and precise active muon imaging systems for high-stakes industrial quality assessment, security, customs inspection, and advanced medical diagnostics. Our platform merges advanced laser-plasma-accelerator-driven muon sources, next-generation particle detectors, and sophisticated AI to deliver high-resolution 3D imaging with automated decision-making. Operating out of major research hubs in Germany and Estonia, our work directly empowers quality and safety assessments for critical metallic and ceramic components—ranging from aerospace hardware like rocket engines and gas turbines to large-scale nuclear and industrial installations. In this role, you will take total ownership of how the muon beam travels from the converter to the scanned object, steering the complete lifecycle of capture, transport, and shielding design. Key Responsibilities & Core Tasks End-to-End Beam Transport Ownership: Own the complete pathway of the muon beam from converter to target, managing capture efficiency, transport dynamics, and comprehensive radiation shielding. Beamline & Geometry Evolution: Design efficient muon capture and controllable transport systems, building upon current operational setups (such as the 35° tunnel bend) while scaling and extending designs toward future laser-plasma-accelerator (LPA) based muon sources. Holistic Shielding & Background Optimization: Construct integrated models for beamline shielding, treating the critical trade-off between background noise reduction and muon signal preservation as the core design constraint, while leveraging fast-model approximations to bypass full simulation runs on every iteration. Fast Simulation Development: Build and benchmark agile simulation tools for rapid beamline optimization, applying them seamlessly across current experimental beamlines and next-generation architectures. Optics & Magnet Engineering: Optimize collection and transport optics for polychromatic beams. Evaluate permanent magnets versus electromagnets based on achievable field strength, demagnetization risks (such as neutron-induced effects), cost, supply chain reliability, and tunability—and directly lead the subsequent procurement process. Infrastructure Resilience: Ensure long-term radiation resilience across all beamline components and magnetic infrastructure. Requirements & Candidate Profile Educational Background: A Doctorate (PhD / Dr.) in accelerator physics, particle physics, nuclear engineering, or a closely related technical field is strictly required. Professional Experience: Minimum post-doctoral experience required, with a strong preference for candidates bringing several years of dedicated post-doctoral research background. Technical Must-Haves: Complete fluency in GEANT4 with proven particle transport simulation and validation experience. Deep expertise in shielding and background physics (accounting for gammas, positrons/electrons, and neutrons). Hands-on beam optics experience tailored for polychromatic beams and constrained spatial geometries. Demonstrated skill in developing fast simulation models. Sound understanding of radiation-aware magnet engineering and mitigation of magnetic degradation. Language Proficiency: At least full professional proficiency in English; ability in German or Estonian is considered a valuable plus. Logistics & Availability: Available to start in January 2027 or, at the latest, February 2027. Open to occasional international travel to visit and collaborate at global research facilities and partner installations. Position is structured as a hybrid role based out of our primary research headquarters (approx. 1 day/week home office; fully remote is not available). Personality & Working Culture Proactive & Analytical: You comfortably challenge design assumptions, push back on constraints when physics demands it, and build models validated against realistic beam conditions. Ownership Mindset: You treat hardware procurement and supply-chain realities as natural extensions of the engineering design process. Fast-Paced Adaptability: You thrive in an agile "build to learn" environment, favoring rapid prototyping, hands-on experimentation, and tight iteration loops over slow, overly polished processes. Compensation & Benefits Package Equity Program: A substantial start-up employee equity package providing a meaningful stake in the company's long-term success. Benefits & Relocation: Attractive supplementary benefits alongside a comprehensive international relocation package and visa support.

items.desc: Location Am Campus 1 74177 Bad Friedrichshall Employment Area IT - Cloud Services Level Experienced professional Working Model Full-time Reference ID 702 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. In this role, you will receive support from many internal service teams to continuously refine our services and build a long-term, stable, and reliable solution that our customers will be happy to use. Your tasks Architecture: Together with your team, you are responsible for designing and maintaining a robust, efficient, and forward-looking storage architecture. Stability & Reliability: You are responsible for maintaining and optimizing the stability and availability of our highly resilient storage infrastructure (Block, Object, Backup, and File Storage). You ensure this through proactive monitoring, independently resolving incidents, and implementing measures to prevent future occurrences. Incident & Post-Mortem Analysis: You will take charge of processing major incidents involving storage as part of our incident and problem management process. Your goal is to derive and successfully implement mitigating measures for the future. Automation: You automate provisioning and operating processes in the storage environment with a continuous drive to improve our products and get a little better every day. Performance & Capacity Planning: You will analyze and optimize the performance of existing systems to support the future scaling of our landscape, including proactive, forward-looking capacity planning. Your Profile Must-Haves Storage Expertise: Proven experience in the architecture, operations, and troubleshooting of storage systems. You must have deep hands-on experience with NetApp ONTAP. Protocols & Architectures: Strong overall understanding of storage architectures and deep experience with associated protocols, specifically NFSv3, NFSv4.x, NVMe-oF. Operating Systems: Robus, hands-on expertise with Linux operating systems, including a proven capability to effectively troubleshoot system issues. Automation & IaC: Strong experience in automating configurations and operational tasks. You are highly proficient with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks and tools such as Ansible, Terraform, and OpenTofu, as well as scripting/programming (e.g., Golang, Python, Bash). API Management: Experience in working with REST APIs. Performance & Capacity Management: Proven experience in performance analysis, troubleshooting bottlenecks, and proactive capacity planning for complex storage landscapes. Continuous Learning: You are highly motivated to dive into new technologies and have a keen interest in storage ecosystem integrations, such as virtualization, backup, and observability (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch). Mindset & Language: You are a motivated team player who enjoys the challenges of operating complex storage systems (lifecycle, high availability, performance analysis). Excellent communication skills in English are required for our international, agile teams (German is an optional bonus). Nice-to-Have Skills Containerization: Experience using Kubernetes (K8s) and working within containerized system landscapes in a storage context. Then your employment contract is on its way to you digitally by e-mail. 5 Welcome Your first day of work with is about to begin and your individual onboarding in the team begins. We look forward to seeing you!

Strong understanding of digital product development and application lifecycle management. Experience working in Agile environments and with Scrum methodologies. items.desc: 80-100% | as soon as possible | Germany or Switzerland About Exeon Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. Since 2016, we have been protecting critical infrastructures, financial institutions and enterprises whose operations fully rely on IT through AI-powered analysis of network communication. This makes the most sophisticated cyberattacks visible – attacks conventional tools fail to detect. We combine Swiss excellence with a flexible, remote-first, and collaborative culture, supporting passionate, ambitious professionals devoted to solving cybersecurity challenges and driving continuous innovation. What your impact will be like: As a Security Engineer in our Solutions team, you will help design the components and data flow of our core products: how data gets in, how deployments are configured and operated, and how everything scales across very different customer environments, many of them on-prem and air-gapped. You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success. In particular, you will: Build tooling and automation to simplify the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Exeon.NDR, Exeon.UEBA, log collection and supporting components Design, build, and maintain scalable log ingestion pipelines for a wide range of network and application log sources and formats, including parsing, normalization, and validation Deploy and operate Exeon in customer environments (on-prem, private cloud, and hybrid), including sizing, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex issues Work with customers to understand their data sources, infrastructure constraints, and security needs, and translate these into clear requirements for product and engineering teams Contribute to customer support, documentation, and runbooks alongside your Solutions colleagues What you can expect from us: Exeon offers an open company culture that values and encourages diversity, teamwork and a growth mindset. Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering: An exciting and impactful job in a fast-growing Swiss cyber tech company expanding across Europe with manifold opportunities to shape your professional profile. Working in close collaboration with our interdisciplinary team and learning from our Security Experts, Data Scientists, and Business Professionals. Taking over responsibilities quickly and help shape and promote a cutting-edge security software. A high degree of trust, independence and flexibility, also in terms of working hours and place of work (remote or in the office). A competitive salary and appealing benefits package. What you bring along: We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic cyber security professional who is comfortable in a high-paced start-up environment and who shares our values. You should be confident with solving problems independently and communicating easily with both internal teams and directly with customers. You should also: 3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, platform/infrastructure engineering, or a similar role Working knowledge of network and application security and the telemetry relevant to detection UNIX/Linux experience, including networking, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in containerized deployments (Docker and/or Kubernetes) Strong programming skills in Python and Bash (or comparable languages), with a focus on automation and maintainable, production-quality code Hands-on experience designing and operating data ingestion pipelines (e.g. syslog, Logstash/Fluentd/Vector, Elastic stack, or similar), including handling heterogeneous formats and high volumes Comfortable with working in a largely remote team where clear communication is key to successful collaboration and impact. We are an English-speaking team but German fluency is appreciated when communicating to some customers Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience Nice to have: Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals, common attack patterns, and the log and telemetry sources that matter for detection Experience with SIEM, SOAR, or detection platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Security), or as a detection engineer or security analyst Familiarity with network telemetry such as NetFlow/IPFIX, Zeek, or Suricata, and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK Prior customer-facing or professional services experience.

With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.* Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management. With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code. Outside China and India RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible for the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of OT network and security infrastructure across industrial environments. Operate and maintain OT firewalls, switches, routers, VPN gateways, and network devices. Manage and troubleshoot Client-to-Site (C2S) and Site-to-Site (S2S) VPNs for secure remote and inter-site connectivity. Perform firewall upgrades, configuration changes, rule management, and migrations. Troubleshoot OT network connectivity, routing, switching, firewall, and VPN issues. Perform network device upgrades, configuration backups, replacements, and lifecycle activities. Implement changes following OT change-management, security, and operational procedures. Maintain network diagrams, firewall/VPN documentation, device inventories, SOPs, and troubleshooting procedures. Support incident management, root-cause analysis, and preventive actions. Coordinate with Cybersecurity, engineering teams, vendors, and site personnel. Support network projects, infrastructure improvements, and OT security initiatives while maintaining system availability and operational continuity. You’re effective at managing multiple tasks, perform well under pressure, and are passionate about learning and growth. We’re looking for someone with the following toolbox: At least 3 years of experience as a Network Engineer Solid understanding of the TCP/IP model and key internet protocols (DNS, SMTP, HTTP, etc.) Familiarity with authentication and authorization schemes In-depth knowledge of network security, IP routing, and VPN technologies (SSL VPN, IPSec, OpenVPN) Hands-on experience with Cisco Catalyst Series and HP Aruba switches Experience with Fortigate and Cisco firewalls and routers Clear and patient communicator, able to interface directly with clients in English Network/security certifications (Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper) are preferred Experience with Linux environments is considered an asset LIFE @ POWER FACTORS We are an agile software development company – big enough to make an impact, but small enough to move quickly and execute in a growing industry. We are a team of bold and ingenious talents driven by results. We are passionate about making the world a better place. We seek fierce and humble people to help us achieve our ambitious plan. WHY JOIN US By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together - committed, conscientious and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry. WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER Power Factors is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to engaging a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

items.desc: Networks and Telecoms Engineer (Grade VII) The Networks and Telecoms Engineer is responsible for network and telecommunications infrastructure, and the services directly associated with that infrastructure. They are responsible for the technical operation, support, maintenance and continuous improvement of the hospital's data network and telecommunications infrastructure. The role has two core and complementary areas of responsibility: Networking , including wired LAN, wireless LAN, network connectivity, network infrastructure, network performance and associated network security. Telecommunications , including legacy telephony, Voice over IP (VoIP), associated voice services and telecommunications infrastructure. The Networks and Telecoms Engineer will work with the internal ICT team, HSE teams and third-party service providers to ensure these services are reliable, secure, resilient and appropriate to the operational and clinical requirements of the hospital. They will also manage and coordinate relevant third-party network and telecommunications suppliers, including service performance, technical escalation and value for money. Key Responsibilities: 1. Network Design, Operation and Improvement: Design, configure, implement, support and continuously improve the hospital's wired and wireless network infrastructure, working with internal ICT colleagues, HSE teams and specialist third-party providers as appropriate. Maintain network infrastructure to appropriate standards of availability, performance, scalability, resilience and security. Deploy, configure and maintain network equipment and associated services across hospital premises. Monitor network availability, utilisation, capacity and performance and take appropriate corrective or preventative action. Troubleshoot network connectivity and performance issues, escalating to HSE or third-party service providers where appropriate. Collaborate with internal ICT and HSE teams on National, Regional and Local network requirements supporting hospital operations and patient care. 2. Telecommunications: Manage and support the hospital's telecommunications infrastructure, including legacy telephony and Voice over IP (VoIP) services. Ensure the availability and continuity of voice communications and associated telecommunications services. Diagnose and resolve telecommunications faults directly or through the appropriate service provider. Coordinate telecommunications changes, upgrades and service improvements. Work with the owners of other hospital systems where integration with telecommunications services is required. Maintain appropriate technical and operational documentation for telecommunications services. 3. Third-Party and Service Provider Management: Manage the operational relationship with contracted network and telecommunications providers. Monitor supplier performance against agreed service levels and escalate service failures appropriately. Coordinate technical support, fault resolution, planned works, upgrades and service changes with suppliers. Review supplier proposals and technical solutions to ensure they meet hospital requirements. Support contract and service reviews with particular attention to service quality, resilience, technical suitability and value for money. 4. Network and Telecommunications Security: Implement and maintain security controls within the network and telecommunications infrastructure, working with the wider ICT team and relevant HSE security functions. Monitor network infrastructure and traffic for abnormal activity, security events and potential threats. Maintain network-device configurations, firmware and security updates in accordance with agreed ICT change and security processes. Assist with investigation and response to security incidents where they involve or affect the network or telecommunications environment. Support network security reviews, vulnerability remediation and implementation of agreed network security controls. Ensure appropriate segmentation, access controls and secure configuration of network infrastructure. 5. Network and Telecommunications Maintenance: Monitor and optimise network and telecommunications infrastructure performance. Diagnose faults and undertake preventative and corrective maintenance relating to network and telecommunications equipment. Apply appropriate firmware updates, security updates, configuration changes and upgrades to network and telecommunications infrastructure. Maintain supported versions of network and telecommunications hardware and software/firmware. Coordinate maintenance activities with third-party providers and other ICT teams where dependencies exist. Follow agreed ICT change-management processes for production infrastructure changes. 6. Resilience, Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery: Design and maintain appropriate resilience and redundancy for network and telecommunications services. Maintain documented network and telecommunications recovery procedures. …

items.desc: Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! Our vision is fast technology, fair service, and honest values. All at the tap of a phone, all the time. We are about giving customers a new way to spend, save and manage their money while taking better care of the planet which has seen us become a multi-award winning bank that now employs over 2300 across five offices in London, Cardiff, Dublin, Southampton, and soon to be Manchester. Our journey started in 2014, and since then we have surpassed three million accounts (and four account types!) with 350,000 business customers. We are a fully licensed UK bank but at the heart, we are a tech first company, enabling our platform to deliver brilliant products. Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together! The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness. Your responsibilities will include: Participating in end-to-end red and purple team operations, as well as designing and delivering cyber resilience exercises (e.g. threat modelling, tabletops, targeted testing, and simulations that evaluate Starling's response and recovery capabilities). Emulating real-world threat actors and leveraging MITRE ATT&CK to test the organisation's defences across both cutting-edge cloud infrastructure and the endpoint estate. Utilising dedicated research time to identify emerging threats, understand new vulnerabilities, and adapt Threat Actor TTPs that can be leveraged during assessments. Working alongside defensive teams post-engagement to actively remediate vulnerabilities, refine playbooks, and improve the overall security and resilience posture of the organization. Engaging in continuous learning and professional development, keeping up to date with current trends in both offensive security and operational resilience. Operations will emulate real threat actors and target cutting edge technology in Starling Bank’s platform as well as ranging across the endpoint estate. You will use emerging threat intelligence to inform and develop effective attacks. You will be an early member of the team and have the opportunity to shape the development and growth of the team. Requirements You will have: 2+ years of experience in Offensive Security (Red Teaming, Pentesting) OR highly technical other cyber security domains. Alternatively, Cyber Resilience experience in delivering Response and Recovery focused cyber simulations (Threat Modelling, Tabletops, Targeted Testing). Experience emulating real-world cyber threats to test the organisation's defences and response capabilities. Understanding cyber kill chains and common MITRE TTPs. Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CRTO, OSEP, OSMR, OSCP) OR equivalent practical experience in defensive, offensive, or cyber resilience operations. Familiarity with standard C2 frameworks (e.g., Mythic, Cobalt Strike) and common offensive security tooling. Strong network and operating system fundamentals e.g Windows, Linux. Big picture understanding of cloud technology (AWS & GCP) and modern software engineering paradigms (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code). Ability to work to defined rules of engagement, showing strong discipline, integrity, steady judgement, and the communication skills to bridge the gap between technical exploits and business recovery. Though not necessarily required, the ideal candidate would also bring: Experience chaining offensive operations directly into broader organisational resilience or response exercises. Exposure to financial sector threat-led penetration testing frameworks (e.g., CBEST, STAR, or DORA) or operational resilience regulations. Deep understanding of macOS operating system fundamentals. Experience in payload modification, scripting (Python, Go, PowerShell, bash), or software engineering (Java, Kotlin, Go). Experience in Social Engineering such as phishing, physical break-in, or vishing. Experience and enthusiasm for sharing knowledge internally to educate staff on the threat landscape and response processes. items.desc: The Hot Box Sauna is Ireland’s leading sauna and wellness experience, offering a unique blend of relaxation, community, and wellbeing. We are a genuine energetic bunch of individuals that are striving for a better lifestyle not only for our customers but also for our own employees. Would you like to be part of it? Then, please keep reading! We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic person to join our team as Sauna Host to deliver a seamless, welcoming, and high-quality experience to our guests. Key Responsibilities Guest Experience & Service A Warm Welcome - greet every guest with a calm, friendly and professional attitude. Set the tone for their visit from the moment they arrive. Sauna Experience - walk guests through the layout, how their session flows, and what to expect from the saunas, plunge pools and shared spaces and answer questions along the way. Look out for how guests are doing and step in gently when someone needs a hand. Keeping the Heat Right - look after the saunas throughout the day, making sure every sauna is at its best temperature for each session by chopping and stacking firewood, lighting the stoves and tending them through your shift, or switching electric heaters on and off safely. Keeping Sessions Flowing - manage check-ins and check-outs, hand out wristbands, and keep transitions between sessions smooth and on time. Support & Presence - be on hand to answer questions, guide guests, and look after anyone who's new or a little nervous, help them feel confident and cared for. Closing Conversation - thank guests as they leave, ask about their experience, and let them know about rebooking, offers and memberships. Cleanliness & Presentation Towel Rituals - prepare and roll fresh towels for each session and keep stations well stocked and looking their best. A Tidy Space - keep reception, changing rooms and refreshment stations spotless throughout the day. Session Turnarounds - reset the venue between sessions: benches wiped, water topped up, towels replenished. Clean the saunas, changing rooms, showers and toilets daily. . Deep Clean Days - take part in scheduled weekly and monthly cleaning, including sauna deep clean, stoves and ash, laundry, and power washing our outdoor areas. Health, Safety & Wellbeing Sauna & Pool Know-How - understand the temperature, hygiene and etiquette guidelines across all our sauna and plunge experiences. Care for the plunge pools by doing daily cleaning, chemical treatment and pool testing, with full training provided. Confidence in the Unexpected - know your way around the venue's safety procedures so you can look after guests calmly if they ever need it. Lost Property - look after and log belongings left behind so they find their way back to their owners. Keeping Records - follow our simple reporting procedures so anything worth noting is logged properly. Arrivals & Bookings Check-In & Check-Out - use our booking system to check guests in, and handle cancellations, reschedules and voucher redemptions. Payments - process payments, gift vouchers, offers and memberships accurately. Stock Awareness - keep an eye on towels, water, merchandise and hygiene supplies, and flag anything running low or in need of attention. Communication & Teamwork Staying in the Loop - use our team tools to keep up with team notes, guest information and shift updates. Breaks & Cover - work with your supervisor on breaks and shift swaps so the team is always well covered. Guest Champion - share the feedback from guests and bring your own ideas for making the experience even better. About You You love the outdoors and working with others in a hands-on environment. Have a friendly demeanour, adapt well to new situations and are passionate about helping others as well as continuous learning and improvement. You enjoy a physically active role, in all weather. Required Skills and Experience Experience in a customer facing role. General maintenance experience is a bonus, as well as interest in Health & Wellness. Good communication skills, strong customer focus, punctual and dependable. Age over 18 years. Able and willing to carry out physical tasks in all weather, outdoor environments. Tasks involve cleaning, lifting and, at our wood-fired venues, chopping and carrying firewood. Right to work in Ireland full time without restrictions. Available to work up to 39 hours per week, Monday to Sunday. Ability to reliably commute and work at the job location Mon - Sun, with morning shift starting at 6:30 AM and afternoon shift ending at 9:30 PM. items.desc: Descrizione azienda Tecnologia, umanità, futuro: questa è Kalpa! Perché tecnologia? Siamo una tech company di consulenza e progettazione embedded la cui mission è guidare i propri clienti verso l’innovazione tecnologica attraverso lo sviluppo di progetti innovativi di AI, IoT, Computer Vision e Industria 4.0 in settori strategici come medicale, industriale, domotica ed energy. Perché umanità? In Kalpa, crediamo che il successo di un’azienda nasca da chi ci lavora ogni giorno. Per questo, offriamo un ambiente che valorizza benessere, crescita professionale e libertà di esprimersi, con benefit reali: smart working, welfare da 1.000€, possibilità di partecipare a workshop tecnici e momenti social. Perché futuro? Ora tocca a te! Se vuoi crescere, divertirti e fare la differenza, il team kalpico ti sta aspettando! Posizione Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Graphics and Simulation Engineer con P.IVA appassionato/a, pronto/a a contribuire a un progetto di intelligenza artificiale in ambito medicale. Il progetto riguarda la generazione di dati sintetici per l’addestramento di un modello di AI: scenari 3D renderizzati in diverse configurazioni, ripresi da telecamere posizionate dall’alto, con uscite RGB, di profondità e termiche. Le principali attività riguardano: Costruzione di modelli 3D parametrici in Unity o Blender per la generazione di scenari sintetici Definizione di parametri regolabili per ottenere variazioni controllate e generazione ripetibile delle scene Sviluppo di pipeline in Python per automatizzare la generazione e il rendering dei dataset Simulazione dei sensori (RGB, profondità, termico) per ottenere dati il più possibile realistici e utili all’addestramento del modello L'attività può essere svolta anche in remoto. Requisiti Il profilo ideale… Ha maturato: Esperienza con Unity o Unreal Engine Buona conoscenza di Blender Ottima conoscenza di Python , in particolare per l’automazione di pipeline Conoscenza delle tecniche di rendering e dei modelli di sensore È una persona: Curiosa, intraprendente ed entusiasta Che affronta problemi complessi con ingegno, metodo e determinazione Che sa lavorare in squadra e crede nel valore della condivisione Con un mindset proattivo, orientato al risultato… e al buonumore! Nice to have: 4 o più anni di esperienza nel ruolo Gradita esperienza nella generazione di dati sintetici per AI e computer vision (es. procedural generation, domain randomization, BlenderProc, NVIDIA Omniverse/Isaac Sim) Cosa troverai in Kalpa Un ambiente di lavoro positivo e stimolante all’interno di un’azienda riconosciuta come Best Workplace e Best Workplace for Innovation, dove le persone e il loro benessere sono un valore chiave Flessibilità del lavoro in un ambiente attento a garantire un buon equilibrio vita-lavoro, benessere e tempo libero Area relax ed eventi sociali (aperitivi, attività di team building, iniziative sportive…) Si valutano solo collaborazioni in P.IVA. Altre informazioni Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91.

items.title: Junior Business Data Analyst
items.card: About the Role We're looking for a curious and driven Junior Business Data Analyst with 2–4 years of experience to join our Data & Sensory team. The team combines deep expertise in taste science with data analysis to power taste intelligence solutions for leading Food & Beverage companies. We're now adding a profile that sits between the data and the business impact it creates. What you'll do ● Turn client requests
items.desc: Who is VINHOOD? VINHOOD is a technology company specialized in collecting — through online services, events, and partnerships — and analyzing consumption data through a proprietary sensory model. We have developed an online service that detects consumer preferences (Taste Test, www.vinhood.com) and translates them into sensory profiles composed of multiple variables. These profiles are used to segment consumers across food and beverage categories, supporting tailored services for companies in the FMCG sector. Behind the model there are 3 million taste profiles, 100 million data points across 43 countries, and ten years of algorithm development. At VINHOOD, we foster a highly dynamic work environment. Our teams are made up of young, energetic, and curious individuals, with a constant exchange of skills, perspectives, and work styles. People are at the heart of our growth — free to take initiative, innovate, and help shape the future of a continuously evolving company. About the Role We're looking for a curious and driven Junior Business Data Analyst with 2–4 years of experience to join our Data & Sensory team. The team combines deep expertise in taste science with data analysis to power taste intelligence solutions for leading Food & Beverage companies. We're now adding a profile that sits between the data and the business impact it creates. What you'll do ● Turn client requests into clear analytical questions, and structure the data work needed to answer them. ● Design data collection together with our sensory experts: define what to ask, whom to ask, and how to structure responses so the resulting data can actually answer the question. ● Analyze survey and taste test responses to identify consumer taste patterns, and translate them into business-relevant takeaways. ● Explore how product performance relates to taste clusters, supporting client decisions on new product development, portfolio optimization, and positioning across markets. ● Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports that make taste and consumer data easy to use for internal teams and clients. ● Present your results clearly, adapting the level of detail to the audience. You'll do this day to day with Google Sheets, SQL, Python, BI dashboards, and AI tools. Who you are Essential ● Master's degree (Laurea Magistrale) in a quantitative field: Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Data Science or similar. ● 2–4 years of working experience in data or business analysis. ● Solid data analysis skills: you can clean, aggregate, and interpret data independently. ● Comfortable working with imperfect data: a significant part of the work is checking and preparing data before the analysis begins. ● Strong business judgment: you can look at a dataset and identify what's actually useful to know, not just what's interesting to measure. ● Solid foundations in statistics (hypothesis testing, confidence intervals) and mathematics (algebra, calculus). ● Solid working knowledge of SQL and Python, and hands-on experience with BI tools. ● Proficient-level written and spoken English and Italian required. ● Autonomy: you can own your work without close supervision. ● Curiosity and initiative: you see your own growth as your responsibility. Nice to have ● Experience on projects involving customer data and behaviour ● Interest in taste, sensory experience, gastronomy, or the Food & Beverage sector What we offer ● A chance to work in a cutting-edge industry, where science and creativity shape the future of food. ● A strong culture of continuous learning, to grow your technical, analytical, and business skills from day one. ● Hybrid work model: up to 3 days of remote work per week. ● Office located in the heart of Milan (Piazza della Repubblica 32). ● Full-time permanent contract, gross annual salary (RAL) between €35,000 and €45,000, depending on background and experience. ● Growth through the management of complex projects and direct client interaction. ● Strong cross-functional collaboration and continuous training. We will evaluate your CV based on educational and professional experience and achievements related to the role. Any personal information (such as nationality, religion, age, etc.) will not be considered in the selection process, and you may remove it from your CV. VINHOOD is an equal opportunity employer and values workforce diversity. https://business.vinhood.com/it/ https://www.vinhood.com/ Retribuzione: €35.000,00 - €45.000,00 all'anno Benefit: Assicurazione sanitaria Buoni pasto Computer aziendale Snack gratis Sede di lavoro: Ibrido/da remoto (20124 Milano)

items.desc: The candidate will work alongside colleagues to achieve company objectives, with a primary focus on: Design, development, testing, and documentation of software components for complex control systems. Continuous improvement, debugging, and troubleshooting of existing products. Duties and ResponsibilitiesPlanning: Define activity schedules with the Department Manager and Project Manager to ensure timely delivery. Development: Develop and optimize C++ software in Windows and Linux environments. R&D Collaboration: Partner with the Engineering and R&D teams to implement innovative technical solutions focused on continuous improvement. Verification: Perform technical audits, performance testing, and software debugging. Version Control: Manage code versioning and ensure development process quality using dedicated tools (e.g., Git). Documentation: Prepare technical documentation (reports, manuals, accounting, and presentations) to certify product compliance with project requirements. Project Management support: Collaborate with management to estimate effort and determine costs for new projects. Professional Growth: Proactively participate in training plans to develop personal and corporate competencies. Skills & Requirements Must Have: C++ Proficiency: Intermediate to high-level programming. Operating Systems: Proficiency in Windows. Scripting: Proficiency in Python. Version Control: Experience with tools such as Git. Should Have: Containerization: Competence with software like Docker. Control Theory: Knowledge of control algorithms (e.g., PID). Low-Level C++: Experience with low-level system programming. Real-Time Systems: Interest or initial experience with RTOS (Real-Time Operating Systems). Nice to Have: Familiarity with neural network optimization and deployment frameworks (e.g., TensorRT). Soft Skills: Strong team player. Technical curiosity and a growth-oriented mindset. Precision, reliability, and high attention to detail. Problem-solving skills and the ability to manage unexpected challenges. Education & LogisticsEducation: Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent diploma with relevant professional experience. Languages: Good command of written and spoken English. Location: Padua (Padova), Italy. Flexibility: Smart Working options available. Travel: Availability for occasional travel (< 5% of the time), coordinated with management. Company Description Dynamic Optics is a pioneering company specializing in adaptive optics technologies, addressing the growing demand for precision in imaging and laser processing applications. The company focuses on solutions like defocus adjustment, aberration correction, and light shaping that traditional optics cannot achieve with required accuracy and speed. Combining advanced research, market insights, and innovation, Dynamic Optics designs and manufactures multi-actuator adaptive lenses, deformable mirrors, and wavefront sensors. These products serve applications in microscopy, vision science, astronomy, high-power lasers, and defense industries. items.desc: Job Description Statutory Financial Statements Specialist Posting Date: 02/11/2026 Country: Italy Location: Milan Function: Administration, Planning & Controlling Experience: 3 - 5 years We are a global leader in the tire industry, specialized in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing high-performance tires for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. With a presence in over 160 countries and around 18 production facilities, we pride ourselves on our cutting-edge technology and commitment to sustainability. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do, and it is fueled by our commitment to the inclusion of unique perspectives and different experiences. Because power is nothing without our people! WHY JOIN US We are offering a rewarding role with scope for career progression along with: International, engaging, and supportive working environment. Global onboarding process. Bespoke training and development programs accessible to all. Competitive welfare and benefits package. International mobility opportunities. DRIVE YOUR FUTURE The candidate will join the Financial Statements & Administration Department, supporting statutory accounting and financial reporting activities for the Italian companies of the Pirelli Group. Reporting directly to the Head of Statutory Financial Statements, they will contribute to the preparation of analyses and documentation related to accounting, reporting, and closing processes, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and timely delivery. YOUR CORE ACTIVITIES Perform general accounting activities for the Italian companies of the Group and support the preparation of statutory financial statements in line with ITA GAAP or IFRS and of quarterly reporting packages. Support the monthly, quarterly and annual closing processes, ensuring the accuracy, completeness and reliability of financial information in compliance with statutory requirements and Group reporting standards. Manage selected phases of the capitalization process for tangible and intangible assets in accordance with Italian accounting standards and IAS/IFRS, including IFRS 16 requirements. Monitor administrative activities performed through shared service centers, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, general ledger accounting, treasury activities and intercompany reconciliations. Perform balance sheet account reconciliations and related analyses, ensuring data consistency and accuracy. Support the external audit process by preparing audit documentation, coordinating information requests and interacting with external auditors throughout the review and statutory audit activities. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Finance, Controlling, Tax, Treasury and Shared Services teams, to ensure consistency, accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting activities. Contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting, reporting and financial closing processes. WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. 3/4 years of professional experience gained in audit firms or multinational companies, preferably in controlling, accounting or similar roles. Good knowledge of Italian accounting standards and IAS/IFRS. Knowledge of SAP modules (FI/CO/MM/AA/SD) and Oracle applications. Good understanding of Italian corporate and tax regulations. Good knowledge of English and Italian. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. WHAT PUTS YOU IN POLE POSITION Strong attention to details, team worker and effective communicator. Adaptability, entrepreneurship and working with methods. Autonomy, ability to plan activities, manage priorities and meet deadlines. COMPENSATION PACKAGE The employment contract will be regulated by “Gomma Plastica” National Collective Bargaining Agreement The gross annual base salary (RAL) offered will be no less than 35.000,00 Euro The Company is committed to offering a competitive compensation package and, following the selection process, may propose a final gross annual base salary above the stated level, commensurate with the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications The position’s compensation package also includes a variable component and a competitive welfare and benefits offer. Further details will be provided at a later stage and will be subject to the applicable Company policies , DRIVE YOUR FUTURE! #WePirelli We are an equal opportunity employer and this search is open to all individuals, in compliance with the principles of equal opportunity and non-discrimination, pursuant to applicable laws and regulations.

items.desc: OUR STORY: \uD83C\uDDEA\uD83C\uDDFA Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow ! Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies. Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector. With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants. Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen. \uD83D\uDCCD Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon. WHY WE NEED YOU ? Our growth is driving us to strengthen our UX Research team within the Product & Design department to scale our research capabilities and better support product decisions across our core cloud infrastructure. Your mission will be to lead impactful user research on highly technical products, while developing scalable ResearchOps practices and empowering product teams to conduct research independently, in order to embed user insights into product strategy and continuously improve the experience of our cloud infrastructure users. YOUR FUTURE TEAM We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together. You will join a growing team of 2 UX Researchers , within the Design department, working closely with Product Managers and Product Designers across different tribes. The team focuses on making user research more continuous, accessible and impactful across Scaleway's product organization. Key initiatives include scaling ResearchOps, developing our Insight Hub, enabling People Who Do Research (PwDR), and responsibly integrating AI into research workflows. You will also collaborate with Solution Architects, Customer Success and Marketing teams when relevant, gaining exposure to a wide range of technical products and customer needs. YOUR DAILY ROUTINE Lead end-to-end UX research initiatives, from discovery to usability testing and continuous research, focusing on cloud infrastructure products and technical users such as developers, DevOps engineers and system administrators. Partner closely with Product Managers and Product Designers to identify research opportunities, frame relevant research questions and translate findings into actionable product recommendations. Collaborate with Product Designers to make highly technical concepts (e.g. provisioning, networking, storage configuration) understandable and usable, helping Scaleway stand out for usability in a historically technical industry. Develop and scale ResearchOps practices, including research workflows, methodologies, templates and insight management processes. Contribute to the development and adoption of the Insight Hub, ensuring research findings are accessible, reusable and actionable across multiple product tribes. Empower Product Managers, Product Designers and other PwDRs to conduct high-quality research independently through coaching, training and practical research guidelines. Explore and integrate AI-powered tools and automated workflows to improve research efficiency while maintaining methodological rigor and responsible practices. Identify cross-product user needs and behavioral patterns to generate insights that extend beyond individual features or product teams. Advocate for user-centered decision-making, communicate research findings effectively and follow up on their impact on product roadmaps and strategic priorities. ABOUT YOU HARDSKILLS : UX Research expertise: 4+ years of experience in UX Research, or UX Design with a strong research focus, including discovery research, usability testing, quantitative and qualitative research methodologies. Technical product experience: Proven experience researching complex B2B products, ideally in cloud infrastructure, developer tools, SaaS or enterprise technology, with the ability to understand technical users and unfamiliar technical concepts. ResearchOps & continuous research: Experience structuring scalable research processes, managing research insights and repositories, and contributing to continuous or always-on research practices.
