 Valutare l’affidabilità creditizia dei clienti di Alphabet Italia, assicurando il pieno rispetto delle normative vigenti e delle policy aziendali, per garantire decisioni solide e consapevoli.
 Supportare attivamente la rete vendite nella preparazione delle Credit Application, facilitando un processo efficiente e fluido.
 Gestire con precisione la contribuzione del portafoglio clienti alle centrali rischi private (SIC).
 Effettuare controlli periodici sull’affidabilità dei fornitori e partner di Alphabet Italia, assicurando collaborazioni di qualità.
 Partecipare attivamente all’aggiornamento e allo sviluppo degli applicativi dedicati alla valutazione del merito creditizio, contribuendo all’innovazione e all’efficienza dei processi. 
 Cosa porti con te? 
 Laurea in materie Economiche o Giuridiche.
 Esperienza di almeno 2 anni in ambito B2B e B2C.
 Curiosità, entusiasmo e proattività sono caratteristiche della tua personalità.
 Vuoi entrare a far parte di un ambiente lavorativo dinamico e coinvolgente.
 Predisposizione al cambiamento e adattabilità fanno parte di te.
 Sei un team player, in grado di instaurare relazioni con gli stakeholder esterni e interni.
 Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office (in particolare Excel e Power Point).
 Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese.
 Ti piacerebbe salire a bordo? Vieni a scoprire la passione che ci guida, candidati ora! 
 Cosa offriamo? 
 Ambiente di lavoro innovativo e internazionale.
 Cultura aziendale orientata alla sostenibilità.
 Worklife balance: orario flessibile, smart working, light Friday.
 Opportunità di carriere internazionali.
 Percorsi di formazione e sviluppo personalizzati.
 Diventare ambasciatore di un Brand Premium.
 Retribuzione: a partire da 35.000€ in base all’esperienza, in linea con le aziende di Brand Premium; bonus variabile al raggiungimento degli obiettivi personali e aziendali.
 Benefit per le nostre Persone: ticket da 8 €; soluzioni di mobilità; misure di sostegno alla genitorialità; supporto allo studio; campagne di health care; previdenza integrativa; cassa assistenza spese mediche; Polizze assicurative…e molto altro.
 Sede : San Donato Milanese (MI)
 Data di inizio prevista : Novembre 2026
 Tipologia contratto : Tempo indeterminato
 Orario di lavoro : Full time
 Inquadramento : Impiegato CCNL Commercio
 Il nostro iter di selezione: 
 Primo colloquio conoscitivo con i referenti HR.
 Due colloqui in base alla seniority con i responsabili e referenti HR di business.
 Sono previsti feedback ad ogni step del processo di selezione anche in caso di esito negativo.
 Le persone interessate possono inviare la propria candidatura con autorizzazione ai sensi del Regolamento UE 2016/679 (GDPR) e del D.Lgs. 196/2003 e successive modifiche. L’offerta di lavoro rispetta il D.Lgs 198/2006.
All’interno del Gruppo BMW attribuiamo grande valore all’uguaglianza di trattamento e alle pari opportunità. Le nostre scelte di selezione si basano sulla personalità, l’esperienza e le competenze dei candidati.

items.desc:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Facebook, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. The people of Adyen are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
 Financial Products 
The Financial Products solution is responsible for all financial products that we offer on top of payments processing to our customers. Examples of these are our Banking, Issuing, Fx, and Capital products. Whether we work with large partner platforms, medium sized local merchants, or major international enterprise businesses, our products need to meet our clients expectations and seamlessly fit into their systems.
 What you’ll do: 
 Work on complex technical projects from requirements analysis through design, implementation, testing and launch into production.
 Be hands-on and contribute to the implementation.
 Identify and improve parts of the platform to make it more robust and scalable.
 Bring your own point of view on best engineering practices.
 Your code will be used at scale and you are expected to think in that mindset when building features.
 We launch fast and iterate often. Concretely, this means that within your first few weeks, you will bring live functionalities that impact many merchants and shoppers.
 Build APIs and tooling according to quality principles such as performance and code quality.
 Collaborate across teams and time zones to get projects over the finish line.
 Who you are: 
 Familiar with complex large scale distributed systems.
 You have experience with Java, Web Services, REST Apis, Webhooks and SQL/PostgreSql.
 You have a good understanding of Software Engineering practices and interest in product knowledge.
 You enjoy working in a cross-functional team with roles like Data Science, Frontend, and Product.
 You value involving other people to hear different perspectives.
 You have an experimental mindset with a launch fast and iterate mentality.
 Minimum qualifications: 
 3+ years of experience in software development industry in a fast paced tech environment
 Full professional proficiency in English
 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration (3 days in the office); we do not offer remote-only roles.
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application.
 What’s next? 
Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

About the Role We are looking for an experienced Sportsbook Software Architect with strong expertise in sports betting and iGaming platforms to design and evolve scalable, high-performance sportsbook systems. The ideal candidate combines deep sportsbook domain knowledge with strong experience in distributed systems, microservices, real-time processing, and cloud architecture. Key Responsibilities Design and evolve end-to-end architecture for sportsbook platforms, including odds feeds, trading, bet placement, settlement, risk, and player management. Architect high-volume, low-latency systems supporting both pre-match and live betting. Design integrations with odds providers, trading platforms, content providers, payments, CRM, KYC, and risk systems. Define scalable microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, event-driven architectures, and real-time data flows. Ensure reliability, security, observability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery across critical sportsbook services. Work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, Risk, Compliance, and Operations teams. Support regulatory and compliance requirements including UKGC, MGA, responsible gambling, audit, and anti-fraud controls. Guide engineering teams and promote architecture, coding, testing, and DevOps best practices. Qualifications & Experience 3+ years of experience as a Software/Solution Architect with strong Sportsbook/iGaming experience. Strong understanding of sportsbook domain and betting lifecycle, including: Pre-match & live betting Odds feeds and pricing Markets and events Betslip & bet processing Trading and odds management Settlement Player profiling, risk & stake controls Strong experience with microservices, distributed systems, REST/gRPC, and event-driven architecture. Experience with technologies such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js, Go, or similar. Experience with Kafka/RabbitMQ, SQL/NoSQL databases, and Redis or other caching technologies. Strong experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code. Experience with high-performance, real-time systems and live data/streaming architectures. Excellent communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Nice to Have Experience with sportsbook platform migration or modernization. Knowledge of UKGC/MGA regulatory requirements. Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP architecture, and TOGAF.What We Offer Competitive compensation package. Collaborative and supportive working environment. Professional growth, mentorship, and internal career development opportunities. Opportunity to work on real-world software products and international projects. Exposure to modern technologies, engineering practices, and innovative solutions. Cross-functional collaboration with experienced engineers, designers, and QA professionals. An environment that values ownership, initiative, and the impact of your work. Equal Opportunity Employer Statertek is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and respectful working environment where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or background. Explore our opportunities: career.statertek.com Learn more about us: www.statertek.com

Il Ruolo Sviluppare applicazioni, moduli e funzionalità della piattaforma Genesi. Realizzare componenti e librerie riutilizzabili per Digital Twin di macchine automatiche e linee. Sviluppare strumenti per la modellazione, configurazione e interazione con ambienti virtuali industriali. Realizzare plugin e integrazioni con PLC, robot, sensori, sistemi di visione e altri sistemi industriali. Sviluppare applicazioni 3D interattive per simulazione, visualizzazione e training. Contribuire all’architettura software, alla qualità del codice e all’evoluzione tecnologica della piattaforma. Integrare funzionalità AI e strumenti di analisi dati nelle applicazioni Digital Twin. Ottimizzare prestazioni, rendering, stabilità e scalabilità delle soluzioni. Attitudine alla collaborazione con team tecnici multidisciplinari. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Cosa può fare la differenza... Esperienza con Unreal Engine. Conoscenza di Python, Computer Graphics o UI/UX per applicazioni 3D. Esperienza con NVIDIA Omniverse. Conoscenza dei processi e delle architetture tipiche delle macchine automatiche. În cadrul grupului nostru de fabrici, Siemens AG dezvoltă și produce motoare electrice pentru piața globală. Clienții noștri țintă activează în domeniul tehnologiilor de automatizare, în industria auto și în zona de intralogistică. 
 In prezent cautam un Packaging Specialist care sa se alature echipei de logistica. 
 Responsabilitatea principala va fi asigurraea managementului operational end-to-end al ambalajelor returnabile si nereutilizabile, cu focus pe disponibilitate, circulatie, stocuri, calitate, cost si trasabilitate. Administreaza procesele si datele in BinMan, coordoneaza activitatea furnizorului de spalare si actioneaza ca punct central de contact pentru clienti, furnizori, transportatori si functiile interne. Contribuie la standardizarea, digitalizarea si imbunatatirea continua a circuitului de ambalaje, pentru sustinerea productiei si a livrarilor. 
 Descrierea postului: 
 • Administreaza operativ BinMan si asigura utilizarea corecta a sistemului, inclusiv actualizarea datelor, monitorizarea miscarilor, reconcilierea soldurilor si tratarea abaterilor. 
 • Monitorizeaza disponibilitatea, circulatia, stocurile, timpii de ciclu, pierderile si deteriorarile ambalajelor; initiaza masuri corective si escaladeaza riscurile care pot afecta productia sau livrarile. 
 • Coordoneaza activitatea furnizorului de spalare: planificare, prioritati, capacitate, volume, timpi de procesare, calitate, trasabilitate si respectarea nivelului de serviciu agreat. 
 • Verifica rezultatele spalarii si conditionarii ambalajelor, gestioneaza deviatiile de calitate si urmareste implementarea actiunilor corective impreuna cu furnizorul si functiile interne relevante. 
 • Coordoneaza operational relatia cu clientii si furnizorii pentru cerinte, disponibilitate, livrari/retururi, diferente de sold, reclamatii, pierderi, deteriorari si reguli de utilizare a ambalajelor. 
 • Asigura necesarul de ambalaje pentru productie si livrari, respectiv disponibilitatea ambalajelor la furnizori, in corelare cu volumele si prioritatile operationale. 
 • Coordoneaza fluxurile de transport asociate ambalajelor si confirma executia acestora pe baza planificarii si a documentelor disponibile. 
 • Mentine si verifica instructiunile, retetele si datele de ambalare; initiaza crearea sau modificarea acestora impreuna cu functiile responsabile si sustine standardizarea conceptelor de ambalare. 
 • Defineste si urmareste indicatori operationali relevanti: disponibilitate, acuratete stoc, timp de ciclu, restante, pierderi/deteriorari, calitate spalare, cost si nivel de serviciu. 
 • Pregateste rapoarte periodice si analize, conduce revizuiri operationale cu partenerii si documenteaza deciziile, responsabilitatile si termenele. 
 • Participa la proiecte de optimizare, relabeling, transfer, introducere de ambalaje noi, reducere de cost, digitalizare si sustenabilitate. 
 • Asigura respectarea standardelor interne, a instructiunilor de lucru, a cerintelor de calitate, EHS, curatenie, reutilizare si reducere a deseurilor. 
 • Instruieste utilizatorii si partenerii privind procesele de packaging si BinMan si actioneaza ca punct de escaladare operationala in aria sa de responsabilitate. 
 • Indeplineste si alte sarcini dispuse de superiorul direct, in limita competentelor si a ariei postului.

items.desc:
Lieu : La Ciotat, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
En nous rejoignant à La Ciotat, vous intégrez un site idéalement localisé sur le littoral méditerranéen, au sein d'un environnement international regroupant nos activités d'identité et de sécurité numériques. 
 En intégrant notre équipe, vous participez à l’innovation dans la supervision approfondie de modèles d’intelligence artificielle évoluant dans des environnements complexes, en analysant leur fonctionnement réel, leurs décisions et interactions à travers diverses architectures distribuées. 
 Pour ce faire vous avez à : 
 - Explorer l’état de l’art et identifier les limites des méthodes actuelles. 
 - Définir des mécanismes pour caractériser le comportement des systèmes d’IA. 
 - Concevoir un monitoring multi-niveaux intégrant embarqué, edge et cloud. 
 - Étudier la détection et l’analyse des comportements inattendus et risques. 
 - Développer et intégrer des prototypes fonctionnels pour tester les concepts. 
 - Mettre en place des expérimentations et analyser les résultats. 
 - Réaliser des démonstrations concrètes pour valoriser les résultats. 
 - Contribuer à la veille scientifique et proposer des pistes d’innovation. 
 Votre profil : 
 Vous êtes actuellement en 5e année d’un cursus en ingénierie ou en master, avec une spécialité en intelligence artificielle, informatique, robotique, systèmes autonomes ou traitement de la donnée. 
 Vous possédez les compétences suivantes :
 - Bonnes bases en intelligence artificielle, apprentissage automatique et développement logiciel, notamment en Python. 
 - Capacité à concevoir, intégrer, tester et évaluer rapidement des solutions techniques dans des environnements évolutifs. 
 Autonomie, rigueur, capacité d’apprentissage et goût prononcé pour la résolution concrète de problèmes au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire. 
 - Bonnes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de communication en français et en anglais. 
 Les plus :
 Une première expérience ou un fort intérêt pour la s upervision de modèles d’IA, l’analyse comportementale, la robotique, les systèmes embarqués, les architectures edge/cloud, les LLM, les systèmes autonomes ou l’évaluation de systèmes d’IA. 
 Curieux, autonome et orienté vers l’expérimentation, vous aimez explorer des approches nouvelles, les confronter rapidement à la pratique et transformer une idée en un système fonctionnel, observable et démontrable.
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 
 When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.

 Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.

 Afin d'optimiser notre flow de développement de produits sécurisés, vous prenez part au développement d'un workflow d'intelligence artificielle agentique. Bist du bereit, mit dem Besten zu rechnen ? 
 Es geht um Entscheidungen. Um Menschen, denen wir im Schadenfall zur Seite stehen. Und zunehmend um die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Mensch und KI. Bei Zurich entwickeln wir Claims neu: digital stark, im Schadenfall nah und immer agil. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die nicht einfach Fälle bearbeiten, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen. 
 Das erwartet dich 
 In deiner neuen Rolle als Claims Handler bewertest du Deckung, Haftung und Umfang des Schadens und begleitest deine Fälle bis zur Regulierung 
 Moderne Systeme und digitale Prozesse gehören für dich zum Alltag 
 Du stehst täglich in Kontakt mit Kund:innen, Anspruchsteller:innen, Rechtsanwält:innen sowie Partnern 
 Du bist Teil eines Teams, das Themen gemeinsam denkt, Wissen teilt und voneinander lernt 
 Das bringst du mit

 Als Entscheider suchst du zielgerichtete Lösungen und bleibst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen gelassen 
 Du hast Lust, aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Prozesse mitzuwirken 
 Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und machst Weiterentwicklung – sowohl unsere als auch deine – zu einem festen Bestandteil deines Arbeitsalltags 
 Diese Stelle ist IDD-relevant. Die Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD) richtet sich als Vertriebsrichtlinie an alle Personen, die am Vertrieb von Versicherungen beteiligt sind. Bei Einstellung benötigen wir gem. § 48 VAG deine Erklärung zu deiner Zuverlässigkeit und deinen Vermögensverhältnissen sowie den Nachweis deiner angemessenen Qualifikation.

 Flexible Arbeitsformen für eine optimale Balance zwischen Arbeiten am Arbeitsplatz und von zu Hause aus 
 Zahlreiche Trainings- und Lernangebote, um fit für den Arbeitsalltag zu bleiben und eine individuelle Weiterentwicklung zu ermöglichen 
 Unterstützung bei deiner Karriereplanung - von der Potenzialanalyse bis hin zur individuellen Förderung 
 Eine moderne, offene und transparente Arbeitsumgebung, die Kreativität und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit fördert 
 Ob Fitness in der Gruppe vor Ort oder virtuelles Achtsamkeitstraining von zu Hause: Unser vielfältiges Gesundheitsangebot unterstützt eine gesunde Work ‑ Life ‑ Balance 
 Bikeleasing, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, ein Mitarbeitenden ‑ Aktienprogramm und weitere tolle Benefits 
 Z usätzliche Informationen 
 Die Zurich Gruppe Deutschland unterstützt in Abhängigkeit zur individuellen Stellenanforderung und der persönlichen Eignung grundsätzlich sowohl flexible als auch Teilzeit-Arbeitsformen. Wenn du Interesse an dieser Stelle hast und deine persönliche Situation nicht ganz mit dem angegebenen Pensum (Voll- und Teilzeit) zusammenpasst, wende dich gerne an uns ( k.schmidt@zurich.com ), um die potenziellen Möglichkeiten zu besprechen.

 Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: Vollzeit 
 Kim Schmidt freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen und des möglichen Starttermins über das Karriereportal (“Jetzt Bewerben”-Button). Leider können wir Bewerbungen per E-Mail nicht berücksichtigen. 
 Willkommen in deiner Zukunft 
 55.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen in 215 Ländern und Gebieten. Gemeinsam auf dem Weg, Versicherung jeden Tag neu zu denken – und die Zukunft für alle zu gestalten. Willkommen in einer starken Gemeinschaft, in der du von Anfang an etwas bewegst. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir uns weiter!

 Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten 
 Du trittst professionell auf und bringst eine hohe Dienstleistungsmentalität mit

items.title: Technicien de réparation (F/H)
items.card: Vos missions seront les suivantes : 1. Vous réalisez la réparation des différents appareils et accessoires auditifs : Vous effectuez le dépistage des pannes des appareils et accessoires envoyés par le client Vous réparez les appareils et accessoires en remplaçant les pièces défectueuses, dans le respect de nos procédures techniques Vous saisissez les actions réalisées dans notre système informatique (SAP) Vous
items.desc:
Poste basé à BRON (69) à pourvoir dès que possible. 
Sonova France est le leader mondial dans la fabrication d'équipements auditifs. Forte de ses marques coeur Phonak , Unitron et Hansaton , l'entreprise vend des produits à haute valeur ajoutée à ses clients audioprothésistes partout en France. 
 Pour assurer la meilleure expérience client, Sonova France assure à ses clients la réparation des produits en panne, grâce à l'engagement et à l'expertise de ses 30 collaborateurs du Service Technique. 
 Rejoindre ce service, c'est rejoindre un collectif formé, efficace et tourné vers la satisfaction client. Vos missions seront les suivantes : 
 1. Vous réalisez la réparation des différents appareils et accessoires auditifs :
 Vous effectuez le dépistage des pannes des appareils et accessoires envoyés par le client
 Vous réparez les appareils et accessoires en remplaçant les pièces défectueuses, dans le respect de nos procédures techniques
 Vous saisissez les actions réalisées dans notre système informatique (SAP)
 Vous participez aux actions connexes du service, comme par exemple l'inventaire des pièces détachées
 2. Vous assurer le contrôle électroacoustique des différents appareils et accessoires :
 Vous vérifiez le bon fonctionnement des appareils réparés avant leur réexpédition au client en réalisant le test électroacoustique à l'aide des équipements à disposition (caisson acoustique, chaîne de mesure)
 3. Vous êtes en charge de l'enregistrement des demandes de réparation dans notre système informatique :
 Lorsque vous recevez un appareil en panne, vous pointez les éléments reçus et vérifiez que le contenu annoncé par le client correspond bien aux éléments reçus (numéro de saisie, etc.)
 Vous enregistrez ensuite les demandes de réparation dans notre systèmes informatique (SAP)
 Ce poste peut aussi comprendre des missions d'expédition des produits réparés. Cela consiste à clôturer la réparation dans notre outil informatique (SAP), à générer le bon de livraison et l'étiquette de transport et enfin à emballer les produits réparés dans le colis d'envoi.
 Le profil recherché
 Travail de précision, vous êtes à l'aise avec la manipulation manuelle, le travail en cadence et le travail sous objectifs. ⏱️
 Vous savez faire preuve de minutie dans des tâches répétitives, avec le juste équilibre entre rapidité d'exécution et dextérité. ️
 Vous avez déjà travaillé avec des outils informatiques type Pack Office, messagerie Outlook. La connaissance d'un ERP/logiciel de saisie est un plus.
 Vous aimez le travail en équipe, et savez communiquez sur ce que vous faîtes, demander et proposer votre aide si nécessaire, et créer du lien avec vos collègues grâce à votre ouverture.
 Vous êtes quelqu'un sur qui on peut compter.

items.desc:
Conectamos el presente. Transformamos el futuro. 
 ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado qué hace posible que millones de personas estén conectadas al mismo tiempo, desde cualquier lugar del mundo, sin que nada falle? 
 En Telefónica, hacemos que sea posible. 
 Somos una compañía global de telecomunicaciones y tecnología que conecta a personas, empresas y comunidades a través de redes de última generación y soluciones digitales avanzadas como cloud, inteligencia artificial, IoT o ciberseguridad. 
 Con una trayectoria de más de 100 años, trabajamos cada día para que la innovación esté al servicio de la sociedad, impulsando una transformación digital responsable, sostenible y con impacto real. 
 Aquí no solo diseñamos infraestructuras, diseñamos el futuro . Buscamos personas que tengan inquietudes, entusiasmo y pasión por lo que hacen, que no se conformen y que quieran crear la Telefónica del mañana. 
 Si te apasiona la tecnología que transforma vidas, este es tu lugar. 
 El área de CDO (Chief Digital Officer) de Telefónica Innovación Digital (TID) es responsable de diseñar, desarrollar y operar productos y plataformas digitales de alto impacto que dan servicio a millones de clientes del Grupo Telefónica en todo el mundo. Se trata de un entorno tecnológico avanzado donde la innovación, la escalabilidad y la excelencia operativa son fundamentales para garantizar la calidad y disponibilidad de los servicios digitales. 
 ¿Cuál será tu misión? 🎯 
 Como Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), tu misión será mejorar la fiabilidad, escalabilidad y eficiencia operativa de las plataformas cloud de producción mediante la automatización, la observabilidad y la aplicación de buenas prácticas de ingeniería. 
 Trabajarás junto a equipos de desarrollo y operaciones para incorporar principios de resiliencia desde las fases iniciales del ciclo de vida de los servicios, contribuyendo a la estabilidad de las plataformas y a la mejora continua de los procesos operativos. 
 ¿Qué capacidades buscamos en ti? 🔎 
 Mentalidad orientada a la automatización, la mejora continua y la excelencia operativa. 
 Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente con equipos técnicos, de producto y de negocio. 
 Actitud proactiva en la identificación y resolución de problemas. 
 Experiencia trabajando en entornos ágiles bajo metodologías Scrum o Kanban. 
 Capacidad para trabajar de forma colaborativa y contribuir al crecimiento técnico del equipo. 
 Capacidad de automatización mediante Python, Go o Bash. 
 Nivel profesional de inglés. 
 ¿Cómo contribuirás con tus capacidades al propósito del rol? 💼 
 Diseñando y evolucionando estrategias de observabilidad mediante métricas, logs y trazas utilizando herramientas como Prometheus, Grafana y OpenTelemetry. 
 Gestionando infraestructuras cloud en GCP, AWS y/o Azure, garantizando disponibilidad, seguridad, escalabilidad y optimización de costes. 
 Automatizando procesos e infraestructura mediante Terraform y Helm para reducir tareas manuales y mejorar la eficiencia operativa. 
 Colaborando en la resolución de incidencias, escalaciones y mejora de procedimientos operativos 
 Trabajando junto a equipos de desarrollo para incorporar buenas prácticas de fiabilidad, resiliencia y operabilidad desde las fases de diseño. 
 Participando en guardias (on-call), respuesta a incidentes y análisis postmortem orientados al aprendizaje y la mejora continua. 
 Contribuyendo a la adopción de la cultura SRE y a la evolución de las prácticas de fiabilidad dentro del equipo. 
 ¿Qué otros aspectos valoramos? 📚 
 Titulación en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o áreas afines. 
 Al menos 3 años de experiencia en posiciones de SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering o Infraestructura en entornos cloud de producción. 
 Experiencia con plataformas cloud como Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS) o Microsoft Azure. 
 Experiencia en Infraestructura como Código utilizando Terraform y Helm. 
 Conocimientos de observabilidad mediante Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Elastic Stack o herramientas equivalentes. 
 Experiencia en gestión de incidencias, análisis postmortem y fundamentos de fiabilidad de servicios. 
 Experiencia en pipelines CI/CD mediante GitHub Actions, Jenkins o herramientas similares. 
 Certificaciones relacionadas con cloud, Kubernetes o DevOps (GCP Professional DevOps Engineer, AWS DevOps Engineer, Azure, CKA, entre otras). 
 Experiencia en entornos multi-cloud y gestión de infraestructuras híbridas. 
 Conocimientos de GitOps utilizando herramientas como ArgoCD o Flux. 
 ¿Qué ventajas tendrás por formar parte de nuestro equipo? 💙 
 Proyectos transformadores. En Telefónica formarás parte de proyectos de alto impacto, que marcan tendencia y responden a los retos de conectividad y transformación digital de nuestra sociedad.

items.desc:
Data Analyst 
 Global innovation for us. Personal development for you. 
 At the BMW Group, everything starts with passion. It turns a profession into a vocation. It drives us to keep reinventing mobility and bring innovative ideas onto the roads. Enthusiasm for joint projects turns a team into a strong unit where every opinion is valued. It is only when expertise, highly professional processes and enjoyment of work unite that we can shape the future together. All employees can and should contribute with their special skills to the unique culture of the BMW Group. We're searching for people who are as passionate as we are. Your expertise, your skill set, your motivation, and your individuality are what drive us forward.
 As a Data Science Specialist at the BMW Group Plant Debrecen, you will be responsible for analyzing and providing transparency into production data, while developing data-driven solutions to support informed decision-making, process optimization, and the development of a future-oriented production system.
 What awaits you? 
 Work environment – You will work in a modern, digitalized and future-oriented manufacturing environment, where the latest technologies and innovative solutions support the production of energy modules for electric vehicles.
 Team – You will be part of a highly skilled team that uses production data to supportdata-driven decision-making and the continuous improvement of quality management.
 Quality Management – You will be responsible for implementing the Quality Management System in the Energy Module production area and for its continuous improvement.
 IT and digitalization – one of your key responsibilities will be the development and continuous improvement of IT-related topics within the Quality Management System.
 Data-driven operations – by analyzing and utilizing production data, you will support data-driven decisionmaking and contribute to creating transparency within a high-volume manufacturing environment.
 Innovation – You will work on implementing and utilizing cutting-edge technologies that support innovation and the development of a future-oriented production system.
 What should you bring along? 
 Education – You hold a university degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics or Mechanical Engineering.
 Work experience - Professional experience in the automotive, energy or railway industry is an advantage.
 Work schedule - You are willing to work on-site at least 4 days a week during regular business hours.
 Language skills – You have confident, intermediate-level English language skills, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Hungarian or German languageis an advantage.
 Professional Skills – You have data management and data analysis knowledge, as well as a strong understanding of manufacturing and quality management processes. You have experience in developing data-driven solutions and increasing process transparency.
 IT skills – You are confident in using or eager to work with Python, JavaScript, SQL, and Cloud technologies. Knowledge of Power BI and other reporting or data visualization tools is an advantage.
 Soft skills – you have an analytical mindset and are able to work independently and in a structured manner. You have a high sense of responsibility and a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
 What do we offer? 
 Our goal is to motivate our employees and recognize their performance, which is why our benefits package includes the following elements in addition to the base salary:
 Bonus - performance-based bonus calculated based on corporate and personal results.
 Cafeteria - annual cafeteria allowance paid out monthly.
 Commuting Support - free, direct bus and train services from major cities in the region, aligned with shift schedules. Travel cost reimbursement for personal car usage is provided at the legally prescribed rate.
 Healthcare Services - high-quality healthcare services, physiotherapy, and therapeutic exercise option is available at the on-site health center.
 Private Health Insurance - after probation time, all associates entitled for health insurance, which contains outpatient care, laboratory- and diagnostics tests, outpatient and one-day surgery, screening tests, patient transport.
 Accident and Life Insurance - in work and out of work group accident and life insurance.
 Subsidized Meals - one daily discounted hot meal at the company cafeteria.
 Learn more about our benefits via this link: BMW Group Plant Debrecen Careers | About us | What we offer

Full-time, permanent employment.

 Technical Teamlead, Technical Support CS Region (f/m/x). 
 What awaits you? 
 Managing and continuously developing Technical Support across the CS Region markets to ensure consistent processes and high service quality.
 Ensuring efficient and solution-oriented Technical Support for BMW Group dealers, particularly in complex technical cases.
 Managing special tools and coordinating the special-tool rental process, including availability, distribution, and continuous process improvement.

 Facilitating the exchange of technical and business knowledge, and conducting dealer satisfaction surveys to identify opportunities for improvement.
 What should you bring along? 
 A passion for leading teams, fostering collaboration, and creating a supportive environment in which expertise and best practices are shared.
 A degree in a technical field, a master’s degree, or a master’s degree in a craftsperson qualification, ideally combined with sound automotive expertise.
 Previous experience within BMW is preferred, together with a good understanding of dealer processes and the BMW Group service environment.
 Fluent English for effective communication across the region; German language skills are preferred and considered an advantage.
 What do we offer you at Campus Salzburg ? 
 With us, you are guaranteed to find challenging and versatile opportunities to actively shape the sustainable mobility of the future. In addition to the motivating working environment in our dynamic teams, we offer a wide range of social benefits:
 A new flexible working environment at the Campus Salzburg with a wide range of possibilities for working (e.g. mobile work, creative spaces, library or directly in the department).
 Flexible working hours without core hours.
 You have the opportunity to experience a variety of our products and test them on the road yourself.
 Our canteen offers you a selection of various discounted meals every day.
 Locally and regionally, we can offer you great discounts through partnerships with various companies (e.g. gym, metro).
 Generous parking facilities directly on the Campus Salzburg.
 Internal initiatives with various events (e.g. initiatives on Sustainability, Health- and Work Environment & Sport).
 We are looking for you as soon as possible for an unlimited duration with an attractive salary & benefit package. The minimum salary for this position is € 3.800 gross per month. The actual salary depends on the respective qualification or professional experience, i.e. we determine the actual amount in a personal interview. A significant overpayment is possible with appropriate suitability.

 Coordinating Flying Doctors and their assignments to provide targeted on-site technical support to dealers and resolve challenging cases effectively.
 Facilitating the exchange of technical and business knowledge, and conducting dealer satisfaction surveys to identify opportunities for improvement.
 What should you bring along? 
 A passion for leading teams, fostering collaboration, and creating a supportive environment in which expertise and best practices are shared.
 A degree in a technical field, a master’s degree, or a master’s degree in a craftsperson qualification, ideally combined with sound automotive expertise.
 Previous experience within BMW is preferred, together with a good understanding of dealer processes and the BMW Group service environment.
 Fluent English for effective communication across the region; German language skills are preferred and considered an advantage.
 What do we offer you at Campus Salzburg ? 
 With us, you are guaranteed to find challenging and versatile opportunities to actively shape the sustainable mobility of the future. In addition to the motivating working environment in our dynamic teams, we offer a wide range of social benefits:
 A new flexible working environment at the Campus Salzburg with a wide range of possibilities for working (e.g. mobile work, creative spaces, library or directly in the department).
 Flexible working hours without core hours.
 You have the opportunity to experience a variety of our products and test them on the road yourself.
 Our canteen offers you a selection of various discounted meals every day.
 Locally and regionally, we can offer you great discounts through partnerships with various companies (e.g. gym, metro).
 Generous parking facilities directly on the Campus Salzburg.
 Internal initiatives with various events (e.g. initiatives on Sustainability, Health- and Work Environment & Sport).
 We are looking for you as soon as possible for an unlimited duration with an attractive salary & benefit package. The minimum salary for this position is € 3.800 gross per month. The actual salary depends on the respective qualification or professional experience, i.e. we determine the actual amount in a personal interview. A significant overpayment is possible with appropriate suitability. 
 Are you interested? Then apply now. We are looking forward to receiving your application.

WER NEUES DENKT, BEWEGT DIE ZUKUNFT. 
 BMW GROUP STIPENDIATENPROGRAMM FASTLANE. 
 Worauf kannst du dich freuen? 
 Attraktive finanzielle Unterstützung während der Programmlaufzeit von 3 Semestern . 
 Verschiedene, flexibel planbare Praxiseinsätze mit einer Dauer von mind. 360 Stunden. 
 Masterarbeit bei der BMW Group und individuelles Mentoring . 
 Unterschiedliche Qualifizierungsbausteine zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung . 
 Spannende Infoveranstaltungen und Networking – auch in Teamprojekten. 
 Welche Themen erwarten dich? 
 Je nach Studienrichtung und Interessen, arbeitest du in unseren engagierten Teams an innovativen und nachhaltigen Technologien, die die Zukunft der Mobilität gestalten. 
 Du sammelst Praxiserfahrungen in Zukunftsbereichen wie Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, Cloud Technologies, Cyber Security, Automatisiertes Fahren, Elektromobilität oder Smart Production. 
 Dabei erhältst du Einblicke in spannende Projekte und neueste Technologien . 
 Mit deinen innovativen und kreativen Ideen kannst du im Rahmen von KI, Digitalisierungs- oder Nachhaltigkeitsprojekten Verantwortung übernehmen. 
 Welchen fachlichen Hintergrund bringst du mit? 
 MINT-Studium , bspw. Informatik, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Elektro- und Informationstechnik, Maschinenbau, E-Mobilität, Digitalisierungsmanagement, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder -informatik (verbleibende Regelstudienzeit im Master ab Programmstart mind. 18 Monaten ). 
 Fundierte Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrungen in mindestens einem dieser Bereiche (z.B. durch Studium, Praktika, Forschungsprojekte, Werkstudententätigkeiten): 
 Künstliche Intelligenz, Data Science, Machine Learning & Robotics.
 Cloud-native Softwareplattformen, Cybersecurity & DevOps.
 Batterietechnologien der nächsten Generation & industrielle Zellfertigung.
 Intelligente Produktions- & Systemtechnologien.
 Nachhaltigkeit, insbesondere Kreislaufwirtschaft.
 Welche persönlichen Fähigkeiten bringst du mit? 
 Begeisterung für neue Technologien, digitale Produkte und die Zukunft der Mobilität. 
 Problemverständnis und lösungsorientiertes Denken. 
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse . 
 Engagement oder Bewusstsein für nachhaltige Entwicklungen und Innovationen . 
 Klingt spannend? Wenn du ab Programmstart im April 2027 noch mind. 3 weitere Mastersemester vor dir hast, dann bewirb dich jetzt noch bis zum 30. November 2026 . Bitte beachte, dass wir neben deinem Lebenslauf weitere Unterlagen wie deine Bachelorurkunde oder alternativ dein aktuelles Transcript of Records benötigen. Füge diese Unterlagen bitte deiner Bewerbung bei. 
 Du möchtest mehr erfahren? Alle Infos zum Ablauf sowie zu unseren Programminhalten findest du unter: bmwgroup.jobs/fastlane . 
 Wir freuen uns auf dich! 
 Hinweis: Bitte bewirb dich ausschließlich online über unser Karriereportal. Bewerbungen auf anderen Kanälen (insb. auch E-Mail) können nicht berücksichtigt werden.
 Hilfreiche Tipps zu deiner Bewerbung und dem Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier . 
 Wir bei der BMW Group legen großen Wert auf Gleichbehandlung und Chancengleichheit. Unsere Recruiting-Entscheidungen basieren auf der Persönlichkeit, den Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten der Bewerber:innen. 
 Mehr dazu hier .

items.desc:
Where do people love what they do, and being great at what they do? 
 At Swisslog, that’s where! Our teams are the heart of a world-leading Robotics company that’s harnessing the power of technology to shape the future of intralogistics. The result? We’re transforming performance and efficiency for customers across the globe, giving them the vital edge in their markets.
 Maak indruk 
 Ben jij technisch onderlegd en krijg je energie van een dynamische omgeving waar geen dag hetzelfde is? In deze functie werk je binnen een hecht team van zeven collega’s en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onderhouden van zowel de logistieke automatisering en installaties als het gebouwbeheer. Je werkt met moderne technieken zoals palletkranen, mini-loadkranen en diverse transportsystemen. Je draait vroege, late en (soms) nachtdiensten (24/5), inclusief consignatieregeling (nacht en weekend). Swisslog investeert graag in jouw groei: je krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en trainingen te volgen binnen diverse technische disciplines. 
 Je standplaats is permanent bij onze klant Wärtsilä in Kampen. 
 Wat ga je doen? 
 • Je voert preventief en correctief onderhoud uit aan geautomatiseerde systemen. 
 • Je lokaliseert en verhelpt storingen op mechanisch, elektrotechnisch en automatiseringsgebied (PLC & IT). Programmeervaardigheden zijn niet nodig, basiskennis van PLC’s is voldoende. 
 • Je initieert en coördineert verbeteringen en reparaties. 
 • Je zorgt voor heldere technische documentatie, onderhoudsrapportages, inspecties en beheer van installaties. 
 Zo bereikt u uw doel 
 Wat breng je mee? 
 • Een afgeronde opleiding (minimaal MBO-niveau) in een technische richting, zoals elektrotechniek, mechatronica of werktuigbouwkunde. 
 • Kennis van mechanica, hydrauliek, elektrotechniek en/of automatisering — of de bereidheid dit bij ons te leren. 
 • Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om goed overzicht te houden in een omgeving vol verschillende werkzaamheden. 
 • Je bent in staat om tijdelijke, slimme oplossingen te vinden om processen draaiende te houden. 
 • Zelfstandigheid in het plannen en uitvoeren van je werkzaamheden. 
 • Je beschikt over goede klantgerichte vaardigheden en kunt op alle niveaus professioneel communiceren. 
 • Goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal. 
 Our promise to you 
 Swisslog is a world of opportunity for people who can deliver a game changing mission: driving the future of intralogistics, by shaping an era of robotic and data-driven automated solutions that create exceptional customer value.
 Join us on this journey and you’ll be part of a global enterprise that’s proud of its Swiss roots - and hugely excited by the worldwide opportunities open to everyone in the Swisslog family. So come and realize your potential, in a team that’s united by passion and driven by the OneSwisslog team spirit.
 About Swisslog 
 Swisslog is shaping the future of intralogistics. As part of the KUKA Group, we work on the latest technologies that are reimagining the world of logistics. We’re a team of 3,000+ experts from 50 countries, serving some of the world's largest and most exciting brands. Together, we’re implementing smart and innovative approaches - including flexible robot-based and data-driven automation solutions that are transforming the supply chain. So join our team and share your unique perspective.
 Join the journey! 
 If you think a career with Swisslog could be what you are looking for, we´d love to hear from you.
 We´re looking forward to receiving your application!

items.desc:
Location 
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands 
 Our team and mission 
 The Systems Department is responsible for Systems Engineering, its implementation within Projects and In Orbit Demonstration and the innovative solutions - in terms of technology and methodology - enhancing its effectiveness: Artificial Intelligence, Advanced Simulation, Augmented Reality, Concurrent and Collaborative Engineering, Cost Engineering, Digital Engineering, MBSE, Sustainability. Standardisation is also within the responsibility of the Systems Department, ensuring that processes are formalised and shared cross the broad community of space stakeholders. 
 The Future Engineering Division (in support of the programme directorates) is responsible for developing and providing the right Engineering Tools, Methods and Standards:
 leading the Agency's centre of excellence for Artificial Intelligence and processing technologies for space applications;
 leading the centre of excellence for Advanced Simulation Methods, including scientific data processing and databases, software applications including human-computer interfaces, support for science operation centres and downstream applications;
 supporting projects with the centre of competence in Sustainability Engineering for all areas related to Clean Space, Life Cycle Analysis, EcoDesign, Zero Debris, REACH and RoHS;
 performing pre-Phase A mission and system design studies in support of programmes' preparation of future missions, providing cost assessments and developing next-generation methodologies including Concurrent Design Facility (CDF), MBSE, and associated ontologies;
 supporting the evolution of ECSS standards supported by all TEC departments and in full coordination with programmes.
 The purpose of the AI and Data Science Section is to implement the ESA AI Competence Centre and lead the Agency's centre of excellence for advanced technologies supporting the development and exploitation of future space missions, contributing to the main mission of the Technology, Engineering and Quality Directorate in supporting European projects and their success through excellent engineering and the provision of innovative and enabling technologies, processes, methods, tools and applications. The AI and Data Science Section carries out technology research in the field of Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and related areas.
 Candidates interested are encouraged to visit the ESA website: http://www.esa.int 
 Field(s) of activity for the internship 
 You can choose among the following topics: 
 1) Topic 1: Knowledge Graph-powered Agentic workflows for Space Applications 
This internship first explores methods for combining knowledge graphs with agentic workflows (e.g., graph-as-memory, Agentic Graph RAG, or graph-as-coordination-hub for multi-agent systems) and maps these methods against candidate use cases in the space domain. Building on this exploration, you will then design, develop and evaluate a prototype implementing one selected use case, demonstrating how the chosen method addresses a concrete space-related challenge.
 2) Topic 2: Synthesis of Pareto-Optimal Interpretations for Neural Network-Based Anomaly Detection Systems 
This internship explores the synthesis of Pareto-optimal interpretations for neural network-based anomaly detection systems intended for autonomous onboard satellite operations. The objective is to investigate methods for generating simple, human-understandable representations (such as decision diagrams) of complex black-box models (such as neural networks), while balancing competing objectives including predictive fidelity, interpretability, and representation complexity. Constructing transparent and trustworthy interpretations is a key requirement for machine learning components in mission-critical domains, where accountability and explainability are essential. You will tailor state-of-the-art symbolic reasoning techniques to machine learning models relevant to ESA programmes, with a particular focus on neural network-based onboard anomaly detection.
 3) Topic 3: LLM-Assisted Verified Code Generation 
The increasing complexity of safety-critical software for space systems calls for new development methodologies that combine automation with rigorous correctness guarantees. This internship investigates the role of Large Language Models (LLMs) as assistants in the development of formally verified software components for critical systems. You will explore LLM-assisted formal specification, where natural-language system requirements are translated into precise formal properties. Building on these specifications, the internship will study approaches for automated code generation and refinement, using formal verification techniques to validate correctness, safety, and reliability. The objective is to move beyond treating LLMs as autonomous code generators and instead establish a workflow in which LLMs serve as efficient engineering assistants whose outputs are …

Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu.  Platové podmienky 
 1 850 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 550 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 300 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1000 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.

 Si ambiciózny/a? Máš v sebe ducha obchodníka? Rád/rada kominukuješ? Máš bankovú prax? Ak si odpovedal/a na všetky otázky áno, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku pre VÚB!
Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
Ako si šikovný/á, toľko si aj zarobíš.
A okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Na pozícii Osobný poradca/poradkyňa klienta bude Tvojou úlohou:
 starať sa o nadštandardných klientov,
 predávať všetky bankové produkty a služby z portfólia VÚB banky,
 aktívne (telefonicky i osobne) oslovovať súčasných a zároveň aj potenciálnych klientov banky zo segmentu nadštandardných klientov,

 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás: 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!

 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).

 ste dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,

 Overview 
 Entrerai nell'ufficio Group Security Planning & Models Monitoring, supportando le attività di governo e monitoraggio dell'Area Chief Security Officer. Avrai l'opportunità di acquisire una visione d'insieme sugli ambiti di Cybersecurity, Antifraud and Business Continuity Management e di Corporate and Physical Security. Contribuirai al coordinamento delle iniziative trasversali dell'Area e delle attività a supporto del Chief (es. piano d'Impresa, monitoraggio indicatori, organizzazione eventi e predisposizione materiali per attività con regulator/enti esterni). 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Supporto al coordinamento delle attività trasversali tra le funzioni dell'Area 
 Supporto al monitoraggio dello stato avanzamento progettuale e raccolta dati per KPI 
 Contributo alla predisposizione della reportistica direzionale 
 Supporto ai Comitati direzionali e incontri di governance (scheduling, predisposizione materiale, follow-up) 
 Supporto al coordinamento e partecipazione attiva a tutti i tavoli di collaborazione cyber e corporate e physical security per lo sviluppo di iniziative sinergiche 
 Contributo ai processi di governance nel rispetto di linee guida e standard 
 Supporto nella preparazione di materiali per il top management 
 Collaborazione con stakeholder interni per l'allineamento operativo 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Esperienza di 1-3 anni nel ruolo 
 Capacità di Project Management, seguendo pianificazione e attività assegnate 
 Conoscenza base di KPI e strumenti di monitoraggio delle performance 
 Capacità di produzione di report e presentazioni, con attenzione a chiarezza e struttura 
 Conoscenza di base di normativa, framework e processi in ambito security 
 Buona padronanza di Excel, PowerPoint e Word 
 Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese 
 Costituiscono titolo preferenziale le seguenti competenze: 
 Laurea in discipline economiche o scientifiche 
 Esperienza pluriennale nella gestione di progetti 
 Esperienza in ambito cybersecurity e/o physical security 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 35.650 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale del Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 L’Area di Governo Chief Security Officer presidia in modo integrato la sicurezza fisica, la sicurezza informatica e la continuità operativa del Gruppo, facendo leva su competenze specialistiche e soluzioni tecnologiche avanzate, con l’obiettivo di garantire elevati standard di sicurezza a livello internazionale.
L’Area comprende le strutture di Security Staff, Group Security Planning & Models Monitoring, Corporate and Physical Security e Cybersecurity, Antifraud & Business Continuisti Management, assicurando un approccio coordinato e trasversale alla protezione del Gruppo. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

items.desc: Welkom! Lees deze vacature door en kijk of we een match zijn. Denk je van wel? Solliciteer dan meteen. Over ons wehave is een gefinancierde Belgische startup die sportclubs (voetbal, tennis, …) helpt met hun operationele last. Dat doen we met een AI-native SaaS waarin clubs contracten beheren, rechten en leveringen opvolgen, hun hospitality runnen en sponsors een professionele ervaring geven. Alles commercieel, vereenvoudigd. Kort gezegd: we bouwen het besturingssysteem voor commerciële teams in de sport. We zijn recent gefinancierd en klaar om de sponsoringmarkt te domineren. Onze waarden We bouwen en shippen razendsnel. Zoals een startup hoort. Snelheid is alles. Potentieel boven ervaring. AI verandert hoe we werken sneller dan we denken. Specifieke ervaring maakt ons niet uit, attitude en grit wel. Work hard, play hard. Cringe, maar waar. We verwachten inzet en engagement. In ruil krijg je een job waar je graag naartoe gaat en een team waarmee je graag samenwerkt. Navigeer de AI-toekomst. We zetten AI maximaal in, halen er het volle potentieel uit en evolueren mee. Jouw rol We zoeken twee Full Stack Software Engineers die in een klein team werken, zij aan zij met onze founding engineer. Je werkt dagelijks over onze volledige stack: research, design, frontend en backend. Onze SaaS is een eenvoudig multitenant platform, gebouwd op de nieuwste technologieën. Maar technologie is slechts een middel: we gebruiken wat het best werkt. Tech stack Talen: TypeScript, React.js Frameworks & platformen: Next.js, React, Vercel, Supabase, Tailwind Cloud (AWS): DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Bedrock, … AI-tools: Claude (Code, Sonnet), Cursor, Gemini, … Wat we vragen Je wilt bij een startup werken. Je hebt smaak: je weet welke software er goed uitziet en welke niet. Je voelt je thuis in de volledige webstack: frontend én backend. Je kunt elke webtechnologie aan en bent leergierig. Je bent sterk gemotiveerd en wilt problemen oplossen. Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en Engels. Werkervaring bij een (SaaS-)startup is een plus. Wat we bieden Een steile leercurve. Wie zich engageert, leert dezelfde lessen als wij. Veel vroege startupmedewerkers starten later hun eigen bedrijf. Toegang tot ervaren adviseurs: ondernemers die al veel bereikt hebben en van wie je kunt leren. Naast je loon een ESOP: kernmedewerkers die met ons willen groeien, krijgen de kans op aandelenopties in het bedrijf. Denk je dat we matchen? Solliciteer en stel jezelf voor. We lezen elke sollicitatie. Loon: €3.500,00 - €7.500,00 per maand Ervaring: Full stack : 3 jaar (Vereist) Werklocatie: Hybride telewerken in Mechelen

In this critical early position, you will bridge the gap between advanced plasma physics and real-world industrial deployment—shaping an LPA system from initial operating parameters into a durable, containerized machine designed
items.desc: Location: Hamburg, Germany (Hybrid – ~4 days on-site / 1 day remote per week; relocation assistance included) Language Requirements: Fluent English (C1+) (German or Estonian nice-to-have) Job Title: Founding Laser-Plasma Accelerator (LPA) Engineer / Engineering Manager Function: Engineering Management Contract & Start: Permanent, Full-Time (Target Start: January or February 2027) Role Overview We are looking for a Founding Laser-Plasma Accelerator (LPA) Engineer to take full ownership of the development, execution, and scaling of our core muon source infrastructure. In this critical early position, you will bridge the gap between advanced plasma physics and real-world industrial deployment—shaping an LPA system from initial operating parameters into a durable, containerized machine designed for continuous, unattended operation. Starting with a heavy focus on practical, laboratory-based execution, you will lead experimental campaigns and direct vacuum and opto-mechanical design efforts. As the project progresses, you will step into a leadership role to recruit, build, and manage our dedicated Muon Source engineering division. Work Setup: Hybrid model (~4 days on-site / 1 day remote per week) in Hamburg. Relocation & Support: Comprehensive relocation support and complete visa sponsorship for global candidates. Core Responsibilities Team Building & Leadership: Establish and grow the Muon Source division (focusing on LPA, converter, and optical systems), driving initial development hands-on before expanding and mentoring the team. Plasma Source & Accelerator Optimization: Design and refine high-durability, density-tailored plasma targets that withstand the thermal loads of a 100 Hz / 100 TW system, ensuring multi-million-shot operational stability. Beamtime & Facility Management: Design and direct multi-year experimental campaigns across international user facilities (including DESY PRIMA, ELI Beamlines, EPAC, and ATLAS), translating empirical beam data into rapid hardware iterations. High-Power Laser Engineering: Formulate rigid hardware specifications for laser equipment suppliers (covering energy, pulse length, pointing/energy consistency, and spatial profile) and manage vendor performance. What We Offer Compensation: €80,000 – €130,000 base salary + key employee equity package & competitive benefits. Foundational Influence & Autonomy: Total ownership over the architecture, budget, and expansion of our core accelerator platform and team. Key Responsibilities Simulate electron-beam columns and electron-optical components using tools such as Opera, CST, COMSOL, Ansys and custom Python code. Develop Python-based simulation, analysis and optimization tools and correlate models with experimental results. Present complex simulation results as clear conclusions and design recommendations to specialists and broader technical audiences. items.desc: The Role 👤 We deploy agentic AI systems that handle real insurance claims for DAX-listed insurers. Not demos. Not decks. Production. We need an AI operator to get into the trenches - operate pilots hands-on, identify where AI replaces manual work, and build the systems that make it scalable. You will become our internal expert on frontier AI - and Claude specifically. That's not a side responsibility. It's a core part of the job. You will work directly with the founders (ex-BCG PLs) and elite AI engineers (ex-Amazon, ex-Meta). You'll sit in rooms with C-level insurance executives, helping us deliver product excellence and scale accounts. But first, you'll process claims, fix edge cases, and ship, leveraging AI. Aufgaben What You'll Do 💼 Master the tools. You'll develop deep, hands-on proficiency with Claude: prompt engineering, context management, multi-step reasoning, structured outputs, agentic workflows. You'll know the difference between a prompt that works in a demo and one that holds up across 10,000 real claims. You'll track model releases, test new capabilities the week they drop, and form a clear-eyed view of what's actually better - and what's hype. Deliver. Support enterprise pilot launches - from first claim to full operational rollout. You'll be in the room when things go wrong, and you'll be the one who fixes them. You'll learn what separates a pilot that converts into a multi-million € annual contract from one that stalls - and you'll build the operational muscle to make the former the default. Build. Every manual process is a target. You'll map workflows, identify failure points, and design automated systems that don't need babysitting. That means writing SOPs, building review queues, configuring AI pipelines, and ensuring the output meets the quality bar of a DAX-listed insurer communicating with its customers. Quality here isn't a vibe - it's measurable, and you own the measurement. Scale. Once something works, your job is to make it run without you. You'll identify bottlenecks, compress cycle times, and hand off systems that are documented, reliable, and ready for the next 10x of volume. The best outcome is that what you built keeps working after you've moved on to the next problem. (Internship) → Year 1 → Year 2+ 📈 (Internship): You start at the source. You won't learn our processes from a manual, but through hands-on execution: structuring data, analyzing client feedback, and automating your first sub-processes. You'll get real exposure to how a VC-backed AI startup operates - the decisions, the trade-offs, the pace. Your goal is to understand how the business breathes at its core, build a track record, and see if there's a long-term fit. Year 1: You're in the details. Processing claims, supporting client reviews, building fully automated workflows. You'll deepen your AI expertise - mastering the tools inside-out, running experiments, iterating fast. You'll gain strategic context - C-level meetings, business model exposure, full pilot lifecycle - but you earn it through operational results. No shortcuts. Year 2+: Paths open based on what you build. Account Ownership - own a major enterprise account end-to-end: commercial relationship, delivery quality, expansion AI Solutions - build the platform and own the delivery model across all clients Back in the trenches - launch the next pilot, compress timelines further, reset the benchmark Qualifikation What You Bring 📄 Top academic track record or equivalent proof of raw horsepower 0-3 years of experience in high-intensity environments: consulting, banking, or a BizOps / strategy role at a VC-backed startup Real proficiency with Claude or comparable frontier AI tools - you've used them extensively, you know how to prompt well, and you have an intuition for where they fail Structured, analytical thinking; comfortable building models, interpreting data, and turning outputs into decisions Strong project management instincts - you track what's moving, flag what's stuck, and close the loop without being asked Exceptional written and verbal communication - you can write a crisp client memo and a clear internal Slack message with equal ease German and English fluency Non-Negotiables ❗ Client-first. The insurer is your client. Their success is your KPI. Their customer's experience is your quality standard. Quality-obsessed. AI output going to a DAX insurer's customers must be flawless. Every edge case matters. You don't ship and hope - you verify. Extreme ownership. You see a problem, you own it until it's solved. No hand-offs to nobody. No "that's not my job." Benefits Why inca ⭐ Timing. We're at the earliest stage of a category-defining company. The people who join now shape what this becomes - the culture, the processes, the product. That window closes fast. Learning curve. You'll learn enterprise service delivery from ex-BCG PLs who've managed 7-figure accounts. You'll learn AI engineering from builders who've shipped at Amazon and Meta. And …

Otwartą i przyjazną atmosferę pracy Hybrydowy model pracy – 2 dni w tygodniu pracy z biura Udział w realnych projektach odpowiadających na potrzeby biznesu Możliwość testowania nowych technologii i szukania dla nich praktycznych zastosowań Przestrzeń na własne pomysły, eksperymentowanie i proponowanie usprawnień Możliwość stopniowego przejmowania odpowiedzialności za własne rozwiązania i projekty Możliwość poznania różnych obszarów biznesu i zrozumienia, jak dane, BI i AI wspierają ich codzienną pracę Opiekę medyczną Grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie Kartę Edenred lub dofinansowanie karty Multisport Dodatkowy dzień wolny z okazji urodzin Stanowisko jest otwarte dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami. Co wyróżnia tę rolę? AI w praktyce Nie chodzi wyłącznie o korzystanie z gotowych narzędzi. Będziesz uczestniczyć w poszukiwaniu miejsc, w których AI może realnie usprawnić pracę, analizę lub procesy biznesowe, a następnie testować możliwe rozwiązania. Czasem trzeba będzie sprawdzić dokumentację, przetestować kilka podejść, wykorzystać sztuczną inteligencję jako wsparcie albo samodzielnie dojść do rozwiązania problemu. items.desc: 🚗 Vehicle Noise Testing & Machine Learning Engineer, Trainee Are you passionate about automotive innovation, machine learning, and AI? Ready to apply your skills to real-world engineering challenges in a global company? Nissan is looking for a proactive and curious intern to join our NVH (Noise, Vibration & Harshness) Team . 🎯 Your Mission Support the development of a predictive model to better understand and estimate tyre noise based on key test parameters such as: Tyre pressure / stiffness / Vehicle speed / Ambient temperature / and other relevant vehicle and test conditions. To optimize the internal RAG application adding new technical parameters based on the history vehicle development key data. Using Machine Learning and AI tools, your goal will be to: Analyse and process vehicle test data. Develop predictive models to estimate tyre noise behaviour. Investigate the influence of different tyre and vehicle parameters on exterior noise performance. Build an intuitive interface that enables engineers to simulate tyre noise based on different tyre specifications and operating conditions. Contribute to the digitalisation and optimisation of NVH engineering processes. 👀 We're Looking For a Motivated Candidate With: Strong knowledge of Machine Learning and AI concepts and tools. Programming skills in Python or similar languages. Solid understanding of mathematical modelling and data analysis methods. Interest in applying technology to real engineering challenges. Fluency in English (spoken and written). 🌍 What We Offer A hands-on internship with exposure to cutting-edge automotive technologies. The opportunity to work on a real project with direct impact on vehicle development. A multicultural and inclusive work environment with colleagues from around the world. Flexibility through hybrid working, combining remote work and collaboration at NTCE facilities. Financial compensation during the internship period. An excellent opportunity for students completing their Bachelor's Final Project or Master's Thesis. 🎓 To join this internship experience, you must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's Degree and able to establish a university internship agreement with your academic institution. At Nissan, we believe that the differences among us - differences in race, gender, age, mindset, religion, people with disabilities and much more - make us stronger and equip us to better serve our customers and communities. We are committed to creating positive change that ensures transparency and inclusivity throughout the career journey, in order to build teams that create a sense of belonging for all members. Barcelona Barcelona Spain

B. items.desc: Intern in the Systems Department - AI and Data Science Section Job Requisition ID: 21053 Date Posted: 1 November 2026 Closing Date: 30 November 2026 23:59 CET/CEST Publication Method: External Only Type of Appointment (learn more): Directorate: Technology, Engineering and Quality Workplace: Noordwijk, NL Location ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands Our team and mission The Systems Department is responsible for Systems Engineering, its implementation within Projects and In Orbit Demonstration and the innovative solutions - in terms of technology and methodology - enhancing its effectiveness: Artificial Intelligence, Advanced Simulation, Augmented Reality, Concurrent and Collaborative Engineering, Cost Engineering, Digital Engineering, MBSE, Sustainability. Standardisation is also within the responsibility of the Systems Department, ensuring that processes are formalised and shared cross the broad community of space stakeholders. The Future Engineering Division (in support of the programme directorates) is responsible for developing and providing the right Engineering Tools, Methods and Standards: leading the Agency's centre of excellence for Artificial Intelligence and processing technologies for space applications; leading the centre of excellence for Advanced Simulation Methods, including scientific data processing and databases, software applications including human-computer interfaces, support for science operation centres and downstream applications; supporting projects with the centre of competence in Sustainability Engineering for all areas related to Clean Space, Life Cycle Analysis, EcoDesign, Zero Debris, REACH and RoHS; performing pre-Phase A mission and system design studies in support of programmes' preparation of future missions, providing cost assessments and developing next-generation methodologies including Concurrent Design Facility (CDF), MBSE, and associated ontologies; supporting the evolution of ECSS standards supported by all TEC departments and in full coordination with programmes. The purpose of the AI and Data Science Section is to implement the ESA AI Competence Centre and lead the Agency's centre of excellence for advanced technologies supporting the development and exploitation of future space missions, contributing to the main mission of the Technology, Engineering and Quality Directorate in supporting European projects and their success through excellent engineering and the provision of innovative and enabling technologies, processes, methods, tools and applications. The AI and Data Science Section carries out technology research in the field of Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and related areas. Candidates interested are encouraged to visit the ESA website: http://www.esa.int Field(s) of activity for the internship You can choose among the following topics: Topic 1: Knowledge Graph-powered Agentic workflows for Space Applications This internship first explores methods for combining knowledge graphs with agentic workflows (e.g., graph-as-memory, Agentic Graph RAG, or graph-as-coordination-hub for multi-agent systems) and maps these methods against candidate use cases in the space domain. Building on this exploration, you will then design, develop and evaluate a prototype implementing one selected use case, demonstrating how the chosen method addresses a concrete space-related challenge. Topic 2: Synthesis of Pareto-Optimal Interpretations for Neural Network-Based Anomaly Detection Systems This internship explores the synthesis of Pareto-optimal interpretations for neural network-based anomaly detection systems intended for autonomous onboard satellite operations. The objective is to investigate methods for generating simple, human-understandable representations (such as decision diagrams) of complex black-box models (such as neural networks), while balancing competing objectives including predictive fidelity, interpretability, and representation complexity. Constructing transparent and trustworthy interpretations is a key requirement for machine learning components in mission-critical domains, where accountability and explainability are essential. You will tailor state-of-the-art symbolic reasoning techniques to machine learning models relevant to ESA programmes, with a particular focus on neural network-based onboard anomaly detection. Topic 3: LLM-Assisted Verified Code Generation The increasing complexity of safety-critical software for space systems calls for new development methodologies that combine automation with rigorous correctness guarantees. This internship investigates the role of Large Language Models (LLMs) as assistants in the development of formally verified software components for critical systems. You will explore LLM-assisted formal specification, where natural-language system requirements are translated into precise formal properties. Building on these specifications, the internship will study approaches for automated code generation and refinement, using …
