items.desc:
We Are Waiting for You 
 Hi there! 
 I am Laura , the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you! 
 First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at ServiZurich: The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at the Zurich ! 
 Let me take a wild guess: you’ve probably sifted through countless job offers today, and they all seem to blur together. Sound familiar? Well, here’s the scoop: At Zurich, we might not have all the answers (and we’re not striving for perfection!), but we’ve got something special. Curious? Keep reading! 
 First off all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier. 
 Who Are We? 
 Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to ServiZurich. Established in Barcelona in 2006, ServiZurich operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units. 
 In addition to our technological solutions, we excel in investment, administration, and accounting, ensuring comprehensive support for Zurich's diverse operations. 
 What Can You Expect? 
 Career opportunity in our Investment Accounting and Administration department within Investment Management for an experienced Data Engineer in cloud based database design and architecture, data pipelines, Python, Spark using Databricks technology. 
 Individuals in this role will assist in the design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of a complex data hub that manages key business operations. Qualified applicants will have a demonstrated capability to learn new concepts quickly, have a data engineering background, and/or have robust software engineering expertise. 
 This role works with a global team of Investment professionals, unlocking value from our vast store of Bloomberg and other financial data. The team also supports many other investment teams with data insights and reporting. Join our dynamic team and work on a rapidly growing key platform for Investment Management. 
 And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at Zurich? I’m glad you asked. 
 As a Data Engineer you will have the opportunity to: 
 Work with the team to understand platform capabilities and how to best improve and expand those capabilities. 
 Design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of complex data pipeline products which manage business-critical operations and large-scale analytics applications. 
 Support internal Investment Management clients and understand their unique needs and challenges. 
 Instill excellence into the processes, methodologies, standards, and technology choices embraced by the team. 
 Grasp new concepts quickly to keep up with fast-moving data engineering technology and AI. 
 Dedicate time to continuous learning to keep the team appraised of the latest developments in the space. 
 Work alongside experts in various technological domains. 
 Enhance your skills with real-world experience 
 Contribute to a team that values your input and creativity

items.desc:
Fedezd fel a benned rejlő lehetőségeket a KUKA-val 
 A KUKA számos lehetőséget kínál, melyek által előremozdíthatod karriered, átélheted álmaidat és kibontakozhat a benned rejlő potenciál. A világ egyik vezető automatizálási szakértői vagyunk, globális lehetőségeket kínálunk a robotika, automatizálás, logisztika, szoftvermegoldások és az elektronika területén. Ha motivált vagy, merész ambíciókkal és elképzelésekkel, aki hisz az együttműködésben és a kölcsönös tiszteletben, akkor a KUKA-nál biztos lehetsz a sikerben!
 Feladatok 
 A telephelyen belüli anyagáramlás folyamatos és biztonságos biztosítása targonca használatával.
 Alapanyagok, késztermékek és egyéb anyagok mozgatása, raktározása és betárolása.
 Kimenő (ritkán, eseti jelleggel bejövő) szállítójárművek rakodása, valamint a rakományok szakszerű kezelése.
 Az anyagmozgatási folyamatok támogatása a termelési és logisztikai igényeknek megfelelően.
 Egyes termékek csomagolása, szállításra történő előkészítése.
 Rakomány rögzítés módjának segítése és felügyelete a teherautón.
 Elvárások 
 érvényes vezetőüléses, lehetőség szerint gyalogkíséretű és vezetőállásos targoncavezetői jogosítvány,
 MS Office alapismeretek,
 pontos, precíz, igényes munkavégzés,
 minőség iránti elkötelezettség,
 elsősorban 2 műszakos (szükség esetén rugalmas) munkarend vállalása.
 Amit mi ígérünk 
 Kultúránk gyökere a robotika és a könnyű, felhasználóbarét automatizálási megoldások iránti szenvedélyünkben rejlik. Az eredmény? Világszerte egyszerűbbé és biztonságosabbá tesszük az emberek életét. Vállalatunk lelke a sokszínűség – nagyra értékelünk minden egyes ragyogó és merész ötletet. Mindenkit arra bíztatunk, hogy munkája során legyen teljesen önmaga, ezáltal egy olyan környezet tud létrejönni, ahol az inspiráció, a szakértelem és a személyes fejlődés kibontakozhat. Közös célunk? A nagyszerűség és az innovatív, pozitív változások beindítása és elérése – nem csak az automatizálási iparágon belül, hanem annak határain túl is.
 Juttatások és támogatások 
 Elkötelezettek vagyunk munkatársaink jóléte iránt, ezért juttatások széles skáláját biztosítjuk, a versenyképes juttatási csomagoktól a rugalmas munkarenden át a szakmai fejlődési lehetőségekig. Mindezzel célunk, hogy munkavállalóink elégedettek legyenek. Hiszünk abban, hogy munkatársaink elkötelezettségét és kemény munkáját elismerés illeti, és juttatásaink tükrözik ezt a hozzáállásunkat. Célunk, hogy olyan munkahelyet hozzunk létre, ahol az alkalmazottak értékesnek érzik magukat, inspiráltak és motiváltak, hogy a legjobbat hozzák ki magukból. Csatlakozz hozzánk, és élvezd az előnyeit egy olyan vállalatnak, amely a csapatának a jóllétét és fejlődését helyezi előtérbe!
 Sokszínűség, méltányosság és elfogadás 
 Alapvető meggyőződésünk, hogy kedvesen, nyitottan és kölcsönös tisztelettel egymás iránt egy olyan környezetet teremthetünk, ahol mindenki önmaga lehet a munkája során. 
 A KUKA az esélyegyenlőség iránt elkötelezett vállalat. Minden jelentkezést aprólékos gondossággal és odafigyeléssel kezelünk – olyan döntéshozatali folyamattal, amelyet nem befolyásol a származás, az iskolai végzettség, az életkor, a nem, a szexuális irányultság, továbbá a vallási vagy a politikai meggyőződés sem. Ha csatlakozol a KUKA-hoz, rengeteg lehetőséged lesz arra, hogy megoszd, mi motivál téged, és mi határozza meg egyéniségedet, ha szeretnéd.
 Csatlakozz az utazáshoz! 
 Ha úgy gondolod, hogy a KUKA által kínált karrier az, amit keresel, szívesen hallanánk felőled.
 Várjuk jelentkezésedet!

items.desc:
Pirelli is an international group with a global brand presence, and is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of high performance tyres. Pirelli are also leaders in various forms of motorsport such as Formula 1 and the World Superbike. We supply tyres to many of the world’s major Motor brands such as Jaguar Land Rover, Porsche, Range Rover, Lamborghini, Bentley and Aston Martin to name a few. 
 Pirelli UK Tyres Ltd is the company responsible for all of the Pirelli Tyre related operations in the UK. For more information please visit www.pirelli.co.uk 
 A 12 month placement is available within our Quality Department. This role involves the improvement of processes to reduce waste and improve process capability. 
 A project will be identified during the placement and a mentor to provide support in learning and development. Assistance will be provided in finding appropriate accommodation, but financial assistance for accommodation will not be given. Student must have a valid work permit/visa for the UK. 
 The opportunity is based at our site in Carlisle, Cumbria . 
 Main duties include: 
 Working as part of a team or as an individual on projects that lead to the reduction of waste across the tyre production process 
 Collection and analysis of data in order to identify root causes 
 Engaging with all levels of the organisation to identify opportunities for improvements 
 Reporting of project status to all levels of the organisation 
 Working in an office and factory environment 
 Student insight on the role: 
 My role in Pirelli is currently providing me with a great experience. Every day is different, with new challenges and problems being presented throughout numerous on-going projects. Within these projects, along with the quality team, we continually collect data and try to resolve these. One of the interesting projects, which I currently champion, involves running a variety of tests on tyres to ensure they meet the required specifications. Due to the new system I have introduced, the company is able to save these tyres; which may have been previously scrapped, and implement preventive measures, which saves the company a minimum of £500 of scrap per day. 
 My role has also been enjoyable, as it broadens my insight into what it means to be an engineer in the industry, especially a PQE (Process Quality Engineer). It has been very different from my course content, which was more focused on the technical calculations behind how materials are made, and now I am expanding this knowledge and learning about the capabilities of machines and process quality/ efficiency. I believe I have benefitted, because my role has developed me as a more rounded engineer, with new found skills in data collection and analysis. 
 My role has also been a great test and has challenged me, as it has helped me build and improve on various skill sets, such as: 
 Organisational Skill: 
 This has improved greatly, as my role requires me to keep all my separate projects running; with the data collection and analysis that has to be done. So I have to organise my time and workload efficiently, to ensure that I keep on top of all my on-going tasks. 
 Prioritising skill: 
 This has been developed as a result of my placement, as stated earlier; I have various on-going tasks, with different levels of importance, where I must decide which tasks to focus on and when, in order to get my work done in a timely and efficient manner. 
 In addition to all of this, I have also been taught industry standard techniques such as: 
 Six sigma techniques and calculations: which I personally use in an on-going capability study with another team member. This will be expanded on throughout many different machines. 
 Kaizen Methodology: Continual collection of data on foreign body, scrap produced and analysis of data to identify areas of improvement throughout the factory. 
 Most importantly, I have received a lot of support throughout my placement from the team with whom I am involved. Everyone is always willing to help and especially because of the team moral we have, everyone wants to help each other. So I have had as much support as I would ever need. 
 I would definitely recommend the role to another student, as it would enable them to acquire knowledge in various universal engineering techniques, such as six sigma and kaizen methodology. It will also give them a good head start on the professional ladder upon the completion of their placement and studies. 
 These are some of the things that a placement at Pirelli can provide. Are you ready to be challenged? 
 Our requirements: 
 High level of general education, with appropriate engineering or scientific background 
 Excellent IT skills, with a good level of understanding and experience of MS Office (especially Excel) - Training will be provided where required 
 Self-motivated to deliver results 
 Good communication, organisational and team working skills 
 Flexible and adaptable to change 
 Understanding …

items.desc:
Pirelli is an international group with a global brand presence and is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of high-performance tyres. Pirelli are also leaders in various forms of motorsport such as Formula 1 and the World Superbike. We supply tyres to many of the world’s major Motor brands such as Jaguar Land Rover, Porsche, Range Rover, Lamborghini, Bentley and Aston Martin to name a few. Pirelli UK Tyres Ltd is the company responsible for all of the Pirelli Tyre related operations in the UK. For more information, please visit www.pirelli.co.uk 
 A 12-month placement is available within our Research and Development Department. As a member of the R&D Product Development team, you will be involved in many aspects of product development and improvements at a technical level in tyre manufacturing. You will also become familiar with the industrialization process to bring new tyres sizes from prototypes to production. You will support the product development engineers in the day-to-day development activities across both OE (Original Equipment) and Replacement tyre developments. 
 Assistance will be provided in finding appropriate accommodation, but financial assistance for accommodation will not be given. Student must have a valid work permit/visa for the UK. 
 The opportunity is based at our site in Carlisle, Cumbria . 
 Main duties include: 
 Assist product development engineers in the development of new tyre specifications consisting of results analysis, tyre design using internal tyre design software, post processing of tyre section analysis after the prototype build and preparing of specifications for production where required 
 Working with the prototype build team to optimise the building of the tyres for builds that you will be involved with 
 Involvement in requesting tests for both indoor and outdoor tyre testing 
 Project management of all types of tyre development projects using PLM (Project Lifecycle Management) software, including project timing analysis and milestone tracking, collaborating with local tyre developers and across the Pirelli group to do this 
 Import operations for materials used for prototype buildings 
 Export operations for prototype tyres to undertake indoor and outdoor testing in other UK locations and across the world 
 Support in development of software specifications designed to improve the product development operation, then work with the Smart Manufacturing team to get them developed to the specification and implemented into the department 
 Development of machine tooling and components through rapid prototyping using 3D printers 
 Working within the Pirelli industrialization process to move tyre specifications from prototype to full production 
 Student insight on the role: 
 I have really enjoyed my time at Pirelli, and I am excited to go back to university equipped with plenty of new soft, hard and personal skills. 
 The fast-paced nature of this role has required me to be very organised in terms of what jobs I have to do. 
 Discipline is something which I always struggled with at university, having a strict routine every day really helped me this year. I became more focused at work, and it improved my mental and even physical health. Having to be in a certain place (the office) at a certain time every day was massively beneficial. 
 Communication is a skill that I have been forced to improve in this year, as the role demands it. Being able to communicate effectively with a wide range of personalities in this role is vital. Whether verbally in-person, on the phone, or in a Teams call, or written communication in emails and Teams messages, knowing how to get what you need from different people is a very important skill in this role. 
 I was able to utilise my excel skills to improve my data visualisation and analysis. There was plenty of opportunity for data analysis during my time at Pirelli, namely comparing different revisions of tyre specification, specifically their cross-section measurements. 
 I have also been involved in app and software development to help improve the prototype building process as well as learning a lot about the technical tyre development and the process of engineering tyres. This consisted of going through the process of fault finding, re-engineering, requesting testing and analysing testing results to then feed back into the development process for the next time round to ultimately improve the performance of the tyre specification. 
 Overall, I’ve really enjoyed my time here at Pirelli and would thoroughly recommend any student considering applying for this role to do so. The office environment is fun and friendly, and the company are very supportive and treat their workers very well. The work isn’t always easy, but is challenging and rewarding, and is a great introduction to the working world. I think this role has been very helpful in shaping me into a better engineer and has developed many skills which I’m sure will be of great …

 Extensive use of Excel, SAP etc. 
 Creation of daily reports to be sent to HQ + Top Management. 
 Current student insight on the role: 
 I really enjoy my role as a planning assistant, due to the level of responsibility that is given to me, as I am not looked at as a helping hand, but rather as an integral member of the team. I am currently responsible for a variety of raw ingredients which are key in the manufacturing process, so part of my job is to ensure that adequate stock levels are maintained, as consequentially a lack of these resources could halt production. My role at Pirelli is enjoyable, as it is just not an office job, but rather sees me out on the shop floor, taking stock levels and also communicating with individuals about the production plan changes. An important part of my role is to send production figures to Pirelli HQ in Milan, this will gives them an idea of how the factory is running, and if we are meeting our monthly targets. 
 This role has not only developed me as an individual but also as a professional. The role has given me a huge insight into the supply chain variant within a business, which has given me a clearer picture to what I want as a career and what I want to achieve. The role has also given me the opportunity to further develop some of my personal skills such as confidence, attention to detail and being organised. I have also greatly improved my ability to cope under pressure, as while you are in the role, you will encounter unforeseen issues and in these instances you must stay calm, rationalise the situation, and then resolve the issue in the most efficient manner to ensure minimal damage to the production process. Attention to detail is also one of the key attributes of a planning co-ordinator, as a number or a dot out of place could seriously affect the factory, so it’s crucial to triple check what you’re doing so that errors do not occur. 
 In regards to professional experience I can honestly say that I feel ready to tackle the real world and everything that comes with it. This placement has given me so many tools to utilise in a variety of roles, that I feel I could go into any industry and succeed. I have learned how to use SAP, which is crucial to my role, but I’ve also gained vast experience and have become extremely proficient with excel. In this role you will learn how to use macros and VBSQL commands to accomplish your tasks. It will be like learning a new language. 
 From a personal perspective I love this job, I love the people I work with, and there isn’t a dull moment in my office because there is always a joke flying around which makes the day more entertaining. My superiors are also great fun; they are light hearted, cheerful and extremely helpful. They understand the learning process, and will ease you in to the role slowly as there is quite a lot to take in and it’s very easy to feel overwhelmed initially. I also love the fact that there is no pressure to get things right all the time, they understand that, they’re more interested in what you do after the mistake. My supervisor always tells me, you’re not judged on the mistake, but on how you recover from the mistake. One thing that I thought before I came into my placement was that I needed to know everything and that I need to be a natural straight off the bat, but what this job at Pirelli has taught me is that asking for help is okay and encouraged, as I am only on the early stages of my professional career and therefore I’m still …

 Student insight on the role: 
 What I really enjoy about my role at Pirelli, is the opportunity which it’s presented me to learn a broad range of skills, while also presenting me with the opportunity to gain vital industry insight and experiences. From my time here, I have also gained a vast knowledge about the different stages involved in the tyre manufacturing process, as part of my responsibility involves me analysing these processes and looking at ways to improve them. I have also become quite knowledgeable about the technical aspect to tyre manufacturing, as I oversee the production of sidewalls and treads used in the tyres to ensure that they are made within the specifications. 
 In my time here, I have also been given the opportunity to work on in-house company software, I have been able to apply a lot of my external knowledge in the development of this software, by providing suggestions on how to improve the quality of data which we extract from the software, in order to improve the quality of products which we make. The improvements which I suggested, have also helped me in regards to my Placement project, as I have been able to extract richer data from the software and identify key issues, with one of them being our extruder screw. The extruder screw degenerates over time, with the current software, not being able to accurately predict and judge when it starts to degenerate, my improvement has helped in improving the accuracy, as I am able to get richer data to analyse, in order to predict this point better. 
 My role has also helped me in developing some of my skill sets such as: 
 Ability to analyse data: 
 A skill which I have developed as a result of the mini projects which are given to me by my supervisor, where I have to extract data, and analyse the data to find a trend in the result, to help support or disprove his hypothesis. 
 Problem solving: 
 Another skill which I developed further through my role, as my role involves me having regular meetings, where we discuss the factory issues, with one of the notable one being a scenario where the production operatives, were confusing the different coloured tread lines( as different tyres have different colours to represent them). So in order to resolve this, me and my team came up with a system, in which I was responsible to design a metal bracket to be attached to each machine, to assist the production operatives, by showing them the different lines and colours each tyres should have. 
 I would recommend this role to other students, as I find the company really supportive of the student and their personal development, as these rings true for myself, due to the different occasions where I have been supported and developed. For example, the company paid for my attendance at an Excel seminar course where I got to develop some of my excel skills and they have also allowed me to improve my knowledge by accommodating my request for other trainings relevant to my development.

items.desc:
DISCOVER PIRELLI 
 We are a global leader in the tire industry, specialized in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing high-performance tires for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. With a presence in over 160 countries and around 18 production facilities, we pride ourselves on`1 our cutting-edge technology and commitment to sustainability. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do, and it is fueled by our commitment to the inclusion of unique perspectives and different experiences. Because power is nothing without our people! 
 Since 2005, Pirelli has chosen to invest in Romania and developed a project in Slatina that created over 4,500 jobs. The local factory has become one of the most advanced production facilities in the Pirelli group to produce car tires. Pirelli also owns a motorsport unit in Slatina, where it also produces tires for Formula 1. 
 WHY JOIN US 
 We are offering a rewarding role with scope for career progression along with: 
 International, engaging, and supportive working environment. 
 Global onboarding process. 
 Bespoke training and development programs accessible to all. 
 Competitive welfare and benefits package. 
 DRIVE YOUR FUTURE

The role will involve working in close coordination with the Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Production departments.

 Responsible for the development and industrialization of new materials and processes.

 Evaluate test results against established objectives. 
 Identify new solutions, develop and improve processes. 
 Collaborate with the Materials Department in Milan. 
 Organize start-up activities for new production machinery. 
 Ensure compliance with Pirelli and legal standards. 
 Create and maintain technical reports. 
 Provide technical support to the Quality, Maintenance, and Production departments for production issues. 
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 University degree in a technical field – preferably in Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, or Materials Science and Engineering.

 Skills:

 Ability to identify defects. 
 Teamwork and precision. 
 Computer skills. 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

 If you're passionate about innovation, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are eager to develop your career in a cutting-edge industry, this is your opportunity to drive the future with us! 
 APPLY NOW, DRIVE YOUR FUTURE!
#WePirelli

Pirelli Motorsport Services Limited (PMSL) 
 Trackside Engineer 
 Pirelli Tyres, one of the leading international tyre manufactures, is currently looking for a Motorsport Trackside Engineer. This is a perfect opportunity for an individual with a minimum of 3 years experience in Motorsport looking for their next career move . 
 The successful candidate will become an integral member of the Pirelli Motorsport team, with an understanding of how motorsport operates; you will be involved in most aspects of tyre engineering, providing professional trackside support at race events in the UK and abroad.
 You will be passionate about motorsport and have excellent practical skills, gained in a Motorsport environment. You will be an experienced problem solver, possess the ability to analyse and interpret data as well as assess physical cases and have the ability to provide clear reports in a timely manner, meeting strict deadlines. Within the remit of this role you will strive to identify and continuously improve performance through, for example, the development of tools/templates to improve the understanding of data.
 Your ability to communicate effectively and appropriately with a variety of people across all levels both internally and externally is key;
 You will work with all motorsport functions and demonstrate professional behaviour, good team work and respect for others at all times working in accordance with Pirelli values.
 The role will include:
 To provide a first class, professional, engineering service in respect of Pirelli Motorsport requirements
 To analyse and interpret race data on behalf of Pirelli and your allocated motorsport team(s) with the aim of promoting continuous improvement in the brand
 To produce clear, factual reports in a timely manner
 To be acutely aware of the need for accuracy and resilience in a fast paced and highly pressurised environment
 To work as an effective team member in relation to the Engineering team and as required with other Pirelli motorsport teams
 To take initiative and solve problems through statistical analysis and regular liaison and discussion with colleagues, line managers and race team representatives
 To identify and undertake training and development activities as required to enable you to fulfil the role, keep your knowledge and skills up to date and to fulfil your own potential
 To undertake any other activities commensurate with the role to ensure the success of Pirelli Motorsport
 You will possess a relevant industry related degree and have a minimum of 3 years experience within a Motorsport environment.
 The successfull candidate will be prepared to undertake substantial worldwide travel and will hold a current British passport and the right to work in the UK.
 You will be proficient in MATLAB and excel. 
 Applicants without the experience requested and the right to travel freely, need not apply.
 Any applicant who is not contacted after a period of 7 days, is considered unsuccessful on this occasion.

Temelj našeg uspješnog poslovanja su naši zaposlenici, koji aktivno sudjeluju u modernom razvoju banke i kreiranju stalnih promjena. PBZ, kao inovativna i suvremena banka i koja je usmjerena na interni razvoj, pruža okolinu u kojoj se možete razviti u smjeru u kojem želite. Univerzalni način kako ostvariti karijeru kod nas nije nepoznanica: učinkovitim radom, ostvarivanjem ciljeva, kontinuiranim razvojem kompetencija, odgovornim organizacijskim ponašanjem, prihvaćanjem različitosti, timskim doprinosom i osobnom proaktivnošću. Svi preduvjeti su tu, na Vama je samo da iskoristite. 
 Glavni savjetnik (m/ž) za Upravljanje porezima 
 (mjesto rada Zagreb) 
 Radno mjesto obuhvaća: 
 sustavno praćenje i tumačenje pozitivnih poreznih propisa i propisa koji reguliraju javna davanja koji mogu imati utjecaj na poslovanje Banke i hrvatskih društava PBZ Grupe 
 odgovornost za podnošenje poreznih prijava (porez na dobit, PDV, članarine turističkoj zajednici, doprinose za općekorisne funkcije šuma i spomeničku rentu) 
 vođenje implementacije novih poreznih propisa u procese Banke 
 odgovornost za otklanjanje nepravilnosti i propusta u radu učinjenih u vezi s poreznom materijom, i drugim javnim davanjima, utvrđenih internom revizijom te od strane vanjskih kontrolnih institucija i organizacija (Porezna uprava, HNB, Devizni inspektorat) 
 Kandidati moraju zadovoljavati sljedeće formalne uvjete: 
 VSS ekonomskog ili pravnog usmjerenja 
 minimalno 5 godina iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima 
 napredno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu 
 napredno korištenje MS Office alata 
 Idealni kandidati za ovo radno mjesto posjeduju: 
 sistematičnost i preciznost 
 proaktivan pristup radu 
 stručnost i snalažljivost u rješavanju problema 
 Što nudimo? 
 Mogućnost napretka u karijeri i profesionalno usavršavanje 
 dinamično i motivirajuće okruženje 
 izazovni projekti 
 stručni tečajevi, seminari, interni razvojni moduli 
 Ravnotežu poslovnog i privatnog života te brigu za zaposlenike 
 rad izvan poslovnog prostora 
 sistematski pregledi u okviru police dodatnog zdravstvenog osiguranja 
 korporativni vrtić uz subvenciju 
 slobodan dan za rođendan 
 sportska udruga PBZ standard i MultiSport kartica 
 PBZ book club 
 Prigodne nagrade, dar djetetu, novčane nagrade 
 o karijeri u PBZ grupi više možete pročitati i na našim korporativnim stranicama 
 U Privrednoj banci Zagreb prepoznajemo vaš talent, pružamo vam vrhunske uvjete za profesionalni razvoj i želimo zajedno s vama stvarati nove vrijednosti. Ako ste ambiciozni i motivirani te želite napraviti izazovan iskorak u karijeri – javite nam se.

 2 600 EUR/mesiac

 Účel a náplň práce 
 Budujte s nami partnerstvá, ktoré pomáhajú slovenským firmám úspešne rásť. Do tímu Upper SME hľadáme skúsenú posilu, ktorá bude rozvíjať vzťahy s klientmi, prinášať nové obchodné príležitosti a navrhovať riešenia prispôsobené ich potrebám. 
 Tvojou úlohou bude: 
 budovať, rozvíjať a udržiavať vzťahy s klientmi daného segmentu a spravovať existujúce portfólio firiem,
 identifikovať nových vhodných potenciálnych klientov a vykonávať priamu akvizičnú činnosť v danom segmente,
 identifikovať a predávať ďalšie produkty a služby, ktoré sú pre klienta užitočné (aktíva, pasíva, platobný styk),
 kvalitne vypracovávať návrhy na schválenie aktívnych obchodov pre klientov a uzatvárať aktívne obchody s klientmi,
 poskytovať klientom poradenstvo pri riešení ich finančných potrieb,
 zodpovedať za monitoring kvality úverového portfólia.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 Homeoffice 1x týždenne po dohode s manažérom.
 Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 vysokoškolské vzdelanie II. stupňa (ekonomické zameranie).
 Jazykové znalosti:
 Anglický jazyk B2. 
 Ostatné znalosti:
 Podvojné účtovníctvo - Pokročilý,
 Vodičský preukaz skupiny B.
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Hľadáme niekoho, kto sa vyzná vo svete firemného bankovníctva, rád pracuje s klientmi a vie prepojiť obchodné príležitosti s ich potrebami. Oceníme najmä, ak:
 máte aspoň 1 rok skúseností v oblasti obchodu s firemnými klientmi,
 disponujete vysokoškolským vzdelaním ekonomického zamerania alebo ste počas štúdia či po ňom získali minimálne 2 roky skúseností v oblasti ekonomického poradenstva, účtovníctva, developerských projektov alebo poisťovníctva,
 viete sa orientovať vo finančných výkazoch a pracovať so súvahou, výsledovkou a cash flow,
 ste aktívnym vodičom či vodičkou,
 komunikácia a budovanie vzťahov patria medzi vaše silné stránky,
 tímová spolupráca je pre vás prirodzená.

items.desc: RAGT Semences, leader en production et commercialisation de semences de grandes cultures et d'élevage, recrute un Stagiaire R&D en Machine Learning et Analyse d’Images f/h basé à son site des Molinières à proximité de Rodez. Contexte : La caractérisation de la qualité des semences et l’évaluation des traitements appliqués reposent sur des analyses et des essais spécifiques visant à mesurer leurs effets sur la germination et la vigueur. Ces étapes de qualification sont chronophages et nécessitent un investissement important en temps. Afin de limiter la charge d’analyse tout en améliorant la précision des résultats, nous souhaitons automatiser le suivi de la croissance de nos semences en laboratoire dans un premier temps sur les semences de maïs. L’objectif de ce stage est de contribuer à la conception d’un outil de phénotypage de la germination des semences. Ce projet s’articulera autour de plusieurs étapes : la qualification de l’équipement, la validation du protocole expérimental, ainsi que le développement et l’entraînement d’un algorithme de traitement d’images. L’outil devra permettre l’acquisition automatisée d’images sur une période définie, ainsi que la détection et le suivi individuel de chaque semence au cours de la germination. Enfin, l’ensemble du dispositif devra être contrôlable via une interface utilisateur simple et intuitive. Objectifs du stage : Étudier les méthodes de traitement d'images et de vision par ordinateur adaptées à l'analyse de semences Définir le cahier des charges en identifiant les besoins, les fonctionnalités attendues et les contraintes techniques Qualification et validation de l’équipement de phénotypage Développer et entrainer un algorithme permettant de détecter des objets et les suivre dans le temps Créer une interface intégrant l’algorithme fonctionnel, documenter les méthodes, le code et les résultats Dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs, master informatique ou ingénieur agronome avec une spécialisation en informatique, intelligence artificielle, traitement d'images et/ou vision par ordinateur Compétence en programmation, gestion de données et statistiques Connaissance des bibliothèques de machine learning et d'analyse de données Expérience pratique en machine learning Connaissance de la détection d'objets et des méthodes d'évaluation Capacité à développer, tester et documenter une interface utilisateur Vos conditions de stages : Lieu : Rodez, Aveyron, Occitanie Type de contrat : stage conventionné (6 mois) Période de stage : à partir du 1er trimestre 2027 RAGT s'engage pour la diversité par la mise en œuvre d'une politique de recrutement inclusive, notamment en faveur de personnes en situation de handicap Mot du recruteur Rejoignez notre groupe et faites la différence ! Nous croyons fermement en un environnement de travail inclusif où chaque talent peut s’épanouir. Le développement des compétences est au cœur de notre stratégie RH. Nous investissons dans la formation continue et encourageons la mobilité interne pour permettre à chacun de progresser. Nous vous invitons à découvrir nos opportunités de carrière et à devenir acteur de notre aventure collective. Ensemble, faisons germer les talents de demain ! Le processus de recrutement du Groupe RAGT 1. La candidature : Une fois déposée, vous recevrez un message instantané vous confirmant la bonne réception de votre dossier. 2. La pré-sélection : Notre équipe recrutement dédiée prendra le soin d’étudier chaque candidature. Si votre candidature n’est pas retenue, vous en serez notifié(e), et celle-ci sera mise en vivier, vous pourrez éventuellement être contacté(e) dans le futur pour une autre opportunité. 3. Les entretiens : Si vous êtes présélectionné(e), vous serez contacté(e) directement et invité(e) à un entretien. Cet entretien pourra être mené par téléphone, face à face ou en visio-conférence. Cette phase d’entretien est le moment de rencontrer votre potentiel futur manager. À l’issue de l’entretien, vous recevrez une réponse dans les meilleurs délais. 4. L’embauche et l’intégration : Félicitations vous rejoignez notre groupe ! Nous formalisons votre contrat et préparons votre arrivée parmi nous.

items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Le département Model Risk Management veille à la qualité et à la pertinence des modèles développés au sein du Groupe, ainsi qu'au suivi du risque de modèle de la banque. L'équipe est entre autres en charge de réaliser des benchmarks afin de tester les limites des modèles des entités auditées. Le stage s'articule autour de deux volets complémentaires : Étude méthodologique : analyser les méthodes de benchmarking et de Red Teaming appliquées aux modèles d'IA générative, avec une attention particulière portée aux nouveaux benchmarks dédiés à l'évaluation des systèmes agentiques Mise en œuvre : déployer les méthodes retenues dans les outils utilisés par le département pour la validation des modèles Dans ce cadre, les principales missions confiées seront les suivantes : Analyse de l'état de l'art et prise en main des outils : réaliser une revue de la littérature consacrée aux méthodes d'évaluation et de benchmarking des LLM, avec un focus sur les systèmes agentiques et les LLM utilisés comme juges, et se familiariser avec les principales bibliothèques associées Appropriation de l'environnement interne : prendre en main les outils du département, notamment l'application utilisée pour l'évaluation des risques associés aux LLM susceptibles d'être déployés au sein du Groupe Développement de l'application : contribuer à l'évolution de l'outil de Red Teaming en intégrant des tests pertinents et les nouvelles approches identifiées dans la littérature Campagnes de Red Teaming: concevoir et exécuter des scénarios de test afin d'identifier les vulnérabilités, les comportements inattendus, les erreurs de raisonnement et les principaux scénarios d'échec Analyse comparative : comparer différentes stratégies de tests adversariaux afin d'identifier les pratiques les plus adaptées à l'évaluation des systèmes agentiques. Documentation et restitution : formaliser les travaux réalisés et animer des ateliers interactifs afin de présenter les avancées aux membres de l'équipe Apports du stage Vous développerez vos connaissances en gestion du risque de modèle dans le secteur bancaire et consoliderez votre expérience en data science. Ce stage vous permettra également de renforcer votre esprit critique, vos capacités de résolution de problèmes, ainsi que vos compétences rédactionnelles et de présentation. Durée du stage : 6 mois Et si c'était vous ? Étudiant en Bac +4/5 en école d'ingénieurs ou en formation universitaire équivalente, vous maîtrisez les bases du machine learning et de Python Une familiarité avec des bibliothèques telles que Transformers ou LangChain/LangGraph est appréciée, de même qu'un intérêt pour le développement de code structuré, Git et le déploiement d'applications d'IA via des API, des conteneurs ou le cloud Vous disposez de bonnes qualités rédactionnelles et savez synthétiser et présenter clairement vos travaux. Autonome, rigoureux et curieux, vous êtes également force de proposition Votre esprit d'équipe, votre enthousiasme et votre aisance relationnelle vous permettront de vous intégrer rapidement au sein de l'équipe Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s'offrir à vous, en France et à l'international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez d'avantages : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d'Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport) Offre variée de restaurants d'entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l'action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s'engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l'éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d'engagement sont multiples.

items.desc: About the Company: At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections. The Role You'll Play: As a Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in driving insights and building data products that support large-scale, cross-departmental initiatives. You'll combine advanced statistical inference, strong engineering skills, and business intuition to create models and tools that improve marketplace efficiency, retention, and growth. This role is not about building models in isolation—it's about leveraging data science to influence strategy, fuel automation, and deliver measurable business impact. Partner with Product, Marketing, Operations, and Finance teams to design and execute analytical solutions that optimize marketplace dynamics, improve unit economics, and uncover opportunities for growth. Apply statistical inference and causal modeling to evaluate experiments, quantify business impact, and guide decision-making under uncertainty. Design, prototype, and deploy scalable data products such as anomaly detection systems, prioritization algorithms, and similarity/recommendation models. Translate complex models and findings into actionable insights and clear recommendations for business stakeholders, including executives. Build frameworks for experimentation, measurement, and monitoring that drive iteration and continuous improvement of strategic initiatives. Balance hands-on technical work (modeling, coding, automation) with strategic thinking, ensuring data science investments align with business objectives. Act as a technical thought partner and mentor for analysts and junior data scientists, raising the bar on scientific rigor and reproducibility. Experience You Bring: 3 – 5 years of experience in data science, applied statistics, or a related quantitative discipline, ideally within marketplace or platform businesses. Strong expertise in statistical inference, causal modeling, and experiment design, with the ability to draw robust conclusions from noisy or incomplete data. Proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels , PySpark , etc.) and SQL, with experience building and deploying production-grade models. Proven track record of designing and delivering data products such as anomaly detectors, ranking/prioritization models, similarity or recommendation systems. Familiarity architecting automated pipelines and data flows that support machine learning and analytics at scale. Ability to balance technical depth with business acumen—knowing when a simple solution beats a complex one, and when complexity is necessary to win. Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence non-technical stakeholders and executives. Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-paced environment; you thrive on experimentation, iteration, and turning insights into action. Familiarity with data visualization and dashboarding tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) to communicate insights effectively. items.desc: Join QuTwo - Europe's private Quantum AI Lab , on our quest to bridge the gap between the classical and the quantum world. We partner with the most advanced and forward-thinking customers, solving fundamental real-world problems, side by side. We are a European AI lab for the quantum era, co-founded by pioneers behind IQM and Silo AI, with a team spanning MIT, UC Berkeley, Cambridge, and Carnegie Mellon, and backed by the founders of Skype, Hugging Face, Quantinuum, Supercell and many more. We are seeking LLM Inference Platform Architect . If you are a humble learner, not afraid of the unknown, we encourage you to apply. Role Description The Infrastructure Architect designs and leads a secure, internal LLM serving platform on fully controlled GPU hardware, ensuring complete data privacy and independence from external model providers. Managing the full serving stack—including GPU clusters, inference engines, access control, and capacity planning—this role delivers a reliable AI service for the entire organization. The architect sets platform standards, ensures strict regulatory compliance (such as DORA), and partners closely with security, operations, and LLM scientists to deploy optimized models. Background in banking or other highly regulated industries, with familiarity with DORA or equivalent compliance frameworks.

items.desc: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us! Position overview Orakl Oncology works on a large cohort of patient-derived organoids (PDO) to predict clinical outcomes of patients and derisk clinical trials. We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Lab Technician to help us execute large-scale drug screening assays on our semi-automated platform, either for internal or external projects. In this position, you will: Actively participate in our commercial contracts: you will take care of numerous PDOs of interest and perform drug screening assays to generate high-quality, robust datasets. These results will be leveraged by our data science and computational biology teams to deliver actionable insights and decision-support data to our partners. Work on the expansion of the Orakl biobank: you will work on patient specimens and organoid cell lines to increase the amount of data collected, thus improving our understanding of cancer. Contribute to the optimisation procedures at Orakl: you will bring new ideas and approaches to improve automation and accelerate workflows in both 3D cell culture and drug screening experiments. Ensure smooth laboratory operations: you will play a key role in laboratory maintenance, documentation, and traceability of activities, while proactively anticipating the needs for consumables and reagents. Required qualifications BSc (or equivalent degree such as BTS, BUT, Licence) in cellular biology, biotechnology or any related discipline. Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, 3D cell culture and preferably organoid culture. Hands-on experience in drug screening assays or viability assessment assay. Exceptional attention to detail and organisational rigour. Flexibility, and a taste for overcoming operational challenges. A genuine enthusiasm and passion for teamwork and learning. As part of an international team, ability to communicate clearly in English Genuine curiosity for cancer biology. Strong collaboration and communication skills to interact in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, ML engineers and researchers. Previous experience working in cancer biology Fluent in English Recruitment process HR Call (15 minutes call) – An initial discussion to better understand your background, experiences, and motivations. Technical Interview (45 minutes call) – A deep dive into your technical skills and expertise relevant to the role. Lab Case (Around 90 minutes) - You will be directly manipulating in our labs to demonstrate your ability to follow a specific protocol and to work under aseptic conditions. Founder Interview: As final step of our recruitment process, you will meet the CTO of Orakl Oncology in person at our office. This meeting is an opportunity for the founders to assess cultural fit and ensure alignment with our company values. More about Orakl here and here

items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Le département Model Risk Management veille à la qualité et à la pertinence des modèles développés au sein du Groupe, ainsi qu'au suivi du risque de modèle de la banque. L'équipe est entre autres en charge de réaliser des benchmarks afin de tester les limites des modèles des entités auditées. Réaliser une étude sur les méthodes de monitoring et de red teaming appliquées aux systèmes multi-agents fondés sur des Large Language Models (LLM), puis les implémenter et les évaluer sur des architectures agentiques open source ou internes à l'équipe. Vous serez notamment amené à : Effectuer une revue de littérature sur les approches de monitoring, d'évaluation et de red teaming des systèmes multi-agents Prendre en main des frameworks agentiques open source ou internes à l'équipe Développer des métriques et tableaux de bord permettant de suivre la performance, la stabilité et la qualité des interactions entre agents Concevoir et exécuter des campagnes de red teaming afin d'identifier les vulnérabilités, comportements inattendus, erreurs de raisonnement et scénarios d'échec Comparer différentes stratégies de monitoring et de tests adversariaux afin d'identifier les meilleures pratiques pour l'évaluation des systèmes agentiques Documenter l'étude et animer des ateliers interactifs pour présenter les avancements aux membres de l'équipe Apports du stage Vous acquerrez une vision spécifique en gestion du risque de modèle au sein des établissements bancaires, ainsi qu'une expérience significative dans le domaine de la data science. Vous mettrez en exergue vos qualités rédactionnelles et de présentation. Durée du stage : 6 mois. Et si c'était vous ? Compétences requises et qualités appréciées : De formation Bac + 4/5 - École d'Ingénieurs ou équivalent universitaire, vous avez de solides connaissances théoriques et opérationnelles en Machine Learning et en Deep Learning (e.g. étapes d'apprentissage d'un modèle) Vous justifiez de bonnes connaissances en Python Doté de qualités rédactionnelles, vous savez rédiger des notes synthétiques et présenter vos résultats sous format PowerPoint ou de Web apps. Autonome, rigoureux, curieux, vous êtes force de proposition Un fort esprit d'équipe, de l'enthousiasme et un bon relationnel vous permettront de vous insérer rapidement dans l'équipe Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s'offrir à vous, en France et à l'international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez d'avantages : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d'Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport) Offre variée de restaurants d'entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l'action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s'engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l'éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d'engagement sont multiples.

items.desc: À Montpellier, WePlante végétalise les espaces professionnels pour le bien-être au travail. Bureaux, rooftops, espaces atypiques : avec Vertuo, Nami et nos scénographies événementielles, nous proposons une végétalisation clé en main. Nous vendons l’usage des plantes des horticulteurs, avec installation, entretien et partage de la valeur, mensuellement ou ponctuellement. En trois ans et demi, près de 30 personnes ont participé à l’aventure. Notre premier stagiaire avait 62 ans, notre dernière alternante 17 ans. Les profils atypiques sont les bienvenus. Ici, inclusion, management collaboratif et goût du challenge se vivent au quotidien. Fondée par Emmanuelle Mausy-Pelissou, ingénieure en informatique de formation agronomique, WePlante bénéficie de ses 16 ans d’expérience dans la tech, notamment chez ADM et InVivo. Aujourd’hui, l’équipe représente 2,5 équivalents temps plein, accompagnés de trois stagiaires et de conseils externes. Entreprise à mission et JEII, WePlante est doublement incubée au BIC de Montpellier et à l’IMT Mines Alès. Avec SYLVIA nous portons cette expérience vers toute la filière de la végétalisation et du bâtiment. Notre IA multimodale d’archi-végétalisation aide à sécuriser l’adéquation entre architecture, environnement et végétal dans le temps long. De la conception à l’entretien et au pilotage, l’ambition est claire : dérisquer les choix, maîtriser les coûts et suivre les impacts. Pour une végétalisation qui dure. Description du poste ADVISOR SCIENCE & LAB PARTNERSHIPS (F/H) WePlante / SYLVIA : du terrain à la deep tech. Une ambition internationale, un vrai goût du challenge. SYLVIA — L’IA multimodale d’Archi-Végétalisation « L’agro-urbanisme aux côtés des acteurs de la filière des bâtisseurs de demain. » « Dérisquer les projets de conception avec notre moteur agro-urbain et modéliser dans le temps long l’adéquation environnement-plantes pour une estimation des risques, impacts et coûts vs métriques réelles. » Notre premier périmètre, SYLVIA SERVIR V1, est une GMAO intégrant l’IA pour les paysagistes et les acteurs du facility management, intégrant l’entretien végétal atypique : intérieur, hors-sol et rooftop. SYLVIA PILOTER : entreprises, bailleurs et propriétaires : CSRD & VSME Friendly SYLVIA IMAGINER : C’est notre brique la plus deep tech, qui nécessite les travaux de deux laboratoires partenaires. Notre usine logicielle « Agentic DevOps / AI Native SDLC », avec une chaîne CI/CD d’intégration et de déploiement continus, soutient le développement au plus près des besoins clients. Le challenge est aussi entrepreneurial : WePlante est une SASU détenue à 100 % par sa fondatrice. Porter seule un projet deep tech en tant que femme expose à des freins de financement qui limitent aujourd’hui notre capacité à accélérer. Selon notre trajectoire actuelle, les dettes devraient être soldées d’ici six mois. Nous préparons une levée mixte de 500 k€, equity et non-equity, pour investir et changer d’échelle à l’international. Rejoindre notre advisory board, c’est prendre une vraie place dans l’aventure. Chez WePlante, notre advisory board réunit quelques personnes de confiance dont l’expérience et le regard nous aident à prendre du recul, challenger nos choix et construire la stratégie de Sylvia. Nous voulons un conseil consultatif impliqué, avec lequel partager les ambitions, les difficultés et les étapes décisives du projet. Rejoindre notre advisory board, c’est : Mettre ton expertise au cœur des choix qui feront grandir WePlante et Sylvia : marché, financement ou partenariats scientifiques. Partager l’ambition de faire émerger un acteur international de l’archi-végétalisation, et vivre les étapes de sa construction de l’intérieur. Échanger régulièrement avec Emmanuelle et les autres membres du board, confronter les points de vue et nous aider à poser les bonnes questions. Ouvrir des portes et porter fièrement ton engagement à nos côtés pour renforcer la crédibilité et la visibilité du projet. Sortir de ton quotidien pour explorer un terrain où le vivant, le bâti et l’IA se rencontrent, tout en nous aidant à sortir la tête du guidon. Nous te proposons une relation directe avec la fondatrice, de la confiance et une place dans la réflexion stratégique. Nous attendons un regard franc, des échanges utiles et l’envie de partager l’aventure : tes conseils doivent pouvoir faire évoluer nos décisions. Tu te connais, toi et ton métier. Tu as de très bonnes soft skills et tu sais où tu veux aller. Tu veux porter une ambition forte, prendre des responsabilités et construire avec nous ? Pour un temps ou pour longtemps, l’essentiel est que tu saches aujourd’hui ce que tu souhaites apporter. Parlons-en. COBRA provides for the implementation, integration, development, and delivery of Modeling and Simulation (M&S) solutions to support the US Air Force, Department of Defense, and mission partner multi-domain operations (MDO) within the Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2) strategy. This role of this position is to support the UAWC’s physical exercise networks including, Non-Secure Internet Protocol Network (NIPRNET), Secure Internet Protocol Network (SIPRNET), Coalition and Exercise Networks, Commercial Internet, and Video Teleconferencing (VTC) systems. Implement network upgrades, system software patching, and security compliance in accordance with DOD 8140.01, Risk Management Framework (RMF), DISA STIGS, Maintenance Task Orders, Information Assurance Vulnerability Management, Air Force Instructions, and UAWC policies. Lead the deployment and optimization of enterprise collaboration tools and communication platforms, including VoIP, VTC, and IPTV. Continually evaluate and upgrade UAWC’s network systems, providing strategic recommendations for enhanced capabilities and network infrastructure refresh cycles to accommodate M&S and JADC2 initiatives. Develop technical documentation, including network diagrams, SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), and compliance policies to maintain accurate records. Monitor status of projects, prepare milestone status reports, and present status to the UAWC. Network engineer experience supporting Department of Defense networks, including network compliance with STIGs, RMF, and NIST Cybersecurity Framework. DESIRED EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS Additional Security certifications such as CASP, CCNA Security, or equivalent. Deep understanding and extensive practical experience with enterprise level networking such as: Cisco Call Manager, Cisco Meeting Servers, Nexus, Cisco Firewalls, Cisco DNA Center, Cisco Identity Service Engine. Experience with emerging technologies such as Cisco SD-WAN and Cisco FMC/FTD with VTI. Experience with SolarWinds. Experience with Multicast routing, QoS, and VPN deployment. Experience with routing protocols such as EIGRP, OSPF, VRFs, NAT, and BGP. Desired experience with VoIP and VTC integration. Desired experience with Virtual Infrastructure such as vSphere, vCenter, and Cisco Hyperflex. items.desc: Die Zukunft der Messtechnik beginnt bei ZEISS ZEISS Research Quality Solutions treibt multidimensionale Messtechnik voran. Mit über 100 Jahren Tradition entwickeln wir hochpräzise multisensorische Messgeräte, Mikroskopiesysteme, 3-D-Röntgentechnologie und leistungsstarke Auswertungssoftware. Global präsent (Oberkochen, USA, China, Indien) – mit starkem Service-Netzwerk. Unsere Lösungen ermöglichen die schnelle Entwicklung neuer Messkonzepte und die Optimierung komplexer Qualitätsprozesse in Elektromobilität, Luftfahrt, Medizintechnik, additiver Fertigung und Kunststoffindustrie. Ihre Rolle Gestalten Sie die nächste Generation von Elektronenmikroskopen und machen Sie physikalische Effekte im Nanometerbereich messbar. In dieser Schlüsselrolle verbinden Sie wissenschaftliche Exzellenz mit Systemdenken und treiben gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Entwicklungsteams innovative Technologien von der Idee bis zum validierten Produkt voran. Entwickeln und integrieren Sie hochkomplexe Elektronenmikroskopie-Systeme und bringen Sie physikalische, vakuumtechnische, mechatronische und softwarebasierte Technologien zu einem leistungsfähigen Gesamtsystem zusammen. Übernehmen Sie die technische Verantwortung für Systemintegration und Validierung, vom Aufbau von Prototypen über Teststrategien bis zum Nachweis von Performance, Zuverlässigkeit und Spezifikationskonformität. Analysieren und beherrschen Sie Einflussgrößen im Nanometerbereich, identifizieren Sie Fehlerquellen, definieren Toleranz- und Fehlerbudgets und entwickeln robuste architektonische Lösungsansätze. Erarbeiten Sie System-, Subsystem- und Schnittstellenkonzepte, übersetzen physikalische Anforderungen in technische Spezifikationen und koordinieren deren Umsetzung mit internen und externen Experten. Bringen Sie Ihre Expertise in Physik, Vakuumtechnik und Elektronenoptik ein, um neue Messkonzepte zu realisieren und die Grenzen hochpräziser Messtechnik weiter zu verschieben. Agieren Sie als technischer Ansprechpartner für internationale Teams, Partner und Kunden, steuern Arbeitspakete oder Teilprojekte und kommunizieren technische Ergebnisse überzeugend auf allen Ebenen. Ihr Profil Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Physik, Experimentalphysik, angewandten Physik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, idealerweise mit Promotion. Fundierte Erfahrung im Systems Engineering sowie in der Entwicklung und Integration komplexer mechatronischer, vakuumtechnischer oder hochpräziser technischer Systeme. Gutes Verständnis physikalischer Zusammenhänge im Mikro- und Nanometerbereich sowie die Fähigkeit, wissenschaftliche Konzepte in robuste technische Lösungen zu überführen. Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Elektronenmikroskopie, Vakuumtechnologie oder verwandten High-Tech-Umfeldern wie Halbleiter-, Analytik- oder Messtechnik. Praxisnahe Labor- und Entwicklungserfahrung, verbunden mit einer strukturierten, analytischen und lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke (Deutsch und Englisch) und Teamfähigkeit, um erfolgreich mit interdisziplinären Entwicklungs- und Forschungsteams zusammenzuarbeiten. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und setzen Sie neue Maßstäbe in der Elektronenmikroskopie. Your ZEISS Recruiting Team: Sandra Vogel

items.desc: Location: Bologna, Emilia Romagna, Italy Business: Energy Systems Position type: Full Time Contract type: Permanent Employee Job ID: 7951 Overview About us We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence. As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations. About Energy Systems We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry. About the role Work at the heart of the energy transition Would you like to combine electrical engineering with renewable energy, hands-on testing, and international project work? As a Power Systems Engineer – Grid Compliance & Testing at DNV, you will work directly with wind, solar and other power-generation projects, helping demonstrate that power plants can connect to the electricity grid safely, reliably and in accordance with applicable technical requirements. This isn't a purely desk-based engineering position. You will combine on-site electrical testing and measurements, data analysis, customer interaction and project delivery, working both in the field and from your home base in Bologna. You don't necessarily need to be a Grid Code Compliance specialist from day one. If you have a solid electrical or power engineering foundation, practical technical experience and an interest in developing your expertise in grid compliance and power quality, this could be an excellent next step. The team You will join DNV's Wind & Solar Technology Testing Team, a multidisciplinary international team supporting renewable and conventional power-generation projects through measurements, simulations, technical analysis and certification services. Within the team, our Grid Code Compliance specialists help verify that power plants meet national and international grid-connection requirements. The work includes Grid Code Compliance assessments, Fault Ride Through (FRT) testing and power-quality measurements, with a strong focus on projects in Italy and across Europe. What you'll do Work hands-on with power-generation assets : Install and commission measurement systems at power plants. Perform Grid Code Compliance and power-quality testing . Monitor measurement campaigns and collect data . Troubleshoot sensors, measurement equipment and data-acquisition systems. Prepare and specify the equipment required for testing . Turn measurements into engineering insight : Analyse data from measurement campaigns against relevant grid codes, international standards and technical requirements. Interpret results and prepare clear, professional technical reports. Present technical findings to customers . Take ownership of your projects : Manage power-quality measurement projects, including scope, schedule and costs . Coordinate directly with customers throughout project delivery . Contribute to technical proposals, contract reviews and bids . Help improve our technical tools, processes and ways of working . What we offer The possibility to join a worldwide company with strong values and commitment. Work with a highly engaged team in an environment where trust and teamwork are core values. A job in a hybrid working model with a home base in Bologna. A 37.5 working hours per week. Salary range between 35.000,00 and 40.000,00 gross per year (grade 7). An attractive benefit package. Continuous training and professional improvement. The possibility to join DNV’s sanitary insurance, available for all employees. Smart working according to work needs. Laptop and mobile phone. Allowance for travel. Medical expenses fund. DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity. About you To be a successful candidate, you must have: A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics or a related technical discipline. Experience within the energy, power, renewables, electrical engineering or a related technical environment. A good foundation in electrical measurements and experience with equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes or data loggers. …

items.desc: Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG's products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another. Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world. We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world. We're proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025). We are looking for a Product Owner (Customer Experience). In this role, you will own the end-to-end customer journey across our products, from the first visit to meaningful long-term connections. Your mission is to find the biggest growth opportunities in a product used by a million-strong audience, remove whatever stands between users and a great experience, and turn every improvement into measurable business results. Your main tasks will be: Own the customer journey end-to-end, from registration to quality conversations, identifying friction points and growth opportunities across the whole funnel. Dig into data yourself: explore analytics with AI tools (e.g., querying BigQuery via MCP), validate insights, and turn them into strong, evidence-backed hypotheses. Write concise product briefs and drive ideas through specs, prototyping, and release together with developers, analysts, and designers. Build and prioritize the backlog based on the value each initiative brings to users and the business. Connect every initiative to business impact (revenue, net profit) rather than isolated conversion gains. Scale successful experiments across our product portfolio. We expect from you: Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Project Manager, or Team Lead in B2C products; startup experience is welcome. A hands-on approach: you do the analysis, write the briefs, and push ideas through to results yourself. Practical experience using AI tools for product analytics and documentation. Strong command of product metrics and funnel analytics, combined with a solid understanding of unit economics. Track record of owning a business metric (revenue, turnover, net profit), not only conversion rates. Strong prioritization skills and comfort working with a broad scope. Persistence and drive to achieve results in challenging conditions. A technical background (degree in a technical field or previous development experience) is a strong plus. Why join: Real influence on the user experience of a product with a million-strong audience. Freedom to improve anything along the customer journey, from small UX fixes to bold product changes. A role for people who want challenging problems and a fast path to growth. What do we offer: REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full-time; The initial pay level or pay range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before the commencement of employment; Vacation 28 calendar days per year; 7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave; Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company; 50% payment for professional training, international conferences, and meetings; Corporate discount for English lessons; Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor's fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children); Workplace organization. The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years; Internal gamified gratitude system: receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for our merchandise, team building activities, massage certificates, etc. Sounds good? items.desc: Overview: The Regional Integrated Work System (IWS) Trainer drives the deployment, coaching, and standardization of IWS, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), and Lean manufacturing principles across multiple manufacturing sites. This role bridges regional operational strategy and shop-floor execution. The primary focus is to eliminate operational losses, build employee capability, and foster a culture of continuous improvement and zero-loss thinking across the region. Responsibilities: Training Delivery: Conduct classroom instruction and hands-on shop-floor coaching on IWS DMSs, pillars, methodologies, and tools. Capability Mapping: Develop skills matrices, identify training gaps, and design tailored learning plans for different plant levels. Leadership Mentoring: Coach and certify site-level IWS Managers, pillar leads, and plant leadership teams to ensure self-sufficiency. Phase Progress Audits: Lead periodic health checks and pillar assessments to evaluate implementation maturity and system sustainability. Loss Elimination: Guide teams in using advanced root-cause analysis tools (5 Whys, Ishikawa, Kaizen) to systematically eliminate manufacturing waste. Best Practice Sharing: Capture successful local initiatives and establish benchmarks to rapidly deploy those solutions across other facilities. Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the central point of contact between global IWS steering committees, regional leadership, and plant managers. KPI Tracking: Monitor and report on key performance indicators, including Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), MTBF, training completion rates, and phase progression milestones. Qualifications: Professional Experience: Proven track record in continuous improvement roles (TPM, Lean, Six Sigma, or IWS) within FMCG, pharmaceutical, or heavy manufacturing environments. Methodological Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of core IWS/TPM pillars, specifically Autonomous Maintenance (AM), Progressive Maintenance (PM), etc. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Chemical), Operations Management, or a related technical discipline. Leadership Skills: Strong change management capabilities with a demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority across various organizational levels. Communication & Facilitation: Exceptional presentation, instructional design, and cross-functional facilitation skills. Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in data analysis, manufacturing metrics (OEE, MTBF, MTTR), and structured problem-solving methodologies. Mobility: Willingness and flexibility to travel frequently to different manufacturing locations within the assigned region.

Technical Evaluations and Prototyping: Support solution evaluations through the sales stages; build prototypes, demonstrations, and integration examples using Cloud products in Partner environments. Partner and Sales Enablement: Serve as a key technical resource for Partners and Sales teams, addressing technical questions, objections, and blockers throughout sales engagements. Solution Guidance and Messaging: Provide best-practice guidance on integration strategies, enterprise architecture, platforms, and application infrastructure. Prepare and deliver technical briefings, whiteboards, and product messaging that communicate the Google Cloud value proposition. Technical Research and Product Expertise: Interpret Cloud technical documentation and use relevant administrative, development, and support consoles to assess solutions and demonstrate product capabilities. Opportunity Management: Maintain accurate Salesforce opportunity records, ensure technical-win criteria are met, and upload or document required sales-stage artifacts. At least five years of experience in technical sales engineering in cloud computing, or a comparable customer-facing role in professional services or systems engineering. Experience with Big Data, PaaS, and IaaS technologies, plus hands-on experience using or managing databases. Knowledge of data technologies such as MapReduce, Hadoop, Spark, Flume, Hive, Impala, Spark SQL, or BigQuery.
