Understanding of enterprise networking concepts such as DNS, TCP, firewalls, proxy servers, and DMZs. Experience with web application development and integration, including REST, SOAP, J2EE, servlets, Python, JavaScript, PHP, or related technologies. items.desc: DEPARTMENT Computing CONTRACT TYPE Open Term LOCATION Barcelona, Spain The Institute of Space Sciences (ICE-CSIC) has an opening for a software engineer(s). The candidate will join a group developing control software for the operation and control of astronomical instrumentation and telescopes and will be strongly involved in the implementation and future exploitation of the CTAO. The CTAO is a multinational, worldwide project to build a new generation of ground-based gamma-ray instrument in the energy range extending from some tens of GeV to about 300 TeV. The successful candidate will work on supporting the development of the scheduling and the analysis software tools for the control infrastructure of the CTAO. Minimum requirements: Degree on Software Engineer or related with an official master (or older degree that was already equivalent to a current master); at MECES3. Minimum technical skills: Knowledge in C++ and CMake Good understanding of design patterns. Used to Linux environments Experience with git (with a GitLab working environment) Able to write clear high-quality, standardised and usable code English at a sufficient knowledge, allowing international interaction level is a must. Merits to be considered: Desired technical skills: Used to CI/CD tools Virtualization with Docker Experience as DevOps engineer Experience in web development The core problem that we are addressing is a form of Job-Shop Problem (JSP), and as a result, experience with optimization algorithms and scheduling methods are valued. Furthermore, knowledge and willingness to dive deeper into AI optimization algorithms such as Metaheuristic scheduling, Swarm Intelligence, and Evolutionary Computation would be a plus. Experience on astronomical facilities, and on the ones involved in the project, will be valued. Salary scale The contract is intended to be made in CSIC M3 scale, approximately 34000 euros gross salary per year (37.5 hrs/week, 22 days of holidays). About the Institute of Space Sciences The Institute of Space Sciences (ICE-CSIC) has been distinguished with the María de Maeztu Excellence Seal, as one of the top research centers in the country. Their areas of research vary from engineering applied to several space missions to fundamental physics and cosmology, from high-energy astronomy to theoretical astrophysics. ICE-CSIC is part of the “Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas” (CSIC, the Spanish National Research Council). CSIC is the largest public institution dedicated to research in Spain and the third largest in Europe. The Institute is also affiliated with the Institut d’Estudis Espacials de Catalunya, (IEEC). ICE-CSIC strives to build a culturally diverse community of researchers, dedicated to contributing to an inclusive environment. We encourage, in particular, applications by women and members of minorities. ICE-CSIC is located in a modern building on the Campus of the Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (UAB) in Bellaterra, just outside Barcelona. The Campus is well served by public transportation (railways and buses), and a variety of accommodation options can be found both in Barcelona city center and in the smaller towns close to the University Campus (Cerdanyola, Sabadell, Terrassa, Sant Cugat, Sant Quirze, Rubí, and others). Application Interested candidates should submit the following documents to together to David Soldevilla (soldevila@ice.csic.es), Diego Torres (dtorres@ice.csic.es) and Daniela Hadasch (dhadasch@ice.csic.es) using the email subject ENG2026. The position will be open until filled, but immediate starting dates are preferred. Applications should consist of A <3 pages CV A <2-page statement of interests and previous experience

Olink panels provide innovative, high-quality solutions for human protein biomarker discovery, enabling researchers to measure thousands of proteins simultaneously from just a few microliters of blood. Using highly specific and thoroughly validated assays with a wide dynamic range, Olink’s technology overcomes traditional limitations in protein analysis and supports deeper insights into human biology and disease. You'll work on sophisticated applications that control our analytical instruments, including mass spectrometers, electron microscopes, and other advanced scientific equipment. As part of a collaborative, multi-disciplinary team, you'll work with developers, scientists, and stakeholders to validate software that enables groundbreaking research and innovation. Your work will directly impact scientific discoveries in fields like cancer research, drug development, and semiconductor manufacturing. The role is based in our Uppsala office and you need to be able to commute at least three days per week. Moreover, we are looking for someone with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working in cross-functional, global teams is a plus. Why Join Us? At Olink, Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will be part of a nurturing team that values integrity, innovation, and involvement. We offer an encouraging environment where your diverse experiences and perspectives are appreciated, enabling you to thrive and excel in your career. items.desc: 3Brain is a Swiss deep tech company working on cell-electronic interfaces that link biological networks to computers via custom-made semiconductor microchips. Our mission is to empower life scientists to probe intelligent networks, accelerate biomedical discoveries for the benefit of patients, and create a future more exciting than the present. The company’s cutting-edge products are used in laboratories and pharma companies worldwide. 3Brain is headquartered in Switzerland nearby Zurich, has a Data Science and Discovery Unit in Genova, Italy, and an operational unit in the US. Tasks For the next expansion step, 3Brain is looking for a full-time Hardware electronics engineer to reinforce our R&D team. You will help develop embedded systems for high-speed data acquisition devices, including tasks such as system engineering, schematics design and layout, testing and verification. You will also contribute to the current device’s life-cycle management, including activities such as automation, production testing and optimization. items.desc: About Us We are a team of passionate individuals from 15 countries developing the world’s first biosecurity platform built to combat critical pest threats to human health, food security and the environment. With a deep commitment to trust, integrity and collaboration, Flyttr has become the trusted partner of governments, industries, philanthropies and communities seeking to make bold advancements on the biggest pest threats of our time. We work with urgency because lives and livelihoods depend on it. Successful candidates will find Flyttr to be an exhilarating place to do their best work and will find that every person at Flyttr plays a critical role in a dynamic, exciting, team-oriented culture. Purpose of the Job As a Scientist for Flyttr, you will join a dynamic project dedicated to the research and development of our self-limiting technology in insects that spread disease, damage crops and harm livestock. You will join our strain development team, a team who are focused on the development of transformation methods and handling techniques that will streamline our strain development processes, followed by the generation and characterisation of self-limiting insect strains for future use in field operations. In alignment with the project scope, you will work under the direction of the Team Lead to bring valuable technical knowledge and be responsible for generating novel genetically engineered strains and designing experimental protocols that are focused on delivering results and progress, measurable against company priorities. To be successful at this job, you will need to show a keen interest in insect biology, have a self-starting attitude, show strong organisational skills, and demonstrate original thinking and attention to detail. Your duties will range widely from equipment procurement to experimental design, execution, analysis and reporting as well as helping to maintain a safe and functional working environment. You will be able to record data precisely and timely, as well as prepare presentations to report to your line manager. You will be able to manage both planned and unplanned workstreams, responding to company priorities. You will have strong experience of generating and interpreting data, and will take a hands-on approach, working closely with the team as well as our molecular department to test, improve, and validate new insect husbandry, genetic transformation methods and strain phenotypes. You will be able to work independently while maintaining a strong team ethos, to demonstrate good laboratory practices, and to follow SOPs. Excellent communication skills, ability to line manage a team and an enthusiasm for Flyttr’s mission are essential. Responsibilities Your key responsibilities will involve developing methods for the successful generation of genetically engineered insects. Working under the guidance of the Strain Development Team Lead you will: Join a small team tasked with developing the transformation methods necessary to generate self-limiting insects. Generate self-limiting strains and assess them against Flyttr’s target product profile metrics. Conduct experiments according to specified protocols. Design and run experiments independently, but in full alignment with program goals and with the endorsement of your line manager and Team Leader. Characterise the behaviour and biology of transgenic strains. Maintain insect colonies. Ensure that processes, methods, and experiments are well designed and focused on delivering results and progress, measurable against the project goals. Carry out literature reviews to guide experimental testing: collect, analyse, and interpret data. Carefully record data and document activities and processes within laboratory books or other applicable records. Manage and train any direct report in line with SOPs and training records. Manage members of the team and act as their daily point of contact. Maintain up to date health and safety records and updating SOPs, COSHH and risk assessments. Provide clear communication regarding outcomes of processes, experiments, and planning with the Team Lead. Report data in meetings throughout the organisation, to audiences with various technical knowledge, and write clear and concise reports for internal review. Have a clear understanding of the commercial impact of the work and responsibilities and strive to optimise performance. Support the smooth running of the laboratory, ordering supplies. Servicing equipment, maintaining tidiness, improving processes, and compliance to established procedures, regulations, and health and safety. Observing daily processes and identifying points for improvement. Follow Health & Safety and containment requirements for all activities. Provide occasional weekend support as part of a rota within the R&D team. Represent the technical function in product development meetings, supplier discussions and new product presentations. Knowledge of UK regulatory frameworks relevant to supplements, cosmetics, labelling and health claims. Experience interpreting certificates of analysis, specifications, analytical results and supplier documentation. Excellent project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple developments from brief to launch. Strong analytical, problem-solving and documentation skills. Desirable experience Experience developing botanical, vitamin, mineral, gummy, capsule, powder, topical or skincare products. Experience working with contract manufacturers, ingredient suppliers and external laboratories. Understanding of clean-label, vegan, sustainability and premium wellness product trends. A collaborative, entrepreneurial working environment based at Kilgraston Science Centre in Perth. Competitive salary, dependent on experience. Opportunities for …

items.desc: At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. We’re reimagining coffee experiences in over 50 countries and counting, as a key part of the Coca-Cola System. Whether you get your coffee in a store, from a machine, at home, or on the go – we’ve got you covered. Turn complex people data into trusted insight that shapes decisions across Costa. You’ll own high-impact analytics and reporting, strengthen Power BI standards and help build capability across our analytics community. Our teams make a difference. Whether that’s working on new tech for the perfect pour, helping our teams grow, creating award-winning campaigns, crunching the numbers, or developing the latest exciting menu item; together, we stir up success. We may be a global brand, but we haven’t forgotten our roots. That’s where the Costa Foundation and our fantastic community agenda come in. Whatever your role, you can help us change lives in coffee growing communities and help your local community too. We also want to help you grow your career through amazing experiences, our apprenticeship scheme, and development programmes. At Costa, you can go beyond day-to-day. And as an Data Analyst (People Insights) there’s never been a better time to join. So, why is Costa? We didn’t become a global coffee brand by sitting back. When you work here, you join a community that values passion, progression and integrity, with some pretty brilliant perks to sweeten the deal: Own a piece of Costa’s success by becoming a share owner in Coca-Cola with our Share Investment Plan (SIP) An annual discretionary bonus scheme, based on business results and individual contribution A smart pension that saves you money on tax and national insurance, and matches your contributions up to 10% The Costa Financial Support Fund, supporting team members who find themselves in unexpected financial pressure 50% discount in all Costa-owned stores, and 25% off in other participating stores Private medical cover thanks to our Private Healthcare scheme And that’s not all. Explore even more of our perks here: https://bit.ly/costaperks We’re passionate about being a great place to work, where you can bring your unique self into our mix. We firmly support diversity, equity and inclusion, and continue to work with our teams to shape the future of our culture and values: Disciplined to Deliver, Passion for Progress, Win with Warmth, Courage to Challenge and Trusted Team Players. What you’ll do Being a Data Analyst (People Insights) is about creating trusted, scalable analytics that help Costa make better people decisions. You’ll be: Owning complex Power BI reporting and analytics solutions end to end, from ambiguous business questions through to adopted outcomes. Designing and governing reusable semantic models, advanced DAX and Power Query solutions aligned to enterprise standards. Translating workforce data into clear narratives, recommendations and executive-level reporting that explain the “so what”. Delivering accurate, compliant and audit-ready outputs, including Gender Pay Gap reporting, pensions audits, headcount reporting and regulatory submissions. Developing advanced insights, including predictive and machine learning models (such as attrition risk, absence and workforce forecasting), that move beyond describing what happened to recommending targeted actions. Driving automation, performance, data quality and standardisation while coaching analysts and contributing to the Analytics Centre of Excellence. Who you are It’s your unique ingredients we’re interested in: An experienced analyst with advanced Power BI, SQL, DAX and Power Query capability, together with strong relational and dimensional modelling knowledge. Confident working with senior stakeholders, challenging assumptions and turning complex or ambiguous questions into high-value analytical outcomes. Experienced in owning complex analytics or reporting initiatives end to end within an enterprise Data & Analytics environment. A structured problem-solver who can combine multiple data sources, identify trade-offs and present evidence-based recommendations. Curious about advanced analytics, with experience or a strong interest in applying statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g. Python, R or Databricks) to turn insight into practical, ethical and explainable actions. Where you’ll work Right now, our Support Centre teams work flexibly, blending home working with in-person time whenever it matters most – whether that’s a team moment, a creative session, or simply coming together to share ideas. We’re excited to be moving into a new home for our brand in St Albans in January 2027 – an inspiring space from which our Support Centre teams will work three days a week to connect and collaborate in-person to bring our bold ambition to life. For any reasonable adjustments or general queries, please get in touch with our Talent Acquisition team.

items.card: The Role We're hiring a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we lend: who we say yes to, at what price, and how we know it's working. items.desc: We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones. To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest. We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you. London (hybrid, 3 days in office) Car Finance at Marshmallow Marshmallow is opening up access to credit to migrants, bringing a brand new product to market which provides newcomers to the UK with fairly priced car finance for the first time. Our Car Finance team is building a new generation lending platform from the ground up, making it simple, transparent and accessible for people who need finance to get on the road. We work closely with dealers, brokers and customers to make sure that every application, decision and interaction is fast, fair and easy to understand. Because we’re a small, high-performing team, everyone has real ownership. We combine hands-on operations with a strong focus on automation and technology. We’re designing highly automated, AI-powered processes that let us move faster and smarter than traditional lenders. The Role We're hiring a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we lend: who we say yes to, at what price, and how we know it's working. Our customers are people that traditional lenders struggle to assess. Many are new to the UK, have thin or no credit files, and don't fit neatly into off-the-shelf bureau scores. That makes credit decisioning at Marshmallow a genuinely hard, genuinely interesting problem: we combine bureau data, Open Banking, insurance, application and behavioural data to build a view of risk that others can't, and we need to do it in a way that is fair, explainable and compliant. This role sits between a traditional credit analyst and a data scientist. You'll build and monitor scorecards, design and test credit strategies, dig into portfolio performance to find out what's really going on, and turn large, messy datasets into insights that change how we lend. You'll own your work end-to-end: from framing the question and pulling the data through to modelling, presenting a recommendation and seeing it live in our decision engine. You'll be working with a small team and a modern stack, alongside a Head of Credit who has built this function from scratch and who will give you real ownership from day one. This is not a role where you hand models over a wall and move on - you'll see the impact of your decisions immediately. What You'll Be Doing Build, validate and monitor application and behavioural scorecards, using bureau, Open Banking and internal data to improve how we assess new-to-UK and thin-file customers. Design, test and refine our credit strategy: cut-offs, affordability rules, pricing tiers and limits, with a clear view of the trade-off between risk, volume and margin. Run experiments and champion/challenge tests to prove that changes to policy and models actually work before we scale them. Explore new data sources and alternative signals, and build the case for using (or not using) them in decisioning. Support model governance: document what you build, evidence that it treats customers fairly, and help us meet our Consumer Duty, CONC and model risk obligations. Work with our engineers to get models and rules into production, and use AI tooling to make yourself and the team faster. What You'll Bring Must have 2–5 years' experience in decision science or data science within consumer lending or another regulated financial services environment. Hands-on experience developing or materially refining credit scorecards or risk models (logistic regression and/or gradient boosting), including the practicalities: sample design, binning, reject inference, validation and monitoring. Experience working with Open Banking or other alternative data in credit decisioning. SQL user, and comfortable working with large, imperfect datasets. A solid grounding in statistics and a good instinct for when a result is real and when it isn't. Commercial judgement: you can translate a model output into a lending decision and explain the trade-offs to a non-technical audience. Curiosity and ownership. You ask why, you dig until you find the answer, and you'd rather ship something and improve it than wait for perfection. Nice to have Motor finance or other secured lending …

items.card: Aufgaben. DEIN PROFIL Code-Kompetenz: Du bringst solide Grundkenntnisse in JavaScript/TypeScript, gerne zusätzlich auch in Python mit, da dies auch im Zeitalter von Generative AI der Schlüssel ist, um Daten für den Agenten
items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Beratung und technische Umsetzung: Du analysierst die Anforderungen unserer Kunden und berätst sie bei der technischen Umsetzung von Conversational AI Usecases. AI Agent Orchestration: Du entwickelst hybride Lösungen, die klassische Flows intelligent mit Generative-AI-Nodes kombinieren, um autonome und handlungsfähige AI Agents zu erschaffen. Prompt Engineering und Conversation Design: Du designst und optimierst komplexe System-Prompts, Personas und Guardrails, damit die KI im Kundenkontext sicher und markenkonform antwortet, dabei natürlich klingt und eine angenehme User Experience bietet. Tool Use & Integration: Du befähigst den AI Agent durch die Anbindung von REST-APIs (Backend-Integration) oder per MCP (Model Context Protocol) dazu, nicht nur zu chatten, sondern echte Aktionen in Drittsystemen auszuführen ("Agentic AI"). Natürlich gehört auch die Anbindung an Contact-Center-Plattformen (CCaaS) oder Telefonanlagen (PBX) zu deinen Aufgaben. Logik & Scripting: Du nutzt JavaScript/TypeScript, um den Output der LLMs zu validieren, Datenformate zu transformieren und die Brücke zwischen Low-Code und komplexer Business-Logik zu schlagen. DEIN PROFIL Code-Kompetenz: Du bringst solide Grundkenntnisse in JavaScript/TypeScript, gerne zusätzlich auch in Python mit, da dies auch im Zeitalter von Generative AI der Schlüssel ist, um Daten für den Agenten nutzbar zu machen. Faszination GenAI: Du beschäftigst dich intensiv mit der Funktionsweise von LLMs (z.B. GPT, Claude, Gemini) und verstehst grundlegende Konzepte wie Context Window, Tokens und Embeddings. Wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen in einschlägigen Conversational-AI-Plattformen wie beispielweise Cognigy, Parloa, Google, Kore.ai oder Amazon Lex. Prompting Intuition: Du hast ein Talent dafür, Anweisungen an eine KI so präzise zu formulieren, dass das gewünschte Ergebnis erzielt wird, und erkennst schnell, warum ein Prompt scheitert. Web-Affinität: Du verstehst die Grundlagen moderner Web-Technologien und weißt, was hinter Begriffen wie HTTP-Request, API und Frontend/Backend steckt. Consulting-Mindset: Du möchtest nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeiten, sondern verstehen, welches Problem wirklich gelöst werden soll, um die bestmögliche technische Beratung zu bieten. Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse ermögliches es dir, nicht nur Dialoge zu schreiben, sondern auch die Qualität generierter KI-Texte kritisch bewerten und feintunen zu können. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: What You’ll Do Own onboarding outcomes against success metrics and customer KPIs (quality, reliability, time-to-value) Execute the initial onboarding cycle using internal tools, then revisit and iterate to improve quality as new data and edge cases appear Validate input data quality and flag issues early (camera angle, occlusion, anonymization, variance, missing detections) Detect and document edge cases and SOP/process variance; grow a diverse dataset and keep it up to date Communicate progress, metrics movement, and blockers clearly to stakeholders; propose concrete next steps Improve the onboarding process over time: checklists, docs, templates, and suggestions for tool improvements based on real usage Coordinate with installation teams to ensure camera setups support reliable onboarding and cross-station consistency You are 2–5 years experience in a structured execution role (implementation, QA, solutions engineering, ops/industrial engineering, data ops, etc.) Metrics-minded: you can define “good”, track it, and drive iteration until it improves Detail-oriented and reliable with process execution (no skipped steps, good documentation hygiene) Fast, concise communicator who escalates early and clearly Strong ownership mindset: you drive onboarding to completion and keep improving it post go-live Comfortable with technical systems (ML depth not required, but you can reason about symptoms and inputs) Manufacturing/process exposure is a strong plus What We Offer Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees* An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats. items.desc: Bij BrightAnalytics spelen we niet alleen met data; we laten data presteren. In het kader van ons scale-up verhaal zoeken we een ambitieuze AI Engineer. Je wordt de tweede sleutelfiguur in ons snel uitbreidende AI-team. Geen ivoren toren of stoffig lab voor jou. Je staat in het hart van onze build-out. Jouw doel? Proof of Concepts (PoCs) transformeren naar robuuste, productie-waardige ML-systemen die onze klanten ondersteunen met geautomatiseerde financiële workflows en forecasting. Wat ga je doen? Samen Met Onze Lead AI Engineer Sla Je De Brug Tussen Data Science, Geavanceerde AI En Stabiele Software. Dit Doe Je Niet Alleen, Maar In Nauw Teamwork Met De Omliggende Teams Van PoC naar Productie: Voor de overdracht van de Proof of Concepts en de functionele vereisten schakel je direct met onze Business Analysts. Je neemt deze innovatieve PoC-ideeën — van traditionele machine learning modellen tot geavanceerde Agentic AI — en optimaliseert deze tot schaalbare data pipelines, robuuste feature engineering, modeltraining en evaluatie-frameworks die nodig zijn voor een live productie-omgeving. Integratie: Samen met de software-engineers zorg je voor een naadloze interfacing met onze core applicatie. Je kapselt Python-modellen en AI-agents in via hoogwaardige microservices (API's) of andere integratiemethoden, zodat deze er vlot mee aan de slag kunnen. (Geen zorgen, je hoeft zelf geen PHP-expert te zijn!) MLOps introduceren: In nauwe samenwerking met onze system engineers en DevOps-collega's zet je stabiele deployment- en CI/CD-pipelines op. Daarnaast help je onze "Way of Working" te definiëren — van MLOps-standaarden tot het monitoren van model drift en het gedrag van autonome AI-agents. Impact: Als tweede persoon in ons AI-team is jouw vingerafdruk vanaf dag één zichtbaar op de architectuur-, integratie- en modelkeuzes. De Tech Stack AI/ML: Python, Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow & & agentic/LLM frameworks (bv. LangChain). Data: SQL, MongoDB en Clickhouse voor high-speed analytics. Infrastructuur: Onze eigen private cloud met Kubeflow voor orchestratie. Integratie: PHP/Laravel (voor de interface met onze kernapplicatie). Wat breng jij mee naar ons AI team? Je beschikt over een Masterdiploma in Informatica, AI of een gerelateerde richting (of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring) De ambitie om verder te gaan dan een model dat enkel op je eigen laptop werkt; je wilt het live zien gaan, schalen en échte waarde toevoegen. Het talent om complexe concepten zoals een "Random Forest" helder uit te leggen aan een Business Analist, maar evengoed over "API Latency" te sparren met een System Engineer. Een enorme leergierigheid waarbij je jezelf constant wilt pushen en openstaat voor hands-on mentorschap door dagelijks samen te werken met een ervaren AI Engineer. Wat kan je van BrightAnalytics verwachten? Een plekje in een van de snelst groeiende FinTech bedrijven in België Wij zijn een internationale, financieel gezonde en ISO-gecertificeerde scale-up met veel ambitie Een open en ondernemende cultuur waar jouw ideeën écht het verschil maken Je maakt deel uit van een gedreven, dynamisch en enthousiast team en je kan ook rekenen op een job vol variatie On-the-job coaching en groeikansen Maar liefst 20 wettelijke + 12 extra vakantiedagen Flexibele werkuren, dat wil zeggen opstarten tussen 7u30 en 9u30 en jouw pc dichtklappen vanaf 16u30 tot 18u30 Bedrijfswagen Maaltijdcheques van 10 euro per gewerkte dag Ecocheques Hospitalisatieverzekering Alan Health Benefits (jouw aanvullende complete gezondheidsverzekering) Friday after work drinks, legendarische teambuildings en een jaarlijks weekend met het voltallige BrightAnalytics team Klaar voor een kickstart van jouw carrière in FinTech? Solliciteer vandaag en groei mee met BrightAnalytics!

items.desc: Can’t wait to make an impact on the world? You’re not alone. Join us in driving progress in the working world and beyond. Your journey with us Deloitte Belgium’s Financial Risk department helps organizations identify the risks impacting their business and implement effective and efficient processes to measure and manage these risks (mainly market, credit and liquidity risk). To this end, the team leverages its expertise in data analytics, machine learning techniques and process optimization, combined with a strong understanding of the regulatory and business context. As a Quantitative Modeler , you will be developing, validating and implementing advanced mathematical and statistical models to address complex financial and business challenges. The ideal candidate will have a strong academic background, experience in quantitative methods, and a deep understanding of financial instruments and markets. What will you be doing? You Will Join a Team Of Experienced Risk Modelers Where Collaboration And Communication Are At The Heart Of Our Way Of Working. You Are Curious And Analytical, With a Natural Drive To Excel. Amongst Other, Your Activities Will Include Model Development: Design and develop quantitative models for risk management, utilizing techniques such as Monte Carlo simulation and machine learning. Model Validation: Conduct rigorous back-testing and validation of models, ensuring their robustness and alignment with regulation and market conditions. Data Analysis & Interpretation: Analyze large datasets to identify trends, relationships, and patterns. Work with financial and market data to derive insights for model improvement and validation. Process Optimization: Analyze process workflow and advise on improvements to facilitate experience in model application, maintenance, and internal and regulatory reporting. Research & Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest research in quantitative finance, machine learning, and statistical techniques. Apply new methodologies and tools to improve existing models and develop new strategies. Let's Talk About You You have a Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Business or Financial Engineering / Economics or Computer Science. You have between 2 and 5 years of experience in quantitative modeling and/or validation, preferably in financial services, with hands-on experience with programming languages such as Python, R, Matlab or SAS/SQL. You demonstrate understanding of business processes, regulatory requirements, internal control risk management, process, data and technology controls and related standards and frameworks. You are fluent in English and Dutch or French. Soft Skills Quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills, with high capacity for solving challenging business problems Present complex quantitative concepts and findings in a clear and accessible manner to stakeholders at various levels of technical expertise. Strong analytical thinking and a drive for continuous learning and improvement, tech-savvy Ability to work in a collaborative, team-based environment How will you grow? You will further develop your expertise across a broad range of quantitative applications in risk. As you grow, you will be given more responsibility to manage assignments working directly with senior members of our client teams and guide junior colleagues. As you become proficient in various skill sets, you will coach your colleagues and continue to enhance your management competencies. Our story Our Risk, Regulatory & Forensic practice is a global leader in helping clients manage risk and uncertainty from the boardroom to the network. We provide a broad array of services that allow our clients around the world to better measure, manage and control risk to enhance the reliability of systems and processes throughout their organization. Who is Deloitte? We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation. In Belgium, +5000 dedicated professionals active in +10 offices, take great pride in bringing multidisciplinary expertise to a wide variety of clients, from national and international companies, small, fast-growing and large organizations to public institutions and governmental authorities. Why Deloitte? Be the true you! We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energises you. Never stop growing! Diversity of thought makes us stronger. At Deloitte, we tailor a personalized learning experience, offering you the opportunity to grow at your own pace and achieve maximum impact. We practice what we preach! As a Purpose-led organisation, at the heart of everything we do is a set …

items.desc: Description & Requirements Who we are looking for 🟢Are you passionate about building intelligent applications that solve real business challenges ? At Deloitte, you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, cloud technologies, and Generative AI, helping leading organizations transform the way they work. We're looking for a Consultant-level Python/AI Developer who combines strong development skills with a consultative mindset. You'll design and build AI-powered solutions , collaborate directly with clients, and contribute to innovative projects leveraging Large Language Models, cloud platforms, and modern web technologies. 💼 What you bring: 2-4 years of experience developing backend applications with Python or Node.js / Next.js. Practical experience with React and/or Angular . Hands-on experience with Azure or AWS. Experience working with Generative AI technologies , including: LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic) Frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex Ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders. Strong problem-solving skills and a consulting mindset. Fluent English and native Hungarian are a must! Your future role Develop and deploy AI-powered applications using modern software engineering practices. Integrate Large Language Models (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic) into business solutions. Build scalable backend services using Python or Node.js. Develop intuitive user interfaces with React or Angular. Design and implement cloud-based solutions on Azure or AWS. Collaborate closely with clients to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions. Take ownership of technical deliverables and contribute to architecture discussions. Work alongside AI, Data, and Cloud experts on cutting-edge transformation programs What we offer Why Deloitte? ✅ Work on real AI and GenAI transformation projects, not just internal experiments. ✅ Collaborate with leading organizations across industries. ✅ Access the latest cloud and AI technologies. ✅ Accelerate your career through continuous learning, certifications, and mentorship. ✅ Enjoy flexible working arrangements and an international environment. ✅ Be part of a fast-growing AI & Data practice where your ideas have real impact. Selection process Step 1: Submit Your Application Apply with your CV in English. If your profile matches our requirements, our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to arrange an initial conversation in English Step 2: HR & Technical Interview Meet with our team to discuss your experience, motivations, and previous projects. We'll explore your software engineering background, AI/LLM experience, and consulting capabilities. Step 3: Final Interview Meet with senior leaders from our AI & Engineering practice. Discuss real project scenarios, team fit, and growth opportunities at Deloitte. Successful candidates will receive an offer shortly after the final interview.

items.desc: Position Description CGI UK | Space, Defence & Intelligence | Gloucester | On-site, 5 days per week At CGI, we're developing innovative software and AI-powered solutions that help protect the UK and strengthen national security. As a Software Engineer within our Space, Defence and Intelligence business, you'll help design and deliver secure, scalable applications that solve complex challenges and support mission-critical operations. You'll take ownership of meaningful development work, explore emerging AI technologies and bring creative ideas to life, turning technical innovation into real-world impact. Working alongside experienced engineers and specialists, you'll have the freedom to develop your expertise, contribute to important technical decisions and help shape future capabilities. Supported by CGI's collaborative culture and commitment to professional growth, you'll build solutions that genuinely make a difference. CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go. Due to the secure nature of this programme, applicants must be sole UK nationals and hold or be willing and eligible to undergo UK Developed Vetting (DV) security clearance. This role is based in Gloucester and requires attendance at CGI or client sites five days per week. Your future duties and responsibilities In this role, you will design, develop and maintain secure, scalable software solutions that support critical national security programmes. Working across the full software development lifecycle, you'll take ownership of technical challenges, from initial concept and design through to development, testing, deployment and continuous improvement. You'll apply modern engineering practices and automation to build reliable applications that deliver measurable value for clients. You'll also have the opportunity to explore and develop artificial intelligence capabilities, using emerging technologies to solve real-world challenges and enhance existing systems. Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, you'll contribute fresh ideas, share knowledge and help shape technical solutions. You'll be supported by experienced colleagues who encourage innovation, continuous learning and the development of your technical expertise. Key responsibilities include: Design & Develop: Build secure, scalable and maintainable software applications using modern development technologies and engineering best practices. Innovate with AI: Explore, prototype and implement AI-driven solutions that address complex client challenges and improve operational capabilities. Develop & Deliver: Contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design through to testing, deployment and ongoing support. Build & Integrate: Develop backend services, APIs and application components using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and Celery. Create & Enhance: Support the development of responsive user interfaces using React and TypeScript, contributing to effective end-to-end solutions. Automate & Optimise: Apply automation, containerisation and cloud technologies, including Docker and AWS, to improve delivery efficiency, reliability and scalability. Collaborate & Solve: Work closely with engineers, technical specialists and clients to understand requirements, resolve challenges and deliver effective solutions. Learn & Share: Explore emerging technologies, contribute to technical discussions and share knowledge to support continuous improvement across the team. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role To succeed in this role, you should have a strong foundation in software engineering, with hands-on experience developing applications using modern programming languages, frameworks and development practices. You'll bring a proactive approach to problem-solving, an interest in artificial intelligence and the ability to work effectively within agile, multidisciplinary teams. You don't need experience in every technology listed, but you should demonstrate strong capability in relevant areas and a willingness to develop your expertise further. Essential experience and qualifications: Software Engineering: Proven experience designing, developing, testing and maintaining software applications across the full development lifecycle. items.desc: Freelance Opportunities Vi samarbejder løbende med erfarne freelancekonsulenter på tværs af en bred vifte af ingeniør- og teknologiprojekter. Hvis du er interesseret i fremtidige freelanceopgaver hos Etteplan, vil vi meget gerne lære dig at kende. Send os dit CV, så kontakter vi dig, når vi ser en mulighed, der matcher din erfaring og dine kompetencer. Om Etteplan Etteplan er en international ingeniør- og teknologivirksomhed, som hjælper industrielle virksomheder med at designe, udvikle og forbedre produkter, systemer og digitale løsninger. I Danmark er vi i gang med at udvide vores tilstedeværelse og opbygger et netværk af erfarne AI & Data Professionals, som er interesserede i at arbejde med os på kommende projekter. Vores kunder arbejder med kunstig intelligens, data og digitalisering på mange forskellige måder – fra machine learning og data engineering til generativ AI og intelligente produkter på tværs af brancher som produktion, energi, life science og industriel teknologi. Om rollen Vi søger profiler, der ønsker at være med til at udvikle intelligente løsninger baseret på data og kunstig intelligens. Afhængigt af projektet kan du arbejde med machine learning, generativ AI, data engineering, analytics eller udvikling af AI-løsninger, der understøtter digitale produkter og forretningsprocesser. Du vil typisk samarbejde med software engineers, data specialister, domæneeksperter og forretningsinteressenter om at omsætte data og teknologi til løsninger, der skaber reel værdi. Typiske teknologier og kompetenceområder Programming & AI Development Python, Java, C#, C++ eller tilsvarende programmeringssprog. Machine Learning & Data Science Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Science, statistiske modeller og predictive analytics. Generative AI & LLMs Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI-agenter og lignende løsninger. Cloud & MLOps Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, MLOps, CI/CD og cloud-baserede AI-platforme. Data Engineering & Analytics Data pipelines, ETL, dataplatforme, analytics og databehandling. Du behøver ikke at have erfaring med alle teknologierne ovenfor. Vi arbejder med forskellige kunder og projekter, så den konkrete teknologistak afhænger af opgaven. Hvem vi typisk leder efter Vi er som udgangspunkt interesserede i profiler, der har: erfaring med ét eller flere områder inden for AI, machine learning eller data erfaring med at udvikle eller implementere intelligente løsninger evnen til at omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til praktiske løsninger interesse for nye teknologier og kontinuerlig læring erfaring med tværfagligt samarbejde mellem teknik og forretning Derfor søger vi profilen Vi arbejder løbende på nye projekter i Danmark og vil gerne være i dialog med erfarne AI & Data Professionals. Selvom der ikke nødvendigvis er et konkret projekt lige nu, tager vi ofte fat i kandidater fra vores netværk, når nye muligheder opstår. Vi er altid interesserede i at komme i dialog med dygtige specialister. Selvom vi ikke nødvendigvis har et projekt, der matcher din profil i dag, vil vi meget gerne lære dig at kende og kontakte dig, når den rette mulighed opstår. Hvad sker der, når du søger Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende. Hvis din profil matcher et kommende projekt, kontakter vi dig for en uforpligtende dialog om mulighederne. Din profil kan også blive en del af vores konsulentnetværk til fremtidige projekter.

Permettant de réduire
items.desc: L'évolution récente des modèles d'IA générative a été portée par une augmentation exponentielle de leur nombre de paramètres de calcul. Ceci induit une augmentation drastique des ressources mémoire nécessaires pour leur accélération ainsi qu'exacerbe la criticité du mouvement de données au sein du système de calcul, que ce soit au niveau de l'efficacité énergétique ou la latence globale. Permettant de réduire fortement le mouvement de données au sein du système de calcul, les approches analog in-memory computing (aIMC) promettent des bénéfices remarquables au niveau de l'efficacité énergétique de calcul, ouvrant une voie pour rendre le déploiement des réseaux de neurones à l'état de l'art à l'edge possible. Cependant, les non-idéalités des technologies mémoire actuelles limitent fortement la scalabilité du aIMC vers les modèles d'IA générative performants. Votre travail concernera le co-développement dispositif-application IA, en se focalisant sur la compression de modèles de langage à l'état de l'art, de type small language model, et leur co-optimisation avec les caractéristiques et contraintes des technologies mémoire. Vous travaillerez entre le CEA-Leti et le CEA-List, bénéficiant d'un écosystème de pointe pour le développement de modèles d'IA et de technologies électroniques. Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ? Nous vous proposons : Une expérience à la pointe de l’innovation, comportant un fort potentiel de développement industriel Des formations pour renforcer vos compétences ou en acquérir de nouvelles Un poste au cœur de la métropole grenobloise, facilement accessible via la mobilité douce favorisée par le CEA Un équilibre vie privée – vie professionnelle reconnu Une politique diversité et inclusion Des restaurants d'entreprise Profil du candidat Avec une formation en informatique et IA ou en électronique, vous savez résoudre des problèmes et faites preuve d'une grande capacité d'adaptation ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en communication. items.desc: Votre mission L’objectif de ce stage est d’utiliser l’IA pour aider les ingénieurs à prouver mathématiquement que des logiciels critiques (aéronautique, ferroviaire, automobile…) respectent les principes de sécurité et sont exempts de bugs critiques. L’IA permettra de diminuer le temps de travail des ingénieurs car la vérification formelle est très puissante mais complexe et chronophage. La construction de preuves (en particulier via des lemmes, des tactiques et des règles de vérification) reste une tâche complexe et chronophage, nécessitant souvent une expertise significative en matière de prouveurs de théorèmes et de cadres de modélisation. Les récentes avancées en Intelligence Artificielle (IA), notamment les grands modèles de langage (LLM) et les systèmes de raisonnement multi-agents, ont ouvert de nouvelles opportunités pour automatiser et assister les processus de vérification formelle. Les techniques pilotées par l’IA peuvent générer automatiquement des scripts de preuve, suggérer des lemmes auxiliaires, optimiser les stratégies de vérification et identifier des invariants réutilisables, réduisant ainsi l’effort manuel et améliorant la productivité. Apprentissage De L’IA  Les prouveurs de théorèmes modernes (Rocq (Ex-Coq), Isabelle, etc.) fournissent une vaste littérature de preuves formelles. Ces exemples pourraient servir de jeux de données d’entraînement pour des IA capables d’apprendre à prédire les étapes de preuve, les tactiques et les lemmes.  L’apprentissage par renforcement peut être réalisé avec une correction de preuve évaluée par le prouveur de théorèmes lui-même. IA Appliquée à Des Outils Particuliers  Atelier B & HLL : Ces environnements nécessitent que les utilisateurs construisent des obligations de preuve pour assurer la correction des spécifications système. Des modèles d’IA entraînés sur des preuves issues de la littérature peuvent suggérer des scripts de preuve, des règles utilisateur et des lemmes auxiliaires.  Simulink, HLL ou Frama-C : Des modèles d’IA peuvent assister dans l’inférence d’invariants. Vos atouts – Vous avez des connaissances en méthode formelle (Expérience pratique avec Coq/Rocq ou Isabelle) et des compétences en développement informatique (Python, OCaml, …) ; – Vous avez des connaissances en intelligence artificielle ou en apprentissage automatique ; – Vous aimez travailler en équipe et faites preuve de curiosité, d’autonomie et d’un bon sens de l’organisation. Apprentissage : 1 à 3 ans Stage : 6 mois Localisation PARIS 8E ARRONDISSEMENT (75008) À propos de SERMA Rejoignez SafeRiver, filiale de SERMA Safety and Security, et contribuez à l’alliance entre sécurité et cybersécurité pour des systèmes embarqués fiables ! Fondée en 2005, SafeRiver s’est donnée pour mission de proposer des services de conseil en sécurité et cybersécurité pour les systèmes basés sur des logiciels. À l’ère où les défis en matière de sécurité se conjuguent avec ceux de la cybersécurité, nous sommes à la pointe de l’innovation. Avec l’ouverture croissante des systèmes embarqués, l’utilisation de composants open-source, et la sensibilité accrue aux attaques, nous aidons nos clients à naviguer dans cette complexité, tout en maîtrisant les coûts de vérification et de certification. Chez SafeRiver, nous développons et déployons des moyens méthodologiques et des composants pour aider nos clients à atteindre un niveau de confiance plus élevé dans les systèmes qu’ils développent. Notre Efficacité Repose Sur Des services innovants avec un engagement envers les résultats Une large application des méthodes formelles (preuves et/ou analyse statique) Des investissements en recherche et développement à travers des projets collaboratifs ou financés en interne Des plateformes propriétaires basées sur des outils puissants (SafeRiver Toolkit) Pourquoi choisir SafeRiver ? Une expertise reconnue en sécurité et cybersécurité Des projets innovants qui font la différence Un environnement de travail flexible et dynamique Des opportunités d’évolution professionnelle et de formation Une culture d’entreprise axée sur la collaboration et l’innovation Ensemble, faisons évoluer la sécurité des systèmes embarqués et relevons les défis de demain ! En rejoignant SafeRiver, vous intégrerez une équipe passionnée, où votre expertise sera valorisée et où vous aurez l’opportunité de travailler sur des projets novateurs. Ensemble, nous affrontons les défis d’un monde numérique en évolution constante, tout en développant vos compétences dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif. En intégrant SafeRiver, vous intégrez plus largement le groupe SERMA : un Groupe solide et indépendant, en pleine croissance sur ses marchés, et expert des métiers de l’électronique et de la microélectronique, de l’énergie, de la cybersécurité et des télécoms. items.desc: Tijdens deze stage werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van een innovatieve AI-ondersteunde business case tool. Deze oplossing helpt organisaties om de businesswaarde en return on investment van softwareprojecten inzichtelijk te maken. Samen met onze Product Owner en engineering experts analyseer je bedrijfsuitdagingen, ontwerp je een gebruiksvriendelijke oplossing en bouw je mee aan een applicatie die echte impact creëert voor klanten. Je combineert softwareontwikkeling, AI-integratie en businesslogica om tot een praktisch en professioneel eindresultaat te komen. Het analyseren van bedrijfsprocessen en identificeren van relevante KPI's en businessdrivers. Het vertalen van functionele en zakelijke vereisten naar een duidelijke gebruikersflow en technische oplossing. Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van een enterprise-grade backend in .NET of Java. Het integreren van AI-services en Large Language Models (LLM's) binnen een professionele applicatie. Het bouwen van een interactieve frontend met Angular. Het visualiseren van financiële inzichten via dashboards, grafieken en ROI-berekeningen. Het automatisch genereren van professionele rapporten en business cases. Het samenwerken met product owners, software engineers en architecten binnen een agile omgeving. Wat breng jij mee? Volg je een bachelor Toegepaste Informatica of een gelijkaardige IT-gerelateerde opleiding? Dan ben jij misschien de stagiair die we zoeken! Je hebt interesse in softwareontwikkeling, AI-toepassingen en het creëren van digitale oplossingen die echte bedrijfswaarde opleveren. Je werkt zelfstandig, denkt analytisch en neemt graag initiatief om complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden. Heb je al kennis van Angular, .NET of API-ontwikkeling? Dat is mooi meegenomen. Ook een interesse in AI, data of businessanalyse vormt een pluspunt. Belangrijker nog zijn jouw leergierigheid, probleemoplossend vermogen en motivatie om nieuwe technologieën te ontdekken. Wat hebben wij jou te bieden? Jij komt terecht in een ambitieus en enthousiast team. Onze experten begeleiden jou gedurende de volledige stageperiode. Je krijgt persoonlijke coaching van ervaren engineering leads en een Product Owner. Je bouwt mee aan een innovatieve oplossing die daadwerkelijk wordt gebruikt binnen klantentrajecten. Je doet praktijkervaring op met moderne technologieën zoals Angular, .NET en AI-integraties. Je leert hoe technische oplossingen worden vertaald naar concrete businesswaarde voor organisaties. Kilometervergoeding, flexibele werkuren, afterwork drinks,… we've got you covered! Werken kan vanuit een Cegeka-kantoor in Hasselt, gecombineerd met thuiswerk. De keuze is aan jou!

In Lutech tecnologia, dati e AI diventano strumenti concreti per trasformare processi, servizi ed esperienze. Attraverso competenze tecnologiche avanzate, ecosistemi digitali integrati e piattaforme AI proprietarie come Lutech BrAIn, il Gruppo accompagna l’evoluzione dell’intelligenza artificiale dall’analisi all’impatto operativo reale, in scenari complessi e internazionali. Entrare in Lutech significa far parte di una community tecnologica globale , collaborando con team multidisciplinari su sfide reali legate ad AI, cybersecurity, cloud e digital transformation , in un ambiente inclusivo e orientato alla crescita , dove competenze, collaborazione e diversità delle esperienze contribuiscono a costruire l’evoluzione tecnologica del futuro. Posizione Sei una persona appassionata di Intelligenza Artificiale e vuoi iniziare il tuo percorso professionale lavorando su tecnologie innovative? Siamo alla ricerca di giovani talenti da inserire in stage all’interno dei nostri team tecnologici, con l’opportunità di affiancare professionisti del settore e contribuire a progetti in ambito Artificial Intelligence e sviluppo software. In Particolare, Le Attività Prevederanno Supporto allo sviluppo e alla sperimentazione di soluzioni basate su AI e Machine Learning; Sviluppo e test di applicazioni e componenti software; Utilizzo di Docker per la creazione e gestione di ambienti containerizzati; Collaborazione nelle attività di integrazione, deployment e testing delle soluzioni; Approfondimento di tecnologie e strumenti innovativi legati all’AI. Requisiti Cerchiamo te se hai: Laurea o percorso di studi in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, AI, Data Science o discipline STEM affini; Conoscenza di base di Python; Interesse per Artificial Intelligence e Machine Learning; Conoscenza, anche accademica, di Docker e container; Familiarità con Git e concetti base di sviluppo software; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Per questa opportunità è previsto un inserimento in stage extracurriculare con un rimborso spese mensile a partire da 800€ lordi. Nel rispetto della normativa sulla trasparenza retributiva, l’importo indicato rappresenta un riferimento iniziale, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rimborso finale sarà determinato tenendo conto del titolo di studio, delle conoscenze acquisite nel percorso formativo e delle evidenze emerse durante il processo di selezione. Altre Informazioni La tua sede di lavoro sarà Roma e opererai in modalità ibrida (smart working). Lutech attua una politica di pari opportunità e accoglie le candidature senza operare alcuna discriminazione in base a razza, religione o convinzioni personali, origine etnica o nazionale, disabilità, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, inclusa convivenza di fatto e unione civile, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, o qualsiasi altra condizione applicabile tutelata dalla legge. Per scoprire di più sul mondo Lutech e sulle opportunità di carriera, visita Lutech Group

items.desc: Rejoignez la Direction Software Engineering qui développe l'ensemble des produits logiciels nécessaires au fonctionnement de nos systèmes d'armes. Au sein du Service Logiciel IHM (Interface Homme-Machine) , vous participerez à la réalisation d'un logiciel opérationnel de type centre de commandement, de préparation de mission ou d'outils. Les centres de commandement des systèmes d’armes sont des logiciels d’aide à la décision permettant d’évaluer et d’exécuter le meilleur plan d’engagement du tir missile. La préparation de mission permet de préparer au sol les données nécessaires à l’exécution d'une mission. Enfin les outils d'analyse et de traitement de données sont des logiciels utilisés pour la validation et la qualification de nos systèmes. Ces logiciels opérationnels mettent en œuvre des technologies complexes : IHM Front/Back End (représentation cartographique, 2D/3D, réalité virtuelle/augmentée, vidéo...), architectures complexes (client serveur, middleware, gestion de données). Vous rejoindrez une équipe composée d'une vingtaine de personnes, jeunes, dynamiques et curieuses de s’essayer à de nouvelles méthodologies de développement. Objectif De Votre Stage Enrichir fonctionnellement un Chatbot IA intégré aux produits afin de permettre la génération automatique de données structurées XML à partir d’un prompt. Grâce à Vos Compétences, Vous Étudiez la faisabilité du projet et les contraintes associées ; Concevez une solution répondant au besoin de génération automatique de données structurées ; Constituez des jeux de données d’entraînement adaptés aux cas d’usage ; Alimentez l’IA avec les jeux de données et un fichier XML afin de permettre sa modification selon les demandes utilisateur ; Contribuez à l’évolution de la solution en Java pour assurer son intégration fluide dans l’outil interne ; Présentez la solution développée et ses résultats, puis rédigez un rapport de synthèse destiné aux équipes internes. En transverse, vous aurez la possibilité de soumettre vos idées et de faire émerger des sujets qui s’inscriront dans le cadre innovant de l’entreprise. Actuellement en dernière année d'un cycle Ingénieur ou équivalent avec une spécialisation en Informatique Industrielle et/ou Logiciel et/ou Intelligence Artificielle. Vous possédez des premières connaissances en Java ainsi qu'en IA. Compte tenu de l'environnement international de la société, un bon niveau d'anglais est requis. Durée du stage : 6 mois conventionnés Date de début : à partir de février 2027 (modulable) Les défis technologiques l’industrie de défense vous motivent ? Envoyez-nous votre candidature !

items.desc: LIEU : Neuilly-sur-Seine Date : Janvier 2027 DUREE : 6 mois Chanel est une entreprise indépendante qui croit en la liberté de la création, cultive le potentiel humain et s’engage activement pour avoir un impact positif dans le monde. A ce titre, vous aurez principalement en charge les missions suivante s : Explorer de nouveaux matériaux, des procédés durables et des outils d’IA avec des start-up et des fournisseurs ; Tester les applications de l’IA à la simulation physico-chimique du packaging et à la synthèse d’informations techniques ; Contribuer au prototypage d’agents IA pour faciliter la recherche et la synthèse d’informations et renouveler les méthodes de travail de l’équipe ; Préparer et suivre les essais, analyser les résultats et proposer des pistes d’amélioration pour les projets en cours ; Enrichir la cartographie des technologies et des partenaires identifiés, par catégorie d’innovation ; Accompagner l’exploration de nouveaux outils d’IA et partager les bonnes pratiques ; Coordonner les échanges avec les équipes internes et les partenaires, dans le respect de la confidentialité. CE QUI VOUS ENTHOUSIASME ET CE QUE CHANEL PEUT VOUS OFFRIR Tout au long de votre expérience, vous serez immergé(e) dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et apprenant ; où la création et l’humain sont au cœur des préoccupations. Chez CHANEL, nous nous attachons à promouvoir une culture inclusive qui favorise l’épanouissement personnel et contribue au progrès collectif. Nous sommes convaincus que le caractère unique de chaque individu contribue à la diversité, la complémentarité et l’efficacité de nos équipes. Nous encourageons vivement votre candidature, car nous apprécions la perspective, l’expérience et le potentiel que vous pourriez apporter à CHANEL.

items.desc: About the Company: At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections. The Role You’ll Play: As a Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in driving insights and building data products that support large-scale, cross-departmental initiatives. You’ll combine advanced statistical inference, strong engineering skills, and business intuition to create models and tools that improve marketplace efficiency, retention, and growth. This role is not about building models in isolation—it’s about leveraging data science to influence strategy, fuel automation, and deliver measurable business impact. Partner with Product, Marketing, Operations, and Finance teams to design and execute analytical solutions that optimize marketplace dynamics, improve unit economics, and uncover opportunities for growth. Apply statistical inference and causal modeling to evaluate experiments, quantify business impact, and guide decision-making under uncertainty. Design, prototype, and deploy scalable data products such as anomaly detection systems, prioritization algorithms, and similarity/recommendation models. Translate complex models and findings into actionable insights and clear recommendations for business stakeholders, including executives. Build frameworks for experimentation, measurement, and monitoring that drive iteration and continuous improvement of strategic initiatives. Balance hands-on technical work (modeling, coding, automation) with strategic thinking, ensuring data science investments align with business objectives. Act as a technical thought partner and mentor for analysts and junior data scientists, raising the bar on scientific rigor and reproducibility. Experience You Bring: 3–5 years of experience in data science, applied statistics, or a related quantitative discipline, ideally within marketplace or platform businesses. Strong expertise in statistical inference, causal modeling, and experiment design, with the ability to draw robust conclusions from noisy or incomplete data. Proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, PySpark, etc.) and SQL, with experience building and deploying production-grade models. Proven track record of designing and delivering data products such as anomaly detectors, ranking/prioritization models, similarity or recommendation systems. Familiarity architecting automated pipelines and data flows that support machine learning and analytics at scale. Ability to balance technical depth with business acumen—knowing when a simple solution beats a complex one, and when complexity is necessary to win. Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence non-technical stakeholders and executives. Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-paced environment; you thrive on experimentation, iteration, and turning insights into action. Familiarity with data visualization and dashboarding tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) to communicate insights effectively. Internally competitive and externally collaborative Have we piqued your curiosity? Sound like the role for you? We’d love to hear from you! Even if you’re not 100% sure about potential fit, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for the right person, not the perfect series of checkboxes. If you are a California resident or reside outside the United States then by submitting your application you confirm that you have read, understood, agree and - where applicable - grant your prior, free, informed and express consent for the processing of your personal information, including sensitive personal information, as described in our California Applicant Privacy Notice or International Applicant Privacy Notice (as applicable). Entreprise familiale depuis plus de 100 ans, présente dans plus de 80 pays, Mars est guidée par ses 5 Principes : Qualité, Responsabilité, Mutualité, Efficacité et Liberté. Nos marques iconiques comme M&M's, Snickers, Royal Canin ou Pedigree font partie du quotidien de millions de consommateurs et de propriétaires d’animaux à travers le monde. Mais derrière ces marques, il y a surtout des équipes engagées et animées par l’envie de construire le monde de demain. Ton stage chez Mars ? Pas un stage café. Chez Mars, tu es considéré(e) comme un associé(e) avec des vraies responsabilités. Des projets engagés. Un fort impact. C’est l’opportunité de rejoindre des équipes passionnées au cœur de grandes marques et notre vivier de talents Mars : la majorité de nos postes junior sont pourvus par nos jeunes Talents. Ce qui t’attend concrètement : Des missions responsabilisantes (pas de missions “fictives”) De l’autonomie (oui mais toujours accompagné de ton Buddy) Un environnement où tu peux oser, proposer, challenger Nous sommes à la recherche de profils curieux, engagés, qui ont envie d’apprendre et de grandir au sein d’une entreprise multiculturelle. Si tu veux vivre une expérience qui compte vraiment sur ton CV (et pour toi), Rejoins-nous ! Stage Royal Canin - Promoteur de l'IA générative pour la R&D Royal Canin (H/F/X) – Janvier 2027 – Aimargues France – 6 mois Rémunération et avantages : Gratification : 1200€/brut mensuel en BAC +4 1350€/brut mensuel en BAC+5 Carte titres restaurant Restaurant d’entreprise Un jour d’absence autorisé payé par mois de présence Prime de transport trajet domicile – lieu de travail Navette gratuite CSE Un campus moderne offrant un cadre de travail agréable (grands espaces de travail, espace dédié au sport) Café et thé à disposition A propos du poste : Envie de mettre la GenAI au service de la science ? En rejoignant l'équipe IT pour la R&D de Royal Canin, tu participeras à un projet d'envergure : favoriser l'adoption et la création de valeur de l'IA Générative (GenAI) au sein de nos équipes de recherche. En binôme avec nos experts, tu exploreras des cas d'usage innovants, animeras notre communauté interne et accompagneras nos scientifiques dans cette transition technologique majeure. Une opportunité unique d'allier technologie de pointe, conduite du changement et dimension internationale ! Tes missions principales : Explorer les capacités émergentes et les tendances de l’IA générative en collaborant activement avec nos communautés d’experts internes ainsi qu’avec des sources externes. Identifier, analyser et documenter des cas d’usage GenAI à forte valeur ajoutée au sein des équipes R&D, en évaluant leur potentiel de déploiement à grande échelle et leur réutilisabilité. Tu contribueras ensuite à la création d’une base de connaissances pour booster l’innovation et la productivité. Développer tes compétences en conseil et en gestion des parties prenantes grâce à des interactions directes avec nos scientifiques, chercheurs, responsables métiers et équipes digitales, afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de les transformer en opportunités concrètes. Contribuer activement à la communauté GenAI de la R&D Royal Canin en participant à la définition des sujets prioritaires, à la préparation et à l’animation de présentations, à la facilitation des échanges et à la collecte de retours d’expérience auprès de publics variés. Acquérir une expérience pratique en gestion de projets IT en coordonnant et en soutenant la mise en œuvre d’une initiative GenAI concrète, depuis la phase de conception jusqu’au déploiement, aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés (un chef de projet IT dédié assurera le pilotage principal). items.desc: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. We are seeking an AI Systems Infrastructure Engineer (IC4) to lead the platform and backend architecture powering our real-time security detection services. In this role, you will build and scale low-latency serving infrastructure for Small Language Models (SLM), Prompt Injection (PI) engines, and Content / Intent Classification platforms running across GPU and cloud clusters. We are looking for a strong systems engineer who understands production backend services, microservices, container management, and high-throughput inference optimization. While you will work closely with ML researchers, your primary focus will be engineering robust backend services, GPU replica scaling, guardrails, and automated evaluation infrastructure. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: Sub-hundred-millisecond SLM and detection service execution speeds across high-volume tenant workloads. Highly resilient, auto-scaling GPU inference cluster infrastructure with automated CI/CD and regression gating. Success Metrics / KPIs : P95 and P99 detection latency for prompt injection (PI) and classification services. GPU pod readiness time and cluster auto-scaling efficiency under burst traffic. Service availability and rate-limiting guardrail enforcement per tenant. Automated MLOps/LLMops pipeline throughput and deployment turnaround time. What You'll Do Architect, build, and optimize production serving pipelines for Small Language Models (SLMs) and traditional ML models using model quantization, batching, and GPU acceleration. Own and scale backend microservices (e.g., sds-service-prompt-injection, sds-service-ddr) delivering real-time threat detection. Build consumption-based monitoring, tenant rate-limiting, and runtime guardrail infrastructure. Manage and optimize GPU cluster replicas (Kubernetes / Pod infrastructure) to minimize cold-start times and manage infrastructure costs. Build continuous evaluation, automated retraining pipelines, model CI/CD, and automated regression gates to test model detection quality against live benchmarks. Refactor legacy service boundaries, service-to-service auth flows, and backend database configurations. Requirements: 5+ years of software engineering experience building distributed backend systems or high-throughput microservices. Proven track record in model serving and inference optimization (e.g., TensorRT, vLLM, ONNX Runtime, Triton Inference Server). Strong programming experience in Python, Go, or C++. Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes, container orchestration, GPU scheduling, and infrastructure auto-scaling. Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, MLOps/LLMops principles, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). Preferred / Nice to Have : Experience building consumption-based rate limiting or multi-tenant guardrail architectures. Familiarity with database refactoring, auth protocols, and backend technical debt remediation. Background in cybersecurity, threat detection engines, or DLP/PII filtering platforms. Experience benchmarking runtime vs. accuracy trade-offs between local SLMs and cloud LLMs (e.g., Vertex AI). Experience with AWS, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Linux. Follow us on LinkedIn! Why Menlo? At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership , Straight Talk , United Impact , Elevated Talent , and Customer-Compelled . We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.
