items.desc: Ben jij een engineer die niet wacht tot AI “klaar” is, maar nu al ziet hoe het ons werk slimmer en sneller maakt? Beweeg je je net zo makkelijk tussen code, product en de mensen die ermee werken? En wil je een organisatie die al volop met AI experimenteert naar een hoger niveau tillen? Dan zoeken wij jou. Bij TreeHouse is AI geen losstaand project en geen toekomstmuziek — het zit al in onze dagelijkse workflow, van code generation tot het versnellen van sprints. Maar de mogelijkheden gaan veel verder dan waar we nu staan. We zoeken een AI Engineer die de kar trekt: iemand die de techniek dóórgrondt, disciplines verbindt, versnelling aanjaagt én faciliteert, en die de razendsnel veranderende wereld van AI blijft begrijpen en vertalen naar concrete waarde voor onze producten. De rol: aanjager, niet uitvoerder Dit is een senior rol met veel autonomie en directe impact. Je bent geen radertje in één team, maar een aanjager die over teams en producten heen kijkt: Pararius Office, Leadflow, Pararius.nl en Huurwoningen.nl. Je vertaalt nieuwe AI-ontwikkelingen naar kansen, bouwt zelf de proof of concepts die laten zien dat het werkt, en helpt teams die kansen daarna structureel te benutten. Het is nadrukkelijk geen managementrol. Je stuurt op inhoud en techniek, niet op mensen. Je gezag komt voort uit wat je bouwt, wat je weet en hoe goed je anderen meekrijgt — niet uit een plek in een hiërarchie. Wat ga je doen? Je verkent en doorgrondt nieuwe AI-ontwikkelingen (LLM's, agents, RAG, evaluatie- en orchestratietooling) en vertaalt ze naar concrete kansen voor onze producten en processen. Je bouwt zelf: van prototype en proof of concept tot productiewaardige AI-features die makelaars en woningzoekenden echt verder helpen. Je verbindt disciplines — engineering, product, data en business — en zorgt dat AI-initiatieven niet op een eiland blijven liggen. Je jaagt versnelling aan én faciliteert die: je tilt de AI-werkwijze van onze engineers naar een hoger niveau en helpt teams effectiever met tooling als Cursor en Claude te werken. Je denkt mee over de architectuur en randvoorwaarden om AI verantwoord en schaalbaar in productie te draaien: kwaliteit, kosten, privacy, monitoring en evaluatie. Je blijft kritisch: je onderscheidt hype van waarde en bewaakt dat we AI inzetten waar het écht iets oplevert. Wat bouwen we? TreeHouse werkt aan platforms die maandelijks meer dan 3 miljoen woningzoekenden verbinden met verhuurprofessionals: Pararius.nl en Huurwoningen.nl, en de CRM-producten Pararius Office en Leadflow. Daar valt enorm veel te winnen met AI — slimmere matching, betere kandidaatselectie, geautomatiseerde processen en datagedreven features. Technisch werken onze teams met PHP (Domain-Driven Design en CQRS), Docker, Kubernetes op Google Cloud Platform, en CI/CD-pipelines met tooling als PHPStan, CS Fixer en Deptrac. AI-tooling (Cursor, Claude) is een vast onderdeel van onze dagelijkse werkwijze — en die versnelling neemt alleen maar toe. Jij helpt bepalen waar we als organisatie heen bewegen. Wat krijg je van ons? Een rol met veel autonomie en directe impact op de richting van een organisatie die volop op AI inzet. Een Mac of Dell laptop om op te werken. Marktconform salaris passend bij een senior profiel. Goede pensioenregeling (wij vergoeden 70%). Ruimte en budget voor opleiding, conferenties en experimenteren met nieuwe tooling. Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid deels thuis te werken. Inspirerende werkplek op de 22e verdieping van Blaak 555 Rotterdam — met een uitzicht dat voor zichzelf spreekt. Gezamenlijke lunches, vrijdagmiddagborrels en leuke teamuitjes. Wekelijkse bootcamp op dinsdagmiddag en korting op een sportabonnement via Urban Sports Club. Over TreeHouse TreeHouse is een toonaangevende digitale speler in de vastgoedmarkt, actief sinds 2006. Met platforms als Pararius.nl, Huurwoningen.nl, Leadflow, RentaRoof.co.uk en Toitpourtoi.fr verbinden we maandelijks meer dan 3 miljoen woningzoekenden met verhuurprofessionals. We zijn een informeel bedrijf met zo'n 80 collega's en werken in kleine, zelfstandige teams die snel schakelen en veel met elkaar sparren. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als software engineer en een sterke, brede technische basis. Je hebt aantoonbaar met AI gebouwd — denk aan LLM-applicaties, integraties, agents, RAG of ML-features — en weet wat er komt kijken bij AI in productie. Je doorgrondt de techniek écht: je snapt hoe het werkt onder de motorkap en blijft je verdiepen in een vakgebied dat maandelijks verandert. Je bent een verbinder: je schakelt moeiteloos tussen engineers, product en business en krijgt mensen mee. Je bent een aanjager met overtuigingskracht — je laat zien wat kan door het te bouwen, niet alleen door erover te praten. Je hebt een pragmatische, kritische blik: je herkent waar AI waarde toevoegt én waar je terughoudend moet zijn. Je voelt je thuis in een moderne devops-omgeving (Docker, Git, CI/CD) en bent comfortabel met cloud (bij voorkeur GCP). Je communiceert …

Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien Au sein de l’activité Véhicules et Systèmes Tactiques, le site de La Ferté Saint Aubin est spécialisé dans la production de systèmes d’armements terrestres et aéroportés (mortiers, munitions, roquettes…), de systèmes de protection des forces et de contrôle de zone. Fort de ses 450 salariés, ingénieurs, techniciens et ouvriers spécialisés, le site de la Ferté Saint Aubin assure la recherche et développement, la production, les essais ainsi que toutes les fonctions « supports » nécessaires à la conception de systèmes performants essentiels à la réussite des missions opérationnelles. Définir, structurer et maintenir les indicateurs de performance (KPI) nécessaires au pilotage des activités industrielles, en garantissant leur cohérence et leur fiabilité. Concevoir et développer des tableaux de bord Power BI permettant le suivi en temps réel de la performance opérationnelle et l'aide à la décision. Assurer la qualité, la gouvernance et l'exploitation des données industrielles, depuis leur collecte jusqu'à leur mise à disposition des utilisateurs. Identifier, développer et industrialiser des cas d'usage d'Intelligence Artificielle, notamment dans les domaines de la maintenance prédictive, de l'optimisation des procédés, de la qualité produit et de l'efficacité énergétique. Développer et déployer des modèles analytiques et d'IA sous Python, Dataiku ou outils équivalents, en assurant leur robustesse et leur performance. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions de Computer Vision et d'analyse d'images industrielles, incluant les applications de contrôle automatisé et de contrôle radiographique RX. Participer aux choix d'architecture, à l'industrialisation et à la sécurisation des solutions Data & IA, dans le respect des exigences de conformité, de cyber sécurité et de gouvernance des données. Accompagner les équipes métiers dans l'adoption des solutions déployées, diffuser les bonnes pratiques Data/IA et assurer une veille technologique permanente sur les innovations du marché. items.desc: Vous souhaitez mettre votre énergie au service d’un groupe qui bâtit un avenir durable ? Rejoignez le groupe EDF pour exprimer votre énergie au service des enjeux climatiques. Au sein de la Direction R&D, vous rejoignez une équipe pluridisciplinaire de quinze personnes. Les missions de cette équipe sont de développer des solutions innovantes autour des systèmes d’information, des télécommunications et de la robotique afin d’accompagner les moyens de production d’électricité. En tant qu’Ingénieure/Ingénieur de recherche robotique, vous contribuez à l’intégration de solutions innovantes pour les activités de production. Vous prenez en charge les missions suivantes au plus près des besoins du terrain et du collectif : réaliser une veille sur les technologies robotiques, télécoms et d’intelligence artificielle ; analyser les usages et besoins des métiers ; concevoir des maquettes et prototypes intégrant des systèmes robotiques ; travailler avec des partenaires industriels et de recherche ; transférer les solutions développées vers les équipes chargées de leur industrialisation. Vous avez un cursus académique de niveau bac +5 avec des compétences solides et reconnues dans le domaine de la robotique, de la mécatronique, des télécommunications et de l’intelligence artificielle. Vous disposez d'un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la robotique, vous disposez de compétences en mécanique, électronique, commandes robotiques, télécom et IA pour la robotique. Vous disposez également de connaissances en programmation (ROS 2, C++, Java, Python). Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais aussi bien oral qu’écrit. Vous faites preuve de capacité d’adaptation, capacité d’analyse et esprit de synthèse, autonomie et vous avez le sens du client. Vos motivations pour la conception et le développement informatique, votre goût prononcé pour les nouvelles technologies et leur application au développement de produits innovants, votre rigueur, et votre capacité à collaborer sont des atouts indéniables pour mener vos projets à bien. La connaissance de l’environnement Linux est indispensable. La diversité alimente notre performance. Dans le groupe EDF, accueillir des personnes en situation de handicap fait partie de notre ADN. Notre objectif est d’ouvrir nos portes à toutes les compétences, toutes les énergies et toutes les personnalités sans exclusion. Le poste proposé est donc ouvert à toutes et à tous. Rémunération proposée: Rémunération brute annuelle de base hors primes : de 46000 € à 68000 €, selon diplôme et expérience professionnelle. Package global comprenant : prime individuelle de performance, intéressement et épargne salariale. Avantages selon conditions d’éligibilité : tarif préférentiel sur l’électricité et le gaz, aides aux familles et à la parentalité, dispositifs de mobilité durable, activités sociales et culturelles … Le poste est soumis à des règlementations spécifiques qui nécessitent la vérification de ou des nationalités du candidat. En rejoignant EDF, vous contribuez à la transition énergétique aux côtés de celles et ceux qui partagent la même ambition. Votre énergie est notre force

items.desc: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd. (“TSMC”) is the world’s leading semiconductor foundry. Headquartered in Taiwan, the Company has operation facilities worldwide and the largest logic chip manufacturing capacity in global semiconductor industry. The Company employs a global workforce of over 89.000 and recorded revenue over US$122 billion in 2025. TSMC produces the chips that are found in smart phones, tablets, computers, smart TVs, cars, laptops, games consoles, data centers and many more applications. TSMC sells to a wide variety of customers, including most leading semiconductor companies. At the TSMC EU Design Center, you’ll work in an exceptional technology and design team to refine your technical and leadership skills within the world's most advanced design service ecosystem. You'll be contributing to the forefront of semiconductor technology, including cutting-edge nonvolatile memory solutions like MRAM and RRAM. Your main focus will be to assist our leading customers in delivering state-of-the-art products that have a transformative impact on people's lives. Job Responsibilities Your work will enable chip innovation possible by developing and optimizing all aspects in the pre-silicon design flow, including: Develop memory IP and compilers targeting AI applications optimized with TSMC process. Develop test chips to validate the memory IP. Conduct rigorous testing to ensure reliability and scalability of developed solutions. Responsibilities For Developing Memory Test Chips And IP Include Conduct circuit design or RTL coding. Perform design verification. Review and verifying layout reports. Prepare design reports. Collaborate on test chip implementation. Assist with silicon characterization and reliability qualification. Contribute to front-end and back-end design kit generation. Analyze and debug silicon data. Provide technical support to customers. Job Qualifications A Master’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related field. Over 5 years of experience in circuit and logic design for embedded memory technologies. Experience in compute-in-memory or AI algorithms is considered a strong advantage. Proficiency with EDA tools and expertise in design methodologies for custom or digital design in the field of non-volatile memory. Only the applications relevant to the criteria above will be taken for further consideration. items.desc: Chez MBDA, le sens de notre mission est ce qui nous unit : contribuer à la souveraineté des nations et préserver notre sécurité et notre liberté en Europe. Pour y parvenir, la collaboration et la confiance sont essentielles. MBDA doit relever des défis uniques pour répondre aux besoins des forces armées face à de nouvelles menaces. Motivés par les challenges technologiques, nous repoussons les limites de l’innovation, de la science et de la technologie pour développer des solutions au meilleur niveau. Nous encourageons le dépassement de soi dans un environnement unique qui offre des opportunités à chacun d’entre nous. Ensemble, nous sommes fiers du rôle que nous jouons. Vous souhaitez avoir un impact concret dans une organisation en pleine transformation ? Rejoignez MBDA, un groupe européen de premier plan, pour piloter le déploiement de solutions d’IA Générative à l’échelle internationale. Au sein d’une équipe multiculturelle répartie sur 4 pays, vous prenez la responsabilité du delivery des initiatives IA avec un objectif clair : générer de la valeur opérationnelle, accélérer l’innovation et transformer les usages métiers. En Tant Que Responsable De Projets GenAI, Vous Identifiez et qualifiez les opportunités d'utilisation de l'IA Générative au sein des différentes directions de l'entreprise ; Challengez les besoins métiers afin de construire des cas d'usage pertinents et à fort impact ; Structurez les projets en définissant les objectifs, les indicateurs de succès, les données nécessaires et les trajectoires de déploiement ; Évaluez la faisabilité technique et organisationnelle des solutions en collaboration avec les équipes Data et IA ; Pilotez les projets de bout en bout en coordonnant les équipes métiers, IT, Data ainsi que les partenaires externes ; Assurez le déploiement des solutions, leur adoption par les utilisateurs et la mesure de leur valeur métier ; Contribuez à l'amélioration continue des pratiques, de la gouvernance et des méthodes de déploiement de l'IA au sein du Groupe ; Participez au pilotage du portefeuille global des initiatives IA Générative et aux reportings associés. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les différentes expertises de l'équipe IA (architecture, gouvernance, change management, value analysis) afin d'accélérer l'industrialisation et l'adoption de ces nouvelles technologies à l'échelle de MBDA. Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une formation universitaire équivalente avec une spécialisation en Data, Intelligence Artificielle, Systèmes d'Information ou Technologies, vous justifiez d'une expérience de 6 ans minimum dans le pilotage de projets Data et IA. Vous avez développé une solide expérience en cabinet de conseil puis dans la conduite de projets opérationnels, vous permettant de faire le lien entre enjeux métiers, technologies et création de valeur. Vous Disposez Notamment D'une expérience confirmée dans le pilotage de projets Data ou IA ; D'une bonne compréhension de l'écosystème IA Générative et de ses usages ; D'une capacité à cadrer et structurer des projets complexes ; D'une expérience de coordination d'équipes pluridisciplinaires ; D'une sensibilité aux enjeux d'architecture et de déploiement des solutions IA ; D'une aisance dans les environnements internationaux et matriciels. Compte tenu de l'environnement international de notre société, un bon niveau d'anglais est nécessaire. Un rôle clé avec un impact direct sur la transformation de l’entreprise Une exposition internationale et transverse Une opportunité de structurer et déployer des cas d’usage IA à forte valeur Un environnement exigeant, en évolution rapide, où votre capacité à délivrer fera la différence Notre rémunération comporte un salaire fixe et des éléments additionnels individuels (une part variable pour nos salariés cadres et une prime d’ancienneté ainsi qu’une prime annuelle pour nos salariés non-cadres) ou collectifs dépendant de la performance et des résultats de l’entreprise (participation, intéressement). De nombreux services/avantages sont également proposés : restaurant d’entreprise, épargne salariale (PEG, PERCOL), protection sociale (mutuelle et prévoyance), comité social et économique, infirmerie et service de santé au travail interne...

items.desc: Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. About the Role: You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. We're looking for a Product Analyst to help us better understand how customers use Wrike, identify product opportunities, and support better product decisions with data. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and UXR throughout the product development lifecycle — from exploring customer problems and evaluating opportunities to defining success metrics and measuring the impact of released features. This role goes beyond reporting numbers. We expect Product Analysts to understand why something is happening, why it matters, and what we should consider doing next — turning data into clear insights and actionable recommendations. Our Work Style: Tech Stack: SQL (GBQ), Python, Tableau, Amplitude, Airflow Work Mode: Hybrid – 2 days in office Your Impact: Discover and Evaluate Product Opportunities Explore customer behavior and product usage, size opportunities, investigate root causes, and turn findings into actionable insights and recommendations. Assess and Measure Product Impact Estimate the potential impact of product initiatives, define meaningful success metrics and baselines, and evaluate whether released changes deliver the expected customer and business value. Run Experiments and Product Research Design and analyze experiments and quantitative research, selecting appropriate methods and data sources and clearly communicating limitations and confidence in the results. Turn Data into Product Insights Investigate adoption, engagement, conversion, and changes in user behavior. Go beyond what happened to explain why it matters and what teams should consider doing next. Build Analytics for Scale Create dashboards, reusable analyses, documentation, and automation that make recurring questions easier to answer and help teams use data more effectively. items.desc: HiQ växer inom data, AI och cloud och vi letar nu efter Data Engineers som vill bygga moderna dataplattformar, skapa smarta dataflöden och göra det möjligt för våra kunder att fatta bättre beslut och utveckla nya tjänster. Som Data Engineer på HiQ kommer du att bygga och implementera skalbara dataplattformar i molnet, från datainhämtning och transformering till realtidsanalys och vidare till användning i analys, rapportering och AI. Du designar och optimerar datamodeller och dataflöden, inklusive streaminglösningar med till exempel Apache Kafka eller motsvarande, och du arbetar med robusta CI/CD-processer samt IaC i moderna cloudmiljöer. Du blir en viktig del i hur våra kunder samlar, strukturerar och använder sin data för att skapa verkligt affärsvärde. Utöver detta kommer du att vara med i den AI-satsning som HiQ gör, med möjlighet att påverka teknikval, arkitektur och arbetssätt för hur data blir navet i våra AI-lösningar. Vi söker dig som har Minst 3 års erfarenhet av data engineering och molnbaserade dataplattformar Erfarenhet av molnlösningar i Azure, AWS eller GCP Goda kunskaper i Python och SQL för att bygga, automatisera och optimera dataflöden Erfarenhet av att arbeta med datamodellering, prestandaoptimering och kvalitetssäkring av data Högskole- eller universitetsexamen i datateknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller annan relevant inriktning Svenskt medborgarskap samt är flytande i svenska och engelska Meriterande Erfarenhet av Databricks, Snowflake eller liknande plattformar Erfarenhet av AI- eller ML-workflows, till exempel att ta modeller i produktion i en dataplattform Förmåga att designa dataarkitektur och göra tekniska vägval i komplexa miljöer Erfarenhet av att arbeta med ETL- eller ELT-verktyg och ramverk som till exempel Airflow eller dbt Vana av att sätta upp och underhålla CI/CD-pipelines för data- och molnprojekt Vana av att jobba kundnära i tekniska projekt Vi tror att du är en person som älskar att bygga stabila lösningar som gör data enkel att använda. Du trivs när du får kombinera struktur med kreativitet, du gillar att dela med dig av din expertis och du har en naturlig förmåga att driva arbetet framåt tillsammans med andra. Varför HiQ Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklat världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. HiQ har alltid fokuserat på två saker: att ha kul på jobbet och att leverera lösningar utöver förväntningar, det är vad som driver oss framåt. Vi HiQare är stolta över att ha en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå våra gemensamma mål och strävar efter att hjälpa varandra att fortsätta växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du utöver chansen att utveckla din egen kompetens också möjlighet att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor. I denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå urvalsfrågor, intervjuer, tekniska tester, referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll. Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig och tillsammans forma framtidens dataintensiva och AI-drivna lösningar. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

items.desc: Functieomschrijving Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UASs) spelen een centrale rol in het moderne dreigingslandschap en vormen de meest recente dreiging voor kritische infrastructuur in Nederland. Bij NLR adviseren wij onze militaire en civiele partners over hoe zij zich het beste tegen deze nieuwe dreiging kunnen beschermen, ook wel Counter-UAS (C-UAS). Wil jij hierin een vitale rol vervullen? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Wat ga je doen? Als Application Engineer C-UAS bij NLR ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het onderzoeken, analyseren en testen van hardware, met de focus op (C-)UASs. Jij onderzoekt grondig de technische specificaties, capaciteiten en beperkingen van deze systemen. Jij brengt de mogelijkheden en beperkingen van UASs in kaart; Je werkt aan de ontwikkeling van effectieve tegenmaatregelen om de dreiging van UASs te verminderen, zoals het identificeren van kwetsbaarheden; Je evalueert detectie- en neutralisatietechnieken van ongeoorloofde UAS-activiteiten. Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw werkzaamheden bestaan uit werkzaamheden met lasersystemen. Je werkt mee aan testcampagnes met lasers, zowel in het laboratorium als op locatie in het veld. Je bent betrokken bij het voorbereiden en opzetten van experimenten, het opstellen en configureren van sensoriek. Je bedient lasersystemen en verzamelt en verwerkt de testdata. Hierbij werk jij nauw samen met andere experts om de resultaten te valideren en de effectiviteit van de tegenmaatregelen te waarborgen. Jouw Activiteiten Richten Zich Met Name Op Onderzoek en analyse van UAV-systemen; Uitvoeren van tests en experimenten om de werking van UAV-systemen te begrijpen; Opstellen, configureren en bedienen van meetapparatuur; Opereren van lasersystemen tijdens experimenten; Documenteren en rapporteren van de resultaten van het onderzoek; Samenwerking met experts om de resultaten te interpreteren en te begrijpen. Wat breng je mee? Een proactieve en assertieve houding; Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding in een relevante technische richting (bijv. luchtvaarttechniek, elektrotechniek, technische informatica); Enthousiasme voor het onderzoeken en analyseren van complexe technische systemen; Uitstekende analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden en probleemoplossend denken; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met samenwerken in een team; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (tenminste C1 niveau). Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast Dit Alles Bieden Wij Jou De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans; Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Binnen het team Weapon Systems werken we aan de ontwikkeling van toekomstbestendige air- en spacepower voor Defensie. Ons team richt zich op technisch tactische vraagstukken. We werken nauw samen met andere afdelingen en divisies binnen NLR. We bieden een informele en collegiale werkomgeving, waarin we samenwerken om complexe problemen op te lossen en innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten? Voor meer informatie kan je contact opnemen met Frank Bax (Senior Recruiter) via frank.bax@nlr.nl of 088 - 511 3103/ 06 15 6769 15. Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal . Solliciteren? Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button. Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

Be seen, be understood, be you. About The Role Are you curious about data, passionate about uncovering insights, and motivated by helping customers make informed decisions? As an Insights Consultant , you'll work closely with customers to understand their objectives, analyze data, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights. Experience preparing and delivering presentations to customer stakeholders. Exposure to customer lifecycle management, retention, or account expansion processes. Experience contributing to process improvements in analytics or consulting. Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team 
 The UI Platform team, known as Sail, builds the foundations behind Stripe’s Dashboard and many other user interfaces. Sail Services owns the systems that evaluate feature flags and experiments, ingest frontend analytics, and improve Dashboard load times for Stripe’s largest merchants.
 We build backend-for-frontend capabilities that connect Stripe’s backend systems to its UI platform. This gives product teams a consistent way to build and operate user experiences without recreating the same infrastructure.
 What you’ll do 
 As a Backend Engineer on the Sail Services team, you’ll help build and evolve the systems that power Stripe’s user interfaces. You’ll independently drive software projects from problem definition through production, working closely with other UI Platform engineers, product teams, and infrastructure partners. Your work will range from APIs and GraphQL integrations to edge systems, architectural migrations, and the tooling needed to operate them safely at scale.
 Responsibilities 
 Take end-to-end ownership of software projects, aligning on priorities and then independently scoping problems and carrying solutions through design, implementation, testing, rollout, and operation
 Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable APIs and backend systems that support Stripe’s Dashboard, mobile applications, and other user interfaces
 Help modernize Stripe’s UI architecture through incremental migrations, automated validation, shadow traffic, and carefully controlled production rollouts
 Improve the reliability, observability, performance, and operability of services on critical user paths
 Partner with frontend, backend, and infrastructure engineers to understand their needs and turn recurring problems into reusable platform capabilities
 Use AI-assisted and agentic development workflows to improve implementation, testing, validation, and delivery
 Contribute thoughtful code reviews, technical discussions, documentation, and runbooks that improve the quality of the team’s work
 Who you are

 Minimum requirements 
 Fluency in using AI-assisted and agentic development tools as part of day-to-day software engineering, including critically reviewing, validating, and improving generated code
 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience, building, shipping, and operating production systems

 Ability to independently scope and deliver open-ended software projects, making practical technical and product tradeoffs with limited oversight
 Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with attention to testing, maintainability, reliability, and user impact
 Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with frontend engineers, product engineers, and infrastructure partners
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience building backend-for-frontend systems, UI platform services, developer platforms, or shared infrastructure
 Experience designing or integrating APIs, including GraphQL APIs
 Experience with high-throughput event ingestion, feature flag or experimentation systems, or other latency-sensitive platform services
 Familiarity with caching, asynchronous systems, configuration systems, or data-consistency tradeoffs
 Experience executing large migrations using automated validation, shadow traffic, feature flags, or staged rollouts
 Experience using data, developer feedback, or operational signals to improve a platform or developer-facing product

items.desc:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 Supportability Decisions is a Dublin-based engineering team within Supportability Engineering, part of Risk Engineering. We own the “how a business sells” side of Supportability: determining whether a user’s declared business, web presence, account configuration, and observed transaction behaviour align with Stripe’s standards.
 Our core domain includes transaction-laundering detection and decisioning, web-presence and URL-policy controls, and low-quality e-commerce detection. We consume the signals and evaluations that support decisions in these spaces and convert them into evidence-based and auditable determinations that can be shared with the rest of the Supportability platforms.
 The pitch is: join a high-ownership team solving some of Stripe’s hardest risk problems. We build technology that helps Stripe distinguish legitimate businesses from bad actors at scale, combining sophisticated engineering, AI-assisted investigation, and meaningful real-world impact.
 What you’ll do
 You will own a meaningful part of a risk-decisioning problem from investigation and design through implementation, rollout, measurement, and iteration. You will help build both the domain capabilities and the modern agentic infrastructure required to make Supportability decisions consistent, stateful, explainable, and appropriate to the business, product, and moment in time. Depending on team priorities and the candidate’s experience, this may include:
 Responsibilities
 Building the Supportability Decision Layer: a durable service and API through which automated systems, agents, and human reviewers can request, produce, retrieve, and understand canonical decisions.
 Developing the infrastructure that enables agentic investigations to synthesize policy, business identity and history, product context, risk appetite, and multiple assessment signals into explainable, confidence-calibrated decisions.
 Improving the transaction-laundering agent’s policy grounding, evidence quality, risk tiering, precision and recall, and use of behavioural, dispute, and other relevant signals.
 Designing durable decision state and history, including traceability from supporting evidence through reasoning and applied consequence, and validity and refresh policies that prevent stale outcomes from persisting.
 Building governed, reusable configuration and integration patterns that adapt decision capabilities across products, partners, countries, and permitted risk appetites without creating bespoke systems for each use case.
 Building reliable backend workflows on shared Supportability and Risk Platform infrastructure.
 Making complex risk decisions explainable to reviewers and affected users.
 Using data and feedback from outcomes, appeals, and corrections to improve decision quality while balancing the identification of bad actors against avoiding unnecessary harm to legitimate businesses.
 Modernising URL enforcement, including when and how URL checks run, reducing unnecessary review volume and user friction, and supporting migration away from legacy systems.
 Expanding shared SAE/SPO decisioning foundations, including due-diligence support and product-scoped remediation and appeal capabilities.
 Improving the Process Orchestration Framework and moving workflow code into more maintainable platform packages.
 Contributing to future work in automated LPM URL screening, low-quality e-commerce detection, wider web intelligence, and active test charges.
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 2 - 7 years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)
 You work effectively across the stack from top to bottom, comfortably navigating codebases with different languages and tools

 Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success
 Ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Cybersecurity Penetration Tester 
 We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. ​
 Who We Are 
 At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives through innovation. 
 We act boldly — because we believe that good business means a better world. Every day, we commit to scientific rigor, unshakable ethics, and broad access to medical breakthroughs. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow, today. 
 We’re also deeply committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. By bringing together people with a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, we create an environment where innovation thrives, creativity flourishes, and everyone belongs. 
 The Opportunity 
 We’re looking for a Penetration Tester to join our Product Security & Privacy Organization (PSPO) — a dynamic global team ensuring the resilience and trustworthiness of Roche’s products and digital solutions. 
 In this hands-on role, you’ll execute vulnerability assessments and penetration testing activities across our physical and cloud-based products under the guidance of senior team members. You’ll collaborate with engineering, product, and architecture teams to strengthen Roche’s cyber defenses and ensure that innovation in diagnostics goes hand in hand with security and patient safety.

Red Team Platform and Hardware secures the hardware/software boundary for all of Apple’s products, focusing on operating systems, kernel, firmware, and user data protection. We’re looking for a skilled, driven engineer inspired to leverage the most powerful technologies in the industry to secure this boundary. This will mean applying, extending, and building on the latest AI-powered tools to design and implement key systems, owning their architecture, implementation decisions, and validation methodology across new and existing designs.
You’ll become part of an outstanding team dedicated to securing low-level technologies such as the boot ROMs, firmware, and iOS and macOS kernel in our Apple Silicon and wireless chipsets. You’ll work with a wide variety of teams and vendors who are equally committed to great work, and your influence will be felt throughout Apple's extraordinary products, such as the iPhone, iPad, Mac and AirPods.
Our team focuses on security improvements for Apple’s various platforms and the hardware that supports them, as well as building security tools to provide high assurance. We leverage the best tools available to reverse engineer exploits, provide insightful analysis, implement innovative security features, consult with other teams on both hardware and software, audit code, and review designs. We are seeking someone with strong technical expertise and a passionate desire to secure low-level systems by showing how they can be broken.
You’ll be working alongside teammates with diverse technical backgrounds including mobile and console research, binary instrumentation, SoC microarchitecture, compiler development, applied fault injection, and more. If you have your own area of fascination and a love of low-level security, you’ll find yourself right at home!

* Mature our team’s AI-based capabilities for augmenting security reviews.

items.desc:
About us
 Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence
PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.
 The role
 You will build the LLM access layer for agents on the PhysicsX platform. That layer serves self-hosted open models and routes each task to the model, or combination of models, that best fits its constraints.
 We want to bring deep, production experience in self-hosted LLM serving and model routing into PhysicsX. You will establish the capability to run open models reliably and choose between self-hosted and external models according to the needs of each workload. You will set the technical direction for inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and serving platforms such as KServe. You will build foundations that product, delivery and customer teams can rely on.
 You will own both. You will learn our requirements and define the implementation, rather than inherit a prescribed gateway design. You will wire serving and routing into the existing platform, identity and observability systems.
 In the near term, you’ll make the platform’s agentic capabilities work out of the box, with no customer-supplied API key needed. Longer term, you’ll build the serving layer into a flexible routing foundation that balances competing priorities, such as cost, quality and data sensitivity, as our needs change.
 What you will do
 Make self-hosted serving and model routing work in air-gapped deployments, including sites where the hardware, connectivity and operational setup force constrained solutions.
 Own LLM packaging, registration, deployment, health checks, upgrades, rollback and retirement for supported LLMs.
 Evaluate and integrate serving platforms such as KServe, including inference services, serving runtimes, model loading and rollout controls.
 Define, model, and implement service levels for availability, quality, and performance metrics (e.g. time to first token, inter-token latency, and tail latency).
 Measure and improve throughput, GPU utilisation, memory use and cost per token under representative agent workloads.
 Tune continuous and chunked batching, KV and prefix caching, quantisation, speculative decoding and tensor, data or expert parallelism where appropriate.
 Evaluate advanced techniques such as cache-aware routing and prefill/decode disaggregation when workload evidence justifies their complexity.
 Build autoscaling, admission control and capacity management around GPU and serving signals rather than generic CPU metrics.
 Make every routing decision observable and explainable, and use evaluation evidence before adding specialist routes.
 Work with Research and Post-Training specialists to move candidate and tuned models through evaluation into supported production routes.
 Help determine how this capability should grow and, over time, shape the team around it.
 What you bring
 Where you need to be strongest
 You have operated inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang, or serving platforms such as KServe, under production traffic, latency and reliability constraints.
 You can explain the boundary between serving orchestration and inference execution, including how deployment, scaling and runtime configuration affect performance.
 You have built or operated model routing across more than one provider, and can explain how you balanced cost, quality, latency, failure and policy.
 You can describe the serving architecture you operated, the bottlenecks you found, the changes you made and the measured effect on latency, throughput, reliability or cost.
 You understand LLM inference as a systems problem: batching, scheduling, KV-cache behaviour, memory pressure, model parallelism and GPU utilisation.
 You have built and operated GPU workloads on Kubernetes, including deployment, scaling, observability and failure recovery.
 You can turn fast-moving open-source engines and provider APIs into a supportable product with versioning, compatibility testing, rollback and clear operational boundaries.
 You are a strong systems engineer who remains hands-on in architecture, implementation, profiling and production debugging.
 Your experience goes materially beyond local model runners or demonstrations; tools such as Ollama are not a substitute for production serving ownership.
 Foundations
 Strong Python plus a systems language such as Go, Rust or C++.
 Linux, containers, Kubernetes, …

Overview 
 The Frontier Transformation Framework helps our customers become Frontier Firms: organizations where AI is not a tool added to the business but part of the operating system the business runs on. Every phase of that journey is carried by eight delivery capabilities — Trust and Governance, Frontier Change, Human-Agent System Design, Organisational AI Capability Building, Value Creation and Management, Continuous Improvement, Experience, and Copilot and AI Intelligence Layers. Today these capabilities are delivered largely by people and point solutions. To scale them across every customer, sector, and engagement, they are required to be productized into a common platform that our teams and our customers can run on. 
 We are seeking a Frontier Tools Architect to build the Agent and Intelligent Platform that enables the eight capabilities to execute with customers. In this role, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and backlog for the agents, accelerators, and intelligence tooling that turn framework capabilities into repeatable, instrumented software. You will translate how our architects, change practitioners, governance leads, and delivery teams work into platform features — building on Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Agent 365, and grounded in the Work IQ, Fabric IQ, and Foundry IQ intelligence layers — so that what is designed once can be deployed, measured, and improved everywhere.

You will decide what to build and what to reuse; you will define the telemetry that proves value; and you will make the platform the fastest, safest way to deliver Frontier Transformation at scale.  Run the operating rhythm for the platform — intake, releases, feedback loops, and a continuous improvement cadence that retires, extends, and hardens components based on real engagement signals.

items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. What you'll build and who you'll work with Every Alan product, in every country, runs on the same backend: events, queues, cache, data shared between components, transactions. More than 200 engineers build on it every day. It carries more than 1 million members today. It must carry 10 million, in more countries, with more regulated health data. You would join Backend Platform , a new team in our engineering organisation. Our job is to rethink the backend of a fully grown company, while it keeps running. Today almost everything runs in one Python monolith on one database. We are moving it towards big services that scale on their own, one pilot at a time. We build the tools that make this possible, and we set the rules for how Alan builds backends. This is a rare kind of project. The codebase serves real members and customers every day, and we have the mandate to change how it is built. What we decide now will shape how hundreds of engineers work for years. You will learn a lot, and your work will have a real impact. The team is small and growing: 3 engineers today, 6 next year. Its mission: Own the backend building blocks every Alan product depends on, and make them simple enough that product teams use them without needing us. Your scope The events pipeline. How our components and services talk to each other asynchronously: a Postgres outbox, Redis Streams, an S3 archive. It is in production for about 20 components. You make it a product that teams use on their own. Data replication between services. A service publishes read-only tables. Other services keep a local, fresh copy and join on it. This replaces slow joins across components. Towards big services. The tools to take capabilities out of the monolith: a service template, APIs between services, traces across services, dependency management. We start with a pilot and turn it into a playbook. The shared runtime. Queues, cache, the transaction layer. Their limits, their SLOs, their headroom. The backend direction. The rules for how we build backends at Alan, written with the other engineering teams. The stack Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, RQ, Datadog, all in a monorepo. New services are async-first. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership: you build it, you own it. You don't need prior Python experience. Is it you we're looking for? Experience we value 5+ years of backend engineering, with code other teams depend on: libraries, frameworks, pipelines, internal platforms. You ran it in production and owned it. Distributed systems as a daily tool: events and messaging (delivery guarantees, ordering, idempotence, retries), data replication, consistency, transactions. PostgreSQL in depth: transactions, locks, replication, query plans. You have split a monolith or built services, step by step, while production kept running. You measure before you optimise, and you set SLOs and alerts for what you own. English working proficiency. French is not required. Mindset we value Product mindset. Product teams are your customers. Adoption is how you measure success. Enabler. You build things others use on their own, instead of doing the work for them. You write to think and align. Short framing docs and decision records are how this team works with the rest of engineering. Influence without authority. You get other teams to change how they build, with no reporting line. Incremental. One pilot first, then the playbook. No big-bang rewrites. Strong plus : you worked in a platform team that served product teams · event-driven architecture at scale · CDC or logical replication · async Python (asyncio, FastAPI) · multi-region or data residency · health, payments or other regulated data. Not required : frontend · Kubernetes and cluster operations · database administration · LLM or AI expertise. Other teams own those. What we’re looking for …

items.desc: We Do Consulting Differently Open to all genders (m/f/d) About the role We are seeking Forensic Consultants across all experience levels to join our Düsseldorf-based team. You will support investigations and disputes by combining digital evidence, data analytics and technology-enabled solutions to establish facts and deliver clear, actionable findings. We welcome junior candidates with relevant internships and a genuine interest in these areas, as well as experienced professionals who can independently deliver workstreams or lead complex engagements. Your areas of work Depending on your experience and specialization, you will contribute to one or more of the following areas: IT Forensics: Identify, preserve, collect and analyze digital evidence. Examples include creating forensic images of laptops, collecting email and cloud data, recovering deleted files, and analyzing metadata or user activity to reconstruct events, while maintaining evidence integrity and chain-of-custody documentation. eDiscovery: Support the management of electronic information from collection and processing through document review and production. Examples include processing and deduplicating email collections, developing keyword searches, configuring review workflows, applying redactions and preparing document productions using platforms such as Relativity, Nuix or comparable solutions. Structured Data Analytics: Analyze transactional and business data from SAP and other ERP systems to identify anomalies and support investigations. Examples include examining general-ledger entries, procurement transactions and vendor master data; identifying duplicate payments or unusual journal entries; and reconciling data across systems using tools such as SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI or advanced Excel. AI Agents and AI Implementation: Develop, implement or evaluate AI-enabled solutions for investigative and analytical workflows. Examples include building assistants that search investigation documents and provide source-linked answers, automating document classification and information extraction, or developing agents that query approved transactional datasets and flag anomalies for human review. Solutions should incorporate appropriate confidentiality safeguards, access controls, accuracy testing and human oversight. What you bring Junior / entry-level candidates You demonstrate a genuine interest in one or more of the areas above, supported by relevant internships, working-student roles or comparable practical experience. For example, you may have assisted with digital-evidence collection, supported a document-review exercise, analysed transactional data or developed an AI prototype during an internship or university project. You are keen to develop your technical expertise and learn how to apply it to investigations. Prior independent engagement delivery is not expected. Experienced consultants You bring demonstrable hands-on experience in one or more of the areas above and can independently deliver defined workstreams. For example, you may have conducted forensic collections, managed eDiscovery processing, analyzed SAP transactions for potential irregularities or implemented an AI-supported review workflow. You can document your methods, validate your results and explain findings clearly to colleagues and clients. Senior candidates through SMC You bring substantial relevant experience and can design approaches, lead engagements, supervise teams and oversee quality. For example, you may have defined a digital-evidence collection strategy, led a large-scale eDiscovery engagement, designed a transactional analytics programme or overseen the implementation of an AI solution with appropriate governance. You can manage client relationships, budgets and deadlines, and communicate complex findings to legal counsel, management and other stakeholders. German-language proficiency Native-level or equivalent fluency in written and spoken German is required—for example, to review German-language business records, discuss findings with clients and legal counsel, and prepare clear reports in German. Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area or with every named tool. We will assess the breadth and depth of your expertise against the seniority and focus of the role. items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION Liquidity risk sits at the heart of every financial institution's resilience, and the team behind it rarely gets the spotlight it deserves. This role puts you squarely in that spotlight: you will own the data that drives regulatory submissions to the FED, PRA, ECB, and APAC regulators, directly influencing how the firm demonstrates its financial strength to the world's most demanding supervisors. As a Liquidity Data & Reporting Senior Analyst in the Liquidity Risk Reporting team you will have a chance to support daily and monthly liquidity risk reporting processes. You will work in collaboration with other Team members validating, reconciling and correcting various liquidity risk data followed by their consumption into liquidity reporting and regulatory submission to FED/PRA/ECB and APAC regulators. You will work in Warsaw based Team and additionally cooperate with Team members in Bangalore, London, Hong-Kong, Delaware, New Jersey providing support to stakeholders around the Globe. Job responsibilities Perform financial product day to day data analysis to identify & resolve liquidity reporting data issues within extensive size data sets. Support and ownership of the production of internal and external liquidity regulatory reporting (ie. LCR, ALMM, NSFR, Stress) in line with Basel guidance Perform product reconciliations & assist with daily variance analysis Identify improvements and leverage available toolsets (Alteryx, Tableau, Excel) to own and implement changes through to completion Support development and work within the Reporting AI Agent infrastructure Improve timeliness and reduce operational risk to the firm Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 1+ year of continuous experience in the reporting area or large data sets operations An experience with working on large data sets and advanced literacy maneuvering within those An experience or interest with financial instruments like Deposits, Loans Bonds, Derivatives An experience or interest within liquidity risk management in financial institutions Bachelor degree required (Engineering, Finance or Business degree) Strong analytic acumen, attention to details Strong MS Excel Ability to adjust to changing environment and assigned book of work Ability to work in frequently changing environment of what and how is being delivered. Teamwork attitude Adherence to 5 days a week work from the office model supported with Firmwide rules defined managerial exceptions. ABOUT US J.P. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation. ABOUT THE TEAM Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success. The work covers areas such as evaluating country-specific risk, understanding regulatory changes and determining credit worthiness. As that initiative matures, you’ll move on to bringing AI-powered features into our customer-facing B2B / B2B2C products. This is not a “manage the backlog” role. items.desc: Van slimme AI-modellen naar oplossingen die écht werken. Een AI-model bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat het betrouwbaar draait, gekoppeld is aan echte data en waarde toevoegt bij een klant: daar wordt het interessant. Bij adesso werk je aan AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan experimenten, van machine learning en MLOps tot generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bouwt, implementeert en verbetert oplossingen die organisaties echt gebruiken. Wat ga je doen? Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid. AI ontwikkelen: je bouwt ML-modellen, LLM-toepassingen en agentic workflows. Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid. Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen. Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen. Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's. Projecten die verder gaan dan het model We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan: Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting. Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen. Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails. Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen. De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van ML- of GenAI-oplossingen. Goede kennis van Python, SQL en machine learning. Ervaring met MLOps en/of LLM's, RAG en AI-agents. Kennis van minimaal één cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Je denkt vanuit de klantvraag en legt technische keuzes helder uit. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt. Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past. Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. Jij gaat als AI Engineer de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Heb je diepe kennis van finance, retail of utilities en wil je dichter op de klant zitten? Kijk dan ook naar onze FDE-vacatures. Twijfel je? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen welke rol het best past. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we …

items.desc: Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap. ➡️ Your job is to close it! Some of the most valuable expertise at Etteplan has been built over years of solving complex engineering challenges, designing plants and delivering successful projects. Every day, our engineers make critical decisions, solve complex problems and create value for our customers. Your mission is to identify where AI can support that work, remove unnecessary effort and help engineering teams focus on what they do best. As an Applied AI Engineer, you bring AI into the day-to-day reality of engineering projects. You work with experienced engineers, understand their challenges and identify where AI can accelerate workflows, improve consistency and create measurable value. From specifications and datasheets to drawings and engineering documentation, you build practical solutions that help project teams work smarter and deliver faster. The result is not another AI prototype. It is measurable value in real customer projects: fewer hours per work package, more consistent output, and solutions the project teams keep using after you have moved on to the next case. What you'll step into: Smart Factory Germany: more than 200 colleagues at five German sites, working across automation, digitalisation and IT/OT Your base is Leverkusen, Berlin, Brunsbüttel, Oberhausen or Wiesloch, hybrid, with the freedom to work where the use case is. Direct access to decision makers: you report to the Vice President Smart Factory Germany and work closely with our Group AI organisation in Finland. Your starting point is electrical engineering and instrumentation, where the opportunity for impact is highest. You are the first person in this role in Germany. The blank page is part of the offer. Your Mission 🔧 Turn AI into an engineering advantage You evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify where they can create tangible value for engineering teams. Rather than introducing tools for the sake of innovation, you focus on solutions that improve the way projects are executed. 🧩 Turn engineering challenges into AI opportunities You work closely with engineering teams to understand where time is lost, information is difficult to access or repetitive tasks slow projects down. Together, you identify high-value use cases and translate them into practical AI-supported solutions that fit naturally into existing engineering workflows. ⚙️ Prove AI where it matters You bring AI solutions into live customer projects and validate their impact under real-world conditions. You establish baselines, measure outcomes and demonstrate tangible improvements in efficiency, consistency and delivery performance. Success isn't determined by how impressive a solution looks. It's determined by whether project teams continue using it after the pilot ends. 🤝 Make it work without you Everything you build is documented, versioned and handed over so that engineering colleagues can run and extend it themselves. You support our regional network of AI champions with building blocks and hands-on help. A solution that only works while you are in the room does not count. Who we're looking for We are looking for a builder. Someone who enjoys turning ideas into working solutions and who is equally comfortable discussing engineering challenges and AI technologies. You are curious about what AI can do, but even more interested in what it can achieve in practice. Most importantly, you care about outcomes, not hype. What You Bring ✔ Understanding of plant engineering, ideally electrical engineering, instrumentation or automation ✔ Strong affinity for AI, prompting, agents, retrieval and modern AI workflows ✔ Experience working with Python and integrating data sources, tools and APIs ✔ Something you have actually shipped into real use, at work or on your own time ✔ A pragmatic mindset focused on delivery and impact ✔ The ability to bridge engineering expertise and technology ✔ Strong collaboration skills and the patience to work side-by-side with experienced domain experts ✔ Fluent German and English Nice to have ➕ Experience in process industries such as chemicals, pharmaceuticals or energy ➕ Familiarity with engineering software ecosystems and their interfaces ➕ Experience working with RAG, agents, multimodal AI or retrieval-based solutions ➕ Experience capturing and operationalising expert knowledge ➕ Projects, experiments or side initiatives that demonstrate your curiosity and builder mindset Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap. If you're the person who can close it, we'd love to hear from you.

items.desc: Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap. ➡️ Your job is to close it! Some of the most valuable expertise at Etteplan has been built over years of solving complex engineering challenges, designing plants and delivering successful projects. Every day, our engineers make critical decisions, solve complex problems and create value for our customers. Your mission is to identify where AI can support that work, remove unnecessary effort and help engineering teams focus on what they do best. As an Applied AI Engineer, you bring AI into the day-to-day reality of engineering projects. You work with experienced engineers, understand their challenges and identify where AI can accelerate workflows, improve consistency and create measurable value. From specifications and datasheets to drawings and engineering documentation, you build practical solutions that help project teams work smarter and deliver faster. The result is not another AI prototype. It is measurable value in real customer projects: fewer hours per work package, more consistent output, and solutions the project teams keep using after you have moved on to the next case. What you'll step into: Smart Factory Germany: more than 200 colleagues at five German sites, working across automation, digitalisation and IT/OT Your base is Leverkusen, Berlin, Brunsbüttel, Oberhausen or Wiesloch, hybrid, with the freedom to work where the use case is. Direct access to decision makers: you report to the Vice President Smart Factory Germany and work closely with our Group AI organisation in Finland. Your starting point is electrical engineering and instrumentation, where the opportunity for impact is highest. You are the first person in this role in Germany. The blank page is part of the offer. Your Mission 🔧 Turn AI into an engineering advantage You evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify where they can create tangible value for engineering teams. Rather than introducing tools for the sake of innovation, you focus on solutions that improve the way projects are executed. 🧩 Turn engineering challenges into AI opportunities You work closely with engineering teams to understand where time is lost, information is difficult to access or repetitive tasks slow projects down. Together, you identify high-value use cases and translate them into practical AI-supported solutions that fit naturally into existing engineering workflows. ⚙️ Prove AI where it matters You bring AI solutions into live customer projects and validate their impact under real-world conditions. You establish baselines, measure outcomes and demonstrate tangible improvements in efficiency, consistency and delivery performance. Success isn't determined by how impressive a solution looks. It's determined by whether project teams continue using it after the pilot ends. 🤝 Make it work without you Everything you build is documented, versioned and handed over so that engineering colleagues can run and extend it themselves. You support our regional network of AI champions with building blocks and hands-on help. A solution that only works while you are in the room does not count. Who we're looking for We are looking for a builder. Someone who enjoys turning ideas into working solutions and who is equally comfortable discussing engineering challenges and AI technologies. You are curious about what AI can do, but even more interested in what it can achieve in practice. Most importantly, you care about outcomes, not hype. What You Bring ✔ Understanding of plant engineering, ideally electrical engineering, instrumentation or automation ✔ Strong affinity for AI, prompting, agents, retrieval and modern AI workflows ✔ Experience working with Python and integrating data sources, tools and APIs ✔ Something you have actually shipped into real use, at work or on your own time ✔ A pragmatic mindset focused on delivery and impact ✔ The ability to bridge engineering expertise and technology ✔ Strong collaboration skills and the patience to work side-by-side with experienced domain experts ✔ Fluent German and English Nice to have ➕ Experience in process industries such as chemicals, pharmaceuticals or energy ➕ Familiarity with engineering software ecosystems and their interfaces ➕ Experience working with RAG, agents, multimodal AI or retrieval-based solutions ➕ Experience capturing and operationalising expert knowledge ➕ Projects, experiments or side initiatives that demonstrate your curiosity and builder mindset Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap. If you're the person who can close it, we'd love to hear from you.

items.desc: ACHI SIAMO AGAP2 è un gruppo europeo di consulenza ingegneristica e operativa, parte del Gruppo MoOngy. Presenti in 14 paesi europei con oltre 8.500 dipendenti, abbiamo inaugurato la nostra prima sede italiana a Milano sei anni fa. Data la nostra costante crescita, stiamo potenziando e ampliando il nostro team con individui che condividano i nostri valori fondamentali: AMBIZIONE, SORRISO, DINAMISMO, VOGLIA DI METTERSI IN GIOCO, il tutto in un contesto in continuo sviluppo, dove le relazioni umane sono prioritarie. IL TUO RUOLO Siamo alla ricerca di un/una AI Engineer da inserire in un team multidisciplinare altamente qualificato su Milano e Torino, con l'obiettivo di contribuire allo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative basate sull'Intelligenza Artificiale. Cerchiamo una figura con solide competenze in ambito AI/ML, approccio innovativo e disruptive, forte capacità di problem solving e attitudine alla sperimentazione. RESPONSABILITÀ PRINCIPALI Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale basate su Large Language Models (LLM). Contribuire a iniziative di agentificazione e allo sviluppo di architetture AI agentiche, anche in ambito Service Contact. Ricercare e sperimentare approcci tecnologici innovativi per rispondere a esigenze di business. Realizzare prototipi e Proof of Concept (PoC), valutandone efficacia e applicabilità. Supportare l'evoluzione delle soluzioni sviluppate verso ambienti di produzione. Collaborare attivamente con team multidisciplinari- REQUISITI Solida esperienza in ambito Artificial Intelligence e Machine Learning. Conoscenza dei Large Language Models (LLM) e delle relative applicazioni. Familiarità con architetture e framework per lo sviluppo di sistemi agentici. Ottima conoscenza di Python. Spiccate capacità di problem solving, pensiero laterale e approccio creativo. Attitudine alla sperimentazione e capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari. NICE TO HAVE Esperienza in ambito Generative AI, Multi-Agent Systems e RAG. Esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI per Customer Service e Contact Center. COSA OFFRIAMO Contratto a tempo indeterminato con pacchetto retributivo competitivo. Buoni pasto e indennità di trasferta. Formazione continua tecnica e gestionale. Affiancamento costante del team HR per il tuo sviluppo professionale. Coinvolgimento in progetti industriali di primaria importanza a livello internazionale. La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 30.000 EUR e 35.000 EUR. The world needs you AGAP2 è un equal opportunities employer : crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Ci impegniamo a garantire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni singola risorsa possa apportare un valore unico alla nostra realtà. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile. Inoltre, teniamo fede ai nostri impegni prestando attenzione alle risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99. I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel regolamento UE 2016/679.
