items.desc: Join Barclays as an AI Software Engineer and help build the next generation of intelligent applications and platforms. You will develop scalable software solutions, integrate advanced AI capabilities into enterprise systems, and collaborate with engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges that deliver meaningful business impact. To be successful as an AI Software Engineer, you should have experience with: Good understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI, including their capabilities, limitations and failure modes, with sound judgement on when deterministic software is the better solution Experience with context engineering, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding, knowledge sources, memory, prompt design and controlled access to information. Experience building AI agents and agentic workflows, including task decomposition, orchestration, state management, tool integration through protocols such as MCP and human approval controls. Experience using AI-assisted development tools and coding agents as a core part of how you engineer, applying strong verification and taking ownership of the quality of AI-generated code Some other highly valued skills may include: Experience integrating different AI models or providers and making informed trade-offs across quality, resilience, latency, security and cost. Experience delivering AI-powered solutions in regulated environments, working with risk and control partners. Experience measuring the impact of AI on engineering productivity, quality or business outcomes. Experience supporting other engineers, including coaching on AI-assisted engineering and contributing to team or community engineering practices. You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. This role is based in Knutsford/ Manchester/ Glasgow office.

At Kuro, you can tackle some of the hardest problems in applied AI every day Curious about the bigger engineering challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build. About us Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling. Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction. After one year on the market, leading construction enterprises with a combined annual construction volume of >€40 billion use Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions . Backed by an €8 million seed round, we already process more than 1 million pages every month and expect that volume to grow 10x over the next six months. We are 15 people based in Berlin. From concept to DB schema, to optimizing LLMs, to UI. Own the full development lifecycle of customer-facing features. Manage evaluations and scoring, and perform error analysis on new and shipped AI features. Build the platform that abstracts workflow building Contribute to the workflow harness, decision-trace standard, and eval tooling so a new use case ships in ~1 month Build reusable human review & approval surfaces where trust in AI output is earned Work on the construction ontology & project graph Help model and evolve canonical entities of our customers Contribute to entity resolution across sources: recognizing the same requirement, position, or price across BoQs, contracts, drawings, and bids Build features so answers are evidence-linked and auditable, and decisions flow back into the graph Contribute to scalable data pipelines & integrations Extend our multi-modal ingestion of unstructured documents - PDFs, scans, drawings, and 3D models - orchestrated and cost-efficient at scale Build read/write integrations with customer systems (document management, ERP/AVA), so workflows complete work end-to-end Projects you would be involved in Current & Past projects Project & document versioning guaranteeing data lineage in construction projects German tokenizer for construction-specific search Document pipeline ingesting 10,000s of PDFs per day Native BIM/DWG file support: ingesting and processing 3D models Design the ontology v1 + graph schema: core construction entities, evidence links, and per-customer extension model Build out our workflow harness to run agentic workflows for customers Current Tech Stack It is still day 0 for Kuro. Therefore, we are highly pragmatic with our tool choices. We believe in keeping it simple and moving quickly. You significantly help shape our tech stack decisions. Web-App: Typescript Database / Vector DB and File Storage: AWS RDS / Trubopuffer / AWS S3 Backend: Fastify API + Prisma ORM Workflow Orchestrator: Prefect (Python) Hosting: AWS Elastic Beanstalk AI: Azure / OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, AWS Obsv., Eval. & Tracking: Langfuse, Datadog Your profile This is the perfect role for an experienced engineer who wants to join an early stage company that builds a high impact applied AI product Bring 3+ years of experience as a (full-stack) software engineer in a fast-paced environment Have proven experience delivering production-grade applied AI features to customers Take full ownership of solving customer problems by designing and implementing AI features Thrive in a small, accountable team with a high degree of ownership and a drive to make an impact Communicate fluently in both spoken and written English Enjoy working onsite with the team at our office in Factory Berlin Mitte every day Bonus Points You’ve started a company before or worked at a very early stage startup You built side projects in the past - we’re excited to hear about these! German-speaking (definitely not a must, we’re fully international) Why Kuro You’ll join at a point when customer demand is proven, but our product and platform are still yours to shape. items.desc: Lieu : Rungis, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Nous fournissons et soutenons des systèmes pour la gestion et la protection de l'espace aérien. Nous travaillons avec passion dans un cadre architectural moderne, et s'efforce de repousser les limites de la technologie dans nos secteurs clés. Au sud de Paris, notre site est facilement accessible en transport en commun. Vous intégrerez un bureau d’études dans le cadre du déploiement de technologies d’intelligence artificielle de confiance pour le développement de produits de haute technologie. Vous contribuerez à l’intégration d’outils d’IA aux logiciels de simulation électronique et de compatibilité électromagnétique, afin d’améliorer les performances globales et les méthodes de travail des équipes d’ingénierie. Vous serez dans un premier temps basé sur le site de Rungis, puis sur le site de Vélizy-Villacoublay. En nous rejoignant, vous vous verrez confier les missions suivantes : Réaliser une recherche bibliographique sur les outils d’intelligence artificielle de confiance de Thales et leurs exigences d’utilisation, et contribuer à l’enrichissement du fonds documentaire IA du département Hardware ; Développer des couplages entre des outils d’IA et le logiciel de simulation LTspice pour l’étude et l’optimisation de phénomènes électromagnétiques ; Coupler des outils d’optimisation basés sur l’IA avec les outils d’ingénierie utilisés pour les études de performance radio de systèmes multisenseurs ; Mettre en place une base de connaissance et former les collaborateurs aux procédures et aux outils IA mis en œuvre ; Développer des solutions d’IA générative pour analyser automatiquement les rapports de tests CEM, produire des avis techniques et faciliter la prise de décision ; Explorer les applications de l’IA générative à l’analyse documentaire, notamment pour l’exploitation des normes, des guides techniques et de la documentation scientifique, ainsi que pour l’aide à la rédaction et à la formalisation de rapports (prompting, bases de données documentaires, procédures, etc.). Votre Profil Vous préparez un BAC+5 (école d’ingénieur ou université) en éléctronique ou télécommunication avec une spécialisation en IA ou Mathématiques et recherchez un stage de 6 mois ? Vous avez un fort attrait pour les outils d'IA et pour la programmation informatique ? Vous avez déjà développé des applications ou des outils utilisant l’intelligence artificielle ? Vous avez des connaissances en électronique, radio et électromagnétisme ? Vous avez déjà rédigé des procédures techniques ou des rapports ? Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ? Vous avez déjà utilisé le logiciel LTSpice pour réaliser des simulations électroniques ? Vous avez déjà travaillé sur du traitement mathématique ou développé des modèles analytiques ? Vous savez faire preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie et d’esprit d’initiative dans un projet ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Mot De L'équipe Le service Bureau d’Etudes intervient sur un large éventail de disciplines (Mécanique, Thermique, Electrotechnique, CEM) dans le développement de systèmes de défense, et accueille régulièrement des stagiaires ou des apprentis qui travaillent sur des sujets d’amélioration ou d’innovation. L’introduction des outils de l’IA dans les méthodes de travail au quotidien et dans l’utilisation d’outils d’ingénierie est un axe de développement important pour les projets en cours et à venir. L’équipe a à cœur de mettre les stagiaires dans les meilleures conditions pour réussir leurs missions. Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Konzeption und Entwicklung moderner AI-Lösungen auf Basis von Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP und Generative AI Entwicklung intelligenter Anwendungen mit Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI
items.desc: Als Data & AI-Engineer konzipierst und entwickelst du Datenstrukturen, KI-Modelle und überführst sie in skalierbare, produktive Systeme. Du gestaltest Lösungen von der technischen Architektur über die Modellierung bis hin zur Integration in reale Anwendungsumgebungen. Gemeinsam mit unserem Engineering Team sitzt du am Puls der Zeit und arbeitest an modernen AI-Technologien – von klassischen ML-Verfahren und Deep-Learning-Ansätzen bis hin zu LLM-/GenAI-basierten Systemen (z. B. Retrieval-Augmented Generation oder agentenorientierten Ansätzen). Du analysierst komplexe Daten und baust skalierbare Dateninfrastrukturen. Große Datenmengen, anspruchsvolle Modelle und moderne AI-Technologien motivieren dich mehr als sie dich abschrecken? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Vollzeitstelle in Linz oder Wien mit Home Office Möglichkeit Deine Aufgaben Als Fullstack AI Engineer gestaltest du anspruchsvolle AI-Projekte von der ersten technischen Konzeption über die Softwareentwicklung bis zum stabilen produktiven Betrieb. Konzeption und Entwicklung moderner AI-Lösungen auf Basis von Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP und Generative AI Entwicklung intelligenter Anwendungen mit Large Language Models (LLMs), für produktive AI-Systeme Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden – von der strukturierten Anforderungsanalyse bis zur produktiven Lösung Eigenständige technische Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete und abhängig von deiner Erfahrung auch gesamte Projekte Dein Profil Fundiertes Wissen im Bereich Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, NLP und Software Engineering mit nachweislicher praktischer Erfahrung in AI-Projekten Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python, Java oder vergleichbaren Hochsprachen sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs, Generative AI und modernen AI-Konzepten wie RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases oder AI Agents Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Services, REST APIs und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme Kenntnisse moderner Frontend-Technologien und Frameworks wie React, Angular oder Vue.js Erfahrung im Design skalierbarer Softwarearchitekturen sowie mit Deployment-Strategien und dem produktiven Betrieb von AI-Anwendungen Sicherer Umgang mit SQL- und NoSQL-Datenbanken sowie strukturierten und unstrukturierten Daten Know-how im Umgang mit Docker, CI/CD und Cloud-, On-Premises- oder hybriden IT-Umgebungen Verständnis für Clean Code, Testing, Security und die Entwicklung wartbarer, produktionsreifer Software Unser Angebot End-to-End AI Engineering: Entwickle intelligente Systeme und gestalte die gesamte technische Umsetzung – von der AI-Architektur bis zur produktiven Softwarelösung Volle technologische Gestaltungsfreiheit bei der Entwicklung innovativer AI-Lösungen – keine vorgegebenen Blueprints Teil eines Expertenteams im Bereich Artificial Intelligence und Software Engineering Umsetzung gesellschaftsrelevanter Projekte mit spürbar positiven Auswirkungen Junges, hochkompetentes und unternehmenslustiges Team Hochmodernes Arbeitsumfeld und Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Partnern und Universitäten Learn forever: Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Vertiefungsmöglichkeiten in AI, Software Engineering und modernen Technologien Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten und regelmäßige Team-Events Nach Vorgaben des Gesetzgebers weisen wir auf das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt 3.267 (14 mal p.a.) für die angebotene Stelle des Fullstack AI Engineers hin. Dein Startgehalt wird sich an deinen Qualifikation und Erfahrungen orientieren, Überbezahlungen sind bei uns daher möglich. Werde Teil des FiveSquare-Teams und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die KI-Landschaft in Österreich. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

items.card: missions : Participer à la conception et à la mise en place d’une nouvelle infrastructure Cloud intégrant des briques d’Intelligence Artificielle. Définir l’architecture MLOps de la plateforme et les standards d’intégration des modèles d’IA au sein de l’infrastructure. Dimensionner et déployer les ressources de calcul dédiées à l’IA (GPU, stockage, réseau) sur Cloud public, privé ou environnements hybrides.
items.desc: Ingénieur MLOps Cloud IA (H/F) Vous souhaitez contribuer au déploiement d’une nouvelle infrastructure intégrant l’Intelligence Artificielle pour l’un de nos clients grands comptes du secteur de la Défense ? Ce poste est fait pour vous ! 👇 🚀 Vos principales missions : Participer à la conception et à la mise en place d’une nouvelle infrastructure Cloud intégrant des briques d’Intelligence Artificielle. Définir l’architecture MLOps de la plateforme et les standards d’intégration des modèles d’IA au sein de l’infrastructure. Dimensionner et déployer les ressources de calcul dédiées à l’IA (GPU, stockage, réseau) sur Cloud public, privé ou environnements hybrides. Industrialiser le déploiement et l’inférence des modèles de Machine Learning et d’IA générative (LLM, RAG) sur Kubernetes ou OpenShift. Construire et automatiser les pipelines de données et de modèles (CI/CD/CT), ainsi que le versioning des données, des modèles et des expérimentations. Mettre en place la supervision des modèles et de l’infrastructure : performance, dérive, consommation des ressources et coûts. Garantir la sécurité, la traçabilité et la conformité de la plateforme, en lien avec les équipes DevSecOps et cybersécurité. Accompagner les équipes Data Science et de développement dans l’intégration de leurs cas d’usage IA sur la nouvelle infrastructure. Participer aux choix d’architecture, à la veille technologique et à l’amélioration continue des pratiques MLOps. 🎓 Parlons un peu de vous : Formation : Diplôme d’ingénieur ou Bac+5 en informatique, intelligence artificielle, data science, cloud computing ou domaine équivalent. Expérience : Minimum 5 ans d’expérience en MLOps, DevOps, Data Engineering ou ingénierie plateforme Cloud, dont une expérience significative dans la mise en production de modèles d’IA. Compétences clés : Maîtrise des environnements Cloud (Azure, AWS ou Cloud privé) et expérience dans la conception ou le déploiement d’infrastructures dédiées à l’IA. Expertise sur les outils MLOps tels que MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, Airflow ou équivalents. Expérience en déploiement et serving de modèles, notamment d’IA générative (LLM, RAG, inférence sur GPU). Maîtrise de Python et des principaux frameworks de Machine Learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Maîtrise de la conteneurisation et de l’orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift). Bonne connaissance des chaînes CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD) et de l’Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible). Solides connaissances en sécurité, observabilité, haute disponibilité et optimisation des coûts d’infrastructure. Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d’équipe et capacité à vulgariser auprès d’interlocuteurs variés. 👥 Qui sommes-nous ? Savant mélange entre le savoir-faire allemand et la créativité à la française, Technology & Strategy est une société d’ingénierie résolument tournée vers l’innovation et spécialisée dans le développement de systèmes embarqués intelligents, sécurisés et responsables. Notre agence est composée d’une équipe de passionnés, chaleureuse et à taille humaine. Elle déploie tout son savoir-faire pour accompagner nos clients, PME ou grands industriels, dans différents domaines (Système, logiciel, safety, cyber,...). Depuis nos bureaux d’études jusqu’aux centres R&D de nos clients, nos experts relèvent les défis technologiques de demain. Aussi passionnantes qu’exigeantes, nos activités rayonnent dans des secteurs variés tels que l’énergie, le médical, l’IOT, les transports... 🚗⚡ En pleine expansion depuis notre création en 2008, nous sommes déjà implantés dans 8 pays en Europe et à l’international, au travers de 22 agences qui regroupent près de 3600 ingénieurs. 🚀 📌 Processus de recrutement : 📞 Prise de contact téléphonique 👩 💼 Entretien avec un(e) RH 👨 💼 Entretien avec un(e) manager 👩 💻 Entretien technique Nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes bénéficiant d’une Reconnaissance de la Qualité de Travailleur Handicapé (RQTH). T&S Groupe encourage la diversité et l’égalité sur le lieu de travail. Tous les candidats qualifiés H/F sont pris en considération pour un emploi sur un pied d’égalité.

items.desc: ALTEN est un acteur majeur de l’ingénierie et du conseil en technologies, reconnu pour son expertise dans des secteurs innovants tels que l’énergie, l’aéronautique, l’automobile et le digital. Avec une présence internationale, ALTEN accompagne ses partenaires dans la réalisation de projets techniques ambitieux, en alliant rigueur, créativité et agilité. Rejoindre ALTEN, c’est intégrer une communauté de passionnés de technologie , engagés dans des défis techniques exigeants et porteurs de sens. Nous offrons un environnement stimulant, où l’innovation et la collaboration sont au cœur de notre culture. Description du poste Contexte du recrutement : Pour renforcer son pôle Intelligence Artificielle , la Direction des Technologies Avancées du groupe ALTEN recrute un Ingénieur Senior en Intelligence Artificielle , spécialisé dans le déploiement de modèles de langage (LLM) et de solutions d’IA de pointe , sous la responsabilité du Responsable Technique IA . Missions principales1. Déploiement et optimisation de modèles d’IA Déployer et utiliser des modèles Mistral en environnement sécurisé, y compris on-premise (vLLM, TGI), en garantissant leur scalabilité, performance et conformité . Adapter les modèles Mistral aux cas d’usage métiers (fine-tuning LoRA / QLoRA, quantisation AWQ / GPTQ) en tenant compte d’indicateurs qualité / latence / coût GPU , avec Hugging Face Transformers et PyTorch . Contribuer , avec l’ingénieur DevOps, à l’ automatisation des pipelines de déploiement et d’évaluation des modèles (GitLab CI). 2. Conception d’architectures IA sécurisées Concevoir des architectures robustes pour l’intégration de modèles d’IA dans des systèmes critiques , en respectant les contraintes de sécurité (Secret Défense, RGPD, etc.) . Collaborer avec les équipes DevOps et Sécurité pour garantir la protection des données et la résilience des infrastructures (ex : chiffrement, isolation des environnements). Utiliser des outils de conteneurisation comme Docker et des orchestrations avec Kubernetes pour des déploiements reproductibles et sécurisés. 3. Intégration et maintenance des solutions IA Intégrer les modèles d’IA dans des applications métiers (APIs, microservices) en utilisant des technologies comme FastAPI, Flask ou gRPC . Concevoir des applications RAG robustes (chunking strategies, hybrid search, reranking) et des agents IA (LangGraph, MCP, orchestration multi-agents). Mettre en place l’évaluation continue des modèles et des applications (jeux de test métiers, LLM-as-judge, Ragas) et leur suivi en production (Langfuse). Sécuriser les applications LLM : protection contre les prompts injections, guardrails, red teaming. Assurer la maintenance et la montée en version des modèles déployés, avec un suivi de la qualité des réponses et des performances (Langfuse, Prometheus / Grafana). Documenter les processus et former les équipes internes aux bonnes pratiques en IA et en sécurité . 4. Veille technologique et innovation Assurer une veille active sur les avancées en IA générative, LLM et sécurisation des modèles . Proposer des solutions innovantes pour répondre aux besoins émergents des clients, en s’appuyant sur des technologies comme LangChain / LangGraph , LlamaIndex ou des bases vectorielles auto-hébergeables (Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector). Participer à des projets R&D pour évaluer et intégrer de nouvelles technologies (ex : routage entre modèles, modèles compacts embarqués, IA explicable). Qualifications Profil recherché Formation / Expérience Diplômé d’une école d’ingénieurs ou titulaire d’un Master (Bac+5) en Informatique, Data Science, ou Intelligence Artificielle . 4 à 6 ans d’expérience en ingénierie ML ou logicielle, dont au moins 2 ans sur des projets d’IA générative , avec au moins un projet LLM mené jusqu’en production , idéalement on-premise ou en environnement sécurisé. items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.
 The Paid Media Expert is responsible for supporting and partnering with our Business Partners to execute the paid media strategy by delivering a full suite of objectives across the Roche online presence. This role acts as a primary operational bridge, managing end-to-end campaign coordination and directing external agency partners to ensure flawless workflow execution, strict adherence to timelines, and optimal performance. Beyond day-to-day coordination, the role brings deep expertise in all aspects of paid campaign management across diverse channels and platforms.
 The Opportunity: 
 Drive and execute high-impact, multi-channel paid media strategies across Roche’s global digital presence.
 Act as a trusted strategic consultant to global business partners and social leads, identifying unmet marketing needs, recommending targeted campaign tactics, and optimizing content and landing pages.
 Lead end-to-end budget management and performance tracking across enterprise platforms, establishing key KPIs, measuring campaign effectiveness, and continually optimizing bid prices, keyword strategies, ad copy, and cost-per-conversion metrics.
 Establish process governance principles within the Global Digital Hub as a center of excellence, ensuring streamlined cross-functional workflows between global, regional, and local affiliate teams.
 Build internal capabilities by providing in-depth specialist knowledge, coaching colleagues to develop their digital expertise, and managing relationships with key agency partners and senior stakeholders.
 Who you are: 
 You are a seasoned digital marketing professional with a relevant BSc or MSc degree, bringing 5 - 7 years of specialized experience in paid campaign management delivering multi-faceted, global channel strategies.
 You are a platform expert with hands-on technical experience publishing, optimizing, and managing large-scale campaigns across Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads and Google Analytics.
 You are a strategic, consultative thinker with a continuous improvement mindset who excels at interpreting complex data analytics to extract trends, refine targeting strategies, and make data-driven decisions.
 You are an exceptional communicator fluent in English who possesses strong interpersonal skills, with a proven track record of managing cross-border stakeholder relationships, guiding agency partners, and engaging effectively with senior leadership.
 You are an energetic, detail-oriented, and adaptable project manager who thrives in a fast-paced global environment, efficiently managing tight deadlines, complex operational tasks, and shifting digital trends.
 In exchange we provide you with: 
 Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career. 
 Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office).
 A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.
 Salary starts from 2800 EUR gross/monthly. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Prototyping & Product Engineering
#LI-Hybrid

What if you could take an ambitious AI idea and turn it into a product that scientists, clinicians, and business teams actually use? In this hands-on, builder-first role, you'll work directly with teams across life sciences and healthcare to translate complex problems into practical AI-powered solutions. You'll move from discovery and rapid prototyping to full-stack product engineering, enterprise integration, deployment, and continuous improvement, using foundation models, AI-assisted development tools, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic approaches, and reusable platforms. This is an opportunity to stay close to the code while shaping solutions with users and turning promising prototypes into secure, scalable products with measurable impact. 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities 
 · Partner with business and domain teams to translate complex challenges into high-value AI product opportunities.
 · Rapidly prototype, test, and refine solutions through short build, demonstrate, learn cycles with users.
 · Build end-to-end AI applications using Python, TypeScript, React, foundation models, and reusable platform capabilities.
 · Apply AI-assisted development tools and coding agents while ensuring quality, security, and maintainable engineering.
 · Develop retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence, agentic workflows, and automation for life sciences use cases.
 · Integrate AI products with enterprise application programming interfaces, data platforms, identity services, and authorized business systems.
 · Deploy secure, reliable applications on Amazon Web Services using Amazon Bedrock and appropriate cloud services.
 · Establish automated testing, evaluation, observability, continuous integration and deployment, and sustainable operational practices.
 · Embed privacy, security, traceability, human oversight, and appropriate controls throughout the product lifecycle.
 · Measure adoption and business outcomes, turning successful solutions into reusable capabilities that accelerate future AI products.
 Essential Requirements 
 · Approximately 8-12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years building and delivering production software.
 · Proven ownership of applications or products from problem discovery through deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
 · Strong Python expertise with the ability to build complete, production-ready applications beyond notebooks, prompts, or model endpoints.
 · Working-to-advanced TypeScript, JavaScript, and React experience building functional and intuitive user interfaces.
 · Strong engineering fundamentals across application programming interfaces, data modelling, databases, authentication, testing, containers, and cloud deployment.
 · Hands-on experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices, building maintainable solutions suitable for production environments.
 Desirable Requirements 
 · Experience building generative artificial intelligence solutions using foundation models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and tool integrations.
 · Experience delivering technology solutions within life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or another regulated environment.

items.desc:
Lieu : Cannes, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Le site de Cannes est en charge de la conception des systèmes satellitaires & plateformes, de l’assemblage/intégration/test des satellites ainsi que des opérations en orbite. Le site a une expertise en instrumentation optique et en avionique. 
 Rejoignez la Discipline Data, IA, Algo du Centre de Compétences Digital Solution (CCDS) France en charge du développement des logiciels, produits et services en algorithme, en intelligence artificielle et en data dans les domaines Télécom, Observation, Navigation et Science.
 Notre équipe passionnée conçoit et développe des produits et solutions qui permettent de centraliser, valoriser et interagir avec différents types de données, qu'elles proviennent des phases d’industrialisation (résultats de mesures, images du contrôle qualité, logs machines, plannings de production ...) ou des phases opérationnelles (images satellites, télémesures, ...).
 En tant qu'Ingénieur Data Scientiste, 
 Vous aurez en charge les missions suivantes : 
 Recueillir et analyser les besoins des utilisateurs afin de les traduire en solutions techniques adaptées. 
 Concevoir, entraîner et optimiser des modèles de Machine Learning pour des applications variées : Computer Vision, séries temporelles, détection d’anomalies et données multimodales. 
 Développer des applications basées sur l’IA générative (GenAI) afin d’automatiser et d’améliorer les processus métiers. 
 Évaluer, valider et assurer le monitoring des modèles afin de garantir leur performance et leur adéquation avec les besoins projets. 
 Collaborer avec les équipes de développement pour intégrer et industrialiser les solutions Data/IA, en appliquant les bonnes pratiques de mise en production et en assurant la documentation technique. 
 Assurer une veille technologique active, contribuer à la roadmap du service et participer aux réponses aux appels d’offres en Data Science et IA. 
 VOTRE PROFIL 
 Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur en informatique ou équivalent BAC+5, avec une spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle ou Machine Learning, vous justifiez de plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la Data Science ? 
 Vous maîtrisez Python, les principaux frameworks de Machine Learning et Deep Learning (Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) ainsi que les techniques d’IA générative (RAG, orchestration agentique) ? 
 Vous avez une expérience dans la conception, l'entraînement, l'optimisation et l'industrialisation de modèles d'IA, idéalement en environnement industriel ? 
 Vous êtes rigoureux(se), autonome, curieux(se) et doté(e) d'un bon esprit d'analyse ? 
 Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez collaborer avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques ? 
 Votre maîtrise de l'anglais vous permet de converser couramment et de rédiger des documents techniques ? 
 Une expérience dans le domaine spatial serait un plus. 
 Vous êtes à la recherche d'un poste qui vous permettra de développer votre expertise technique et de contribuer à des projets innovants en Data et Intelligence Artificielle ? 
 Vous vous reconnaissez ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position description:
We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join the CI Experience squad within our Code Orchestration department.
 The CI Experience squad enables users to analyze their projects in their own CI, making analysis a core part of their workflow. We have a mission to make analysis reliable, fast, configurable and developer-friendly.
What you will do:
Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and engineers to build the best CI-based analysis experience.
 Contribute well tested and production ready code.
 Participate in the on-call operation of analysis infrastructure, including feature deployments, production monitoring, incident response, and troubleshooting.
 Contribute to the definition of the team’s short and long-term goals.
Experience and qualifications:
MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).
 0-3 years of professional software engineering experience.
 Proficiency with Java.
 Solid engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and the ability to reason about correctness and performance
 Nice to have 
 Familiarity with a variety of build systems and CI runners.
In-office culture
We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 
Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.
 
We value diversity, equity, and inclusion
At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com. 
All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 
Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

 Microsoft Norway is looking for an Account Technology Strategist to lead the technology agenda across a portfolio of major Norwegian Public Sector enterprise customers.

You will work at the intersection of AI, security, data and cloud, helping customers modernise their technology estate, build secure AI foundations and turn their Microsoft investments into measurable business value.
 Working in close partnership with the Account Executive, you will orchestrate Microsoft's technical specialists, customer success resources, engineering teams and partners to shape opportunities, remove blockers and accelerate adoption and consumption.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Lead outcome-driven C-suite and line-of-business engagements by framing clear technical roadmaps, trade-offs and recommendations that drive customer decisions. 
 Drive execution, value, consumption and usage. Make sure strategy converts to execution and value, growing cloud consumption, Billed Revenue and Copilot/Security usage. Own and secure renewals, and drive recapture to protect revenue and prevent attrition. Move Stage 1 opportunities to qualified pipeline across ACR, Copilot, Security and Billed Revenue.
 Orchestrate technical leadership and raise the bar. Set the standard for the technology strategy by driving clear ownership and cross-solution alignment across internal segments and partners to deliver industry-focused customer outcomes. Own the end-to-end technical narrative across the customer lifecycle, from Frontier Discovery through value realisation. Demonstrate strong executive storytelling and thought leadership in AI, security, sovereignty and agentic architectures.
 Build trusted executive relationships. Grow and manage the technology relationship with senior technology and business leaders.
 Work towards a territory with municipalities. Apply and build knowledge on Public Sector and mainly municipalities. 
 Governance and compliance. Hold the highest standards of integrity and ethical conduct, meet company policy, regulatory and security standards, and manage risk proactively.

As threats become more frequent and sophisticated, we must work to keep our customers safe through our Security Solutions. The Solution Specialist Unit team within the Microsoft Security organization is at the forefront of this effort, engaging directly with customers to contribute to their success.

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 Be the security leader and expert for your assigned territory. Leads and plans for accounts across territories, does business analysis to pursue high-potential sales opportunities and manages the End-to-End Security business across the territory.

items.desc:
. 
 Overview 
 Entrerai nel team Identity Security Technology della struttura Cyber Technology di Intesa Sanpaolo, impegnato nella governance e nell'evoluzione delle identità digitali. Progetterai modelli e soluzioni per gestire l'intero ciclo di vita delle identità umane, non umane e agentiche, curandone l'integrazione con applicazioni e piattaforme Cloud. Collaborerai con team tecnologici e di sicurezza per sviluppare servizi di Identity Security innovativi, affidabili e tracciabili, in linea con i principi Zero Trust e Identity First. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Progettare ed evolvere soluzioni enterprise di Identity Management e Identity Governance, traducendo requisiti di sicurezza, compliance e business in architetture tecnico-funzionali scalabili e sostenibili. 
 Definire processi e modelli di governance per l'intero ciclo di vita delle identità umane, non umane ed agentiche. 
 Integrare le piattaforme Identity con sistemi HR, directory, applicazioni, servizi di sicurezza ed ambienti Cloud attraverso API, connettori, eventi e workflow automatizzati. 
 Definire standard e pattern architetturali coerenti con i principi Identity First, Zero Trust, Least Privilege e Segregation of Duties, anche in contesti Hybrid e Multi-Cloud. 
 Guidare iniziative progettuali complesse, coordinando team interni e fornitori e curando requisiti, specifiche, documentazione architetturale e roadmap evolutive. 
 Definire metriche, controlli ed audit trail per garantire qualità, sicurezza, tracciabilità e conformità dei processi Identity. 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Esperienza di 3-5 anni in ambito Cybersecurity 
 Esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni di Identity Management, Identity Governance, autenticazione ed autorizzazione 
 Conoscenza di LDAP, SCIM, API REST e connettori applicativi 
 Esperienza con Active Directory, Microsoft EntraID, Cloud Identity ed ambienti Hybrid e Multi-Cloud 
 Conoscenza e capacità di applicazione dei principi Zero Trust, Identity First, Least Privilege e Segregation of Duties 
 Conoscenze preferenziali: 
 Laurea ambito STEM 
 Inglese almeno livello B2 CEFR 
 SailPoint IIQ o Security Cloud, AI Security, Agent Identity, DevSecOps, Cloud Security 
 SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, Kerberos, PKI, RACF 
 Certificazioni CISSP, CISSM 
 Significative esperienze professionali o di studio in contesti internazionali. 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 40.000 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 L’Area Chief Data, A.I. & Technology Officer è la realtà IT del Gruppo che coniuga l’agilità di una fintech con la solidità di un grande gruppo; avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo con tecnologie all’avanguardia e con forte spinta alla trasformazione digitale. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

items.desc:
MixRank (YC S11) | Software Engineers | 100% Remote (Global) | Full-Time MixRank processes petabytes of data every month through web crawling. Hundreds of customers use our data products, including Google, Amazon, Facebook, Intel, and Adobe, across industries such as finance, recruiting, sales, marketing, and security. We’re a fully remote company with a global footprint across 20+ countries. We’re growing, profitable, employee-owned, and have no dependence on outside funding. Applicants from all geographies and backgrounds are welcome. We’re looking for passionate individuals for whom programming is not just a job, but something they genuinely love to do. We’re obsessed with computers, programming, big data, databases, compilers, hardware, math, data science, and the internet. Does this sound like you? Please apply to join our team. Our codebase is friendly to new contributors. You’ll have a fully functional development environment within hours through full automation and will be pushing commits on your first day. Deployments to production happen multiple times per day and finish in under two minutes.Effectively all of our codebase is written in Python, Rust, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Nix. The core technologies you’ll need familiarity with to be productive are Python, PostgreSQL, Linux, and Git.
We operate at a larger scale than typical startups. We run two datacenters with high-performance servers we’ve built ourselves, capable of handling the volumes of data we process. We’ve implemented our own distributed file system, perform full-scale web crawls, and download and run static analysis on the entire universe of published Android APKs and iOS IPAs.
Unlike a typical startup where you might spend half your time in meetings and the other half fixing Jira tickets, at MixRank you’ll challenge yourself with difficult technical problems that help you grow as an individual. We’re continuously hiring for the positions below; these aren’t singular roles that close once filled. Our philosophy is that the candidate is more important than the position. For each new member of the team, we design a custom role and responsibilities around their interests. Other companies may create a long list of specific requirements with the expectation that you’ll exactly replace someone on the team or fit a role defined by committee. MixRank is more pragmatic: we first get excited about bringing a unique individual onto the team, then figure out the best way to support their specific talents.
Junior Software Engineer - Remote (Global), Full-Time
We’re looking for remote junior engineers with 0–3 years of professional software experience and 5+ years of curiosity exploring computers, programming, and technical hobby projects.
This is an open-ended entry role with mentorship and diverse opportunities to work across all areas of our product: databases, distributed systems, infrastructure and tooling, data analysis, machine learning, frontend/backend web development, APIs, data mining, data modeling, and more.
To stand out, please highlight what makes you unique: passion for computing, curiosity and side projects, work ethic, niche research, or anything else that shows how you think and build.
Ideally, you’ve already graduated. But if you still have one or more years left of school, please feel free to apply anyway. If you’re the right fit for the team, we’ll figure out a way to accommodate your schedule.
Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mixrank/jobs/Fnwsojk-j 
Software Engineer - Remote (Global), Full-Time
We’re hiring generalist software engineers to work on web applications, data mining, machine learning/data science, data transformation/ETL, data modeling, database scaling, infrastructure, DevOps, and more. We’ll tailor the role to the subset of areas that best match your interests.
Beneficial experience includes PostgreSQL, Python, Rust, Linux, TypeScript, Nix, frontend/backend web development, and data mining.
Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mixrank/jobs/RXQspen-s 
I’m Kiran, Chief of Staff at MixRank, a fully remote data startup building go-to-market intelligence. We’re US-incorporated but hire globally, and we’re bringing on new teammates to join a fast-moving team with real ownership and impact.

items.desc:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
 This is a full-time, permanent role based in Milan and we are unable to hire people part-time, or outside of the Milan area for now. 
 About the Role
 We’re building the clinical co-pilot of the future - empowering clinicians, enhancing care delivery, and scaling impact. As part of our Global Medical Operations team , you’ll play a pivotal role in rolling out Tandem’s AI clinical operating system to some of the most influential healthcare organisations worldwide.
 This is a highly visible, global role where you’ll engage directly with executives, medical leaders, and end-users. You’ll bring clinical insight into how our tools are implemented on the ground - from onboarding new organisations and refining workflows to shaping the product through continuous feedback. You’ll be at the forefront of transforming healthcare delivery, ensuring Tandem becomes an indispensable part of daily patient care for clinicians across the globe.
 What You Will Do
 Lead live product demos for prospective clients and support global commercial efforts.
 Design and adapt workflows and templates for diverse markets and large-scale customers.
 Partner with product, engineering, and commercial teams to deliver smooth rollouts and seamless workflow integration.
 Represent Tandem at international conferences, workshops, and customer events.
 Guide clinicians through onboarding, training, and day-to-day support.
 Troubleshoot and solve problems to ensure clinicians get maximum value from Tandem.
 Build templates and prompts, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Tandem’s AI assistant.
 Manage clinical safety incidents and optimise internal operations for safe scaling.
What You Bring
 Clinical experience in healthcare, ideally as a medical doctor (e.g. general practice, hospital, private practice).
 Exposure to consulting, corporate, or startup environments.
 A passion for technology, AI, and their potential to transform care.
 Strong communication skills — equally comfortable with executives, engineers, and frontline clinicians.
 Organisational strength and a process-driven mindset.
 Ownership, curiosity, and initiative in a fast-paced environment.
 Flexibility to travel up to 25% and step in during critical moments.
 Ability to communicate fluently (bilingual) in both English and in Italian.
 Bonus Points
 Experience with prompting or large language models (LLMs).
 Background in healthtech or SaaS.
 Familiarity with EU clinical safety or digital health regulations.
 Track record in implementation projects or customer rollouts.
 Location
 We believe great ideas thrive when we connect in person. This is a full-time based in Milan with occasional travel to meet the core team in Stockholm and clinicians across the country as needed
 How to Apply
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
 Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
 Screening interview with Talent Acquisition 
 First interview with our Director of Italy
 Follow up interview with one of our Medical Operations team members
 Working Day - Join us in the Stockholm office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.
 Culture at Tandem
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
 Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

items.desc: At Pretius we are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join a project for a client in the insurance industry. The project combines classic machine learning with Generative AI agents, built entirely on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will help build solutions that support underwriting, actuarial analysis and fraud, waste and abuse (FWA) detection, with a strong focus on security, traceability and client data isolation. Project / Role Build ML and statistical models (e.g. risk scoring, fraud detection) for insurance clients on OCI. Prepare data and manage the model lifecycle: training, batch scoring, deployment and drift monitoring. Run daily batch scoring and large-scale data processing. Design GenAI agents with RAG over insurance documentation and governed access to data through SQL. Build and evaluate the vector search layer behind the agents. Implement guardrails and traceability for GenAI solutions. Ensure security and isolation of client data in a multi-tenant setup. Requirements 3+ years in statistics and machine learning. Strong PL/SQL skills and hands-on work with Autonomous Database (ADW) on OCI. Practical knowledge of OCI Data Science: notebook sessions, Jobs, ML Pipelines, conda environments, Model Catalog (versioning, metadata) and Model Deployment. Model monitoring for drift and performance. Working with Autonomous Database and Object Storage from Data Science, with a clear view on when to train in-database vs. externally. Scheduling and orchestration of batch scoring on daily-refreshed data. Background in LLM- and RAG-based solutions, ideally on OCI Generative AI, including hosting or calling LLMs in governed agents. Ability to build agents that query governed data through SQL and function-calling tools instead of answering numbers from model memory. Solid grasp of retrieval fundamentals: chunking, embeddings, retrieval quality evaluation. Solid grasp of guardrails and traceability: prompt-injection controls, citations, trace logging of every tool call and answer, human approval for consequential actions. Good command of cloud security: IAM policies, Vault, private networking, Logging and Monitoring. Fluent English (min. B2). Nice to have Oracle Machine Learning (OML) and Select AI, including where Select AI fits and where it doesn’t. Familiarity with OCI Generative AI Agents: agents, endpoints, sessions and knowledge bases over documents such as policy wordings, underwriting guidelines, actuarial memos and FWA investigation playbooks. Exposure to Oracle AI Vector Search or OpenSearch. Exposure to OCI Data Flow (Spark). Insurance domain knowledge (underwriting, actuarial, FWA). Background in multi-tenant solutions that keep client data and models isolated. What do we offer? We focus on long-term relationships based on fair principles and reliability. Co-financing of the Multisport card and Medicover private healthcare. Modern office available. Team bonding activities, internal courses, conferences, certifications.

Generatieve AI biedt heel wat kansen om slimmer te werken. Maar niet elke vraag vraagt om AI. Jij helpt ons om de juiste opportuniteiten te vinden en ze om te zetten in concrete oplossingen. Je gaat in gesprek met collega’s en onderzoekt waar AI echte meerwaarde kan bieden. Je stelt kritische vragen en helpt de juiste use cases kiezen. Je vertaalt goede ideeën naar concrete AI-oplossingen en helpt ze technisch te realiseren op de beschikbare platformen binnen Agristo. Je begeleidt een oplossing van de eerste businessvraag tot een toepassing die werkt, gebruiksvriendelijk is en onderhouden kan worden. Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende IT-teams rond data, integraties en infrastructuur. Tegelijk heb je veel contact met stakeholders uit de business. Je past onze afspraken rond AI-governance toe en denkt mee over hoe we die verder kunnen verbeteren. Je neemt collega’s mee in AI. Dat doe je via trainingen, inspiratiesessies en onze interne AI-community. Zo help je de AI-kennis binnen Agristo verder groeien. Je houdt nieuwe ontwikkelingen en tools rond AI in de gaten. Je beoordeelt kritisch welke technologie interessant is voor Agristo en vertaalt die naar concrete kansen. Hier herken jij jezelf in: Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma met een technische of analytische achtergrond, aangevuld met relevante werkervaring. Een master is mooi meegenomen, maar geen absolute must. Je hebt al professionele ervaring binnen AI en bent klaar om die kennis praktisch toe te passen. Je hebt een goede basis in programmeren, bijvoorbeeld met Python, en kunt die kennis inzetten bij het ontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen. Je kent moderne AI-concepten, zoals large language models en prompt engineering, en wilt je hierin verder verdiepen. Ervaring met platformen zoals Databricks, Microsoft Foundry of de bredere Microsoft-stack is een pluspunt, geen vereiste. Je denkt kritisch en abstract. Je stelt de juiste vragen en durft ook aan te geven wanneer AI niet de beste oplossing is. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar businessprocessen en ziet snel waar technologie echte meerwaarde kan creëren. Je communiceert helder en werkt graag samen met verschillende mensen, binnen IT én daarbuiten. Je staat comfortabel voor een groep en kunt een technisch onderwerp eenvoudig uitleggen. Je krijgt energie van collega’s meenemen in nieuwe technologie. Verandering schrikt je niet af. AI evolueert snel en ook binnen Agristo zijn we voortdurend in beweging. Wat krijg je ervoor terug? Een smakelijk loon dat aansluit bij jouw kennis en ervaring, flexibele planning voor telewerk, diverse extralegale voordelen, aangevuld met een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, bedrijfswagen en laadpas, op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. Een flex reward plan met de mogelijkheid om een deel van je loonpakket zelf samen te stellen (fiets, multimedia, verzekeringen, verlofdagen,…). Een cultuur die je voelt: positief, mensgericht en vooruitstrevend. Hier krijg je energie van collega’s met een sterke can-do mentaliteit en een oprechte drive om te groeien. Een paar extra kilo’s op de weegschaal, want je koopt voortaan diepvriesfrietjes, kroketjes en andere aardappelproducten aan voordelig tarief. Core op dinsdag, bootcamp op donderdag of samen trainen voor een (halve) marathon. Want bij Agristo gaan samen zweten en samen groeien hand in hand. Bij Agristo word je gehoord, gewaardeerd en ondersteund. Niet omdat het moet, maar omdat we geloven dat mensen het verschil maken. About the role Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on. Who we're looking for Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow. Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism. Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming. What you'll do Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of: Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD. Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems. ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software. Unbound: Build our product extension platform, enabling BLP to automate arbitrary customer business processes as we scale. What you'll bring We do not require experience with any particular technology or even industry software development experience. You should, however, provide clear evidence of the abilities we’re looking for. That evidence could include: strong academic backgrounds (math PhD/MSc or significant olympiad achievements) startup experience (early employee, built productive systems yourself & know what it takes to maintain them) FP experience (have deep understanding of programming languages and are able to discern the various tradeoffs of different paradigms) Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

items.desc: City: Warsaw Department: IT & Engineering Recruiter: Anna Symonenko Rate: 89 – 119 PLN/hour (B2B) We are looking for a skilled Java Engineer for service agreement collaboration (B2B contract) to cooperate with a team dedicated to Network Planning at FlixTrain - building internal tools that help plan the timetable and vehicle allocation, reduce manual processes, and increase productivity. This is a greenfield environment with plenty of room to shape new products from the ground up and explore innovative solutions for our internal users. Scope of Services You will independently design, develop and deliver reliable backend services within a self-organized, cross-functional, distributed team. This includes building robust APIs and event-driven integrations for our internal tools, with a strong focus on internal user needs. You will also help drive backend architecture decisions and contribute to technical quality across teams through code reviews and close collaboration. About the Engagement Design, build and maintain backend services and APIs that automate and simplify FlixTrain Network Planning workflows Develop and evolve data models and integrations, including asynchronous, event-driven communication between services Work with internal users, product and other engineers to understand their needs and turn them into practical technical solutions Write and maintain automated tests to ensure the reliability and maintainability of the services you deliver Collaborate with other engineers across a distributed architecture within an Agile environment Document technical decisions, solutions and ways of working Our backend stack: Java with Spring Boot AWS Kafka Kubernetes Terraform for IaC GraphQL PostgreSQL GitLab CI About You You have 3 to 5 years of experience building backend applications, from which a couple of years building backend applications in Java or another JVM language such as Kotlin You have worked in cloud environments (ideally AWS) You have practical experience with at least one of the following: Building and running on AWS Designing, building and maintaining event-driven systems with Kafka Deploying and operating workloads on Kubernetes Managing infrastructure as code, ideally with Terraform You write automated tests as a natural part of your development process and care about code quality and maintainability Understanding of event-driven systems and how to work with them Solid written and spoken English skills Experience working in an Agile setup Curiosity about the business domain. Interest in transportation, logistics or similarly complex domains is a good signal, as is the ability to explain such a domain clearly Nice to have Experience building services with Spring Boot Experience working with databases, relational and/or NoSQL Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI or GitHub Actions) A DevOps mindset: you are willing to own pipelines, infrastructure and quality, not just the application code Experience with agentic or AI-assisted coding We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! What We Offer Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. To view more local benefits specific to each office location, Why Join Flix? At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you’re looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

Your Mission You run the room. Two to three days in Zurich that set the tone for every implementation that follows. Before a project kicks off, our clients send the people who will carry it, their BLP Champions, to the BLP Academy. You bring in our BLP experts for deep dives and make sure their expertise lands. Our clients go home certified, connected and ready for their implementation, after an unforgettable few days in Zurich. And as BLP expands across Europe and North America, the Academy will grow with it, with you shaping what that looks like. That takes an unusual mix: part entertainer, part teacher, part professor, with a real curiosity for processes and AI. We care less about where you come from than about what happens when you walk into a room. You will join a fast-growing, global AI company and a team that brings real energy to everything it does. If you light up a room and make complex things simple at the same time, read on. Key Responsibilities In the room Host every Academy cohort in Zurich: welcome our clients, set the tone, and be their main point of contact from arrival to departure. Lead the sessions: present, explain, and guide participants through hands-on exercises on the BLP platform. Pace every hands-on block to the room, giving fast learners space to go deeper while making sure nobody gets left behind. Moderate the deep-dive sessions with BLP experts and connect their content to each participant's situation. Keep the energy high across two to three intense days, and host the evenings and everything around the program. Around each cohort Get every participant ready before they arrive, so the Academy starts with momentum on day one. Make sure every participant completes the BLP Champion Certification and goes home ready for their implementation. Collect feedback and participant NPS, and make every cohort better than the last. Beyond the classroom Bring the Academy experience to new formats as they launch, from online learning programs for our clients and certification for our implementation partners to onboarding for new BLP colleagues. What We're Looking For The following key attributes ensure success in this role: Energy – You bring the room to life on day one and still have it on day three, evenings included. Owning a Room – You lead groups with confidence, from senior client audiences to hands-on sessions, and know when to push, when to pause and when to make people laugh. Patience and Empathy – You notice who is struggling before they say so, and you adapt the pace of a hands-on session to each participant. Communication – You make complex topics simple and convincing, and you can tell whether a participant has really understood or is just nodding. Credibility – You hold your own with senior experts and executives, because you think in structures and understand what you are talking about. Curiosity for Processes and AI – You want to understand how enterprise processes run and what AI changes about them, and you learn fast. Host Mindset – You care that every participant has a great experience, keep a multi-day program running smoothly, and notice the details that make it work. items.desc: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on. Who we're looking for Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow. Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism. Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming. What you'll do Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of: Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD. Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems. ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software. Unbound: Build our product extension platform, enabling BLP to automate arbitrary customer business processes as we scale. What you'll bring We do not require experience with any particular technology or even industry software development experience. You should, however, provide clear evidence of the abilities we’re looking for. That evidence could include: strong academic backgrounds (math PhD/MSc or significant olympiad achievements) startup experience (early employee, built productive systems yourself & know what it takes to maintain them) FP experience (have deep understanding of programming languages and are able to discern the various tradeoffs of different paradigms) Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.
