items.desc: About the Company The company is building a new generation of cybersecurity technology powered by autonomous AI agents. Its platform is designed to simulate real-world attack techniques, uncover security weaknesses and verify whether vulnerabilities can be successfully exploited. By combining offensive security expertise with advanced AI engineering, the company aims to make security testing more continuous, effective and accessible to organisations. Following a $4 million pre-seed funding round, the team is expanding its technical capabilities and bringing together security professionals and engineers to develop this technology. About the Role The company is looking for an Offensive Security Engineer with a strong practical understanding of how vulnerabilities are discovered, investigated and exploited. You will work across real-world applications, APIs and infrastructure, performing security testing and investigating potential attack paths. A key part of the role will involve examining vulnerabilities identified by autonomous agents, reproducing their behaviour and determining whether they represent genuine security risks. Beyond traditional security testing, you will contribute directly to improving the company's technology by developing proof-of-concept exploits, writing scripts and helping engineers translate offensive security techniques into repeatable testing capabilities. This is a hands-on engineering position suited to someone who enjoys solving technical problems, exploring unfamiliar systems and understanding how weaknesses can be exploited. Key Responsibilities Perform hands-on security assessments of web applications, APIs, cloud environments and infrastructure. Investigate potential vulnerabilities and identify practical ways to reproduce and exploit them. Analyse the output of autonomous security agents, verify findings and identify false positives or incomplete attack paths. Develop proof-of-concept exploits to demonstrate vulnerability impact and validate exploitability. Explore authentication, authorisation, access-control and injection weaknesses across different technologies. Develop Python scripts and lightweight tools to support security research, automate testing and improve investigation workflows. Work closely with software engineers to improve vulnerability detection, agent capabilities and testing methodologies. Document technical findings, attack paths and remediation guidance in a clear and reproducible format. Contribute to the development of repeatable security tests based on real-world vulnerabilities and exploitation techniques. Requirements Practical experience in offensive security, penetration testing, application security testing or vulnerability research. Ability to investigate and manually exploit common security weaknesses, particularly in web applications and APIs. Good understanding of authentication, authorisation, access control, injection vulnerabilities and common attack techniques. Experience using tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap and other offensive security utilities. Ability to write or adapt Python scripts for security testing, automation or vulnerability investigation. Understanding of how applications, APIs and infrastructure interact, including common security weaknesses across these environments. Ability to develop reproducible proof-of-concept demonstrations and explain technical findings clearly. A practical, investigative mindset and the ability to work independently while collaborating with engineers and other security specialists. Desirable Experience Experience in one or more of the following areas would be beneficial: Active Directory security and exploitation. Linux or Windows privilege escalation. Cloud security testing, particularly AWS or Azure. Red teaming and adversary emulation. Exploit development and vulnerability research. Source-code review and application security. Development of offensive security tools, scripts or automation frameworks. Public vulnerability disclosures, CVEs, bug bounty programmes or technical security research. Candidates do not need experience in every area to be considered. Certifications and AI Experience Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE or equivalent are welcome but are not essential. Practical technical ability, problem-solving skills and a genuine understanding of exploitation are more important than formal qualifications. Previous experience with AI or machine learning is not required. However, an interest in autonomous security testing and the application of AI to offensive security would be valuable. What the Company Offers The opportunity to work on an emerging AI-powered cybersecurity platform. Direct involvement in shaping how autonomous agents discover and validate security vulnerabilities. Hands-on exposure to real-world applications, APIs and infrastructure. Close collaboration with experienced security researchers and software engineers. Technical ownership and the opportunity to influence product …

items.desc: Buscamos perfiles de Data Science y Forward Deployed AI Engineering para diseñar y llevar a producción soluciones de inteligencia artificial aplicadas a operación, mantenimiento, manufacturing y logística. La oportunidad tiene dos vías de entrada. Puedes aportar profundidad en Data Science o en ingeniería de soluciones de IA ; no esperamos que seas especialista en ambas. En cualquiera de las dos, será importante entender el problema operativo, trabajar con quienes conocen el proceso y construir soluciones que puedan integrarse, utilizarse y evolucionar. El trabajo puede implicar datos de sensores y series temporales, eventos, órdenes de trabajo, inventario, producción, calidad, documentación técnica o movimientos de materiales. La experiencia previa en entornos industriales será valorable, pero no es imprescindible: sí lo son la curiosidad por entenderlos y la disposición para aprender de sus especialistas. ¿Qué harás? Trabajar con equipos de operación, mantenimiento, producción y logística para entender sus procesos, decisiones, restricciones y fuentes de datos. Traducir problemas operativos en casos de uso de IA con alcance, métricas, baseline y criterios de aceptación definidos. Diseñar, desarrollar y validar soluciones desde la exploración inicial hasta su puesta en producción. Integrar modelos, agentes o servicios analíticos con APIs, bases de datos, documentación técnica y sistemas empresariales u operativos. Construir y mantener pipelines de datos e IA con testing, trazabilidad, observabilidad y monitorización. Evaluar calidad, robustez, coste, latencia e impacto operativo, explicando también los límites de cada solución. Colaborar con perfiles de negocio, ingeniería, arquitectura y usuarios finales, adaptando la comunicación a cada interlocutor. Si tu especialidad es Data Science , buscamos experiencia demostrable en varias de estas áreas: Python, SQL, estadística y Machine Learning aplicado. Análisis exploratorio, diseño de baselines y validación rigurosa de modelos. Series temporales, datos de sensórica, detección de anomalías, predicción, optimización o process mining. Feature engineering, entrenamiento, evaluación, despliegue y monitorización de modelos. Capacidad para conectar los resultados analíticos con decisiones operativas. No es imprescindible tener experiencia previa en IA generativa para esta especialidad. Sí esperamos interés por aprender cuándo agentes o modelos de lenguaje pueden aportar valor. Si tu especialidad es Forward Deployed AI Engineering , buscamos experiencia demostrable en varias de estas áreas: Desarrollo de aplicaciones con modelos de lenguaje y agentes que utilizan herramientas. Diseño de workflows, planificación, memoria, supervisión humana y automatización de procesos. Integración con APIs, servicios, bases de datos y sistemas corporativos. Evaluación y observabilidad de soluciones: trazas, métricas, datasets de prueba, errores, coste y latencia. Despliegue de servicios de IA mantenibles, seguros y operables. Gestión de riesgos de IA generativa, como alucinaciones, prompt injection, permisos, fuga de información, guardrails y supervisión humana. Se valorará conocimiento práctico de sistemas RAG, aunque el foco está en construir agentes y soluciones integradas que funcionen dentro de procesos reales. ¿Qué tienen en común las dos vías? Fundamentos de ingeniería de software y experiencia práctica con Python. Uso de Git, testing, logging, documentación y buenas prácticas de desarrollo. Capacidad para integrar componentes mediante APIs y trabajar con datos estructurados y no estructurados. Comprensión de métricas, experimentación y validación basada en evidencia. Criterio técnico, comunicación clara y disposición para aprender de la especialidad complementaria. Tecnologías y experiencia Se valorará experiencia con herramientas como FastAPI o equivalentes, Docker, CI/CD, scikit-learn, PyTorch, plataformas MLOps, APIs de modelos fundacionales, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel o AutoGen. También con Databricks y servicios de datos o IA en Azure, AWS o GCP. Según el proyecto, pueden aparecer entornos como SCADA, historian, IoT, GMAO/CMMS, ERP, MES, WMS o TMS. No es necesario conocer todas estas tecnologías : valoramos el dominio demostrable de herramientas equivalentes y la capacidad para elegir las adecuadas para cada problema. Se valorará formación adicional en IA, Data Science, ingeniería de software, sistemas industriales, operaciones o supply chain. ¿Por qué NTT DATA? En NTT DATA, la tecnología se desarrolla en colaboración entre equipos con conocimientos distintos y se aplica a retos de sectores como industria, energía, logística, finanzas y salud. En esta posición, esa colaboración significa trabajar junto a especialistas que conocen la operación y tener en cuenta el uso real de la solución, no solo su desempeño técnico. Formarás parte de una compañía internacional con más de 139.000 profesionales en más de 50 países, con oportunidades para profundizar en tu especialidad y …

items.desc: L'entreprise Le Groupe Chopard jusqu’alors acteur majeur de la distribution automobile a souhaité diversifier les moyens de mobilité proposés à ses clients. L’intégration des marques deux roues souligne un véritable tournant dans son histoire. En parallèle, il participe au développement de nouvelles formes de mobilités : vélos électriques ainsi que bornes de recharge viennent étoffer son offre. Ces activités s’ajoutent aux 105 points de vente automobiles répartis en 16 marques. La culture d’entreprise du Groupe se définit à travers les valeurs d’Humain, d’Engagement et d’Excellence. Elles garantissent le bien-être de nos collaborateurs et permettent d’accomplir nos objectifs individuels et collectifs. Notre entreprise s’engage en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion. Tous nos postes sont ouverts à toutes et à tous, et nous adaptons les conditions de travail aux besoins spécifiques de chaque collaborateur, dans la mesure du possible et en cohérence avec les contraintes du poste. Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise où il fait bon travailler et être le partenaire de notre réussite ? Rejoignez-nous ! À propos du poste Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) IA générative et solutions agentiques (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes de la Direction des Systèmes d’Information Groupe et contribuer au développement des usages de l’intelligence artificielle au service des métiers. Basé(e) au sein du siège social du Groupe à Besançon, secteur Temis, et rattaché(e) à la Responsable Data, vous serez chargé(e) d’identifier, de concevoir et de déployer des solutions d’intelligence artificielle répondant à des besoins métiers concrets. Vous interviendrez notamment sur le développement des usages de Microsoft 365 Copilot et sur la mise en œuvre d’agents IA connectés aux données et aux applications du Groupe. Vos missions: Vous contribuez à transformer les opportunités offertes par l’intelligence artificielle en usages concrets pour les métiers en intervenant de l’idée jusqu’à la mise en service : Comprendre les besoins métiers, identifier les cas d’usage à valeur et aider à distinguer les bonnes idées des faux problèmes à résoudre par l’IA. Concevoir et prototyper des solutions d’IA générative et des agents, notamment autour de Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio et Azure AI. Connecter l’IA au système d’information : documents, données, API et applications métiers, dans le respect des règles de sécurité et de confidentialité. Tester, mesurer et améliorer les solutions avec les utilisateurs avant de contribuer à leur industrialisation. Accompagner l’adoption, par des ateliers, des formations et un travail de proximité avec les équipes métiers. Suivre les solutions dans la durée : qualité des réponses, valeur produite, usages, incidents et améliorations. Travailler en transversal avec les équipes métiers, Data, sécurité, infrastructure et applications. Votre objectif est de mettre en production des usages qui apportent une valeur réelle et mesurable à l’entreprise. Profil recherché Diplômé(e) d'une formation Bac+5 en Informatique, Data, Intelligence Artificielle ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie (1 à 3 ans) dans la conception, le déploiement ou l'exploitation de solutions d'intelligence artificielle, idéalement dans un environnement Microsoft et Cloud. Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances en : Intelligence artificielle générative (LLM, RAG, recherche sémantique, prompting) ; Écosystème Microsoft (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Power Automate) ; Développement et intégration (Python, API, SQL) ; Conception et orchestration de solutions et agents IA ; Exploitation, sécurisation et gouvernance des données ; Automatisation et industrialisation des solutions numériques. La connaissance de technologies telles qu'Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, Entra ID, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, Logic Apps ou Docker constitue un atout. Curieux(se), pragmatique et autonome, vous appréciez autant l'expérimentation que la mise en œuvre de solutions fiables, sécurisées et adoptées par les utilisateurs. Votre sens de la confidentialité, votre pédagogie et votre capacité à travailler en équipe sont vos points forts.

items.desc: Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) IA spécialisé(e) en IA générative, dans le but de transformer des flux de travail et des données complexes en solutions intelligentes et automatisées qui stimulent nos opérations commerciales. Dans ce rôle, vous concevrez, mettrez en œuvre et orchestrerez des LLM avancés et des agents autonomes pour guider les décisions stratégiques, améliorer l'expérience client et résoudre des problèmes métier complexes, en étroite collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires. Le poste sera basé à Paris dans un sites d'Admiral Europe. Vos responsabilités principales seront les suivantes : ● Conception et mise en œuvre de solutions d'IA : Développer et déployer des modèles d'IA générative, des agents autonomes et des interfaces conversationnelles pour répondre à des défis métier complexes et automatiser les flux de travail internes. ● Optimisation des modèles : Ajuster (fine-tuning) les modèles fondamentaux existants et construire des pipelines RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) robustes pour garantir des résultats d'IA très précis et adaptés au contexte. ● Ingénierie de prompt & Orchestration : Concevoir et optimiser les prompts et utiliser des frameworks d'orchestration pour construire des systèmes multi-agents capables de gérer des tâches complexes et multi-étapes. ● Alignement métier : Collaborer avec les experts du domaine pour traduire des questions métier ambiguës et des goulots d'étranglement opérationnels en frameworks d'IA générative exploitables. ● Production & LLMOps : Partenariat avec les équipes MLOps/DevOps pour assurer un déploiement fluide des modèles, surveiller la latence, la qualité et les hallucinations, et respecter les meilleures pratiques de CI/CD et de tests automatisés. ● Expérimentation : Concevoir et analyser des expériences A/B et multivariées rigoureuses pour valider l'efficacité et l'adoption par les utilisateurs des nouvelles fonctionnalités pilotées par l'IA. ● Communication avec les parties prenantes : Communiquer les concepts d'IA, les capacités et les limites des systèmes aux parties prenantes techniques et non techniques. ● Intégration : Collaborer avec des équipes transversales, incluant des ingénieurs logiciels, des responsables produit et des data scientists, pour intégrer vos agents et modèles d'IA dans les systèmes de production. ● Apprentissage continu : Rester à jour sur les avancées rapides du paysage de l'IA générative, des LLM et du NLP. Au moins 2 ans d'expérience en machine learning, ingénierie logicielle ou développement d'IA, avec une expérience avérée dans la mise en production de solutions d'IA générative ou de Machine Learning. Expérience confirmée dans la construction et l'orchestration d'agents d'IA à l'aide de frameworks modernes (ex. LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, Strands, Bedrock AgentCore). Maîtrise de niveau expert en Python et excellente connaissance des principales API de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face). Compréhension approfondie des méthodologies d'ingénierie de prompt. Expérience dans la création et la mise à l'échelle d'architectures RAG. Compréhension du CI/CD et maîtrise de Git. Maîtrise de l'anglais (C1) et du français. L'espagnol ou l'italien est un plus. Et surtout, volonté d'apprendre et d'intégrer constamment les nouvelles technologies disponibles dans le flux de travail. Les plus qui feront la différence : Expérience sur des environnements Big Data / Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) et plateformes LLMOps (LangSmith, Weights & Biases). Expérience avec les bibliothèques IA/ML (PyTorch) et le Traitement Automatique du Langage Naturel (NLP). Pratique des techniques de fine-tuning (PEFT, LoRA). Pratique des bases de données vectorielles (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant). Maîtrise de l'espagnol ou de l'italien. 1. Préqualification technique (15 min) : Un premier échange téléphonique avec un membre de l'équipe technique. 2. 1er entretien (RH & Technique) : Un entretien croisé avec Joséphine (RH) et un collaborateur de l'équipe technique. 3. 2ème entretien (Management) : Un échange approfondi en anglais avec notre Head of AA & AI, et notre Head of Data & CX

Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer – AI Tooling Infrastructure based in France. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to build, operate, and scale the backend infrastructure powering innovative AI-driven developer tools. In this role, you will take ownership of production services, including infrastructure supporting AI agents, developer assistants, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. You will focus on ensuring reliability, security, performance, and observability in an environment where AI-driven traffic introduces unique infrastructure challenges. Working closely with platform, security, and infrastructure teams, you will help shape scalable architectures and improve operational excellence. This is a hands-on engineering position offering significant ownership over systems running in production. You will join a globally distributed, asynchronous engineering environment that values autonomy, open-source development, and continuous improvement. Accountabilities Build, deploy, operate, and scale production backend services supporting AI-powered developer tools, including MCP servers, agent skills, and AI assistants. Own service architecture and infrastructure decisions, improving system reliability, maintainability, scalability, and deployment processes. Define and monitor service reliability objectives (SLOs), track error budgets, and prioritize improvements in collaboration with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams. Participate in the team's on-call rotation, investigate production incidents, coordinate resolutions, and develop incident reports, runbooks, and preventive solutions. Manage operational support requests and identify recurring issues that can be addressed through long-term engineering improvements. Design and maintain authentication and authorization systems for AI agents and machine clients, including OAuth applications, scoped tokens, permissions, and secure access management. Establish and maintain comprehensive observability through metrics, distributed tracing, logging, dashboards, and alerting systems. Manage AI agent traffic, implementing rate limits, capacity controls, cost safeguards, and mechanisms to handle dependency failures and unexpected traffic spikes. Collaborate with Platform, SRE, Authentication, Billing, and Edge Functions teams to improve shared infrastructure, release processes, security, and operational practices. Contribute to the development of AI tooling infrastructure, ensuring that reliability, security, and performance remain central to engineering decisions. Requirements At least 5 years of experience building, deploying, and operating production backend services, including participation in on-call rotations. Strong programming skills in TypeScript or Go, with practical working knowledge of the other language. Proven experience designing and maintaining APIs, including versioning, error handling, rate limiting, and backward compatibility. Strong understanding of OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT, and API authorization, with the ability to troubleshoot authentication and permission issues in production environments. Good knowledge of PostgreSQL and relational database systems. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, containerized deployments, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems using metrics, logs, and traces to identify performance bottlenecks and service failures. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and work effectively in globally distributed, asynchronous environments. Adaptability, ownership, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while delivering solutions in fast-paced engineering environments. Deep expertise in at least one of the following areas: APIs and Authentication: Experience designing permission models, token scopes, and OAuth flows for third-party integrations or machine clients, including safely migrating authentication systems without disrupting existing users. Production Operations: Hands-on experience managing production services, participating in on-call rotations, developing alerts and runbooks, implementing SLOs, and improving system reliability. Gateways and Distributed Systems: Experience building or operating proxies, gateways, or distributed services, troubleshooting retries, partial failures, upstream outages, and making appropriate fail-open or fail-closed decisions under degraded conditions. Nice To Have Experience with AI agent tooling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or infrastructure serving AI agents and LLM clients. Experience extracting services from larger codebases while maintaining compatibility with existing integrations. Familiarity with observability platforms such as Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or Logflare, along with practical experience implementing SLOs. Contributions to open-source …

items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer – AI Tooling Infrastructure based in United Kingdom. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to build, operate, and scale the backend infrastructure powering innovative AI-driven developer tools. In this role, you will take ownership of production services, including infrastructure supporting AI agents, developer assistants, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. You will focus on ensuring reliability, security, performance, and observability in an environment where AI-driven traffic introduces unique infrastructure challenges. Working closely with platform, security, and infrastructure teams, you will help shape scalable architectures and improve operational excellence. This is a hands-on engineering position offering significant ownership over systems running in production. You will join a globally distributed, asynchronous engineering environment that values autonomy, open-source development, and continuous improvement. Accountabilities Build, deploy, operate, and scale production backend services supporting AI-powered developer tools, including MCP servers, agent skills, and AI assistants. Own service architecture and infrastructure decisions, improving system reliability, maintainability, scalability, and deployment processes. Define and monitor service reliability objectives (SLOs), track error budgets, and prioritize improvements in collaboration with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams. Participate in the team's on-call rotation, investigate production incidents, coordinate resolutions, and develop incident reports, runbooks, and preventive solutions. Manage operational support requests and identify recurring issues that can be addressed through long-term engineering improvements. Design and maintain authentication and authorization systems for AI agents and machine clients, including OAuth applications, scoped tokens, permissions, and secure access management. Establish and maintain comprehensive observability through metrics, distributed tracing, logging, dashboards, and alerting systems. Manage AI agent traffic, implementing rate limits, capacity controls, cost safeguards, and mechanisms to handle dependency failures and unexpected traffic spikes. Collaborate with Platform, SRE, Authentication, Billing, and Edge Functions teams to improve shared infrastructure, release processes, security, and operational practices. Contribute to the development of AI tooling infrastructure, ensuring that reliability, security, and performance remain central to engineering decisions. Requirements At least 5 years of experience building, deploying, and operating production backend services, including participation in on-call rotations. Strong programming skills in TypeScript or Go, with practical working knowledge of the other language. Proven experience designing and maintaining APIs, including versioning, error handling, rate limiting, and backward compatibility. Strong understanding of OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT, and API authorization, with the ability to troubleshoot authentication and permission issues in production environments. Good knowledge of PostgreSQL and relational database systems. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, containerized deployments, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems using metrics, logs, and traces to identify performance bottlenecks and service failures. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and work effectively in globally distributed, asynchronous environments. Adaptability, ownership, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while delivering solutions in fast-paced engineering environments. Deep expertise in at least one of the following areas: APIs and Authentication: Experience designing permission models, token scopes, and OAuth flows for third-party integrations or machine clients, including safely migrating authentication systems without disrupting existing users. Production Operations: Hands-on experience managing production services, participating in on-call rotations, developing alerts and runbooks, implementing SLOs, and improving system reliability. Gateways and Distributed Systems: Experience building or operating proxies, gateways, or distributed services, troubleshooting retries, partial failures, upstream outages, and making appropriate fail-open or fail-closed decisions under degraded conditions. Nice To Have Experience with AI agent tooling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or infrastructure serving AI agents and LLM clients. Experience extracting services from larger codebases while maintaining compatibility with existing integrations. Familiarity with observability platforms such as Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or Logflare, along with practical experience implementing SLOs. Contributions to …

Avec plus de 57 000 collaborateurs à travers le monde, dont 88 % d’ingénieurs, nous sommes un moteur d’innovation dans des secteurs variés tels que l’aéronautique, l’automobile, la défense et les télécommunications. Labellisé "Best Managed Company" en 2026, ALTEN place le développement de ses ingénieurs au cœur de son modèle. Si vous êtes passionné par l’innovation et les défis technologiques, ce poste est fait pour vous ! Description du poste 📍 Localisation : Nantes (44) - déplacements à prévoir 🎯 Secteur : Défense / Aéronautique 💼 Type de contrat : CDI Rejoignez ALTEN, acteur majeur de l’innovation technologique, pour contribuer à des projets stratégiques dans des environnements exigeants. Connaissance des bonnes pratiques en MLOps et déploiement de modèles. Atouts : Intérêt pour les environnements sécurisés et les enjeux d’optimisation. Building Generative AI and Agentic AI applications that retrieve information, reason across multiple steps and interact with tools, APIs and data sources.
items.desc: About This Vacancy As a Data Scientist, you will develop intelligent solutions based on operational, process and asset data. Depending on the project, your work may include: Developing machine learning and predictive models for process optimization, anomaly detection and predictive maintenance. Building Generative AI and Agentic AI applications that retrieve information, reason across multiple steps and interact with tools, APIs and data sources. Designing RAG solutions using structured data, documents, events, embeddings, vector/hybrid search and knowledge graphs. Developing multi-agent and tool-using workflows, including decision logic, memory orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls. Applying process mining, anomaly investigation and root-cause analysis to operational challenges. Exploring new use cases and assessing data availability, data quality and potential business value. Translating analytical results into actionable insights and recommendations together with domain experts and end users. Building reusable AI services and APIs that integrate with operational data and digital products. Productizing prototypes using solid software-engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD and observability. Supporting the deployment and integration of machine learning and AI solutions into production environments. Exploring new developments in Generative AI, machine learning, process mining and knowledge graphs, and translating promising technologies into practical applications. What We Expect From You A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Strong programming skills in Python and PySpark. Experience with libraries and frameworks such as pandas, scikit-learn and TensorFlow. Strong software-engineering fundamentals, including Git, API development, automated testing and maintainable software design. Hands-on experience with Azure, particularly Databricks, for machine learning development and MLOps. Experience developing end-to-end data and machine learning pipelines and working with MLOps principles. Hands-on experience developing Generative AI, RAG and/or Agentic AI applications. What You Can Expect From Us TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to their clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC is operating as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster changing technological world. At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. items.desc: AI Engineer – Internal AI Applications London | Hybrid (2-3 days a week) £80,000 – £90,000 + benefits and bonus Please note: sponsorship is not available We're looking for an AI Engineer who loves building great software for people actually want to use it. Our client is investing heavily in AI, but this isn't a research role and it's not about building AI for the sake of it. The team is focused on creating high-quality internal applications that genuinely improve how people work - taking ideas from an early concept through to something people use every day. You'll work across the full product and engineering lifecycle: understanding the problem, working with users, designing the solution, building it, testing it, launching it and then continuously improving it. AI is at the heart of what the team is doing, with applications incorporating LLMs, RAG, agents, automation and other emerging technologies . But the focus is ultimately on building useful, reliable and well-engineered applications , rather than simply experimenting with models. What you'll be doing You'll be involved in a mixture of new product development and improving existing applications. Build and develop AI-powered internal applications from concept through to production. Work closely with users and stakeholders to understand what they're actually trying to achieve and turn that into practical technology. Design intuitive, reliable applications that make complex tasks simpler and improve the user experience. Develop backend services, APIs and AI workflows using Python and modern software engineering practices . Build user-facing experiences using React and JavaScript/TypeScript . Work with LLMs and technologies such as RAG, agents, tool calling and retrieval to create genuinely useful AI capabilities. Prototype quickly, test ideas with users and iterate based on feedback. Think about the things that make an application production-ready — performance, security, reliability, monitoring, testing and maintainability . Integrate AI applications with existing business systems, data and APIs. Work with the wider engineering and technology teams to deploy and support applications in production. Keep up with developments in AI and identify where new technology can genuinely improve an existing product or create something new. What we're looking for We're particularly interested in engineers who enjoy building things . You don't need to be an AI researcher. You do need to be a strong software engineer who understands how modern AI can be used to build better applications. You'll ideally have: Strong commercial experience building production-quality software applications . Strong Python development skills. Experience with React and JavaScript/TypeScript or similar modern frontend technologies. Practical experience building applications using LLMs and Generative AI . A good understanding of concepts such as RAG, embeddings, agents, tool calling and prompt engineering . Experience taking ideas or prototypes through to production . Good understanding of APIs, databases, cloud platforms and modern software engineering principles. An interest in product and user experience , not just the underlying technology. The ability to take a loosely defined problem and work out what a good technical solution looks like. Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A genuine curiosity about AI and a desire to keep learning as the technology develops.

items.desc: We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. We are developing an agentic AI platform for Cloud Operations: autonomous agents that classify alerts, run operational playbooks, investigate incidents, and progressively refine their own skill library. The platform is organised into two layers — a control plane covering agent registration, skill governance, and human-in-the-loop orchestration, and the agents themselves, which execute on SAP BTP / Kyma. This position lives at the boundary between AI engineering and platform engineering. We are hiring someone who ships agents that operate reliably in production — not proofs of concept. What You'll Build Designing and delivering LLM-driven agents based on skill-routing patterns (LangGraph, Claude API / Anthropic SDK, or comparable stacks) Curating and evolving skill library — self-contained skill definitions with clearly declared tool bindings, trust levels, and confirmation checkpoints Wiring agents into the systems already in production use: ServiceNow, alerting pipelines, Kyma / BTP APIs, and our internal knowledge sources Contributing to shared agent memory and the feedback loops that lift skill quality over time Packaging, deploying, and operating agents on SAP BTP / Kyma Performing Agent testing and ensure Agents are production-ready, including authorizing tests that assess decision quality, not merely whether a task ran to completion Results and Outcomes Delivers agents and skills within an established architecture autonomously Performs comprehensive testing on agents they build Effectively works in accordance with established compliance, security and governance requirements Understands ITSM and ITIL practices in the context of Cloud Operations and has them in mind to ensure Agent RoI, performance and relevance Mindset You focus on efficiency, value add and customer-centric experience You actively communicate and collaborate with AI CoE and relevant teams to ensure compliance and effectiveness of AI Agents developed You document your work — agent designs, skill contracts, and the reasoning behind decisions You reason in terms of boundaries and contracts: what an agent is authorized to do unattended, what it must propose for approval, and what it must never do You embed input from Operation team testing in Agent workflows prior implementation You continuously work to develop a skill definition and initiate data-driven improvements over time Essential What You Bring Strong command of Python (primary language for agent work), with working fluency in TypeScript / Node Practical experience building LLM applications that go well beyond prompt crafting — including tool invocation, structured output handling, and agent control loops A clear grasp of agentic design patterns: skill routing, human-in-the-loop workflows, and state-machine-driven execution Working familiarity with at least one agent framework — LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or an equivalent Comfort with containers and foundational boundaries Strongly Preferred Hands-on exposure to SAP BTP, the CAP framework, or enterprise integration patterns. Familiarity with ITSM and ITIL concepts — ServiceNow, the incident lifecycle, SLA management — since this is the domain in which the agents operate Experience designing how AI systems are evaluated and measured Hands-on experience in Cloud Operations or SRE, with a proficient understanding of what "safe remediation" actually requires A track record of contributing to a shared skill or tool library consumed by multiple agents Meet Your Team As part of SAP’s Global Cloud Operations Cloud Lifecycle Engineering & AI Ops organization, you’ll join a team responsible for developing AI solutions related to operations of SAP’s strategic cloud solutions, such as SAP Business AI Platform, Joule, Business Data Cloud and AI Platform Our mission is evolving beyond traditional cloud operations. Our engineers partner closely with development and platform engineering to create smarter operational workflows, reduce time to resolution, and continuously improve customer experience. items.desc: Description With 49,000 colleagues in over 140 countries, we help organisations make forward-thinking choices about their people, their investments and the risks they face. Joining our Insurance Consulting and Technology (ICT) team, you’ll be part of our impact right from the start. Our ICT team uniquely combines deep insurance consulting expertise with innovative technology. We work across all major actuarial pillars within Property and Casualty ("P&C") - reserving, capital, and pricing - as well as broader areas such as data science, process transformation, risk and regulatory, climate, exposure management, underwriting and claims analytics, involving both client projects and research and product development. On our eight-week internship, you’ll do more than experience our projects – you’ll help us deliver them. At WTW, we believe difference makes us stronger. We want our workforce to reflect the different and varied markets we operate in and to build a culture of inclusivity that makes colleagues feel welcome, valued and empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive work environment throughout our organisation. We embrace all types of diversity. Responsibilities Joining our P&C Insurance team for eight weeks, you’ll build invaluable real-world experience at the heart of our ICT business. These will focus on data-hungry areas such as pricing, claims and operational processes. In This Role, You Will Use data science techniques to analyse data and produce insightful results Present your analysis both internally and to clients Collaborate with colleagues in the UK and globally Build your core technical skills through hands-on experience and team support Deliver data science projects that involve the development, assessment and deployment of machine learning models and writing of high-quality code Learn and apply open-source tools and technology, alongside WTW’s own proprietary insurance technology solutions, used widely by the insurance market Grow through structured early-career training and ongoing learning from subject matter experts in the team This is the perfect opportunity to understand what you could expect if you joined our graduate programme the following year. We have many examples of our interns returning as permanent team members after graduation. Qualifications Requirements: To transform your tomorrow with a WTW internship, you’ll need to be: Highly numerate and analytical, with an interest in drawing value from data and applying your skills to complex and challenging commercial problems Experienced in a coding or data-processing language such as Python, R, SQL or similar Genuinely interested in what’s happening in the world of data science, such as recent advancements in Machine Learning and Generative AI A clear and confident communicator who can make complicated ideas understandable and engaging for a range of audiences Personable, approachable and motivated to work as part of a supportive team Someone with an interest in and aptitude for learning and developing new ideas Comfortable using AI tools to support work, with an understanding of their strengths and limitations. Exposure to concepts such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (“RAG”) and Agentic AI would be beneficial but is not required In your penultimate year of university On course to achieve a 2:1 degree, as well as A-level Mathematics at grade A or above, and at least 136 UCAS points across three A levels, or equivalent qualifications. For example, AAB or A*AC would meet the overall points requirement. Closing Date: 20th November 2026 Workstyles We believe in the value of in-person learning, so you’ll be expected to attend the office five days per week. You’ll be based in either our London or Reigate office. Your office location will be agreed with you during the onboarding process. Regardless of your allocated office, you may be expected to travel to other WTW offices for team or client meetings. The Application Process Stage 1: Apply online and attach your CV Stage 2: Complete an online test and video interview Stage 3: Attend an in-person assessment centre in our London office, where you’ll meet the team. Stage 4: Offer and acceptance Stage 5: Onboarding We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com

Concevoir les solutions dans une logique de réutilisabilité, en contribuant des composants et des patterns réutilisables à la communauté des AI Product Manager & Builders. Adoption, Communauté & Changement Accompagner les directions métiers dans l'adoption des nouvelles solutions, en jouant le rôle de premier point de contact pour les questions techniques, le dépannage et l'accompagnement utilisateurs après déploiement. Organiser et animer des business cafés et des ateliers terrain pour favoriser l'adoption des outils IA, suivre les usages et faire remonter les blocages opérationnels. Participer à l'effort d'acculturation IA – non pas en tant que formateur, mais en tant que praticien qui démontre concrètement ce qui est réalisable et démystifie l'IA pour les équipes opérationnelles. Aider les utilisateurs à prendre en main les outils, suivre les données d'usage et identifier les freins à l'adoption de manière précoce. Suivre les métriques d'usage après déploiement et réinjecter les enseignements dans le cycle d'itération pour maximiser l'impact dans la durée. Documentation & Partage des Connaissances Documenter rigoureusement toutes les solutions développées afin de faciliter la maintenance, la passation et les évolutions ultérieures par d'autres équipes ou futurs AI Builders. Partager les apprentissages, composants réutilisables et bonnes pratiques au sein de la communauté des AI Product Manager & Builders, afin d'accélérer le développement des compétences collectives. Rendre compte au Directeur Transformation & Adoption et maintenir une coordination étroite avec le Data & AI Product Manager tout au long du cycle de vie de chaque cas d'usage. 🏆 Et si on parlait de vous ? Experience working with RESTful API and general microservice-oriented architectures. Solid …

items.desc: Du bist interessiert an der Stelle als AI Engineer / Softwareentwickler für KI-Lösungen (m/w/d) bei tef-dokumentation GmbH ? Auf Instaffo kannst du dich für diesen und weitere Jobs ohne großen Aufwand bewerben. Erstelle dein Profil in unter 2 Minuten und starte den Bewerbungsprozess mit nur wenigen Klicks. Anforderungen Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland erforderlich ist. Sprache: Deutsch - Fließend (C1), Englisch - Fließend (C1) Das bringst du mit: Softwareentwicklung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung mit C#, ASP:NET Core und Vue.js, sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur, APIs, Datenbank und verteilten Systemen KI-gestützte Entwicklung: Erfahrung mit Coding-Agenten und ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie KI durch klare Anforderungen, Kontextinformationen und Coding Guidelines zuverlässig eingesetzt werden kann Technisches Fundament: Sicherer Umgang mit Linux, Docker und Skriptsprachen wie Python oder Bash. Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Azure DevOps, CI/CD und der Modernisierung von Legacy-Systemen Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest selbstständig, denkst analytisch und übernimmst Verantwortung für die technische Konzeption und Umsetzung deiner Lösungen Kommunikation: Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln, arbeitest gerne mit Fachabteilungen zusammen und verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau Ein abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil. Entscheidend sind deine praktischen Fähigkeiten und deine Begeisterung für neue Technologien. Tätigkeiten Deine Aufgaben KI-Lösungen entwickeln und integrieren Du integrierst LLMs, KI-Schnittstellen und intelligente Funktionen in unsere bestehenden Anwendungen auf Basis von ASP.NET und Vue.js. Du entwickelst RAG-Systeme, KI-Agenten und agentische Workflows, die Unternehmenswissen nutzbar machen und Aufgaben automatisiert ausführen. Du entwickelst APIs und Tools, über die KI-Systeme sicher auf Daten, Anwendungen und Geschäftsprozesse zugreifen können. Unternehmensprozesse automatisieren Du identifizierst gemeinsam mit unseren Fachabteilungen Automatisierungspotenziale und entwickelst passende KI-gestützte Lösungen. Du verbindest bestehende Anwendungen, Datenbanken und Unternehmenssysteme zu durchgängigen, intelligenten Prozessen. Du entwickelst unsere Systemlandschaft und Datenstrukturen schrittweise weiter. Softwareentwicklung mit KI voranbringen Du setzt moderne Coding-Agenten und KI-Entwicklungswerkzeuge produktiv ein und etablierst Best Practices für deren Nutzung. Du entwickelst Methoden, um komplexe Entwicklungsaufgaben für KI-Agenten zu spezifizieren, zu strukturieren und zuverlässig umzusetzen. Du entwickelst und optimierst einen AI Agent Harness, der KI-Agenten durch strukturierte Kontextbereitstellung, klare Vorgaben, Tool-Integration und automatisierte Validierung bei der zuverlässigen und kontrollierten Umsetzung komplexer Aufgaben unterstützt. Team Unser IT-Team besteht aus 10 motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Ländern. Das macht unsere Abteilung nicht nur international, sondern auch sehr vielfältig - was wir als große Bereicherung empfinden. Wir legen großen Wert darauf, dass jeder hier eigenverantwortlich arbeiten kann. Das bedeutet, dass jeder die Freiheit hat, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Entscheidungen zu treffen und aktiv an unseren Projekten mitzuwirken. Besonders schätzen wir diese selbstständige Arbeitsweise weil sie uns nicht nur flexibler macht, sondern auch Innovationen fördert. Bei uns herrscht eine offene und vertrauensvolle Atmosphäre, in der sich jeder wohlfühlen und weiterentwickeln kann. Für uns ist es wichtig, dass jeder Einzelne die Möglichkeit hat, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam im Team Großartiges zu erreichen. Über das Unternehmen tef-dokumentation GmbH ist ein besonderes IT- und Software-Haus. Unsere Mission ist die Digitalisierung des kompletten After-Sales-Bereichs, dabei unterstützen wir Hersteller und ihre Handelspartner. Damit im After-Sales-Bereich alles in einer Hand bleibt, konzipieren und erstellen wir Betriebsanleitungen, Handbücher, Schulungsunterlagen und vieles mehr. Klicke auf "Bewerben" für Details zu den Benefits, dem Team und dem Bewerbungsprozess.

items.desc: LAIF sviluppa soluzioni software Data & AI driven, su misura per le aziende, sia PMI che enterprise. Realizziamo applicazioni web, data platform, algoritmi di matematica applicata. Siamo un team giovane e tecnico, e lavoriamo a stretto contatto con i clienti dall'analisi dei requisiti fino al rilascio in produzione. Per il potenziamento del team Data & AI cerchiamo un/una Data & AI Engineer (profilo Junior o Mid). La risorsa lavorerà su progetti di dati e AI per i nostri clienti, affiancata da figure senior, e avrà il compito di costruire soluzioni scalabili e robuste. In particolare, si occuperà di: Raccogliere i requisiti dati del cliente, capendo quali fonti sono disponibili, la loro qualità e il loro volume. Sviluppare flussi di ingestion e trasformazione dati (ELT/ETL) efficienti, con codice di qualità e performance sotto controllo. Sviluppare modelli dati per lo storage e la presentazione del dato, curandone consistenza e tempi di consumo. Progettare e mettere in produzione soluzioni di AI generativa (LLM, RAG, agenti) integrate nei dati e nelle applicazioni del cliente. Costruire controlli sulla qualità del dato e sulla qualità delle risposte delle soluzioni AI. Lavorare sullo stack LAIF e dentro gli stack e i processi dei clienti (cloud, CI/CD, code review, infrastruttura come codice). Documentare le scelte architetturali e il funzionamento di quanto sviluppato. Desideriamo entrare in contatto con risorse in possesso dei seguenti requisiti Laurea in informatica, ingegneria o discipline correlate. Ottima conoscenza dell'italiano e dell'inglese (si lavora anche in inglese con team internazionali). Ottima capacità di lavorare in team e di organizzare il proprio lavoro. Buona conoscenza di SQL e dei principali database relazionali. Buona conoscenza di Python e dei principali pacchetti per la manipolazione del dato (pandas, SQLAlchemy). Buona conoscenza dei principi di modellazione e trasformazione del dato. Buona conoscenza di Git e di Docker. Comprensione dei concetti di AI generativa (LLM, prompting, embedding, RAG) e nozioni di base di Machine Learning (metriche di valutazione, feature engineering). Si richiedono i concetti, non l'addestramento di modelli. Costituiscono un plus Esperienza con data warehouse e strumenti ELT moderni (Snowflake, dbt). Esperienza con orchestratori di flussi (Airflow, AWS Step Functions, Glue). Esperienza con CI/CD (GitHub Actions) e infrastruttura come codice (Terraform, AWS CDK). Esperienza con almeno uno dei principali cloud provider (preferibilmente AWS). Esperienza con API di LLM (Claude, Amazon Bedrock), sviluppo di soluzioni RAG e database vettoriali (pgvector). Abitudine a lavorare con assistenti AI per lo sviluppo (es. Claude Code). Conoscenza di framework backend Python (FastAPI) e di PostgreSQL. Esperienza con ERP o fonti dati aziendali e con strumenti di data catalog e data quality. Conoscenza di Spark, Kafka o altre tecnologie Apache. Conoscenza di design pattern e passione per il Clean Code. Cosa offriamo Progetti reali di dati e AI, per clienti e settori diversi, con affiancamento di figure senior. Percorso di crescita su Data Engineering e AI Engineering. Un gruppo di lavoro giovane, dinamico, attento alla formazione e alla crescite condivisa Un contratto a tempo indeterminato in smart working, con ritrovo saltuario presso gli uffici di Bologna

items.title: KI Solution Architekt
items.card: Aufgaben Als technischer Architekt übernimmst du die Konzeption und Steuerung unserer Kundenprojekte: Company LLM & RAG-Architektur: Konzeption DSGVO-/DSG-konformer, firmeninterner LLM-Lösungen, Aufbau von Retrieval-Systemen (Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken, Chunking-Strategien) und Einschätzung, wann lokale, selbst-gehostete Modelle nötig sind. KI-Agenten, Automatisierung, Voice Agents & SaaS: Architektur autonomer
items.desc: KI-Solution-Architekt 50-100% (m/w/d) – RAG, Company LLM & Systemarchitektur Arbeitsort : 100% Remote (Schweiz / DACH-Region) Pensum : 50% – 100% (Flexible Zeiteinteilung) Vergütung : Pro Projekt / prozentual am Projektumsatz (Attraktives, leistungsbasiertes Modell) Branche : Agentur für Künstliche Intelligenz, Prozessautomatisierung & SaaS Über uns Wir sind eine dynamisch wachsende Agentur im Bereich KI-Lösungen, Automationen und SaaS. Wir arbeiten mit Agenturen, Beratern und Dienstleistern zusammen, die bereit sind, in skalierbare Systeme und echtes Wachstum zu investieren. Unser Fokus liegt auf hochpreisigen Agenturdienstleistungen, messbaren Ergebnissen und einem leistungsorientierten Umfeld. Zur Verstärkung unseres Umsetzung Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Architekten, der gemeinsam mit uns den Markt technisch prägt. Deine Rolle & Aufgaben Als technischer Architekt übernimmst du die Konzeption und Steuerung unserer Kundenprojekte: Company LLM & RAG-Architektur: Konzeption DSGVO-/DSG-konformer, firmeninterner LLM-Lösungen, Aufbau von Retrieval-Systemen (Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken, Chunking-Strategien) und Einschätzung, wann lokale, selbst-gehostete Modelle nötig sind. KI-Agenten, Automatisierung, Voice Agents & SaaS: Architektur autonomer Agenten-Systeme, Design deterministischer Workflows sowie technische Konzeption von Voice Agents und SaaS-Lösungen (CRM/ERP), gesteuert über Agentic-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Codex. Das bringst du mit Wir suchen keine perfekten Lebensläufe – sondern Leute mit Substanz, Biss und Anspruch. Technischer Stack: Grundkenntnisse in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Node.js und React - du verstehst die Architektur hinter unseren Projekten und kannst beurteilen, ob von KI-Agenten generierter Code sauber, sicher und funktionsfähig ist. Qualitätssicherung bei KI-Agenten: Du erkennst, wenn ein Agent sich in Endlosschleifen verfängt, halluziniert oder ineffizient arbeitet (z. B. unnötig hoher Token-/Ressourcenverbrauch), und kannst solche Fehlerquellen identifizieren und korrigieren. Nachweisbare Substanz: Du hast bereits reale Projekte gebaut oder mitverantwortet – kein Bootcamp-Wissen ohne Praxis, sondern belegbare Umsetzungskompetenz. Prozessverständnis: Du kannst Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden erfassen und einschätzen, wo eine technische Lösung wirklich Mehrwert bringt. Kommunikation: Klare, fehlerfreie Kommunikation auf Deutsch und ein professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Geschäftskunden. Mindset: Hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, Zielorientierung und die nötige Eigenverantwortung für eigenständiges Arbeiten an Projekten. Interesse: Begeisterung für die Themen Data Science, RAG, lokale LLMs und digitales Wachstum. Hintergrund: Erfahrung in Data Science, RAG-Architektur oder KI-Agenten-Entwicklung ist Voraussetzung - bitte reale Referenzprojekte bei der Bewerbung mitschicken, diese sind für uns ausschlaggebend. Vergütung & Entwicklung Starker Verdienst : Vergütung pro Projekt bzw. prozentual am Projektumsatz (leistungsbasiert und nach oben offen). Flexibilität : Flexible Arbeitszeiten bei einem Pensum von 50–100% und ortsunabhängiges Arbeiten (100% Remote). Karriereleiter : Klare Aufstiegschancen (vom Projekt-Architekt → Senior-Architekt → Leiter der IT). Support : Strukturierte Einarbeitung, laufender Austausch und direkter Zugang zu einem High-Performance-Umfeld. Extras : Attraktive Incentives und exklusive Team Reisen. Deine Perspektive Du arbeitest in einem Markt mit enormem Zukunft Wachstum (KI & Automationen) und bekommst die Chance, dir langfristig eine echte Karriere als technischer Kopf unserer Agentur aufzubauen. Bei uns entscheidet deine Leistung – nicht dein Lebenslauf. So bewirbst du dich . Der Prozess ist bewusst einfach gehalten! Kurze Bewerbung : Sende uns deine Daten und 2–3 reale Referenzprojekte (ein klassischer Lebenslauf ist für den ersten Schritt nicht zwingend erforderlich). Online-Gespräch : Wir lernen uns in einem kurzen, persönlichen Videocall kennen. Probeprojekt : Bei beidseitiger Eignung startest du mit einem bezahlten Probeprojekt, bevor es in die laufende Zusammenarbeit geht. Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht!

Neugier für Agentic AI, AI-gestützte Entwicklungstools und neue Arbeitsweisen im Software-Development-Lifecycle Eine teamorientierte, strukturierte und hands-on Persönlichkeit mit professionellem Auftreten, Freude am Kundenkontakt sowie sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen Das sind unsere Benefits für dich Bonus für alle gleich: Bonus gibt es bei uns für alle Mitarbeitende – und verteilt wird er proportional gleichmässig Entwicklung & Perspektive: Persönliche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten basierend auf deinen Karrierevorstellungen Wissen teilen und voneinander lernen: Das monatliche ERFA, kurz für Erfahrungsaustausch, ist unsere interne Konferenz, an der wir Wissen, Erfahrungen und neue Ideen miteinander teilen. Weitere interne Wissensformate garantieren Know-How Austausch und frische Ideen Mehr Zeit für dich: Bei uns profitierst du von sechs Wochen Ferien und hast zusätzlich die Möglichkeit, unbezahlten Urlaub zu nehmen Das sind die Hard Facts Dein Arbeitsort ist vor Ort beim Kunden in der Deutschschweiz (Zürich, Luzern, Basel, Bern, St. Gallen) Pensum: 80% oder mehr Dieses Stelleninserat umschreibt ein Szenario, das dich in einem Projekt erwarten könnte. Wir suchen Talente, die für verschiedene Themen und Technologien offen sind. «We hire for attitude and train for skills» – Wir erwarten nicht, dass Du bereits mehrjährige Berufserfahrung mitbringst. Vielmehr wollen wir Dich gezielt fördern. Bist du technisch affin und hast Freude an Kundenkontakt und Beratung? Magst Du es technisch hands-on zu arbeiten? Dann ist ipt genau die richtige Firma! Wir freuen uns schon jetzt auf deine Bewerbung!

items.desc: Department: Software Solutions Location: Madrid, Spain Description Based in Madrid, you will contribute to the development of Aurora’s growing suite of software products, used by leading companies across the energy sector. You will collaborate with multiple Aurora teams to improve the product and increase adoption. You will work with large datasets and support the deployment of our services across European regions. You will develop the skillset to step into the role of an Associate Product Manager. Successful candidates will combine a passion for global energy transformation with a strong interest in product management and advanced data analytics. They will work in a dynamic, intellectually stimulating, demanding and collaborative environment. They will gain a deep understanding of the energy industry and product management skills, working at the forefront of the global energy transformation. The position suits a recent graduate of a bachelor’s or master’s degree (Analyst), or a person with 1–2 years of relevant professional experience (Senior Analyst). Key Responsibilities Work with a cross-functional team of highly skilled software engineers, modelers, and research analysts in continuous product delivery. Gather client feedback, support to answer client questions, and help them get the most value from our software and services. Test our products to ensure we deliver high quality and robust software to our clients. Apply advanced analytics techniques to deliver insights from energy modelling and other complex datasets. Become a subject matter expert for the products you work with, in areas such as energy modelling, renewables and batteries. Work with the Product Manager to maintain and update a prioritized product backlog using structured product management methodologies. Assist the Product Manager in creating a product roadmap. Measure, analyze and report on key product metrics such as adoption, engagement, and retention. Project manage the new feature delivery, write product requirements. Collaborate with other Product Analysts and Managers to share best practices and expand the culture of Product Management. Required Attributes Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Bachelor’s degree from a leading university and evidence of strong academic performance in a quantitative subject. Experience with at least one programming language, e.g. Python, R, etc. The ability to collect, analyze and interpret complex quantitative data and information. Strong interest in energy and power markets. Evidence of strong performance in team-oriented environments. Strong communication skills and the ability to adapt your communication style for technical and non-technical audiences. Self-starter with strong ownership: take initiative, stay on top of priorities without prompting, and consistently deliver on deadlines. What We Offer Some of the benefits we include are: Health & Dental Insurance Pluxee Restaurant Card Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Flexible Retribution Parental Leave At AER, we are committed to offering flexibility in the way we work. Most of our roles are hybrid with a mix of in-office/home working and potentially adjustable working hours. Let’s discuss what works for you and AER during the interview process. The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavourable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy, and maternity. To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a versatile and highly skilled Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will combine strong technical abilities with excellent communication skills, working directly with customers to ensure they maximize the value of HappyRobot’s AI platform. You will be involved in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing support, while also contributing to product development and innovation. Full-Stack Development – Utilize React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python to develop robust applications and tools. Cross-Functional Collaboration – Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to deliver tailored solutions. Ability to manage APIs and integrate with third-party systems. Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines. Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. Why join us? If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. Craftsmanship Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching. We are “majos” Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. Urgency with Focus Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. items.desc: AlphaPrompt ist ein Münchner B2B-Software-Startup für die institutionelle Immobilienwirtschaft. Wir bauen die Intelligente Immobilienakte: einen intelligenten Datenraum, der Dokumente automatisch klassifiziert, ausliest und mit nachvollziehbaren Quellen strukturiert, und einen Agentic Workspace, in dem KI-Agenten Prüfungen und Workflows übernehmen – von Mietverträgen über Nebenkostenabrechnungen bis zur Übergabe in Drittsysteme. Unsere Kunden sind Asset- und Property-Manager im DACH-Raum, die täglich damit arbeiten. Aufgaben Deine Rolle Du bist die technische Person, die unsere Kunden kennen. Du bringst neue Kunden und Objekte auf die Plattform, konfigurierst Datenräume und Agenten-Workflows für ihren Anwendungsfall, stimmst Ergebnisse mit ihnen ab und klärst Rückfragen – ohne Umweg über ein Support-Team. Wo die Plattform nicht reicht, baust du selbst: Anbindungen, Importe, Konfigurationen, kleinere Features und die Integration der KI-Funktionen unseres AI-Teams. Und weil du siehst, was Kunden immer wieder brauchen, machst du aus Einzellösungen Standard im Produkt. Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und unserem Lead-Entwickler zusammen. Was du bei uns machst Kunden-Onboarding verantworten: Datenräume aufsetzen, Dokumente einspielen, Metadaten und Workflows konfigurieren – und das Setup Schritt für Schritt automatisieren. In Terminen mit Asset- und Property-Managern Anforderungen aufnehmen, Ergebnisse zeigen und entscheiden, was konfiguriert, gebaut oder abgelehnt wird. Selbst über den ganzen Stack bauen – Backend in Python, Frontend in React: Importe, Exporte, Anbindungen an Drittsysteme wie SharePoint, kundenspezifische Erweiterungen. KI-Agenten unseres AI-Teams beim Kunden in Betrieb nehmen und ihre Ergebnisse an echten deutschen Dokumenten prüfen: Mietverträge, Nebenkostenabrechnungen, Wartungsprotokolle. Kundenfeedback ins Produkt zurückspielen: Muster erkennen, sauber beschreiben und Wiederkehrendes selbst zum Standard-Feature machen. Qualifikation Was du mitbringst Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1/C2) in Wort und Schrift – nicht verhandelbar. Dazu gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit im Team. Wohnsitz in Deutschland und Arbeitsplatz München im Office . Zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung an einem Produkt, idealerweise SaaS/B2B. Full-Stack mit Schwerpunkt Backend (Python) – und du greifst auch ins Frontend (React/TypeScript), statt einen Bogen darum zu machen. Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Kunden oder Fachbereichen – etwa als Solutions Engineer, Implementierungs- oder Technical Consultant oder Entwickler mit Kundenkontakt. Du erklärst Technik so, dass ein Asset Manager sie versteht, und hältst einen Termin auch allein. Produktverständnis und Startup-Drive: Du willst wissen, wofür ein Feature da ist, nimmst dir Themen eigenständig und ziehst sie durch – schnell, pragmatisch, sauber. Grundverständnis für LLM-basierte Anwendungen – du musst keine Agenten bauen, aber nachvollziehen und integrieren können, was das AI-Team gebaut hat Benefits Was wir bieten Ein Produkt, das bei institutionellen Kunden im Einsatz ist – du siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit beim Kunden bewirkt. Kurze Wege: direkt mit den Gründern und dem Lead-Entwickler; Entscheidungen fallen im Raum. KI als Kern des Produkts, nicht als Buzzword – und echten Einfluss auf die Roadmap, weil du am nächsten am Kunden bist. Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag, Büro in München. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

items.desc: Bij Protime helpen we organisaties in heel Europa om tijd slimmer en betekenisvoller te beheren. Met onze Workforce Management-oplossingen geven we bedrijven de tools om efficiënter te werken, compliant te blijven en het volledige potentieel van hun medewerkers te benutten. Ons motto? Make time valuable. Onze ambitie? Uitgroeien tot dé nummer 1 in Workforce Management in Europa. Workforce Management omvat alles rond werktijd: plannen, registreren en correct verwerken tot in de payroll. Planning is daarin de stap vooraan: de juiste mensen, met de juiste skills, op het juiste moment op de juiste plaats . Wat gepland is, vloeit door naar tijdsregistratie en payroll, en daarom is planning een kernstuk van ons WFM-aanbod. Binnen onze gevestigde WFM-oplossing is myProtime Planning een nieuwe toevoeging die volop groeit. We willen het verder uitbouwen en sterker in de markt zetten. Daarvoor zoeken we iemand die zich wil vastbijten in de complexiteit van planning in Europa en ons helpt de juiste keuzes te maken. Zo bouw je mee aan het succes van myProtime Planning bij klanten. Daar kom jij in beeld! Wat doe je als Business Analyst Planning? Jouw missie: Protime helpen om sterke, onderbouwde productbeslissingen te nemen voor myProtime Planning, door duidelijkheid, context en bewijs te brengen. Je beweegt je vooral in de problem space: hoe plannen organisaties vandaag, waar lopen ze vast, en wat vraagt de wetgeving in de verschillende Europese landen? Je brengt daar structuur in en zorgt dat we de juiste problemen aanpakken, nog vóór we oplossingen bouwen. Dat doe je nooit alleen. Je werkt elke dag samen met Product Management, Portfolio Managers, Product Owners, UX en engineering. Daarnaast zoek je actief het gesprek met klanten, sales, support en legal. Je maakt deel uit van het Planning-team en rapporteert aan de Product Manager Planning. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Strategic Discovery Je verkent hoe organisaties in Europa plannen en wat ze nodig hebben. Denk aan retail, waar de bezetting de drukte volgt, of aan productie en logistiek, waar bedrijven 24/7 draaien met vaste ploegenroosters. Je verdiept je in de arbeidsregels die een planning raken, zoals rusttijden, maximale arbeidsduur, toeslagen en sectorafspraken, en in GDPR en data-ethiek. Je combineert desk research met interviews, en haalt eruit wat schaalbaar is over landen heen en wat echt landgebonden is. Problem Framing Je zet verspreide signalen van klanten, sales, consultants en support om in duidelijke, testbare probleemstellingen voor planning. Je herkent welk planningsprobleem een klant echt heeft. Een flexibele bezetting en ploegenwerk zijn verschillende problemen, met elk hun eigen aanpak. Je definieert context, scope, gebruikers, aannames, risico's en succescriteria. Je zoekt patronen over klanten, sectoren en landen heen, zodat we niet voor één klant of één land bouwen. Synthesis & Evidence-Based Decision Support Je scheidt feiten van hypotheses, en ruis van echte inzichten. Je bouwt en onderhoudt de opportunity backlog van myProtime Planning, decision logs en de rationale achter keuzes. Je helpt lichte experimenten en validaties op te zetten. Met je analyses ondersteun je de keuzes van Product Management en Portfolio Management over markten, prioriteiten en de roadmap van myProtime Planning, en help je het product in de markt te zetten. Samen met hen en met sales maak je duidelijk voor welke klanten en welke planningsproblemen onze oplossing het verschil maakt. Collaboration & Shaping Je faciliteert discoveryworkshops, zoals journey mapping, story mapping, event storming en opportunity mapping. Je werkt samen met Product Owners, architecten en engineers aan coherente MVP's. Ook als de Product Owner de lead neemt in het solution design, blijf je mee aan tafel. Omdat planning en tijdsregistratie samenhangen, werk je nauw samen met de teams van Time & Attendance, zodat roosters, afwezigheden en contracten op elkaar aansluiten. Onze andere producten, Strobbo en Checks, raken eveneens aan het planningsdomein. Je werkt er niet zelf aan, maar je deelt actief kennis over planning over de producten heen, zodat we van elkaar leren. Jij en AI We bouwen bij Protime aan een agentic manier van werken, waarin AI mee onderzoek doet, informatie samenbrengt en context opbouwt. Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn, maar ervaring is een mooie meerwaarde. Wat we wel vragen: je gelooft dat AI een versneller kan zijn om onderzoek te doen, en om de context te creëren waarmee straks iedereen in het team betere beslissingen neemt. En je hebt zin om dat mee vorm te geven. Jouw skills en mindset om te starten bij Protime We zoeken iemand die floreert in complexiteit en plezier haalt uit structuur brengen. Een strategisch denker met sterke analytische vaardigheden en uitstekende communicatie. Ervaring Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in Business Analysis, Product Discovery of Service Design. Ervaring met planning, WFM, HR Tech, payroll of andere gereguleerde omgevingen is een plus. …

items.desc: Product Owner — Bucharest Location: Bucharest (on-site) · Team: Product · Reports to: Head of Product · Contract: permanent employment contract, full-time About EC Markets and the role EC Markets is an FCA-regulated FX and CFD brokerage. Working knowledge of FCA Consumer Duty. CSPO, PSPO or equivalent certification. User research and UX collaboration. Experience with AI-powered product features. items.desc: Join our team at Sinch as a Data Engineer III, where you'll help design, build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines across our global product portfolio. You'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies, embrace AI-assisted development, and explore emerging innovations such as AI agents, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation to help shape the future of data engineering at Sinch. We're looking for someone with a solid foundation in SQL, Python, and ETL/ELT, who enjoys solving complex challenges and building scalable, reliable data solutions. We value curiosity, a collaborative mindset, and an interest in exploring how AI-powered development tools, LLMs, and AI agents can simplify engineering tasks, improve productivity, and create new opportunities for automation across our data platforms. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful initiatives in a rapidly growing global business, develop your technical expertise, and experiment with new approaches to building and operating modern data solutions. Contribute to high-impact data engineering initiatives, delivering reliable and scalable solutions that create value for our customers and business. Support data integration efforts across diverse platforms and products, enabling seamless and efficient data movement throughout Sinch. Build, optimize, monitor, and maintain data pipelines, ensuring high standards of performance, quality, and reliability. Identify opportunities for improvement in our data pipelines, development processes, and engineering practices. Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high code quality. Explore emerging AI technologies, including AI agents and agentic workflows, to support automation, simplify data operations, and improve engineering efficiency. Collaborate on data engineering projects, taking ownership of assigned tasks and contributing to their successful delivery. Continuously learn and experiment with modern data engineering technologies, sharing knowledge and contributing to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. REQUIREMENTS We believe you bring solid expertise in diverse data landscapes, coupled with proficiency in Informatica for the development and governance of pipelines. Your essential experience with virtualization tools, as well as your demonstrated capability in real-time data processing and analytics sets you apart. As an effective communicator, you effortlessly bridge the technical and business sectors. Your dedication to continual learning ensures that you stay current of industry trends and eagerly adopt new technologies. Proficient in software development with expertise in Python, Spark, Git, CI/CD, and Docker. Skilled in using SQL for data querying and ETL/ELT development. Experience in structuring and storing large volumes of data in data lakes and warehouses. Capable of fixing and optimizing data pipelines for enhanced performance and reliability. Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools like Airflow, Dagster, and experience using Databricks. Cloud experience in AWS or GCP. Knowledgeable about various data architectures such as Data Lake, Data Mesh, and Data Fabric. items.desc: THE OPPORTUNITY The way B2B revenue teams operate is fundamentally reshaped by AI and most organizations haven't caught up yet. The ones that move now won't just be more efficient; they'll see things their competitors can't see, act on signals others miss, and compound that advantage quarter after quarter. We're building a Revenue Operations function designed for this moment. Not a back-office reporting team, but an operational intelligence engine that sits at the heart of how we generate, convert, and grow revenue. This role is central to that ambition. As our AI-Enabled Revenue Operations Specialist, you will own three interconnected missions: Revenue Insights & Reporting: Build AI-enhanced analytics across the full funnel — pipeline health, conversion dynamics, QBR narratives, revenue forecasting — turning fragmented data into decisions that leadership and frontline teams act on weekly, not quarterly.
