Job Description: 
 En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ? 
 Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage. 
 Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium. 
 Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année. 
 Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - IA & Transformation Digital Supply Chain (all gender) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Montoir de Bretagne. 
 Cette mission débutera en janvier 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois. 
 Découvrez le site en vidéo : 
 Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo et la Présentation du site de Montoir de Bretagne 
 Tâches et responsabilités : 
 Vous rejoignez une équipe de 90 personnes au sein du département Planification, Production Control et Logistique en charge de la gestion globale des flux, de l'approvisionnement des composants à la livraison des produits finis, en passant par l'optimisation des plannings de fabrication et du niveau des stocks.
 Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes : 
 Audit & Identification des Use Cases : Immersion auprès des équipes métiers pour cartographier les irritants, les tâches répétitives et les flux d'informations lourds (RAG/Support documentaire, automatisation de comptes-rendus/e-mails, consolidation de données). 
 Prototypage & Développement (POC) : Conception et développement de solutions d'IA applicatives et pragmatiques (scripts Python, intégration dans l'environnement Microsoft Azure / M365 / Copilot Studio, agents IA). 
 Déploiement Transversal : Pilotage de l'intégration des outils validés à travers les 7 services du département pour garantir une adoption fluide. 
 Mesure du ROI & Conduite du Changement : Évaluation précise des gains de temps générés (indicateurs de performance/KPIs) et accompagnement des utilisateurs dans l'appropriation des nouveaux outils 
 Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formati on 
 Gestion de projet IA de bout en bout : Capacité à cadrer un besoin métier, élaborer un cahier des charges fonctionnel, concevoir une solution technique et mesurer son apport de valeur (KPI / ROI).
 Ingénierie applicative & intégration de technologies émergentes : Maîtrise opérationnelle du prototypage d'outils Data/IA (Python, architecture Azure/Copilot) appliqués à des environnements industriels complexes.
 Conduite du changement & transformation digitale : Aptitude à vulgariser des notions technologiques avancées, à accompagner des profils pluridisciplinaires et à piloter l'adoption de nouveaux usages digitaux.
 Analyse des flux & performance logistique : Compréhension approfondie des enjeux d'optimisation de la chaîne logistique et de la gestion de production au sein de l'aéronautique.
 Parlons de VOUS ! 
 Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master 2 ou dernière année d’École d’Ingénieurs ou de Commerce) avec une spécialisation en Intelligence Artificielle, Data Science, Génie Industriel ou Informatique. 
 Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes : 
 Compréhension des principes de gouvernance des données et d'analyse de performance (ROI, KPI). 
 Développement & Scripting : Maîtrise de Python appliquée au traitement de données ou au développement de prototypes.
 Savoir être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication,Capacité d'adaptation 
 Anglais : B1 
 Français : courant 
 Parlons de NOUS ! 
 Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est : 
 Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux, 
 Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale, 
 Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain. 
 Notre processus de sélection 
 Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Human and Organisational Factors (HOF) Specialist in Robotics (f/m) to join our HOF Center of Expertise based in Toulouse, France . 
 You will join a passionate team bringing HOF and User-Centered Design principles to robotics and industrial machinery. 
 In this role, you will contribute to production efficiency, safety, and operator health while driving the growth of human factors across Airbus manufacturing sites. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 
 Your challenges: 
 Lead human factors studies (task analysis, usability testing, heuristic evaluations) for robotics and industrial machines. 
 De-risk solutions regarding human-robot interaction, workload, situation awareness, display logic, and industrial HMIs. 
 Identify HOF risks, formulate actionable design recommendations, and guide their implementation. 
 Deliver high-quality reports and presentations on findings to multidisciplinary engineering teams. 
 Develop and deliver HOF/HRI guidance, awareness sessions, and training materials for production sites. 
 Your boarding pass: 
 Background in Human Factors, Cognitive Ergonomics, Cognitive Psychology, HCI, or equivalent. At least 10 years of HOF professional experience in highly regulated industries (aviation, rail, nuclear, military). 
 Strong background in qualitative/quantitative research methods and industry HOF/HMI standards. 
 Proven ability to prepare/deliver HOF training and confidently justify technical positions. 
 Seamless collaboration with UX designers and robotics engineers across Agile and Waterfall frameworks. 
 Advanced level in English is required; French, Spanish, or German is a plus. 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and Airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair Certification department based in Toulouse, France. 
 You will be part of a team providing airworthiness approval for In-Service repair solutions. 
 You will be part of the airworthiness and certification team, integrated into the Customer Care Center, your mission is to ensure the repair solutions provided to to our customers is compliant to the regulations, restores the aircraft airworthiness to allow the operator to bring their aircraft back to an airworthy condition after an event. 
 Your challenges: 
 You will work in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide. To ensure continuous support, we operate in a "follow the sun" approach with two offshore teams: 
 Mobile (USA) 
 Bangalore (India) 
 Working hours: After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation. 
 Your main tasks and responsibilities: 
 Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF) and Flight Condition Documents (FCD). 
 Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams, and other airworthiness departments. 
 Act on request as an airworthiness specialist in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations. 
 This position is an opportunity to work on all Airbus civil programs and all ATA chapters, allowing you to develop multi-skills. Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge and enlarge your network within the company. 
 Your boarding pass: 
 You are educated to a degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline. 
 You have an advanced level in English. 
 You possess structure and / or systems skills alongside a good general knowledge in aeronautics. 
 You bring at least 10 years of successful background within a Design Office or Certification and Airworthiness department, with familiarity in configuration management considered an advantage. 
 You are a collaborative team player, reactive, and curious.

items.desc:
Lieu : Rennes, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
En nous rejoignant à Rennes, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée 
 Vous intégrez notre pôle d'Excellence Cyber sur notre site de Rennes. Ce pôle contribue à la protection du contrôle aérien militaire Français et à la lutte informatique défensive. 
 A ce titre, le service répond aux besoins de ses clients en matière de lutte contre les cyber menaces, notamment en accompagnant les opérationnels sur le développement de solutions de cyberdéfense.
 Au sein du Centre de Compétences Cybersécurité de Thales, vous intégrez le service d'Intégration/ Validation / Soutien Cyber regroupant les ingénieurs et responsables d'intégration, Vérification et Qualification, vous participez à des projets de développement de produits et systèmes de cybersécurité souveraines. Vous évoluez dans un environnement technique exigeant, au cœur des activités de validation et de qualification des solutions développées. 
 Dans le cadre de l'amélioration de ses processus de développement et de qualification, notre organisation souhaite étudier, expérimenter et mettre en production une plateforme d'intelligence artificielle générative dédiée aux activités d'ingénierie. 
 Cette plateforme permettra aux développeurs et intégrateurs de bénéficier des capacités des grands modèles de langage (LLM) tel que l'IA agentique afin d'implémenter des cas d'usage. 
 Ce stage est consacré à l'étude comparative, la sécurisation et l'industrialisation d'une plateforme d'intelligence artificielle pour le développement et l'IVQ de produits et solutions de cybersécurité. 
 L'objectif est de concevoir, sélectionner, sécuriser et industrialiser une solution d'intelligence artificielle locale capable d'assister les développeurs/intégrateurs et de contribuer à l'automatisation de leurs activités d'ingénierie. 
 Dans ce contexte, vos missions sont les suivantes : 
 Réaliser une étude comparative des solutions d'IA spécialisées dans le développement logiciel. 
 Evaluer leurs performances, leurs capacités fonctionnelles et leurs contraintes d'exploitation sur une infrastructure GPU locale. 
 Concevoir une architecture sécurisée permettant l'intégration avec les outils du système d'information. 
 Étudier et expérimente r la génération automatisée de cahiers de tests et de scripts de validation à partir d'exigences documentaires. 
 Déployer une plateforme opérationnelle intégrée aux chaînes GitLab CI/CD. 
 Supporter la mise en œuvre de cas d'usage. 
 Votre profil 
 Votre priorité est de développer vos compétences techniques tout en contribuant à des projets concrets au service des utilisateurs ? 
 Vous avez envie de développer et d'intégrer des solutions de cybersécurité ? 
 Vous êtes en école d’ingénieur, master ou équivalent dans un domaine généraliste avec une spécialisation en cybersécurité et vous disposez des compétences suivantes : 
 Maitrise des environnements Linux ; 
 Maitrise des LLM (intégration et utilisation), des modèles Open-weight et des architectures RAG ; 
 Connaissances en programmation (Python et Golang) et sur les outils Git et GitLab ; 
 Connaissances en conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes) ; 
 Notions d'infrastructure GPU et de calcul haute performance ; 
 Connaissances en Cybersécurité ; 
 Connaissances des processus de développement et de tests logiciels ; 
 Intérêt pour les outils d'automatisation des tests et des pipelines CI/CD. 
 Autonomie, esprit d'analyse, rigueur et organisation sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnaît ? 
 Alors ce stage est fait pour vous ! 
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études.Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 …

 Hands-on laboratory work, including RF tuning and testing using network analysers, spectrum analysers and other RF test equipment

 Problem-solving, debugging and failure analysis skills with a solid understanding of core engineering principles

items.desc:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands 
 Job Title: AI Platform Engineer 
 Locatie: Hengelo – Hybride
 Talen: Nederlands & Engels
 Dienstverband: Fulltime
 Role Overview 
 Ben jij een DevOps of Platform Engineer die de sprong wil maken naar de wereld van Generative AI, binnen een van de meest hoogbeveiligde software-omgevingen van Nederland?
 Bij Thales Nederland bouwen we in Hengelo aan onze eigen geavanceerde AI-ecosystemen die draaien in volledig air-gapped infrastructuren . Als AI Platform Engineer word jij de spin in het web die ervoor zorgt dat onze software engineers en systemen veilig gebruik kunnen maken van lokale taalmodellen, geavanceerde multi-agent netwerken en systemen voor contextgebaseerde informatie-ophaling. Omdat we geen gebruik kunnen maken van publieke cloud-API's, bouwen, hosten en beheren we alles zélf on-premise op onze eigen high-performance GPU-clusters.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Beheer van AI-Containerapplicaties: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het deployen, updaten en onderhouden van cruciale AI-hulpprogramma's en developer-tools binnen de on-premise container-orkestratieplatforms. Je zorgt voor optimale performance, resource-allocatie en hoge beschikbaarheid voor de development teams.
 Air-Gapped RAG & Codebase Infrastructure: Je bouwt en onderhoudt de on-premise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) infrastructuur. Je zorgt dat applicaties via lokale data-pijplijnen, tekst-segmentatie (chunking) en vector-indexering veilig en razendsnel context kunnen ophalen uit onze interne codebases.
 On-Premise Model Routing & Lifecycle: Je richt de tooling in voor lokale model-serving en helpt bij het bouwen van een flexibele routing-laag. Hierdoor kunnen applicaties binnen het afgesloten netwerk dynamisch schakelen tussen verschillende lokale modellen op basis van de complexiteit van de specifieke taak.
 Agent Orchestration & Tooling: Je ondersteunt het opzetten van lokale raamwerken voor multi-agent systemen (zoals gespecialiseerde code-, architectuur- en debugging-agents). Je helpt bij het integreren van lokale geheugensystemen en interfaces waarmee agents externe tools kunnen aanroepen.
 Air-Gapped Observability: Je implementeert monitoring- en tracing-dashboards die volledig lokaal binnen het netwerk draaien. Je meet hiermee het token-verbruik, de verwerkingstijd (latency) en infrastructuurkosten per team of gebruiker, zonder dat er data naar buiten lekt.
 Strikte AI Safety & Security Rails: Samen met onze security-experts implementeer je harde vangrails en beveiligingsinfrastructuren om kwaadwillige invoer (prompt-injecties) te voorkomen en te garanderen dat agents zich strikt houden aan datacompartimentering en autorisatieniveaus.
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Ervaring met On-Premise & DevOps: Goede ervaring met Linux-omgevingen, containerisatie en container-orkestratie in een on-premise datacenter-setting.
 Software Engineering: Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python (ervaring met andere systeemtalen of scripting is een pre) en ervaring met het bouwen en integreren van lokale API's.
 GenAI Interesse & Conceptuele Kennis: Je begrijpt de theorie achter vector-indexering, embeddings en de werking van grote taalmodellen (LLM's). Je hebt hier bij voorkeur al op hobbymatige of projectmatige basis mee geëxperimenteerd met open-source middelen.
 Talen: Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.
 Veiligheidsonderzoek: Aangezien je werkt aan defensie-gerelateerde projecten, is het succesvol doorlopen van een nationale veiligheidsscreening (Verklaring van Geen Bezwaar) een vereiste.
 Wat Thales biedt 
 Een unieke kans om te pionieren met state-of-the-art GenAI-technologie in een high-security enterprise-omgeving.
 Een flexibele hybride werkomgeving met een gezonde balans tussen thuiswerken en samenwerken op het High Tech Systems Park in Hengelo.
 Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de CAO Metalelektro, waaronder een zeer competitief salaris en 40 vakantiedagen per jaar (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen).
 Ruimte en budget om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen tot een expert in AI-infrastructuur.
 #LI-NB1

items.desc:
Overview 
 With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CE&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.   
We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), specializing in AI solutions, who is passionate about driving our customers’ AI transformation journey with M365 Copilot Chat, Agents, PowerPlatform and Copilot Studio. This is a customer-facing role that serves as a strategic trusted advisor and technical subject matter specialist, accelerating AI adoption and change management by creating business value and ROI. 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 Be a trusted advisor and drive business value through AI Transformation: Create business value by translating customer challenges into actionable solutions aligned to high ROI customer outcomes. Ensure a seamless, connected experience that fosters satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term value. 
 Drive Customer Success: Lead architectural design, engaging with business and technical decision makers to drive intent and enable sustained usage of M365 Copilot, Agents, PowerPlatform and Copilot Studio, securing long-term customer success and renewal. 
 Leverage Agentic AI: Use Copilot prompt engineering and Agent-building expertise to drive AI at scale. 
 Explore growth opportunities: Partner with technical and sales teams to identify opportunities and develop tailored solutions to drive expansion and business value realization. 
 Accelerate Customer AI Transformation Journey: Engage in relevant communities to share expertise, contribute to IP creation, prioritize IP re-use, and learn from others to help accelerate your customer’s AI transformation journey. 
 Embrace a growth mindset: Act as the voice of the customer by proactively sharing insights, feedback, and success stories to inform internal strategy and execution.  
 Learn-it-all: Demonstrate a self-learner mindset through continuous, self-directed learning in areas such as M365 Copilot, Agents, PowerPlatform, Copilot Studio, FinOps, business value realization, and adoption and change management. Build and maintain technical readiness aligned to Customer Success Unit (CSU) priorities and corporate initiatives.  
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications (RQs): 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field 
 OR equivalent experience 
 Effective verbal and written communication, analytical and presentation skills   in German as well as English. 
 You must be based and legally authorised to work in Germany to be eligible for this role. (Legally authorised = has citizenship or has been granted a valid visa or work permit).  
 Preferred Qualifications (PQs): 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 2+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting 
 OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field 
 OR equivalent experience. 
 Technical Certification in Cloud (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert , Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications). 
 Cloud Solution Architecture IC2 - The typical base pay range for this role across Germany is € 55,400.00 - € 88,800.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. 
 Find additional benefits and pay information here:
 https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/germany-corporate-pay.html 
 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, …

items.desc:
Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
 Most engineering roles focus on improving what already exists. Ericsson gives the opportunity of creating something entirely new.
 We are building an AI-powered engineering platform that keeps design intent and implementation aligned, turns engineering knowledge into a searchable asset, and enables AI to become a true engineering partner. By connecting system design with software implementation, we're laying the foundation for a new way of developing complex systems.
 This is a greenfield initiative within Ericsson's RAN organization. You'll work at the intersection of AI, software architecture, and systems engineering, building intelligent agents, knowledge frameworks, and tooling that amplify engineering expertise. The challenges are ambitious, and the solutions have yet to be defined.
 The goal is not to replace expertise, but to elevate it. By reducing repetitive work, AI allows engineers to focus on innovation, problem-solving, and high-value technical decisions.
 You'll have the opportunity to shape the direction of this work and influence how future wireless systems, from 5G to 6G and beyond, are designed and developed.
 As a Systems Data Engineer , you will drive how RAN system knowledge, design decisions, and technical structures are captured, represented, and governed. You will ensure data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, secure handling, and enable analytics/BI. Use Prefect orchestration, Python and SQL, containerization, CI/CD and monitoring; collaborate with architects and product teams to translate requirements into scalable, production-grade data solutions.
 What you will do: 
 • Design, build, and optimize robust end-to-end data pipelines and reusable processing components that deliver trusted and timely data to product teams and other stakeholders.
• Develop, maintain, and operate platform-based, event-driven data workflows and S3-backed data flows, ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable data movement across the delivery lifecycle.
• Build and evolve orchestrated data processing workflows using tools such as Prefect, with strong focus on quality, maintainability, and operational support.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, architects, and stakeholders to design scalable data solutions aligned with product, analytics, and operational needs.
• Drive implementation of data ingestion, transformation, validation, and quality assurance frameworks, including support for raw and parsed dataset workflows.
• Contribute to the evolution of data catalogue, metadata, and lineage capabilities to improve discoverability, governance, and controlled data consumption.
• Support secure data handling, access control, and consent-aware ways of working in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and governance processes.
• Enable data consumption for analytics and reporting scenarios, including integration points that support cataloguing, dashboards, and internal visibility of available datasets.
• Drive improvements to data platform capabilities, pipeline performance, testing, observability, and operational excellence.
• Use modern engineering practices and AI-assisted tools where appropriate to improve development efficiency, documentation quality, troubleshooting, and delivery excellence while following security and governance requirements.
• Communicate technical solutions, trade-offs, and delivery progress effectively to engineering teams, product stakeholders, and leadership in both technical and plain language.
 The skills you bring: 
 • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or related technical field
• 5+ years of experience in data engineering or closely related software engineering role
• Strong experience in data modelling, scalable batch data pipelines, and data lake or data warehouse patterns
• Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases, schema design and performance optimization
• Strong programming skills in Python for data processing and reusable pipeline components
• Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect or equivalent
• Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven data pipelines across different platform services (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Batch, Step Functions, Glue, Athena, EventBridge, S3)
• Experience with Bash scripting in cloud-native data processing workflows
• Practical experience with data catalogue, metadata, lineage, governance, and secure data handling practices
 Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

items.desc:
Cologne, Germany | UMH | Product Engineer | Full-time | 70k - 100k EUR | ONSITE (part remote)
Hi, Alex and Jeremy here from UMH.
8 years ago, Jeremy was absolutely frustrated with the status quo of data infrastructure in manufacturing. Companies paid millions per year for "shitty 90s software" and are still doing that today, when there is much better software out there for open-source. So we decided that we can do this better, first founded a System Integrator, realized most of the tasks in setting up and maintaining a data infrastructure can be standardized, and decided to found the currently VC-backed UMH, which is built on open source software and is open source itself.
What we're actually building: We build and scale a real-time data platform that runs hundreds of Benthos pipelines inside a single Docker container (UMH Core), processing millions of industrial messages that control actual production processes.
Plus a local-first user interface (Management Console) where both non-technical factory workers and power-users/developers can work together. And yes, we care about UI in enterprise/industrial software.
 https://www.umh.app/careers/product-engineer-f-m-d-70-100k-e...

Ses équipes d’experts, présentes dans environ 30 pays, conseillent les clients sur leur développement stratégique en les accompagnant dans le développement et la transformation de leurs activités tout en maximisant leur impact positif. Natixis CIB s’engage sur un alignement de son portefeuille de financements sur une trajectoire de neutralité carbone d’ici 2050 tout en aidant ses clients à réduire l’impact environnemental de leur activité. Natixis CIB fait partie du Groupe BPCE, deuxième groupe bancaire en France à travers les réseaux Banque Populaire et Caisse d’Epargne. Elle bénéficie de la puissance financière et des solides notations du Groupe (Standard & Poor's : A+, Moody's : A2, Fitch Ratings: A+, R&I : A+). Poste et missions Vous rejoignez notre équipe Data & Innovation, qui recherche un Data Scientist, pour un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027. Nous travaillons à la réalisation de projets de data sciences (data analytiques et machine learning) pour les métiers bancaires de la CIB afin d’explorer au maximum les opportunités business. Nos développements sont des outils en proximité métier, qui permettent de réaliser des études d'opportunité de mise en oeuvre autour de cas d'usage sur base de Data Science. En collaboration avec votre tuteur, vos missions principales seront : Reprendre, travailler et avancer sur les sujets Data Science existants (RAG, Agents LLM, ..); Proposer des améliorations sur les Proof Of Concepts; Développement de solution tactiques et de template réutilisables; Documenter les travaux effectués et diffuser la connaissance dans la CIB. En tant que Data Scientist vous participez aux développements de l'équipe, à la mise en valeur de ces développements via des dashboards (Power BI/Plotly/Flask) Vous travaillez dans un environnement international, au sein d’une communauté d’experts qui place l’excellence, l’impact et l’action collective au coeur de tout ce qu’elle entreprend. #FinanceTransformative Vous évoluez dans un environnement international et inclusif, favorisant le collaboratif avec des missions concrètes et un impact réel. Nous vous accompagnerons tout au long de votre expérience chez nous pour que vous puissiez apprendre et développer vos compétences en travaillant aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés. Vous avez également la possibilité de vous engager en faveur de la société et de causes qui vous tiennent à cœur via notre fondation d’entreprise. En plus d’une indemnité de stage attractive calculée en fonction de votre formation et de votre niveau d’études, vous bénéficiez du remboursement de votre titre de transport à hauteur de 60 %, d’un jour d’absence autorisé payé pour chaque mois travaillé et de l’accès au restaurant de l’entreprise. Vous pourrez également avoir accès au comité d’entreprise. Vous aimez appliquer vos compétences techniques à la résolution de problèmes concrets. Vous êtes curieux pour comprendre et maitriser les sujets liés à la finance de marchés. Vous êtes à l’aise pour présenter et communiquer des informations à l'oral, rédiger et partager des informations à l'écrit. And last but not least, you are perfectly fluent in English.

items.desc: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role We're looking for the top 1% - engineers who treat their craft like athletes treat performance, and who want to work alongside people who do the same. The world has changed dramatically in the last quarter. What used to take a team of consultants six months now takes a sharp engineer a few days. The momentum is unreal, and we're growing into it fast. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you're embedded directly in our customers' environments, taking a messy enterprise problem from first conversation to a working production system in days - not quarters. You work as part of a small senior team - alongside a Senior Consultant and other FDEs - and you own the technical solution end-to-end: architecture, integrations, agent and workflow logic, frontend where needed, evals, deployment. The work starts and ends with the customer, not the codebase. Feedback cycles are measured in hours, the bar is high, and the people you ship with will push you to raise it. What you'll do Sit with end-users, process owners, and client engineers to understand the real workflow - and the real problem underneath the stated one Translate the target-state process into a concrete technical solution: architecture, data model, integrations, agent and workflow design - and ship it in days and weeks, not quarters Demo early and often, rough edges included, and fold real feedback into the next iteration Make speed / quality / cost trade-offs in real time. Choose build vs. buy vs. configure existing platform capability Own observability and evals once live. Iterate until the system is reliable in the customer's real conditions Earn trust with the client's own engineering and security teams - API access, data flows, deployment, reviews Bring patterns back - reusable components, prompt structures, integration approaches - so the next engagement ships faster What you'll bring Builder background with real shipping experience - you've taken systems from zero to production and kept them running Fluent with modern AI tooling: LLM APIs, tool and function calling, agent frameworks, evals, prompt engineering as a real discipline Strong with TypeScript on the backend. Comfortable with APIs, auth, queues, and integrating with legacy systems Daily, fluent use of Claude Code, Cursor, or similar - expected to ship meaningfully faster than a traditional engineer because of them Customer-facing instinct - you genuinely enjoy being in the room with users, asking sharp questions, and pushing back respectfully when needed You move fast, communicate clearly, and operate well with ambiguity. Comfortable being dropped into an unfamiliar domain and coming back with a working prototype Fluency in English. German is a plus MUST : experience automating business processes in the ERP space (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar), or prior background in consulting, solutions engineering, or founding/building products end-to-end What you'll get Ship in days, not quarters. Watch a messy enterprise problem become a working production system inside a single engagement. Work at the frontier. We use and build with state-of-the-art tech, the latest LLMs, agent frameworks, and AI coding tools, with the budget and mandate to keep up as the field moves. Build with the best tools. No legacy stack to drag around. Big responsibility, fast. You own customer engagements end-to-end from day one: architecture, build, delivery, and the relationship. A team that raises the bar. You're working alongside other FDEs and senior consultants who were hired for exactly this pace. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

items.desc: Job Description & Summary PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. Chaque jour, nous exerçons des métiers d’excellence pour concrétiser notre ambition : être utiles à nos clients et accélérateurs de mouvement. Dans un monde en constante évolution, nous investissons dans le développement de nos équipes avec une proposition de valeur forte : Grow here. Go further. Un engagement mondial pour accompagner nos talents dans l’évolution de leurs compétences. Ce que nous recherchons ? Des expertises, bien sûr. Mais surtout, des personnalités curieuses, passionnées, prêtes à incarner les comportements du PwC Professional, notre référentiel commun qui guide notre manière de travailler ensemble. Reconnu Top Employer pour la 6ème année consécutive, PwC s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et handi-accueillant, où chacun peut pleinement collaborer et avoir un impact. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part. Votre équipe Grâce à son alliance avec Salesforce, leader sur le marché du CRM depuis 2012, PwC met son expertise business et stratégie au service du client pour lui offrir une expérience de transformation unique et adaptée à ses besoins. L’équipe Salesforce se positionne comme un acteur majeur de la transformation digitale de la relation client, accompagnant les clients de la stratégie à l’exécution avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires. Vos missions Responsable de la conception, gouvernance, intégration et évolution de la plateforme Salesforce. 1. Architecture & Design Définir l’architecture cible de la plateforme Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, etc.). Concevoir des solutions robustes, évolutives et sécurisées, intégrées dans le SI existant. Garantir la cohérence architecturale, du modèle de données aux règles métiers. Arbitrer les choix technologiques et proposer les meilleures pratiques (Apex, LWC, Flow, API, Intégrations). 2. Intégration & Urbanisation Définir les patterns d’intégration entre Salesforce et les autres applications (Mulesoft, ESB, API REST/SOAP, ETL...). Participer à l’urbanisation du SI autour de la plateforme CRM. Veiller au respect des principes de sécurité, de confidentialité, de gouvernance des données et de compliance. 3. Pilotage & Delivery Encadrer les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles (développeurs, consultants, testeurs). Participer aux ateliers de conception avec les équipes métiers. Définir les standards de développement et les bonnes pratiques DevOps (CI/CD, Git, automatisation). Garantir la qualité des livrables et la performance des solutions. 4. Gouvernance & Stratégie Définir et maintenir la roadmap Salesforce. Assurer la gouvernance des environnements, des licences et des déploiements. Conseiller les décideurs sur l’adoption des fonctionnalités Salesforce et des innovations (AI, Einstein, Data Cloud...). Piloter la stratégie de certifications et de montée en compétence de l’équipe. Votre profil Compétences Salesforce Maîtrise avancée des Clouds Salesforce : Sales, Service, Experience, Marketing, Field Service… Excellente connaissance du modèle de données Salesforce. Connaissance approfondie d’Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL/SOSL. Conception d’architectures multi-org et multi-cloud. Certifications attendues (non exhaustif) : Application Architect System Architect Technical Architect (CTA) – un atout majeur Integration Architecture Designer Data Architecture & Management Designer Compétences SI & Intégration • •Architecture d’intégration (API, Middleware, ESB, ETL). • •Maitrise de Mulesoft, Informatica ou équivalent. • •Connaissances solides en sécurité, IAM, OAuth2, SSO, RBAC. • •Bonne compréhension des environnements cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP). Compétences Solutionning & Chiffrage Construction d’options de solution claires et argumentées. Estimation détaillée des charges et planification projet. Contribution aux dossiers d’avant vente et appels d’offres. Soft Skills Leadership technique et capacité à influencer. Excellente communication orale et écrite (capacité à vulgariser). Forte orientation solution et sens du service client. Capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et aisance dans la prise de décision. Autonomie, rigueur, adaptabilité. Expérience 5 à 10 ans d’expérience sur l’écosystème Salesforce. Expérience en tant qu’architecte ou lead technique sur des projets Salesforce d’envergure. Interventions dans des contextes multi-pays, multisite ou multi-organisation appréciées. Vos avantages Un environnement technologique innovant : accès à des outils de pointe comme le Tech Lab, Copilot M365 et l’IA Factory pour façonner le monde de demain. Des possibilités d’apprentissage et de développement hors normes, grâce à notre plateforme de formation intelligente et notre culture du feedback continu. Un cycle de performance …

items.desc: Who we are We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we're here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe's safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing. Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, "roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen" kind of people. It's these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you're someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let's go! Your mission As an Information Security Expert, you are a senior individual contributor who sets direction and solves the hardest GRC problems in a regulated fintech environment. You shape our security governance strategy, ensure our control framework remains effective as the business scales, and act as a key advisor to security leadership and senior business stakeholders on risk and compliance decisions. You'll lead complex, high-impact initiatives (multi-entity, multi-region, regulator/customer-facing), influence across the organisation, and raise the bar for how we design, test, and evidence security controls. What you'll do GRC strategy & roadmap: Define multi-year GRC roadmap aligned to business strategy, risk appetite, and regulatory expectations (e.g., DORA readiness, audit strategy, control maturity targets). Drive control framework evolution: rationalize controls, reduce duplication, and ensure proportionality based on criticality, data sensitivity, and business impact. Establish "north star" principles for governance (e.g., minimum control baselines, exception governance, evidence-by-design). Executive advisory & decision support: Advise leadership on material risk decisions: risk acceptance, remediation prioritisation, control investments, and scope decisions. Produce executive-grade outputs: risk narratives, board/committee materials, and regulator/customer responses with defensible rationale. Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment when priorities conflict (delivery speed vs control rigor; cost vs assurance depth). Regulatory, audit & assurance leadership (complex scope): Own strategy and approach for major audits/assurance activities (ISO 27001, SOC 2, regulatory examinations, key client due diligence), including scope, positioning, and negotiation. Lead responses to complex audit/regulatory issues: root-cause analysis, corrective action programs, and sustained effectiveness verification. Domain SME ownership (one or more, depending on needs): You may be the SME for one or more of: ISMS/ISO 27001 at scale (multi-entity scope, continuous compliance); DORA / operational resilience governance (control mapping, ICT risk integration, testing oversight); Third-party risk for critical ICT providers (oversight model, ongoing monitoring, exit/continuity governance); Security control assurance (testing program design, evidence standards, control health metrics). Enablement, standards & mentorship: Set standards and reusable artifacts: control narratives, evidence templates, testing methodologies, and playbooks. Mentor specialists and associates; raise organisation-wide capability through coaching and review. Partner with Security Engineering/IT/Compliance to embed controls into workflows (policy-to-automation where possible). Who you are Typically 7–10+ years of experience in information security GRC, audit/assurance, security risk, compliance, software engineering and/ or financial services risk roles. Demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder GRC programs and successful navigation of audits/regulatory scrutiny. Deep working knowledge of ISO 27001, DORA and strong familiarity with adjacent frameworks (SOC 2, NIST CSF, BaIT, COBIT), including how to test and evidence controls. Strong technology risk understanding across cloud, IAM, SDLC governance, incident management, vulnerability management, logging/monitoring, crypto/fintech operational processes (as relevant). You are able to influence across the organisation and resolve conflicts with a risk-based, outcome-oriented approach. What's in it for you Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice. Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation …

About the role: Creative Fabrica Studio is where people turn ideas into real creative work. Generators, editors, and tools live in one product: studio.creativefabrica.com. Thousands of makers use Creative Fabrica; Studio is how we turn that audience into creators who ship work every day. We're redesigning Studio into an experience that matches how ambitious the tech already is: faster, clearer, more distinctive, and genuinely easy to use, the kind of product designers wish they got to shape from the ground up. We are looking for a Product Designer who brings strong visual craft, a focus on user experience, and well structured Figma files that developers can build from smoothly. As a Product Designer, you'll take ownership of the end-to-end design for Creative Fabrica Studio and raise the bar for usability and visual quality across the platform. You will work closely with developers and product as a hands-on partner: independent enough to drive the design direction, collaborative enough to turn ideas into buildable UI quickly. This is not a role for endless exploration or for lightly adapting patterns from elsewhere. We want someone who brings original product taste, ships thoughtfully and often, and uses AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar. You will have real ownership. Sometimes you will get a clear problem or flow; other times you will be expected to propose the better experience yourself and take it to a developer-ready design. What you will do: Lead the redesign of Studio end-to-end: information architecture, flows, UI, and interaction details that make the product easier and more delightful to use. Raise visual and interaction quality so Studio feels modern, distinctive, and worthy of an AI-native creative product. Turn product goals and constraints into concrete screens, components, and prototypes that developers can implement with confidence. Partner daily with engineers: clarify intent, resolve edge cases early, and keep design and build in sync. Produce structured Figma work, clear hierarchy, components, variants, states, and specs, so handoff is efficient and unambiguous. Design for real creator workflows: reduce friction, improve discoverability, and make advanced AI capabilities feel simple. Move from concept to usable design quickly; prefer strong iterations over polishing one direction for days. Use AI tools to accelerate research, exploration, and production while keeping craft and judgment yourself. Build and evolve a coherent design system / UI language for Studio that scales across new features. Validate designs with lightweight methods (critiques, quick tests, usage feedback) and adjust without derailing delivery. Balance originality with clarity: distinctive where it matters, familiar where it helps users move fast. Stay current with product design, AI product UX, Figma workflows, and emerging patterns in generative-media tools. What you will need: 5+ years designing digital products (UI/UX or product design), with a portfolio that shows shipped product work. Excellent UI craft: typography, layout, visual hierarchy, interaction design, and polish in complex product surfaces. Advanced Figma skills for developer handoff (components, variants, auto-layout, clear states and specs). Proven ability to redesign or substantially improve a product experience with measurable usability gains. Proven ability to take a product or major surface from concept to polished, buildable UI quickly. Comfortable using AI tools in the design workflow; strong written and spoken English. Thrives in high-pace environments: manages shifting priorities, ships on deadline, and stays decisive when briefs or constraints change. Independent and ownership driven: proposes direction, unblocks yourself, and partners with developers without heavy process. Original and tasteful: brings creative point of view; does not default to copy-paste industry patterns. Nice to have: Agency background delivering digital product, web, or app redesigns for real clients under commercial pressure. Experience designing AI, generative media, SaaS, or creator tools. Experience building or maintaining a product design system used by engineering. Is this you? Get in touch! We'd love to speak to you. You can apply by clicking the "Apply now" button. The Talent Intelligence Partner will support both proactive workforce planning and active hiring priorities. This includes assessing talent availability and market competitiveness, identifying optimal talent pools and locations, developing external talent pipelines, and providing intelligence that informs sourcing, recruitment, and broader workforce decisions. The successful candidate will bring a strong combination of talent sourcing expertise, analytical curiosity, market research capability, and stakeholder advisory skills, with the ability to move from data and research to clear recommendations and action. Conduct external talent market research to assess talent availability, demand, competition, skills, locations, compensation trends, and competitor activity, translating insights into strategic recommendations on talent pools, role profiles, market feasibility, and emerging talent risks and opportunities. items.desc: CloudLinux is the maker of Imunify360 — a suite of security products protecting millions of websites across the web hosting industry — and of CloudLinux OS , the operating system behind a large share of the world's shared hosting. To learn more about our company and products, visit our websites: cloudlinux.com and imunify360.com. Alongside those established product lines we run a small innovation team whose job is to find and prove the next ones. We are looking for a Product Owner to lead that team: a small, senior, fully remote squad of engineers that takes new product concepts from idea to a working MVP in customers' hands, then hands proven products to a product line and moves on to the next concept. You will be accountable for the pipeline of ideas, the speed and rigour with which they are tested, and the evidence behind every go / no-go recommendation. This is a hands-on lead role, not pure people management: roughly 50% discovery and leadership (customer conversations, scoping, prioritisation, coaching, reporting to the CPO) and 50% building (prototypes, spikes, design and code review, demo stands). You will not be the team's only builder, but you must be able to build a credible prototype yourself and hold a technical opinion about every part of it. You don't need to arrive as an expert in web hosting or security. If you have taken a product from nothing to its first paying customers before — as a founder, an early engineer, or the lead of an incubation team — and you get deep into unfamiliar technical territory fast, we will teach you the market. What the team works on The innovation team sits across CloudLinux and Imunify and owns the product concepts that do not yet have a home in an established product line. Ideas come from customer conversations, industry events, telemetry across more than 80,000 servers and the CPO’s strategy; the team’s job is to turn them into something a customer will pay for within a quarter, using AI coding agents throughout. What you will own Discovery and delivery Run the pipeline of product concepts: capture, size and rank ideas with their assumptions written down, and keep the backlog of bets visible to the CPO and leadership. Take each funded concept to a working MVP on a fixed timebox, typically one quarter, with a named customer or design partner testing it. Define success criteria up front and report against them with real numbers rather than adjectives: usage, conversion, willingness to pay, support load. Make the go / no-go call honestly: hand proven products to a product line with a written runbook and roadmap, and capture what was learned from concepts that did not prove out. Report status and risk to the CPO weekly; every item carries an owner and a due date. Prototyping and technical direction Choose the fastest credible build for each concept — buy, borrow, open source or write — with the trade-offs made explicit. Build prototypes and demo stands yourself where that is the quickest route to evidence; review designs and code on everything the team ships. Keep MVPs production-worthy enough to run on real customer servers: packaging, safe rollout, rollback and observability from the first release. Work with the architecture group and the product teams so a successful MVP can be adopted without a rewrite. People Lead a small distributed team: 1:1s, goal setting, performance reviews, and career development. Hire: define the profile, run technical interviews, onboard, and mentor engineers. Set the working agreements that make fast async work possible — written decisions, public-by-default communication, demos over status meetings. AI-augmented engineering We evaluate engineers partly on how effectively they work with coding agents, and in the innovation team this is the main lever on speed. As the lead you model and coach it: prompt specificity, review quality on agent-generated code, context provision, iteration and error recovery, and end-to-end task completion. Expect to use agents to build prototypes, generate test corpora and draft customer-facing material. First 90 days 30 days: Complete 1:1s with every team member and produce a written read on the team's strengths and gaps; review the concepts in flight and the evidence behind each; spend time with sales, support and at least three hosting customers. 60 days: Own the concept pipeline and the weekly status; publish success criteria for every active concept; ship at least one prototype or demo yourself. 90 days: Present a ranked portfolio of bets for the next two quarters agreed with the CPO, including one go / no-go recommendation backed by customer evidence and a staffing recommendation. Requirements Must-haves: 5+ years as a software engineer, with 2+ years leading a small team (team lead, tech lead with people responsibility, founder or engineering manager) building new products in a product company or startup. A track record of taking at least one product from concept to first paying customers, and of …

items.desc: About Creative Fabrica Creative Fabrica is a fast-growing AI platform that makes it easy for everyday consumers to create whatever they imagine, from images and videos to audio and 3D creations, using the latest generative AI models. About the role: Creative Fabrica Studio is where people turn ideas into real creative work. It's our AI-native creative suite, image, video, audio, 3D, and a full design workspace, built so anyone can go from a rough idea to a professional asset in minutes. Generators, editors, and tools live in one product: studio.creativefabrica.com. Thousands of makers use Creative Fabrica; Studio is how we turn that audience into creators who ship work every day. We're not polishing a finished product. We're redesigning Studio into an experience that matches how ambitious the tech already is: faster, clearer, more distinctive, and genuinely easy to use, the kind of product designers wish they got to shape from the ground up. We are looking for a Product Designer who brings strong visual craft, a focus on user experience, and well structured Figma files that developers can build from smoothly. As a Product Designer, you'll take ownership of the end-to-end design for Creative Fabrica Studio and raise the bar for usability and visual quality across the platform. You will work closely with developers and product as a hands-on partner: independent enough to drive the design direction, collaborative enough to turn ideas into buildable UI quickly. This is not a role for endless exploration or for lightly adapting patterns from elsewhere. We want someone who brings original product taste, ships thoughtfully and often, and uses AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar. You will have real ownership. Sometimes you will get a clear problem or flow; other times you will be expected to propose the better experience yourself and take it to a developer-ready design. What you will do: Lead the redesign of Studio end-to-end: information architecture, flows, UI, and interaction details that make the product easier and more delightful to use. Raise visual and interaction quality so Studio feels modern, distinctive, and worthy of an AI-native creative product. Turn product goals and constraints into concrete screens, components, and prototypes that developers can implement with confidence. Partner daily with engineers: clarify intent, resolve edge cases early, and keep design and build in sync. Produce structured Figma work, clear hierarchy, components, variants, states, and specs, so handoff is efficient and unambiguous. Design for real creator workflows: reduce friction, improve discoverability, and make advanced AI capabilities feel simple. Move from concept to usable design quickly; prefer strong iterations over polishing one direction for days. Use AI tools to accelerate research, exploration, and production while keeping craft and judgment yourself. Build and evolve a coherent design system / UI language for Studio that scales across new features. Validate designs with lightweight methods (critiques, quick tests, usage feedback) and adjust without derailing delivery. Balance originality with clarity: distinctive where it matters, familiar where it helps users move fast. Stay current with product design, AI product UX, Figma workflows, and emerging patterns in generative-media tools. What you will need: 5+ years designing digital products (UI/UX or product design), with a portfolio that shows shipped product work. Excellent UI craft: typography, layout, visual hierarchy, interaction design, and polish in complex product surfaces. Advanced Figma skills for developer handoff (components, variants, auto-layout, clear states and specs). Proven ability to redesign or substantially improve a product experience with measurable usability gains. Proven ability to take a product or major surface from concept to polished, buildable UI quickly. Comfortable using AI tools in the design workflow; strong written and spoken English. Thrives in high-pace environments: manages shifting priorities, ships on deadline, and stays decisive when briefs or constraints change. Independent and ownership driven: proposes direction, unblocks yourself, and partners with developers without heavy process. Original and tasteful: brings creative point of view; does not default to copy-paste industry patterns. Nice to have: Agency background delivering digital product, web, or app redesigns for real clients under commercial pressure. Experience designing AI, generative media, SaaS, or creator tools. Experience building or maintaining a product design system used by engineering. Is this you? Get in touch! We'd love to speak to you. You can apply by clicking the "Apply now" button. Creative Fabrica is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe's safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing. Your mission As an Information Security Expert, you are a senior individual contributor who sets direction and solves the hardest GRC problems in a regulated fintech environment. You shape our security governance strategy, ensure our control framework remains effective as the business scales, and act as a key advisor to security leadership and senior business stakeholders on risk and compliance decisions. You'll lead complex, high-impact initiatives (multi-entity, multi-region, regulator/customer-facing), influence across the organisation, and raise the bar for how we design, test, and evidence security controls. What you'll do GRC strategy & roadmap: Define multi-year GRC roadmap aligned to business strategy, risk appetite, and regulatory expectations (e.g., DORA readiness, audit strategy, control maturity targets). Drive control framework evolution: rationalize controls, reduce duplication, and ensure proportionality based on criticality, data sensitivity, and business impact. Establish "north star" principles for governance (e.g., minimum control baselines, exception governance, evidence-by-design). Executive advisory & decision support: Advise leadership on material risk decisions: risk acceptance, remediation prioritisation, control investments, and scope decisions. Produce executive-grade outputs: risk narratives, board/committee materials, and regulator/customer responses with defensible rationale. Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment when priorities conflict (delivery speed vs control rigor; cost vs assurance depth). Regulatory, audit & assurance leadership (complex scope): Own strategy and approach for major audits/assurance activities (ISO 27001, SOC 2, regulatory examinations, key client due diligence), including scope, positioning, and negotiation. Lead responses to complex audit/regulatory issues: root-cause analysis, corrective action programs, and sustained effectiveness verification. Domain SME ownership (one or more, depending on needs): You may be the SME for one or more of: ISMS/ISO 27001 at scale (multi-entity scope, continuous compliance); DORA / operational resilience governance (control mapping, ICT risk integration, testing oversight); Third-party risk for critical ICT providers (oversight model, ongoing monitoring, exit/continuity governance); Security control assurance (testing program design, evidence standards, control health metrics). Enablement, standards & mentorship: Set standards and reusable artifacts: control narratives, evidence templates, testing methodologies, and playbooks. Mentor specialists and associates; raise organisation-wide capability through coaching and review. Partner with Security Engineering/IT/Compliance to embed controls into workflows (policy-to-automation where possible). Who you are Typically 7–10+ years of experience in information security GRC, audit/assurance, security risk, compliance, software engineering and/ or financial services risk roles. Demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder GRC programs and successful navigation of audits/regulatory scrutiny. Deep working knowledge of ISO 27001, DORA and strong familiarity with adjacent frameworks (SOC 2, NIST CSF, BaIT, COBIT), including how to test and evidence controls. Strong technology risk understanding across cloud, IAM, SDLC governance, incident management, vulnerability management, logging/monitoring, crypto/fintech operational processes (as relevant). You are able to influence across the organisation and resolve conflicts with a risk-based, outcome-oriented approach. Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation …

We provide services in the areas of production, logistics, data engineering (IT), engineering, consulting, quality, business services, human resources, communication, and administrative and financial services. We are looking for an Incident Management Coordinator (IMC) to run the Central Incident Board of a new Level 2 IT Operations service for connected-vehicle digital products. As part of a newly established operations service, you will play a central role in coordinating the end-to-end management of incidents affecting critical digital products and services. This is a unique opportunity to help shape a new service model and establish operational excellence within an international environment. Own the ticket lifecycle end to end in JIRA and ServiceNow, and keep the two taxonomies reconciled so that reporting from either tool agrees. Drive major incidents: convene the bridge, keep the timeline log, manage stakeholder communication, and produce the post-incident report. Monitor SLA clocks continuously and escalate before a breach occurs, not after it. Produce the daily operational report, and supply the data that feeds the weekly service review and the Joint Governance Board. Act as the named counterpart for requesters across the four brands and four time zones. Maintain the incident catalogue and the knowledge base; feed recurring incidents into problem management and the shift-left backlog. English C1, as the working language of the service.. Nice To Have Experience in automotive, connected vehicle, IoT or telematics environments. Previous experience inside the Volkswagen Group or with a Group supplier. Experience standing up an incident management process from scratch, rather than inheriting one. German, at any working level, for the German-speaking stakeholders of the service. Exposure to AWS services and to cloud monitoring tooling. items.desc: Har du erfarenhet av att utveckla AI-lösningar och vill ta ansvar från verksamhetsbehov till fungerande system? Skarp Systems söker dig som kombinerar kvalificerad mjukvaruutveckling med praktisk erfarenhet av LLM-applikationer och RAG. Skarp Systems AB har sina rötter i Östergötland och startades 2012 – ett litet men gediget konsultbolag med hjärtat på rätta stället. Vi växer med ambitionen att samla erfarna specialister som vill lösa komplexa problem, ta tekniskt ansvar och vara med och påverka bolagets utveckling. Ditt uppdrag Som anställd konsult hos Skarp Systems arbetar du med AI- och datalösningar i en teknikintensiv verksamhet med höga krav på kvalitet och säkerhet. Du deltar tidigt i dialogen med beställare, undersöker behov och omsätter dem till lösningsdesign. Arbetet omfattar både avgränsade koncepttester och större leveranser, med fokus på robusthet, kvalitet och ansvarsfull användning av AI. Du kommer bland annat att: Designa, utveckla och implementera AI-system. Utveckla LLM-applikationer och RAG-pipelines. Utvärdera lösningarnas kvalitet genom systematiska tester och felanalys. Identifiera och prioritera förbättringar av data och lösningar. Ge verksamhetsnära teknisk rådgivning. Utforma lösningar som kan utvecklas och förvaltas över tid. Din erfarenhet Vi söker dig som har: Praktisk erfarenhet av professionell mjukvaruutveckling, exempelvis som ML Engineer, Data Scientist eller i en närliggande roll. Erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla LLM-applikationer och RAG-pipelines. Erfarenhet av utvärdering av AI-lösningar, inklusive evals, datakvalitet och felanalys. Goda kunskaper i Python. Förståelse för molninfrastruktur, gärna Microsoft Azure. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska. Det är meriterande med erfarenhet av MCP, SQL, PySpark, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Amazon S3 eller Apache Airflow. Även erfarenhet av dataarkitektur, ETL-pipelines och arbete i reglerade eller säkerhetskänsliga verksamheter är relevant. Du tänker långsiktigt, tar ansvar för dina tekniska beslut och kan förklara möjligheter och begränsningar på ett begripligt sätt. Varför Skarp Systems? Vi vill förena hög teknisk kompetens med nära relationer och omtanke om människorna bakom lösningarna. För dig som kommer från ett större arbetsgivare eller konsultbolag kan Skarp vara ett bra steg om du vill komma till ett lite mindre bolag med platta beslutsvägar och eget mandat, utveckling och bidra med både erfarenhet och idéer. Praktisk information Placering: Linköping eller annan ort enligt överenskommelse och uppdragets förutsättningar. Arbetsupplägg: Hybridarbete. Omfattning: Heltid. Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsteresor inom Sverige förekommer. Uppdraget omfattas av säkerhetskrav. Tillämpliga krav och kontroller klargörs i rekryteringsprocessen. Beskriv gärna utan att dela konfidentiell information.

BBVA is a Spanish bank with its Swiss offices located in Zürich. Functions (duties and responsibilities): Contribute to our Global Liquidity Planning & Forecasting function With exposure to senior management, focus on forecasting, analyzing and driving execution decisions across a variety of liquidity metrics including Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) and Internal Economic Barometers Responsibility for the enhancement, control and maintenance of robust and accurate liquidity forecasts and explain as well as distribution and presentation of liquidity forecasts to management Interdivisional collaboration with Treasury and close interaction with our business partners as well as the rest of the CFO division especially with the ALM manager, CFO, Accounting and MIS Monitor and analyze structural interest rate risk, including its potential impact on earnings and economic value Assess and control the potential impacts of exchange rate fluctuations on foreign currency positions into the solvency (equity) and annual results of the firm Management and control of credit, counterparty and settlement risk of the balance sheet, including large exposure positions (Cluster Risk), NOSTRO portfolio framework and counterparties. Ensure that the calculation of the impairment of the financial instruments is done according to IFRS 9 Your profile: Degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering or equivalent. Master’s degree, post-graduate studies or equivalent higher education in numerical/analytical fields Deep understanding of Know-how in risk management, risk management processes and regulatory reporting requirements. At least 5 years of relevant experience in banking, particularly in Asset and Liability Management (ALM), structural risk and financial markets. items.desc: Overview of Responsibilities About us Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them. About the job Join UKAEA’s Materials Division as a Senior Scientist and help shape the materials that will enable future fusion power plants. You’ll lead the development, testing and qualification of copper alloys, tungsten and other plasma-facing component materials, providing the performance data needed to support the STEP programme. This is an opportunity to influence the design of next-generation fusion systems through innovative research, technical leadership and collaboration across the fusion and nuclear materials communities. The role provides leadership on material requirements for use in in‑vessel plasma‑facing components (PFCs), focusing primarily on Cu-alloy heatsink materials. It ensures coordinated, technically robust materials‑engineering support across STEP Vacuum and In‑Vessel Systems (VIVS) PFC development activities. Expertise in the development and testing of Cu-alloys heat sink materials is essential for the role. Accompanied by expertise in mechanical & thermophysical properties testing for engineering design to deliver materials performance data for the development of STEP PFCs. Knowledge of tungsten as an armour material for PFCs is also desirable. This role is a Fixed-Term Appointment until March 2029. What You’ll Be Doing Organise, lead and coordinate short and long-term projects (Project >£100k), arranging specimen/data procurement, scope of work, funding and resources for sample preparation, testing and modelling. Deliver high quality, novel research and engineering in the field of nuclear materials through own endeavour and creative input. Compile and present results within technical reports and internal meetings, contributing as a lead author in high-impact publications. Lead in the definition of materials requirements for operation in a fusion power plant, collaborating closely and building a network not just with internal stakeholders but with other fusion and fission partners in both academia and industry. Build and provide leadership and management to, a small team of material scientists or PhD students, providing direction and allocating them to projects (Project >£100k) as required. This may also include leading teams during experiments or modelling exercises, to ensure that data is collected and reported in a robust and timely manner. Manage relationships with external collaborators (including universities, public sector research establishments and industry in fusion and fission related fields) and customers, in order to complement UKAEAs internal capability. Lead on the contribution to the development and positive reinforcement of UKAEAs knowledge base, design rules and practices in the area of materials & nuclear physics research and development. Propose, lead bids and secure funding and contribute to delivery of novel projects (Project >£100k) aligned with internal strategy (e.g. STEP, EUROfusion, EPSRC, PhD, Masters placements, graduates) Represent UKAEA at both domestic and international conferences, as well as at various meetings and functions as required. Participate in a national working group in a specialist area of nuclear related science (e.g. EUROfusion group, standards committee, benchmarking across countries). What You’ll Bring PhD degree in a relevant subject or equivalent learning across an HNC / apprenticeship / base degree plus work experience. Significant previous research-oriented experience in a laboratory environment / materials research group / experimental campaign. Ability to work well within a team and to readily articulate complex technical information to both specialist and non-specialist audiences. Ability to deliver high-quality results to tight timescales and budgets. Fluent written and spoken English Digital literacy across MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) UKAEA is an onsite organisation, and this role requires regular onsite presence (usually 5 days in any given week) in line with business needs. We actively support flexible working arrangements where this is compatible with the role. Benefits We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include: A salary of £57,117 (inclusive of a 5,800 specialist allowance) Up to 7% corporate performance bonus Final salary defined benefits pension scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution 25 days annual leave plus 2.5 ‘privilege’ days; 8 Bank Holidays Additional 3 days of site closure over Christmas break Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave …

About the job Job summary Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) capabilities are critical to Defence's ability to understand, decide and act in increasingly contested environments. This role delivers technical research and analysis through the development, application and exploitation of modelling and simulation tools to assess current and future PNT capabilities. Working alongside specialists from across Dstl, industry and academia, you will use modelling, simulation and data analysis to investigate complex technical challenges and generate evidence that informs Defence decision making.
