As the company grows, we need someone whose full-time focus is understanding the security of our platform, identifying the highest-impact risks and helping engineering teams address them. CAST AI operates inside customers' production
items.desc: CAST AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, CAST AI continuously optimises performance, reliability and efficiency in production. More than 2,100 companies rely on CAST AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, Hugging Face, NielsenIQ, Swisscom and TGS. We are headquartered in Miami and operate as a remote-first company across 34 countries in Europe, North America, Latin America and APAC. In January 2026, CAST AI reached unicorn status following a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group. About the role CAST AI is hiring its first dedicated Security Engineer. Security is currently handled alongside other responsibilities by engineers across the product organisation. As the company grows, we need someone whose full-time focus is understanding the security of our platform, identifying the highest-impact risks and helping engineering teams address them. CAST AI operates inside customers' production environments. Customers grant the platform cloud credentials, cluster access and permission to delete, move and resize workloads. Every permission needs to be justified, every action needs to be attributable and every component needs to be assessed as part of a wider attack surface. You will work across a multi-tenant platform spanning AWS, GCP and Azure, Kubernetes environments, microservices, CI/CD pipelines and AI agents that make autonomous decisions in production. You will help make the secure path the easiest path for engineering teams. This is a technical, hands-on individual contributor role. You will not be expected to implement every security control yourself, but you will identify risks, define practical mitigations, guide the teams responsible for implementation and drive the most important issues through to closure. You will report to Mantas Norvaiša and work closely with engineering teams, the Platform team and Danielius, who leads the non-technical side of compliance. What you will do Learn CAST AI's architecture, infrastructure and engineering workflows, then identify security flaws and material risks. Set up, operate and continuously tune cloud security tooling such as Wiz so it produces high-signal findings that engineering teams can act on. Build threat models for the product and backend architecture, including trust boundaries, service-to-service authentication, customer-cluster access, secrets and attack paths. Assess and prioritise findings using evidence, business impact and exploitability rather than treating every alert equally. Present the most important risks to engineering and company leadership and build the case for addressing them. Advise engineering teams on practical security improvements. Drive the implementation of security controls across engineering, including production access, identity, secrets management and secure CI/CD practices. Work with the relevant teams to ensure security controls are implemented, tracked and maintained. Help translate compliance requirements into meaningful technical work and evidence. Contribute to security standards for cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, software supply chains and AI-enabled systems. Support the development of security signals and incident-response practices while helping reduce alert noise. Use scripting, prototypes or code where helpful to validate risks, automate security workflows or support engineering teams. This is not a software development role, but strong software-engineering fundamentals are important. What you will bring At least 5–6 years of professional security experience. Around 10 years or more would be ideal. Hands-on experience setting up and running cloud security tooling in production, such as Wiz, Upwind or a similar platform, and turning findings into fixes. Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure security across compute, networking, IAM, storage and service communication. Practical experience with at least one of AWS, GCP or Azure, with the ability to reason about how cloud systems work and how they can fail. Strong understanding of Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure. Experience threat modelling real systems using STRIDE or a similar method, and the ability to lead engineering teams through the process. Strong software-engineering fundamentals, including the ability to understand and reason about software architecture, distributed systems and infrastructure. Ability to write or review code and automation in Go or Python. Strong written and spoken English. A proactive, adaptable approach and comfort working in a fast-moving environment where the security function is being built from the ground up. The ability to explain architectural choices and their trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. It is a strong plus if you bring: Experience with data products, federated data models or reusable data capabilities. Knowledge of embedded systems, automotive or systems engineering. Experience working across organizational or domain boundaries. Interest in how trusted engineering data can support AI-enabled applications. You bring a collaborative, pragmatic approach and are comfortable working through open questions with others. items.desc: Ben jij een data scientist die energie haalt uit het verbeteren, versnellen en vereenvoudigen van processen voor klanten én collega’s? Wat je gaat doen Binnen het AI-kernteam van NN Pensioen werk je aan uiteenlopende en betekenisvolle AI-oplossingen, van voorspelmodellen tot het slim automatiseren van processen. Als data scientist vertaal je businessvraagstukken naar krachtige data-oplossingen en draag je bij aan het succesvol in productie brengen hiervan. Je ziet kansen, denkt mee over nieuwe toepassingen en versnelt de ontwikkeling van innovatieve oplossingen. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI-oplossingen, waaronder Generative AI, LLMs, Cognitive Services en OpenAI Samenwerken met collega’s uit de business om hun behoeften te vertalen naar AI-oplossingen Signaleren van kansen om bedrijfsprocessen te optimaliseren met behulp van AI en waarde toe te voegen voor de klant Continu verbeteren van modellen die in productie zijn, zodat ze blijvend waarde leveren Wat wij jou bieden NN investeert in een inclusieve, inspirerende werkomgeving en in vaardigheden en competenties voor de toekomst. Daarbij passen arbeidsvoorwaarden die aansluiten bij wat er vandaag nodig is én die rekening houden met de toekomst. Zo bieden we onze medewerkers de mogelijkheid het beste uit zichzelf te halen. items.desc: Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld. Din roll Som AI-utvecklare blir du en nyckelperson i utvecklingen av vår AI-plattform och de tjänster som byggs på den. Du utvecklar AI-applikationer, API:er och integrationer som kopplar samman plattformens olika komponenter med övriga system i vår IT-miljö. Rollen innebär även att anpassa och vidareutveckla open source-komponenter för att skapa skalbara, säkra och verksamhetsanpassade lösningar. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från data- och modellintegration till automatiserade arbetsflöden och användarnära AI-lösningar. Tillsammans med arkitekter, plattformsutvecklare och andra specialister bidrar du till att bygga en robust AI-förmåga som skapar verkligt värde för verksamheten. Det här är en unik möjlighet att komma in i ett tidigt skede där en ny AI-förvaltning etableras. Du får möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, arbetssätt och framtida plattformsförmågor samtidigt som du är med och bygger organisationens långsiktiga AI-kapacitet. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Utveckla och vidareutveckla AI-applikationer och AI-drivna tjänster Bygga och förvalta API:er samt integrationer mellan olika system och plattformar Implementera och vidareutveckla lösningar baserade på generativ AI och stora språkmodeller (LLM) Anpassa och integrera open source-komponenter för verksamhetens behov Utveckla automatiserade arbetsflöden och effektiva dataflöden Arbeta med databearbetning, modellintegration och RAG-baserade lösningar Säkerställa kvalitet genom testning, felsökning och versionshantering Samarbeta nära arkitekter, plattformsutvecklare och verksamheten för att omsätta behov till tekniska lösningar Bidra till utvecklingen av vår AI-plattform, våra arbetssätt och framtida tekniska vägval Din profil För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är en nyfiken, initiativtagande och lösningsorienterad utvecklare med ett starkt intresse för AI och modern systemutveckling. Du drivs av att omsätta ny teknik till praktiska lösningar och trivs i en miljö där innovation kombineras med stabil leverans. Du har ett analytiskt och strukturerat arbetssätt och en förmåga att omsätta komplexa problem till genomförbara lösningar. Samtidigt är du pragmatisk och fokuserar på att skapa verkligt affärsvärde. Eftersom rollen innebär nära samarbete med både tekniska specialister och verksamheten är du en kommunikativ lagspelare som kan förklara komplexa tekniska lösningar på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Vi värdesätter också att du är självgående, ansvarstagande och trivs i en föränderlig miljö där nya tekniker och arbetssätt ständigt utvecklas. Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och forma framtidens AI-förmåga och arbeta med teknik i framkant. Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av: Python API-utveckling och REST Git SQL Containerbaserad utveckling (Docker/Kubernetes) Systemintegrationer Testning och felsökning Meriterande erfarenheter: AI-ramverk som LangChain, LlamaIndex eller Hugging Face RAG-lösningar, prompt engineering eller agentbaserade AI-lösningar Dataplattformar, ETL-flöden och datahantering TypeScript/JavaScript och moderna integrationsmönster Fine-tuning av AI-modeller Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här. Om du är intresserad av vilka förmåner som du kan ta del av som anställd på Saab i Sverige, kan du läsa om dem här. Våra värderingar kan du läsa om här. Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

items.desc: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We’re also co-building alongside leading AI companies. Position Overview Hilbert is building a reasoning engine that must navigate non-deterministic user behavior across data silos. Our demand intelligence platform doesn’t just call APIs. It solves the hard problem of orchestrating multi-step inference over messy, high-stakes enterprise data where deterministic answers don’t exist. We’re looking for an AI Engineer who can build production-grade AI systems end-to-end, from prototype to pipeline to product, with the ownership and urgency of a startup culture. This is not a “wire up a prompt chain and move on” role. You’ll own core pieces of the AI stack that power Hilbert’s platform: designing agent architectures, building evaluation systems, and making hard tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, and cost in production. You’ll ship fast while the spec is still evolving, and you’ll explain what you’re building (and why) clearly to the rest of the team. If you think in systems, have opinions about how agentic workflows should actually work, and want to build AI products that drive real enterprise outcomes, we want to meet you. What you’ll own first: evaluation and testing for our agents Hilbert’s agents are in production with enterprise customers today. Before we expand what they do, we need to know, reproducibly, when a change makes them better or worse. You’ll design the eval harness, define what “correct” means for a multi-step agent trajectory, build the regression gates that run before anything ships, and turn production failures into test cases. From there, your scope widens to retrieval, orchestration, and execution across the AI stack. What You’ll Do Own the evaluation layer for our agents: harnesses, metrics, golden datasets, regression gates, and human-in-the-loop review. Architect and implement agent workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent, including state memory, routing, tool registries, and recovery paths. Own systems from experimentation through production, and operate them once they’re live: tracing, monitoring, latency, cost-per-task budgeting, and on-call for what you build. Diagnose real production failures (hallucination, tool misuse, retrieval misses, silent degradation) and turn each one into a durable fix and a test. Set the technical standard for agent work at Hilbert: review designs, define patterns others build on, and raise the bar across the team. Collaborate closely with the founding team and cross-functional partners, communicating tradeoffs, progress, and technical decisions clearly. Make pragmatic engineering decisions under ambiguity: ship, learn, iterate. Our current hurdles: the kinds of problems you’ll walk into on day one Intelligent retrieval across different approaches. Our agents need the right information at exactly the right moment. The challenge isn’t picking one retrieval method. It’s combining RAG, graph-based retrieval, and other approaches into one strategy that fetches the most relevant content exactly when the agent needs it, no more and no less. Agentic workflows that solve real-world problems. Workflows have to be robust enough to handle the unexpected. When an agent hits an edge case, missing data, or a situation it wasn’t designed for, it needs to reason through it: use the context it has, escalate to a human when it can’t, and never fail silently. Evaluation beyond vibes. We need systematic, reproducible evals that actually predict real-world performance. If you’ve built custom evaluators for RAG or agent workflows, we want to talk. Execution and real-world integration. An agent that only surfaces insights isn’t enough. We’re building systems where agents take action: integrating with external platforms, executing workflows, and doing real work with the information they have, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints that keep enterprise trust intact. Who Thrives In The Role We care about what you’ve shipped and how you think. We expect 4+ years of building production software, with at least 2 of those on LLM or agentic systems that real users depend on. Must-haves 4+ years of production software engineering (APIs, services, data infrastructure). You’ve owned code other people depended on, with tests, CI/CD, and on-call attached. 2+ years building LLM or agent systems that shipped to production and were adopted by real users. items.desc: Van slimme chatbots tot geavanceerde LLM-oplossingen: bij ilionx bouw je aan AI-toepassingen die ertoe doen. Jij brengt de visie, wij bieden de ruimte, technologie en collega’s om het waar te maken. Jouw nieuwe functie als AI Engineer Vanuit ons kantoor in Den Bosch werk je als AI Engineer aan het praktisch én schaalbaar toepassen van AI bij onze klanten. Jij bouwt niet alleen slimme oplossingen, je helpt organisaties ook echt vooruit. Dat betekent: meedenken met de klant, de juiste vragen stellen, kansen signaleren en AI vertalen naar concrete bedrijfswaarde. Je werkt aan innovatieve AI-oplossingen met bewezen impact. Denk aan het ondersteunen van besluitvorming met machine learning (human-in-the-loop), het automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen, en het ontwikkelen van generatieve AI-oplossingen met LLM’s en agents. Je integreert taal-, beeld- en multimodale modellen naadloos in bestaande bedrijfsprocessen en IT-landschappen. Daarnaast bouw je aan slimme chatbots, co-pilots en agent-based systemen die gebruikers ondersteunen en processen versnellen. Je weet hoe je met prompt engineering het maximale uit LLM’s haalt en hoe je generatieve AI koppelt aan interne en externe kennisbronnen met technieken als RAG, vector search en tool calling. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek en toepassing. Samen met data engineers, data scientists en cloudspecialisten werk je aan oplossingen die niet in de la verdwijnen, maar daadwerkelijk in productie draaien. Je ontwerpt mee aan robuuste AI-architecturen en denkt mee over system- en solution design: van probleemdefinitie tot eerste schets en uiteindelijke implementatie. Je werkt met de AI-offeringen van grote public cloud providers (zoals Azure, AWS of GCP) en maakt gebruik van moderne frameworks en tooling zoals LangChain, dSPy, PydanticAI, n8n en MCP. Platforms als Databricks zijn daarbij een pré, geen must. Wat ons onderscheidt: we zoeken hyperdevelopers. Engineers die zelf dagelijks LLM’s en agents inzetten om slimmer en sneller te werken, en die hun kennis actief delen met collega’s én klanten. Wat bieden wij jou: Salaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.000,- o.b.v. 40 uur, plus bonussysteem Volledig hybride werken: bij de klant, op kantoor of vanuit huis Veel ruimte voor initiatief, innovatie en experimenteren Een persoonlijk loopbaantraject, waarin jij bepaalt hoe je je verder ontwikkelt (technisch, inhoudelijk of richting consultancy/architectuur) Samenwerking met gedreven collega’s uit verschillende specialismen binnen Data, AI en Cloud Wat vragen wij van jou: Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen, implementeren en productierijp maken van AI-oplossingen Ervaring met LLM’s, prompt engineering en agent-based toepassingen Ervaring met de AI-offeringen van grote public cloud providers Je hebt meegebouwd aan AI-oplossingen zoals chatbots, co-pilots, classifiers, recommender systems of vergelijkbare toepassingen (verras ons!) Je integreert AI-functionaliteit via API’s, SDK’s en moderne AI-architectuurpatronen Deze eisen geven een richting aan het profiel dat wij zoeken voor deze functie. Voldoe jij niet aan alle eisen maar denk je wel dat dit de functie voor jou is? Dan nodigen wij je graag uit om te solliciteren. Het team De regionale teams bestaan uit experts die jouw groei en kennisontwikkeling ondersteunen. Onze collega’s zijn niet alleen (cloud) back-end data specialisten, maar ook experts in rapportages, dashboards, voorspellende analyses, data-gedreven werken, machine learning en data science. Leuk weetje: in totaal werken er zo’n 350 data specialisten binnen ilionx! Bij ilionx draait het niet alleen om technische expertise, maar ook om de mensen achter de technologie! We hechten waarde aan een cultuur van samenwerking, kennisdeling en inspiratie. Als onderdeel van ons team maak je deel uit van een gemeenschap die gedreven wordt door nieuwsgierigheid, innovatie en een passie voor het creëren van waarde uit data. Of je nu op een van onze kantoren, bij de klant of thuis werkt, bij ilionx krijg je de perfecte omgeving om je passie voor data tot leven te brengen. Lees hier praktijkervaringen van jouw toekomstige ilionx data collega’s!

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: Job Description Agilent is expanding its AI capabilities across scientific, service, commercial, and operational functions. We are building a team of engineers who can help design, deploy, and scale trusted AI solutions that create measurable business impact. We're interested in connecting with experienced professionals across AI Engineering, AI Data Engineering, and related technical disciplines who are passionate about applying AI in real-world environments. Depending on your background and interests, opportunities may focus on AI applications, agentic systems, retrieval foundations, AI-ready data products, platform engineering, or the underlying capabilities that enable AI at scale. You will work within cross-functional AI pods alongside engineers, domain experts, business stakeholders, and platform teams to turn complex business challenges into practical, production-ready solutions. What You May Work On Building production AI applications, agents, and AI-enabled workflows. Designing retrieval foundations for AI solutions, including RAG, vector search, semantic enrichment, and knowledge assets. Developing AI-ready data products with strong foundations in quality, governance, lineage, and reuse. Creating reusable capabilities, patterns, and assets that accelerate future AI use cases across the enterprise. Applying evaluation, monitoring, observability, and governance practices to ensure reliable AI outcomes. Partnering directly with domain experts to understand workflows and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. Leveraging AI-assisted approaches such as metadata generation, entity resolution, and content classification to improve data quality and discoverability. We're Particularly Interested in Professionals with Experience In: AI Engineering AI agents and Agentic Workflows Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) LLM application development AI evaluation and observability AI orchestration and integration Production AI deployment AI Data Engineering Data products and data contracts AI-ready data foundations Metadata management and semantic enrichment Retrieval architecture Vector databases and graph technologies Data quality, governance, and lineage Software & Platform Engineering Full-stack software development Distributed systems and APIs Cloud platforms and enterprise integration Platform engineering Identity, access, and governance controls Qualifications What We're Looking For: Technical Expertise Experience building software, AI, platform, or data solutions in production environments. Familiarity with modern AI technologies, data platforms, and enterprise architectures. Strong engineering foundations and commitment to quality, reliability, and reusability. Domain & Delivery Mindset Strong problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguous environments. Ability to partner closely with business stakeholders, domain experts, and technical teams. An instinct to build solutions that can scale beyond a single project or use case. Communication & Influence Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to explain complex concepts clearly and build credibility through expertise and partnership. Curiosity & Growth Mindset Curiosity about AI, both its opportunities and limitations. Commitment to continuous learning in a rapidly evolving field. Education & Seniority Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent practical experience. Typically, 6+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, AI engineering, data engineering, machine learning, platform engineering, or related disciplines. Additional Details This job has a full time weekly schedule. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. items.desc: TLDR: This isn't a regular engineering job given the autonomy, pace and progression path available. We're looking for a full-stack engineer to help build an agentic commercial insurance brokerage from the ground up. Venture-backed team comprising repeat founders and experts in insurance technology and broking. Why Vara Businesses buy over $1 trillion of commercial insurance every year, and around 90% of it is still run by hand. At Vara, we're building a UK commercial insurance brokerage where we'd like 90% of it to be run by agents. We're doing that in two ways. First, we're making the professionals who help businesses buy insurance 10x more efficient than they are today. Second, we're building for a world where businesses start their insurance journey with AI: Claude, ChatGPT or Grok, or a personal assistant like Muse or Instinct that already knows their business. You'll have extreme ownership and autonomy building the AI operating and distribution system that will reshape a trillion-dollar industry, alongside a low-ego, high-velocity team. What you'll do (key list below but be ready to adapt to what is required given you will be the tech stack): • Own products end to end: work with our brokers, shape the requirements, then build the frontend, backend, agents and evals. • Build for AI-first distribution: connectors, structured APIs and MCP integrations so that AI platforms and personal assistants can ask the right questions and get a quote from Vara. • Turn broking expertise into code: risk gathering, submission packaging, market comparison, insurer chasing, renewal prep. • Build voice agents that take client and insurer calls and hand over cleanly to a broker. • Own the number, not the feature. "Quote turnaround went from three days to four hours" beats "we shipped the thing." Who you are: • 5-10 years' experience • A full-stack engineer who has built production systems that real people depend on • You've shipped agentic systems to production, not demos (side projects count) • You have sharp product instincts and would rather watch a broker work than guess • You're fast and passionate about using AI coding tools • You care more about commercial impact than elegant code • You're willing to learn insurance properly Experience level matters less than the quality of your thinking and what you've shipped. Bonus: MCP and agent integrations, voice AI, RAG, evals, document extraction, early-stage experience. The honest bit: insurance is unglamorous and full of detail that matters, with insurer portals that are decades old. We're regulated, so some things have to be right, not roughly right. And we're early: small codebase, few conventions, not many people to ask at 6pm. Base salary plus equity will be discussed in first call. To apply, send your CV.

This is a senior role where autonomy, ownership, and technical leadership are central. You will own complex backend systems and full-stack features
items.desc: Science advances fastest when researchers can collaborate across boundaries — institutional, geographic, and disciplinary. Research Topics are how Frontiers makes that happen: themed, peer-reviewed article collections where leading researchers from around the world propose a theme, invite contributors, and curate the resulting work into an openly accessible body of knowledge — free for anyone, anywhere to read and build upon. We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with a strong backend lean to join the team that builds and evolves the platform powering this experience. You will work on the Research Topic Management (RTM) application — a distributed .NET system with Vue/Nuxt frontends, SQL Server-heavy data operations, Github/Azure DevOps-driven deployments, and async integration workflows connecting multiple internal services. This is a senior role where autonomy, ownership, and technical leadership are central. You will own complex backend systems and full-stack features end-to-end — from specification refinement and architectural decisions, through implementation, to production monitoring and incident resolution. You will work on real production systems where SQL performance, distributed reliability, and integration correctness matter daily. We have fully embraced AI-based spec-driven design , integrating AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle — using skills, rules, multi-agent workflows, and automation for code review, testing, and code analysis. From specification to implementation, AI tooling shapes how we architect, build, and iterate, making us faster, more deliberate, and focused on what matters most. This isn't an experiment. It's how we work. Your work directly enables researchers worldwide to collaborate, publish openly, and push science forward. Science advances fastest when researchers can collaborate across boundaries — institutional, geographic, and disciplinary. Research Topics are how Frontiers makes that happen. Each Research Topic is a themed collection of peer-reviewed articles built around an emerging or critical area of science. Leading researchers from around the world propose a theme, invite contributors, and curate the resulting work — transforming scattered individual efforts into a coherent, openly accessible body of knowledge. When complete, every collection is published as a free ebook, available to anyone, anywhere. These are not just publications. They are communities of researchers working together toward answers that matter: healthier lives, a more sustainable planet, a deeper understanding of the world we share. The Research Topic Management (RTM) application is the platform that makes this possible at scale. It supports the full lifecycle — from the moment a researcher proposes a topic, through editorial coordination, contributor recruitment, and submission tracking, all the way to publication and closure. RTM gives the teams behind Frontiers the tools they need to turn a scientific idea into open, lasting knowledge — one collection at a time.\ Responsabilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications using .NET, Vue.js, and Nuxt Modernise and replace legacy systems — including migrating older Angular applications to our current Vue and Nuxt stack Own full-stack projects end-to-end, from specification refinement through delivery to production monitoring Collaborate with product managers, architects, and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and determine the best implementation strategy Work effectively within a multinational, cross-functional team to deliver software aligned with business needs Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, and uphold engineering best practices across the team Ensure the quality of delivered solutions through robust testing and review Optimise applications for items.desc:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description
We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles.

What you will do:
Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services.
 Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems.
 Implement and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including vaulting, session management, and just-in-time access.
 Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls.
 Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP.
 Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations.
 Secure cloud identity and access across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM policies, workload identity, and service accounts.
 Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards, policies, and best practices.
 Monitor identity-related threats and support detection and response for account compromise, credential abuse, and privilege escalation.
Experience and qualifications:
6 to 15 years of experience in IAM, security engineering, or a related field. 
 Hands-on experience with at least one major IAM platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or CyberArk. 
 Strong knowledge of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos. 
 Experience with Active Directory and directory services architecture. 
 Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Go, Java, or JavaScript). 
 Solid understanding of cloud IAM models (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM). 
 Experience with MFA, passwordless, and conditional or risk-based access. 
 Familiarity with Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth principles. 
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Additional comments
 This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

items.title: AI Engineer (LLM / RAG) F/H
items.card: Votre mission : transformer l’IA en valeur produit concrète (automatisation, recherche pertinente, meilleure UX) en garantissant qualité, sécurité et conformité en production. Vos missions Concevoir et délivrer des systèmes LLM “production‑grade” : pipelines RAG complets (ingestion, nettoyage, chunking, embeddings, stockage, retrieval, génération). Mettre en place des stratégies de retrieval robustes : hybrid search
items.desc: Vous rejoignez l’équipe Data / IA / Engineering , rattachée au Chief AI Officer , pour concevoir, implémenter et industrialiser des fonctionnalités d’ IA générative (LLM / RAG) au cœur des produits Harvest (CRM patrimonial, outils de conseil, etc.). Votre mission : transformer l’IA en valeur produit concrète (automatisation, recherche pertinente, meilleure UX) en garantissant qualité, sécurité et conformité en production. Vos missions Concevoir et délivrer des systèmes LLM “production‑grade” : pipelines RAG complets (ingestion, nettoyage, chunking, embeddings, stockage, retrieval, génération). Mettre en place des stratégies de retrieval robustes : hybrid search (lexical + vectoriel), filtrage par métadonnées, reranking, approches multi‑stage pour optimiser recall / precision. Réduire les hallucinations et fiabiliser les réponses (grounding, citations internes, guardrails, politiques d’abstention). Construire un framework d’évaluation (tests, métriques de factualité et de couverture, benchmarks continus) et un monitoring LLMOps (latence, coûts, qualité, dérive, feedback utilisateur, traçage des prompts). Industrialiser les pratiques : versioning des prompts/chaînes, A/B testing, rollouts / rollbacks, définition de SLOs. Intégrer sécurité et compliance by design : contrôle d’accès, multi‑tenancy, gestion du PII, auditabilité, OIDC/OAuth2 (ex. Keycloak). Travailler en étroite collaboration avec Product, Engineering, experts métier pour transformer des besoins en fonctionnalités mesurables et documenter les bonnes pratiques (RAG, prompting, LLMOps). Profil Recherché ≥ 5 ans d’expérience en ML / ML Engineering / IA appliquée, avec des réalisations LLM / RAG en production. Excellentes bases de software engineering : APIs, tests, performance, design modulaire, revue de code. Maîtrise des architectures RAG production‑grade et des agents LLM (orchestration, routing, mémoire, modes dégradés). Solide culture LLMOps : évaluation continue, monitoring, A/B testing, rollouts/rollbacks. Stack : Python, SQL, JavaScript, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Airflow, Qdrant (ou équivalent), Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Grafana, OpenTelemetry. À l’aise dans des environnements complexes et réglementés, autonome, structuré·e. Bonus : expérience multi‑agents (router + tools + evaluator), finance / conformité. Côté Soft Skills, Nous Recherchons Une Personne Curieuse, qui voit un monde d’opportunités dans l’IA. Battante, capable de pousser les sujets dans un cadre en construction. Avec un vrai sens de l’ownership, de la décision et de la pédagogie auprès des métiers.

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.title: Embedded Vision Engineer
items.card: About The Role As our new Embedded Vision Engineer – Poultry Innovation , you will play a key role in developing the next generation of vision-based inspection and processing systems for the global poultry industry. This role goes beyond traditional software development. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing embedded vision platforms that power advanced poultry processing and inspection
items.desc: 🚀 We're Hiring: Embedded Vision Engineer – Poultry Innovation That feeling when your vision technology turns complex image data into real-time decisions on the production line… 📍 Location: Boxmeer – Hybrid 🕒 Employment Type: Full-Time 💼 Department: Poultry Innovation 🔍 About The Role As our new Embedded Vision Engineer – Poultry Innovation , you will play a key role in developing the next generation of vision-based inspection and processing systems for the global poultry industry. This role goes beyond traditional software development. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing embedded vision platforms that power advanced poultry processing and inspection solutions. You will work at the intersection of embedded Linux, industrial imaging, artificial intelligence, machine vision, and high-performance computing. You will collaborate closely with innovation, product development, software, electrical, and mechanical engineering teams to create robust vision solutions that deliver accuracy, speed, and reliability in demanding industrial environments. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in embedded software engineering, machine vision, Linux-based systems, and industrial automation with a passion for innovation and technical leadership. 🧠 Key Responsibilities Embedded Vision System Development & Architecture Architect, develop, and maintain embedded vision systems running on Linux-based ARM platforms. Design scalable and reliable vision system architectures supporting next-generation poultry processing equipment. Integrate industrial cameras, sensors, and illumination systems for high-speed image acquisition and analysis. Optimize system performance to meet real-time processing and throughput requirements in industrial environments. Support standardization and future-proofing of vision platforms across multiple product lines. Software Engineering & AI Deployment Develop and optimize software components in C++ and Python for image processing, machine control, and data handling. Build containerized vision applications using Docker for scalable deployment and reproducible environments. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support rapid and reliable software delivery. Deploy and manage AI inference workloads using Triton Inference Server to enable real-time decision-making on embedded hardware. Develop lightweight configuration and monitoring interfaces where needed. Vision Technology Integration & Validation Work in multidisciplinary project teams alongside project managers, vision application engineers, system architects, electrical engineers, and software engineers. Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and product teams to ensure seamless integration of vision systems into complete machine solutions. Troubleshoot complex system-level issues involving hardware, software, networking, and camera interfaces. Define validation and verification strategies and execute system testing activities. Ensure solutions meet quality, reliability, safety, and performance requirements. Technical Leadership & Innovation Lead technical design reviews and contribute to key architectural decisions. Mentor junior engineers and support technical skill development within the team. Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle. Contribute to the long-term vision technology roadmap for Poultry Innovation. Identify and evaluate emerging technologies in embedded computing, AI, and machine vision to maintain technology leadership. 🛠️ What kind of person are you? You Will Recognize Yourself In The Following Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related technical field. 5+ years of experience in embedded software development, machine vision, or industrial automation environments. Strong experience with Embedded Linux and ARM-based platforms. Proficiency in C++ and Python software development. Maîtrise des concepts fondamentaux : prompt engineering appliqué, architectures RAG et connecteurs de contexte.  Conduct experiments, analyze results, and communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

items.desc: Location Barcelona Employment Type Full time Location Type Hybrid Department Engineering Hello ✨ We’re HappyScribe, a profitable, 100% bootstrapped AI company based in Barcelona. We built one of the web’s most accurate multilingual transcription platforms, trusted by hundreds of thousands of users each month . That product funds our freedom to create what’s next—no investors, no burn rate, just focus. Now we’re taking that same tech and expertise to a bigger frontier: turning conversations into intelligence. We’re building the layer where speech becomes memory, insights become action, and teams work with more clarity and speed. You’d be joining a team of ~17 people, close-knit and pragmatic. Some of us are scaling a mature, revenue-generating platform. Others are prototyping new products that push the limits of speech and agentic AI . We move fast but think long-term. There’s room here to shape, ship, and own real products — not pitch decks. About the role… We're looking for an AI Engineer to work on the AI layer that powers HappyScribe Intelligence features. You will work on building features that bring together LLMs, speech models, and retrieval systems to address real user problems. This role is for builders obsessed with making AI actually work — engineers who'd rather ship a clever prompt chain that solves a real problem than debate model architectures in Slack or over-engineer multi-agent frameworks that become quickly obsolete. What you will do… Own AI features end-to-end — from problem discovery to prompt design to production. You'll build the systems that turn conversations into intelligence: summaries, search, actions, memory. Build and maintain our evaluation framework. You'll design evals that actually catch regressions, iterate on prompts with confidence, and keep quality high as models change under us. Optimize our AI infrastructure for speed, cost, and reliability. Provider routing, caching strategies, chunking approaches, latency budgets — you'll own the trade-offs. Stay dangerously current. The field moves weekly. You'll bring new techniques to the team and know when a new model or approach is worth the migration cost. Ship with the product team. You'll work closely with designers and engineers to integrate AI features that feel native, not bolted on. Example projects: Design and ship semantic search across transcripts using embeddings and hybrid retrieval. Build an agentic system that turns meeting notes into drafted emails, tasks, and follow-ups. Create a prompt evaluation pipeline that catches quality regressions before users do. What you will bring… You're a seasoned engineer (5+ years) who's spent the last 2+ years deep in AI applications. You’ve shipped LLM-based features to production — not demos, not notebooks, real products with real users. You stay current by doing, not just reading. New model drops Tuesday, you've tested it by Thursday, and you know whether it's worth a migration or just hype. You're fluent in prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and evaluation frameworks. You've debugged retrieval that returned garbage and prompts that hallucinated confidently. You think in trade-offs: latency vs. quality, cost vs. capability, speed-to-ship vs. technical debt. items.desc: Beschrijving Rol en context Als QA & AI Evaluation Engineer waak je over de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid van het AIHub Platform . Dit is het centrale, intern ontwikkelde AI-platform van Delen Private Bank, dat geïntegreerd is in de processen en systemen van de bank. AI-oplossingen gedragen zich niet altijd voorspelbaar. Daarom gaat kwaliteit hier verder dan alleen de vraag: “Werkt de functionaliteit zoals bedoeld?” Jij bepaalt hoe we meten of een AI-toepassing correct, consistent, veilig en bruikbaar is. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat dit ook zo blijft na wijzigingen aan modellen, prompts of data. Je werkt nauw samen met AI Engineers, developers, business analysts, domeinexperten en stakeholders . Daarbij combineer je sterke QA-expertise met analytisch inzicht in AI-systemen . Je vertaalt verwachtingen vanuit de business naar meetbare evaluatiecriteria, bouwt en onderhoudt evaluation datasets en integreert geautomatiseerde evaluaties in onze delivery pipelines. Verantwoordelijkheden Analyse & Evaluation Design Je werkt samen met business analysts en domeinexperten om verwachtingen rond het gedrag van AI te vertalen naar meetbare acceptatie- en evaluatiecriteria . Je definieert evaluation datasets (golden datasets) die realistische gebruiksscenario’s weerspiegelen, inclusief edge cases en failure scenarios. Je bepaalt evaluation rules , zowel: deterministisch : bijvoorbeeld format validation, schema checks, exacte of gestructureerde matches, verplichte bronvermelding en correcte tool calls; non-deterministisch : bijvoorbeeld LLM-as-a-judge, semantic similarity, groundedness en relevance. Je kalibreert LLM-as-a-judge evaluations ten opzichte van menselijke beoordelingen, zodat geautomatiseerde scores betrouwbaar blijven. Je helpt mee de evaluation strategy, coverage en quality thresholds te bepalen, zowel per use case als voor het platform als geheel. Test Execution & Validation Je voert functionele en non-functionele tests uit op verschillende platformcomponenten, zoals API’s, integraties, dataverwerking en user interfaces. Je evalueert RAG applications op retrieval quality, groundedness en correcte bronvermelding. Je test agentic flows , waaronder correcte tool selection, parameters, multi-turn behaviour en error handling. Je voert adversarial testing en red teaming uit, bijvoorbeeld rond prompt injection, jailbreaks, het lekken van vertrouwelijke of persoonlijke gegevens en ongewenste of misleidende output. Je valideert of guardrails en content filters correct werken. Je registreert bugs in Azure DevOps , volgt de oplossing ervan actief op en valideert opgeloste issues. Je faciliteert UAT-sessies met eindgebruikers en verzamelt gestructureerde feedback. Automation & Continuous Improvement Je monitort regression bij model upgrades en prompt changes en vergelijkt verschillende versies op een objectieve manier. Je onderhoudt evaluation datasets op basis van online evaluations en feedback uit productie . Onvoorziene edge cases zet je om in permanente test cases binnen de standaard eval sets. Je volgt de kwaliteit in productie op via monitoring & tracing , bijvoorbeeld aan de hand van quality scores, drift en gebruikersfeedback, en signaleert achteruitgang tijdig. Je gebruikt zelf AI tooling om test cases en synthetische testdata te genereren en resultaten sneller te analyseren. Collaboration & Platform Enablement Je helpt bij het uitbouwen van herbruikbare evaluation standards, templates en guidelines , zodat teams die op AIHub bouwen zelf de kwaliteit van hun use cases kunnen meten. Je schrijft annotation guidelines en betrekt domeinexperten bij het reviewen en labelen van output. Je communiceert bevindingen helder naar zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders. Profiel en competenties Je hebt een uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands en een goede kennis van het Engels. Kennis van het Frans is een plus, onder andere met het oog op meertalige evaluaties. Je hebt ervaring als QA Engineer binnen een agile IT-omgeving en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Je hebt hands-on ervaring met het testen of evalueren van LLM applications , of je kunt aantonen dat je binnen dit domein al een sterke maturiteit hebt opgebouwd. Je begrijpt de uitdagingen van non-deterministic systems en weet hierover op een betrouwbare en statistisch onderbouwde manier te rapporteren. Je hebt een kritische en creatieve “break it”-mindset waarmee je actief op zoek gaat naar edge cases en abuse scenarios. Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht. Je bent een echte teamplayer met uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Basiskennis van of ervaring met Python voor test automation en evaluation scripts, bijvoorbeeld pytest; LLM evaluation frameworks , zoals LangSmith, Azure AI Foundry Evaluations, promptfoo, DeepEval, Ragas en Langfuse; concepten zoals RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agents en tool calling ; API testing , bijvoorbeeld met Postman, REST en OpenAPI; Azure DevOps voor test …

items.desc: DIGWAY recrute un(e) Analyste IA appliquée & Ingénierie des processus pour intervenir sur un projet stratégique chez l'un de nos clients basé à Monaco, au sein d'un environnement bancaire exigeant et en pleine transformation. Vous interviendrez sur l'identification des opportunités d'automatisation, la conception et le déploiement de solutions d'IA générative, ainsi que l'amélioration continue des processus existants, dans le respect des exigences de gouvernance, de sécurité et de conformité du secteur bancaire. Vos missions En tant qu' Analyste IA appliquée & Ingénierie des processus , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la transformation des pratiques métiers et le déploiement de solutions d'intelligence artificielle. items.desc: Most AI internships ask you to write prompts or do bite-sized changes here and there. This one asks you to rebuild how a deep-tech company works, including proving it worked. Full-time · on-site in Delft · 4–6 months, starting January 2027 · €750/month + commute + vacation days Why this internship You’ll be coached daily by an experienced generalist whose career spans aerospace deep-tech, AI transformation for enterprise clients, and leading the computational modelling at a major nonprofit from inception through >€200M funding to date. You’ll work inside a fast-moving deep-tech startup with more ownership than most interns ever get, on real company infrastructure, with real engineers who will tell you very quickly if something doesn’t work. The learning curve will be steep. If you want six months that move your skill set a few levels up, keep on reading. About us At Emergent we build counter-drone solutions and autonomy systems for teams of drones working together in the real world - defense and emergency response. Bad thinking gets exposed fast in our line of work so we embrace complexity and handle it pragmatically. Small team, high standards, real room to try things and break them intelligently. The role: two streams Stream A - AI Enablement (~60–70%) We’re making Emergent AI-native: redesigning how we work around what AI now makes possible, not just adding AI to existing processes. The groundwork and underlying analysis are done, the first systems are running, and the next phase is yours. Four scoped example sub-tracks (exact tasks will be determined based on immediate priority at the moment of onboarding): A1 - The AI coding harness. Build the scaffolding that makes AI-assisted development reliable: layered instruction files (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md as a navigable table of contents, not a monolith), well-designed tools for just-in-time codebase retrieval, mechanical CI invariants that enforce architecture boundaries, a plan-execute-verify loop, and explicit governance - permission separation, human approval gates for destructive actions, cost ceilings. Done right, this is a direct path to ~2× productivity per engineer. Phase 1 is built; phases 2–7 are approved and need to be implemented A2 - Integration testing. Today, getting a build from sim to field takes a myriad of fragile manual steps. Miss one and the field testing day is lost. The fix is disciplined systems engineering - containerization, vertical integration, versioned scenarios, CI-gated integration tests - with AI used to accelerate building the pipeline and to triage failures, not to execute test logic. Target: collapse the number of steps to 1–3. A3 - The AI reviewer. As AI speeds up code production, verification becomes the binding constraint. Phase 2 (yours): take it to production: extend it across the codebase, add cross-repo impact checks, tune it against real reviewer feedback, and measure whether it actually shortens review. Target: reviewers start from checked findings, not a blank page. A4 - The company brain. Critical knowledge lives in people’s heads, chat threads and meetings, and leaves when they do. The fix is a company knowledge base with low-friction capture (automated pipelines from the tools we already use, structured records instead of free-text notes, standard handover files), built to be queried by engineers and AI agents alike. Least friction wins: if it needs a form, nobody fills it in. Phase 2 (yours): connect the sources into one knowledge base that people and agents actually use. All four are the same problem: scattered components and scattered knowledge that need a reliable harness around them. You’ll be the one building that harness. Stream B - Product & Strategy Support (~30–40%) The work a small deep-tech startup always needs: research feeding strategy and product decisions, roadmap input, market analysis, pitch materials, turning messy technical ideas into clear visuals and narratives, supporting demos and external conversations. One week you’re inside a codebase, the next you’re shaping how we pitch it. You’re a fit if you… Black belt common sense and critical thinking: you can tell what matters from what doesn’t Think from first principles and apply Pareto ruthlessly (80% of the outcome, then stop) Understand the basics of coding and how LLMs work well enough to design scaffolding for them: you don’t write production C++, but you know what’s possible and what isn’t Think about verification, governance and failure modes, not just speed Can get busy engineers to adopt something new, sceptics included (especially the sceptics) Handle ambiguity without freezing, and bring structure to messy things Write and communicate clearly (and timely!) Are curious, proactive and want high expectations with real support Are working toward a BSc/MSc in engineering, AI, CS, business informatics, or similar (you must be enrolled in a Dutch university for the whole duration of the internship) Nice to have Hands-on with LLMs, …

items.desc: Qwokka en quelques mots Pendant longtemps, le support client a été traité comme un centre de coût. Résultat : on empile des outils, on gère l’urgence, et la base de connaissance finit par vieillir plus vite que l’équipe ne peut l’entretenir. Avec l’IA, ça change : un service client bien construit devient un levier de rétention (et parfois d’acquisition). Encore faut-il avoir la bonne matière : une connaissance structurée, maintenue, testée ; et des agents IA qui s’améliorent au fil des tickets. La plupart des intégrations s’arrêtent là où l’outil s’arrête. Nous, on pousse plus loin : quand il manque une brique, on la crée (connecteurs, logique métier, automatisations sur-mesure, QA). Résultat : on peut traiter des cas simples… comme des environnements enterprise avec des contraintes réelles. Chez Qwokka, on aide des e-commerces, SaaS et marketplaces à automatiser une grande partie de leur support en quelques mois, en appliquant une logique simple : un support qui s’améliore en continu . On structure la connaissance, on connecte les outils, on automatise ce qui est répétitif, on mesure ; et on itère. Objectif : moins de tâches manuelles, des réponses plus rapides, et une satisfaction assurément plus haute. Contexte du stage Tu rejoins une boîte au tout début , avec de la traction et des clients actifs, et tu travailleras en direct avec le fondateur (ex-CTO et cofondateur d’une startup e-commerce, 7 ans d’expérience sur l’automatisation et les systèmes ops). Ton terrain de jeu : la connaissance et l’amélioration des agents IA . Ce stage est pour toi si tu veux : comprendre comment rendre une IA utile et fiable en conditions réelles itérer vite, mesurer, améliorer (tests, non-régression, qualité) construire des bases de connaissances qui tiennent dans le temps et progressent à chaque ticket Ton rôle On cherche un(e) stagiaire ingénieur analytique et rigoureux(se) pour travailler sur le cœur du système : la connaissance + l’amélioration continue des IA . Concrètement, ton quotidien sera orienté : bases de connaissances (structure, qualité, coverage, mise à jour) itération sur les agents IA (règles, prompts, garde-fous, tests) diagnostic (pourquoi l’IA se trompe, où ça casse, comment corriger) Dans un second temps, si tu montes bien en autonomie, tu pourras progressivement aller vers l’automatisation (n8n / workflows), mais ce n’est pas le cœur du stage au début. items.desc: Senior AI Engineer | Gen AI Overview We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build and operationalise AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership of AI capabilities from technical design and experimentation through to production deployment and continuous improvement. Working closely with software engineers, data teams, product owners and business stakeholders, you will develop reliable AI applications, integrate them into existing platforms and help shape the organisation’s AI engineering practices. A key part of the role will be exploring how Generative AI and Agentic AI can support complex workflows, automate tasks and improve decision-making. Responsibilities Design, develop and deploy production-ready AI and Generative AI applications. Build LLM-powered solutions, including RAG pipelines, AI assistants and intelligent information retrieval. Design and implement agentic workflows using tool calling, orchestration and multi-step task execution where appropriate. Develop robust backend services and APIs, primarily using Python, to integrate AI capabilities with business applications and enterprise systems. Evaluate foundation models and AI frameworks based on quality, performance, security, latency and cost. Build AI evaluation frameworks, automated tests and feedback loops to improve model and application reliability. Implement monitoring, observability and tracing for AI systems in production. Apply security, privacy, access controls and responsible AI principles throughout the development lifecycle. Collaborate with cloud, data and software engineering teams on deployment, CI/CD and scalable architecture. Take ownership of deployed AI solutions, troubleshooting issues and continuously improving performance. Contribute to technical standards, architecture decisions and knowledge sharing across the engineering team. Requirements Proven experience as a Senior AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, GenAI Engineer or in a similar technical role. Strong Python development skills and solid software engineering fundamentals. Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based applications in production. Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLM architectures, prompt engineering and RAG. Practical experience with agentic AI concepts, including agent orchestration, tool/function calling and multi-step workflows. Experience developing APIs and integrating AI solutions with databases, applications and external services. Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings and semantic search. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud. Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing and production monitoring. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. Comfortable working with multidisciplinary teams and taking technical ownership.

Lieu : Vélizy-Villacoublay, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital.  Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Rejoignez-nous sur le campus Vélizy qui héberge une grande diversité d’activités Thales, aéro, défense, civile,... A l'ouest de Paris, ce site offre un environnement de travail équipé des dernières innovations technologiques et propose des services permettant de concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle. 
 Contexte : 
 Face à la multiplication des données et à la complexité croissante des opérations, Thales SIX GTS développe une plateforme Data & IA pour améliorer la compréhension des situations et accélérer la prise de décision. Conçue comme une alternative européenne, cette plateforme modulaire propose des services accessibles en self-service avec des parcours standardisés et recommandés (golden paths), tout en répondant aux enjeux de souveraineté numérique, de partage sécurisé de l’information, d’interopérabilité et de résilience.
 Votre rôle clé : 
 Définir l’architecture des capacités IA de la plateforme : outils de développement et d’industrialisation de modèles IA, chatbot, environnement de création d’applications no-code et services IA intégrés. Assurer leur cohérence avec l’architecture de la plateforme et les exigences de performance, de sécurité et d’exploitation.
 Vos missions seront les suivantes :
 - Traduire les besoins métier en solutions d’architecture IA, incluant outils MLOps, agents intelligents, catalogue de modèles et registres.
 - Concevoir une architecture modulaire adaptée aux déploiements on-premise, edge et aux parcours self-service.
 - Évaluer et intégrer des solutions existantes (externes ou open source) en garantissant leur compatibilité avec la plateforme.
 - Définir les interfaces entre capacités IA, données et services, tout en intégrant exigences de sécurité, gouvernance et traçabilité.
 - Gérer le cycle de vie des modèles IA : évaluation, versionnement, déploiement et supervision en optimisant qualité, performance et coûts.
 - Accompagner les équipes techniques via prototypage, support au développement, gestion des évolutions et documentation des bonnes pratiques.
 Profil recherché : 
 Vous justifiez d’une expérience avérée de plus de 5 ans en tant qu’architecte sur des produits complexes, incluant des projets en MLOps, déploiement de LLM, plateformes no-code/low-code et intégration de services IA.
 Vous maîtrisez les pratiques MLOps et LLMOps, notamment l’évaluation, le versionnement, le déploiement et la supervision de modèles à l’aide d’outils tels que Kubeflow et MLFlow, ainsi que l’intégration de modèles et d’outils via des catalogues, protocoles et registres MCP.
 Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie des technologies d’IA générative (LLM, RAG, systèmes agentiques), de la conception d’API et SDK (Swagger, OpenAPI, REST, GraphQL), et comprenez parfaitement les pipelines de données, les ontologies et les graphes de connaissances.
 Vous êtes attentif aux questions de sécurité, gouvernance et traçabilité des services IA, tout en étant familier avec les outils de gestion de projet comme JIRA et Gitlab.
 Doté d’un leadership technique et d’une capacité à collaborer transversalement, vous faites preuve d’analyse, de synthèse et de pédagogie pour argumenter vos choix avec rigueur, pragmatisme et sens des priorités.
 Le poste nécessite une présence sur nos sites de Vélizy et Issy-les-Moulineaux.
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !
